description: Slapy Trail Maniacs is a challenging trail race in the picturesque surroundings of the Slapy Reservoir in the Central Bohemian Region. It offers three courses of 61 km, 47 km, and 33 km, crossing rugged terrain with significant elevation gain. The race is suited to experienced runners looking to test their abilities in nature and earn points toward their UTMB Index. The race hub is in the village of Cholín; start times vary by course and take place on Saturday. The organizers also provide accommodation and refreshments during the race.
course_highlights: 61 km course with 2,300 m of ascent and 2,400 m of descent
47 km course with 1,850 m of ascent and descent
Scenic routes around the Slapy Reservoir with technical sections
additional: The 61 km race starts at 7:00 in Nečín, the 47 km race starts at 9:00 in Cholín, and the 33 km race starts at 12:00 by the Živohošť Bridge. The race cutoff is 23:00 in Cholín. Accommodation is available for 250 Kč per night in a bed, or on a sleeping mat in the common room. Registration changes are free until 12 October 2025; after that, a 100 Kč fee applies. The terrain includes trails, off-trail sections, rocky areas, and climbs. The race offers accommodation, set start times and cutoffs, and contributes to the UTMB Index.

name: Olomoucký kros
location: Stadion AK Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Olomouc Cross is a traditional cross-country race organized by AK Olomouc and held at the AK Olomouc stadium. The race features a challenging 9 km off-road course that tests runners’ endurance and strength. The main category starts at 10:15, and the race is part of the official Czech Running calendar under the Czech Athletics Federation. The organizers invite runners of all levels to take part in this popular event in Olomouc.
course_highlights: 9 km cross-country course on off-road terrain
Start and finish at the AK Olomouc stadium
Challenging terrain suited to endurance runners
additional: The race is held at the AK Olomouc stadium; registration and further details are not specified.

name: Skalička run
description: Skalička Run is an off-road running event set in the picturesque valley of the Lubě stream in South Moravia. It offers three interconnected routes of 7, 13 and 22 kilometres, running mostly through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths. The route is gently undulating, with a few hills, and is suitable for recreational runners and those who prefer a relaxed pace and want to enjoy the beautiful countryside and colourful autumn scenery. The course is well marked, and the stream crossings are shallow and easy to get across. During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance.
course_highlights: Off-road route running mostly through forests and meadows, away from paved roads
The longest route is 22 km, with three interconnected loops and a moderate elevation gain of 436 m
Autumn run over fallen leaves, with a well-marked course and shallow stream crossings
additional: During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance. The course is thoroughly marked with arrows and trail ribbons. The stream crossings are shallow and can be crossed with dry feet using a footbridge. The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. Trail running; registration details are not specified; an autumn race with a beautiful natural atmosphere.

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Hradečák is part of the Leskros series, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature. The race offers various running categories, including a half marathon, a 10K, and shorter distances for children and young people. It also includes canicross categories for different age groups and experience levels. The race takes place in the beautiful forest surroundings of Hradec Králové and is suitable for the whole family, including beginner runners.
course_highlights: GELOREN and MIZUNO forest routes of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km)
Canicross distances from 1 km for children up to 4 km for experienced competitors
Aid stations along the course and at the finish, chip timing, and a unique finisher’s medal
additional: The entry fee includes a unique finisher’s medal, a Speedcup cup, chip timing, drinks, refreshments, a race photo, gifts from partners, and parking arrangements. Canicross equipment can be borrowed by prior arrangement. Categories for children and adults, including junior and non-competitive categories for beginners. Aid stations along the course and at the finish, prize money for elite canicross competitors. Trail running and canicross, categories for children and adults, registration opens in December, the event includes charity activities and the option to borrow equipment.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
description: KEEN Prague Park Race in Prokopské údolí is a running race in beautiful natural surroundings within sight of Prague. The race offers a unique atmosphere and a course through a picturesque valley on both natural and paved paths. Prokopské údolí is an ideal place for nature-loving runners who want to take on a sporting challenge in peaceful, scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: The course follows paved and unpaved paths in Prokopské údolí
Natural terrain with picturesque views and scenic sections
A race near the city of Prague, with the atmosphere of a nature park
additional: The course is accessible as part of the race; no wave divisions or capacity limits are specified. After registering, participants will receive payment instructions by email. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, which also includes races in Průhonice Park, Divoká Šárka and Konopiště. Trail running, multiple races in various parks in Prague, online registration, pre-race runs and events featuring KEEN shoe testing

name: Běhej Valachy
description: Běhej Valachy is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of Velké Karlovice and the surrounding area in the Beskydy Mountains. The race gives athletes of all ages and fitness levels the chance to test themselves in beautiful countryside, with views of the hills of Wallachia. Since 2013, it has been part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers attractive prizes and prize money. Come and enjoy a run in the heart of Wallachia and experience the unique atmosphere of this sporting celebration.
course_highlights: Picturesque valley of Velké Karlovice and the surrounding area
Running in the Beskydy countryside among the hills of Wallachia
Traditional race with a long history, part of the series since 2013
additional: The race is part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers events in various disciplines for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers are MORAVIA EVENTS s.r.o. and BESKYDY OUTDOOR s.r.o. The race director can be reached at +420 602 275 790. The race routes follow paved roads and forest trails, with the option to relax in thermal pools. Registration opens at 8:00, and races start at 9:30. Course maps are available on mapy.cz.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
description: The Golden Emil Zátopek Marathon Ostrava is a prestigious running event held on a fast, certified course in Ostrava. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race and mixed team race, and welcomes every runner, whether a beginner or an experienced athlete. The atmosphere is professional, with world-class elite runners and extensive facilities including refreshments, music and sports shopping. The course is one loop, with the start and finish at the famous Vítkovice Stadium, where Emil Zátopek set his records.
course_highlights: Fast, certified course in Ostrava
Start and finish at Vítkovice Stadium
The chance to run alongside the world’s elite runners
additional: Race entry can also be purchased on-site in cash or by QR code during registration. The race pack includes an original Macron technical T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, refreshments during and after the race, a large expo, and free taping and physiotherapy care. The race takes place on a one-loop course, with partial traffic restrictions in effect during the event from 8:50 to 15:00. The event includes various categories, including relay races, and supports charitable activities. It is held with the support of the City of Ostrava and the Moravian-Silesian Region.

name: Moravská Sázava
location: Zábřeh na Moravě, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Moravská Sázava Ultra 50 is a challenging 50 km ultramarathon that follows the valley of the Moravská Sázava River from Zábřeh through Lázek to the river’s source on Buková hora. The route offers beautiful natural scenery, including Březná Nature Park and the Suchý vrch–Buková hora Nature Reserve, where the race also finishes. The total elevation change is 698 metres of descent and 1,369 metres of ascent. The race base is at Horský Resort Buková Hora, where runners can rest and refresh themselves after finishing. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge beyond a standard marathon but who do not want to take on an extreme 100 km mountain course.
course_highlights: The route follows the course of the Moravská Sázava River
Březná Nature Park and the Suchý vrch–Buková hora Nature Reserve
Finish at the summit of Buková hora, with 1,369 m of ascent
additional: Participants can hand in their own refreshment bags to be transported to the aid stations. Support is available only at aid stations. Check-in is from 10:00 at the start in the Zábřeh skatepark. Aid stations also serve as relay handover points. Soup with pasta is provided at the finish. Results are recorded both electronically and manually; the relay baton is a GPS tracker with online tracking. Participants can hand in labelled bags for the aid stations at the start. Personal support is allowed only at aid stations.

name: NN Night Run Olomouc

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 Km

description: NN Night Run Olomouc is the largest running event in Olomouc, held at the Flora Exhibition Centre. The event offers a 10 km night run, a 2 × 5 km relay, a 5 km charity run, and a 3 km family run, including children’s races. It brings an unforgettable atmosphere, a varied programme of activities, and support for charitable projects. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can enjoy running through the city at night by the light of headlamps.
course_highlights: Night run through Olomouc, with an atmosphere illuminated by headlamps
Distances ranging from 300 m for children to a 10 km night run
Bellis Run charity race supporting the fight against breast cancer
additional: Registration and race-pack collection take place from 13:00 to 17:30, depending on the race. A baggage drop and changing rooms are available. After the race, participants can enjoy activities including a photo booth, face painting, a bouncy castle, and testing and sales of running equipment and nutritional supplements. Entry can be transferred to another participant online or on site for a fee. All participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish. The race facilities are at the Flora Exhibition Centre. Online registration closes on 19 October 2026 at 18:00; on-site registration is subject to available capacity. The time limit for the main race is 90 minutes.

name: Běh kolem Asuánu
location: Jižní konec retenční nádrže Asuán, Jinonice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Aswan is a traditional cross-country and trail race held on the embankment of the Aswan retention reservoir in Prague 5-Jinonice. It offers courses of varying lengths for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, over gently rolling terrain with a natural surface, finishing on an asphalt straight. The race is organized by Atletika Stodůlky z.s. and is accessible only on foot from nearby stops. The entry fee is voluntary, enabling broad participation by runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Gently rolling course with a natural surface
Asphalt finishing straight
Loops around the Aswan retention reservoir in Prague 5-Jinonice
additional: The start and race office are at the southern end of the Aswan retention reservoir, accessible only on foot from the Ovčí hájek and Galerie Butovice bus stops and the Volcano complex. Categories are divided by age, with course distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 3600 m for men. The entry fee is voluntary. The start and race office are at the southern end of the reservoir; they can only be reached on foot. Information about the 2026 edition has not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: SZÁDVÁR TRAIL
description: The Compressport Szádvár Trail is an exciting trail-running race that winds through the wild, rugged mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst. Participants can discover deer hidden in the forest, a monastery ruin nestled among the trees, the grueling climb up Szádvár, panoramic views from Esztramos Hill, and the atmospheric wine-cellar row near Bódvaszilas. This challenging race welcomes adventure-seekers to Szögliget in October.
course_highlights: The wild, rugged mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst
A monastery ruin nestled among the trees
Panoramic views from Esztramos Hill
additional: The race takes place in October 2026, on varied terrain featuring mountains, valleys, and forests. Participants can register online and enjoy the scenic landscape and challenging course.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap running race takes place in Dióskert, where participants can complete the half-marathon distance in four laps. Those who would prefer to run fewer laps may do so. The race has a voluntary entry fee of 500 HUF per lap, and registration takes place at the venue. After the race, runners are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal, and the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The race route is four laps covering the half-marathon distance
Participants may complete fewer laps
Location: Törökbálint, Dióskert
additional: Registration takes place at the venue. The suggested voluntary entry fee is 500 HUF per lap. Participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. The top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. Hilly terrain; four laps for a half marathon; options to run fewer laps; refreshments provided; medals for all; awards for top finishers.

name: Račiansky kros – jeseň
location: Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros - jeseň je tradičný bežecký pretek konaný v Bratislave, v lokalite Knižková dolina, Bratislava - Rača. Pretek ponúka bežcom možnosť zažiť jesennú atmosféru v príjemnom prostredí amfiteátra a okolia. Organizátori OZ PERUN zabezpečujú kvalitnú prípravu a občerstvenie pre účastníkov. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a bežeckých nadšencov rôznych vekových kategórií.
course_highlights: Pretek v prírodnom prostredí Knižkovej doliny
Štart a cieľ v amfiteátri Bratislava - Rača
Jesenná atmosféra a kvalitné občerstvenie
additional: Prihláška a súhlas dotknutej osoby sú dostupné na stránke. Organizátorom je OZ PERUN. IBAN pre platby: SK09 8330 0000 0025 0082 7935. Trať pozostáva z 80% lesných ciest a 20% asfaltu; preteky sú určené pre mužov, ženy aj deti; registrácia je možná online aj na mieste s obmedzeným počtom štartov; súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské preteky a občerstvenie po preteku.

name: T1 Ring kros
location: Areál T1 ring, Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
description: T1 Ring kros je bežecký pretek konaný v areáli T1 ring vo Vecheci, okres Vranov nad Topľou. Pretek ponúka dve hlavné trate - 9 km s prevýšením približne 210 metrov a 4 km trať, pričom súčasťou je aj nesúťažná disciplína Nordic Walking. Súťažiť môžu muži a ženy v rôznych vekových kategóriách, deti majú samostatný štart. Pretek je súčasťou Bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance 2025 a štartuje o 13:00 hod. pre hlavnú kategóriu a o 11:00 hod. pre deti.
course_highlights: 9 km trať s prevýšením cca 210 metrov
4 km hobby trať a Nordic Walking nesúťažná disciplína
Pretek v areáli T1 ring vo Vecheci
additional: Štart detí o 11:00 hod. Kategórie mužov a žien podľa veku. Súčasť Bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance 2025. Preteky sa konajú v areáli T1 ring, s možnosťou registrácie online aj na mieste, štartovné od 8 do 20 eur, začiatky pretekov o 11:00 a 13:00.

name: Košickopolianska desiatka
description: Košickopolianska desiatka je bežecké podujatie organizované obcou Košická Polianka, ktoré sa koná pred kultúrnym domom v Košickej Polianke. Hlavný pretek štartuje o 13:00 hodine, detské kategórie začínajú o 11:00 hodine. Pretek je rozdelený do viacerých vekových kategórií pre mužov, ženy a deti, čo umožňuje širokú účasť bežcov rôzneho veku. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí si chcú užiť športový deň v príjemnom prostredí obce.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ pred kultúrnym domom v Košickej Polianke
Viacero vekových kategórií pre mužov, ženy a deti
Príjemné prostredie obce Košická Polianka
additional: Detské preteky začínajú o 11:00 hod. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku od 0 rokov až po seniorov. Organizátorom je obec Košická Polianka, kontaktné telefóny a e-maily sú k dispozícii pre záujemcov o informácie. Pretek je súčasťou série ročníkov a ponúka možnosť zúčastniť sa na 10 km trati s rôznymi kategóriami pre všetky vekové skupiny, vrátane detských pretekov.

name: Kobeřický půlmaraton
description: The Kobeřice Half Marathon is a traditional athletics race organized by TJ Sokol Kobeřice, with a long history dating back to 1996. The race is part of the Moravia and Silesia Championships and attracts runners from across the Czech Republic and abroad. The course offers an opportunity for both experienced and recreational runners and is part of a series of public races organized by the athletics club in Kobeřice. The organizers emphasize supporting young people and developing running traditions in the region.
course_highlights: A traditional half-marathon course in Kobeřice, with a history dating back to 1996
Part of the Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships
Natural and urban sections suitable for runners of different levels
additional: The race is part of a series of three public runs organized by TJ Sokol Kobeřice, including the Winter Run through Kobeřice and the Kobeřice Twenty. The athletics club focuses on young people and has a long-standing tradition in the region. In 1998, the half marathon was included in the Moravia and Silesia Championships; in 2005 and 2009, the half-marathon and veterans' championships were held here. The race is part of the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup and the Prajzsko-Opava Running League, and has a history and tradition in the region.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Park Ladronka, Praha 6, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague, aiming to promote a healthy lifestyle and residents’ sense of belonging to their district. The race in Prague 6 takes place in Ladronka Park and is part of the series, where each participant represents their district and contributes to the competition for Prague’s most athletic district. The event is suitable for all ages, including children, seniors, and people with disabilities. The organizers prepare original medals and a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: Race in Ladronka Park in Prague 6
Running series across Prague’s districts
Promoting a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
additional: Each participant represents their district based on their permanent place of residence and contributes to the districts’ scores in the series. The organizers prepare special medals for each category as a keepsake from the race. Race series with multiple events; terrain details not specified; registration information on the website.

name: Jilemnický kros
location: Všesportovní Hraběnka, Jilemnice, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Jilemnice Cross-Country Race is a traditional autumn running race in Jilemnice, held at the Hraběnka All-Sports Complex. The race offers 5- and 10-kilometre courses, mainly along forest roads and paths that are clearly marked and suitable for trail running. The Olda Hrubý Memorial commemorates the race’s founder and attracts runners in all categories. The mass start takes place at 10:00, allowing everyone to share the experience of running in the beautiful autumn surroundings of the Krkonoše Mountains.
course_highlights: The routes follow forest roads and paths in the Hraběnka complex
Two main courses: 5 km for women and 10 km for men
Clearly marked and maintained running routes on natural surfaces
additional: All categories start together in a mass start. The routes are available and marked year-round. The Hraběnka complex offers four running routes of 3, 5, 7 and 10 km, marked with coloured symbols on trees. The race is a memorial to Olda Hrubý and is intended for juniors, adults and veterans. The race is part of local sporting activities, with results available via Strava and other online platforms. The event is open to all age groups and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic, Arka Tołłoczko, Rafał Malitkowski
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale marathon held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The 42.195 km course follows forest and rural roads in a peaceful, uncrowded setting, with course markings and convenient access. The event is organized by local runners, who prioritize a friendly atmosphere and a recreational experience over competition and prizes. It is an excellent choice for fans of cross-country running in natural surroundings.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km course along forest and rural roads
Start and finish on Polna Street in Chwałowice
Every kilometre marked, with convenient parking
additional: No crowds and a relaxed atmosphere without the pressure of competition. The course is laid out and marked by the “Harcownik” Running Club. Participants can take part in a series of four marathons per year on the same course. The event is friendly and recreational in nature. Napoleonic Marathon, mainly urban parkland terrain, training preparations, online registration, various distances, entries, regulations, GPX routes.

name: XLIV Perła Paprocan
description: The Perła Paprocan Run is a unique marathon around Paprocany Lake in Tychy, combining competition with training over almost any distance. Runners can complete one or more laps of the 7-kilometre loop, up to the full marathon distance. The event is recreational and community-oriented, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a welcoming atmosphere among runners. Tychy is the only city in Poland where a marathon is held twice a year, and Perła Paprocan is one of those editions.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop around Paprocany Lake
Paved sections (over 50%), as well as compacted paths and forest trails
A refreshment point with drinks, fruit, and sweets available after each lap
additional: Start and finish at the Paprocany Holiday Centre, ul. Parkowa 17, Tychy. Race bibs can be collected in the days before the event and on race day. The participant limit is 1111. Runners do not need to declare their distance before the race and can change it during the event. Participants aged 12 and over may take part with the written consent of a parent or guardian. Valuables can be left in the baggage deposit. The event is recreational, and runners must keep to one half of the paths to allow others to overtake. Participation from age 12 with a guardian’s consent, refreshment points with drinks and fruit, a limit of 1111 participants, online registration, and an event held twice a year.

location: Bažantnice v Heřmanově Městci, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Enamelled Pheasant is a traditional race organized by the Heřmanův Městec Running Club, held in the beautiful surroundings of the pheasantry in Heřmanův Městec. It is the final round of the Mrdice League and gives runners the chance to test themselves over 1,500 metres in a pleasant atmosphere. The event is suitable for all runners looking for a sporting challenge within a friendly club and league.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the pheasantry on natural terrain
A 1,500-metre race serving as the final event of the Mrdice League
The friendly atmosphere of a running club in Heřmanův Městec
additional: The race is part of the Ruler of Mrdice sports league, which includes a series of races and timed training runs throughout the year. The club also holds regular timed runs every Tuesday and other sporting events in the region. The race is part of the Mrdice League; entry is by voluntary contribution. It takes place in the natural surroundings of the pheasantry, and registration and the start list are available online.

name: Podzimní půlmaraton VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The VAŠE LIGA Autumn Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1 km road race taking place on October 28, 2026, in Prague 4-Braník. The course follows the cycle path along the Vltava from Braník to Vrané and back. It is flat and fast, often allowing runners to achieve personal bests. The race offers a relaxed running atmosphere and is suitable for anyone looking to enjoy a pleasant half-marathon in beautiful surroundings. The first category starts at 11:00 on the cycle path by Kempink 2.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on the cycle path along the Vltava
The course runs from Braník to Vrané and back
Beautiful surroundings and the chance to achieve a personal best
additional: The race starts on the cycle path by Kempink 2 in Prague 4-Braník. The race is organized by VAŠE LIGA; the contact person is Petr Lundák. The course is flat and fast, making it suitable for personal bests. A relaxed running atmosphere is guaranteed. The course is measured by a certified course measurer, and the race uses chip timing. It includes refreshments, a medal, a certificate, a shower, toilets, changing facilities, and the option to withdraw up to 24 hours before the start.

name: Náměšťský tvarůžek
location: Náměšť na Hané, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Náměšťský tvarůžek is a four-year running race in Náměšť na Hané, which is part of the Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. The main race is 9.22 km long and consists of three 2.9 km loops, plus an approach and a run-out. The course runs on asphalt and farm tracks, offering a combination of firm surfaces and natural surroundings. The race is open to different age categories, as well as a recreational run with no age limit, with an emphasis on fair play and participant safety.
course_highlights: Main race: 9.22 km, consisting of three 2.9 km loops
Surface: asphalt and farm tracks
Approach and run-out outside the loop: 518 m in total
additional: Race-day check-in takes place at the venue. Runners must have a chip card with a balance of at least CZK 150, which will be deducted at check-in. The results ceremony will take place at the KVS grounds; results will be published on hanackybeh.cz and liga100.cz. Categories are divided by age and gender, including a recreational run with no age limit. The race offers cash prizes for the top runners, registration is available with a chip card, and the course passes through the scenic surroundings of Náměšť na Hané.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nepomuk
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nepomuk is a fun run with no racing, held on October 28. Routes are available for adults and children. Adults run 3.2 km through the town, mostly on asphalt, while children take a shorter route with off-road obstacles. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. The event base is at the local Sokol grounds, with refreshments and a place to leave belongings. The event celebrates the founding of Czechoslovakia and takes place in a friendly atmosphere, with no times or rankings recorded.
course_highlights: Adults run 3.2 km on paved paths and asphalt through the town
Children’s 350 m course features several off-road obstacles near the Sokol hall
Adults run their loop twice; the route passes the polyclinic and housing estate
additional: The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. All participants receive a medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Sports activity stations are set up for children at the event grounds. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the Sokol hall car park. The event base is at the local Sokol grounds, with refreshments and a place to leave belongings. The event is held every year on October 28 and is open to participants from different continents, with online registration available and a race pack that includes a medal. The route passes through town streets, by the polyclinic and the Sokol hall, with parking available nearby.

description: The Provodov Run is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Provodov in the Zlín Region. The race offers three distances—5, 11 and 21 km—which run mainly along field and forest paths. Shorter age-based courses with free entry are available for children. The event is suitable for the general public and takes place whatever the weather, with an emphasis on safety and fair play.
course_highlights: Trail running mainly along field and forest paths
Three distances of varying difficulty: 5 km, 11 km and 21 km
Children’s courses by age group with free entry
additional: Race registration from 9:00 at Areál mládí and the FC Rak Provodov football pitch. Race starts: 21 km at 11:00, 11 km at 11:05, 5 km at 11:10. Children’s races from 14:00, with age-based categories. Medical supervision provided by members of the Czech Red Cross (ČČK). Entry is free for preschool children and pupils taking part in the children’s races. Each participant runs at their own risk. The organiser reserves the right to make changes or cancel the race in extreme conditions without compensation. Outdoor course; registration online or on site; compliance with road traffic rules and wearing a race number are mandatory. Refreshments and facilities are available at Areál mládí and the FC Rak football pitch.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Březník
location: Údolí Oslavy a Chvojnice, Březník, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné pro dospělé a děti (cena explicitně uvedena na stránce)
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Březník is a fun run with no racing, held on 28 October in the picturesque Oslava and Chvojnice valley. The routes follow paved and forest paths with gentle descents and climbs, ideal for anyone who wants to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia by getting active. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children, so early online registration is required. At the finish, everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the republic and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: The routes follow paved forest paths with gentle descents and climbs
The run takes place in the Oslava and Chvojnice Valley Nature Reserve
Two main adult routes: 5 km and 6.2 km, with a challenge from ambassador Katarína Pejpková
additional: Finish times are not recorded, and no ranked results list is produced. Capacity is limited to 20 adult and 30 child participants. Toilets are available, course marshals staff the route, a race pack is provided at the event facilities, and a medal shaped like the republic is awarded at the finish. Non-competitive run, routes from 0.6 km to 6.2 km, capacity of 20 for the main race and 30 child participants, accompanying programme, free refreshments, online registration, facilities on private grounds, on the border of the Divoká Oslava reserve

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Děčín

Children’s races are offered in two distances: 5 km for older children and 1 km for the youngest, who run along the river and Mariánská louka. The course is flat, with varied sections, and professionally timed. At the finish, participants receive a medal shaped like the republic. The event celebrates the republic and offers a sporting atmosphere for all age groups.

Cross the new bridge with views of the Elbe
Run along the Elbe Embankment and across Tyrš Bridge

A beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits at the finish. The route is suitable for all age groups, including children, who have their own shorter courses. name: Sokolský běh republiky - Dolní Újezd

The main course is 8.9 km long and runs partly alongside the Desná stream, across fields and along the edge of the village, combining paved roads with surfaced forest and field paths. Children can choose a 1.4 km course on paved roads and through the housing estate. Facilities at the Sokol hall include a race pack, refreshments, changing rooms and parking. Everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish.

The 1.4 km children’s courses run on paved roads and through the housing estate

The event takes place in Dolní Újezd, Pardubice Region, on October 28, with online registration available and facilities offering refreshments and parking.

The main course is just under six kilometres long, with the start and finish at the Sokol hall, which provides facilities including changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. Safe courses for children are set up on the Sokol hall grounds. Capacity is limited to approximately 155 runners to ensure high-quality organisation and timekeeping.

Main course of just under 6 km through the city
Safe children’s courses on the Sokol hall grounds, with no need to cross roads

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Louňovice pod Blaníkem
location: Louňovice pod Blaníkem, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: T. J. Sokol Louňovice pod Blaníkem

The main course is 5.6 km long and passes the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník, including its highest point, where the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene stands. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series and offers a race pack, a medal shaped like the republic, and a raffle for participants in the main race. The start and finish are in the square in front of the château in Louňovice pod Blaníkem. In addition to the main race, children’s courses of 0.4, 0.8, and 1.3 km are available.
course_highlights: The course passes the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník
Run past the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene at the highest point of Malý Blaník
A mix of paved, field, and forest paths

Each participant can collect their race pack at the race facilities. The main race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series. An accompanying program and refreshments are provided. The races are electronically timed, free parking is available in the square, and proceeds support charitable projects.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Lužice
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Lužice is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race is run without mandatory timekeeping; participants receive a starter pack and a beautiful republic-shaped medal at the finish. The main race course is 7.3 km long and runs along roads, paved farm tracks and through a vineyard, past the railway line and Lužák Pond. Shorter children’s courses of 0.2, 0.5 and 1 km are laid on paved surfaces. The race facilities are at the Sokol Hall complex, with changing rooms, showers, toilets and refreshments available.
course_highlights: The course runs along roads, paved farm tracks and through a vineyard
The route passes the railway line and Lužák Pond
Children’s courses run on paved surfaces
additional: The starter pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. All participants receive a republic-shaped medal at the finish. Facilities at the Sokol Hall complex include changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments. Parking is available at the car park by the Sports Hall, approximately 500 m from the complex. The course runs along roads, paved farm tracks and through a vineyard. Children can run on paved surfaces. Facilities at the Sokol Hall complex include changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments. Parking is approximately 500 m from the complex.

location: Státní zámek Mníšek pod Brdy, Mníšek pod Brdy, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

The race offers a 5 km adult course passing the Sokol Hall, ponds and Hostinec u Káji Maříka, with the start and finish by the state château. Shorter children’s loops are set on a grassy area and are easy, making them suitable for different age groups. Facilities at the start include registration, changing tents, toilets and refreshments, and parking is free. Every participant receives a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish.

The course is asphalt for up to 1 km; the children’s courses are on grass. The start is by the state château, with registration and refreshments on site. Parking is free. name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nový Bydžov

The race is held in open traffic, with marshals at intersections, and offers a race pack and a republic-shaped medal for all participants.

Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka skvelú atmosféru, občerstvenie a medaile pre všetkých účastníkov. Víťazi v kategóriách mužov a žien získavajú medaile a vecné ceny. additional: Registration, race details and results are available at the external link https://tech.orgsu.org/Site/SG/3. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series, which features other races throughout the year. The trail courses include the golf course; registration closes 30 minutes before the start, and parking is available directly at the venue.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - listopad
description: The Olomouc 2 Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and competing primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age-grading coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. On-site registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and the race starts in the morning. The race is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has supported the running community for more than 35 years.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
Suitable for all ages and running abilities
Picturesque setting by the park fountain
additional: On-site registration is from 9:30 to 10:00. The start is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is part of a year-long cup competition, with points calculated using an age-grading coefficient. It is part of the Olomouc 2-mile race series, takes place on a paved course, registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and it is suitable for all age groups and running abilities.

description: The HRUŠTICE Road Race – Zdeněk Drobník Memorial is a traditional race with a history dating back to 1974. Since 2024, it has been run on a new 10 km course through the Jizera Valley. This popular autumn event attracts runners from across the surrounding area each year and offers beautiful views and an atmosphere shaped by local history and traditions. The start and race facilities are in Turnov, with chip timing and professional organization. After the race, prizes are raffled, traditionally including regional semi-precious stones.
course_highlights: New 10 km course through the Jizera Valley
Beautiful views from the plateau above Turnov
Traditional prizes featuring regional semi-precious stones
additional: All categories start together. Registration and race-number pickup take place from 08:30 to 10:00. On-site registration is available until 10:00 for a higher entry fee. After the race, race numbers are entered into a prize draw. Race facilities are located in the AC Turnov athletics clubroom at Ludvík Daněk Stadium. The race is part of a long-running series and offers various age categories. Registration and results are managed by STOPNI TO s.r.o. The race takes place on a road course and is open to runners of all levels.

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful natural surroundings along the Berounka, motivating runners of all levels to exercise regularly. The race in Beroun, held on November 2, 2026, is a night stage through the Křivoklát forests, with views of the surrounding area and a final descent from the Děd lookout tower to the finish. The route is well marked and offers beautiful natural scenery, refreshments, and baggage storage. The series is suitable for experienced runners as well as beginners who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Night stage requiring a headlamp
The route runs through the Křivoklát forests, with views by the walnut-tree avenue
A challenging climb to the Děd lookout tower, followed by a descent back to the finish with views of Beroun
additional: Every participant receives a race number. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. Bringing a headlamp for the night run is recommended. The top three finishers in each category receive diplomas. Night stage, trail run, marked routes, views of the surrounding area, on-site registration, start no later than 17:45, refreshments and baggage storage, winners’ awards by category, headlamp required.

name: TRAIL LÁZNĚ VELICHOVKY
location: Lázně Velichovky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Lázně Velichovky is the third edition of an autumn trail race in the historic spa town of Velichovky. It offers varied and beautiful running terrain, with the start and finish on the spa colonnade, where covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant are available. The race is complemented by spa amenities, including a café, and offers original medals, gifts and a race pack. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for all lovers of trail running and spa surroundings.
course_highlights: The most colourful autumn running terrain
Start and finish on the spa colonnade
Covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant
additional: The race includes an original medal, race pack, electronic timing chip, refreshments during the race and at the finish, changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, medical services and an accompanying programme. Gladiator Race clothing is also available for purchase, and parking is available near the event centre. Online registration via reg-sportvisio.cz, medals, chip timing, course photos, certificates, refreshments and spa services.

description: Jizerun is a relay race connecting Prague and the Jizera Mountains. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 164 km along cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails in a single day. The race offers a unique team experience, with a choice of two entry packages featuring different benefits such as a sports T-shirt, headband, evening buffet and finisher medals. The event is open to men’s, women’s, mixed and corporate relay teams and is supported by general partner Metrostav a.s.
course_highlights: 164 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains
A combination of cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails
Relays for teams of 4–5, with each runner completing at least 3 legs
additional: Entry packages are for teams of 5. The RUN&FUN package includes T-shirts, headbands, a buffet dinner, finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party with live music. The NO FUN, JUST RUN package includes finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party. Facilities and services include mobile toilets, showers at the finish, medical services, an announcer and full event support. When registering, the captain’s details must be provided; team members and T-shirt sizes can be added later. Each team member must run at least 3 legs, and only one car per team is allowed. The race supports a fundraiser for hospice and hospice care in the Czech Republic. Registration opens in April 2026.

name: Běh kolem Práchně
description: Běh kolem Práchně is a traditional running race in Horažďovice, offering a 9.5 km course. Since 2024, the updated route has followed the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit. The start and finish are located in front of Envicentrum PROUD, which provides runners with facilities including changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. The results are announced at approximately 12:00 after the race. The event is organized by DDM Horažďovice and KČT Horažďovice, who ensure a pleasant atmosphere and a smooth event.
course_highlights: The 9.5 km course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit
Start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD, with full facilities
A mixed-type race in the picturesque surroundings of Horažďovice
additional: The results are announced at approximately 12:00 at Envicentrum PROUD, where refreshments, changing rooms and toilets are available. The course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit, with the start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD and refreshments and facilities available after the race.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - listopad
description: The 2 Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is welcomed at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit, just under two laps long (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children up to 12 years old (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in both adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start include by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). Races take place on the first Saturday of every month, start at 9:00, and registration is from 8:15 to 8:55; you can arrive by bike, on foot, by car, or by trolleybus. The course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit; the main course is 3.2 km long and the children's course is 800 m long.

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
description: The Otrokovice Running Festival is a traditional sporting event offering a wide range of races, including a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, decamarathon and youth races. The MUDr. Josef Podmolík Memorial is the flagship half-marathon race, held in the beautiful surroundings of Otrokovice. Runners can enjoy a well-maintained course with electronic timing and the atmosphere of a running festival with a varied program for all age groups. Race check-in and the awards ceremony take place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and marathon courses in Otrokovice with chip timing
A 4.2195 km decamarathon loop
Youth races over various distances from 200 m to 1,700 m
additional: Race check-in takes place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall. Runners must collect their race number and chip for electronic timing. Winners are presented with their awards after each race in turn, and winners are required to attend the ceremony. Registration is by email. The event includes various age groups and races on city streets and at the sports hall.

name: Svatojánská 20
location: TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 is a traditional running race held in Beroun, offering two main routes of 11 and 18 kilometres. The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium. The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream, with turnarounds at the settlement of V Kozle (11 km) and in Svatý Jan pod Skálou (18 km). The race is open to a wide range of age groups and offers refreshments at the finish, as well as cash and non-cash prizes for the top runners.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream
The 11 km route turns around at the settlement of V Kozle; the 18 km route turns around in Svatý Jan pod Skálou
The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium
additional: On-site check-in and registration on race day from 11:00 to 12:40. Runners who register in advance and pay by 5 November will receive a race number bearing their name. Finish-line refreshments include tea and biscuits. The race takes place in open traffic; participants must obey traffic regulations and take part at their own risk. Parking is available around the stadium; nearby car parks are recommended because of the blue parking zones. Online and on-site registration are available. Medals and certificates are awarded, and cash prizes are paid.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Kovárna VIVA a spolkem Běhy Zlín
description: Kovářská pětka is a traditional 5-kilometre city road race held in the Baťa complex in Zlín. The race is open to both adults and children and is organised by Kovárna VIVA in cooperation with the Běhy Zlín association. The event offers a high-quality sporting experience in the centre of the regional capital, with international participation. It attracts a wide running community every year and is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organised proceedings.
course_highlights: The course runs through the former Baťa complex in Zlín
A 5-kilometre road race in an urban setting
The race is suitable for adults and children
additional: The race is part of a year-round competition for runners from the Zlín region. The organisers provide online results and event photos. Children’s categories are also included. The event provides professional timing and support for the regional running community. It is part of a series of races in Zlín, offers various age categories and is suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race is suitable for slow and fast runners, experienced runners and beginners who want to improve their personal best, train, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park setting. After the finish, everyone receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Times are recorded for every participant and results are published online; they count toward the year-round Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs along Stromovka’s paved paths
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Královská obora–Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (beneath the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Arriving by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings (unattended), along with a mobile valuables storage service. Toilet cabins are available on site. Start at 9:07; registration from 8:15 to 8:45; online registration available. The race takes place in Královská obora–Stromovka Park. Parking is by the bridge to Císařský Island; changing facilities and toilets are available.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: The Labský Half Marathon is a running race held in Lysá nad Labem, offering two courses of approximately 12.5 km and 21.3 km. The routes pass through the flat Polabí forest, on a mix of paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short sections of asphalt or concrete. The start and finish are at the racecourse, where refreshments, baggage storage, and other facilities are available. The race is suitable for the general public and is limited to 700 participants. The program also includes children’s races with distances varying by age.
course_highlights: The courses are flat and run through the beautiful Polabí forest
Start after approximately 1 km on the racecourse
Refreshment stations at km 8 and 17 on the 21 km course, and one station at km 8 on the 12 km course
additional: The race is limited to 700 participants. Baggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments, and a raffle are available for runners. Parking in the venue costs 50 CZK per car. Children’s races range from 200 to 1,000 metres depending on age. The route is marked with ribbons, signs, and flour arrows, and each kilometre is marked approximately. The race includes children’s races, registration is available online, and the route may be modified due to reconstruction work in the area.

name: Závod dvojic
description: Hostivařské dvojice is a relay running race for pairs, offering a unique team-running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Hostivař. The race is for pairs who want to enjoy a sporting challenge as well as the friendly atmosphere. The route passes through scenic terrain and is suitable for runners of all levels. Come for a run and enjoy a great sporting event in a welcoming community.
course_highlights: Relay race in pairs
Scenic surroundings of Hostivař
Friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, in Kladno. It is a team relay event, and registration is available online.

name: Hornická desítka
location: Národní dům, Frýdek-Místek, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hornická desítka is a traditional running race held in Frýdek-Místek. It has been held since 1980, with interruptions, and the tradition was revived in 1996. The event offers various running disciplines, including youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It celebrates exercise and sporting spirit, attracting hundreds to thousands of participants of all ages. It is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere. The race starts at the National House in Frýdek-Místek and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: The course runs in the Frýdek-Místek area; the event dates back to 1980
A main 10 km race, accompanied by youth races and a Run for Health
Start and finish at the National House in Frýdek-Místek
additional: The event includes a non-competitive parents-and-children run, youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It is known for its excellent organization and relaxed atmosphere. The organizer is Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s. The race takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at the National House in Frýdek-Místek. The event involves road closures and traffic measures.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Labe and vicinity, near TJ Dynamo canoe club, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Malá Pardubická - cross country is a traditional cross-country race organized by the AC Pardubice athletics club. The race takes place near the Elbe River and close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club. The organizers warmly invite all runners and running fans to this popular event, which offers a sporting experience in a natural setting. The race regulations and further information are available on the club’s website.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on natural terrain near the Elbe River
Start and finish close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club
A traditional running event organized by AC Pardubice
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, is open to the general public, including children and young people, and is part of the local sports calendar.

description: Jizerun is a relay running race from Prague to the Jizera Mountains, following the Jizera River. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 165 km along cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains in a single day. The race offers a unique sporting experience and the chance to work as a team in men’s, women’s, mixed, and corporate categories. The route is divided into several stages of varying difficulty, allowing each runner to choose a suitable segment.
course_highlights: A 165 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains along cycle paths and trails
A relay race for teams of 4–5 in several categories
Stages with difficulty ratings from 1 to 8 on a 10-point scale, across varied terrain
additional: The entry fee includes timing, GPX tracking and the JIZERUN app, portable toilets, finish-area facilities including showers, a speaker and sound system, medical services throughout the race, gifts from partners, photos and video, and full event staffing and all relevant permits. The route is divided into 14 stages of varying lengths and difficulty; for example, the Bradlec–Klášter stage is 14.7 km and rated 7/10. The 2026 edition is sold out; the organizer mentions a waiting list. Teams consist of four or five runners.

description: The Run Against Addiction is a running race in Homolka Forest Park in Plzeň, with courses for different age groups, from children to adults. The route follows paved paths and includes both flat children’s courses and the varied terrain of the 6 km main race. There is also a relay race for teams of three, with each runner completing one lap. The event is suitable for runners of all abilities who want to support the fight against addiction and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in nature.
course_highlights: The route follows paved paths in Homolka Forest Park
The 6 km main race features varied terrain and three laps
The children’s courses are flat and adapted to different age groups
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 9:00 to 10:30. Children’s races begin at 10:00, with staggered starts by age group. The men’s and women’s main races and the relay start at 11:30. The relay has three runners, each completing one lap of approximately 2,000 m. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 12:15. A recommended route is available on Garmin Connect as a single lap, which will be run three times during the race. The organizer lists children’s races and a 6 km race; Kudy z nudy also lists a 3 × 2 km relay for 2026. The race regulations available on the organizer’s website are for the 2024 and 2025 editions, so prices from those editions have not been assigned to the 2026 race.

description: Gorlicki Mountain Run is an annual running event held in the scenic surroundings of Radocyna and Magura Małastowska in the Low Beskids. The event offers three distances: 7.6 km, 23.9 km, and a 2.3 km Vertical race with significant elevation gain. It attracts both amateurs and elite runners, offering a unique atmosphere and cash prizes. The participant limit is 400, and the start and finish are located at the State Forests Holiday Resort “Radocyna” and Magura Ski Park. This is the event’s eleventh edition, combining sporting competition with the beauty of mountain nature.
course_highlights: 24 km course with 610 m of elevation gain
7 km course with 160 m of elevation gain
2.3 km Vertical with 340 m of elevation gain to Magura Małastowska
additional: Participant limit: 400 (150 for 7 km, 250 for 24 km). Start and finish at the State Forests Holiday Resort “Radocyna.” Race office open from 7:45 to 10:00. The time limit for the 24 km race is 5 hours. Runners must attach their bibs to the front of their shirt or shorts. Participants with a Rate My Trail ranking of 730 points or higher may enter free of charge. The courses include mountain trails and muddy sections, and the start is scheduled for 10:30. The event attracts both amateurs and experienced trail runners.

name: FUSS EGY NAPOT!
description: “Run for a Day!” is an ultrarunning event held at Benkó Zoltán Park in Kecskemét. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and create a shared community sports experience. Runners can test their abilities over various distances in a friendly and supportive environment. The program includes a carnival atmosphere and the joy of exercising together.
course_highlights: Ultrarunning around Benkó Hill
Varied terrain close to nature
A community spirit and carnival atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose from several distances. The registration deadline is November 5, 2025. Options for changing clothes and equipment at the venue are limited, and access to the lake during the run is not guaranteed.

name: HALLOWEEN RUN
description: Halloween Run 2026 is a special, exciting running event in Budapest, held on the grounds and in the cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery. During the race, participants run along a dark, spooky course accompanied by frightening characters and eerie effects. Races are held over various distances, from short tours to longer multi-lap events, so everyone can find a suitable option. At the finish, music and celebrations await the brave participants who have overcome the challenges.
course_highlights: Course on the grounds and in the cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery
Dark, spooky visuals and frightening effects
A variety of distances, including a 21 km lap race and running through a tunnel
additional: The event takes place at Rottenbiller Park in Budapest's 10th district. It is easily accessible by public transport, but parking is limited. The program includes several races, from 2.5 km Halloween tours to a 21 km individual and relay race. On-site registration is available up to 45 minutes before the race start, provided online registration has not filled up. The awards ceremony begins at 15:40. Multiple races, a themed dark atmosphere, various distances, venue: Rottenbiller Park, Budapest, online and on-site registration, awards ceremonies.

name: VASKAPU TRAIL
organizer: Esztergomi Triatlon Kulturális és Szabadidősport Egyesület
description: The Vaskapu Trail is a nature-focused trail-running race in Esztergom, offering runners a challenge over three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 22 km. The course follows trails and marked hiking paths, with minimal road sections, allowing participants to enjoy the natural scenery and varied terrain. The event is environmentally conscious, with cup-free aid stations and support for the Green Forest program. The start and finish are at the Vaskapu Restaurant, at the Brilli Gyula shelter, where participants can also use changing rooms and bag storage.
course_highlights: Trail running on paths and marked hiking routes
Three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 22 km, with varied levels of difficulty
Minimal road sections for a nature-focused experience
additional: The race uses chip timing; chips are issued against a 2,000 HUF deposit. The event is cup-free, so participants must bring a hydration vest or their own cup. Race-pack collection takes place at the race center on race day; earlier collection is not available. Entries may be cancelled until 2026.10.15; after that, they can only be transferred to the following year. The race center has separate women’s and men’s changing rooms and a built-in toilet, but no washbasin. All finishers receive a finisher’s medal, and the top three women and men overall receive separate awards. Participants must bring the equipment needed for hydration. Changing rooms and bag storage are available on site, and environmentally friendly solutions are used to support participants.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske
description: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná na počesť výročia oslobodenia mesta. Tento športový sviatok priláka bežcov rôznych vekových kategórií, vrátane mládeže a dospelých, ktorí súťažia na rôznych dĺžkach tratí. Podujatie organizuje mesto Strážske v spolupráci s bežeckým klubom MBO Strážske a je známe svojou dlhou históriou a silnou komunitnou atmosférou. Bežci si môžu užiť atmosféru mesta a zároveň si zmerať sily v priateľskom a súťažnom prostredí.
course_highlights: Viacero kategórií vrátane mládeže a dospelých
Štart pred budovou Mestského úradu v Strážskom
Tradičný beh s dlhou históriou a komunitnou podporou
additional: Podujatie má dlhoročnú tradíciu, v roku 2026 sa uskutoční 49. ročník. Bežci sú rozdelení do viacerých vekových kategórií vrátane predškolákov, žiakov a dospelých. Po behu sa oceňujú najrýchlejší v jednotlivých kategóriách a organizuje sa tombola s hodnotnými cenami. Trať vedie mestom Strážske s cieľom pred budovou Mestského úradu.

name: Žandovská desítka
description: Žandovská desítka is a traditional 10-kilometer race held in Žandov in the Liberec Region. The event is part of the Českolipsko District Running League and welcomes runners of all ages. The course runs on both roads and trails, offering varied surroundings for competitors. The race is popular with the regional running community and provides an opportunity to challenge yourself and meet fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The course runs on both roads and trails
Part of the regional Českolipsko running league
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race takes place in November 2026. Registration and further details are not specified. The event is part of a broader series of regional races.

name: Dobřichovický běh
location: Škvárový stadion TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Run is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers runners a course approximately 6 km long. The race starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice and follows farm roads, providing pleasant running terrain. The event is suitable for both adults and children, who have their own races. The main race starts at 13:00 and is organized by ASK Dipoli.
course_highlights: Course approximately 6 km long
Starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice
The course follows farm roads
additional: Start location: TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Pražská 375. The course was measured by GPS at 5.72 km, though the race information lists it as 6 km. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup, which also includes children's races. The course combines a cinder track and farm roads. The course includes a cinder track and farm roads; online registration is available; races are suitable for all age groups.

name: Velká kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Velká kunratická is one of the oldest running races in the Czech lands. It is held every year on the second Sunday in November in Kunratice Forest in Prague. The race has been run continuously since 1934 and is known for its challenging course and changeable weather, which contribute to its unique atmosphere. A wide range of runners take part, from young children to veterans, competing on six courses ranging from 370 to 3,100 metres. The event is organised by the Spartak Praha 4 athletics club.
course_highlights: Challenging courses through Kunratice Forest
Six courses ranging from 370 m to 3,100 m
Wave starts in pairs, with a 10-second interval
additional: All categories start in pairs at 10-second intervals. Official BUSHMAN-brand T-shirts are available exclusively during registration. Ordered T-shirts can be collected at the tent on the dam. The total number of participants is limited to 3,600, with a limit of 2,700 runners on the route over Hrádek. Registration changes can be made by email until 14 October 2026; after that, they can only be made at check-in. The race takes place in November, with the number of participants limited to 3,400. Online registration opens on 5 October 2026, and on-site registration is available. There are various age and performance categories.

description: Krumlovská 11 is a St. Martin’s charity run held on 8 November 2026 at Hornobránský Pond in Český Krumlov. It offers a main run of approximately 11 km for runners aged 15 and over, a family run for children aged 2 to 15, and relay races. The route passes through beautiful countryside via Křížová hora and Přídolí. The event supports the Personal Assistance social service, which helps children with disabilities and seniors in the region. There is also a varied program of accompanying activities and running T-shirts available to purchase.
course_highlights: Main route: approx. 11 km via Křížová hora and Přídolí
Family run: 1–2 km depending on age category
Relay race: 2 × 5.5 km, with the baton exchange at Hornobránský Pond
additional: The main run and relay races start at 12:11; the family run begins from 10:01, with staggered start times for the different categories. The main run has a capacity of 200 runners, and the family run a capacity of 200 children. Race packs with bib numbers can be collected at the venue from 8:45 to 11:30. Running T-shirts and St. Martin’s goose are available to purchase for an additional fee. Relays may be women’s, men’s, mixed or corporate. The event is a charity event, with proceeds supporting the Personal Assistance social service in Český Krumlov. The start and finish are at Hornobránský Pond; the main run starts from 12:11. Online registration is open until 30 October 2026 and is mandatory. The race has a capacity of 200 participants.

name: Marceliński Bieg Jesienny 2026
description: Marceliński Autumn Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic courses that showcase the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Wielkopolska, offering participants a unique running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Courses that showcase the location’s aesthetic appeal
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. Race packs can be collected using an authorization form template. Cross-country race, event in Marceliński Forest, November 8, 2026, puzzle-piece medals, forest routes

name: Feldwar Trail 1 / 5 / 10 / 17 / 23
description: Feldwar Trail is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race among the hills of Dunaföldvár, with stunning views and an impressive race headquarters at Ispánház. Runners can choose from several distances, from children’s races to the 23 km course, with women’s and men’s categories awarded separately. The courses run mostly on dirt roads, with minimal paved sections, allowing participants to enjoy being close to nature. The event is run as a green event, so the organisers ask runners to bring a reusable bottle or their own cup to the refreshment stations.
course_highlights: Trail routes among the hills of Dunaföldvár
Stunning views of the southern Danube Bend from Kálvária and the ridge along the Danube
Mostly dirt roads, with minimal paved sections
additional: On-site registration: Sunday, 2026.11.08, 9:00–10:00 (children: 9:45). An instant-run option is available within one year after November 10, 2025, by prior arrangement; the fee is 3,000 Ft. Chip timing with the Traxpace system and online split results. The race is limited to a maximum of 400 participants, including a maximum of 100 preschool and primary-school children. Disposable cups are not provided at the refreshment stations, so participants are asked to use their own bottle or cup. The time limit is advisory; finishers receive a medal even if they finish after the time limit. Distances: 1, 5, 10, 17 and 23 km; refreshment stations on the various distances; chip timing; instant-run option; children’s races; individual or group registration; awards by category.
