name: Maraton Praha – Dobříš
location: A Park, Braník, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Prague–Dobříš Marathon is a traditional trail race held on 5 December 2026. The event offers three distances: 42 km with an individual start, and 21 km and 10 km with mass starts. The route runs from Prague 4, Braník, through Dobříš to Kytín, with elevation ranging from 125 to 593 metres. Runners can use baggage transport from the start to the finish. Overall winners and age- and gender-based category winners are announced. The event is suited to trail-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with a choice of distances.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 593 m of elevation gain
Start in Prague 4, Braník; finish in Kytín
Baggage transport for runners from the start to the finish
additional: The 42 km race has an individual start; the 21 km and 10 km races have mass starts. The 42 km course has aid stations at kilometres 10, 16, 27 and 33, and at the finish. Parking is available near the start and finish area. Runners take part at their own risk and must take extra care when crossing roads. The course is suitable for runners of all levels. Online registration is available, along with course maps and information about race categories.

name: Mikulášský běh Čimelice
description: The Mikulášský běh Čimelice is a traditional annual race held in Čimelice, a popular event with a long history that usually takes place in early December. It attracts local runners and visitors, who can look forward to a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. Exact details about the course and race distance are not currently available, but the race is part of the local sporting calendar and has a long tradition.
course_highlights: A traditional race with a long history in Čimelice
Held annually in December
Friendly atmosphere and local community
additional: The race is part of the local sporting calendar. Results from 2025 are available online.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - prosinec
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children aged 12 and under (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is a precisely measured asphalt loop; the children's course is 800 m long. The race is open to all age groups, with categories for men, women, boys, and girls. You can start by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race has a friendly atmosphere and encourages everyone to enjoy running, whether you want to improve your personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. After the finish, everyone gets a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children one.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children up to 12 years old run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful setting in the Royal Game Reserve – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate (below the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Pre-registration online is available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age, with an age-adjustment coefficient used for the year-round Lívancový Cup. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage facility, and toilet cabins are available. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. 3.2 km course, road surface, registration is voluntary, and running without a bib is permitted.

name: LEKI WINTER SkyRace®
description: LEKI WINTER SkyRace® is a winter skyrunning race held at Ještěd, in the ski jump area. The race offers a challenging 22 km royal course with 1,180 metres of elevation gain, bringing the 2025 skyrunning season to a close. Shorter courses and children’s races are also available, welcoming a wide range of runners. The event atmosphere is rounded out by the winners’ ceremony and an accompanying programme.
course_highlights: Winter SkyRace® royal course: 22 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
Other courses: Winter Trail 12 km / 520 m+, Winter Easy 6 km / 220 m+
Children’s races: 200 m, 500 m and 1,200 m
additional: The winners’ ceremony starts at 15:30. The race takes place in the ski jump area at Ještěd. Canicross races are also available over the same distances as the main courses. The race is part of the LEKI JEŠTĚD SERIES. winter mountain race, multiple courses, children’s races, canicross, registration, race equipment and refreshments

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace®
description: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace® is a trail-running race held on the Ještěd Ridge in the Liberec Region. It offers challenging courses with beautiful views and natural scenery, appealing to both experienced runners and fans of mountain running. The race is part of the JEŠTĚD SKYRACE series and is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and extensive accompanying program, including healthy refreshments and a partner zone. Participants can also purchase original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary.
course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd Ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with courses of varying distances (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Extensive accompanying program, including healthy and varied refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially stocked race bag. Healthy and varied refreshments are available, including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary is available. Races on different courses, a series of summer and winter races, registration, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť over a distance of 5.7 km. It offers not only a sporting experience, but also a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Runners are welcome to wear devil costumes, adding a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories by age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol hall and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Traditional 5.7 km winter run
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Sokol Cup results announced after the race
additional: The race takes place on 6 December 2025 from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, at the Sokol hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in different age groups). After the race, there is a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course. Registration via naZávody.cz. The event is suitable for all age groups and fans of dressing up.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
description: The Ráztoka–Pustevny Uphill Run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoky and around Pustevny. It offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners’ endurance and strength in the beautiful setting of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular with athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes everyone who enjoys mountain running and wants to experience the race’s unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Climb to Pustevny with 400 m of elevation gain
Course length of approximately 5.7 km
Mountain setting in the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is also suitable for children. Weather may affect conditions. Registration details are not provided. The event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: Jested Series
description: Ještěd Skyrace is a technical trail-running race on the Ještěd Ridge, featuring challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and professionals and includes several route options, including races for children. The event is part of a race series with a friendly atmosphere and a generous participant race pack.
course_highlights: Technical trail sections on the Ještěd Ridge
Challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 m of elevation gain
Route options from 6 km to 22 km, including children’s races
additional: Mandatory equipment is required. Race bibs and timing chips are provided. On-site registration is available, along with bag storage, changing rooms and toilets. Refreshments and an awards ceremony are provided after the finish. The race is livestreamed, and results are available online. The race also offers canicross options and children’s races on shorter routes. The series also includes children’s races. The listed Winter SkyRace distances are 22, 12 and 6 km; the date 5 December 2026 is not confirmed in the available information.

name: Last Man Standing Run VYSOČINA
description: Last Man Standing Run Vysočina is a unique endurance race held on December 5, 2026, at Želiv Monastery. Competitors repeatedly complete a 6.7 km loop, starting every hour, with the aim of lasting as long as possible and lining up for another start on the hour. The inaugural edition is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops, with the winner being the person who completes all 24 loops. The race is not about speed, but about endurance and the ability to overcome physical and mental challenges in the winter conditions of Vysočina.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the hilly terrain of Vysočina
A new start every hour, up to a maximum of 24 loops / 24 hours
The official time is set by the tolling of the church bell at Želiv Monastery
additional: The race is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops. Every competitor must wear their race bib throughout the event and keep a timing chip on their ankle. Headphones are prohibited on the course for safety reasons. Registration is processed manually; payment details are sent by email after the application has been processed. A T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on for 490 Kč. The official race time is set by the tolling of the church bell, which also symbolically closes the finish gate on the hour. The entry fee includes participation, light refreshments and facilities. Mandatory equipment includes a red rear light, a reflective item, neck protection and a personal drinking container. Part of the route may run along roads open to regular traffic.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners of all abilities. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running levels. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete throughout the Grand Prix series. Registration is available only at the Race Office on race day, and participation is free.
course_highlights: 10 km race in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice
A series of seasonal events promoting a healthy lifestyle
A running community and opportunities to connect with the local community
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in the Grand Prix races is free. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. It focuses on promoting physical activity, health, and the running community, with varied courses and seasonal editions.

name: ADVENTI JÓTÉKONY FUTÁS
description: The Advent Charity Run is a welcoming, family-friendly running event in Bölcske, where participants can test their abilities over 3 or 6 kilometers. Part of the entry fee goes to charity, making the event not only a sporting activity but also a chance to help others. It is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners looking to enjoy a pleasant winter running event.
course_highlights: Choose between 3 km and 6 km
A family-friendly running event supporting charity
Set in the natural surroundings of Bölcske
additional: HUF 500 from each entry fee goes to charity. Runners can choose whether to take part in the 3 km or 6 km event. Family registration is also available for the 2 km distance, for up to 4 participants. The event supports charitable causes, payment of the entry fee is mandatory, and participation is open to all ages. The run takes place at 1435/6 Csorda út, Bölcske.

name: ADVENTI KOCOGÓ
description: The Advent Jog is a charity running event held at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre in Kecskemét. The aim is to raise donations for the NM Foundation for the Recovery of Muscles, supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, including Marci Nemes. The event offers participants a sense of community and an active experience while serving a worthy cause. The organizers thank all the runners and volunteers who contributed to its success.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre
A charity event supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy
A community-focused sporting experience for families and runners
additional: Volunteers also help behind the scenes at the event. The run is organized for charity, supporting the local foundation and children with the condition. It is part of the Advent season; the run supports the recovery of sick children and is traditionally held every year to bring the community together.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 12. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod na 2 míle (3,218 km) organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team v areálu kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Závod je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:30 a štart je o 10:00. Súťaž je súčasťou série, kde bežci zbierajú body do Putovného pohára Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, pričom výsledné časy sa prepočítavajú podľa koeficientov podľa roku narodenia.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 2 míle (3,218 km), deti cca 200 m
Miesto konania: Areál kúpaliska Kuchajda, Bratislava
Prezentácia pri volejbalovom ihrisku
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30. Kategórie sú deti (13 rokov a mladší), juniori, ženy, muži, veteránky a veteráni. Súťažiaci sú bodovaní podľa počtu účastníkov v kategóriách, juniori a juniorky sú bodovaní samostatne. Pri rovnosti bodov rozhoduje rok narodenia a najlepší čas v danom roku. Na dve účasti je vyhlásená amnestia, kedy sa zrušia 2 mesiace s najnižším počtom bodov. Preteky majú rôzne kolá počas roka, vrátane decembrového 12. kola. Registrácia je možná na mieste, podrobnosti o cene nie sú špecifikované, a trať je prevažne asfaltová v mestskom prostredí.

name: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke
location: Základná škola Hviezdoslavova, Lipany, Prešov, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné je stanovené na minimálnu sumu 7€.

description: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke je adrenalínový nočný beh určený pre účastníkov starších ako 15 rokov. Podujatie sa koná 6. decembra 2025 so štartom o 19:00 zo Základnej školy Hviezdoslavova v Lipanoch. Bežci sa môžu tešiť na jedinečný zážitok v nočnom prostredí s výhľadom z rozhľadne. Štartovné je stanovené na minimálnu sumu 7 € a záujemcovia sa musia prihlásiť do 5. decembra 2025.
course_highlights: Nočný beh s adrenalínovou atmosférou
Trasa vedie na rozhľadňu na Balážke
Podujatie určené pre účastníkov starších ako 15 rokov
additional: Podujatie je jedinečné nočné podujatie s minimálnym štartovným 7 €. Účastníci musia byť starší ako 15 rokov. Registrácia je možná do 5. decembra 2025. Štart je zo ZŠ Hviezdoslavova v Lipanoch. nočný beh, štart zo ZŠ Hviezdoslavova, registrácia do 5.12.2025, možnosť zľavnených štartov pre skupiny a na kostýmy, podujatie zahŕňa občerstvenie a sprchy

name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
description: The Malá cena Velké Verandy is a traditional forest cross-country race held in Choceň. The race is 4,300 metres long and follows forest roads and trails, with approximately 200 metres of elevation gain. The course is marked with ribbons and includes a short stretch of asphalt. The race is also the Jirka Švadlena Memorial and is popular with runners looking for challenging terrain with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: 4,300 m along forest roads and trails
Hilly profile with approximately 200 m of elevation gain
Course marked with ribbons, approximately 400 m of asphalt
additional: The race includes approximately 400 m of asphalt and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting. It is part of the local sporting calendar.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The start is by the fountain in the park.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
A race suitable for all ages and running abilities
A picturesque park setting, with the fountain as the starting point
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The race venue is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens, except for two races in June and August, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is held on an asphalt course. It is part of a series of runs in Olomouc, with multiple dates throughout the year.

name: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów – XXIV Półmaraton Świętych Mikołajów
XV Grand Prix Krakowa w biegach górskich – Bieg Mikołajkowy
STOP-MIKULÁS FUTÁS
description: The Stop Santa Claus Run is a traditional, family-friendly running race in Tatabánya, held for the 33rd time in 2025. The event features three distances: 200 metres for young children, and 1,900 and 5,900 metres for adults and older runners. More than 200 people took part, each receiving a unique finisher’s medal, and Santa’s gifts await the youngest participants. The race has a welcoming, family atmosphere, with the organisers presenting numerous prizes and special awards. Participants can also celebrate those with December birthdays with cake and pastries.
course_highlights: Three distances: 200 m, 1,900 m and 5,900 m
Unique finisher’s medal for the 1,900 m and 5,900 m distances
Family-friendly atmosphere, with gifts from Santa for the children
additional: Runners over 70 are honoured with certificates, and the sportiest families receive a special award. The event’s main sponsors are Tatabányai SC and Stop Cukrászda, which treats participants to cake and pastries. The oldest participant completed the longest distance at the age of 87. Community support, an awards ceremony, gifts and a cheerful winter running celebration.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Nižbor
price_range: 390 Kč za závod, 1 900 Kč za 6 závodů, 2 900 Kč za celou sérii

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voucher na celou sérii 12 běhů = 2 900 Kč (240 Kč/závod)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River, from Radotín to Nižbor, running from January to December 2026. The routes follow trails with stunning views and varied terrain, often near nature reserves and historical sites. The series is suitable for experienced runners and beginners alike, and aims to encourage regular running. Most starts are at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs. At the end of the series, winners are announced and prizes are awarded in 12 categories.
course_highlights: Trails with views of the Berounka River and the Český kras Protected Landscape Area
Challenging climbs and nature reserves, such as Klapice and Radotínské skály
Starts at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs
additional: Refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms with showers, and race bibs are available at the race venues. Bringing a headlamp is recommended. Rankings are based on the 10 highest-scoring races in the series. Most starts are near train stations and at local pubs that provide facilities. Trail races in the Berounka area; starts mostly accessible by train; winners announced in December; 12 categories; scoring based on the 10 best races

name: BORVIDÉK FÉLMARATON
distance_verbose: 23 km, Félmaraton, 14 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km

name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada, between the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in Chabařovice and offers 12.5 km and 5.3 km routes, as well as Olympia children’s races. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the lake’s magical snowy and icy landscape. All races have a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere and are suitable for children, families and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes run through the natural surroundings of a former brown-coal mine transformed into Lake Milada
A winter run through the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: a 12.5 km long route and a 5.3 km short route, plus children’s races
additional: A race pack and medal for every competitor. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. The first 100 children to register receive a children’s T-shirt free of charge. The race is limited to 500 competitors. The accompanying programme includes St. Nicholas, a devil and an angel, and the Olympia children’s corner. Terrain in the former mine area, winter/icy conditions, family and children’s categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club. The race takes place in the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The race bib is valid for the entire series of races organized by the event organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the square in Úpice, by the A. Jirásek Theatre
Categories for children and adults, with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the option to take part in the race series
additional: The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. Registration closes at 13:30 for the children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The race bib is valid for the entire race series and must be brought to each subsequent race. Results are not announced after each individual race but are published on the organizer’s website. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in the square in Úpice. The scheduled start times are 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration takes place one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026. It is both a charity event and a race. The aim is to encourage more people to take up sport, help those in need, and give participants a chance to unwind from pre-Christmas stress by running through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas. The route passes through the beautiful chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere. You can preview it in a video or download the GPX file for your smartwatch. After the race, warm soup and mulled wine will be served to round off the event.
course_highlights: Run through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas
The route passes through the chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere
Downloadable GPX route file for smartwatches
additional: The race is a charity event, and warm soup and mulled wine will be served to participants after the run. The overall male and female winners hold the course record with a time of 19:10. The route is illuminated for Christmas, and festive decorations add to the atmosphere. The event offers two distances, 900 m and 5,500 m, and is open to children and adults. It features a Christmas atmosphere and a downloadable GPX route file.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: The Pre-Christmas Run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for both young people and adults. Young runners take on asphalt loops in the stadium grounds ranging from 180 m to 1.7 km. Adults run kilometre loops: men run 8 km and women 3 km, with various distances available in the stadium grounds. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt loops in the stadium grounds for young runners, from 180 m to 1.7 km
Kilometre loops in Staré Město for adults — 8 km for men and 3 km for women
Race with a long-standing tradition dating back to 1984
additional: A run in the stadium grounds, with on-site registration, refreshments in the stadium clubhouse, and various distances from 200 m to 8 km

name: Vranovský noční Trail
location: Samovýčep, Vranov u Brna, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Night Trail is a winter race run in the dark around Vranov u Brna, offering a challenging yet beautiful course. The race symbolizes the balance between day and night and is the first real running test of the new season. The start and finish are at the Samovýčep venue, which has facilities including a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. After the race, warm Italian food, mulled wine and a relaxed after-party await. The organizers emphasize quality refreshments and a friendly atmosphere that runners can enjoy after finishing.
course_highlights: A 21.3 km course in the Podkomorské forests and around the reservoir
The course is marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter race run in the dark over challenging terrain
additional: Race facilities at the Samovýčep venue include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. There is plenty of water and sports drinks on the course. After the race, there is warm Italian food, mulled wine and an after-party with the opportunity to share feedback and socialize. A headlamp is essential. Facilities include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea, a warm post-race meal and an after-party.

name: 9 Bieg Śladami Żubra
description: The Bieg Śladami Żubra is an annual running event organized by the Aktywna Pszczyna Sports Association in Studzienice, held in December. The route follows one or two loops through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest, offering scenic woodland views. The event features several distances, including the Fancy Dress Run, children’s races, 6 km and 12 km runs and Nordic Walking, as well as a half marathon and marathon. Participants can expect medals, awards for costumes, and traditional pea soup at the finish.
course_highlights: The route runs through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest
Races cover one or two forest loops
Scenic woodland views and natural mud
additional: Start times are staggered: 08:00 marathon, 08:30 Fancy Dress Run (1.8 km), and 10:10 half marathon. Children’s races are offered over distances of 200 m, 400 m, 800 m and 250 m, 400 m, 850 m, depending on age. Medals and awards for the most creative costumes await at the finish. A team classification is held (the four fastest times after one loop). The route is also used for Nordic Walking. Traditional pea soup is served at the finish. GPX files are available for the half-marathon, marathon, and 6 km and 12 km routes. New marathon distance, changed start and finish location, food and recovery attractions, honorary patronages, additional cross-country races, and team classification.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Sątopy, Nowy Tomyśl County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: WINTER TRAIL MAŁOPOLSKA
location: Kasinka Mała, Mszana Dolna, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (12)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach
price_range: 20-110 zł, pakiety od 220 zł do 800 zł, opłaty dla pracowników i studentów 30 zł

tiers.description: dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w wysokości 20 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.description: dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w dniu biegu 30 zł

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewniki forests in Katowice. The event takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. It promotes an active lifestyle and education about responsible behaviour in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewniki forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during verification. Annual race-entry packages are available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable but may be transferred to a subsequent race if requested by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the race. The event is recreational, with a 3-hour time limit and online registration; entry fees are non-refundable. It also has an educational aspect, promoting responsible behaviour in forest areas.

name: Bieg po moczkę i makówki
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Stanowicach, Stanowice, Opole, Poland
description: Bieg po Moczkę i Makówki is an annual, friendly running event held in Stanowice. Since 2012, it has become a fixture on the holiday running calendar. The course is 10 km long, divided into four 2.5 km loops, and runners may finish after any number of loops. After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and traditional moczka and makówki, and can also enjoy hot coffee and tea. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere, with a prize-winning contest for the most interesting costume and a spectator competition.
course_highlights: A 10 km course divided into four 2.5 km loops
Start and finish at Stanowice Primary School, ul. Szkolna 17A
Runners may finish after any number of loops
additional: After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and servings of traditional holiday dishes: moczka and makówki. A prize-winning spectator competition is held along the course, as well as a contest for the most interesting individual or group holiday-carnival costume. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere and encourages active spectating. It features costume contests and recreational activities, is based at Stanowice Primary School, and offers the option to take part in the 10 km run. The event is usually held in December during the holiday season.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Gór...

The event offers two main races: a challenging 19.9 km main race over Velký and Malý Blaník, and an accompanying 11.2 km race. The routes pass through the beautiful Podblanicko countryside, with significant climbs, forest sections, and views from the lookout tower on Velký Blaník. The start and finish are right in the centre of Načeradec, with cosy facilities. The race is limited to 700 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organisation.

Online registration is available, with entry-fee refunds possible until 31.12.2026. The race takes place in January and has a capacity of approximately 700 runners. The route runs mostly along forest and field tracks. The main race starts at 10:10.

description: The Oxygen Cup is a traditional winter running series in Debrecen’s Nagyerdő, offering middle- and long-distance runners and amateur athletes the opportunity to compete. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, and encourage people to stay active during winter. The course follows the Nagyerdő’s natural, runner- and joint-friendly terrain, with a variety of distances for several age groups and categories. The series includes both individual and team competitions, strengthening the sense of community among participants.

description: ALS charitatívny beh - memoriál Jána Svočáka je horský trailový beh v lokalite Svit, ktorý ponúka náročnú 21 km trať s prevýšením 950 metrov. Trať vedie prevažne lesom (80 %) a lúkami (20 %) a obsahuje dve občerstvovačky na 8. a 16. kilometri. Okrem hlavného behu sú súčasťou podujatia aj detské behy, štafety, nordic walking a špeciálny trail so psom. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov, ktorí hľadajú výzvu v prírodnom prostredí s kvalitnou organizáciou a certifikovanou traťou.
course_highlights: 21 km trail s 950 m prevýšenia
80 % trasy vedie lesom, 20 % lúkou
Dve občerstvovačky na 8. a 16. km

Štafety sú 3×1,7 km s prevýšením 140 m, povrch trate les, lúka, asfalt a šotolina. Nordic walking má povrch 90 % les, 10 % asfalt. Všetky detské kategórie sú ocenené a vyhodnotené hneď v cieli. Certifikácia trate ITRA, 1 kvalifikačný bod pre ALS 21 km. Podujatie podporuje ľudí s nervovo-svalovými ochoreniami. The 7.1 km course is an out-and-back route and almost flat, with climbs after the start and before the finish. The surface consists of field paths, asphalt, and gravel, offering a varied running experience. The race starts at 11:00 and is suitable for runners of all abilities.

name: Širokodolský kros
location: Obecní sál, Široký Důl, Pardubice District, Czech Republic
description: Širokodolský Cross-Country Run is a traditional off-road race held in the village of Široký Důl near Polička in the Pardubice Region. The event offers races for children and young people ranging from 60 metres to 4 km, as well as a 7 km main race with a mass start for men and women. The course runs along paved roads, forest trails and dirt tracks, with a climbing bonus on the first hill. Children can win prizes, while adults can receive cash prizes in their categories. The start and finish are by the municipal hall, creating a welcoming race atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs along paved roads, forest trails and dirt tracks
Climbing bonus on the first hill
Start and finish by the municipal hall in Široký Důl
additional: Children and young people start in successive age categories, with distances ranging from 60 m to 4 km. The 7 km main race has a mass start for men and women. Children receive prizes for the first three finishers in each category, while adults receive cash prizes for the first three in each category. The race starts by the municipal hall. The programme includes races for children and young people; the results for the 2026 edition list distances from 80 m to 7.8 km.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - duben
location: Madal Bal, Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The event also includes an 800-metre children’s course. After the finish, every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their effort. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00 a.m.

A precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under two laps (3.2 km)

additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to 12 years old. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The men’s course record is 9:31.8. Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55; the start is at 9:00. Every participant is timed, and the best finishers in the categories receive small prizes.

name: Čendův běh v Petrově

organizer: Obec Petrov, Libřický osadní klub, osada Hřebena a SDH Petrov
description: Čendův Run is the oldest tramp-style running race in Bohemia and one of the oldest cross-country races of all. It is traditionally held on Easter Sunday in Petrov near Prague and offers technically challenging courses along soft forest roads and trails in the valley of the Záhořanský Stream and around Ďábel Hill. The race is known for its family atmosphere and demanding terrain, with professional chip timing provided by irontime. Courses range from 100 metres for children’s categories to 12 km for experienced cross-country runners.

The valley of the Záhořanský Stream and the area around Ďábel Hill
A traditional Easter-time date and a family atmosphere
additional: Professional chip timing is provided by irontime. The race offers a wide range of categories, from 100 metres for children to 12 km for experienced runners. The event takes place at the municipal sports ground in Petrov near Prague. It is traditionally held on Easter Sunday; the listed courses in the previous edition included 6 km and 12 km. The date 11 April 2027 has not been confirmed by sources.

Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for a wide audience who enjoy running in a pleasant setting steeped in history.
course_highlights: Picturesque grounds of Tovačov Castle

Traditional endurance race with a long history

It is part of the regional championships and the Podbrdy Cup, attracting hundreds of runners of all ages. The route follows roads with gentle elevation changes and is suitable for a broad range of runners.

name: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail
description: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail je horský bežecký pretek v Divíne, ktorý ponúka dve náročné trate s krásnymi výhľadmi a výrazným prevýšením. Trať Ostrôšky ultra má dĺžku 47 km s prevýšením 2000 m, zatiaľ čo Langoš trail je kratší s dĺžkou 27 km a prevýšením 950 m. course_highlights: maratón, štafetové kategórie
tradičné podujatie s históriou
lokalita v Košiciach s výbornou atmosférou
additional: Online výsledky sú dostupné od 10:00 hodiny v deň preteku. Prihlasovanie na Furčiansky Maratón 2026 je ukončené. Organizátor je O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice. Podujatie zahŕňa maratón, extrémny maratón a štafetové preteky, s rôznymi vekovými kategóriami a registračnými poplatkami. Súčasťou je aj spomienka na Štefana Semana a podpora bežeckej komunity.

name: Jarný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Stredná odborná škola technická
price_range: 2 € dospelí, 1 € mládež do 18 rokov, 0 € muži nad 70 rokov a ženy nad 60 rokov
description: Jarný beh Michalovčanov je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v sobotu 11. apríla 2026 v Michalovciach pri V. ZŠ na Školskej ulici. Pretekári sa môžu tešiť na súťaž v rôznych vekových kategóriách, vrátane detí do 9 rokov, ktoré bežia 400 metrov. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru jarného športového dňa s vyhlásením výsledkov a ocenením medailistov.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ pri V. ZŠ, Školská 2, Michalovce
Bežecké trate pre rôzne vekové kategórie
Krátky beh 400 m pre deti do 9 rokov
additional: Program podujatia zahŕňa štart behu na 400 m o 9:30 pre kategórie chlapcov a dievčat do 9 rokov a vyhlásenie výsledkov s ocenením medailistov o 10:30. Detský beh začína o 10:00, hlavný beh o 10:15; štartovné zahŕňa rôzne vekové kategórie; miesto konania je Michalovce, V. ZŠ, ŠKOLSKÁ 2

name: Horský půlmaraton Sušice
location: Ostrov Santos, Sušice, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Sušice Mountain Half Marathon is a challenging and beautiful running race in the heart of Šumava, offering a unique experience with stunning views from three peaks and of iconic places such as Žižkův vrch, Kalich, Sedlo, Kalovy and Pustý Hrádek. The race base is traditionally on Santos Island by the Otava River, where runners can enjoy quality services, marked courses and a family-friendly atmosphere. The organizers focus on providing excellent conditions and an unforgettable day filled with sport and nature. The race also has a strong tradition and is organized in memory of Matěj Molcar, an enthusiastic athlete.
course_highlights: The main course is 21.1 km long with 800 m of elevation gain
The surface consists of 90% paved roads, singletrack, forest trails and rocky climbs
The route crosses three peaks and offers stunning views of Šumava
additional: The race base on Santos Island offers a restaurant, parking, a children's playground, a swimming pool, a pump track and a skatepark. Relay teams are provided with transport to the start and a shuttle after the race. The children's race has several age categories, with different loop lengths. Cancellation insurance for the entry fee can be arranged through Kooperativa. The race offers several distances, including a half marathon and 10.5 km, with challenging terrain and a family-friendly atmosphere in the Sušice and Šumava area.

name: 57. ročník Běhu vítězství, 53. ročník Hranické dvacítky a 10. ročník Hranické desítky
location: Stadion SK Hranice, Hranice, Czech Republic
description: The Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice. The races take place at the SK Hranice stadium and in the surrounding area, with the shorter distances of 100 to 500 metres run on the stadium track. The Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka partly follow forest paths, offering runners a pleasant natural setting. These races have a long tradition and are popular with runners of all kinds, as well as children and young people.
course_highlights: Races from 100 to 500 m on the stadium track
The Hranická dvacítka follows forest paths
Natural surroundings near the stadium
additional: The races have children’s categories and a training schedule for children and young people. Photos from previous editions are available online. The races are part of SK Hranice’s activities and promote a healthy lifestyle. The programme also includes children’s and youth races; the 100 to 500 m runs take place on the stadium track. The main 20 km race is part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje.

name: Mistrovství ČR v půlmaratonu mužů a žen
location: Společenské centrum IDEON, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Czech Men’s and Women’s Half Marathon Championships is a prestigious 21.0975 km athletics race held in Pardubice. The start is on Smetana Square by the East Bohemian Theatre, and the finish is also in Pardubice. The race is for men, women and, where applicable, juniors who are entered by their athletics clubs and approved by the technical delegate. Participants receive a JOMA performance T-shirt free of charge. The Czech Championships results are announced shortly after the race, including the half-marathon results.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Pardubice, on Smetana Square by the East Bohemian Theatre
Course distance: 21.0975 km
Sports drinks and water at every lap
additional: Registration and race-number and timing-chip collection take place on Friday, 9 April, from 16:00 to 19:00 at the IDEON Social Centre, Jiráskova 1963, Pardubice. Runners must compete in club vests registered with the Czech Athletics Federation (ČAS). The race is technically organized by Oldřich Bujnoch in cooperation with the KPA Pardubice Sports Club. The Czech Championships results ceremony is at 15:40, and the half-marathon results ceremony is at 16:25. The race is scheduled for 10 April 2027, with a 14:00 start. The race office and race-number collection will be at the IDEON Social Centre. Runners receive a JOMA performance T-shirt, a medal and water at the finish; entries for the championship race are submitted by runners’ clubs.

name: Jarní běh Bílovice nad Svitavou
location: Palackého údolí, Bílovice nad Svitavou, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run in Bílovice nad Svitavou is a traditional athletics event organized by Sokol Bílovice nad Svitavou with the support of the municipality. The race takes place in Palackého Valley, approximately 800 metres beyond the Sokol gym, and is open to all age groups, from preschool children to adult men and women. The first race starts at 9:00, with categories divided by age and ability. The event offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere amid beautiful natural surroundings and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs through Palackého Valley in Bílovice nad Svitavou
Start approximately 800 m beyond the Sokol gym
Categories range from preschool children to adults
additional: The race is open to all categories, from preschool children up to 6 years old through to men and women. It starts on Saturday morning at 9:00. The event is organized with the support of the municipality of Bílovice nad Svitavou and Sokol Bílovice nad Svitavou.

name: Pardubický vinařský půlmaratón – Mistrovství ČR v půlmaratonu
description: The Pardubice Wine Half Marathon is a traditional 21.097 km race held in Pardubice. It is also the Czech Republic Men’s and Women’s Half Marathon Championship, with a scenic course through the city centre and the finish at Pernštýnské Square. The start is at Smetana Square, and runners complete two laps. Participants receive a technical T-shirt and a bottle of wine if they pay the entry fee on time. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and elite athletes.
course_highlights: The course runs through the centre of Pardubice, starting at Smetana Square and finishing at Pernštýnské Square
Two laps, with a total distance of 21.097 km
Isotonic drinks and water at every lap
additional: The start and finish are in the centre of Pardubice. Registration takes place at the IDEON Social Centre in Pardubice. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours. Registrations not paid by 4.4.2027 do not include a T-shirt or wine. Timing chips are non-returnable and assigned by number. Parking is available in front of the IDEON Social Centre and in nearby car parks.

name: Zlínská lesní hodinovka
description: The Zlín Forest Hour Run is a unique running race in the Czech Republic, held in the forest above the Lesní čtvrť district of Zlín. The race has a long tradition: it was originally run on a cinder track, moved to the forest at Vršava in 1995, and since 2006 has taken place on a gently rolling one-kilometre loop. The run lasts 60 minutes, and competitors try to cover as much distance as possible. The race is organized by Jirka Prokop and his team and is known for its friendly, regional character.
course_highlights: A gently rolling one-kilometre loop in the forest above the Lesní čtvrť district of Zlín
A unique forest course, the only hourly race in the Czech Republic run in a forest
The Gustav Bělský Loop at Vršava (historically)
additional: Race registration takes place at the observatory. The race lasts 60 minutes of running time. The best performance is over 17 km in an hour. The race is part of the year-round competition for runners from the Zlín region.

name: Jarní kros Okolo Dračí studánky
location: Malíkovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: ZD Hradečno a Obec Malíkovice ve spolupráci s MK Kladno a Pavlem Žlábkem
description: The Spring Cross-Country Race around Dračí studánka is a 6 km race that runs mainly along field and forest paths in Malíkovice. This cross-country race gives runners the chance to enjoy the natural terrain and woodland setting of the Central Bohemian Region. It is organized by ZD Hradečno and the Malíkovice Municipal Office in cooperation with MK Kladno, ensuring high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and wants to experience a springtime run.
course_highlights: 6 km course mainly along field and forest paths
Natural and woodland terrain in the Central Bohemian Region
Scenic surroundings of Dračí studánka in Malíkovice

name: Půlmaraton Plzeňského kraje
description: The Plzeň Region Half Marathon is a popular running celebration held at the Škodaland venue in Plzeň. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including a half marathon, the regional 10K, a 5K, a team run and children’s races. The event is not only a sporting challenge but also an opportunity to get together and enjoy a great atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. The start and finish are located in front of the Škodaland venue, where refreshments, medical supervision and an accompanying programme are provided.
course_highlights: Certified half-marathon course measuring 21.0975 km
The route passes through Plzeň-Bory, Litice, Šlovice, Dobřany, Lhota and Valcha
Start and finish at the Škodaland venue in Plzeň
additional: You can order a technical T-shirt and headband when registering. The race pack can be collected at the Škodaland venue on Friday, 23.4.2027, from 14:00 to 19:00, or on race day from 7:30 to 9:00. Registration closes after 9:00. The entry fee includes a medal, chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, photo service, an online diploma, a race bag, baggage storage, free parking and medical supervision. You can transfer your registration to another participant free of charge until 20.4.2027; after that date, a fee of 100 Kč applies. The race involves traffic restrictions along the route due to road closures.

name: Veřovská desítka
description: We invite you to the traditional Veřovská desítka run, held in the picturesque village of Veřovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all ages and abilities, including children’s categories and a race for non-registered participants. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and beautiful surroundings, inspiring active movement and a memorable sporting experience. Race information is available to download on the official website. We look forward to your participation and to sharing a great sporting experience.
additional: Race information and details of the children’s categories are available to download on the website. Orlovna’s contact telephone numbers and opening hours are listed for enquiries and reservations.

name: Běhej lesy Karlštejn
location: Bubovice, Karlštejn, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Karlštejn is a trail race held in the picturesque countryside near Karlštejn, offering a range of distances, including short, medium, and extra-long routes. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, ensuring high quality and prestige. The course features special Conti Speed Section speed segments and the extended Generali Investments Finish straight, adding competitive elements and motivation. Join runners enjoying the beautiful forest setting and sporting atmosphere of this popular race.
course_highlights: UTMB Index Races with international rankings
Conti Speed Section – a 150-metre speed segment on the 12 km, 18 km, and 30 km routes
Generali Investments Finish – an extended 500 m finish straight with a timed segment
additional: The race features special Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish speed segments, with prizes for the fastest runners. You can transfer your registration and change your race entry online through SportID or at the race venue. The race is sold out for all main distances in 2026. The race offers a range of distances, including an extra-long route, has an international UTMB Index, and includes charitable and competitive elements, as well as the option to download GPX routes. The course passes historical and natural landmarks with beautiful views.

name: 7 pohoří Jizerské hory
location: Ski areál Severák, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Jizerské hory 2026 race is part of the 7 pohoří trail run series and offers technical trails with epic views around Smržovka, Josefův Důl and Maxov. The start and race facilities are at Ski areál Severák in the Liberec Region. Runners can choose from three courses: the main 25 km course with 860 m of elevation gain, an alternative 14 km course with 400 m of elevation gain, and the Kari Traa RUN 6 km course with 150 m of elevation gain. The routes have been designed by Michal Zavadil, a rescuer with the Jizerské hory Mountain Rescue Service. The race takes place in all weather conditions and has a time limit of 4 hours.
course_highlights: Technical trails with up to 860 m of elevation gain
Routes follow paths and trails around Smržovka, Josefův Důl and Maxov
Epic views and an atmosphere unique to the 7 pohoří trail run series
additional: The entry fee includes a professionally marked course, race number, chip timing, commemorative medal, refreshments along the course and at the finish, and use of the race facilities. Participants can leave small belongings at the registration tent. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the záchranka app. The event takes place in all weather conditions, and participation is at your own risk. Course distances: 25 km, 14 km or 6 km; elevation gain: 150 m to 860 m; start and race facilities at Ski areál Severák; registration includes chip timing, a medal and refreshments; event held in all weather conditions.

name: Běh Trojzemím
location: Kristýna recreational area, Hrádek nad Nisou, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 200/300 Kč to 300/500 Kč za pár, zdarma pro děti
description: Běh Trojzemím is a family run for all ages and ability levels, held at the Kristýna recreation area in Hrádek nad Nisou. The race offers a fast 5 km and 10 km course, mostly along flat cycle paths, ideal for runners of all levels. The event is traditionally supported by local partners and is suitable for the whole family. The start and finish are located in beautiful natural surroundings, with paid parking available near the start.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km and 10 km course
Mostly flat cycle paths
Start and finish at the Kristýna recreation area
additional: Children’s check-in is from 8:30 to 9:30 in the start and finish area. Adult check-in is from 9:00 to 12:30. Parking is paid and available in the immediate vicinity of the start; the car park is unattended. The race has reached capacity and registration is closed; it is not possible to register online or on site. The course includes flat cycle paths; registration is closed; the race includes road traffic; health and safety information is provided.

name: NN NIGHT RUN Ostrava
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 Km

description: NN NIGHT RUN Ostrava is the largest running event in Ostrava, held in Masaryk Square. More than 2,000 runners of all ages take part each year, from beginners to experienced competitors. The event offers an unforgettable atmosphere and a varied programme, including children’s races, relays and runs supporting breast cancer awareness. The races start in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. There is also entertainment, performances and the chance to test sports equipment.
course_highlights: Night run in central Ostrava, starting in Masaryk Square
10 km course with a 90-minute limit, a 2 × 5 km relay, and shorter 3 km and 5 km runs
A lively atmosphere with accompanying activities, performances and the chance to test sports products
additional: The programme includes the KIDS CUP children’s races, the FÉNIX RUN 3 km, the BELLIS RUN 5 km supporting breast cancer awareness, the NN NIGHT RUN 10 km main race and a 2 × 5 km relay. Race packs are distributed from the afternoon. The accompanying programme features performances, warm-ups, MIZUNO sports equipment testing, a shoe rental service, NUTREND nutritional supplements, a photo booth, face painting, a bouncy castle and other activities. The time limit for the 10 km is 90 minutes and for the 5 km it is 70–75 minutes; the event is also suitable for brisk walking. The organiser offers entry-fee discounts for NN clients and athletes, the option of free insurance during the race and other benefits. Races include various categories, registration is available online and on site, and participants receive medals, running T-shirts and refreshments.

name: Běh Litní a zámeckým parkem
location: Liteň, Liteň, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
