The afternoon also includes special races for the youngest children, with shorter courses. The main race has an individual start at 20-second intervals. Winners receive certificates and prizes, and refreshments are available at the venue. The race is part of ISCAREX CUP 2026 and is organized by the Town of Žamberk, SVČ ANIMO, and SK Žamberk.
course_highlights: Uphill race to Rozálka Hill in the grounds of the Tyrš Lookout Tower
Special short courses for children aged up to 5 (90 m) and 6–7 (190 m)
Individual start for the main race at 20-second intervals
additional: Categories D1 and D2 have mass starts from the Chapel of St. Rosalia at 16:15 and 16:20. The main race has individual starts from 17:00 near the Municipal Museum, at 20-second intervals. Registration and payment of the entry fee are available online until 22.4.2026; after that, registration is available only on site, with cash payment. Sports clubs may submit group entries by email. Results will be announced and prizes presented immediately after the race. Light refreshments are available for purchase at the venue. Running courses from 90 to 190 metres, main race from 17:00, online and on-site registration, refreshments at the venue, runners set off at 20-second intervals

name: Trhovosvinenská padesátka
location: Trhové Svin, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trhovosvinenská padesátka is a traditional long-distance walk through the Trhové Sviny region and its surroundings, offering two main routes of approximately 50 km and 100 km. The event is open to walkers and runners and takes place in all weather. The routes pass through picturesque countryside and include several refreshment stations. The finish is at Buškův hamr, a technical monument in Trhové Sviny. The organizers focus on a welcoming atmosphere, clear route marking and comfortable facilities, including refreshments and the option to stay overnight.
course_highlights: The 50 km route has 2 refreshment stations; the 100 km route has 4
The 100 km route starts on Friday evening, with start times for both walkers and runners
The finish is at Buškův hamr, a technical monument in Trhové Sviny
additional: The event takes place in all weather. For the 50 km route, the number of servings of soup is limited (250); other participants will receive a baguette. For the 100 km route, participants can choose the type of refreshments at two morning stops when registering. Mandatory equipment includes a charged mobile phone, a headlamp and reflective elements as required by regulations. Overnight accommodation has been arranged; details will be confirmed at the start. The routes include hilly terrain through the Novohradské Mountains and Austria. Overnight accommodation is available on Saturday 25.4. Registration is open until 20.4.2026. Refreshments are provided along the route, and participants receive a medal after the event.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Kuřim
location: Kuřim, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Excalibur Race MOON Kuřim is an OCR race taking place on April 24, 2026, in Kuřim. The course combines flat sections, hills, forest trails, and water sections, including a quiet forest, Srpek Pond, the challenging Zlobice Hill, and the atmosphere of Kuřim’s Stonehenge. The race will test every participant’s physical and mental endurance and is for brave knights of obstacle sports. The main category starts at 20:30, giving the race a unique nighttime atmosphere.
course_highlights: Quiet forest and Srpek Pond
Challenging Zlobice Hill
The mysterious atmosphere of Kuřim’s Stonehenge
additional: This is a nighttime OCR race with course distances ranging from 6 to 12 km. The organizer is Překážkové sporty, z. s., Jan Kolář. The race starts in the evening at 20:30, creating a unique atmosphere. The course combines varied terrain and obstacles that test physical and mental endurance. Terrain: forest, water, hills; online registration; OCR obstacle race

name: Ultramaratón Košice – Miskolc
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: Ultramaratón Košice - Miskolc je náročný medzinárodný ultrabežecký závod, ktorý sa koná 18. apríla 2026. Trasa vedie z centra Košíc do Miskolca, ponúkajúc bežcom výzvu v podobe dlhého a rozmanitého terénu. Podujatie je súčasťou série bežeckých akcií organizovaných Maratónskym klubom Košice a je určené pre vytrvalostných bežcov, ktorí hľadajú jedinečný zážitok na hranici svojich možností. Štart je na Hlavnej ulici v Košiciach, čo dodáva preteku historickú atmosféru a podporu miestnych divákov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie z Košíc do Miskolca cez rôzne terény
Štart a cieľ v historickom centre Košíc na Hlavnej ulici
Medzinárodný charakter preteku s prechodom cez hranice
additional: Štart preteku je na Hlavnej ulici v Košiciach medzi hotelom DoubleTree by Hilton a obchodným domom Dargov. Podujatie je súčasťou série Košice Marathon eventov a organizuje ho Maratónsky klub Košice. Nie sú uvedené konkrétne informácie o vlnách štartu, kapacitách, alebo poplatkoch. Pretek začína o 6:00 a 7:00, registrácie majú stanovené termíny a poplatky, preteky sa konajú na Hlavnej ulici a Dolnej bráne v Košiciach, je určený pre bežcov od 16 rokov a starších, kategórie zahŕňajú individuálne, dvojice a štafety.

name: Ultra Kras
location: Národný park Slovenský kras, Turni nad Bodvou, Slovakia
description: Ultra Kras je horský ultramaratón s dĺžkou 57 km a prevýšením 2400 metrov, ktorý vedie Národným parkom Slovenský kras. Štart aj cieľ sú v Turni nad Bodvou, pričom pretek má časový limit 12 hodín. Pretek je súčasťou Slovenskej Ultratrailovej Ligy a ponúka náročnú trasu s viacerými občerstvovacími a kontrolnými bodmi. Prezentácia pretekárov prebieha deň pred štartom a v deň preteku, pričom štart je spoločný o 7:00 ráno.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie Národným parkom Slovenský kras
Dĺžka 57 km s prevýšením +2400 m
Živé kontrolné stanovištia na občerstvovacích staniciach
additional: Prezentácia účastníkov prebieha v piatok 24.4.2026 od 18:00 do 22:00 a v sobotu 25.4.2026 od 5:00 do 6:30. Časový limit na dosiahnutie cieľa je 12 hodín od štartu, teda do 19:00. Kontrolný bod K3 Hačava (30 km) má časový limit 7,5 hodiny od štartu (do 14:30). Cieľ aj štart sú na parkovisku vedľa kina Hviezda v Turni nad Bodvou. Elektronická časomiera zaznamenáva príchody na kontrolných bodoch a v cieli. Trať 57 km, limit 12 hodín, registrácia 24-25 apríla, občerstvovacie stanice, povinná výbava, kategórie muži a ženy, súčasť Slovenskej Ultratrailovej Ligy.

name: Demänovský Štvanec
location: Demänová rezort, Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia
organizer: WinTeam o.z. a Agentúra 8P v spolupráci s Demänová rezort
description: Demänovský Štvanec je bežecké podujatie určené pre hobby bežcov aj výkonnostných pretekárov, ktoré sa koná v krásnej prírode Demänovskej doliny v Liptovskom Mikuláši. Preteky ponúkajú tri disciplíny: Malý Štvanec na 5 km, Veľký Štvanec s TUI na 10 km a detské behy Štvanček. Okrem športového zážitku si účastníci môžu užiť rodinnú atmosféru a doplnkové aktivity v Demänová rezorte. Podujatie je súčasťou víkendu plného pohybu, hier a radosti, ktorý organizuje WinTeam o.z. a Agentúra 8P v spolupráci s Demänová rezort.
course_highlights: Trate vedú krásnou prírodou Demänovskej doliny
Malý Štvanec 5 km a Veľký Štvanec 10 km s časovým limitom 1:30 a 2:00 hodín
Detské behy Štvanček s postupným štartom podľa vekových kategórií
additional: Prezentácia a vyzdvihnutie štartových čísiel v piatok 24.04.2026 od 17:00 do 19:00 a v sobotu 25.04.2026 od 8:00 do 10:00 pre deti aj dospelých. Meranie časov pre dospelých zabezpečuje VOS-TPK pomocou čipov s priebežným zverejňovaním výsledkov na www.sportsofttiming.sk. Pri zakúpení pobytu v Demänová rezorte je štartovné v cene ubytovania. Kategórie detí štartujú postupne od 11:00 hod. podľa veku. Podujatie zahŕňa registráciu online aj na mieste, kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny, a súčasťou sú aj rodinné aktivity a balíčky s ubytovaním v Demänová rezorte.

name: Račiansky polmaratón, Račianska desiatka
location: Športový areál Tbiliská 4, Bratislava-Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky polmaratón a Račianska desiatka sú tradičné bežecké podujatia v mestskej časti Bratislava-Rača, ktoré ponúkajú možnosť zúčastniť sa na polmaratóne alebo desiatke. Pretekári si môžu užiť trať vedúcu športovým areálom Tbiliská 4 a okolitými časťami Rače. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť, vrátane rekreačných bežcov aj náročnejších športovcov. Organizátorom je mestská časť Bratislava-Rača, ktorá zabezpečuje kvalitné podmienky a servis pre účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trať vedie športovým areálom Tbiliská 4 v Bratislave-Rači
Možnosť výberu medzi polmaratónskou a desiatkovou trasou
Prechádza mestskou časťou Rača s príjemným mestským prostredím

name: Prešov Running Series 1. kolo
price_range: 10 eur (detský štart), zľava 2 eurá pre poistencov Dôvery
description: Prešov Running, o.z. vás srdečne pozýva na Prešov Stars Run 2026, ktorý sa uskutoční 25. apríla v centre Prešova. Tento bežecký večer vás zavedie do atmosféry 90-tych rokov s hudbou, retro športovou módou a zábavou. Pretekári si môžu vybrať z detských behov a tratí na 5 a 10 km, pričom počas behu budú sprevádzaní DJ-mi a vystúpením MC Erika. Prešov Stars Run je prvým kolom série Prešov Running Series 2026, ktorá pozostáva z troch samostatných behov v rôznych častiach mesta a jeho okolí.
course_highlights: Bežecké trate v centre mesta Prešov
Hudobný sprievod DJ-ov počas behu
Retro atmosféra s hitmi 90-tych rokov a vystúpením MC Erika
additional: Poistenci Dôvery môžu využiť zľavu 2 eurá na štartovnom (okrem detských behov). Zľava nie je prenosná a pri neúčasti je možná len storno registrácie do dátumu uvedeného v propozíciách. Po rozcvičke v štýle Cvičme v Rytme s Omnis Vitality štartujú bežci na 5 a 10 km. V rámci série Prešov Running Series 2026 sa konajú tri samostatné behy v apríli, júni a septembri. Trať zahŕňa mestské ulice, organizuje sa online registrácia, podujatie má sprievodný program s hudbou a vystúpeniami.

name: Gavurky run 2026 + Backyard ultra
description: Gavurky run 2026 je bežecké podujatie v Dobrej Nive, ktoré ponúka rôzne trate vrátane hlavného behu, hobby behu, Nordic walking a Backyard ultra. Preteky sa konajú 25. apríla 2026 s prezentáciou a štartmi na Námestí SNP. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú škálu bežcov vrátane detí, hobby bežcov a ultramaratóncov, pričom kapacita je limitovaná na 400 účastníkov. Organizátorom je ŠPORTKLUB Dobrá Niva, o.z., ktorý zabezpečuje profesionálnu organizáciu a meranie časov.
course_highlights: Hlavný beh 10,4 km s prevýšením 190 m
Backyard ultra trať 6,7 km s prevýšením 132 m, štart o 8:00
Hobby beh a Nordic walking trať 5,6 km
additional: Prezentácia pre Backyard ultra je od 7:00 do 7:30 na Námestí SNP. Prezentácia pre hlavný, hobby beh a Nordic walking je od 8:30 do 10:30. Deti majú samostatné behy s bezplatnou registráciou na mieste. Kapacita podujatia je 400 bežcov. On-line registrácia končí 24.4.2026 o 12:00 alebo pri naplnení limitu. Platba štartovného je možná online, bankovým prevodom alebo na mieste (za príplatok). Trať zahŕňa asfaltové a nespevnené cesty, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, kapacita je 400 bežcov, súčasťou sú aj detské behy a Nordic walking. Pretekárov čakajú medaily, guláš, tombola a meranie času čipovou časomierou.

name: Agrotim Race
location: Zemplínska Nová Ves, Zemplínsky kraj, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Zemplínska Nová Ves a AGROTIM spol. s.r.o

description: Agrotim Race je bežecké podujatie organizované obcou Zemplínska Nová Ves a firmou AGROTIM spol. s.r.o., ktoré sa koná v Zemplínskom Klečenove pod altánkom v Oáze oddychu. Pretek je určený pre mužov a ženy a ponúka možnosť online registrácie do 22. apríla 2025. Štartovné je dostupné za zvýhodnenú cenu pri včasnej registrácii a vyššiu cenu pri registrácii na mieste. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov, ktorí hľadajú príjemný bežecký zážitok v prírodnom prostredí.
course_highlights: Trať vedie v Zemplínskom Klečenove pod altánkom v Oáze oddychu
Prírodné prostredie vhodné na beh
Organizované obcou Zemplínska Nová Ves a firmou AGROTIM spol. s.r.o.
additional: Registrácia prebieha online e-mailom na o.ouznves@gmail.com. Štartovné je 8 € pri online registrácii do 22.4.2025, na mieste 10 €. Miesto štartu je pod altánkom v Oáze oddychu v Zemplínskom Klečenove. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov všetkých úrovní, pričom podrobnosti o trase nie sú špecifikované, a prebieha v prírodnom prostredí v okolí Zemplínskej Novej Vsi.

name: 1000-ročný beh
location: Tenisové kurty pri nemocnici s poliklinikou, Spišská Nová Ves, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia
price_range: 6 € pre hlavné kategórie, 4 € pre beh pre zdravie a Nordic walking, plus dobrovoľné príspevky

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 6 € kategórie hlavného behu + dobrovoľný príspevok, keďže ten bude poukázaný dobrej veci

price_tiers.distance: Beh pre zdravie a nordic walking

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 4 € kategórie behu pre zdravie a nordic walking + dobrovoľný príspevok

description: 1000-ročný beh je bežecká súťaž organizovaná SPK Medveď v Spišskej Novej Vsi, ktorá sa koná 25. apríla 2026 na tenisových kurtoch pri nemocnici s poliklinikou. Trať vedie prevažne po poľných a lesných cestách s dĺžkou hlavného behu približne 9,6 km a prevýšením 267 m. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj kategórie pre deti, dorast, juniorov, nordic walking a beh pre zdravie, pričom štart je o 10:00 hod. Pretekári majú zabezpečené občerstvenie na trati a v cieli, vrátane guľášu alebo pirôh a nápoja. Registrácia prebieha online alebo e-mailom, štartovné sa platí na mieste v deň pretekov.
course_highlights: Trať prevažne poľné a lesné cesty
Hlavný beh cca 9,6 km s prevýšením 267 m
Štart na tenisových kurtoch pri nemocnici s poliklinikou
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je v deň pretekov od 8:30 do 9:30. Platba štartovného sa realizuje na mieste v deň pretekov. Každý účastník má nárok na občerstvenie v cieli (guľáš alebo pirôhy a jeden nápoj - pivo alebo kofola). Vyhlásenie výsledkov je po dobehnutí posledného pretekára okolo 13:30. Registrácia je možná priamo na mieste v deň pretekov, štart hlavného behu je o 11:00, detské behy začínajú o 9:30, podujatie sa koná na Tenisových kurtoch pri nemocnici s poliklinikou v Spišskej Novej Vsi.

name: Beh oslobodenia Chtelnice
description: Beh oslobodenia Chtelnice je tradičný bežecký závod s nemennou trasou, ktorý štartuje na Námestí 1. mája a vedie cez malebné prostredie Malých Karpát. Trať kombinuje asfaltové úseky s lesnou cestičkou popri vodnej nádrži Priehrada Chtelnica, pomníku padlých z 2. svetovej vojny a Kaplnke sv. Rócha. Bežci si môžu vychutnať prírodné scenérie a výzvy ako legendárny „stupák“ v lesnom úseku. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov, ktorí hľadajú kombináciu asfaltu a prírodného terénu v pokojnom horskom prostredí.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez krásne prostredie Malých Karpát
Úsek popri vodnej nádrži Priehrada Chtelnica
Lesná cestička s pomníkom padlých a Kaplnkou sv. Rócha
additional: Online registrácia a meranie času zabezpečuje firma SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk. Registrácia online končí 24.04.2025 o 23:59, po tomto termíne je možná registrácia na mieste v deň pretekov, ak nebude naplnený účastnícky limit. Pretekári štartujú na vlastnú zodpovednosť a musia mať zabezpečené zdravotné poistenie. Trať je značená bielym značením na asfalte a bielymi stužkami v lese. Odporúča sa nepoužívať tretry kvôli asfaltovým úsekom. Registrácia je možná online alebo priamo na mieste, podujatie je súčasťou osláv oslobodenia Chtelnice, a je súčasťou 41. ročníka podujatia.

name: Čirov beh – Radobica
description: Čirov beh - Radobica je tradičný dedinský beh, ktorý ponúka bežcom možnosť vychutnať si rôznorodý terén na trati dlhšej 5,4 km s prevýšením 201 metrov. Trať vedie po asfalte, dedinských uličkách, poľných cestách, kopčekoch, rovinách a lesíkoch, vrátane krátkeho strmého úseku. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské behy na 800 metrov, ktoré sú vhodné pre mladších bežcov. Podujatie sa koná v Radobici pred obecným úradom a je otvorené pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane domácich bežcov. Organizátori ponúkajú finančné odmeny za prekonanie traťových rekordov.
course_highlights: 5,4 km trať s prevýšením +201 m
Rôznorodý terén: asfalt, dedinské uličky, poľné cesty, kopčeky, rovinky, lesíky
Detské behy na 800 m bez prevýšenia
additional: Vyhodnotenie pretekov je o 17:15 hod. Kategórie zahŕňajú rôzne vekové skupiny mužov, žien a mládeže. Absolútny víťaz a víťazka ženskej kategórie môžu získať finančnú prémiu za prekonanie traťových rekordov (150€ a 100€). Štart je pred obecným úradom v Radobici. Podujatie je organizované na vlastné riziko účastníkov. Preteky sú vhodné pre všetky vekové skupiny, registrácia je možná na mieste, podujatie začína v popoludňajších hodinách s rôznymi kategóriami a sprievodnými aktivitami.

name: Jablonická desiatka – Memoriál Felixa Rímeša
description: Jablonická desiatka - Memoriál Felixa Rímeša je bežecký pretek organizovaný ŠK Jablonica a Obcou Jablonica, ktorý sa koná pri Zdravotnom stredisku v Jablonici. Pretek ponúka kategórie pre deti, dorast, juniorov a dospelých, s rôznymi vekovými kategóriami mužov a žien. Štart pre detské kategórie je o 14:30 a pre dorast, juniorov a dospelých o 17:00. Pretek je príležitosťou pre bežcov všetkých vekových skupín zúčastniť sa na tradičnom podujatí v príjemnom prostredí.
course_highlights: Trať cez CHKO Malé Karpaty s krásnymi výhľadmi
Kategórie pre všetky vekové skupiny vrátane detí a veteránov
Hlavné disciplíny 10 km a 4 km beh
additional: Štart pre detské kategórie je o 14:30 hod., pre dorast, juniorov a dospelých o 17:00 hod. Kategórie zahŕňajú detské, žiacke, dorastenecké, juniorské, mužov v rôznych vekových skupinách a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách. Podujatie je súčasťou regionálnych bežeckých pohárov a ponúka aj po pretekoch guláš a príjemnú atmosféru. Registrácia je možná prostredníctvom kontaktov na webovej stránke.

name: Jablonická desiatka

description: Jablonická desiatka je tradičný bežecký memoriál Felixa Rímeša, ktorý sa koná v obci Jablonica. Podujatie je určené pre celú rodinu, vhodné aj pre deti a ponúka bezbariérový prístup. Bežci si môžu užiť aktívne trávenie voľného času v príjemnom prostredí obce. Štartovné je symbolické a deti a mládež majú účasť zdarma.
course_highlights: Bežecký memoriál Felixa Rímeša v obci Jablonica
Bezbariérový vstup a vhodné pre deti
Príjemné prostredie obce Jablonica
additional: Podujatie je vhodné pre deti, má bezbariérový vstup a je povolený vstup so zvieratami. Organizátorom je ŠK Jablonica. Doba trvania podujatia je približne 285 minút. Podujatie zahŕňa kategórie pre deti, mládež aj dospelých, s rôznymi dĺžkami tratí, a je vhodné pre rodiny a bežeckých nadšencov.

name: NZ charitatívny beh pre OZ čiernouško
location: Parkovisko pri reštaurácii Berek, Nové Zámky, Slovakia
organizer: Občianske združenie čiernouško, STG Nové Zámky

description: NZ charitatívny beh pre OZ čiernouško je bežecké podujatie v Nových Zámkoch, ktoré sa koná na parkovisku pri reštaurácii Berek na ulici Tatranská. Trať je prevažne asfaltová, vedie po rovine a mimo cestnej komunikácie. Výťažok z behu je venovaný občianskemu združeniu čiernouško, ktoré pomáha zvieratám bez domova, týraným a zvieratám v núdzi. Organizátormi sú Občianske združenie čiernouško a STG Nové Zámky, pričom podujatie je vhodné pre milovníkov zvierat a bežcov, ktorí chcú spojiť šport s charitatívnou pomocou.
course_highlights: Prevažne asfaltový povrch
Rovinatá trať mimo cestnej komunikácie
Miesto štartu a cieľa pri reštaurácii Berek, ulica Tatranská
additional: Štartovné je 10 € pri registrácii vopred, na mieste 12 €. Pri platbe je potrebné uviesť do poznámky BEH + meno bežca. Organizátorom je Občianske združenie čiernouško a STG Nové Zámky. The race is for runners looking for a personal challenge and wanting to push their limits on a moderately difficult course. It also features a unique steamboat relay, combining running with a steamboat ride across the reservoir. The event is organized by Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s., which emphasizes quality facilities and runner safety.
course_highlights: An 18 km varied course through natural terrain along both shores of the Brno Reservoir
Stunning views of the reservoir and Veveří Castle
A unique 2 × 9 km steamboat relay, including a crossing of the reservoir
additional: The race is limited to 700 runners. The race packet contains a race bib with a timing chip, safety pins, a bag-storage tag, partner vouchers, a ticket for hot soup after the race, and a raffle ticket. Separate changing rooms, guarded baggage storage, and storage for bicycles and scooters are available. Timing uses chip technology, with real-time results. Medical support is available on the course, at the finish, and at the event facilities. The first relay leg and the main race start between 9:45 and 9:55; the second relay leg starts at 9:20, with participants departing for the steamboat. The race is limited to 700 participants and includes timing, technical facilities, medical support, and refreshments on the course and at the finish.

name: Hlučínská 24ka
description: Hlučínská 24ka is a unique 24-hour ultramarathon held in the beautiful surroundings of the Hlučín gravel pit, around Hlučín Lake. The race offers the chance to test your endurance by completing as many laps as possible on a 6,180-metre course. In addition to the main individual race, a new pairs race gives participants the opportunity to share the experience with a partner. The event also includes children’s races and shorter runs for the general public, all in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. It is organised by the Benešováci z.s. association, which emphasises sporting spirit, fair play and promoting an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: A 6,180-metre loop around Hlučín Lake
Flat asphalt course with no significant elevation changes
Beautiful natural surroundings at the Hlučín gravel pit
additional: The race takes place on 25.4.2026 and the 24-hour ultramarathon finishes on 26.4.2026 at 9:00. Children’s and shorter runs start between 14:00 and 15:00. The course is flat asphalt with a low difficulty level. Each participant receives a race number and an ID chip; the race number must be worn visibly. The organiser recommends a medical check-up before the race, and participation is at your own risk. An ultramarathon T-shirt is also included. Facilities are at the campsite directly by the Hlučín gravel pit. 24-hour ultramarathon, 6,180 m course, held at the Hlučín gravel pit, pairs race option, accompanying activities

name: Nížkovský běh u koupaliště
location: Nížkov u koupaliště, Nížkov, Czech Republic
description: The Nížkov Run by the Swimming Pool is a traditional cross-country race organised by TJ Sokol Nížkov and held annually by the swimming pool in Nížkov. The race has a long-standing tradition and is popular with local runners and sports enthusiasts from the surrounding area. It offers athletes of all ages and abilities the chance to enjoy a run in the pleasant surroundings of the Vysočina region. The organisers focus on a friendly atmosphere and high-quality event organisation.
course_highlights: A traditional cross-country race in the natural surroundings by the swimming pool in Nížkov
Organised by TJ Sokol Nížkov, with a long-standing tradition
Suitable for runners of different ages and abilities
additional: The race is part of TJ Sokol Nížkov’s activities and traditionally takes place in spring, usually one week after the Easter holidays. The organisers also hold athletics races for children and young people at the field behind the Sokol hall. The Nížkov Run by the Swimming Pool is part of the wider sports programme in the municipality of Nížkov. A traditional spring race; attended by local and visiting runners; results available online; held by the swimming pool in Nížkov.

name: ALIS RUN - Bystřický běh s úsměvem
description: ALIS RUN – Bystřice Run with a Smile is a traditional running race held in the village of Bystřice. This friendly race offers a pleasant atmosphere and is suitable for the general public, including younger participants with written consent from a legal guardian. The race takes place on April 25, 2026, and participants start at their own risk, with an emphasis on following safety instructions. The event also offers the opportunity to buy an Alis Run 2026 T-shirt in advance.
course_highlights: Scenic route around Bystřice
Support for the local charity “Nikdy nejsi sám”
Friendly atmosphere and various race categories
additional: Participants under 18 may take part in the race only with written consent from a responsible representative. Each participant starts at their own risk and agrees to follow safety instructions. Participants consent to audiovisual recording of their participation and performance for the purpose of promoting the race. Orders for Alis Run 2026 T-shirts are closed for this year. Entry fees will support the association “Nikdy nejsi sám”; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Rychlebský maraton
description: The Rychlebský Marathon is a spring supplementary race in the beautiful Rychlebské Mountains, known for their wild and remote nature. The routes follow excellent mountain trails through deep valleys, deserted rocky outcrops, old mountain meadows and abandoned settlements, offering runners an unforgettable wilderness experience and beautiful views. The race is ideal for anyone who wants to discover the Rychlebské Mountains through the eyes of experienced locals and enjoy a run in nature with minimal asphalt. Routes of 26, 46 and 76 km are available, with the longer options also entering neighbouring Poland.
course_highlights: Routes follow excellent mountain trails and a border path
Through deep valleys, deserted rocky outcrops and mountain meadows around former settlements
Minimal asphalt, mostly forest trails and paths
additional: Registration is also possible on site, but signing up in advance helps with race preparations. Runners are divided into two age categories (under 39 and 40 and over). The entry fee includes a forest-owner fee, a map, a race bib, chip timing, a GPS tracker for the long route, a finisher’s certificate, generous on-course refreshments and hot soup at the finish (vegan and non-vegan). Accommodation in a makeshift gym in Javorník is available for 150 CZK per night. Trail ultramarathon on mountain trails, registration information, special programmes including evening talks, and changes to the event venue on race day.

name: Běh na Mědník
location: Klášterec nad Ohří, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Mědník is a sporting event held in the scenic Ore Mountains, with the event hub and registration at the Fénix restaurant in the village of Měděnec. Runners are taken by bus to the start in Klášterec nad Ohří, where they set off on the course. The event offers beautiful natural scenery and is suitable for runners who want to combine sport with discovering the region.
course_highlights: Start in Klášterec nad Ohří
Event hub at the Fénix restaurant in Měděnec
Runners transported by bus to the start
additional: The event hub and registration are at the Fénix restaurant in the village of Měděnec. At 10:15, runners are taken by bus to the start in Klášterec nad Ohří. The course runs mainly over off-road terrain in the Ore Mountains. The race includes bus transport from Měděnec to the start, refreshments along the course and at the finish, and the option to change at the Fénix restaurant at the finish.

name: VC Krkonoš Horní Maršov - Pomezní Boudy
location: Horní Maršov, Trutnov District, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: VC Krkonoš Horní Maršov - Pomezní Boudy is a mountain trail race with 540 metres of elevation gain. It starts in Horní Maršov and finishes at the former customs house on Pomezní sedlo at an altitude of 1,050 m above sea level. The challenging 13.6 km course is suited to runners who enjoy mountain challenges. A cross-country race is also organised for children and young people, making the event accessible to a wider public. The organiser, Jiří Kostadinov, ensures the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Mountain trail race with 540 metres of elevation gain
Finish at the former customs house on Pomezní sedlo at an altitude of 1,050 m above sea level
Course length: 13.6 km
additional: A cross-country race is organised for children and young people. The race is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s services for runners and running. The start is at Bertholdovo náměstí in Horní Maršov. The event also includes a cross-country race for children and young people and is part of the national mountain-running series, with the possibility of qualifying for European competitions.

name: Bratčická desítka

price_tiers.distance: Hlavní závod 10 km a doprovodný 6,5 km

description: Bratčická desítka is a running race held in the village of Bratčice in the South Moravian Region. The main race is 10 km long, and the accompanying race is 6.5 km. The course runs 80% on field and forest paths and 20% on asphalt. Lunch and refreshments at the finish are included in the entry fee, adding to the race’s pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: 80% field and forest paths
20% asphalt
Two races: 10 km run and 6.5 km accompanying run
additional: Lunch and refreshments at the finish are included in the entry fee. The first category starts at 9:00, and the main category starts at 11:00. The event is organized by Obec Bratčice and Roman Mazal (contact: 602 280 394). The race offers refreshments and lunch and is suitable for all ages and running levels.

name: Běh Semicemi
location: Semice, Nymburk District, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Semice Run is a traditional running event organized by Semice Primary School in the Nymburk District. The race has a long history and is held regularly in spring in and around the village of Semice in the Central Bohemian Region. It is open to various age categories and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport and meet runners from the region. Results from previous editions are regularly published on the school’s official website.
course_highlights: The course passes through the picturesque landscape of the Elbe Lowlands
The race is suitable for all age categories, from children to adults
A tradition and a friendly atmosphere at a local sporting gathering
additional: 10 km race; registration on site or in advance; the event is part of the local sports calendar; results are regularly published online.

name: Dobroběh Slováckem
location: Bílovice u Zlína, Zlín, Czech Republic

description: Dobroběh Slováckem is a running race held at the sports complex by the elementary school in Bílovice. It offers an 11 km main race with gentle elevation changes and a separate 5 km race. The event is open to the general public, including men’s and senior categories, and is suitable for runners aged 12 and over. Younger runners may also take part with written consent from their legal guardians. Registration takes place on race day, and participants receive a race pack and refreshments. Dobroběh Slováckem is a traditional sporting event in the region with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 11 km main race with 38 m of ascent and 38 m of descent
Separate 5 km race with 31 m of ascent and 31 m of descent
The course runs around the sports complex by the elementary school in Bílovice
additional: Race-day registration is open from 8:45 to 9:45 at the elementary school sports complex. Runners receive a timing chip, refreshment vouchers and a race bag. Participants under 18 must have written consent from their legal guardians. On-site entry is available, but does not include a race pack. The junior category has a reduced entry fee. The terrain includes village roads, concrete-panel roads and cycle paths. The race offers electronic timekeeping, refreshments and basic facilities. Registration is available online and on site.

name: III Bieg Pełną Parą dla Dzieciaków
XXIX Bieg o Puchar Dyrektora MOSiR
Mozdulj Csepel!
location: Kolonics György Szabadidőközpont, Hollandi út 8-10, Budapest, Hungary
description: Mozdulj, Csepel! is a free family running event organized by the Csepel Municipality as part of the Actively for Csepel program series. The race takes place on the beautiful Csepel Danube waterfront, starting from the Kolonics György Recreation Centre, and offers four distances: 3.5 km, 7 km, a 400 m children’s race, and a special race for people with disabilities. The event aims to share the joy of community and exercise with all age groups, with an environmentally conscious approach and cup-free refreshments. Race bibs must be worn for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances, and chip timing ensures accurate results.
course_highlights: The course follows Kolonics Promenade along the Danube.
Chip timing and overall men’s and women’s podiums for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances.
The children’s race course passes under the two-hole bridge; parental accompaniment is permitted.
additional: The event is cup-free, so participants are encouraged to bring their own soft cup, water bottle, or cup. The youngest participants will receive a medal, while older children will find a gym bag, an apple, and muesli at the finish. Strollers are permitted only at the participant’s own risk. The special race is a fun run for people with disabilities, where walking is also allowed. Multiple distances; registration required; environmentally friendly; chip timing; awards; family and special categories; route along the Danube; outdoor event; rain or shine.

name: Galbicska Péter Emlékfutás Tata 7 / 14
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The 6th Galbicska Péter Memorial Run will take place on April 25, 2026, on Tópart Promenade in Tata. Runners can choose between two distances: 7 km (1 lap around the lake) and 14 km (2 laps around the lake). Entries are available by age group and gender. The event has a friendly atmosphere and takes place in a lakeside setting, offering participants both a challenge and an enjoyable experience. The start is at 10:00, and registration is open until 18:00 on April 23.
course_highlights: 7 km and 14 km lakeside laps
Scenic surroundings on Tópart Promenade in Tata
Race distances available by age group and gender
additional: Required fields must be completed during registration; separate entry codes apply for each age group and gender. Registration is online, with the entry fee payable by bank card or bank transfer through the SimplePay system. The registration deadline is 18:00 on April 23. The event includes several categories, and participants must register by April 23. The event is part of Tata’s sporting life and traditions.

name: BACKYARD ULTRA ESZTERGOM
location: Franka Pálya – Gimnázium Sportpálya, Esztergom, Komárom-Esztergom County, Hungary

description: Backyard Ultra Esztergom 2026 is a special ultrarunning race that continues until only one runner remains. Competitors complete a 6,706-metre loop every hour, and only those who finish before the next start remain in the race. The event is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is held as an age-group championship, with the top female and male runners awarded in 11 age groups. The race takes place at Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya in Esztergom, and participants who complete distances of up to 160 kilometres may also receive recognition.
course_highlights: A 6,706-metre loop to be completed every hour
A last-runner-standing race: runners must finish before the next start to continue
An age-group championship with 11 categories for female and male competitors
additional: The race is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is held as an age-group championship, with the top female and male runners awarded in 11 age groups. The entry fee can be paid by bank card or bank transfer; for bank transfers, a payment request will be sent. The Backyard MINI event consists of 6 laps (40.236 km), with gold medals awarded to the fastest female and male runners. Competitors can earn multiple medals and trophies. On-site registration may be available if places remain, at a higher price. The race takes place at Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya; detailed registration and award information can be found on the official website. The race is a celebration of perseverance and community, where runners can push their own limits.

name: Beh za A(tra)ktívny Bardejov

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Každý bežec svojím štartovným v sume min. 15 € podporil jeden zo štyroch projektov

description: Beh za A(tra)ktívny Bardejov je benefičný beh, ktorý každoročne spája komunitu v Bardejove a jeho okolí. Podujatie sa koná na Radničnom námestí a ponúka možnosť podporiť štyri vybrané projekty prostredníctvom štartovného. Bežci môžu súťažiť fyzicky na mieste alebo virtuálne z akéhokoľvek miesta na svete. Atmosféru dopĺňa hudobné vystúpenie a rodinný beh pre deti do 6 rokov, čím je podujatie vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ na Radničnom námestí v Bardejove
Možnosť virtuálneho behu s minimálnou dĺžkou 2 km
Rodinný beh pre deti do 6 rokov s medailou a sladkosťou v cieli
additional: Benefičný beh je súčasťou grantového programu A(tra)ktívny Bardejov. Každý bežec podporuje jeden zo štyroch projektov, ktoré získavajú granty zo štartovného, sponzorských darov a príspevku nadácie. Podujatie zahŕňa aj tombolu s darčekmi od partnerov a moderovanie podujatia. Bežci z rôznych regiónov a dokonca z Poľska sa môžu zúčastniť. Pretek je vhodný pre všetky vekové kategórie, registrácia je možná online, podujatie podporuje komunitu a zdravie, je možné sa zúčastniť aj virtuálne.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 2. kolo

description: Šamorínska bežecká liga je séria bežeckých pretekov organizovaných 3klubom Šamorín v krásnom prostredí lesoparku Pomlé. Liga je určená pre širokú verejnosť bez vekových a výkonnostných limitov, pričom súťažia muži, ženy aj deti v rôznych kategóriách. Štartovné zahŕňa meranie časov, štartové čísla a občerstvenie v cieli. Súťažiaci zbierajú body počas celého roka a na konci ligy sú vyhodnotení najlepší bežci podľa vekového koeficientu. Liga je ideálna pre tých, ktorí chcú pravidelne súťažiť a zlepšovať svoje výkony v priateľskej atmosfére.
course_highlights: Lesopark Pomlé - prírodné prostredie vhodné na beh
Rôzne kategórie vrátane detských behov s kratšími vzdialenosťami
Hlavné behy pre dospelých na 3 km, 5 km a 1,5 km podľa kola
additional: Štartovné zahŕňa štartové čísla, meranie časov, občerstvenie v cieli a vyhodnocovanie ligy počas celého roka. Deti štartovné neplatia. Prezentácia prebieha od 9:00 do 30 minút pred štartom kategórie. K dispozícii sú WC a šatňa v priestoroch amfiteátra. V rámci posledného kola je oficiálne vyhodnotenie ligy. Škôlkari dostanú medailu po dobehnutí bez hodnotenia. trasa v parku, registrácia online alebo na mieste, bez vekových alebo výkonnostných limitov

name: Beh oslobodenia obce Chocholná-Velčice
location: Pred hasičskou zbrojnicou, Chocholná-Velčice, Trenčín, Slovakia
description: Beh oslobodenia obce Chocholná-Velčice je tradičný športový podujatie, ktoré sa koná už 52. ročník v nedeľu 26. apríla 2026. Organizátormi sú obec Chocholná-Velčice, Jednota Sokol, DHZ Chocholná-Velčice a SOŠ dopravná Trenčín. Pretek sa štartuje pred hasičskou zbrojnicou v obci a je určený pre všetkých športových priaznivcov. Podujatie je vhodné aj pre deti a je bezbariérové, čo zaručuje prístupnosť pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Štart pred hasičskou zbrojnicou v Chocholná-Velčice
Bezbariérový prístup na podujatie
Podujatie vhodné pre deti
additional: Podujatie trvá približne 270 minút a je organizované v spolupráci s miestnymi organizáciami vrátane Jednoty Sokol a Dobrovoľného hasičského zboru. Miesto štartu je pred hasičskou zbrojnicou v Chocholná-Velčice. Podujatie je súčasťou kalendára akcií obce a je bezbariérové, vhodné pre deti a vstup so zvieratami je povolený. Podujatie je naplánované na 26. apríla 2026, zahŕňa rôzne kategórie pre všetky vekové skupiny, a je sprevádzané sprievodnými aktivitami vrátane historickej prednášky a pietneho aktu.

Pretek je zároveň Majstrovstvami Slovenska v lesnom behu a ponúka kategórie pre deti, dorast, juniorov, ženy a mužov v rôznych vekových skupinách. Organizátorom je Bežecký klub Bodice a Olympijský klub Liptova, ktorí zabezpečujú kvalitný športový zážitok v príjemnom prostredí.

Preteky v časti mesta Liptovský Mikuláš, Bodice
Kultúrny dom Bodice ako štart a cieľ

Organizátorom je Bežecký klub Bodice a Olympijský klub Liptova. Informácie poskytuje Ing. description: The Plzeň Quarter Marathon is a running race held on Božkov Island in Plzeň, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational athletes. The event includes a main quarter-marathon course, a shorter 5 km loop, children’s races, and an accompanying program for the whole family. The race also has a charitable aspect, with part of the entry fee donated to support little Tomík, who has a serious genetic condition. The event offers a pleasant setting for sport and family fun in the fresh air.

The main race is a quarter marathon, complemented by a 5 km loop
Children’s races are also included (200 m, 400 m, 500 m)

name: O Krušovický soudek
description: We invite runners and spectators to the 43rd edition of the Cross-Country Race for the Krušovice Keg, held in Stochov. The race is organized by TJ Sokol Stochov - Honice in cooperation with the Royal Brewery of Krušovice and the town of Stochov. The 20 km course follows field and forest tracks, partly on asphalt, and starts at the St. Wenceslas Memorial Oak, finishing in the grounds of the Krušovice Brewery. The winner receives the traveling Krušovice Keg trophy.
course_highlights: 20 km course on field and forest tracks, partly on asphalt
Start at the St. Wenceslas Memorial Oak in Stochov
Finish in the courtyard of the Krušovice Brewery grounds
additional: Runner registration takes place from 8:00 at the Sokol gym in Stochov. The race is a traveling competition, and the winner receives the traveling Krušovice Keg trophy. Registration takes place from 8:00 at the Sokol gym in Stochov; the course includes stretches across fields, forest tracks, and asphalt sections; the main prize is the traditional Krušovice Keg for the winner.

name: Memoriál Quida Štěpánka
location: Lyžařský areál Malák, Jablonné nad Orlicí, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Quido Štěpánek Memorial is a traditional running race held at the Malák ski resort in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The race features a rolling loop course across nearby meadows, up to 7.5 km long, suitable for runners of all categories. It also includes a prestigious 4 x 500 m relay and races for young people and the youngest children. The event is part of the ISCAREX Cup and attracts a broad running community.
course_highlights: Rolling loop course across nearby meadows
Course length of up to 7.5 km
Includes a 4 x 500 m relay
additional: Registration opens at 8:30; youth races start at 10:00, and the adult race starts at 10:00. Relays follow the finish. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. Registration and details are available on the ISCAREX Cup website.

name: Běh Škarmanem, memoriál Vladimíra Reta a Marka Kubalíka
organizer: Školní policejní středisko, SKP Psohlavec, SKP Domažlice
description: Běh Škarmanem, the memorial race for Vladimír Ret and Marek Kubalík, is a running race in Domažlice. It offers men a 5.1 km course and women a 3.4 km course across varied terrain. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska Cup and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting. It is suited to runners looking for a quality trail race with a tradition and an atmosphere that pays tribute to notable members of the running community.
course_highlights: 5.1 km course for men and 3.4 km course for women
Trail race in the area around Domažlice
Part of the Běžec Chodska Cup
additional: The race includes various age categories, including youth and children, and is known for its challenging nature, with changing paces on the trail course.

description: Montacké vlny is part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP series, which brings together traditional road and trail races in the Náchod region. The race takes place in Montace Forest Park in Náchod and features a 7.5 km two-lap course with 230 metres of elevation gain. The varied course surface combines asphalt, dirt and grass, making the race appealing to both experienced and beginner runners. The programme also includes shorter races for children and juniors, held at the PRIMÁTOR brewery grounds. The organisers have also prepared an accompanying athletics programme for children and prizes for the top runners and the oldest participant.

PRIMÁTOR brewery grounds in Náchod

name: Nymburský půlmaraton
location: Nymburk, Nymburk District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Nymburk Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Nymburk. Its flat course is suitable both for recreational runners and for those training for longer races. The route runs through the town park, along the Elbe cycling path and over two bridges, covering a total of 21.1 km. A 10K is also available as a shorter option for less experienced runners. The race venue is located below the town walls, giving the event a unique atmosphere.

The route runs on paved roads (95%) and paths or paving stones (5%)
Runners cross two bridges over the Elbe River, including one with 60 steps

The race has no significant elevation gain and a 3-hour time limit.

name: Modřany Ravine Run!
location: U Liščích děr, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Modřany Ravine Run is a traditional running race in Modřanská Rokle Nature Park in Prague, now being held for the 23rd year. Both run mainly along forest and field paths, with several steep climbs and descents. Shorter courses for children are held on flat terrain at Louka u Liščích děr, including a course for the youngest children, aged up to 4. The race is part of the Modřany Running Triathlon, which comprises three different races held throughout the year, with points awarded and an overall awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Two courses through the varied terrain of Modřanská Rokle: 10 km and 6.1 km
Forest and field paths with several steep climbs and descents
Flat circuits for children at Louka u Liščích děr
additional: The youngest children, aged up to 4, can run a 50 m course accompanied by their parents. The race is part of the Modřany Running Triathlon, which comprises three races with points awarded and an overall awards ceremony. After the race, certificates, medals, prizes and light refreshments are provided. The race has various age categories, including children, and is part of the Modřanský Běžecký Trojboj series. The event also offers an accompanying programme and the chance to take part in special editions with a modified course.

The race is open to all runners over 15 and also features children’s races and an accompanying programme. The adults’ race starts on Sunday at 10:00. Registration is available online and on site. The race is intended for runners interested in mountain running who want to test themselves on challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of Radhošť. Registration details and the exact route are available on the official website.

name: Vratislavický Běhoun 2026
location: Koupaliště SLUNÍČKO, Vratislavice nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic

This 32nd edition features a course along field and forest paths, with a small section on asphalt, offering varied and interesting terrain for all participants. The race is also the 28th edition of the Vratislavice nad Nisou Mayor’s Travelling Cup and is suitable for the general public and competitors in various categories. name: Nymburský půlmaraton a desítka

The race runs through the town park, along the Elbe cycle path and over two bridges, with the finish and facilities beneath the historic town walls. A shorter 10K on a flat route is available for less experienced runners. Facilities in the park include changing rooms, storage, toilets and drinking water.

The race has a new start location in Bozsok and offers runners several distances, from a 7 km introductory trail run to the 102 km Alpokalja Ultra. The courses take participants across varied terrain, with beautiful views and aid stations, and require stamina and good physical preparation. The race also offers family-friendly activities, so even the youngest visitors can enjoy nature-conservation and interactive exhibitions.

The race showcases the natural beauty of the Kőszeg Mountains across varied terrain, with a new start in Bozsok, and offers people of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to take part.

Preteky sa konajú na rôznych vzdialenostiach od 1 000 m pre deti až po 10,6 km pre dospelých. Trať vedie po poľnej ceste a spevnenom turistickom chodníku, čo zabezpečuje príjemný zážitok z behu v prírode. Podujatie je organizované Marathon Banská Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z. a Nemciansky Beh OZ a je vhodné pre širokú vekovú kategóriu bežcov.
course_highlights: Trať vedie po poľnej ceste a spevnenom turistickom chodníku
Rôzne kategórie podľa veku a pohlavia
Viacero štartovacích časov podľa vzdialenosti

organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Obec Vinné

description: Podvihorlatský maratón a Michalovský polmaratón sú tradičné bežecké podujatia konané v krásnom prostredí Zemplínskej šíravy a mesta Michalovce. Preteky ponúkajú maratónsku trať, polmaratón a polmaratónsku štafetu, ktoré sú vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane skúsených bežcov aj rekreačných športovcov. Organizátori zabezpečujú kvalitné služby vrátane elektronickej časomierky, občerstvenia na trati a v cieli, štýlových tričiek a účastníckych medailí. Podujatie je známe svojou priateľskou atmosférou a podporou bežeckej komunity v regióne.
course_highlights: Trať vedie okolo Zemplínskej šíravy s krásnymi výhľadmi
Elektronická časomiera s čipom pre presné meranie času
Občerstvenie na trati a v cieli vrátane ovocia, vody, kofoly a piva

Súčasťou štartovného je štartovné číslo s čipom, elektronická časomiera, štýlové tričko (veľkosť garantovaná pri úhrade do 20.4.2026), šatne, občerstvenie na trati a v cieli, lístok na obed a účastnícka medaila. Muži nad 70 rokov a ženy nad 60 rokov majú zľavu 5 € pri registrácii do 28.4.2026. Víťazi z predchádzajúceho ročníka majú bezplatný štart pri registrácii do 28.4.2026. Podujatie zahŕňa maratón, polmaratón a štafety, s podrobnými informáciami o trase, pravidlách a cenách na oficiálnej stránke.

description: ETHOS Májový beh cyklotrasou je štvrtý ročník bežeckej súťaže, ktorá sa uskutoční 1. mája 2026 v Krásne nad Kysucou. Preteky vedú po cyklotrase v krásnom prírodnom horskom prostredí s minimálnou premávkou, čo zaručuje bezpečný a príjemný zážitok. Súťažiť je možné na certifikovaných tratiach v kategóriách muži a ženy, s rôznymi vekovými skupinami. Organizátor vyzýva pretekárov na online registráciu a zabezpečuje občerstvenie a medaily pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie po cyklotrase v horskom prírodnom prostredí
Takmer celá trasa je bezpečná bez premávky s výnimkou vozidiel miestnych obyvateľov
Občerstvovacie stanice sú na polmaratóne 3 a na maratóne 7 plus v cieli
additional: Prezentácia maratónu od 08:00 do 08:30, štart o 09:00. Prezentácia 10 km a 21 km od 08:00 do 09:30, štart o 10:00. Rodinný beh prezentácia od 08:00 do 10:30, štart o 11:00. Rodinný beh je štartovné za celú rodinu bez ohľadu na počet členov. Podpora pretekárov je povolená, ale nesmie obmedzovať ostatných (DSQ). Platby štartovného sú možné bankovým prevodom do 19.04.2026, platby na mieste sú obmedzené bez garancie občerstvenia a prezentov. Každý pretekár štartuje na vlastnú zodpovednosť a musí mať individuálne zdravotné poistenie. Trasy vedú po horskej cyklotrase, zabezpečené občerstvovacie stanice na 10 km, 21 km a 42 km, online registrácia je povinná, kategórie pre mužov a ženy, certifikované trate, možnosť registrácie pre rodinné tímy za jednotnú cenu 20 €.

name: Medzinárodný pouličný beh Komárom – Komárno
organizer: Bežecký spolok Komárom - Európa (KEFE), Komárom-Európa Futó Egyesület (KEFE)
description: Medzinárodný pouličný beh Komárom - Komárno je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v meste Komárno s štartom pri Mestskej športovej hale. Pretek ponúka trate na 5,5 km a 10 km, ako aj detskú súťaž, pričom štart je na križovatke ulíc Arany János a Vág v Komárome. Podujatie je organizované Bežeckým spolkom Komárom - Európa (KEFE) a je vhodné pre širokú vekovú kategóriu bežcov. Atmosféra preteku je medzinárodná a priateľská, s dôrazom na športový výkon a komunitný zážitok.
course_highlights: Trate 5,5 km a 10 km vedú po uliciach Komárna a Komáromu
Štart a cieľ pri Mestskej športovej hale v Komárne
Detská súťaž so štartom o 11:00 hod. na križovatke ulíc Arany János a Vág
additional: Štart 10 000 m o 9:30 hod., 5 500 m o 10:00 hod., detská súťaž o 11:00 hod. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia. Štart detskej súťaže je v Komárome na križovatke ulíc Arany János a Vág. Pretek zahŕňa kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny, štartové časy sú o 9:30 a 10:00, detský beh je naplánovaný na 11:00; miesto konania je Mestská športová hala v Komárne.

Podujatie podporuje zdravý životný štýl a športové aktivity v komunite.

Organizované obcou Pečovská Nová Ves a základnou školou s materskou školou

Značenie trasy s kontrolami a občerstvovacími stanicami na oboch tratiach

name: Memoriál Luboše Svobody – cena Běžce Vysočiny

description: The Luboš Svoboda Memorial – Vysočina Runner’s Prize is a traditional running race held in Heulos Forest Park in Jihlava. The race offers various distances for all age groups, from the youngest children to veterans, with the main 8.8 km course for men, juniors, and veterans. The course follows paved and unpaved paths through the forest park, with scenic sections along the Jihlávka River and around the athletics stadium. The race also honors the memory of Luboš Svoboda, a prominent runner from the Vysočina region.
course_highlights: A 2.2 km loop on paved and unpaved paths through Heulos Forest Park
The main course runs along the left bank of the Jihlávka River and crosses footbridges near the ZOO and athletics stadium
Paved surfaces make up approximately 25% of the course
additional: The start takes place at the summer cinema venue in Heulos, Jihlava. Changing rooms and toilets are available beneath the cinema screen. Runners aged 3 and older may take part. Categories are divided by age, with distances ranging from 350 m for the youngest participants to 8.8 km for adults and veterans. A season entry pass can be used. The race is part of the Vysočina Runner series, which promotes an active lifestyle and sporting opportunities in the region. The start is scheduled between 17:15 and 17:30 at the summer cinema venue in Jihlava.

name: Běh na Doubravku
description: The Run to Doubravka is a traditional running race held at Doubravka Castle in Teplice as part of Sports Day at Doubravka. The course is 5,100 metres long with 170 metres of elevation gain and follows a forest trail. The race is open to the general public and offers an opportunity to celebrate spring through sport and fun. Diplomas are awarded to the top three in each category, winners receive a trophy, and the fastest team receives a perpetual trophy. The event also features a cultural programme and other sporting activities.
course_highlights: A 5,100 m course with 170 m of elevation gain
The course surface is a forest trail
Part of Sports Day at Doubravka Castle
additional: Diplomas are awarded to the top three in each category, and winners receive a trophy. The fastest team receives a perpetual trophy and diplomas. The event is part of the wider Sports Day at Doubravka, which also includes a cultural programme and other sporting disciplines. The race includes category awards and prizes for the top runners, and in the past it has also had virtual editions during the COVID-19 pandemic.

description: Karlovský kopcovák is a running race held on May 1, 2026, on the slope of Karlov in Benešov. The race is 4.5 km long and offers a sporting challenge on hilly terrain. Registration is available online only in advance. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series, which offers a varied calendar of running events in the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: 4.5 km course
Hilly terrain on the slope of Karlov
Held in Benešov, Central Bohemian Region

name: Běh KERMI

description: The KERMI Run in Stříbro is a traditional 10.5 km race that runs mainly off-road, starting and finishing at the KERMI company premises. The race is suitable for runners of different levels, who can start either at 10:00 or in the main start at 10:30. After the race, there will be a results ceremony, a get-together and refreshments for participants. The event is organized by KERMI in cooperation with the Stříbro Endurance Runners Association, which supports amateur athletes and runners in the region.
course_highlights: A 10.5 km route, mainly off-road
Start and finish at the KERMI Stříbro premises
Option of an earlier start at 10:00
additional: The race starts at 10:30, but slower runners can also start earlier, at 10:00. After the race, there will be a results ceremony, a get-together and refreshments, including drinks. The route is mainly off-road. Registration is available on site. The start is at 10:30, and refreshments and an awards ceremony will be provided after the race.

name: Jarní přespolní běh Nýrsko
location: Areál pod Sjezdovkou, Nýrsko, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Cross-Country Run in Nýrsko is a traditional athletics event organized by TJ Nýrsko z.s. and held at the venue below the ski slope. The event offers children’s categories starting at 13:00 and the main race from 14:00. The course runs through the sports complex below Pajrek, with an elevation gain of 20 metres per lap. The event is part of the Ešus League, a series of off-track races in the Klatovy District, and is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and nature.
course_highlights: The course runs through the sports complex below Pajrek
The elevation gain per lap is 20 metres
The race is part of the Ešus League, a series of off-track races in the Klatovy District
additional: On-site registration from 12:00; registration closes 15 minutes before the start of each category. Refreshments are available at the venue below the ski slope. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers in each category, subject to the organizer’s resources. All participants take part at their own risk; children participate at their parents’ responsibility. The event includes various races, including the main race and a children’s race, and is part of the local sports calendar. The run is known for its tradition and friendly atmosphere.

name: Májový běh okolo rybníka Nezmaru
description: The May Run around Nezmar Pond is a traditional running race organized by Maratón klub Seitl Ostrava, held in the picturesque village of Jilešovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. Founded in 1997, Seitl Ostrava brings together runners of all levels and supports sporting activities in the region. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and a chance to meet the running community in beautiful natural surroundings. The organizers welcome both new runners and experienced athletes looking for a quality running experience.
course_highlights: A loop around Nezmar Pond in Jilešovice
Picturesque natural surroundings in the Moravian-Silesian Region
A traditional running event with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The event is part of a regional running series and emphasizes a community atmosphere and sporting activities for all age groups.

name: Boskovické běhy
description: Boskovice Runs is a major sporting event in the region, offering routes of varying lengths for all age groups, including children. The main race, the Run for the Seven-Toothed Ridge, is 12.5 km long and features two long forest sections. The event is not only a sporting competition but also a social occasion that promotes a healthy lifestyle and a family-friendly atmosphere. It also includes a varied accompanying program and, new this year, a team race for teams of three. Walkers can join in and enjoy a shared day of activity and fun.
course_highlights: The main course is 12.5 km long
Two long forest sections on the main course
Children’s races for all age groups
additional: New this year is a race for teams of three. Race bibs can display the runner’s name. Walkers can take part in the group event. Special children’s races are planned. The information line is available on weekdays from 9:00 to 12:00 and from 16:00 to 19:00 at 776 762 602. The event includes various races, including children’s races, team races and the main race, and takes place in the South Moravian Region on May 1, 2026.

Held in the picturesque surroundings of the Osada Údolí oddechu settlement

Picturesque setting in Castle Park in Horšovský Týn

name: Vrcholy
description: The Peaks of the Czech Mountains are a unique collectible challenge for all nature lovers and outdoor adventurers. This sticker set features the 25 highest peaks of the Czech mountains and ranges, which you can stick on your bottle as a reminder of your trips and achievements. Each sticker is hand-drawn and inspired by real peaks, and made from durable material with UV protection and water resistance to withstand even demanding conditions. This collection is ideal for anyone who wants to carry an original, personal touch of adventure with them wherever they go.
course_highlights: The 25 highest peaks of the Czech mountains and ranges
Hand-drawn and exclusively designed stickers
High-quality materials with UV protection and water resistance
additional: The stickers are water-resistant and have strong adhesive that holds on a variety of surfaces, even in adverse conditions. They are protected against fading by UV lamination. Some stickers are also dishwasher-safe.

location: Struhařov, Mnichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč pro dospělé, zdarma pro děti a juniory
description: The Běh Krásné vyhlídky is a traditional running race held in Struhařov near Mnichovice, featuring a unique panoramic route along the new Krásné vyhlídky nature trail. The race is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje running series and welcomes a wide range of runners, including children, juniors, adults, and veterans. The start and race facilities are at Hliněný rybník, where accompanying races for the youngest age groups are also held. The main race is 7.4 km long and follows one loop along the nature trail. The race is made possible by the support of volunteers, local associations, and partners.
course_highlights: A unique panoramic route along the Krásné vyhlídky nature trail
A 7.4 km loop for the main race
Accompanying races for children and juniors around the pond
additional: Registration for the accompanying races is from 13:00 to 14:30, with the first races starting at 14:45. Registration for the 7.4 km main race is from 14:00 to 16:00, and the main race starts at 16:30. Categories include preschoolers (200 m), schoolchildren (620 m), juniors (1860 m), and adult men, women, and veterans (7.4 km). The fastest man and woman from Struhařov are recognized in the main race. The race is part of the regional Pohár Ladova kraje series, with starts at 14:45 and 16:30. Race distances include the 7.4 km main race and children’s races of 200 m, 620 m, and 1860 m.

name: Běh Údolím vzdechů
location: Sudoměřice u Tábora, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Through the Valley of Sighs is a traditional cross-country race organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora and held annually on May 1. In 2026, the event will take place for the 10th time, attracting runners of all ages, including children and adults. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the scenic surroundings of Sudoměřice u Tábora and is accompanied by a lively atmosphere and community spirit. Results and photos from previous editions are available online.
course_highlights: A cross-country race in the scenic valley of Sudoměřice u Tábora
A course suitable for children and adult runners
An annual tradition with a community atmosphere
additional: Results for the children’s and adults’ races are published online. Photos from the event are available in several online galleries. The event is organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora, which also organizes other sporting and social events in the village. The race includes children’s events starting at 50 m, registration for adults costs 150 Kč, and the races take place on natural terrain, with participation open to the general public.

name: Běh údolím samoty
location: Radvanec u Nového Boru, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Run through the Samota Valley in Radvanec near Nový Bor is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, taking place on May 1, 2026. The race gives runners the chance to enjoy a run through a picturesque valley with natural scenery and a peaceful atmosphere. It is an ideal event for nature-running enthusiasts who want to combine athletic performance with the beauty of the surrounding landscape. The race is part of a wider series of running events in the region that promote an active lifestyle and community sports.
course_highlights: A picturesque valley with natural scenery
A peaceful atmosphere, ideal for running in nature
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League
additional: Race details and regulations are available to download; the event is part of a regional running series.

name: PM Consulting Choceňský půlmaraton
description: The PM Consulting Choceň Half Marathon is a 21.1 km running race along forest roads between Choceň and Horní Jelení. The course follows good-quality forest roads with gravel and some asphalt, making it suitable for running on light terrain. In addition to the half marathon, shorter 10 km and 5 km routes are available, suitable for juniors, veterans and anyone who wants to experience the race atmosphere. Race facilities are located at the swimming pool complex in Choceň, where medical services are also provided. The event is open to the general sporting public and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Forest course on firm paths with gravel and asphalt surfaces
Race facilities at the swimming pool complex in Choceň
Czech Red Cross medical services at the start and finish area
additional: The race also includes a three-person team competition, with the times of all team members added together. An accompanying programme for children includes a bouncy castle. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The course runs along the Banda reservoir and is suitable for the general public. The event is part of a wider sports day in Choceň, with the option to take part in other accompanying activities.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Chomutov
price_range: 100 / 200,- Kč, 200 Kč - 300 Kč za měřené běhy, 100 Kč za rodinný běh

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: rodinný závod 1 km - registrace on-line/na místě od 100 Kč

description: The Run for the Memory of Nations in Chomutov is a sporting and community event held to support the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the lives of people who witnessed historical events and helps preserve their stories. The race takes place on May 1, 2026, at Wakepark Chomutov and offers a timed 5 km run and an untimed 1 km family run. The course follows a flat cycle path around the Banda reservoir and through Otvice, finishing in the car park by Banda. The event is suitable for all ages and promotes endurance and remembrance of freedom fighters.
course_highlights: Flat route along the cycle path around the Banda reservoir
Turnaround in the village of Otvice, followed by a return along the same route
Start and finish by Aquasvět and the car park by Banda
additional: Registration and race-bib collection are open from 8:30 to 9:45 for the 1 km run and until 10:30 for the 5 km run. Storage, restroom facilities, water at the finish, and refreshments are available. DJ Lukáš Budai will provide the music. Pupils, students under 18, members of the Memory of Nations Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. The start is scheduled for 08:30. Registration is available online and on site; the event includes refreshments, bag storage, and music.

name: Král Zvičiny 2026
location: Lipnice, Zaháj, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč online (250 Kč na místě) pro hlavní závod; 100 Kč online (150 Kč na místě) pro děti
description: Král Zvičiny 2026 is a mass-start uphill road race for individuals and an ideal way to kick off the season. The race takes place on May 1, 2026, in the Dvůr Králové nad Labem - Lipnice - Zaháj area and offers two main routes: an adult race of approximately 10 km on asphalt with a continuous climb, and a 3 km children’s race. The main race finishes at Raisova chata on Zvičina, while the children’s race finishes in Dehtov. It is organized by the Carla Kupkolo.cz team from Dvůr Králové nad Labem.
course_highlights: Main race: approx. 10 km on asphalt with a continuous climb
The route passes through Lipnice, Dehtov and Třebihošť, finishing at Zvičina
Children’s race: 3 km, finishing in Dehtov
additional: Race-day check-in takes place in Dvůr Králové - Lipnice - Zaháj from 8:30 to 9:30. The awards ceremony is held at Motorest U Lípy in Třebihošť. Categories are divided by age and gender, including junior and veteran groups. The race is part of the cycling season and offers both competitive and amateur cyclists a great opportunity to enjoy the atmosphere and the uphill challenge. Registration is available online via sportchallenge.cz.

name: LENART XI Bieg Uliczny o Puchar Starosty Powiatu Kępińskiego
XIII Bieg Borków
location: Osieczna, Leszno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIII Bieg Tropami Śląskich Dinozaurów
