name: Etyekrun
organizer: RUNaway Sportszervező Kft. és Etyek Trend
description: EtyekRUN is a unique running race in the rolling hills of Etyek, where the atmosphere of the wine region, its vineyards, rows of vines and spring scenery accompany participants every step of the way. The race is part of the Garmin WTF series, which celebrates the joy of movement and the diversity of athletic achievements, with both shorter road distances and longer trail-running routes. The event is family-friendly, and sustainability, consistency and enjoyment are at the heart of the community. Participants will have a unique experience amid the beauty of nature and the wine region.
course_highlights: A route through the rolling hills of Etyek, among rows of vines and vineyards
Spring scenery and the atmosphere of the wine region
Mixed terrain: road and trail running
additional: Discounted family registration is available, allowing one adult to register up to 5 family members. Family registration does not include a medal by default, but one can be ordered for an additional fee. Registration cannot be cancelled, but it can be transferred to another race no later than 21 days before the event. The registration system automatically sends an invoice, and several payment methods are available. The Garmin WTF series puts sustainability and a sense of community first. Participants can choose from several distances, and free Pilates classes, local wines and food will be available in connection with the event. The race is an ideal event for lovers of vineyards and nature.

name: XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 5 / 10 / 21
location: Mór, Szent István tér, Mór, Hungary
description: The 11th Ezerjó Half Marathon will take place on May 1, 2026, in Mór, at Szent István Square. The event offers three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). Runners can take on the routes through beautiful vineyards across varied terrain, with climbs and panoramic views. The event is family-friendly and also welcomes younger participants with children’s races. Finishers are rewarded with refreshments and a finisher’s medal. The event’s distinctive atmosphere comes from the local wine region and the sense of community.
course_highlights: 5 km route within Mór, with minimal elevation gain on easy terrain
10 km route through vineyards, following a hilly and varied course
21 km half marathon with long climbs, views of Csókakő Castle, and downhill sections
additional: The start area is in front of Mór Town Hall. Start times: half marathon at 10:00, 5 km at 10:05, and 10 km at 10:10. The entry fee includes participation, a finisher’s medal, chip timing, refreshments, a fröccs station, coffee, and ice cream at the finish. The race is cup-free as part of its commitment to environmental protection. Children’s races will also take place in Szent István Park, with separate age groups and awards. The half marathon uses chip timing, with a UHF chip attached to the back of the race bib. Technical and cotton T-shirts can be ordered for an additional fee during advance registration. Scenery: park and city streets. Advance registration is open until April 20; on-site registration is available at higher fees. Children’s races. A finisher’s medal is not guaranteed for on-site registrations.

name: 50. Komárom-Komárno Nemzetközi Utcai Futóverseny
location: Komárom, Szabadság tér, Komárom-Esztergom megye, Hungary
description: The 50th Komárom-Komárno International Street Race is a traditional international running event held in two countries within one city. Participants can choose between 5.5 km and 10 km races, as well as a children’s race. The event is open to both competitive and recreational runners. The race starts at Szabadság Square in South Komárom and finishes at the sports hall in North Komárom. Its aims are to promote running, strengthen the running community, and support a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets of North and South Komárom, crossing two countries within one city
5.5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 200-metre children’s race
The finish is at the sports hall in North Komárom
additional: Race-pack collection is available on race day: by 9:15 at the latest for the 10 km race and by 9:45 for the 5.5 km race. The children’s race is for participants aged 10 or younger. The time limits are 1 hour 30 minutes for the 10 km race and 45 minutes for the 5.5 km race. The awards ceremony takes place at 11:30 at the sports hall in North Komárom. The participant limit is 1,500. Several thousand people take part in the event, and registration is open until April 25. The race is part of the Komárom Days events and the course passes several points around the city, including the area around Szabadság Square and the North Komárom Municipal Sports Hall.

name: KOMÁROM – KOMÁRNO FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Komárom-Komárno International Street Running Race is an open, recreational running event held on the streets of the cities of North and South Komárom—two countries, one city. The event offers 5.5 km and 10 km distances, as well as children’s races, and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners. Its aim is to promote running, strengthen the sense of belonging to the running community, and support healthy living. The start is at Szabadság Square in South Komárom, and the finish is at the City Sports Hall in North Komárom. The event is a longstanding international tradition that also strengthens cooperation between the two cities.
course_highlights: Street course through the districts of North and South Komárom, in two countries
5.5 km and 10 km distances, plus children’s races
Start: Szabadság Square, South Komárom; finish: City Sports Hall, North Komárom
additional: Race-pack pickup on race day: by 9:45 at the latest for the 5.5 km distance and by 9:15 for the 10 km distance. The event aims to strengthen the running community and promote healthy living. The mayors of the two cities are the event’s patrons. Race directors and local race coordinators oversee the organization. The event takes place on May 1, 2026; registration is open, and detailed information is available on the official websites. The event brings together the local community and international runners.

name: FUT AZ ÜLLŐ
description: “Fut az Üllő” is a traditional urban running race held in the city center of Üllő. The race aims to promote sport and community life and is open to all age groups. A limited number of on-site registrations will also be available on race day from 7:00 a.m. The event is organized by the Municipality of Üllő, which ensures its success with the support of the local community.
course_highlights: Running course in the city center
Community-oriented, family-friendly event
On-site registration available on race day
additional: Online registration closes on April 26, 2024, at 12:00 p.m., but a limited number of on-site registrations will also be available on race day from 7:00 a.m. Race date: 2026-05-01; registration deadline: 2024-04-26; location: City Center, Üllő

name: Behaj lesmi – Smolenice
description: Behaj lesmi Smolenice je súčasťou série siedmich pretekov v krásnej slovenskej prírode, ktoré ponúkajú trasy prevažne na mäkkom povrchu a v čerstvom vzduchu. Preteky sú zaradené do UTMB Index Races, čo znamená medzinárodné bodové hodnotenie trailových pretekov. Trasy vedú pod Smolenickým zámkom, kde bežcov povzbudzujú tematické postavy a vytvárajú tak jedinečnú atmosféru. Súťažiť môžete na dvoch hlavných trasách - 12 km a 19 km, pričom na trati je aj rýchlostný úsek Conti Speed Section s hodnotnou cenou.
course_highlights: Trasy z 80 % na mäkkom povrchu v prírode
Rýchlostný úsek Conti Speed Section s dĺžkou 150 metrov
Preteky pod Smolenickým zámkom s tematickou atmosférou
additional: Preteky obsahujú rýchlostný úsek Conti Speed Section s označením vlajkami Continental, kde je možné získať voucher v hodnote 200 Eur a bežecký dres. Trasy sú značené a vedú prevažne v prírode s prevýšením. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské preteky Dr. Max. Preteky ponúkajú rôzne vzdialenosti (6 km, 12 km, 19 km), možnosť registrácie so zľavami pri viacerých štartoch, atraktívne prostredie v okolí Smolenického zámku, a súčasťou série trailových pretekov po celom Slovensku.

name: Tlmačský polmaratón

price_tiers.distance: Hobby beh a nordic walking 3,5 km

description: Tlmačský polmaratón a desiatka je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v meste Tlmače. Tento 43. ročník pretekov ponúka polmaratónsku trať dlhú 21 km a desiatku, pričom súčasťou je aj hobby beh a nordic walking na 3,5 km. Podujatie je súčasťou Bežeckej ligy Patriotov a organizuje ho mesto Tlmače spolu s miestnymi športovými klubmi. Bežci si môžu vychutnať kvalitnú organizáciu, elektronické meranie času a štartovné balíčky s propagačnými predmetmi a poukážkou na stravu.
course_highlights: Polmaratónska trať 21 km a desiatka 10 km v meste Tlmače
Súčasť Bežeckej ligy Patriotov
Hobby beh a nordic walking na 3,5 km
additional: Štartovné balíčky obsahujú štartovné číslo, športové a propagačné predmety a poukážku na stravu. Elektronické meranie času zabezpečuje firma SunBell s.r.o. pomocou čipov na štartovných číslach. Prihlasovanie je možné online do 30.4.2026 alebo na mieste v deň pretekov. Prihlasení účastníci sa stávajú platnými po úhrade štartovného. Pri prihlasovaní na mieste je platba možná len v hotovosti. Podujatie zahŕňa aj detské behy, nordic walking a sprievodný program. Súčasťou je aj vyhodnotenie a výsledky na VysledkovyServis.sk.

name: Tlmačský polmaraton (10 km)
organizer: Mesto Tlmače, MsKS Tlmače, ZŠ a MŠ Tlmače, Atletický klub mesta Tlmače
price_range: 15,- € to 20,- € online, 20,- € na mieste; detské behy zdarma

description: Tlmačský polmaratón je tradičný bežecký závod v meste Tlmače, ktorý ponúka polmaratónsku trať dlhú 21,1 km a aj 10 km beh pre rekreačných bežcov. Pretek sa koná 2. mája 2026 s štartom o 10:00 hod. pre dospelých a o 9:00 hod. pre deti. Organizátormi sú Mesto Tlmače, MsKS Tlmače, ZŠ a MŠ Tlmače a Atletický klub mesta Tlmače. Bežci dostanú štartovné číslo, športové a propagačné predmety a poukážku na obed. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj hobby beh a nordic walking na 3,5 km a detské behy zdarma.
course_highlights: Polmaratónska trať dlhá 21,1 km
10 km beh pre rekreačných bežcov
Hobby beh a nordic walking na 3,5 km
additional: Bežci na polmaratón a 10 km beh dostanú balíček so štartovným číslom, športovými a propagačnými predmetmi a poukážkou na obed. Detské behy sú zdarma. Štart detí je o 9:00 hod., dospelých o 10:00 hod. Trať zahŕňa cestný beh, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste; preteky začínajú o 10:00 pre dospelých, 9:58 pre handbik, 9:00 pre deti; súčasťou je aj sprievodný program

name: Jarný charitatívny beh Nitra
organizer: Mgr. Lukáš Čelinák, Rotary klub Nitra Harmony
description: Jarný charitatívny beh Nitra je komunitné športové podujatie, ktoré spája pohyb, solidaritu a podporu zdravotníctva v meste Nitra. Beží sa na podporu urgentného príjmu Fakultnej nemocnice Nitra a je organizované Rotary klubom Nitra Harmony spolu s tímom Oktoberfest Run Nitra. Podujatie ponúka rôzne disciplíny vrátane 10 km, 5 km a 1,2 km tratí, pričom je možné sa zapojiť aj tímovo. Bežci tak môžu prispieť k charitatívnemu cieľu a zároveň si užiť športovú atmosféru v Nitre.
course_highlights: Trať vedie v okolí Fakultnej nemocnice Nitra
Rôzne disciplíny: 10 km, 5 km a 1,2 km
Tímová súťaž pre firmy, kluby a komunity
additional: Možnosť prihlásiť sa do tímovej súťaže pre firmy, kluby a komunity. Vyhodnotenie najlepšieho tímu podľa súčtu časov troch najrýchlejších bežcov v tíme. Charitatívny beh s dôrazom na komunitu, zdravie a solidaritu, podujatie je určené na podporu zdravotníkov a verejnosti.

name: Ivachnovský beh pre všetkých
location: Futbalové ihrisko obce Ivachnová, Ivachnová, Slovakia
organizer: Cyklo - turistický oddiel obce Ivachnová a Kúria Ivachnová
description: Ivachnovský beh pre všetkých je športová akcia určená pre všetky vekové kategórie, ktorá sa uskutoční 2. mája 2026 na športovom areáli futbalového ihriska v Ivachnovej. Organizátorom je Cyklo-turistický oddiel obce Ivachnová v spolupráci s KÚRIA Ivachnová. Bežci si môžu vybrať z viacerých kategórií vrátane 5000 m pre mužov, ženy a juniorov, 10 000 m pre mužov a ženy, ako aj kratších behov pre predškolákov, žiakov základných škôl a dôchodcov. Trasa vedie po poľnej ceste a pevnej komunikácii s rovinatým profilom v obci Ivachnová. Registrácia je možná online do 1. mája 2026 do 12:00 hodiny alebo priamo na mieste v deň pretekov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie po poľnej ceste a pevnej komunikácii
Rovinatý profil trate v obci Ivachnová
Viacero kategórií pre všetky vekové skupiny
additional: Štart behu na 5000 m pre mužov, ženy a juniorov o 13:00, štart behu na 10 000 m pre mužov a ženy o 14:00, štart behov pre predškolákov, ZŠ a dôchodcov od 15:30. Organizátor si vyhradzuje právo na zmenu štartu kategórií podľa organizačnej náročnosti. Platba je možná na mieste v deň registrácie. V prípade nepriaznivého počasia sa akcia neuskutoční. Podujatie sa koná na futbalovom ihrisku v Ivachnová, je možné sa zúčastniť v rôznych kategóriách vrátane detí, juniorov, mužov a žien; registrácia je možná online aj na mieste.

name: Sklené sa hýbe
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Sklené, Turčianske Teplice, Slovakia
description: Sklené sa hýbe je bežecké podujatie konané na futbalovom ihrisku v Sklenom, okres Turčianske Teplice. Preteká sa na troch tratiach s rôznou dĺžkou a prevýšením: polmaratón (21,5 km, 740 m+), 14 km (420 m+) a 8 km (320 m+). Okrem hlavných kategórií sú pripravené aj detské aktivity. Štart hlavných kategórií je o 10:30 hod., detské behy začínajú o 10:45 hod. Podujatie je súčasťou série Beh tromi krajmi a Beh dvomi krajmi.
course_highlights: Polmaratón s prevýšením 740 m
Trať 14 km s prevýšením 420 m
Trať 8 km s prevýšením 320 m
additional: Detské aktivity štartujú o 10:45 hod. Štartovné sa líši pre online a platbu na mieste. Miesto konania je futbalové ihrisko v Sklenom, okres Turčianske Teplice. Súčasťou podujatia je aj Martin's off-road aktivita, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, trať zahŕňa rôzne terény vrátane futbalového ihriska.

name: Plesnivec VerticalRun

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: po vyplnení registračného formulára a prevode 17 eur

description: Plesnivec VerticalRun je horský beh s dĺžkou 5 km a prevýšením 530 metrov, ktorý sa koná 2. mája 2026 v Tatranskej Kotline pri chate Plesnivec. Bežci si užijú náročný vertikálny profil trate, ktorý preverí ich kondíciu a vytrvalosť. Registrácia prebieha online a zabezpečuje zaradenie na štartovaciu listinu po úhrade štartovného poplatku. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetkých milovníkov horského behu, ktorí hľadajú výzvu v krásnom prírodnom prostredí.
course_highlights: 5 km dlhá trať s prevýšením 530 metrov
Náročný vertikálny profil trate
Štart pri chate Plesnivec v Tatranskej Kotline
additional: Registrácia prebieha online od 1.4.2026. Po vyplnení registračného formulára a úhrade štartovného je pretekár zaradený na štartovaciu listinu. Kontakt na organizátora: Ján Matava, tel.: +421944132176. Online registrácia od 1. apríla 2026; trať zahŕňa vertikálne stúpanie; miesto konania v Tatranskej Kotline

name: Beh oslobodenia obce Budča
description: Beh oslobodenia obce Budča je tradičný bežecký pretek, ktorý sa koná v obci Budča s cieľom pripomenúť oslobodenie obce. Hlavný beh má dĺžku 8,4 km s prevýšením 232 metrov a vedie okolo obce cez lesné cesty a asfalt, so štartom a cieľom pri obecnom úrade. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské kategórie s kratšími traťami prispôsobenými veku pretekárov a kategória "Kolo pre zdravie" určená pre všetkých bez rozdielu veku a výkonnosti. Pretek je súčasťou Zvolenskej bežeckej ligy a ponúka elektronické meranie časov, občerstvenie a medaily pre účastníkov.
course_highlights: Okruh okolo obce Budča cez lesné oblasti Kremenný Jarok a Sietno
Dĺžka hlavného behu 8,4 km s prevýšením 232 m
Občerstvovacia stanica na približne 4. kilometri trate
additional: Štart detských kategórií je od 10:15, kategória "Kolo pre zdravie" štartuje o 12:05. Pretekári s trvalým pobytom v obci Budča neplatia štartovné. Štartovné zahŕňa štartovné číslo, meranie času elektronickým čipom, občerstvenie v cieli, účastnícku puzzle medailu a ceny pre prvých troch v každej kategórii. Registrácia je možná online do 26.4.2024 alebo osobne v deň preteku od 9:00 hod. do pol hodiny pred štartom. Pretek sa koná v máji, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, súčasťou je aj kategória 'Kolo pre zdravie' bez poplatku.

name: SHELMA Brnišťský půlmaraton
location: Lesní zátiší v Brništi, Brniště, Liberec, Czech Republic

description: The SHELMA Brniště Half Marathon is a traditional running race held amid the beautiful scenery of Podralsko. It offers distances of 21.1 km and 10.55 km, a relay, a 3,300 m run, and Nordic walking. The route passes through the village of Brniště, along the Hastrman Trail, around ponds and past grazing horses, and through the forest. The surface is approximately half asphalt and half trail. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in races across many categories. The race pack includes a T-shirt, medal, refreshments, and other gifts from sponsors. The event has a friendly atmosphere and welcomes runners and spectators in a family-friendly setting.
course_highlights: The route passes through the village of Brniště, along the Hastrman Trail, around ponds, and past grazing horses
The course surface is approximately half asphalt and half trail
There are three refreshment stations and a water station along the route
additional: The race pack includes a T-shirt (for registrations by 31 March), a medal, a drink, a protein bar, and small prizes from the organizers and sponsors. Changing rooms with showers and a baggage storage area are available, along with three refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. Participants are road users and run at their own risk. A lead cyclist rides ahead of the runners, and organizer marshals are stationed at junctions. The children’s races take place at the Lesní zátiší grounds, and the main race starts at 12:00. The 21.1 km race consists of two laps and the 10.55 km race of one lap. The event also features children’s races. Register by 6 April to receive a T-shirt. The entry fee includes drinks, a bar, a medal, small prizes, and a technical T-shirt for early registrations. Race-day facilities include changing rooms, refreshments, course markings, and marshals.

description: The Karel Rais Memorial is a traditional road race organized by the ELNA Počerady Athletics Sports Club, held on May 2, 2026, in Louny. The event features the 35th edition of the 15 km race and the 11th edition of the inline skating race. The course is certified by an AIMS measurer and runs on closed roads with gentle elevation changes. It starts near the village of Volevčice and finishes in Masaryk Gardens in Louny. The day also includes a fun run for all age groups and activities for families and children. The organizers provide transport to the start and facilities including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: The 15 km course follows closed class II and III roads with no motor vehicle traffic
Start elevation: 219 m; finish elevation: 178 m
Course certified by an AIMS measurer, valid for 10 years from 2016
additional: The race starts in four waves according to category. Bus transport from Louny to the start in Počerady is provided. Changing rooms and showers are available at the swimming pool sauna next to the exhibition grounds. Personal belongings are transported by van. The fun run is suitable for everyone, including people with disabilities, and participants receive a T-shirt. The program includes a Children's Day with athletics competitions and cultural activities. Registration is open until April 30, 2026. The race takes place on closed roads, with transport provided from Louny Municipal Swimming Pool. Race categories include different age groups and relay races.

name: Běh na 2 míle – Praha, Stromovka
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children aged 12 and under, who run the shorter 1.6 km course. It’s ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park setting. After the finish, every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Everyone’s time is recorded, and results are published online and count toward the year-round Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children aged 12 and under run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Královská obora – Stromovka, a beautiful park setting
additional: Registration takes place near the Brussels Gate from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age and gender, with an age coefficient for the year-round cup. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings, along with a mobile valuables deposit and toilet cabins. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský ostrov on Za elektrárnou Street. The race is for all age groups, covers 3.2 km, and is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike, with the aim of encouraging the joy of running. Parking is available near the bridge to Císařský ostrov, and changing facilities and toilets are provided.

name: Kačický lesní běh
location: Obora, Kačice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kačice Forest Run is an appealing off-road race in the beautiful Obora Forest and surrounding area of Kačice, with a range of distances from 100 m to 900 m for young people and adults. The event takes place on 2 May 2026 and is open to all age groups, including children’s races with free entry. There are also social activities, including a sauna and refreshments after the race, creating a friendly atmosphere for the whole family. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup, making it a great opportunity to get together for sport in nature.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in Obora Forest, with distances from 100 m to 900 m
Races for all age groups, including children’s races
Post-race social activities, including a sauna and refreshments
additional: Cross-country running in Obora Forest, various race distances, children’s races with free entry, sauna and refreshments after the race

name: Maloskalský půlmaraton
location: Malá Skála, Český ráj, Czech Republic
description: The Maloskalský Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Český ráj region, in Malá Skála. The race offers a half-marathon course with approximately 25 metres of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt, gravel and dirt roads. The start is in the early evening, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The event also includes a 10 km course, suitable for a wide range of runners. The organisers provide a full service, including chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, baggage storage and medical services.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course: 21.098 km, with approximately 25 m of elevation gain
Course surface: 80% asphalt, 10% gravel, 10% dirt road
The route follows a cycle path and hiking trails, crossing a railway bridge and passing Hrubý Rohozec Chateau
additional: Limit of 200 runners for the half marathon and 100 for the 10 km race. Race bibs can include the runner’s name for registrations made by 26 April. STOPNITO chip timing. Refreshments on the course at kilometres 5, 8, 13 and 16, and at the finish. Race check-in from 14:45 to 16:40; baggage storage available until 16:40. Race-logo T-shirt available to order. Course: 21.098 km; start at 17:00; registration from 14:45 to 16:40. The race includes refreshments, chip timing, gifts and medical services.

name: K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival
description: The K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival is a prestigious ultramarathon held in Konstantinovy Lázně on a 2,854-metre loop. The festival includes six races of varying lengths, from 24 hours to a six-day run, attracting ultramarathon runners from many countries. In 2026, the 24-hour race will also be the Czech Republic Championships. The race is known for its difficulty and international participation, making it a significant event in Czech and world ultramarathon running.
course_highlights: A 2,854-metre loop in Konstantinovy Lázně
The longest race lasts six days
The 24-hour race is the 2026 Czech Republic Championships
additional: The race is held on an asphalt road course. The organiser is Rumning klap z.s. The first category starts at 12:00. The festival includes 50 km, 24-hour, 48-hour, 72-hour and 144-hour races, as well as a six-day run. The races take place on a 2,854-metre loop equipped with lighting and meeting international standards. The event is part of the international ultramarathon calendar and offers various race distances, including 50 km, 24 hours, 48 hours, 72 hours and 6 days.

name: Otrokovická 100
location: Otrokovice, Buchlovské hory, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Otrokovická 100 is a 100 km ultramarathon held in Otrokovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The event is part of a wider weekend program that also includes a 50 km option, and is intended for runners seeking a challenge in the beautiful surroundings of the Buchlov Mountains. The race is organized by the SKÁJ team and attracts participants from across the country who want to test their endurance over a long distance. The event emphasizes athletic performance, active recreation, and a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 100 km ultramarathon in the picturesque surroundings of the Buchlov Mountains
The option to take part in a 50 km event
Organized by the SKÁJ team, with an emphasis on athletic performance and community
additional: The race includes aid stations and is intended for active athletes and running enthusiasts, with an option to volunteer.

name: Avanti běh Lukov
location: Lukov u Znojma, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Avanti Run Lukov is a race in Lukov near Znojmo, featuring a 9 km main race for men and a 4.5 km race for women, along with children’s races of various distances depending on age. The course is mainly on firm surfaces, including asphalt and farm tracks, with a significant climb in the upper part of Lukov. After the race, the full Znojmo Running Cup series is celebrated with awards for the top runners and light refreshments. The event is organized by the Rabbits Znojmo team, which welcomes all runners to take part and meet up after the race.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly on asphalt and farm tracks
A significant climb in the upper part of Lukov
Two laps for men (9 km), one lap for women (4.5 km)
additional: Check-in and registration take place on site at Penzion Adalbert in Lukov near Znojmo. The children’s races start at 9:15, and the main race starts at 10:00. After the race, the full Znojmo Running Cup series is celebrated, with handmade trophies and prizes from sponsors. Light refreshments are provided for participants. The organizers welcome feedback and suggestions for improvement. The event is open to the general public, including children.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - květen
location: Madal Bal, Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and levels of running experience, from beginners to seasoned runners. The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop of just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children up to 12 years old (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in each category receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is 3.2 km long, the start is at 9:00 by the Madal Bal company, registration is held on the first Saturday of the month from 8:15 to 8:55, and the run is open to all ages and focused on the joy of movement.

name: Kokina běh
location: Horka nad Moravou, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Kokina Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc and held in Horka nad Moravou. The race is 15 km long and is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners. The Liga stovkařů club specializes in recreational and competitive running and offers participants a quality sporting experience in the picturesque surroundings of Central Moravia. The race is suitable for runners of varying ability who want to test themselves on an interesting course.
course_highlights: 15 km race distance
Picturesque surroundings of Horka nad Moravou
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners
additional: Registration is open until 1.5.2026. Participants agree to the race rules and take part at their own risk. The organizer is not responsible for any injuries. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners series. It takes place as part of a regional series and offers not only a sporting experience but also the opportunity to meet the local running community.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - květen
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children under 12, who run 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park setting. After the race, every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Everyone’s time is recorded, and results are published online and count toward the year-round Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Královská obora–Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place by the Brussels Gate (beneath the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with online pre-registration available for faster check-in. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Parking is recommended by the bridge to Císařský ostrov on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings (unattended), as well as a mobile valuables locker. Toilets are also available on site. The race is part of the year-round cup; start at 9:07, registration from 8:15 to 8:45, online registration available, parking by the bridge to Císařský ostrov, changing facilities and toilets available, participants are divided into age categories.

name: Letohradská pětka
location: Orlovna na Orlici, Letohrad, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Letohrad Five is a cross-country running race for children and adults, held on May 2, 2026, in Letohrad, at the Orlovna in Orlice. Depending on the category, the course ranges from 100 to 5,000 metres and runs mainly along field and forest paths. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is part of the Orel Running League. Registration takes place in the morning, and the main race starts at noon.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly along field and forest paths
Course distances range from 100 to 5,000 metres, depending on the category
Start at the Orlovna in Orlice
additional: Registration for the children’s category is from 8:30 to 9:45, and for the adult category from 8:30 to 11:30. The first category starts at 10:00, and the main race starts at 12:00. The course runs along field and forest paths, with the start at the Orlovna in Orlice. The race is part of the ISCAREX CUP 2025 and the Orel Youth Running League.

description: The Říp Cross-Country Run in Roudnice nad Labem is a traditional race with a rich history, held at Tyrš Stadium and in the area around Mount Říp. The event offers a range of courses for all ages, from preschoolers to adults and veterans, with distances from 300 metres to 15,200 metres. Entry fees are paid at registration. The race is open to the general public and offers a chance to enjoy a day of sport in beautiful surroundings. It is organised by T. J. Sokol Roudnice nad Labem, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and good facilities for runners and spectators.
course_highlights: A range of courses from 300 m for preschoolers to 15,200 m for distance runners
Start and finish at Tyrš Stadium, with routes passing through the area around Mount Říp
Age- and gender-based categories, with courses in the Roudnice nad Labem area
additional: Registration is from 8:00 at Tyrš Stadium; children and youth must register by 8:45, and adults by 9:30. Categories are divided by age, with different start locations. The race is organised by T. J. Sokol Roudnice n.L.; contact details and a phone number are available at the venue. The course is marked and secured by race marshals and municipal police. Registration is through the naZávody.cz system. The start is at Tyrš Stadium; registration is open from 8:00 to 9:30.

name: Hornobludovická sedmička
location: Horní Bludovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Hornobludovická sedmička is a traditional running race in Horní Bludovice, held on a challenging, hilly 7 km course with approximately 100 m of elevation gain, including 63 steps up to the Žermanice Reservoir dam. The race is part of the Karviná District Running Cup and offers a beautiful running experience on a mix of road, gravel and farm-track surfaces. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a raffle and refreshments at the FC Horní Bludovice football grounds, which provide facilities including changing rooms and showers. Runners of all categories and age groups are welcome, with prizes for the top three in each category.
course_highlights: 7 km course with approximately 100 m of elevation gain, including 63 steps up to the Žermanice Reservoir dam
Mixed surfaces: road, gravel and farm track
Challenging, hilly and varied course
additional: Race-day registration is from 9:00 to 10:00 at the FC Horní Bludovice football pitch. Refreshments at the start and finish are subject to the organiser’s arrangements. After the race, there will be a raffle and refreshments. Categories are divided by age and gender, with prizes for the top three in each category. Changing rooms and showers are available at the football grounds. Parking is available by the football pitch. The race takes place on 2 May 2026; registration runs from 1 January to 1 May 2026, and the race is part of the Karviná Cup 2026.

name: Běh Klobasnou
location: Lesy u Veselí nad Lužnicí, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Klobasna Run is a traditional running race organised by the athletics club in Veselí nad Lužnicí, now taking place for the 64th time. The event offers various categories, including a 1 km family run and children’s races, where participants receive medals, trophies and prizes. Registration is available in advance or on race day, making organisation easier and reducing waiting times. The event takes place in a pleasant sporting atmosphere and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: A traditional running race with a 64-year history
A 1 km family run and children’s categories
A pleasant atmosphere and a sports complex in Veselí nad Lužnicí
additional: Registration is available in advance or on race day from 9:00 to 11:00, no later than 30 minutes before the start. On race day, participants only pay the entry fee and collect their race number. Participants in the children’s categories and family run receive a finisher’s medal. The club also sells jerseys, caps and headbands. Parking is available at the sports complex. The race includes various courses, including children’s races and the family run, with registration available on-site or in advance, forest and gravel paths, and undulating terrain.

name: II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail
description: The II Mohácsi Gőcze Trail is a recreational running event taking place on May 2, 2026, at the Szőlőhegyi event grounds in Mohács. The race follows the trails of the Mohács Hills and offers various distances for all age groups, from an 500-meter children’s race to a 22 km distance. The family-friendly event offers medical coverage and prizes, and participants can have their times recorded by chip timing. Runners can take part in a group warm-up before the start. Participation is at the runner’s own risk.
course_highlights: Trails of the Mohács Hills
Distances from 500 m to 22 km, for all age groups
Start and finish at the Szőlőhegyi event grounds
additional: Chip timing with a 2,000 Ft deposit. Prizes for the top three finishers in each distance and gender category. Participants in the children’s races receive a finisher’s medal. Register online and pay by bank transfer. Registration changes: fussajovodert@gmail.com. Littering is prohibited and may result in disqualification. The event may be postponed in extreme weather. Terrain: trails of the Mohács Hills; Registration: online, through the Facebook event; chip timing, prizes, medical coverage, children’s races

name: MOHÁCSI GÖCZE TRAIL (2.)
location: Mohácsi Szőlőhegyi rendezvénytér, Mohács, Baranya County, Hungary
description: The Mohács Gőcze Trail is a trail-running race held at the Mohács Szőlőhegyi Event Venue. Every finisher receives a metal finisher’s medal, and the top three finishers in each distance and gender category receive special prizes, including in the children’s races. The event promotes the power of running and community, and offers participants high quality at low prices. The race includes a 21 km distance that earns Ötpróba points. The organizers emphasize the positive effects of running on physical and mental health.
course_highlights: 21 km trail-running distance
Every finisher receives a metal finisher’s medal
The top three finishers in each distance and gender category receive special prizes
additional: On-site registration is available on race day. The race venue is the Mohács Szőlőhegyi Event Venue. The race is part of the Ötpróba program; the 21 km distance is worth 4 points. Children’s races also include prizes. Distances: 500 m, 1 km, 6 km, 10.5 km, 22 km; venue: Mohács, Szőlőhegyi Event Venue; online and on-site registration; medical coverage; children’s races; changes may be made depending on the weather.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km), ktorý sa koná v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Organizuje ho Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team a je určený pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste v deň preteku od 9:30, štart je o 10:00. Súťaž je súčasťou série pretekov, kde bežci zbierajú body do putovného pohára podľa kategórií a výkonov.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 2 míle (3,218 km) v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda
Prezentácia a registrácia pri volejbalovom ihrisku
Kategórie pre deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste v deň preteku od 9:30 hod. Pri rovnosti bodov v súťaži rozhoduje najlepší čas po prepočte koeficientom a potom veľkosť topánky. Súťažiaci môžu získať plusový bod za zlepšenie svojho najlepšieho času v roku. Na konci roka sa z celkových výsledkov vymažú dve najhoršie mesiace (amnestia). Pretek sa koná na verejnej ceste v oblasti Kuchajdy, Bratislava; kategórie zahŕňajú deti, juniory, ženy, mužov a veteránov; registrácia je možná aj na mieste.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: Beh 2 míle v Bratislave pri Kuchajde je pravidelný bežecký závod na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km), organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamom. Prezentácia a registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30, štart je o 10:00 hod. Závod je otvorený pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Súťaž je súčasťou putovného pohára Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, kde sa výsledné časy prepočítavajú podľa vekových koeficientov a pretekári sú bodovaní podľa účasti a výkonov.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 2 míle (3,218 km) v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda
Prezentácia a štart pri volejbalovom ihrisku
Kategórie pre deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:30 pri volejbalovom ihrisku. Súťaž o Putovný pohár Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, kde sa body prideľujú podľa účasti a výkonov s možnosťou amnestie na dve najhoršie účasti v roku. Pri rovnosti bodov rozhoduje vek a najlepší čas v danom roku. Beh sa koná na Areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda, Bratislava, s možnosťou registrácie od 9:30 a štartom o 10:00. Súťaž o Putovný pohár Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, hodnotenie podľa bodov a časov, kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny.

name: Stropkovská dvadsiatka
description: Stropkovská dvadsiatka je tradičný cestný bežecký pretek s bohatou históriou od roku 1977, ktorý sa koná v meste Stropkov. Trať vedie cez niekoľko obcí a ponúka bežcom možnosť súťažiť na 20 km vzdialenosti s občerstvením na trati a v cieli. Podujatie organizuje Klub Bežcov Stropkov, ktorý sa stará o rozvoj bežeckého hnutia v regióne. Bežci môžu očakávať kvalitnú organizáciu, štartovné balíčky a možnosť regenerácie po behu v krytej plavárni. Pretek je súčasťou Oblastnej bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez obce Stropkov, občerstvenie na 5 km, 11 km, 16 km a 19 km
Cieľ na Námestí SNP v Stropkove s občerstvením a možnosťou regenerácie v krytej plavárni
Dĺžka trate 20 km, cestný beh s bohatou históriou od roku 1977
additional: Registrácia online od 01.03.2026 do 30.04.2026, možnosť registrácie na mieste do 10:30 hod. v deň preteku. Účastníci do 150 prihlásených s riadne uhradeným štartovným získajú kompletný štartový balíček vrátane medaily. Podujatie je súčasťou Oblastnej bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance. Po behu možnosť sprchy a regenerácie v krytej plavárni pri ZŠ Konštantínova ul. od 12:30 hod. Dátum podujatia: 3. mája 2026; Lokalita: Námestie SNP, Stropkov; Súčasťou sú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a aktivity ako Nordic walking a barefoot beh.

name: Stropkovská desiatka a  I. ročník Barefoot
location: Námestie SNP v Stropkove, Stropkov, Slovakia
description: Stropkovská desiatka a I. ročník Barefoot sú súčasťou tradičných cestných bežeckých pretekov v Stropkove, ktoré majú bohatú históriu od roku 1977. Podujatie organizuje Klub Bežcov Stropkov s cieľom podporiť bežecké hnutie v regióne a na Slovensku. Bežci môžu očakávať kvalitne pripravené trate s atmosférou, ktorú každoročne vytvárajú stovky fanúšikov a bežcov. Okrem hlavného behu je súčasťou programu aj beh na boso, ktorý prináša nový zážitok pre účastníkov.
course_highlights: Cestné bežecké trate s bohatou históriou od roku 1977
Trate lemované fanúšikmi v meste Stropkov a okolí
Súčasťou je aj nový beh na boso (Barefoot)
additional: Podujatie zahŕňa viaceré bežecké disciplíny v rovnaký deň vrátane Stropkovskej 20, Stropkovskej 10 a 10 Barefoot, Stropkovskej 5 a 5 nordic walking a Detského behu pre mamičku. Štart všetkých hlavných behov je o 11:00 hod. na Námestí SNP v Stropkove. Podujatie ponúka rôzne preteky vrátane 5 km, 10 km a 20 km, s dôrazom na športové zážitky a komunitnú atmosféru.

name: Mistrovství ČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The Czech Republic Men’s and Women’s Marathon Championships is a prestigious race over the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, held in Prague’s historic city centre, starting in Old Town Square. The race is for men and women over 18 who met the qualifying standards in previous years. It is organised by Juniorský maratonský klub, z.s. in cooperation with RunCzech. Runners can use modern timing services, and a professional photography service is available after the race. The start is traditionally at 08:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: Start and finish in historic Old Town Square in Prague
A 42.195 km route through central Prague
Professional timing and the option to download the GPX route
additional: The race office is open on 1 and 2 May 2026 at the Výstaviště exhibition grounds in Holešovice, in the Křižík Pavilions. Photography is provided by witisi.photo, with the option to pre-order during registration or order after the race. Applications are accepted only from runners who met the qualifying standards between 1 January 2025 and the registration deadline. Participation is subject to the qualifying standards and approval by the technical delegate. The available information relates to the 2025 and 2026 editions, not to the date 9 May 2027.

name: Barvám Neutečeš České Budějovice
location: Sokolský ostrov, České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: Barvám Neutečeš is a colourful run and a full day of fun for all ages, families and friends, held on Sokolský Island in České Budějovice. Choose between two routes: 5 km with five colour zones, or 1.5 km with three colour zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about joy, friendship and unforgettable experiences filled with colour, music and fun. Come and enjoy a day of laughter, dancing and shared energy, where nobody can escape the colours.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colour zones
1.5 km route with 3 colour zones and an interactive sports zone
The colour zones cover runners from head to toe in colour
additional: The event runs from 9:00 to 16:00 on Sokolský Island. It includes musical performances, themed zones, photo booths, 360° video and an accompanying programme. The event is suitable for everyone, regardless of ability; children can take part on shoulders, scooters or in strollers. It takes place on 3 May 2026 on Sokolský Island in České Budějovice. Registration is available both on site and online, with different packages for individuals, teams and corporate participants. The event also has a charitable aspect and various accompanying city activities.

name: Běh na 2 míle, Zlín – Příluky
location: Průmyslová zóna Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2 Miles Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and a 9:00 start. At the finish, each participant is rewarded for their effort with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: A precisely measured asphalt loop of just under two laps
The course runs mostly among gardens in the industrial zone
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to 12; age categories apply for the entire calendar year. Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the men’s, women’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on roller skates or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The race takes place every month, registration is voluntary, a warm cinnamon pancake is served at the finish, the course is precisely measured and suitable for runners of all abilities.

name: Prague International Marathon 2026
description: The Prague International Marathon 2026 is a prestigious running event held in Prague’s historic city centre. The race offers a traditional 42.195 km marathon course that passes iconic city landmarks. The running weekend also includes accompanying races for families and children, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all age groups. The start is scheduled for May 3, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. in Old Town Square.
course_highlights: The course runs through Prague’s historic city centre, with views of its landmarks
Start and finish in Old Town Square
A measured 42.195 km marathon distance
additional: The running weekend also includes the Active Breakfast Run (4.2 km), the dm Family Mile (1.609 km) and the dm bambini run (children’s races of 100–200 m). Runners can use the RunCzech mobile app for race information and a virtual race pack. The race is part of the RunCzech running league and offers special categories, including the Czech Marathon Championships for men and women. The 42.195 km race starts on Sunday, May 3, 2026, at 8:00 a.m.; registration also includes other events such as the Active Breakfast Run, the dm Family Mile and the dm bambini run.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
description: The Olomouc 2 Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and competing primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The top three finishers in each category receive awards.
course_highlights: Race in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, by the fountain
Course length: 2 miles (3.2 km); children’s course: 600 m
Friendly atmosphere for runners of all abilities and ages
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The race venue is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens, except for two races in June and August, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. Results are adjusted using an age coefficient, and runners collect points for the cup competition covering September 2025–August 2026. The race includes categories for all age groups, with awards for the best finishers in each category; the course runs through Smetana Gardens and by the river, and registration is from 9:30 to 10:00.

name: ORLEN Maraton Praha, MČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The ORLEN Prague Marathon is a prestigious race held in Prague’s historic center and also serves as the Czech Republic Marathon Championships for men and women. It traditionally covers the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, starting in Old Town Square. The race attracts thousands of runners and offers a unique atmosphere with beautiful views of Prague’s landmarks. It is part of the RunCzech Running League and is known for its professional organization and support for the running community.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Old Town Square, Prague
The route passes through Prague’s historic center, with views of its landmarks
Classic marathon distance of 42.195 km
additional: The marathon weekend also includes accompanying races such as the ORLEN active breakfast (4.2 km), dm family mile (1.609 km), and dm bambini run (children’s races of 100–200 m). The race pack and further information are available in the RunCzech mobile app. The race is part of the RunCzech Running League and offers support for runners, including insurance and race transfers. It includes various categories, including relays and accompanying races, and is a major sporting event with international participation. The route is challenging but offers a unique running experience in Prague’s historic setting.

name: 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton
description: The 24th Self-Transcendence Marathon will take place on May 3, 2026, at Malomvölgyi Lake in Pécs. Organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, this family-friendly race follows a loop course and offers marathon and half-marathon distances. The course runs on compacted forest trails and crushed stone, with 30 meters of elevation gain, giving participants varied terrain to race on. Chip timing ensures accurate results, and the aid stations provide plenty of refreshments.
course_highlights: 5.2 km loop course; the marathon covers 8 laps
Compacted forest trails and crushed stone, with 30 meters of elevation gain
A combination of the walking path around the lake and a marked course
additional: Chip timing uses a chip attached to the back of the bib. The aid station at the start/finish offers isotonic drinks, water, sweet and savoury biscuits, sandwiches, fruit, vegetables and chocolate. Field limit: 250 participants. A T-shirt can be ordered separately for HUF 3,500 until April 15. Cut-off times: 5.2 km — 50 minutes; 10.4 km — 1 hour 40 minutes; half marathon — 3 hours; marathon — 6 hours. Bib and T-shirt collection is available on race day between 7:00 and 7:45; on-site registration is also available during this time. Multiple distances, a forest course, chip timing, on-site and online registration, a participant limit (max. 250), cut-off times and awards by distance, and nearby accommodation offers.

name: Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: The Farkasmály Vineyard and Cellar Run is an atmospheric trail-running race along the vineyard slopes of Farkasmály in Gyöngyös, among vineyards and wine cellars. The event offers challenges over several distances, including a shorter, less hilly 3 km loop and a longer 8.5 km loop with climbs. Runners can enjoy being close to nature, visits to wine cellars, and varied terrain suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike. The event is organized by GYÖTRI Klub, which has decades of experience running sporting events.
course_highlights: Vineyard Loop: 3,000 m, 40 m elevation gain, 2 loops among the vineyard slopes, with a wine-cellar visit
Farkasmály Loop: 8,500 m, 190 m elevation gain, 4 loops with climbs and wine-cellar visits
Relay race: 4 × 1,500 m; Spritzer Run for teams of 3, with an 800 m distance and spritzer drinking stations
additional: Registration and bib pickup from 13:00; on-site registration closes 15 minutes before the start of the relevant race. Parking is available on the grassy area beside the Szilue Hotel. Race location GPS coordinates: 47.805908, 19.955025. Registration for the race is open from April 10 to April 30; prizes and a wine tasting await participants.

name: MÁSODSZOR IS CÉLBA ÉRÜNK!
description: Koraszülöttfutás 2026 is a charity running event that starts in Zalaegerszeg and finishes in Keszthely, covering a total distance of 66 km. Along the way, participants run through the beautiful landscapes of Zala County, with ten relay points, and the entire route is timed using chip timing. The event gives special support to premature babies, and includes a separate run for them. Teams can cross the finish line together to share the experience and the achievement. The start and pasta party venue is the Zala Zone Automotive Test Track. The run takes place on Sunday, May 3.
course_highlights: 66 km between Zalaegerszeg and Keszthely
10 relay points and a refreshment point at the Göcseji Village Museum
The route is marked with small teddy-bear signs and ribbons approximately every 200 metres
additional: Timing is provided by a chip attached to the race bib. The time limit for the distance is 8 hours 30 minutes. The pasta party takes place at the Zala Zone Automotive Test Track on May 2 at 17:00. The route also crosses two railway crossings; participants are escorted by an ambulance across the first one. The run for premature babies takes place on May 3 at 16:00, from the castle park in Keszthely to Fő tér. The event includes several related activities, including registration, race-pack collection, relay points and the finish, and offers the option to enter individually or as a team.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Řevnice
location: Pivovar Řevnice, Řevnice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka running series in Řevnice is part of a traditional race series held in the picturesque surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The route runs mainly along a green educational trail, with beautiful views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests. It includes two long climbs, passing through the Forest Theatre and by Píšťák Pond. The start and finish are at the Řevnice Brewery, where refreshments and bag storage are available. The race is suitable for runners who want to enjoy nature and the community atmosphere of the running series.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along a green educational trail marked in red and white
Two long climbs, including a section through the Forest Theatre and up to Píšťák Pond
Views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests, with the return route passing the cemetery and Havlíčkovy sady Park
additional: Registration is available online and on site from 17:00; arrival by 17:30 is recommended. Refreshments and bag storage are available on site. Diplomas are awarded to the top three finishers in each category. The race follows a natural-surface course. On-site registration is available, and the event includes race numbers, refreshments, and awards for the best in each category.

name: Jarní kros Písařova
location: Tatran Písařov, Písařov, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Cross-Country Race in Písařov is a traditional running event organized by SK Pašerák in the village of Písařov. It is part of the CHLAPÁK district running competition and is open to the general public, including children. The event takes place at the Tatran Písařov sports field and offers a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. SK Pašerák has a long-standing commitment to organizing sports activities for children and young people in the region.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Tatran Písařov sports field
Part of the CHLAPÁK district running competition
A traditional spring cross-country race in the village of Písařov
additional: The race takes place on Wednesday, May 6, 2026, from 5 p.m. at the Tatran Písařov sports field. It is organized by SK Pašerák, which also organizes the Children’s Cup, a series of races for children in various sports. The race is scheduled for May 6, 2026. The event is in Czech and supports an active lifestyle among young people in the region.

name: Běh lesoparkem Praha Hostivař
description: The Prague Hostivař Forest Park Run is a trail race offering two course options: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men. The race takes place in the scenic Hostivař Forest Park in Prague 10 and is part of the SABZO series. It is suitable for anyone who wants to enjoy running in nature, with gentle elevation and a pleasant atmosphere. The race is ideal for trail-running enthusiasts and offers the chance to compete against other runners in the beautiful Hostivař forest.
course_highlights: Trail course in Hostivař Forest Park
Two distances: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men
Part of the SABZO series
additional: Registration costs 50 Kč; members of TJ Zentiva and SABZO can enter for free. The race takes place in Prague 10-Hostivař, near the gazebo by the children's playground in Hostivař Forest Park.

name: Žďárák – Čerňák
location: Čerňák, Žďár nad Sázavou, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 50 Kč (startovné bude opět věnováno na dobročinnou sbírku, tentokrát pro Charitu, která podpoří Alexe Vondru, studenta ze Žďáru, který přišel o ruku a potřebuje peníze na sportovní protézu.)

description: Čerňák is a trail race along the paths of the Black Forest around Zelená hora and across meadows towards Vysoké. The 7 km route with 180 m of elevation gain features varied terrain, with 90% off-road and 10% asphalt, reminiscent of Scottish fellrunning races. The race is popular with local runners and offers beautiful views of the town of Žďár nad Sázavou and the UNESCO-listed Pilgrimage Church of St John of Nepomuk on Zelená hora. The start and finish are by the car park at the church on Zelená hora. The entry fee goes to a charity fundraiser for a sports prosthesis for student Alex Vondra.
course_highlights: 7 km trail race with 180 m of elevation gain
The route follows paths through the Black Forest and meadows towards Vysoké
A final climb up the steps to the UNESCO-listed church on Zelená hora
additional: Start and finish by the car park at the church on Zelená hora. Trail shoes are recommended. The entry fee goes to a charity fundraiser for a sports prosthesis. The route is marked. Race photos are available online. Events include trail, cross-country, road, gravel and MTB disciplines; registration and exact routes are listed on the website.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice
location: České Budějovice, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice

price_tiers.distance: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in České Budějovice is a charity running event taking place on 6 May 2026, starting at 21:00 by the sports hall near Stromovka. Participants can choose between two distances—2.3 km (1 lap) and 4.6 km (2 laps)—and the event is suitable both for runners and for those who would like to walk the course. The entry fee is 500 Kč, half of which goes directly to support people with severe visual impairments. The event offers race packs with a headlamp or a sports headband, as well as an accompanying programme including a concert by the band Byt číslo 4.
course_highlights: Night run with a choice of 2.3 km or 4.6 km courses
Start and finish by the sports hall near Stromovka in České Budějovice
Charity run supporting people with severe visual impairments
additional: Registration desks open at 19:00. Capacity is limited for participants’ safety and comfort. Race packs are available in two versions—with a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P cards who are accompanied by someone can enter for free; they can purchase a race pack on site for 250 Kč. An admission ticket with a unique code, either printed or on a mobile device, is required to enter the venue. The programme includes a concert by the band Byt číslo 4 from 20:00. Distances of 2.3 km or 4.6 km, accompanying programme, benefits for the Světluška project, registration via GoOut.cz, tickets with a code, holders of ZTP and ZTP/P cards enter for free

name: 2. E.ON Business Run
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event held at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The race aims to bring together people from the corporate world and everyone interested in a shared active experience, where both individual achievement and team spirit take centre stage. Runners can choose from three options: a 5 km individual run, a 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km), or a 2 km walking stadium tour. Music, a party and street food accompany the event, making it an unforgettable experience even after the run.
course_highlights: The iconic running track at the National Athletics Centre
Three distance options: 5 km individual run, 3 × 2.7 km relay, and a 2 km walking stadium tour
Run near the Danube, enjoy the stadium experience and soak up the fantastic party atmosphere
additional: Payment at the event is possible by bank card and SZÉP card. Registration requires a BSI account. Finishers receive a unique finisher’s medal. After the race, participants can enjoy a fantastic party, music and street food. Each runner in the 3-person relay completes approximately 2.7 km. Free online training and a charity option are also available at the event. Distances: 5 km, 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km), stadium tour (2 km walking). The event takes place at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. Participation is possible with online or on-site registration.

name: E.ON BUSINESS RUN
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event taking place on May 6, 2026, at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The event welcomes not only people from the corporate world but everyone interested in coming together to get active, take on a challenge and celebrate. There are three distances: an individual 5 km, a 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km) and a 2 km stadium walking tour. Participants will receive a unique finisher’s medal, and music, street food and an evening party will provide the entertainment.
course_highlights: The iconic track at the National Athletics Centre
3 distances: individual 5 km, 3 × 2.7 km relay, 2 km stadium walking tour
A special riverside location on the Danube
additional: Online registration is available only by bank card and SZÉP card. A BSI account is required to register. Finishers receive a unique finisher’s medal. Music, street food and an evening party await participants. Contact details for the registration office are available on the website. Music, street food and a festive atmosphere await participants at the National Athletics Centre, where community activities will also take place alongside the running event.

name: VSE City run Košice
price_range: 3 EUR (pre deti, študentov, seniorov, PWD), ďalšie dary prijímané

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deti, študenti, dôchodcovia a ZŤP osoby: 3 EUR

description: VSE City Run v Košiciach je charitatívny beh s dĺžkou 4 km, ktorý sa koná 7. mája 2026. Podujatie je určené pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, študentov, seniorov a zdravotne znevýhodnených osôb, pričom štartovné je venované na podporu Platformy rodín detí so zdravotným znevýhodnením. Beh prebieha v centre Košíc a je známy svojou inkluzívnou atmosférou a komunitným charakterom. Organizátori spolupracujú s Maratónskym klubom Košice a ďalšími partnermi, pričom cieľom je nielen šport, ale aj pomoc rodinám s deťmi so zdravotným znevýhodnením.
course_highlights: 4 km trať v centre Košíc
Charitatívny beh s inkluzívnym charakterom
Podpora rodín detí so zdravotným znevýhodnením
additional: Štartovné sa platí v hotovosti v deň konania behu pri vydávaní štartových čísel od 14:00. Účastníci mladší ako 12 rokov musia štartovať v sprievode dospelej osoby. Organizované kolektívy môžu využiť hromadnú prihlášku cez online Google formulár. Súčasťou programu je aj prechádzka VSE City Run o 16:30. Charitatívny beh, možnosť registrácie osobne alebo online, podujatie zahŕňa aj prechádzku a hlavný beh, výťažok podporuje deti so zdravotným znevýhodnením

name: Varínsky lesný beh
location: Športový areál Juraja Sobolu, Varín, Žilina, Slovakia
organizer: Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík, Obec Varín
description: Varínsky lesný beh je bežecké podujatie v podhorí Malej Fatry, ktoré ponúka krásne trasy s výhľadmi na malofatranský hrebeň. Pretekári si môžu vybrať medzi dlhšou trasou s dĺžkou 13,7 km a prevýšením 600 m, alebo kratšou trasou 6,5 km s prevýšením 120 m. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov a milovníkov prírody, ktorí si chcú užiť beh v malebnom prostredí. Súčasťou programu sú aj detské preteky a po vyhlásení výsledkov je pripravená tombola. Organizátormi sú Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík a obec Varín.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie podhorím Malej Fatry s výhľadmi na malofatranský hrebeň
Dlhá trasa má 13,7 km s prevýšením 600 m
Krátka trasa má 6,5 km s prevýšením 120 m
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je od 7:30 do 9:45 v Športovom areáli J. Sobolu vo Varíne. Poučenie účastníkov je o 9:55 pre dlhú trať a o 10:15 pre krátku trať. Štart krátkej trate je o 10:20, detské preteky začínajú o 10:30. Vyhlásenie výsledkov a tombola sú naplánované na 13:30. Prezentácia pretekov je v sobotu od 7:30 do 9:45, štart dlhej trate o 10:00, krátkej o 10:20, detských pretekov o 10:30 a vyhlásenie výsledkov o 13:30. Trasy vedú v podhorí Malej Fatry s výhľadmi na malofatranský hrebeň.

name: Memoriál brig. gen. Ľ. Kukorelliho
organizer: Mesto Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestské kultúrne stredisko mesta Hanušovce nad Topľou, ZO SZPB Hanušovce nad Topľou, Hermanovský bežecký oddiel
description: Memoriál brig. gen. Ľ. Kukorelliho je bežecké podujatie v Hanušovciach nad Topľou, ktoré ponúka kategórie pre mužov, ženy, štafety s rôznym počtom členov a beh pre radosť. Organizátormi sú Mesto Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestské kultúrne stredisko, ZO SZPB a Hermanovský bežecký oddiel. Pretek je bez štartovného, čo umožňuje širokej verejnosti zúčastniť sa bez finančnej záťaže. Miestom štartu je Mestský úrad v Hanušovciach nad Topľou.
course_highlights: Miesto štartu: Mestský úrad v Hanušovciach nad Topľou
Kategórie: muži, ženy, štafety (2 až 5 členov), beh pre radosť
Organizovaný mestom a miestnymi bežeckými oddielmi
additional: Štartovné je bez poplatku. Organizátormi sú Mesto Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestské kultúrne stredisko, ZO SZPB a Hermanovský bežecký oddiel. Kategórie zahŕňajú štafety s 2 až 5 členmi a beh pre radosť. Podujatie sa koná na území Hanušoviec nad Topľou, pričom presný traťový profil nie je špecifikovaný. Registrácia je možná cez kontaktné údaje uvedené na oficiálnej stránke.

name: Charitatívny beh obcou Bukovec
organizer: Obec Bukovec a občianske združenie Oáza-nádej pre nový život
description: Charitatívny beh obcou Bukovec je tradičná športová udalosť, ktorú organizuje obec Bukovec a jej starostka spolu s poslancami obecného zastupiteľstva. Tento beh sa koná v malebnom prostredí obce Bukovec, ktorá je známa svojou rekreačnou oblasťou s vodnými nádržami a prírodnou krásou. Bežci majú možnosť prežiť príjemný športový zážitok v blízkosti miestneho kostola a zároveň podporiť charitatívne účely. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a prináša komunitný zážitok v pokojnom prostredí.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie obcou Bukovec v blízkosti miestneho kostola
Malebné prostredie s výhľadmi na vodné nádrže a riečku Idu
Rekreačná oblasť s prírodnou scenériou a tichým prostredím
additional: Podujatie je organizované obcou Bukovec, starostkou a poslancami OZ. K dispozícii sú propozície behu vo formáte PDF na stiahnutie. Obec Bukovec je známa rekreačnou oblasťou s vodnými nádržami, ktoré sú súčasťou okolia trate. Informácie o podujatí sú zverejnené na oficiálnej webovej stránke obce. Dátum: 8. mája 2026, štart o 10:00, lokalita: Bukovec pri kostole, možnosť registrácie na mieste, podpora na charitatívne účely.

name: Mistrovství ČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km mužů a žen
description: The Czech Road Running Championships for men and women over 1 mile and 5 km take place in the beautiful surroundings of the spa park in Poděbrady. The course is very fast, with no elevation gain and precisely measured 1 km laps along the spa colonnade, offering ideal conditions for personal records. The race is officially recognized by the Czech Athletics Federation and is part of the prestigious Poděbrady Walking program. The event also features an accompanying program and the chance to receive an original finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain.
course_highlights: 5 km race over five 1 km laps along the spa colonnade
1 mile race featuring an opening 609 m section and a 1 km lap along the spa colonnade
Very fast, flat course certified for the European Race Walking Championships
additional: Registration is available online only, with payment due within 7 days of registering. Late registrations will have no name printed on the race bib. On-site registration is available until 30 minutes before the race starts. Registration can be transferred free of charge until 21.4.2026; a fee applies after that date. Finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain. Accompanying program throughout the day along the spa colonnade. Available information about the program, registration, and prices applies to the 2026 edition; details for the date 14. 5. 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Běh vítězství Jihlava – Třešť
price_range: 150 Kč online, 200 Kč na místě pro dospělé; zdarma pro mládež do 17 let online, 50 Kč na místě
description: The Jihlava–Třešť Victory Run is an annual running event held on May 8, 2026, offering various race categories for adults, juniors, and children. The route runs from Jihlava to Třešť and includes both road sections and forest trails, with the main race covering 14.6 km. The event is part of the Vysočina Running Cup and offers not only sporting experiences but also prizes and in-kind awards for the winners. Registration is available online, and the race is suitable for a broad range of participants, including young people and children.
course_highlights: Main 14.6 km route from Jihlava to Třešť on roads and forest trails
Categories for different age groups, including children and young people
Part of the Vysočina Running Cup, with online registration available
additional: The route includes paved roads and forest trails; the race starts at approximately 8:45–9:45; race categories are available for children and young people; winners receive prizes and in-kind awards; refreshments and showers are provided.

name: Běh vítězství zámeckým parkem Lány
location: Lány, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sokol Lány, Základní škola Charlotty Garrigue Masarykové Lány
price_range: 50 Kč pro děti a mládež, 100 Kč pro dospělé, zdarma pro účastníky akce 'Běh pro zdraví'

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti a mládež do 18 let 50 Kč

description: The Victory Run through the Lány Castle Park is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1972. It takes place every year on May 8 in the castle park in Lány. The race offers a wide range of categories for children and adults, with distances from 60 metres to 7,800 metres. The courses are mostly on sand, gravel and grass, creating a pleasant and varied running environment. Races start at 8:20 and continue throughout the morning, and spectators are welcome to enjoy the atmosphere. The event is organised by TJ Sokol Lány and Charlotta Garrigue Masaryk Elementary School under the auspices of the Municipality of Lány.
course_highlights: The courses run mainly along sandy and gravel paths and over grass in the castle park
The women’s main race is 3,900 m (one lap), and the men’s is 7,800 m (two laps)
Children’s courses range from 60 m to 1,500 m, with colour-coded laps
additional: Race-day check-in is from 7:30 at the main entrance to the castle park, below the castle greenhouse. Runners must collect their race numbers no later than half an hour before their category’s start. Runners line up at the start 5 minutes before the start. Participants in the Run for Health start together on the 1,200 m course; the winner is determined by a draw. There is no entry fee for participants in the Run for Health. The race starts at 8:20; registration is available online or on site. The event has been part of the local sports calendar since 1972.

name: Čavisovská stovka
description: Čavisovská Stovka is a long-distance walk in the area around Čavisov, with 30, 50 and 100 km routes. It is being held for the thirteenth time. The start and finish are at the TJ Sokol sports field in Čavisov. Routes follow hiking trails, cycle routes and the event’s own markings; using a digital track for navigation at night is recommended. The organisers provide refreshments and basic facilities, including toilets and a shower at the start. The event is open to everyone, regardless of gender or a dog’s breed, and dogs may take part without a time limit.
course_highlights: Routes follow hiking trails, cycle routes and the event’s own markings
A flagship 100 km route for experienced participants, a challenging 50 km route and an easier 30 km route
Four refreshment stations on the 100 km course (at 16, 26, 53 and 79 km)
additional: The start and finish are at the TJ Sokol Čavisov sports field. Routes are not marked on hiking trails or cycle routes, so a digital track on a watch or phone is recommended. The event ends on 10 May 2025 at 23:59 for all routes; anyone finishing after the time limit will be recorded as DNF. Dogs may take part without a time limit. Toilets and a shower are available at the start; hot water is limited by the capacity of the boiler. The event offers several distances, online registration, maps and elevation profiles for the routes. The walk is open to the general public, including families and endurance runners.

name: Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice
description: The Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice is a 6 km running race that takes place on trails in the countryside around the village of Čechtice. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves amid the picturesque scenery of the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys trail running and wants to experience a sporting atmosphere in pleasant surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail course around the village of Čechtice
Race distance: 6 km
Part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup
additional: The race is part of a solemn day of remembrance for the victims of fascism, highlighting the event’s historical and social significance.

name: Strážnická stovka
description: Strážnická stovka is an extreme sporting event in the heart of the White Carpathians, open only to participants over 18. This ultratrail marathon features a challenging 100 km route, with a slightly modified hundred-kilometre course that tests runners’ determination and fitness. The start and finish are in Strážnice. The race includes aid stations and the option to transport drop bags. Each participant receives an original race bib bearing their name and, after completing the course, a beautiful metal finisher’s medal as a reward for pushing their limits.
course_highlights: 100 km route through the White Carpathians
Aid stations and drop-bag transport to OS Května
Race bib bearing your name and a metal finisher’s medal
additional: The race has two start groups: Limit 24h starts on Friday, 8 May 2026 at 19:30 for participants not aiming for a trophy; Limit 15h starts on Saturday, 9 May 2026 at 5:00 for runners aiming for a trophy. Accreditation takes place on Friday, 8 May from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday, 9 May from 4:15 to 4:45 (drop bags are not available). The entry fee includes refreshments on the course and at the event base. Timing is provided by ORGSU chips, and entry can be transferred to a substitute. A T-shirt with the logo is an optional item available to order through the e-shop. Registration opens on 3 November 2025. The race is open to adults only, and the course includes challenging terrain and technical sections.

name: Poděbrady Running - MČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km a veřejný běh na 5 km
description: Poděbrady Running is the inaugural open Czech Republic Road Running Championships over 1 mile and 5 km, complemented by a public 5 km race. The event takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the spa colonnade in Poděbrady and features certified, very fast and flat circuits where world records are set. This race is an ideal opportunity for runners looking to set a personal best and experience the atmosphere of competing alongside the best Czech athletes.
course_highlights: Certified circuits along the spa colonnade
