A very fast, flat course suitable for personal bests
The beautiful surroundings of Poděbrady
additional: The event is organised by the Czech Athletics Federation. The first and main category starts at 12:00. The course is certified and suitable for fast times. The entry fee can be paid in advance or on site for an additional charge. The 5 km course consists of 5 laps of 1 km each. The race is certified for the European Race Walking Championships. Registration is available in advance and on site. The time limit for the 5 km is 38 minutes. The race is suitable for participants aged 15 and over.

name: Běh osvobození
location: Lišany, Díly, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: SK Lišany, z.s. / TJ Sokol Díly
description: The Liberation Run is a traditional road race between the municipalities of Lišany and Lužná in the Plzeň Region. The race is 7 km long and takes place on a lightly trafficked third-class road. The start is at 11:15 after registration at the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany. The race is divided into six age categories and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Cash prizes are offered to the top finishers in each category and for breaking course records.
course_highlights: A 7,000 m route on the lightly trafficked third-class road Lišany–Lužná–Lišany
Start and finish by the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany
Cash bonuses for breaking course records
additional: Registration opens at 9:30 at the U Hřiště restaurant (community hall) in Lišany. Entries are accepted on site until 30 minutes before the start at the latest. Results and the awards ceremony are planned for approximately 12:30. The race has four men’s and two women’s categories. Cash prizes and certificates are awarded to the first six finishers in each category. Bonuses are also offered for the speed section and for breaking course records. Participants or their sponsoring organizations are responsible for meeting health requirements and covering the entry costs. The races are open to various age groups, with non-members of ČUS also eligible to compete, and include cash prizes and bonuses. The course follows a lightly trafficked road, and the races are part of regional cups.

name: Czechia Backyard Ultra Run
location: Zámecký park, Holešov, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Czechia Backyard Ultra Run 2026 is the fourth edition of a unique ultra-running race with the motto “Run as long as you can.” The race takes place in the beautiful grounds of the chateau park in Holešov and is part of the Silver Ticket races, offering the opportunity to compete in an international endurance event. Runners complete a 6.706-kilometre loop within 60 minutes and must line up at the start on the hour every hour until only one runner remains. The race is streamed live and offers full facilities, including showers, toilets and refreshments.
course_highlights: An exactly 6.706 km loop in the chateau park in Holešov
The route passes the chateau, a watercourse and a paved cycle path
Start and finish at the swimming pool complex, with full facilities
additional: The maximum number of participants is limited to 100 runners. Registration may be transferred to another runner until 24.4.2026. The entry fee includes a personalized race number showing the number of laps completed, a commemorative medal and refreshments. Showers, toilets, a medical professional and continuous supervision in the start/finish area are available. The race will be streamed live. Terrain: chateau park; registration: online; rules: run a 6.7056 km loop every hour, no assistance except from other runners, live streaming, maximum 100 participants, no poles; showers, toilets and heated changing rooms available.

name: Memoriál otce Jožky
organizer: Orel jednota Stěbořice, Farnost Stěbořice, Obec Stěbořice
description: The Father Jožka Memorial is a traditional running race held in Stěbořice, in the Moravian-Silesian Region, in honour of the priest Josef Motyka. The event offers various distances, including 10 km and 4 km, for men, women and young people, as well as short races for preschoolers. It is organised by local associations and the municipality and is open to the general public, who can enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the picturesque surroundings of Stěbořice. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and for supporting sport in the region.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Stěbořice
Distances range from 100 m for preschoolers to 10 km for adults
The race is suitable for all age groups, including masters
additional: Participants and spectators are advised not to take dogs onto the course during the race. Registration is open. The race is held in honour of the priest Josef Motyka and is part of the local cultural calendar.

name: Běh Černou Horou
location: Černá Hora, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh Černou Horou is a traditional cross-country race with a rich history dating back to 1928, making it the fourth-oldest race in the Czech Republic. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Černá Hora and offers courses for all age groups, including children’s races with up to 200 participants. The main course is 9.2 km long and runs around Černá Hora Castle. The race is part of the Blansko District Running League. The event is suitable for runners of all abilities and offers a challenging yet beautiful running experience.
course_highlights: 4 laps around Černá Hora Castle, each 2.3 km long
A 9.2 km main course with picturesque views of the castle
A course suitable for all age groups, including children
additional: Race registration takes place in the old changing-room building at the sports complex in Černá Hora. Parking is available in the adjacent car park right by the sports complex. The race is part of the Blansko District Running League. The race is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike, offers relays and children’s courses, and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Columbia Sunset Trail
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail-running race held at sunset in the area around Naszály Hill. Runners receive a unique wooden finisher’s medal, and the top three women and men in each distance receive special prizes. The event offers plenty of aid stations, changing rooms and luggage storage. Runners are advised to use a headlamp and hydration pack. The atmosphere and proximity to nature are sure to make this an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Run at sunset in the area around Naszály Hill
Unique wooden finisher’s medal for every distance
Plenty of refreshments at the aid stations and finish
additional: Free, cool photos available the day after the race. Changing rooms and luggage storage at the base. A working, fully charged headlamp is mandatory. Your mobile phone must be charged, switched on and have the volume turned up. You must use a hydration pack, bottle or cup, as there will be no disposable cups at the aid stations or finish. This trail-running event welcomes runners with excellent organization and participant services, including photos, prizes and equipment recommendations.

name: COLUMBIA SUNSET TRAIL
location: Naszály, Bocskai utca 1, Naszály, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail-running race held at sunset in the scenic surroundings of Naszály. Runners receive a unique wooden finisher’s medal at every distance, and the top finishers are awarded special medals. The event offers plenty of aid stations, changing rooms and baggage storage. For a safe race, runners are advised to use a headlamp and a hydration pack. The atmosphere and closeness to nature are sure to make this an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Run at sunset in Naszály’s natural surroundings
Unique wooden finisher’s medal at every distance
Plenty of refreshments at the aid stations and finish
additional: Free, fantastic photos available the day after the race. Special medals for the first three female and male finishers at each distance. Changing rooms and baggage storage at the base. A headlamp is mandatory; it must be in working order and fully charged. Bring a fully charged, switched-on, working mobile phone with the volume turned up. A hydration pack, bottle or cup is recommended, as there will be no disposable cups at the aid stations or finish. An ID card or a legible copy is required for registration. This trail-running event offers participants plenty of refreshments, safety equipment and memorable experiences.

name: Košice Peace Half marathon
location: Dolná brána, Hlavná ulica, Košice, Košice, Slovakia
organizer: Maratónsky klub Košice, Progress Promotion Košice
description: Košice Peace Half Marathon je tradičný polmaratónsky beh, ktorý sa koná v historickom centre Košíc. Trať vedie po malebných uliciach mesta, vrátane Dolnej brány a Hlavnej ulice, a ponúka bežcom jedinečný zážitok v atmosfére mieru a športového ducha. Podujatie je súčasťou série bežeckých akcií v Košiciach a je organizované s dôrazom na kvalitu a bezpečnosť pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie historickým centrom Košíc vrátane Dolnej brány a Hlavnej ulice
Bežecký zážitok v atmosfére mieru a športového ducha
Organizované v rámci série významných bežeckých podujatí v Košiciach
additional: Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne trate, sprievodné akcie, finisher medaily a zľavy pre registrovaných účastníkov na ďalšie podujatia v rámci série Košice Peace Marathon.

name: Strážovská 50
description: Strážovská 50 je horský ultramaratón a turistický diaľkový pochod s dĺžkou 50 km, ktorý sa koná v krásnom prostredí Strážovských vrchov. Štart aj cieľ sú v kúpeľnom meste Trenčianske Teplice. Trasa vedie po značených turistických chodníkoch a je certifikovaná ITRA s hodnotou Mountain level 5. Podujatie je súčasťou Slovenskej Ultratrailovej Ligy 2026 a ponúka náročný zážitok pre bežcov aj turistov.
course_highlights: 50 km horský ultramaratón v Strážovských vrchoch
Trasa vedie po značených turistických chodníkoch s náročným horským profilom
Certifikovaná ITRA trasa s 2 bodmi a Mountain level 5
additional: Registrácia je možná len online od 10. februára 2026 do 24. apríla 2026 alebo do naplnenia kapacity 250 účastníkov (z toho 50 miest je vyhradených pre kategóriu 50 km so psom). Registrácia na mieste nie je možná. Minimálny vek účastníka je 18 rokov. Úhrada štartovného musí byť vykonaná prevodom do 7 dní od registrácie. Trasa obsahuje náročné orientačné úseky, kde je potrebné dávať pozor na značenie. Účastníci musia mať kompletnú povinnú výbavu a odovzdať podpísaný informovaný súhlas pri prezentácii. Ultramaratón, 50 km, horský terén, registrácia vyžadovaná, súčasť Slovak Ultra Trail League, kategórie s a bez psa, registrácia zahŕňa povinné vybavenie

name: Beh oslobodenia Lietavskej Lúčky
location: Lietavská Lúčka pri dome kultúry, Lietavská Lúčka, Žilina, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Lietavská Lúčka v spolupráci s Bežeckou ligou Žilina
description: Beh oslobodenia Lietavskej Lúčky je bežecké podujatie organizované bežeckými nadšencami a obcou Lietavská Lúčka. Pretek sa koná pri dome kultúry v Lietavskej Lúčke a ponúka trať s asfaltovým a družstevným povrchom. Štart je naplánovaný na 9:30 hod. pre 10 km trať a o 9:40 hod. pre deti. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, čo umožňuje širokú účasť bežcov rôznych vekových skupín.
course_highlights: Trať vedie po asfalte a družstevných cestách
Štart pri dome kultúry v Lietavskej Lúčke
Dostupné kategórie podľa veku a pohlavia
additional: Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, s absolútnym poradím pre mužov a ženy. Organizátorom je Miroslav Ščibran, kontakt: 0903 611 060. Preteky sa konajú 9. mája 2026, štart hlavného behu o 9:30 a detského o 9:40, povrch: asfalt a družstevné cesty, kategórie pre mužov a ženy rôznych vekových skupín, možnosť registrácie online aj na mieste.

name: Vertical Chopok
description: Vertical Chopok je bežecké vertikálne podujatie, ktoré sa uskutoční 9. mája 2026 v Nízkych Tatrách, na trase zo Srdiečka na Chopok Juh. Pretekárov čaká náročný beh s prevýšením takmer 950 metrov na dĺžke 6,4 km. Podujatie je súčasťou kalendára Slovenskej skyrunningovej asociácie a zároveň nominačným pretekmi v kategórii vertikal. Trať vedie prevažne po ceste na Kosodrevinu a cez Zadné Dereše, čo umožňuje pretekárom podať maximálne výkony. Memoriál Vlada Plulíka, po ktorom je podujatie pomenované, má dlhoročnú tradíciu a pripomína významnú osobnosť slovenského športu.
course_highlights: Prevýšenie takmer 950 metrov na 6,4 km trati
Trasa vedie zo Srdiečka cez Krupovú až na Chopok Juh
Trať vedie po ceste na Kosodrevinu a cez Zadné Dereše
additional: Podujatie je zaradené do kalendára Slovenskej skyrunningovej asociácie pre rok 2026 a slúži ako nominačné podujatie v kategórii vertikal. Trať bola od roku 2025 predĺžená a upravená, aby umožnila lepšie výkony bez zápchy na úvodnej časti. GPX súradnice trasy sú k dispozícii v prílohe. Registrácia otvorená od 20. decembra 2025, pretek je súčasťou Slovenského pohára v behu do vrchu 2019, preteká sa v horskom teréne, možnosť nominácie na ME, MS do 23 rokov a MS masters.

name: Podhájska Trail
description: Podhájska Trail je komunitné bežecké podujatie v areáli termálneho kúpaliska Podhájska, ktoré spája pohyb v prírode, zdravý životný štýl a miestnu komunitu. Preteky ponúkajú dve hlavné trate - dlhú 18 km s prevýšením 353 m a krátku 7 km s prevýšením 143 m, ako aj detské behy rôznych dĺžok podľa veku. Trasa vedie prevažne lesnými cestami a spevnenými cyklocestami, pričom štart a cieľ sú v termálnom kúpalisku. Podujatie má charitatívny rozmer a podporuje miestnu mládež kúpou športových pomôcok.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie hrádzou, lesnými cyklocestami a medzi obcami Podhájska a Veľké Lovce
Povrch trate je 20% spevnené cyklocesty a 80% lesné cesty
Prevýšenie na dlhej trati je +353 m, na krátkej +143 m
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je od 8:30 do 10:30 v areáli termálneho kúpaliska. Štart detských behov je o 9:30, krátka trať štartuje o 10:30 a dlhá trať o 11:00. Pretekári majú zadarmo vstup na parkovisko pred termálnym kúpaliskom. Trasa je značená bielo-červenými stuhami a usmerňovaná organizátormi. Vekové kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku dosiahnutého v roku preteku. Detská kategória 100 m je bez čipového merania času a všetky deti sú ocenené. Trať vedie hrádzou, lesnými cyklocestami a medzi obcami, s povrchom 20 % spevnené cyklocesty a 80 % lesné cesty. Preteky majú charitatívny rozmer a limit účastníkov je 400 pre hlavné behy. Súčasťou sú aj detské kategórie.

name: Squarebizz Ultra maratón na 6 hodinovka a M-SR v behu na 50 km
location: Areál Squarebizz Business Center Bory, Bratislava - Devínska Nová Ves, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Squarebizz Ultra maratón na 6 hodinovka a M-SR v behu na 50 km je náročný bežecký pretek konaný v areáli Squarebizz Business Center Bory v Bratislave - Devínska Nová Ves. Pretek ponúka dve hlavné disciplíny: beh na 50 km a beh na 6 hodín, pričom súťažia muži aj ženy v rôznych vekových kategóriách. Podujatie je zároveň Majstrovstvami Slovenska v behu na 50 km, čo zvyšuje jeho prestíž a atraktivitu pre vytrvalostných bežcov. Organizátorom je Michal Šuľa, ktorý poskytuje aj kontaktné informácie pre záujemcov o účasť. Štartovné je rozdelené podľa disciplíny a termínu prihlásenia, s postupným zdražovaním až do začiatku mája 2026.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 50 km v areáli Squarebizz Business Center Bory
Možnosť súťažiť v behu na 6 hodín alebo na 50 km
Majstrovstvá Slovenska v behu na 50 km s kategóriami podľa veku a pohlavia
additional: Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane absolútnych porádí. Miesto konania je v areáli Squarebizz Business Center Bory v Bratislave - Devínska Nová Ves. Organizátor poskytuje telefonický kontakt +421 944 013 358. Pretek sa koná na certifikovanom okruhu v Devínskej Novej Vsi, s možnosťou online registrácie, občerstvenia počas pretekov, zabezpečenými šatňami a toaletami, a vyhodnotením najlepších v kategóriách. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj medaily, diplomy a vecné ceny pre víťazov.

name: Krupanská desiatka
location: OŠK Dolná Krupá, Dolná Krupá, Slovakia
organizer: Bežecký klub Dolná Krupá a Obecný úrad Dolná Krupá
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste; zľavy pre obyvateľov Dolnej Krupé a deti zadarmo
description: Krupanská desiatka je tradičný bežecký závod organizovaný Bežeckým klubom Dolná Krupá, ktorý sa koná v areáli OŠK Dolná Krupá. Trať má dĺžku 10 km s prevýšením 107 metrov, pričom 85 % trate vedie po asfalte a 15 % po lesnej ceste. Okrem hlavného 10 km behu sú súčasťou podujatia aj kratšie behy a nordic walking na 5 km. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru športového podujatia v prírode.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 10 km s prevýšením 107 m
85 % asfaltová a 15 % lesná cesta
Štart a cieľ v areáli OŠK Dolná Krupá
additional: Prezentácia a registrácia bežcov prebieha v deň preteku od 09:00 do 11:30 hod. Štart detských behov je od 10:00 hod. Štart 10 km behu je o 12:00, 5 km beh o 12:05 a nordic walking o 12:10. Maximálny počet účastníkov na jednotlivých tratiach je 250. Podujatie organizuje Občianske združenie Horný Chríb. Pretek sa koná 9. mája 2026, registrácia je možná do 7. mája 2024, štart je naplánovaný na približne 12:00 hod. na futbalovom ihrisku v areáli OŠK Dolná Krupá.

name: BTK Run Fest
organizer: Občianske združenie Bežecko Triatlonový klub Veľký Biel
description: BTK RUN FEST 2026 je bežecké podujatie pre všetkých, ktoré sa uskutoční 9. mája v areáli kaštieľa vo Veľkom Bieli. Ponúka rôzne disciplíny vrátane 5 km a 10 km cestných behov, detských behov, štafety rodič + dieťa a adrenalínového prekážkového behu pre deti aj dospelých. Trasy vedú prevažne po asfaltových a spevnených plochách okolo jazera s malebným okolím. Podujatie je vhodné pre rekreačných bežcov, rodiny aj skúsených športovcov, pričom sú pripravené ocenenia a medaily pre najlepších i finišerov.
course_highlights: 85% asfalt a 15% spevnené plochy
Rovinatá trasa okolo jazera so štartom a cieľom v kaštieli
Dve okruhy pre 10 km beh preveria kondíciu bežcov
additional: Detské behy majú trasy 350m, 600m a 1000m. Štafeta rodič + dieťa je na 2x 350m. Prekážkový beh je určený pre deti aj dospelých s dĺžkou 1 km. Štartovné zahŕňa štartové číslo, občerstvenie, fotografie a ocenenia. Na mieste je možná registrácia, ak nie je naplnený limit účastníkov. Časy štartov sú rozdelené podľa disciplín od 09:00 do 13:10 s vyhlasovaním výsledkov medzi behmi. Podujatie sa koná na povrchu s 85% asfaltu a 15% spevnených plôch; registrácia je otvorená s rôznymi termínmi a poplatkami; preteky zahŕňajú rôzne vzdialenosti a kategórie pre dospelých aj deti.

name: Fiľakovský cross
description: Fiľakovský cross je bežecké podujatie organizované OZ FTC Fiľakovo a Komisiou pre šport a telesnú výchovu pri MZ vo Fiľakove. Preteky sa konajú na štadióne FTC vo Fiľakove a ponúkajú rôzne kategórie vrátane detských, hobby a nordic walking. Povrch trate tvorí kombinácia poľných ciest, asfaltu a trávy, čo robí beh zaujímavým a rôznorodým. Štart pre deti je o 10:00 hodine a pre dospelých o 12:30 hodine. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú športovú atmosféru.
course_highlights: Povrch trate: poľné cesty, asfalt, tráva
Miesto štartu a cieľa: štadión FTC vo Fiľakove
Rôzne kategórie vrátane detských, hobby a nordic walking
additional: Štart detí o 10:00 hod., dospelí o 12:30 hod. Kategórie zahŕňajú detské, hobby a nordic walking. Organizátorom je OZ FTC Fiľakovo a Komisia pre šport a telesnú výchovu pri MZ vo Fiľakove. Kontaktné osoby: Mgr. Attila Visnyai (0915 163 310), Mgr. Gabriel Nagy (0908 948 429). Preteky zahŕňajú rôzne trate s dĺžkami od približne 3 do 14 km, registrácia je možná od 1.4.2024 do 10.5.2024, a podujatie je určené pre všetky vekové kategórie vrátane detí a hobby bežcov.

name: EuroPainClinics Horský beh Bardejov
location: Reštaurácia Kúpeľná dvorana, Bardejovské Kúpele, Bardejov, Slovakia
organizer: EPC Pro Health Team a BarRan Team

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Online registrácia a úhrada štartovného do 27. 04. 2026 s garanciou všetkých benefitov

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Úhrada štartovného do 05. 05. 2026 bez garancie niektorých benefitov (napr. tričko)

description: EuroPainClinics Horský beh Bardejov je horský beh, ktorý sa koná v malebnom prostredí Bardejovských Kúpeľov. Pretekári si môžu vybrať z troch tratí: krosový polmaratón s prevýšením viac ako 1000 metrov, sedemkilometrová kúpeľná trať a sprievodné detské a mládežnícke kategórie. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetkých bežcov, ktorí majú radi náročnejší terén a horské výzvy. Organizátori zabezpečujú občerstvenie na trati, medaily, tričká a ďalšie benefity pre včas registrovaných účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trasa A: Krosový polmaratón 22 km s prevýšením 1000+ m
Občerstvenie na trase A na 8. km pri Zborovskom hrade a na 15. km na Stebníckej Magure (899 m n.m.)
Trasa B: Kúpeľná sedmička 7 km s prevýšením 180+ m
additional: Registrácia na Trasu C (deti a mládež) prebieha na mieste podujatia, počet štartujúcich je obmedzený na 80. Pretekári na Trase A a B majú zabezpečené bezplatné parkovanie v Bardejovských kúpeľoch, číslo pretekára s čipom, tričko, občerstvenie na trati, medailu, trofeje, ceny, obed a nápoj po pretekoch. Čas na Trase C sa nemeria, všetci účastníci dostanú medailu a sladkú odmenu. Trať vedie horským terénom, možnosť registrácie online alebo na mieste, viacero kategórií vrátane detí a mládeže, program na deň pretekov a podrobné pokyny pre účastníkov.

name: Beh pre Labky
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: Beh pre labky 2026 je charitatívny beh organizovaný Úniou vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov UVP, ktorý sa uskutoční v Košiciach, v lokalite Kavečany pri chate Hrešná. Tento 10. ročník podujatia ponúka bežcom možnosť podporiť dobrú vec a zároveň si užiť príjemný beh v prírode. Trať má dĺžku 5 km a je vhodná pre všetky vekové kategórie vrátane detí a bežcov so psami. Podujatie je otvorené širokej verejnosti a ponúka rôzne kategórie podľa veku a typu účastníka.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie v prírodnom prostredí Kavečian pri chate Hrešná
Dĺžka trate je 5 km s jedným okruhom
Možnosť bežať so psom alebo s psom z útulku
additional: Podujatie je charitatívneho charakteru, organizované Úniou vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov UVP. Kategórie zahŕňajú muži, ženy, chlapci a dievčatá do 15 rokov, ako aj kategórie s psom a psom z útulku. Registrácia prebieha cez web pretekaj.sk s možnosťou vytvorenia účtu pre správu prihlášok. Podujatie je určené na podporu ľudí a psov v núdzi, registrácia je možná online, a výsledky sú dostupné na stránke organizátora.

name: DOBRObeh
organizer: KERIC Čadca, Centrum voľného času Čadca, Terminovka.sk, Červený kríž, Detské oddelenie KNsP Čadca, Mesto Čadca
description: DOBRObeh je charitatívny beh v Čadci, ktorý ponúka päť rôznych tratí vrátane hlavného behu Márie Marcibálovej s dĺžkou 21,5 km a prevýšením 600 m. Trať vedie prevažne lesom, asfaltom a lúkami, pričom je jasne vyznačená a zabezpečená usporiadateľmi. Podujatie je určené pre všetkých bežcov, ktorí chcú podporiť dobrú vec, pričom víťazom je každý, kto si zabehne. Štart je na Palárikovej ulici pri fontáne Rybka v pešej zóne v Čadci. Okrem hlavného behu sú k dispozícii aj kratšie trate vrátane 10 km, 4,5 km a detských behov.
course_highlights: Beh Márie Marcibálovej: 21,5 km s prevýšením +600 m, 70% les, 10% asfalt, 20% lúka
KERICross 10 km: 65% asfalt, 25% lúka, 10% šotolina, prevýšenie +180 m
Beh mestom 4,5 km: 90% asfalt, 10% les, prevýšenie +42 m
additional: Povinná výbava: vlastný pohár na pitie, trailové topánky, mobil s číslom na organizátora, hodinky alebo mobil s trasou, skladacie bežecké alebo turistické paličky. Občerstvovačky na 3,8 km a 13,8 km. Trať je jasne vyznačená šípkami a fáborkami, usporiadatelia navigujú bežcov na nejednoznačných miestach. Vyhodnotenie je o 12:30 hod. Charitatívny beh bez vyhodnotenia víťazov, kde je víťazom každý, kto podporí DOBRO. Charitatívny beh s možnosťou prispieť potravinami alebo finančne, rôzne trate vrátane 21,5 km behu, podujatie podporuje pomoc ľuďom v núdzi.

name: Běh Mánesovou stezkou
organizer: TJ Sigma Lutín a TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc
description: The Mánes Trail Run is an endurance cross-country and trail race held in Lutín, in the Olomouc Region. The moderately undulating course runs mainly along local roads and forest and field paths. The race offers two distances: 23 km for men and 16.5 km for women and men over 60. It is organized by TJ Sigma Lutín and TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, with the aim of offering runners interesting and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly along local roads and forest and field paths
Moderately undulating terrain suited to cross-country and trail running
Two distances: 23 km and 16.5 km
additional: The race is organized by TJ Sigma Lutín and TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc. The start is at the Sigma Lutín stadium. The race is open to men, women, and men over 60, with different course distances. It is part of the Czech Running Club. The race is suitable for runners looking for a moderately challenging course with varied terrain; registration and further information are available on the official website.

name: Vltava Run 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Základní startovné 29.700 Kč / 1.215 € včetně DPH pro jeden tým. Předregistrace do 30. 9. 2025.

description: Vltava Run is a relay race more than 375 km long, running from Šumava to Prague. The route passes through Šumava National Park, along the Vltava River, through forests, past reservoirs, and through beautiful valleys, hills, and historic towns and villages in the South Bohemian and Central Bohemian Regions. The race is for teams of 6 to 12 runners, regardless of gender, and offers a unique experience of running the most beautiful route to the finish. It starts at the Zadov–Churáňov cross-country skiing stadium at dawn and finishes in Prague in the afternoon.
course_highlights: A 375 km route from Šumava to Prague
Route along hiking trails and second- and third-class roads
Passes through Šumava National Park, by Vltava reservoirs, and through historic towns
additional: The race is a relay with designated changeover points. Teams may have 6 to 12 runners, regardless of gender. A runner’s estimated 10 km time in the past year must not exceed 60 minutes. Runners must be at least 18 years old, or 15 with written parental consent and a parent on the same team. Registration includes required information and questions about the race rules, which must be answered correctly for registration to be successful. The race is divided into several checkpoints and is run by teams of 6–12 runners. It offers a unique experience of running in nature, with the opportunity to discover the beauty of the South Bohemian and Central Bohemian regions.

name: Kros Merklín-Plešivec
location: Sjezdovka v Merklíně, Merklín, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: Kros Merklín-Plešivec is a 6.5 km uphill race that follows forest trails and, at the start, a ski slope in the Ore Mountains. The race is part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners’ League and offers runners challenging terrain and beautiful natural scenery. It is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: 6.5 km course with elevation gain in the Ore Mountains
Forest trails and an opening section on a ski slope
Part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners’ League
additional: The course features mountain terrain; registration details are not specified. The race is suitable for runners seeking an outdoor challenge.

name: Memoriál Jana Janovského
description: The Jan Janovský Memorial is a traditional sporting event organized by TJ Sokol Blatná. It takes place in Blatná, in the area below the Sokolovna and in the castle park. The races are primarily intended for children and young people, with categories ranging from the youngest children to adults, and take place on asphalt and forest paths. The first race starts at 9:00. In-person registration is available no later than 15 minutes before the start of the relevant category. The event is supported by the South Bohemian Region and offers facilities including toilets, changing rooms, and baggage storage.
course_highlights: Course surface: asphalt and forest path
Start and finish in the area below the Sokolovna and in the castle park
Categories for children aged 3 and up, as well as adults
additional: In-person registration is available no later than 15 minutes before the start of the relevant category. Toilets, changing rooms, baggage storage, and washrooms are available. The event is supported by South Bohemian Region grant programs focused on sports activities for children and young people. The event is part of a local sporting tradition; in-person registration is available before the race, and the event is supported by regional grants.

name: Novojičínský půlmaratón
location: Náměstí v Novém Jičíně, Nový Jičín, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400,- Kč v rámci on-line registrace do 31.3.2026 i jeden člen štafety

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 500,- Kč v rámci on-line registrace od 1.4.2026 do 30.4. 2026 i jeden člen štafety

description: The Novojičín Half Marathon is an open race with a maximum capacity of 400 runners aged 18 and over. It takes place on 9 May 2026 in Nový Jičín. The route follows a scenic landscape along the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path from Nový Jičín through Hodslavice, Mořkov and Hostašovice and back, predominantly on asphalt. The race also offers a 2 × 10.5 km relay and is suitable for runners looking for a quality half-marathon experience, with refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and finish are on Masaryk Square in Nový Jičín; the race starts at 9:00.
course_highlights: The route follows the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path
95% asphalt, 5% paving
Refreshment stations at kilometres 6.5, 11 and 17, and at the finish
additional: Race packs are distributed on race day from 07:00 to 08:30. A changing room is available at the start venue for storing belongings. Two pacers are available on the course, targeting times of 2:00 and 1:45. Medical services are provided at the start, at the refreshment stations and at the finish. The race takes place in all weather conditions and has a maximum time limit of 2:45. The course passes through Nový Jičín, Hodslavice, Mořkov and Hostašovice; the race takes place in all weather conditions, with refreshments along the course and after the race, and a medal for participants. Registration is open until 30 April 2026.

name: Přísnotický kros
description: Přísnotický kros is a traditional running race held in Přísnotice in the South Moravian Region. It is part of the Zajíc League as the series’ second race. The event offers a wide range of categories for men, women, youth and children of all ages, with distances ranging from 110 metres for the youngest runners to 7,500 metres for adult men. Race numbers are issued from 8:30 a.m. The race is also open to the youngest children, who do not score points in the league and can register on site. Přísnotický kros is suitable for all runners who want to test themselves in pleasant surroundings with well-organised event support.
course_highlights: Distances range from 110 m for the youngest runners to 7,500 m for adult men
Categories for all age groups, including veterans
Part of the Zajíc League; the second race in the series
additional: Registration and race-number collection are available from 8:30 a.m., no later than 30 minutes before each category’s start. The youngest children, as well as adult and youth categories, can also register on site up to 30 minutes after their category’s start. The race takes place in Přísnotice. Registration costs 50 CZK. The course is mostly through woodland, with pleasant natural surroundings and minimal elevation gain.

name: Závadská desítka
location: Přírodní rezervace Dařanec u Závady, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: od 01.04.2026 do 12.04.2026 - 1. vlna registrace: 250,- Kč, (startovní číslo se jménem v ceně)

description: Závadská Desítka is a 10 km cross-country race along forest trails around the Dařanec Nature Reserve. This highly appealing race has become a traditional part of the Prajzsko-opavská Running League (POBL), where it is considered the most appealing short-distance race. Safety along the course is provided by race staff, and a refreshment station is located at the 6 km mark. The race is divided into several men’s, women’s and youth categories, including categories for local residents and people born in Závada, who compete for a perpetual trophy.
course_highlights: Cross-country race along forest trails in the Dařanec Nature Reserve
Refreshment station at the 6 km mark
Safety provided by race staff
additional: The race is part of the Prajzsko-opavská Running League (POBL). In addition to the main 10 km race, there are children’s races of 100 m, 500 m and 1,000 m, as well as 4 km and 10 km walks. A race bib bearing the runner’s name is included in the first registration wave price. Course: 90% forest trails, 10% asphalt; registration waves, refreshments, race pack; race categories by age and gender.

name: 50 mil železnohorských
location: Náměstí míru, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The 50 Miles of the Iron Mountains is an ultramarathon held in the beautiful Iron Mountains near Heřmanův Městec. The course passes historic fortresses, castles, hillforts, and oppida, offering a unique opportunity to explore the region up close. The race is open to both individuals and relay teams and is part of the Vládce Mrdic series. The event takes place on May 9, 2026, and welcomes all running enthusiasts looking for a challenge and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: The course passes historic fortresses, castles, and oppida in the Iron Mountains
The race can be run individually or as a relay
Part of the Vládce Mrdic series, with beautiful trail sections
additional: The race offers a course approximately 81 km long, with cycling and scootering available as secondary categories. Advance registration is recommended.

name: Barvám neutečeš – Olomouc
description: Barvám Neutečeš in Olomouc is a colorful run full of joy, friendship and fun, taking place on May 9, 2026, at Výstaviště Flora. It offers two routes: 5 km with five color zones and 1.5 km with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. The event is not about speed, but about sharing an experience, music and fun for all ages, families and individuals. The race pack includes a T-shirt, colors, a medal and other items to enhance the colorful experience.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 color zones
1.5 km route with 3 color zones and an interactive sports zone
Color zones shower runners with color from head to toe
additional: Online registration closes on May 7, 2026, at 20:00. After that, registration is available only on site, subject to capacity. The race pack includes a T-shirt, a sackpack, Holi color powder, a sheet of limited-edition temporary tattoos, a bubble blower, a race number and a medal. The event is suitable for individuals and teams (a team consists of 4 or more people). Various registration packages are available, including options for teams, and the event is also suitable for children. The event also has a charitable component and an interactive sports zone.

name: Vrchlabí - Strážné
description: Vrchlabí - Strážné is a traditional off-road hill running race that leads from Vrchlabí to Strážné over three hills and two descents. The varied course offers challenging climbs, technical descents and fast flat sections, making it ideal for hill-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Hradec Králové Region Championships. The start is by the Střelnice Cultural Centre in Vrchlabí, and the finish is in the car park in Strážné. The race is held in memory of Jan “Pída” Herbes, the race’s spiritual founder.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly off-road along forest and meadow paths
A challenging climb up Jankův kopec and a technical descent past Jankův háj
The final section features an almost 1.5 km fast straight and a finishing sprint on asphalt
additional: Transport for runners from the finish back to the start is not provided; using the yellow hiking trail is recommended. Refreshments are available at the finish. Cross-country or trail shoes are recommended. The race is part of the Hradec Králové Region Championships, and the finish offers refreshments and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Na dvě rozhledny s Nadačním fondem Bernard
price_range: 300 Kč za jednotlivce, 500 Kč za rodinu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné činí 500 Kč za rodinu (rodiče a děti do 15 let)

description: The Na dvě rozhledny charity run with the Bernard Endowment Fund is a sporting and social event organized by the Bernard Family Brewery in Humpolec. The race has staggered starts and passes through two checkpoints: the Bernard Lookout Tower and the lookout tower at Orlík Castle. The route follows both paved and unpaved paths, and runners can choose their own strategy and navigation. After the race, refreshments, including beer, are available at the finish, and medals are provided for the first 100 registered participants. The event is intended for people over 15; younger participants must have the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The route passes two lookout towers: Bernard and Orlík Castle.
Runners must pass through two checkpoints and have them marked on their race card.
The route combines paved and unpaved paths, with free navigation.
additional: Starts are staggered at 30-second intervals for runners and 5-minute intervals for groups of 15 walkers. Water is available for runners at Orlík Castle. Each participant is entitled to refreshments at the finish, including alcoholic or non-alcoholic beer. Medals are provided for the first 100 registered participants. Runners must have both checkpoints marked on their race card. The time limit is 2 hours from the start. Participants under 15 may take part only when accompanied by a legal guardian or with the guardian’s written consent. The route is approximately 5 km long. The start is scheduled for 12:30, and the race lasts up to 2 hours. Start intervals are 30 seconds and 5 minutes. The event supports the Bernard Endowment Fund.

name: FREEDOM RUN
description: FREEDOM RUN is a cross-border mountain race in the Krkonoše Mountains, offering two route options. The shorter 9 km Classic route runs from Harrachov through Nový Svět and the Mýtiny area to Orle in Poland, finishing in Jakuszyce, a well-known sports centre. The longer 16 km Mega route is more technically and physically demanding, with greater elevation gain and beautiful mountain scenery, making it ideal for more experienced runners. Both routes start in Harrachov and pass through picturesque mountain landscapes and forest trails, with open mountain plains in the Krkonoše.
course_highlights: Cross-border route from the Czech Republic to Poland
Beautiful mountain scenery and forest trails in the Krkonoše Mountains
Finish straight at the Jakuszyce sports centre
additional: The entry fee includes a race number and timing chip. The race includes mountain terrain, forest trails and cross-border sections; registration is required, and safety rules and race regulations apply.

name: Charitativní běh pro Emmičku
location: Kramolna u hasičské zbrojnice, Kramolna, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Charity Run for Emmička takes place on Saturday, May 9, 2026, in Kramolna by the fire station. The event offers two routes—3 km and 7 km—as well as a 200 m children’s route. The routes follow surfaced forest paths, suitable for sports strollers and wheelchairs. Dogs are welcome but must be kept on a leash or in a harness throughout the event. Participants can run or walk the course at their own pace.
course_highlights: The routes follow surfaced forest paths
Suitable for sports strollers and wheelchairs
Dogs are welcome but must be kept on a leash or in a harness
additional: The routes are also suitable for sports strollers and wheelchairs. Dogs are welcome but must be kept on a leash or in a harness. The course can be completed by running or walking. The event traditionally takes place by the fire station in Kramolna. Dogs are welcome, and participants can run or walk. Registration: sport-reg.cz. Date: May 9, 2026.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Myślenice 2026
description: Garmin Ultra Race Myślenice is a mountain trail race taking place on 9 May 2026 in the picturesque Beskid Wyspowy mountains, near Kraków. The routes run along forest trails with numerous steep climbs and breathtaking views, offering challenges for runners of varying experience levels. Myślenice combines natural beauty, history and modern infrastructure, making the race an attractive event for fans of active recreation. The Garmin Ultra Race series promotes running in harmony with nature, fair play and support for the running community.
course_highlights: Forest trails in the Beskid Wyspowy mountains, with natural climbs
Views of the Tatras from selected points along the route
A range of distances from 13 km to 78 km, with up to 2,300 m of elevation gain
additional: Race packs can be collected at the race office on 8–9 May. Starts are in waves according to distance, with the longest distance, 78 km, starting at 05:00. The time limit for completing the 78 km distance is 15 hours. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. Runner cards can be downloaded 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Award ceremonies take place after each distance has finished. Distances from 6 km to 101 km; time limits from 1 hour to 17.5 hours; different race-pack options; the option to take part in several distances as part of the Challenge; mountain terrain; medical support; marked routes; refreshment stations; GPS tracker (78 km only).

name: Bieg Herosa
description: Bieg Herosa is a unique running event held in Klucze near Olkusz, offering a range of distances and race formats on challenging sandy terrain. The most extreme event is Nomada 9h, where runners take on desert sand and their own limits for 9 hours, relying on strategy and endurance. Shorter options are also available, including Nomada 3h, dynamic 5- and 7-kilometre loops, children’s races, and special races with dogs that highlight cooperation and trust between the handler and their four-legged companion. It’s an event for those seeking a sporting challenge and a connection with nature in a unique desert setting.
course_highlights: Sandy, desert terrain that demands good technique and endurance
Long-distance competition lasting up to 9 hours in extreme conditions
Special courses for dog-running races and children’s races over distances from 200 to 1,000 metres

There are also children’s races, all set against beautiful views of the surrounding mountains and countryside. The race headquarters are at the ski lodge in Jedličná, between Polevsko and Kytlice, and the race is part of the Českolipsko District Running League.
course_highlights: Undulating, hilly terrain in the Lusatian Mountains
The route follows winter ski trails, forest paths and pastures
Beautiful views of Klíč, Ještěd, Jedlová, Ralsko, Bohemian and Saxon Switzerland, Bezděz and the Českolipsko region
additional: Registration is available online via nazavody.cz, with the option to enter the 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km or children’s race. The start and finish are at the ski lodge in Jedličná. Parking is available in the adjacent parking area and, if it is full, at the winter car park below Jedličná. Registration and race-number collection must be completed at least half an hour before the start; otherwise, participants will not be allowed to start. 5 km or 10 km course, children’s races, online and on-site registration, parking at the ski lodge in Jedličná.

name: Lesní běh Kalichem
location: Koberovy, Liberec District, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kalich Forest Run is a traditional sporting event organized by TJ Sokol Koberovy in the beautiful countryside of the Bohemian Paradise, specifically in the area known as Kalich. The race is open to all age groups, from preschoolers to seniors over 60, who enjoy running in nature. The start is divided into age categories, ensuring fair competition among runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, the active participation of Sokol members, and excellent refreshments after the race. Every year, it attracts several dozen to several hundred runners.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful countryside of the Bohemian Paradise in the Kalich area
Age categories ranging from preschoolers to seniors
Active participation by Sokol members, who help build the course and manage timing
additional: Refreshments after the race include roasted chicken thighs, sausages, and draft beer. The event is supported by the Liberec Region and is one of the longest-running events in the area. Results and photos from previous editions are available on Facebook and the website. The run takes place in the countryside of the Bohemian Paradise, starts are divided by age, refreshments include chicken thighs, sausages, and beer, and the event has a long-standing tradition.

price_range: od 120 zł do 250 zł, mieszkańcy gminy 50 zł
description: The 5th Jedlina-Zdrój Mountain Festival is a mountain running event taking place on 10 May 2026 in Jedlina-Zdrój. Participants can choose from three distances: 10 km, 23.5 km and 50 km. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace. The route runs through the scenic Wałbrzych Mountains, including Borowa Mountain, which has a newly built observation tower, and features challenging climbs and varied terrain. The event is a great opportunity to enjoy an active break and discover the charms of the region.
course_highlights: The route passes over Borowa Mountain, with its new observation tower
Varied terrain: gravel roads, asphalt roads, forest trails and mountain paths
Distances of 10 km, 23.5 km and an ultra 50 km, with refreshment and timing checkpoints
additional: The total participant limit is 600. Festival T-shirts can be ordered until 19.04.2026 for 90 zł; they are made from high-quality Attiq technical fabric. The 50 km ultra route has 7 refreshment stations and 5 timing checkpoints. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4. The organizer reserves the right to modify the route up to one week before the start. The mountain route is demanding and features varied terrain. There is a limit of 600 participants, online registration, possible date changes in the event of sanitary restrictions, accommodation options and festival T-shirts for participants.

description: The 13th PKO Białystok Half Marathon is the largest race in eastern Poland. It has been held since 2013 and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown. Runners cover the half-marathon distance of 21.097 km in the picturesque city of Białystok. The event also includes the PKO Night Run over 5 km, which can be a great warm-up for the half marathon, as well as children’s races. It is a true celebration of running, attracting participants from across Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.097 km half-marathon course in central Białystok
Start zones based on predicted finish time, from elite runners to recreational runners
Side events: the 5 km Night Run, Junior Run, and Breakfast Run
additional: Start zones by predicted finish time: AA (elite), A (<1:35), B (1:35–1:44:59), C (1:45–1:49:59), D (1:50–1:54:59), E (1:55–1:59:59), F (2:00–2:09:59), G (>2:10). Race office hours: May 8, 17:00–21:00; May 9, 10:00–20:00; May 10, 7:00–9:00. Side events: Breakfast Run (approx. 4 km, free, starts May 9 at 9:00), PKO Junior Run for children aged 2–14. A weekend package combining the half marathon and the 5 km Night Run is available. Urban course; information about registration, medals, and promotional clothing; 3-hour time limit; course changes may be made for safety reasons.

It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during a spring race.

Routes with visual appeal and a natural character
Organised with passion and experience since 2014

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start at the same time around the world, running from the Catcher Car. There is no traditional finish line—participants run until they are caught by the car. All entry fees go towards research into treatments for spinal cord injuries, making this not only a sporting challenge but also a charity event. You can take part locally or via the app, which lets you run from anywhere in the world.
course_highlights: Simultaneous start around the world
No traditional finish line—the Catcher Car pursues participants
A race for runners, wheelchair users and first-timers
additional: Participants can join the race locally or via the Wings for Life World Run app, which tracks time and distance. 100% of entry fees support spinal cord research. Marketing tools and promotional materials are available for organisers of local app runs. Taking part supports research into treatments for severed spinal cords; the event also includes merchandise sales and the option to join remotely, with all proceeds going to scientific research.

The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and brings together the local community and running enthusiasts. The half-marathon course winds through the scenic streets of Pszczew, offering participants a unique sporting experience.

Scenic streets and surroundings of Pszczew
Accompanying races for children and young people

description: Charytatywna Dycha is a sports and charity running festival held in Miechów in support of the Caritas Hospice. The event brings the local community together to support hospice patients by raising funds for essential medical equipment. The race takes place around the park, and participants, donors, and organizers create an atmosphere of empathy and solidarity. This unique initiative not only promotes physical activity but also raises public awareness of hospice care.
course_highlights: The race takes place around the park in Miechów
The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting the hospice
Strong support from the local community and organizations
additional: The event is a sports and charity festival, with local schools and organizations actively taking part. The funds raised go toward purchasing specialist medical equipment for hospice patients. The organizers emphasize the event’s social significance and its role in raising awareness about hospice care. The race and charity activities raise funds for medical equipment for the hospice.

The start and finish are at Sławik and Antall Square, and the route passes notable Katowice landmarks such as Spodek, MCK, NOSPR, the Silesian Museum and the Silesian Insurgents’ Monument. The race promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants will receive commemorative medals and can enter a prize draw.

Participant limit: 100 people

description: The 9th Bieg Pilicy is a small-scale running event held in the charming town of Białobrzegi on the Pilica River. The start and finish are located in the central, revitalized Zygmunt Stary Square, and the route follows the town’s main streets. The event combines sport, passion, and a family-friendly atmosphere, with distances suited to different levels of experience: a 10 km main race, a 3 km recreational run, and a 3 km Nordic walking event. Color runs for children and young people are organized for different age groups. Every participant can look forward to a hot meal, drinks, and a voucher for local ice cream.

Color runs for children and young people, with distances suited to their age
additional: Participants receive a hot meal, drinks, and a voucher for famous Białobrzegi ice cream. Trophies and gifts are planned for the top finishers, and sweet surprises for the youngest participants. Color runs are free for residents of the municipality. Main 10 km route, Nordic walking, medals and prizes, hot meal and ice cream for participants.

name: XV Działoszyńska Dziesiątka
description: The 15th Działoszyńska Dziesiątka is a road race held in Działoszyn on May 10, 2026. The event is organized by Stowarzyszenie Atelier Sportu, which specializes in professional timing and the organization of running events. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00. The event attracts runners who value well-organized races with electronic timing.
course_highlights: A 10 km race in the picturesque surroundings of Działoszyn
Professional organization and online registration
The 15th anniversary edition of the event
additional: Electronic timing uses RFID chips and mats at the start and finish lines. Atelier Sportu timing provides online results with a QR code to scan. The organizer offers technical support, rental of race bibs and returnable chips, and an electronic LED clock at the finish. Online registration closes on May 7, 2026. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00. Participants can contact the organizers by email or phone with any questions.

name: XXIX Górski Bieg Magurki
description: The 29th National Magurka Mountain Run is an annual running event organized since 1997 by the “Groniczek” People’s Student Sports Club in Bielsko-Biała. The mass-participation race promotes mountain running and an active lifestyle. The 8.8 km course, with 509 m of elevation gain, starts in the Straconka district and leads to the summit of Magurka, passing through the scenic area of Mała Straconka and forest trails. The event attracts leading Polish mountain runners as well as competitors from abroad, and the course is professionally secured and clearly marked.
course_highlights: An 8.8 km course with 509 m of elevation gain
An alpine-style race, entirely uphill with no downhill sections
Scenic trails through Mała Straconka and forest tracks leading to the summit of Magurka
additional: The race starts in Bielsko-Biała, in the Straconka district, on Pikowa Street (opposite Karczma w Straconce). The course is very clearly marked and secured by race officials, technical and medical staff, and the police. The event takes place regardless of the weather. Competitors’ insurance is the responsibility of the sports clubs they represent. The race has 12 age categories, from primary school pupils to veterans. Mountain terrain, online registration, timekeeping, medals. Entry requirements include a medical examination or parental consent.

name: Pusztafutás 1 / 5 / 11
description: Pusztafutás is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race held every year since 2016 in Solt Szőlőhegy. It offers several distances for runners of all ages, on a varied and exciting route that takes in hilly, interesting terrain rather than the familiar flat plains. Finishers receive a unique, interlocking finisher’s medal, and several facilities are available on site, including parking, a buffet and a playhouse. The race aims to provide an enjoyable experience for all ages and to offer runners a full event experience.
course_highlights: Varied, exciting terrain on the western edge of the Kiskunság
A marked 580-metre route with minimal elevation change
Start area at Szőlőhegy, next to Krammer Winery
additional: The race will be held only if at least 100 valid entries are received by the end of the first registration period. Entries are accepted from a maximum of 400 runners, including no more than 100 preschool and lower-primary-school-age children. Accompanying parents may not physically assist their child while running and do not need to register separately. The race offers unique, interlocking finisher’s medals, but runners can also register at a lower price without a medal. Parking, toilets, a playhouse, a first-aid point and a buffet are available on site. The race will not be held in 2026 because the number of entries did not reach the minimum set by the organizers.

description: The Garmin WTF BRZSNY is a unique trail-running race around Szokolya and Királyrét, taking place on May 10, 2026. It offers challenges over several distances, from 8 km up to the 42 km trail marathon, with varied elevation gain and beautiful woodland scenery. One special feature of the race is that road and trail runners start together, so everyone can complete the distance on their preferred terrain. The entry fee includes a race bib, timing, aid stations, baggage storage, changing facilities and medical services, as well as chimney cake at the finish and a choice of medals. The race prioritizes sustainability and a sense of community, where every achievement matters.
course_highlights: Trail distances of 8, 13, 23, 33 and 42 km, with varied elevation gain (from 230 m to 2,000 m)
A 10 km road race with 220 m of elevation gain
Beautiful woodland scenery around Szokolya and Királyrét
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib, timing, aid stations, free event photos, a route guide, baggage storage, changing facilities, medical services, a route permit and insurance. Runners can enjoy chimney cake at the finish and choose from six medals if they register in time. From 21 days after registration, entries can only be transferred and cannot be cancelled. Entries that include a T-shirt are not available after April 25. Participants receive medals, certificates, photos and insurance; a race bib and refreshments are also provided.

Runners can choose from the 1 km Smile Run and distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km. All participants start together in a mass start. The event aims to promote a love of sport and create a community gathering where people of all ages can find a distance that suits them. Race numbers must be collected in advance; there is no on-site registration. Timing is chip-based, using a chip attached to the back of the race number.
course_highlights: The start and finish are at the same location, in the area in front of the City Sports Hall.
The Smile Run follows a marked 1 km course. The other distances run on paved roads, with traffic marshals assisting participants on busier sections.
Participants are asked to be especially alert on the course and to obey traffic rules.
additional: Race number collection is available on Saturday from 17:00 to 20:00 and on Sunday from 07:30 to 09:30. There is no on-site registration. Timing is provided by a chip attached to the back of the race number; it must not be removed or damaged. Race numbers are different colors for each event, making them easy to distinguish. Chip checking will be available on the morning of the race. The race is a mass start, with participants setting off together regardless of age or gender. Participants can enter several distances, with registration taking place online. Race day is May 10, 2026, and registration is open from 07:30 to 09:30. The course runs on city streets and designated running tracks, with chip timing. The family running day and the different award categories add to the event's appeal.

name: Fertőrákos félmaraton 6 / 16 / 21
location: Kőfejtő - Barlangszínház, Fertőrákos, Győr-Moson-Sopron County, Hungary
description: The Fertőrákos Half Marathon is a special scenic run above Lake Fertő, starting and finishing at the Quarry – Cave Theatre. The varied, gently undulating course takes runners through some of the area’s most beautiful spots. The longer distance reaches as far as Balf, with views of scenic Lake Fertő and its reed beds accompanying runners along the way. This race is not only a challenge but also an enjoyable running experience, with new views and inspiration at every kilometre. The event also operates as a green race, highlighting the importance of environmental protection.
course_highlights: Start and finish area at the Quarry – Cave Theatre
A varied, gently undulating course through some of the area’s most beautiful spots
Panoramic views of scenic Lake Fertő and its reed beds on the longer distance
additional: The race operates as a green race, highlighting the importance of environmental protection. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in the overall individual standings in each distance. Prizes are presented only at the awards ceremony; collection or postage at a later date is not available. The race is part of a points-collection system in which runners can earn points for every kilometre they run and redeem them for discounts at the end of the season. Race categories, course description, information about the environmentally friendly race, detailed rules and registration information are available on the website.

The race takes place on a 10.5 km loop course that runners complete multiple times. The route passes through central Szeged, allowing runners to enjoy the city’s landmarks. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races and a charity walk.

Start and finish at Dóm Square
The course passes the city’s landmarks
additional: The event offers several distances: marathon (42.195 km), 31.5 km, half marathon (21.1 km), 10.5 km, 3 km, as well as children’s races and a charity walk. description: The EU Half Marathon is a free running race requiring registration, taking place on May 10, 2026, at Szabadság tér in Budapest. Participants can run 21.1 kilometres individually or as part of a 2–3-person relay. The race is part of Budapest’s Europe Day festival. Runners follow a three-lap course passing iconic Budapest landmarks, and everyone who finishes receives a unique commemorative medal. The event is organised by the Representation of the European Commission in Hungary and the European Parliament Liaison Office in Hungary, with Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Kft. as professional partner.
course_highlights: The distance consists of three laps and can be completed individually or as part of a relay.
The route passes through central Budapest, including Szabadság tér, Nádor utca, Széchenyi rakpart and Margaret Bridge.
Refreshment stations along the course and chip-based net timekeeping.
additional: Race bibs, T-shirts and relay batons can be collected from May 5–8, between 11:00 and 19:00, at the Europa Experience Centre (1052 Budapest, Szervita tér 8.), and on May 10, between 7:00 and 8:30, at Szabadság tér. The relay zone is located between Nádor utca, Zoltán utca and Steindl Imre utca. The race uses chip timing; the final member of each relay team must hand in the baton at the finish. Participation is free but requires registration, and places are limited (2,000 individual runners and 700 relay teams). There will be no full road closures; traffic will be managed by the police and civil guard. Participants must register to take part. Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected from May 5–8 at Europa Experience, or at Szabadság tér on race day. The detailed course route, refreshment stations and start/finish locations can be found on the official website.
