additional: Check-in from 17:00 at the blue tent by the turning circle near the Lipiny reservoir. The entry fee includes an isotonic drink and light refreshments after the race and along the course, as well as luggage storage in the organizers’ tent. Awards for the top runners in the 40− and 40+ categories. You can withdraw up to 24 hours before the start and have your entry fee credited toward another race. Good public transport access, parking at the start, and cycle route A21 from the Vltava. The race takes place on May 20, 2026. Registration is available online and on site. The event includes medals, refreshments, and race results.

name: Jarní sen
description: Jarní sen is a running race taking place on May 21, 2026, in Prague-Hostivař. The race is part of the sporting calendar and welcomes all running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the spring atmosphere and nature around Prague. The organizer, SABZO, offers this race as an opportunity for runners of all levels to test themselves and enjoy a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Set in the natural surroundings of Prague-Hostivař
Opportunity to take part in races of different distances
A friendly atmosphere and sporting experiences for runners of all levels
additional: The race is scheduled for May 21, 2026; further details about the courses and registration are not explicitly provided.

name: Jarní běh projektantů Od hospody k hospodě
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Designers’ Run, From Pub to Pub, is a traditional running event held in the pleasant surroundings of Krčský Forest in Prague 4. The 93rd edition will take place on May 21, 2026, and welcomes all running enthusiasts and designers to take part in this popular race. Organizers Pepa Krejčí and Honza Vočko look forward to a large turnout and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A traditional running route in Krčský Forest
Pleasant woodland surroundings
A popular route from pub to pub
additional: Race-day registration is available approximately one hour before the start. The event takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Krčský Forest and is suitable for all ages and running abilities. The run is organized as a friendly competition with an emphasis on community spirit.

name: Běh Holednou
location: Hřiště Tatran, Kohoutovice, Brno, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: Běh Holednou is a running race held in Brno, Kohoutovice, at the Tatran sports ground. The race features a 5.5 km loop, which men and women run together in a single category. A separate race is organized for children, with the loop distance announced before the start. The event is part of the Brno Running Series and is suitable for all age groups. Refreshments and baggage storage are available after the race.
course_highlights: A 5.5 km loop in the pleasant surroundings of Kohoutovice
Men and women start together
Children’s race with the loop distance announced before the start
additional: On-site registration opens at 17:15. The children’s race starts at 17:45 and the main race at 18:00. Water and a baggage-storage tent are available after the finish. Parking is limited. Public transport: trolleybus 37 to the “Voříškova” stop. The course runs through a city park. Registration takes place at the venue. The race is open to all age groups, with the start and finish at the Tatran sports ground in Kohoutovice.

name: Stonařovské aleje

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kè - mui , junioøi, eny, juniorky pøihláené on-line.

description: Stonařov Alleys is a traditional running race dating back to 1978, held in the picturesque surroundings of Stonařov in the Vysočina Region. The main race follows farm and forest roads alongside a stream and along Zelená Alley to a hunting lodge. The course has a gentler elevation profile and is mostly soft underfoot. Races are offered for all age groups, from preschoolers to veterans, with a focus on a family-friendly atmosphere and an enjoyable sporting experience for every runner. Each participant receives a commemorative prize and a diploma; category winners receive prizes, and the overall winner receives the Běžec Stonařova travelling trophy.
course_highlights: The 10 km main course follows farm and forest roads and includes 30% asphalt.
The route runs alongside a stream and along Zelená Alley to a hunting lodge.
A gently undulating profile with mostly soft terrain.
additional: Start at the football pitch; categories for ages 3 and up; youth participants run for free; mass starts for categories A, B, C, D and P. Each participant receives a diploma and a small package. The top three in each category receive prizes. A travelling trophy is awarded to the best man and woman in the main race. A scenic course featuring historical and natural landmarks, with multiple categories including youth and children. The race is part of the Vysočina Running Cup.

name: Ultra-Trail® Malopolska
location: Gorce and Beskid mountains, Małopolska, Poland
description: Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is a festival of challenging mountain races held in the Małopolska region, in the Gorce and Beskid Mountains. The event offers a range of distances from 16 to 240 km, following scenic and demanding mountain trails. It is organized by the 4 Alternatywy Foundation and attracts runners who value a challenge and the beauty of mountain nature. Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is an excellent opportunity to test your abilities on courses of varying difficulty and experience the unique atmosphere of ultra running.
course_highlights: Routes through the Gorce and Beskid Mountains
Distances from 16 km to 240 km, including highly demanding ultramarathons
Scenic and technical mountain trails
additional: The organizer is the 4 Alternatywy Foundation, based in Kraków. Other running events are also held as part of the festival, including Szczebel CUP and Winter Trail Małopolska. A Ultra-Trail® Małopolska training camp is available, led by professional instructors and camp coordinator Paweł Derlatka. The organizer and camp coordinator can be contacted at fundacja@utm.run and by phone. Registration information, route details, and event updates are available on the organizer’s website. The event also includes the winter edition, Winter Trail Małopolska, in December 2025.

name: Memoriál Františka Daniša – cezpoľný beh
description: Memoriál Františka Daniša - cezpoľný beh je bežecké podujatie konané v obci Trstín, okr. Trnava, na futbalovom ihrisku. Trať vedie prevažne po poľnej a trávnatej ceste s čiastočným úsekom asfaltového chodníka. Súťažia rôzne vekové kategórie mužov, žien, juniorov a trstínčanov, pričom niektoré kategórie bežia dva okruhy. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov, ktorí majú radi prírodné povrchy a cezpoľný beh v príjemnom prostredí obce Trstín.
course_highlights: Trať je z 3/4 poľná a trávnatá cesta
1/4 trate tvorí asfaltový chodník
Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku v Trstíne
additional: Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, niektoré kategórie bežia dva okruhy, trstínčania majú vlastnú kategóriu. Miestne kontakty: Obec Trstín, tel. 033/558 92 62, e-mail outrstin@slovanet.sk, starosta Peter Hlávek, tel. 0918 775 109, e-mail starosta@trstin.sk. Podujatie zahŕňa viacero kategórií a je súčasťou jarného behu zdravia, pričom je možné sa prihlásiť aj na mieste. Registrácia je dostupná prostredníctvom kontaktu na organizátorov.

name: Turčiansky beh
description: Turčiansky beh je charitatívny bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná 23. mája 2026 na futbalovom štadióne v Belej - Duliciach. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi trasou 5 km alebo 10 km, ktoré vedú mierne členitým terénom po poľnej ceste a šotoline s prevýšením 40 až 80 metrov. Podujatie podporuje dobrú vec, keďže všetky vyzbierané financie poputujú na liečbu 4-ročného chlapca s autizmom a na projekt „deti môjho srdca“. Pre účastníkov sú pripravené darčeky, tombolové lístky, pamiatkové medaily a animácie pre deti, pričom rodičia môžu behať a o deti je postarané. Na mieste je zabezpečené občerstvenie a parkovanie pri štarte a cieli.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie po poľnej ceste a šotoline
Prevýšenie 40 až 80 metrov, mierne členitá
Štart a cieľ na futbalovom štadióne Belá Dulice
additional: Registrácia prebieha v deň preteku od 8:00 do 11:00. Pred štartom dostane každý účastník pitný režim, fit tyčinku a darček od partnerov. Vstupné zahŕňa jeden tombolový lístok s možnosťou dokúpenia ďalších. Po dobehnutí dostane každý pamiatkovú medailu. Pre deti sú pripravené animácie s profesionálnymi animátormi a atrakcie. Parkovanie je zabezpečené pri areáli štartu/cieľa. Na mieste je možnosť zakúpenia občerstvenia a pitného režimu. Pre virtuálnych bežcov sa po skončení podujatia zasiela darček a medaila na adresu. Terén je poľná cesta a asfalt, parkovanie je zabezpečené pri štarte a cieli, k dispozícii sú šatne, sprchy a občerstvenie na mieste. Registrácia je možná online, s možnosťou virtuálnej účasti.

name: Night Run Trenčín
location: Klub Lúč, Mierové námestie, Trenčín, Slovakia
price_range: 12 € až 35 € v závislosti od registrácie a kategórie
description: Nočný beh Night Run Trenčín je bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa koná 23. mája 2026 v Trenčíne, v klube Lúč a pri priaznivom počasí na Mierovom námestí. Bežci majú možnosť prekonať samých seba v príjemnej atmosfére večerného mesta. Registrácia je možná online do 21. mája 2026 alebo na mieste v deň pretekov, ak nebude naplnený limit účastníkov. Organizátor zabezpečuje elektronickú časomieru a občerstvenie na trati. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov od 12 rokov, pričom mladší účastníci potrebujú súhlas zákonného zástupcu.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ v klube Lúč alebo na Mierovom námestí pri priaznivom počasí
Elektronická časomiera na štarte, cieli a na 4 km
Možnosť využiť mestské parkovanie pri Trenčianskej bráne
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je od 17:00 do 20:40 v klube Lúč, pri priaznivom počasí na Mierovom námestí. Muži a ženy nad 60 rokov neplatia štartovné, ale musia byť zaregistrovaní online. Minimálny vek účastníka je 12 rokov, mladší ako 15 rokov musia mať súhlas zákonného zástupcu. Organizátor nepreberá zodpovednosť za škody na majetku alebo zdraví. Elektronická časomiera je zabezpečená firmou SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk, výsledky budú priebežne zverejňované na stránke vysledkovyservis.sk. Nočný beh, registrácia online a na mieste, štart od 17:00 do 20:40, možnosť využiť mestské priestory, zdravotné údaje na štartovnom čísle

name: Dynasport beh na Vtáčnik
description: Dynasport beh na Vtáčnik je náročný horský beh v okolí Kameneca pod Vtáčnikom, ktorý ponúka tri trate s rôznou dĺžkou a prevýšením. Pretekári si môžu vybrať z 50 km trate s 2000 m prevýšenia, 27 km trate s 1000 m prevýšenia alebo 8,4 km trate s 380 m prevýšenia. Každá trať má svoj časový limit a kategórie pre ženy a mužov do a nad 40 rokov. Pretek sa štartuje na farme pod Vtáčnikom a je zabezpečené občerstvenie na viacerých miestach trasy. Organizátor kladie dôraz na povinnú výbavu a bezpečnosť bežcov.
course_highlights: 50 km trať s prevýšením +2000 m a časovým limitom 10 hodín
27 km trať s prevýšením +1000 m a časovým limitom 5 hodín
8,4 km trať s prevýšením +380 m a časovým limitom 2 hodiny
additional: Na trati 50 km sú tri občerstvovačky na 9 km, 27 km a 44 km. Povinná výbava zahŕňa doklady totožnosti, nabitý mobilný telefón, mapu alebo GPX súbor, vlastný skladací pohár alebo fľašu s objemom minimálne 1,5 dl, balík prvej pomoci (izotermická fólia, elastický obväz) a minimálne 0,5 l vody. Štartovné číslo musí byť viditeľne umiestnené na prednej časti tela počas celého preteku. Odporúčaná výbava zahŕňa nepremokavú bundu v prípade dažďa. Traťové dĺžky: 50 km, 27 km, 8 km; prevýšenia: +2000 m, +1000 m, +380 m; povinná výbava, občerstvovačky na tratiach, časové limity 10, 5 a 2 hodiny.

name: Petržalská 10
price_range: 20 € (online pred 1. aprílom 2026), 25 € (po, do uzávierky registrácie); deti 6-8 €
description: Petržalská 10 je obľúbený bežecký pretek v Bratislave, ktorý sa koná na Námestí Republiky v Petržalke. Pretek ponúka rôzne kategórie vrátane detského behu, hlavného behu na 10 km, nordic walking a rodinného behu so psom. Štart detských behov je o 10:00 a hlavného behu o 11:30. Organizátorom je Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, ktorá zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trať vedie v Bratislave-Petržalke, štart a cieľ na Námestí Republiky
Hlavný beh na 10 km s kategóriami pre mužov, ženy a nordic walking
Rodinný beh so psom na 1,8 km a detský beh na 5 km
additional: Deti do 5 rokov a deti z centier pre deti a rodiny (CDR) majú štart bezplatný. Kategórie zahŕňajú mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách, nordic walking na 5 km a rodinný beh so psom na 1,8 km. Viacero kategórií vrátane 5 km, rodinného behu a Nordic walking; štarty o 10:00 a 11:30; online registrácia; miesto konania na Námestí Republiky v Petržalke

name: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety
description: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety je bežecký štafetový maratón, ktorý sa koná 23. mája 2026 na trase medzi mestami Salgótarján v Maďarsku a Lučenec na Slovensku. Trať má dĺžku 42,2 km a je rozdelená na štyri úseky, ktoré bežia štyria pretekári v štafete. Preteky sú určené pre mužské, ženské a zmiešané štafety s minimálnym pomerom 50 % žien a 50 % mužov. Na trati sú zabezpečené občerstvovacie stanice a v cieli čaká guláš, športové poháre a finančné odmeny pre najlepšie štafety. Pretekári štartujú o 10:00 a registrácia je možná do 21. mája 2026 online alebo na mieste, ak sú voľné miesta.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez Salgótarján, Šiatorská, Rátka, Rapovce a Lučenec
Štafeta má 4 úseky: 11 km, 10 km, 10,7 km a 10,5 km
Občerstvenie na každom bode odovzdávania štafiet a guláš v cieli
additional: Registrácia je platná po zaplatení štartovného. Kapacita je limitovaná na 20 štafiet. Štafetu tvoria 4 pretekári, odovzdávanie štafiet je možné len na určených bodoch. Limit na celú trať je 4 hodiny. Prísny zákaz doprovodu na trati (auto, bicykel, kolobežka) z dôvodu bezpečnosti. Štart je možný pretekárom od 15 rokov. Beží sa za plnej cestnej premávky po ľavej strane. Pretek je určený pre účastníkov od 15 rokov, s dôrazom na bezpečnosť a dodržiavanie pravidiel. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj sprievodné kultúrne akcie a online registrácia.

name: Hlbocký boyard – extrémny beh s prekážkami
description: Hlbocký Boyard je extrémny beh jednotlivcov, ktorý sa uskutoční 23. mája 2026 v obci Hlboké nad Váhom. Tento 6. ročník ponúka jeden okruh trate s množstvom adrenalínových prekážok a prudkými kopcami na moto-crossovej trati. Súťažiť sa bude v deviatich kategóriách podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane detských kategórií. Pretekári si užijú čerstvý vzduch, výzvy na trati a po behu ocenenie, občerstvenie a pamätné predmety.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 9 - 10 km s množstvom nových prekážok oproti predchádzajúcim ročníkom
Prudké kopce a adrenalínové prekážky na moto-crossovej trati
Pitná voda na štarte a počas trate, občerstvenie a guláš po behu
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je od 07:45 hod. v areáli pri futbalovom ihrisku. Štart je postupný, prvý štart detského boyardu a následne štarty po 4-5 pretekároch každých 5 minút. Štartovné zahŕňa medailu, pamätný predmet, lístok na guláš a nápoj, sladkosť, vodu a občerstvenie na trati. Po behu sú k dispozícii sprchy s teplou vodou vo futbalových kabinách. Diváci majú bezplatný vstup na celú trasu. Parkovanie je bezplatné. Pretek sa koná za akéhokoľvek počasia, registrácia je možná predplatením, súčasťou sú medaily a občerstvenie, prebieha od marca do mája 2025

name: Jacovská dvadsiatka
description: Jacovská dvadsiatka je bežecký pretek organizovaný v Jacovciach na futbalovom štadióne. Pretek ponúka dve trate - hlavnú 22 km a hobby beh na 8 km, ktoré vedú po asfaltových a poľných cestách so šotolinou. Štart je naplánovaný na 10:00 pre 22 km a 10:15 pre 8 km. Pretek je vhodný pre rôzne vekové kategórie a pohlavia, pričom organizátorom je ATK Javorina Jacovce. Štartovné je dostupné za prijateľné ceny, čo robí podujatie prístupným pre širokú bežeckú komunitu.
course_highlights: 50 % asfaltové cesty a 50 % poľné cesty so šotolinou
Dve trate: 22 km a 8 km
Štart na futbalovom štadióne v Jacovciach
additional: Kategórie pre 22 km sú rozdelené podľa veku: do 39 rokov, od 40 do 49 rokov, od 50 rokov; pre 8 km sú kategórie muži a ženy. Štart je rozdelený na dve vlny: 10:00 pre 22 km a 10:15 pre 8 km. 50% asfalt a 50% poľné cesty, možnosť registrácie cez email, predaj alebo výmena štartových čísel, pretek sa koná 23. mája 2026

name: Kostolanský májovec
description: Kostolanský májovec je bežecké podujatie organizované run ForRest run o.z., ktoré sa koná na futbalovom štadióne Michala Podolana vo Veľkých Kostoľanoch. Pretekári si môžu vybrať medzi dvoma traťami s dĺžkou 10,90 km a 5,40 km, obe s prevýšením 64 metrov a povrchom kombinujúcim asfalt a lúku. Štart je naplánovaný na 11:00 hod. a súťažiaci sú rozdelení do vekových kategórií s ocenením najrýchlejších Kostolanec a Kostolanka. Podujatie ponúka občerstvovačku a je vhodné pre bežcov hľadajúcich príjemný beh s miernym prevýšením v peknom prostredí.
course_highlights: Trať 10,90 km s prevýšením +64 m
Trať 5,40 km s prevýšením +64 m
Povrch 50% asfalt a 50% lúka
additional: Vyhodnotenie pretekov je o 12:45 hod. Pre zaradenie do kategórií je rozhodujúci rok narodenia. Pre najrýchlejších Kostolancov/Kostolanky je potrebné pri registrácii uviesť obec Veľké Kostoľany. Počet občerstvovačiek na trati: 1. Preteká sa podľa pravidiel cestnej premávky. Účastníci sú zodpovední za vlastné zdravotné poistenie. Trať je prevažne rovinatá, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, podujatie zahŕňa kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a je vhodné pre rekreačných aj výkonnostných bežcov.

name: Sninský trailový polmaratón
description: Sninský trailový polmaratón je bežecká udalosť v Snine, Slovensko, ktorá ponúka dve trate - hlavnú 21 km trať a kratšiu 7,5 km trať. Pretek je určený pre všetkých milovníkov trailového behu, ktorí si chcú užiť krásy prírody a výzvy terénu. Organizátori vítajú bežcov všetkých úrovní a ponúkajú kvalitnú atmosféru športového podujatia.
course_highlights: Trailový beh v prírodnom prostredí Sniny
Dve možnosti trate: 21 km a 7,5 km
Výzva pre všetky úrovne bežcov
additional: Pretek je vhodný pre všetky úrovne bežcov, s možnosťou registrácie online alebo na mieste, a zahŕňa rôzne kategórie vrátane detí a mládeže.

name: Beh Soviou Poľanou
description: Beh Soviou Poľanou v Podolínci je lesný bežecký pretek, ktorý ponúka kvalitný tréning a možnosť preveriť si svoje schopnosti v horskom teréne. Pretek je vhodný pre bežcov, ktorí chcú zažiť strhujúci deň v prírode a pripraviť sa na dôležité preteky v sezóne. Trasa vedie malebnými lesmi okolo Podolínca a poskytuje výzvu aj pre skúsených bežcov.
course_highlights: Lesné trate v okolí Podolínca
Horský terén s prírodnými prekážkami
Malebné výhľady v oblasti Poľany
additional: Sú k dispozícii detské behy a viacero tratí vrátane 11 km a 18 km varianty. K dispozícii sú mapy, plagáty a propozície na stiahnutie. Registrácia prebieha online cez oficiálnu stránku. Pretek je súčasťou série pretekov s možnosťou online registrácie a rôznymi kategóriami, vrátane detského behu. Podujatie je zamerané na podporu trailového behu v prírode a ponúka atraktívne ceny pre najlepších v kategóriách.

name: Mravenčárska míľa
description: Mravenčárska míľa je bežecké podujatie konané na futbalovom štadióne v Plaveckom Štvrtku. Preteky ponúkajú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny mužov a žien, ako aj pre deti, žiactvo, dorast, juniorské kategórie, Nordic walking a canicross. Štart pre žiactvo je o 10:10 a pre hlavnú kategóriu o 12:00. Organizátorom je Obecný úrad Plavecký Štvrtok, ktorý zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom štadióne v Plaveckom Štvrtku
Viacero vekových a špeciálnych kategórií vrátane Nordic walking a canicross
Štart hlavných kategórií o 12:00, žiactvo štartuje o 10:10
additional: Kategórie zahŕňajú mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách, deti, žiactvo, dorast, juniorské kategórie, Nordic walking a canicross. Organizátormi sú Milan Zajíček a Soňa Zajíčková s kontaktnými telefónmi 0907 467 595 a 0908 423 975. Preteky ponúkajú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny, vrátane detí, Nordic walking a canicross; štarty sú naplánované na 10:10 a 12:00; miesto konania je futbalový štadión v Plaveckom Štvrtku

name: Niže Linča
organizer: Dobrovoľníci z obce Zeleneč, Obecný úrad Zeleneč, Vinársky spolok vinárov a vinohradníkov Zeleneč, DHZ Zeleneč, Zdravotnícka služba Zeleneč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 15 € do 15.05.2026 ( online registrácia bude spustená od 13.4. 2026 )

description: Niže Linča je bežecké podujatie v Zeleneči, ktoré organizujú dobrovoľníci z obce spolu s miestnymi spolkami a zdravotníckou službou. Pretek je určený pre mužov, ženy a juniorov do 18 rokov, pričom súťaží sa aj o najrýchlejšieho linčana a linčanku. Štartovné zahŕňa vstup na degustáciu vína počas SvätoUrbanských slávností, čo podujatiu dodáva jedinečnú atmosféru a spája šport s kultúrou. Online registrácia bude spustená od 13. apríla 2026 a pretek sa uskutoční 23. mája 2026.
course_highlights: Pretek v Zeleneči, Vinohrady Zeleneč
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a juniorov do 18 rokov
Vstup na degustáciu vína v cene štartovného
additional: Štartovné zahŕňa vstup na degustáciu vína počas SvätoUrbanských slávností v hodnote 5 €. Registrácia online od 13. apríla 2026, miesto konania: Zeleneč, okr. rnava, čas štartu: 18:30, miesto: Jednotka

name: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón
description: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón je bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa koná v krásnej prírode Fatranskej oblasti, v lokalite Tomčany pri Martine. Pretekári si môžu vychutnať beh po lúkach, kopcoch a predmestí Fatry s nádhernými výhľadmi na Lúčanskú, Krivánsku a Veľkú Fatru. Trasa je offroadového charakteru, s prírodnými prekážkami ako blato či spadnuté stromy, čo pridáva na atraktivite a výzve pre bežcov. Podujatie je určené pre rôzne skupiny bežcov, ktorí si môžu vybrať svoj trail podľa schopností a preferencií.
course_highlights: Bežecké preteky fatranskou prírodou, po lúkach a kopcoch
Nádherné výhľady na Lúčanskú, Krivánsku a Veľkú Fatru
Offroad trasa s prírodnými prekážkami ako blato a spadnuté stromy
additional: Povinná výbava: pohárik alebo fľaša minimálne 0.2 l, telefón s číslom na organizátora (0949 465 006). Miesto konania: Tomčany (mestská časť Martin). Podujatie je 1. ročník. Nie sú uvedené konkrétne ceny ani termíny registrácie na stránke. Traťové dĺžky od 4,5 km po maratón, registrácia cez MisoSport.sk, povinná výbava zahŕňa pohárik alebo fľašu a telefón s číslom organizátora, rôzne trasy a aktivity pre deti, štart v 10:00.

name: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu
location: Ul. Pod záhradami, Mestská časť Dúbravka, Bratislava, Slovakia

price_tiers.distance: AZ-pneu vertical 10 km a Dôverun 5 km

description: AZ-Pneu Vertical - Dúbravský beh na Kobylu je bežecké podujatie v Bratislave, ktoré ponúka trate pre deti aj dospelých. Pretek sa koná v mestskej časti Dúbravka s štartom pri ulici Pod záhradami (pri Lidli). Súťažiť môžete na 10 km trati AZ-pneu vertical, 5 km Dôverun alebo v detských behoch. Organizátorom je Beh si ty, o.z. spolu s Mestskou časťou Dúbravka. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka kategórie podľa veku a pohlavia.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ v mestskej časti Dúbravka, Bratislava
Trať AZ-pneu vertical má dĺžku 10 km
Okrem hlavnej trate sú aj detské behy a 5 km Dôverun
additional: Poistenci ZP Dôvera majú zľavu 2 Eurá pri online platbe štartovného. Štart detských behov je o 10:20, hlavný beh AZ-pneu vertical 10 km štartuje o 11:00 a Dôverun 5 km o 11:20. Trať vedie mestskými cestami v Dúbravke, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, podujatie je naplánované na 23. mája 2026.

name: Beh s vlkmi pre život
price_range: od 11 € do 40 € v závislosti od spôsobu registrácie
description: Beh s vlkmi pre život je charitatívny bežecký event organizovaný Nadáciou CHADIM´S CHARITY, ktorý sa koná v malebnom prostredí Čierneho na Trojmedzí Slovenska, Česka a Poľska. Ponúka šesť rôznych tratí vrátane polmaratónu, desiatky, päťkilometrového behu, nordic walkingu a detských behov, pričom trate vedú prevažne po asfaltových a lesných cestách s krásnymi horskými výhľadmi. Pretekári môžu očakávať kvalitnú organizáciu s vyznačenými trasami, občerstvovacími stanicami a sprievodným vozidlom s vodou. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje zdravý životný štýl a charitatívne ciele.
course_highlights: Polmaratón s prevýšením +500 m vedúci po horských hrebeňoch s krásnymi výhľadmi
Trasy prevažne po asfaltových a lesných cestách
Vyznačené trate s fáborkami a dobrovoľníkmi na kľúčových križovatkách
additional: Na trati polmaratónu je časový limit 5 hodín, na 10 km behu 2 hodiny. Pretekári musia mať štartovné čísla umiestnené vpredu a prejsť všetkými kontrolnými bodmi. Na trati je jedna občerstvovacia stanica, pitný režim je zabezpečený na štarte aj v cieli. Počas pretekov bude sprievodné vozidlo rozdávať vodu na dostupných miestach. Povinná výbava zahŕňa osobné doklady a odporúča sa poistenie s náhradou liečebných nákladov vzhľadom na prechod cez územia viacerých štátov. Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne kategórie pre dospelých aj deti, možnosť registrácie na mieste, sprievodný program a občerstvenie, s dôrazom na podporu charitatívnych aktivít.

name: Hutňanská šelma
description: Hutňanská šelma je bežecké podujatie v Novoveskej Hute, ktoré ponúka štart pre deti aj dospelých. Preteky sa konajú v príjemnom prostredí Remeselného šenku za Holubnicou a sú rozdelené do viacerých vekových kategórií s ocenením pre prvé tri miesta. Štart detských kategórií je o 10:00 hodine, pre dospelých a staršie deti o 13:00 hodine. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov rôznych vekových skupín a úrovní.
course_highlights: Preteky v prostredí Novoveskej Huty, Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou
Viaceré vekové kategórie od detí do dospelých
Štart detí o 10:00, dospelých a starších detí o 13:00
additional: Kategórie pretekov zahŕňajú deti do 6 rokov, deti od 7-9 rokov, deti od 10-14 rokov, mládež a dospelých rozdelených podľa veku s ocenením pre prvé tri miesta v každej kategórii. Pretek sa koná v krásnom prostredí Novoveskej Huty, začiatok pre deti je o 10:00 a pre dospelých o 13:00, súčasťou je aj medaila pre účastníkov a rôzne atrakcie počas podujatia.

name: Jistebnický VH maraton
location: TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100-200 Kč (za jednotlivé závody, dle registrace a délky)
description: The Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running race, now being held for the sixteenth year in the picturesque landscape on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. It offers routes ranging from 3.6 km to a marathon, running through nature with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains. The start and finish of all races are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex, which also hosts a varied programme of side events, including a children’s Olympics. The race is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Routes run through nature on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area
Landscape between Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou and Klimkovice
Fantastic views of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: Registration for all races opens at 7:00 and closes 20 minutes before the start of the relevant race. The start and finish are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. There are refreshments on the course; at the finish, one of the course refreshment stations is available, and additional refreshments are offered by the local pub, known for its Marathon Soup. Parking is available near the complex, though using train or bus connections is recommended. Changing rooms and showers are available after the race. Blood and blood plasma donors receive a 50% discount on the entry fee upon proof of their most recent donation. The races take place in a natural setting and offer various route distances, including children’s categories and a side programme. Online registration is available.

name: Vrané – Zvole
location: Vrané nad Vltavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Vrané - Zvole is part of the KOPEC series, which features uphill races in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers a challenge in the form of a demanding climb and is intended for runners who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. The KOPEC series is a long-standing, popular circuit where runners are automatically included in the overall standings without needing to register separately. The races are organised with an emphasis on fair play, safety and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: An uphill race through the terrain of Prague and Central Bohemia
A demanding climb and a hilly course profile
Part of the long-standing KOPEC series, with scoring and league standings
additional: Runners are automatically included in the overall KOPEC series standings by taking part in any race. The series standings are determined by the total points earned for placing in individual races, with a maximum of the 10 best results counted. Runners must follow the rules for starting and conduct on the course, including wearing a race number and not receiving assistance from other people or animals. If health is at risk, the race director may interrupt or end the race.

name: Štramberská desítka
description: Štramberk Ten is a traditional road race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place in the picturesque town of Štramberk and offers a 10 km mixed-terrain course, mostly on roads. The event is open to the general public and is known for its friendly atmosphere and rich history. Participants can expect refreshments at the finish and prizes for the top runners in various categories. The race takes place in traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: 10 km course, mixed terrain with mostly road running
Refreshments at the finish and traditional Štramberk ears
Course records: men 37:26.6, women 47:26.5
additional: Race-day registration is open from 9:15 to 10:40 at the gymnasium of Štramberk Primary School. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Sokol Hall in Štramberk. Prizes are awarded in age and gender categories, including cash bonuses and non-cash prizes. The race is part of the Ing. Petr Bayer Memorial. Registration is from 9:15 to 10:40 at the primary school gymnasium in Štramberk; refreshments are provided at the finish, and changing rooms and showers are available at the Sokol Hall. The race takes place in traffic, and participants run at their own risk.

name: Berounská desítka
price_range: drahší poplatek na místě, přesná cena není uvedena
description: Berounská desítka is a revived running race with a long tradition, taking place on 23 May 2026 in the village of Zdejcina near Beroun. It offers three distances: the 10 km main race for experienced runners, a shorter 4 km route suitable for everyone, and a free 500 m children’s run. The course follows forest trails with 252 metres of elevation gain and reaches its highest point at the Děd lookout tower, 491 m above sea level. Runners can look forward to refreshments during and after the race, as well as a welcoming atmosphere that revives the local running tradition.
course_highlights: Paved and unpaved forest trails
Highest point at the Děd lookout tower (491 m above sea level)
252 metres of total elevation gain
additional: Race-number collection is open from 8:00 to 10:00 on race day. Runners in the 10 km race can get refreshments at approximately 6 km, and fruit and water after finishing. The 500 m children’s race starts at 10:15; the 4 km and 10 km races start together at 11:00. Payment on site is possible, but costs more. The race takes place in all weather; suitable footwear for wet terrain is recommended. Parking is available on Hudlická Road; runners are advised not to try to park directly in the village. Course with 252 m of elevation gain; refreshments before the start, at 6 km and after finishing; parking on Hudlická Road; weather may vary; race takes place in all weather.

name: Orelský běh lesoparkem Skalky, memoriál prof. P. Leopolda Benáčka
location: Olešnice v Jihomoravském kraji, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Orel Run through Skalky Forest Park is a traditional sporting event organized by Orel, a Christian sports organization, in Olešnice in the South Moravian Region. The Prof. P. Leopold Benáček Memorial gives runners the opportunity to compete in the beautiful natural setting of Skalky Forest Park. The event is part of Orel’s broader program, which supports sport for all in the spirit of fair play and a healthy lifestyle. The race is suitable for the general public and contributes to the development of sporting activities in the region.
course_highlights: Skalky Forest Park, with natural running trails
Beautiful natural surroundings near Olešnice
A traditional memorial race dedicated to Prof. P. Leopold Benáček
additional: The race is part of the OBL 2026 race schedule, offers rules and results, and takes place in May 2026

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov
location: Letkov u Plzně, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov is a traditional outdoor running race near Plzeň, offering scenic courses of varying lengths and difficulty. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Letkov and is part of the celebrations marking the municipality’s 750th anniversary. The route passes Jandova skála and Čilina, and also includes a marathon with climbs to Maršál and Radyně. A multigenerational relay is available for children and families, encouraging active movement across all generations.
course_highlights: 8.5 km course via Jandova skála
21 km course via Čilina
Marathon with climbs to Maršál and Radyně
additional: The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup. Children’s races and the multigenerational children-and-parents relay “Běžíme pro Totem” are also available. The race is one of the events celebrating Letkov’s 750th anniversary. The event offers various course distances, including 8.5 km, 21 km and a marathon, as well as family relays and children’s categories. Registration opens at the end of 2025, and the races take place in a natural setting, with refreshments and medals for participants.

name: Libouchecký UltraMaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 850 Kč. Členové ČAU mají slevu 100 Kč na startovném.

description: Tisá Ultra Trail is a new event that continues the tradition of the Libouchec Ultramarathon. It offers several routes of varying lengths and difficulty in the beautiful surroundings of Tisá and the surrounding area. The races run mostly off asphalt roads, along forest and field roads and trails, with clear course markings. The race facilities are well equipped, with showers, changing rooms and refreshments, as well as the option to stay overnight in your own tent or car. The organizers emphasize safety and environmental responsibility, for example by limiting the use of plastic cups at aid stations.
course_highlights: The routes run mostly off asphalt roads, along forest and field roads and trails
Aid stations are placed every 15–20 km and offer a varied selection of food and drinks
Race facilities include changing rooms, showers, toilets and the option to stay overnight in your own tent or car
additional: The start and finish are behind the football pitch in Tisá. Facilities include changing rooms, toilets, showers, seating and refreshments in a covered tent. You can stay overnight in your own tent or car. Parking is available at the Burg grounds. Mandatory equipment for the 100 km race includes a race timing chip and a fully charged mobile phone. Aid stations offer water, cola, sports drinks, fruit, bread, cheese, biscuits, muesli bars and salt. Soup and a main meal are served at the finish; bringing your own dishes and cutlery is recommended. The 10 km race starts at 12:00, and the 100 km race at 5:00. Registration and drop-bag handover take place the day before the race. Course options range from 25 km to 100 km, with children’s races, facilities at the football pitch and in the Libouchec hall, the option of a tent campsite, ceramic medals and participant T-shirts.

name: Běhej lesy Brdy
location: Obecnice, CHKO Brdy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč při koupi 8 závodů v rámci jedné objednávky
description: Běhej lesy Brdy is a trail running event held in the Brdy Protected Landscape Area, near Prague and Příbram. The event offers various routes, including short and long distances that are part of the international UTMB Index Races. Runners can enjoy beautiful nature, technical sections and competitions for valuable prizes. The finish straight has been extended to 500 metres, adding an interesting twist for all participants. The Běhej lesy series is known for its community atmosphere and respect for nature.
course_highlights: UTMB Index Races with international ranking points
Conti Speed Section — a 150-metre speed section marked with Continental flags
Generali Investments Finish — an extended 500 m finish straight with a timed section
additional: In Brdy, runners compete on the Nova 12 km and ČSOB 22 km routes. The prize for the Conti Speed Section is a tyre voucher and a running shirt. The fastest man and woman across all routes will each receive a Craft technical running shirt and the title GENERALI INVESTMENTS FINISHER #1. The event features various distances from 4 to 22 km, children’s races, an accompanying programme and options for families to take part. It takes place in the natural surroundings of the Brdy Protected Landscape Area, with an emphasis on ecology and community spirit.

name: Běh pro hospic Litoměřice
price_range: startovné je darem na podporu hospice
description: The Run for Litoměřice Hospice is a charity sporting event held to support St. Stephen’s Hospice in Litoměřice. Participants run to help those nearing the end of their life and contribute to funding and supporting hospice care. The event takes place in a beautiful setting and includes professional timekeeping. “Those who run help others” is the race’s main motto.
course_highlights: Charity sporting event supporting the hospice
Beautiful surroundings in Litoměřice
Professional timekeeping
additional: The event is charitable and supports hospice care. The website mentions volunteers and other fundraising activities, but does not provide specific details about start times, waves, capacity, or equipment for runners. The event includes various route distances (0.5 km, 1 km, 3 km, 6 km, 11 km), offers the option of a virtual run, and supports care for the sick.

name: Milada Run
location: Hlavní pláž jezera Milada, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Milada Run is part of the popular Milada Tour sports series, held in the unique landscape of a former lignite mine transformed into the natural Milada Lake. The 10th anniversary edition offers a friendly, family atmosphere, with routes for children and adults. The races follow rolling and flat paths, with beautiful views of the lake and surrounding countryside. The race’s high standards and popularity are confirmed by the participants themselves.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route has two loops, including a rolling path by the water and views from above the lake
The 10 km route follows paved, flat paths and is suitable for all runners
Children’s races of 500 m and 1 km take place near the main beach, with parental supervision
additional: Race capacity is limited to 500 participants. All runners receive a medal. A race number bearing the runner’s name is provided to those who pay by 16 May 2026. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt is available to order during registration, and a free children’s T-shirt is available to the first 100 children to register. The accompanying program includes an Olympia children’s corner and childcare. The event features courses around Milada Lake, children’s races, medals for all participants, and an accompanying program.

name: Brdské rokle
location: Lesní divadlo, Řevnice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Brdské rokle is a trail race held in the picturesque setting of the Forest Theatre in Řevnice, offering three courses of varying lengths and difficulty. All routes run through the forest over varied terrain, including climbs, descents and beautiful views of springtime nature. The race is known for its technical sections and undulating profile, which challenge both runners and experienced trail enthusiasts. You can have your name printed on your race bib, and runners can make use of facilities with refreshments and a kids’ corner for families with children.
course_highlights: Forest routes with 200–360 m of elevation gain, depending on course length
Technical sections featuring rocky and soft forest paths
Beautiful views and spring nature in full bloom
additional: A race bib with your name can be ordered until 17.5.2026. The facilities at the Forest Theatre include toilets, baggage storage and refreshments at the finish (Corny bars, bananas, water and Ionilyte isotonic drink). A kids’ corner with arts and crafts activities and supervision by an experienced teacher is available for children. Travelling by train is recommended due to limited parking in Řevnice. Trail races in nature, technical sections, refreshment stations, 10 km and 15 km routes, starting from the Forest Theatre in Řevnice.

name: NN NIGHT RUN Liberec
location: Vesec, Liberec, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 Km

description: NN NIGHT RUN Liberec is the largest running event in Liberec, held in the Vesec area. Every year, more than 2,000 runners of all ages—from beginners to experienced competitors—take to the start line. The event offers an unforgettable experience with a varied programme of activities, including races of different distances and a charity run against breast cancer. The atmosphere is full of energy, music and fun, making this race a popular sporting event for the general public.
course_highlights: A night run in the Vesec area, with a lively atmosphere and music
Races for all age groups, including children’s races and relay races
The 5 km BELLIS RUN charity race against breast cancer
additional: Time limit of 90 minutes for the main NN Night Run 10 km race. Time limit of 75 minutes for the 5 km BELLIS RUN against breast cancer (manageable at a brisk walking pace). A varied programme of activities, including performances, warm-ups with Honza Kaňůrek (NUTREND), MIZUNO running shoe testing, airbrush tattoos, a raffle and other attractions. Discounts for students with an ISIC card and clients of NN Životní pojišťovna. MIZUNO technical running shirts available to purchase for an additional fee. The event includes various routes, registration online or on site, activities and races focused on families and health.

name: Salomon Valašský Hrb
location: Horský hotel Čarták, Hutisko-Solanec, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Salomon Valašský Hrb is a mountain run suitable for beginners and endurance runners, held in the picturesque surroundings of Horský hotel Čarták in Hutisko-Solanec. The race offers routes of 50 km, 30 km, 20 km, and 10 km, running along a paved ridge road with stunning views. This race is ideal for mountain-running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of nature while taking on a sporting challenge. Come and experience the atmosphere and challenge of mountain terrain in the heart of the Zlín Region.
course_highlights: Run along a paved ridge road
Stunning views along the route
A range of distances from 10 km to 50 km
additional: Race distances, mountain terrain, and registration details not specified

description: VolšoHEC RUN is a traditional charity relay race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Olšovec pond in the South Moravian Region. The race has two relay options: 4 × 5.5 km and 2 × 11 km, covering a total half-marathon distance of 21.1 km. The event supports children in need, with all entry fees and voluntary contributions for the original running shirts going directly to Život dětem, a public benefit organisation. The programme also includes free children’s races and a non-competitive scooter ride. The race is ideal for teams who want to combine sporting achievement with supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: Relay route around the Olšovec pond
Four laps of 5.5 km or two laps of 11 km
Follow the race progress live on a large screen
additional: An original running shirt with a custom name can be purchased for 500 Kč; orders must be placed by 31. 3. 2026. The time limit for completing the full relay is 3 hours. Relay handovers take place in the start and finish area. The non-competitive scooter ride starts at 13:13, with no time limit or timing. The children’s races are free and take place from 13:30 to 14:45, followed by the results announcement. The main race starts at 15:00 and consists of four laps, with a 3-hour time limit. Registration is available via an online form. The event also includes children’s races and a ceremonial awards presentation.

description: Běhám pro děti is a sports and entertainment afternoon that has been held since 2015 to support children and young people from children’s homes. The event features running races and fun sporting activities for all age groups, including a family run and a team relay. The program also includes face painting, a bouncy castle, a magic show, and musical performances. In 2026, the event will take place on May 23 in Na Pankráci Park in Prague 4, under the patronage of the mayor of Prague 4. Everyone who helps is a winner, and every participant is entered into a prize draw.
course_highlights: The Prague 4 Mayor’s Cup 5 km race in Na Pankráci Park
A 1 km family run for 2 to 5 members, with everyone starting and finishing together
A 4 × 1 km team relay, with at least one adult on each team
additional: Registration is available online until May 20, 2026, at a lower price; after that, on-site registration is available at a higher price until 30 minutes before the start. Every registered participant is entered into a prize draw and receives an electronic certificate. Daily steps now count too, not just intentionally tracked activity. The event includes a rich program of musical performances and fun activities for children. It is held under the patronage of the mayor of Prague 4. Registration is available online; the event supports children from children’s homes, offers sponsorship opportunities, and promotes community sports.

name: SeziRun
location: Sezimovo Ústí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč pro hlavní závody, 100 Kč za 4 km s kočárkem, 50 Kč pro děti do 16 let, dobrovolný příspěvek pro děti do 12 let
description: SeziRun is a traditional running race held in Sezimovo Ústí on May 23, 2026. The 10th anniversary edition offers a wide range of races for children and adults, including a half marathon and 12 km, 6 km, and 4 km distances. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels, with winners announced in individual categories. Parking is available near the start and finish, making it easier for participants to get there. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with photos shared and a limited-edition headband available for participants.
course_highlights: A range of distances for adults and children, from 200 m to a half marathon
Start and finish in Sezimovo Ústí, with parking available about 300 meters from the start
The top three finishers are announced in all categories except the walking category
additional: Parking is available in designated car parks in Sezimovo Ústí, ideally as close as possible to or directly on K Hájence Street, about 300 meters from the start. Motor vehicles are not permitted to drive directly to the gamekeeper’s lodge. A limited-edition headband is being prepared for the 2026 anniversary edition. The photo gallery is shared with all SeziRun participants and fans. The race takes place in a natural setting and offers online registration, refreshments, chip timing, and a raffle with prizes. Temporary changing rooms are available on site in a haystack, with no showers or storage facilities.

name: Zaječický bůr
location: Zaječice u Pyšel, Zaječice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Zaječický bůr is a traditional cross-country race with a family-friendly atmosphere, offering courses for all ages, from children to adults. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Zaječice near Pyšely and is part of the Ladův kraj Cup. Prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each category, with prize money for a course record on the longest course. The race is popular for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization, attracting runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Five courses ranging from 55 m to 10,555 m for different age categories
A grand prize for the overall winner of the MAXI zajíci category over 5,555 m
Part of the Ladův kraj Cup, with prize money for a course record over 10,555 m
additional: You can register online until 22 May or in person on race day. Starts are staggered by category from 9:00 to 12:50. Parking is available near the start and is signposted from the entrance to Zaječice. The race counts toward the Ladův kraj Cup and the Central Bohemian Regional Ski Association. The HOLE category is Nordic walking, with technique judged. The race offers medals, prizes, certificates, race packs, refreshments for all participants (a biscuit, juice or tea, and soup), and online registration. The event is suitable for the whole family and also includes activities for children.

name: Krok za Šimonka
location: Skalka, Nový Jičín, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Krok za Šimonka is a sporting event held to support a fundraiser for Šimonka, a boy with the rare metabolic disorder Lesch–Nyhan syndrome. The event offers a fun-filled day of sports for the whole family at Skalka near Nový Jičín. Its aim is not only to support treatment and rehabilitation, but also to raise awareness of the disorder and the strength of the community. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and the chance to support a good cause.
course_highlights: A 13 km run combining paved and trail routes
Supporting children with serious illnesses, especially Šimonka, who has Lesch–Nyhan syndrome
Accompanying activities, a raffle, and a fundraiser to support healthcare
additional: The event is a fun-filled day of sports for the whole family, with refreshments. Support also includes selling T-shirts, with part of the proceeds going toward Šimonka’s treatment. The event takes place at the Skalka amphitheatre; online registration is available, and the proceeds go toward rehabilitation, assistive devices, and medical examinations. The programme includes races for children and adults, activities, and a fundraiser.

name: Běh pro úsměv – Pelhřimovský půlmaraton
location: Pelhřimov náměstí, Pelhřimov, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné při registraci do 30. dubna 2026 (cena není explicitně uvedena)
description: Běh pro úsměv is a sporting event for the whole family, held at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov. This Pelhřimov half marathon is suitable for both sporty and non-sporty families, active seniors, and children from 1 year old. You don’t have to run the race—you can walk it. Half of the entry fees go to the Julinka Endowment Fund, which works to combat childhood obesity. The children’s and parents’ races take place one after the other, and while waiting for their parents, children can enjoy activities such as face painting, a bouncy castle, riding scooters, or learning first aid.
course_highlights: The 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon courses are certified
Children’s races have no placing awards; they are all about fun and smiles
Start and finish at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov
additional: Race bib collection and race-day registration open at 8:30. Bibs must be collected at least 20 minutes before the start. Runners in the 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon are timed using disposable chips attached to their race bibs. Registration by 30 April 2026 includes a medal, a race bib with the runner’s name, and Rajec water. Parents accompanying children run for free. A bag drop is available for runners. The event is hosted by Ondřej Havlík (En.dru) and Petr Cerha (Nasty). The races are suitable for all age groups, including children and seniors, with activities for children and a charitable purpose.

name: Memoriál Ivana Belobrada
description: The Ivan Belobrad Memorial is a traditional running race held in Dlouhoňovice and part of the ISCAREX Cup. The race offers courses of up to 9 km along village roads, forest paths and field tracks, with varied surfaces. It is suitable for the general public, including young people and children, with a flexible start time for the youngest participants. The event takes place in a pleasant sports complex and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: A course of up to 9 km along asphalt roads, forest paths and field tracks
Varied surfaces: asphalt, paved and unpaved terrain
Dlouhoňovice Sports Complex serves as the start and finish venue
additional: Registration is open from 8:00 to 8:30, the first category starts at 9:00, and the main course starts at 11:00. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. A fun run with a flexible start time is available for the youngest children. Registration is available online and on site, with different entry fees. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series and includes various categories; exact course details are not specified.

name: Přibyslavský kros
location: Přibyslav u Nové Paky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Město Přibyslav ve spolupráci s ACO Industries k.s.
description: Přibyslav Cross Country is a cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Přibyslav near Nová Paka in the Hradec Králové Region. The race offers two routes, 8 km and 4 km long, through natural terrain and forest paths. The main category starts at 11:00, making it convenient for both the general public and competitive runners to take part. The event is organized by the Town of Přibyslav in cooperation with ACO Industries k.s. and David Myslivec, who ensure the event is well organized.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail routes
8 km and 4 km routes through natural surroundings
Forest paths and natural terrain
additional: The first category starts at 10:00 and the main category at 11:00. The event is organized by the Town of Přibyslav in cooperation with ACO Industries k.s. and David Myslivec (telephone 728 334 590). The race features cross-country and trail routes, with starts scheduled for 10:00 and 11:00; registration conditions are not specified.

name: Běh do vrchu Poniklá – Rezek
location: Tuláčkova Návsi, Poniklá, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Poniklá–Rezek uphill run is a traditional sporting event held in the village of Poniklá. It starts at Tuláčkova náves and climbs uphill to Rezek. The event is suited to runners who enjoy challenges on natural terrain and want to spend an active day outdoors in beautiful surroundings. The organiser is Petr Holec, who ensures the race runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Start at Tuláčkova náves in Poniklá
Uphill run finishing at Rezek
Natural terrain and scenic views
additional: The race starts at Tuláčkova náves. There are various distances, including 2 km and 9.2 km, and the course features a demanding climb and a final ascent to Rezek. The event is supported by the local community and also offers an evening programme.

name: Gočárův běh
location: Hradec Králové and Pardubice, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: Gočár’s Run is a unique race connecting the two regional capitals of Hradec Králové and Pardubice, following in the footsteps of architect Josef Gočár. Runners take on a 33-kilometre course combining road and natural-surface sections, with Gočár’s buildings as a backdrop, from the schools in Hradec to the iconic Automatic Mills in Pardubice. The race is open to individuals, pairs, four-person relay teams and children, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a cultural and social experience, with a supporting programme and live music. Gočár’s Run is quickly becoming a tradition in the East Bohemian region, attracting hundreds of runners and thousands of fans every year.
course_highlights: 33 km course from Hradec Králové to Pardubice
A mix of road and natural-surface sections
Gočár’s buildings along the route, including the Automatic Mills
additional: The race pack includes original Eleven socks, a medal, a pack of Hradecký Klenot beer, a race bib with logo, an electronic timing chip, refreshments on the course and at the finish, a digital certificate and a supporting programme. Facilities and services include changing rooms, baggage storage with transfer to the finish, medical services, catering, race photos and video, Craft shoe testing and taping at a reduced price. The VIP experience includes a personalised T-shirt, a certificate and a rooftop experience at the Automatic Mills. The supporting programme features live music, children’s activities, various race categories and the chance to share the experience with friends.

name: Bóžovo 59ka
description: Bóžovo 59ka is a traditional race organized by the Jasan Ski Club in Aš, Karlovy Vary Region. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, and offers a sporting experience in beautiful surroundings, with club members and the public welcome to take part. Jasan is known for its long tradition and active approach to training and racing in the region.
course_highlights: The course includes hills around Aš
The race takes place on May 23, 2026
The organizer offers sporting experiences in a natural setting
additional: Registration until January 31, 2026; the race course includes hills and natural terrain around Aš; start and registration information is available on the official website.

name: Běh o štěně okolo Poděbrad - memoriál Zdeňka Slepičky
description: The Běh o štěně - Zdeněk Slepička Memorial is a 7.2 km cross-country race held in Hejčín, Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners and offers runners an interesting course through natural terrain. The event is suited to cross-country running enthusiasts who want to test themselves on a more challenging course with varied surfaces. The race has a long tradition and is named in memory of Zdeněk Slepička.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through natural terrain
7.2 km course
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners
additional: The event is open to the wider running community and supports the regional running community.
