description: Žlutavská 11 is a running race that takes you through the scenic hills around the village of Žlutava. It offers routes for all ages, from the youngest children to a race of over 11 km. Runners can enjoy ample refreshments and comfortable facilities, including changing rooms and showers. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful countryside around Žlutava.
course_highlights: Main route: 11.3 km with 227 m of elevation gain
Course surface: asphalt (35%), grass and dirt (30%), gravel (35%)
Scenic hills around the village of Žlutava
additional: Runners have access to chip timing, refreshments (drinks and fruit), a meal and drink voucher for online registrants in the main races A and B, participation medals for children, and prizes for the top three in each age category. Changing rooms and showers are available. IZS categories have special conditions, and part of the entry fee is donated to the Military Solidarity Fund. A route of over 11 km, refreshments, showers, parking by the football pitch, registration online and on site, various age categories, start date: 23.5.2026.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Brno
location: Brno, Pavilon Anthropos, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: registrace on-line od 400 Kč / štafeta od 2 000 Kč

description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Brno is a sporting and social event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of eyewitnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Anthropos Pavilion and offers timed 6 km and 10.5 km runs, a 4 x 2.5 km relay, as well as untimed family and children’s runs. The route follows the Svratka River on paved paths and asphalt. Participants’ entry fees help fund the recording and preservation of eyewitness stories and educational programs.
course_highlights: Route along the Svratka River toward Kamenná Colony and Kamenný Bridge
Paved paths and asphalt
Timed runs: 6 km (1 lap) and 10.5 km (2 laps)
additional: Start and finish at the Anthropos Pavilion. Changing rooms, baggage storage, restroom facilities, water for rinsing off, and refreshments to replenish energy are available. Pupils, students under 18, members of the Memory of the Nation Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. On-site registration is available at a higher entry fee. The event includes not only sporting activities but also an accompanying program with music, refreshments, and facilities including changing rooms and water stations. Registration is available online and on-site.

name: Jistebnický vodohospodářský půlmaraton
location: Sportovní areál TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč (pro mladistvé do 19 let registrované do 17.5.2024), 200 Kč na místě
description: The Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running event now being held for the sixteenth year in the picturesque landscape on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. Races range from 3.6 km to a marathon, including relays and a children’s Olympics, and both start and finish at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. The routes pass through nature, with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains, and run between the villages of Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou and Klimkovice. The event also features a varied accompanying program and is suitable for a wide range of runners and families with children.
course_highlights: Routes pass through nature on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area
Landscape between Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou and Klimkovice
Views of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: The start and finish of all races are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. Registration opens at 7:00 and closes 20 minutes before the start of each race. Refreshments are available on the course, and one of the refreshments is included in the entry fee at the finish. Trying the Marathon Soup at the local pub is recommended. Parking is available near the complex and along the main road; using train and bus connections is ideal. The event also includes a children’s Olympics and an accompanying program from 10:00 to 15:00. Blood and blood plasma donors receive a 50% discount on the entry fee upon proof of their most recent donation. The course runs through natural areas, the event includes multiple race categories and children’s activities, and it takes place in May 2026.

name: Krušnej seběh
location: Nové Hamry, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Krušnej seběh is a traditional running race organized by Bike Team Nejdek, held in the picturesque setting of Nové Hamry in the Karlovy Vary Region. The race offers two courses: the longer FullHD, approximately 14 km, and the shorter HD, 7 km. They run mainly along forest trails and surfaced paths through hilly terrain with technical sections. Both the start and finish are in Nové Hamry, and the start has been moved earlier so the race takes up only part of the morning. The race is suitable for all runners looking for a challenging but attractive cross-country run in the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Loop course of 14 km (FullHD) and 7 km (HD)
Forest trails, surfaced forest paths, and asphalt sections
Hilly terrain with demanding climbs and technical descents
additional: The race starts in Nové Hamry by the Velká sjezdovka. The course is a loop, with a refreshment station along the route for FullHD participants and at the finish. Transport to the start is provided, so there is no need to travel by train. Results are announced before noon, so the race takes up only the morning. Course options: FullHD (18.9 km) and HD (11 km); hilly profile; bus transfer from registration to the start; on-site and online registration; changes to the route and schedule compared with previous editions.

name: Běšinský běh
location: Běšiny u Klatov, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Běšinský Run is a traditional running race held in Běšiny near Klatovy, offering a 4.8 km course. The race is mixed and also includes a hill-climb bonus, adding to its appeal and challenge for runners. The start is at the football field, and the race takes place in all weather. It is organized by Sokol Běšiny, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and a safe event.
course_highlights: A 4.8 km course in Běšiny near Klatovy
A mixed race with a hill-climb bonus
Start at the football field
additional: The race takes place in all weather. Each participant takes part at their own risk and is responsible for their own health. Children enter for free. The course goes through the football field; registration is at your own risk; race in all weather; hill-climb bonus.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Olomouc
location: Smetanovy sady and Čechovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
price_range: on-line registrace od 400 Kč, na místě od 500 Kč; štafety od 1 500 Kč, na místě od 1 600 Kč; dětské závody od 100 Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: registrace on-line od 400 Kč / štafeta od 1 500 Kč

description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Olomouc is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses. The race takes place on 23 May 2026 in Smetana and Čech Gardens and offers timed 5 km and 10 km races and a 4 × 2.5 km relay, as well as untimed children’s and family runs. The start and finish are by the collection greenhouses in Smetana Gardens. The event is suitable for all ages and celebrates heroism and freedom.
course_highlights: The route follows marked loops through Smetana and Čech Gardens
The 5 km race consists of 2 loops, and the 10 km race of 4 loops
The relay consists of 4 legs of 2.5 km each
additional: Pupils, students under 18, members of the Friends of the Memory of the Nation Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Changing rooms, a baggage drop, sanitary facilities, and water at the finish are available. The accompanying programme includes stalls with games for children, a relaxation and science zone run by Palacký University, workshops, and prize competitions. Race numbers are distributed during check-in on race day. The event includes refreshments, water, a family- and child-friendly programme, and supports remembrance of the past and the fight for freedom.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Jihlava
location: Český mlýn, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
organizer: Post Bellum, z. ú. a Parlament Gymnázia Jihlava
price_range: on-line registrace od 200 Kč, na místě od 300 Kč
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Jihlava is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Český mlýn complex, with the start and finish behind the skatepark. Runners can choose timed 4 km and 10 km races, or untimed children’s and family races. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant setting on paved cycle paths. The entry fee is a donation for a good cause and supports the Memory of the Nation.
course_highlights: The course follows paved cycle paths in the Český mlýn complex
The start and finish are located behind the skatepark in the complex
Offers timed 4 km and 10 km races, as well as untimed children’s and family races
additional: Pupils, students under 18, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Sanitary facilities, water at the finish, and refreshments are available. Registration and race-number pickup take place on race day at the specified times. Results are announced after the competitors finish. Paved paths, registration details, support for different race categories

name: I Górski Pólmaraton Szczytniański
location: Szczytna, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 1st Szczytna Mountain Half Marathon is a unique running event held in picturesque Szczytna, on a 21.1 km course with numerous mountain climbs. The race offers beautiful views of this charming town in the Kłodzko Land and a chance to connect with nature, giving every participant an unforgettable experience. The event also includes a 10 km Nordic Walking walk, an excellent option for people who enjoy active recreation without time pressure. The event’s organizer, the Szczytna Biega Association, promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings the local running community together.
course_highlights: A 21.1 km half-marathon course with numerous mountain climbs
Picturesque views and a chance to connect with nature in the charming Kłodzko Land region
Untimed 10 km Nordic Walking, with prizes and a shared finish line with the runners
additional: 10% discount for teams of 5 or more. Nordic Walking is untimed, with prizes at the finish and a shared finish line with the half-marathon participants. The Nordic Walking route passes through the most beautiful corner of the Kłodzko Land, with forest trails and a Sudeten atmosphere. Mountain running, preparation and training plans are available online; the event is aimed at fans of trail running and mountain challenges.

name: Kiełczowska Dycha i Piątka
location: Kiełczów, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Kiełczowska Dycha i Piątka is a unique running event taking place on 23 May 2026 in Kiełczów. It’s a full Day of Sport, designed for professionals, amateurs and families alike. The event combines sporting competition with bringing the local community together, offering positive energy and the chance to improve your running times. It is part of the Biegowe Grand Prix Zagłębia Miedziowego and promotes physical activity at all levels.
course_highlights: A scenic, runner-friendly course in Kiełczów
Two distances to choose from: 10 km and 5 km
A family event with a welcoming atmosphere and sporting competition
additional: Registration is via the external system fitstrefa-kielczow.cms.efitness.com.pl. The event is part of the Biegowe Grand Prix Zagłębia Miedziowego. Timing is provided by Feniks - Timing, which offers professional electronic timekeeping services. Street race; online registration available; the event promotes sport and local community integration.

name: Maraton Zagłębiowski
location: ArcelorMittal Park – ZPS Sosnowiec, Sosnowiec, Śląskie, Poland
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji w Dąbrowie Górniczej
description: The Zagłębie Marathon is a prestigious marathon held at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec. The course is officially certified by the Polish Athletics Association, guaranteeing an accurately measured distance and reliable results. The event is for runners of varying ability levels and combines sporting competition with the satisfaction of overcoming personal challenges. The organizers provide professional event management and extensive support for participants.
course_highlights: Course officially certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
The race takes place at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec
Professionally prepared and accurately measured course
additional: Registration is through the Datasport Registration Portal. Participants can run the marathon individually or as part of a two-person relay, with each participant completing a half marathon. The certified course allows results to be compared with those from other races. The event is part of the Zagłębie Triad, a series of three races in the region. The event includes relay options, a 6-hour time limit, and course attractions, including the halfway point at Pogoria 3 and a spectator zone.

name: Pancerna Piątka
organizer: Zarząd Wojewódzki NSZZ Policjantów województwa podkarpackiego
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in the 5 km road race, held in Żurawica. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship Police Commander in Rzeszów. More than 400 participants take part, and the course follows roads through Żurawica. The event is organized by the Regional Board of the Independent Self-Governing Trade Union of Police Officers of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: 5 km road race
The course follows roads through Żurawica
The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship Police Commander in Rzeszów
additional: More than 400 participants take part. The event is organized by the Regional Board of the Independent Self-Governing Trade Union of Police Officers of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship. The race takes place on 23 May 2026, with electronic timing, and is part of local events promoting sport and physical activity.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultramarathon held in the picturesque Beskid Niski region, on routes of varying difficulty. The event commemorates the historic “Jaga-Kora” Courier Route from World War II, giving the race a unique character and historical significance. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 19 km to 101 km, which pass through the areas around Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój. The race is certified by ITRA and UTMB, underscoring its standing in the mountain-running community.
course_highlights: The route follows the historic “Jaga-Kora” Courier Route from World War II
Five distances of varying difficulty: 101 km, 68 km, 42 km, 33 km and 19 km
The course passes through the picturesque Beskid Niski region, including Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój
additional: Starts take place overnight and in the morning on 23 May 2026, with different start times for each distance. The race office is open on 22 May from 17:00 to 22:00 and on 23 May from 5:00 to 7:30. Coach transport to the starts is provided for the 100 km, 33 km and 19 km distances. The courses have specified cutoff times, and the winners’ awards ceremonies take place on the stage at the amphitheatre beside the gazebos above Czarny Potok. Prizes will not be sent to participants who are absent from the awards ceremony. Registration opens on 1 December 2025. Detailed routes and the schedule are available on the organizer’s website. The event includes aid stations and awards ceremonies, live tracking and online results.

name: Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossman Run
description: The Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossmann Run is one of Poland’s most important running events, held in central Łódź on Piotrkowska Street. Launched in 2003, the race attracts both recreational runners and leading competitors from across the country. The route runs along the city’s representative thoroughfare, and the event is accompanied by a wide range of attractions, including a food zone and a free post-race recovery meal. A Mini Run over shorter distances is organized for children and people with disabilities.
course_highlights: The route runs along Piotrkowska Street in Łódź
Start and finish near Scheiblerów Avenue, close to Poznańskich Avenue
Evening start at 19:00, with start zones assigned according to declared finish times
additional: The race office is open from Wednesday to Saturday at Łódź Fabryczna Railway Station. Bag storage and changing rooms are available at the station. Showers are available at the Well Fitness club upon presentation of a race bib. Participants can travel free of charge on Łódzka Kolej Aglomeracyjna on race day. After the race, the organizer provides a free recovery meal—a soup. Each participant can enjoy a one-hour visit to the pool and sauna area at Aquapark Fala from 20 to 25 May 2026. Accompanying persons are prohibited from travelling along the route on bicycles, scooters, or other vehicles. Traffic and public transport disruptions will occur during the race, which starts at 19:00; disruptions are expected from 18:00 to 21:30.

name: 10 Family Run
description: The 10th KSOS Family Run is a special celebration of family running held on Kraków’s Błonia. The event brings generations together, promotes physical activity and family bonding, and offers a variety of races for children and parents, as well as an open race for everyone. The event also features games and activities for children, a simultaneous chess exhibition, and artistic performances, creating a joyful, sporty atmosphere for the whole family. It’s a great opportunity to get active, meet in a relaxed setting, and enjoy moving outdoors together.
course_highlights: All races take place on the grassy area of Kraków’s Błonia
5 km Open Run with a 46-minute time limit
Children’s races from 200 m to 2,100 m, adapted to age
additional: Participants may enter more than one race. Children must provide a declaration from a parent/legal guardian. Participant limits: 90 for the Open Run, 190 combined for the Mum and Dad Runs, and 455 combined for the Children’s Races. A race pack including a T-shirt is guaranteed only with advance registration and payment. The race office is open on 22.05.2026 (16:00–20:00) and 23.05.2026 (8:30–11:30). In the “Wolf Cubs” race (children born in 2020 or later), a parent may accompany the child on the course. All races take place on the lawns of Kraków’s Błonia. The event is aimed at the local community, schools, and families. Detailed course information will be available one week before the event.

name: 23. Półmaraton Hajnowski
price_range: 180.00 PLN (standard), 90.00 PLN (zniżki dla mieszkańców powiatu Hajnowskiego i seniorów)
description: The 23rd Hajnówka Half Marathon is a unique and unforgettable race held in the picturesque area of Białowieża, near Hajnówka. The half-marathon route passes through the charming Municipal Park in Hajnówka, giving participants the chance to enjoy nature and beautiful views. The event is very popular and is organised by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Hajnówka, which takes care of runners’ comfort and safety. The race office is open the day before the race and on race day. Participants can expect race packs and a coffee buffet.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Municipal Park in Hajnówka
Picturesque landscapes of Białowieża and the surrounding area
A chance to enjoy nature and beautiful views
additional: The race office is open on 22 May from 15:00 to 21:00 at the Municipal Park Amphitheatre in Hajnówka, and on 23 May from 8:00 to 9:30. An ID card is required to collect the race pack. Running under another participant’s name is not permitted. Registration is not available on race day. Participants can enjoy a free coffee buffet. The route is on asphalt, with the start in Białowieża and the finish in Hajnówka. The race office is in the amphitheatre. Massages and showers are available after the race.

name: Bieg Lwa
location: Tarnów Podgórny, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg Lwa is an annual half marathon held in Tarnowo Podgórne, attracting both elite runners and amateurs. The event is known for its excellent organization, attractive course, and enthusiastic crowd support. The festival also features children’s races and various accompanying events, such as cheering competitions and concerts. Bieg Lwa is a great opportunity for sporting competition and family fun in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course in Tarnowo Podgórne
Pogoń za Lwem 10 km race course
Numerous refreshment stations along the course
additional: Option to transfer the race pack until 10 May 2026. Cheering Competition with a prize of PLN 1,000. Accompanying events: ØRGANEK concert, FOODSTIVAL, Hobby Horse Cup, and challenges on the stadium track. Major children’s races during the festival. Registration until 10 May, race and recovery packs, cheering competition, previous editions’ race sold out

name: Bieg Poznaniaka
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na Rzecz Edukacji Dzieci i Młodzieży z Autyzmem „Aperio”
price_range: 60-80 zł dla dorosłych, 40-45 zł dla dzieci

description: Bieg Poznaniaka dla Przedszkolaka is a family running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in the picturesque Wielkopolski National Park and on the grounds of the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. The program includes main races over 11 km and 5.5 km, a Nordic Walking march, and children’s and youth races over various distances. The event is charitable, with all proceeds going to support children with autism. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals, and a range of activities for participants and their families, including free museum admission and outdoor games for children.
course_highlights: The main races and Nordic Walking route follow a marked loop of approximately 5.5 km in Wielkopolski National Park
Participants in the 11 km race complete the loop twice
Children’s races take place on the grounds of the National Museum of Agriculture and Agri-Food Industry in Szreniawa
additional: Electronic timekeeping is provided for all races except the virtual race. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal. Free admission to the National Museum of Agriculture and Agri-Food Industry in Szreniawa is available, along with outdoor games for children. The start area can be reached by car, by MPK bus lines 703 and 705, or by PKP train to Szreniawa station (a 150 m walk). 11 km and 5.5 km races, Nordic Walking march, children’s races, visit to the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals

name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden
location: Kampus Główny Akademii Wychowania Fizycznego, Białołęka, Warszawa, Poland
description: The 20th Onet Marathon Relay is Poland’s largest team running event. It will take place on 23 May 2026 at the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw. This unique event brings together runners of all abilities, with six-person teams covering the marathon distance together in the Japanese ekiden relay format. The event promotes teamwork and cooperation, offering different relay-leg distances that make it easier for beginner runners to take part. It’s a great opportunity for friendly competition and bonding with friends, family or colleagues.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Białołęka
The course consists of two loops
A fast, team-friendly course for six-person teams
additional: Starts take place in waves; participants select their start time during registration. The race bib must be worn on the front of the outfit and kept visible. Participants should arrive well before the start to allow time to use the baggage drop, changing rooms and toilets. Time is measured net, from the moment each participant crosses the start line. Volunteers help with the event’s organization and atmosphere, and volunteer registration is open. The event promotes cooperation, community and team spirit, with different distances and categories for various age groups, including races for children and young people.

name: Nowomiejska Dycha
location: Nowe Miasto Lubawskie, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Nowym Mieście Lubawskim
description: Nowomiejska Dycha is a special night street race taking place on May 23, 2026, in Nowe Miasto Lubawskie. The route winds through the town’s atmospheric historic streets, offering participants a unique experience and the chance to compete for attractive prizes. The event features two races: 5 km at 18:00 and 10 km at 20:00. Both start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, post-race meals, and a great time in charming surroundings.
course_highlights: The route runs through the atmospheric historic streets of Nowe Miasto Lubawskie
Night street races starting and finishing at Nowomiejski Market Square
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Race packs include T-shirts, bags, commemorative magnets, and medals. Cash and merchandise prizes will be awarded to the top runners. Post-race meals will be available. Both races start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. The event combines a passion for running with joy and community in a charming small town. Night race, registration on Superczas.pl, prizes, race packs, festive atmosphere

name: Phoenix RUN
location: Smolarnia, Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Klub Biegowy Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska i Opalenicki Klub Biegacza
description: Phoenix RUN is a unique sporting event held in a scenic forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. This is the second edition of the race, organized by the Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska Running Club, bringing together running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The event offers a range of distances for adults and children, encouraging families and friends to spend time actively together. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, commemorative medals, attractive prizes, socializing, and a chillout zone.
course_highlights: 10 km main race through the forest
5 km Nordic walking for adults
Children’s races from 100 to 800 m
additional: Start and finish at the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. Children’s races start at 9:00; the main race and adult Nordic walking start at 11:00. The event offers opportunities to socialize, healthy food, a chillout zone, generous race packs, commemorative medals for all participants, attractive prizes for the top finishers, and a lottery. Events include a 10 km race, 5 km Nordic walking, and children’s races from 100 to 800 m. Participants can enjoy activities and prizes, and the forest route offers scenic views and an active day out.

name: Sieprawska Piątka
description: Sieprawska Piątka is an annual race held in Siepraw, attracting runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event takes place in a picturesque area, and the course runs through Słoneczny Park and the Orlik sports complex, offering participants comfortable conditions for competition and recreation. The race brings people together and promotes physical activity among residents and visitors. The organizers provide extensive sports facilities and support during the event.
course_highlights: The course runs through Słoneczny Park in Siepraw
The start and finish are located by the Orlik Sports Complex
Well-prepared sports facilities, including changing rooms and toilets
additional: The event is organized by the Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Sieprawiu. The Orlik Sports Complex provides sanitary facilities and changing rooms for participants. The event brings people together and promotes physical activity among the local community. It also includes a variety of sports and cultural activities involving local communities, including children’s and youth races, walks, and accompanying events.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultra race held in the scenic Low Beskids, near Rymanów-Zdrój. The course follows the historic Beskid Courier Route “Jaga-Kora,” which was used during World War II. The event features five races of varying difficulty and length, from 19 km to 101 km. The races are certified by ITRA and UTMB, highlighting their prestige and high organizational standards. Join us for the 10th edition, taking place on 23 May 2026.
course_highlights: The course follows the historic Beskid Courier Route “Jaga-Kora” from World War II
Five race distances: 101 km, 70 km, 42 km, 33 km and 19 km
Scenic Low Beskid landscapes, with numerous trails and historic sites
additional: Starts take place overnight and in the morning on 23 May 2026. The longest distances (100 km and 33 km) start at midnight from the market square in Jaśliska, after participants are transported by coach. The remaining distances start from Altany nad Czarnym Potokiem or Moszczaniec. The courses have designated cut-off times, and the winners’ awards ceremony takes place on the amphitheatre stage next to Altany nad Czarnym Potokiem. Prizes will not be mailed, and attendance at the awards ceremony is compulsory. Registration opens in December 2025. The event offers various distances, and participants can expect support along the course and beautiful views.

name: VII Skaryszewski Bieg Konia
location: Stadnina Koni Hubertus, Skaryszew, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: opłata elektronicznie 50 zł do dnia 21.05.2026 r

description: The 7th Skaryszew Horse Run is an annual running event held at the Hubertus Horse Stud in Skaryszew. The main event is the 10 km Końska Dycha, which follows field, dirt and forest roads, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature and compete. The event promotes running as a form of active recreation and a healthy lifestyle, and brings the local community together. Children’s races are also held, making the event appealing to families.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race follows field, dirt and forest roads
Start and finish at the Hubertus Horse Stud in Skaryszew
Team classification takes competitors’ genders into account
additional: Main race limit: 150 participants. Age categories start at 16, with age-group divisions and an open classification. The team classification is based on the combined times of the four fastest runners, including at least one person of the opposite gender. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, while winners receive trophies and cash prizes in the open category. The course follows field, dirt and forest roads; registration is online and on Facebook. The outdoor event takes place whatever the weather, with prizes and medals provided.

name: X Leśne Bieganie dla Zdrowia
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Miedźnej, Szkoła Podstawowa we Frydku, Nadleśnictwo Kobiór
description: The 10th Forest Running for Health is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Miedźna, based in Wola. The races take place on forest routes of 5.5 km and 10 km, which can be downloaded in GPX format to a smartwatch or smartphone. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor activity, encouraging runners of different ages and ability levels to take part. Registration is online, and the rules are available on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Forest routes of 5.5 km and 10 km
Routes can be downloaded in GPX format to mobile devices
A race promoting health and outdoor physical activity
additional: The electronic entry form is available on the website. The rules and consent forms for minors are available to download. The race routes are available to download in GPX format. Registration is through an online platform. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and sport among residents of the Miedźna municipality.

name: XVI Bieg Koziołków
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kędzierzynie-Koźlu
description: The 16th Bieg Koziołków is an annual running event held in Kędzierzyn-Koźle, aimed mainly at children and young people. The event takes place on 23 May 2026 and offers professional RFID timing to ensure accurate results. It is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle. The event has a family-friendly, sporting character and promotes physical activity among the youngest participants. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00, and registration is open until 18 May 2026.
course_highlights: A race for children and young people
Professional RFID timing
Held in the city of Kędzierzyn-Koźle
additional: Registration closes on 18 May 2026 at 23:59. The event is timed by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in professional timing for sporting events in Poland. Online registration is available until 18 May 2026. The event starts at 16:00 and includes various age categories, including the youngest participants, born in 2022 and later.

name: XX Bieg Lupusa
location: Bartkowo, Dobroszyce, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 20th edition of the Lupus Run will take place on May 23, 2026, in Bartkowo, Dobroszyce. This is a Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)-certified race, offering professional timing, a medal, a meal, and excellent organization and atmosphere. The event attracts athletes from across the country, creating a unique spirit of competition and camaraderie. Registration is now open on the dedicated website.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified race
Professional timing
Medal and meal for participants
additional: The Lupus Run offers professional timing, a medal, and a meal for participants. The organizers ensure a great atmosphere. The start and finish are in Bartkowo. Details about start waves, participant limits, or additional services are not available. The race starts at 10:00 in Bartkowo. The event also offers online registration and various distances, including 10 km.

name: XXI Cross Maraton przez Piekło do Nieba
description: The 21st Cross Marathon “Through Hell to Heaven” is a unique running event organized by the PTTK Branch in Końskie. The event will take place on May 23, 2026, and attracts both runners and recreational runners, offering a challenging route in scenic surroundings. The marathon is known for its interesting and demanding course, which passes through areas named Piekło and Niebo, underscoring its character and challenge. The organizers provide professional service and support for participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the areas of Piekło and Niebo
Scenic landscapes around Końskie
Challenging cross-country terrain
additional: The organizer’s office is open Mondays from 13:00 to 17:00, and Tuesdays and Thursdays from 8:00 to 11:00. Telephone: +48 514 030 401. No details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees are provided on the website. Participation is open to people over 18, with various age categories and classifications. The race starts at 9:00, with an earlier start for participants expecting to finish in more than 6 hours. After the race, participants will receive medals and trophies and be served refreshments.

name: II Podgórski Bieg i Marsz Leśnymi Ścieżkami
V Ultra Nordic Walking World Records
Hegyre Megyek - Badacsonyi Futófesztivál 500m / 4 km / 8 km / 11 km / 21 km
LÉLEKFUTÁS ÉS PIKNIK
description: The Soul Run and Picnic is a warm, community-focused event in Magyarpolány, centered on movement and renewal for body and soul. Runners of all ages take part, and the day is rounded off with delicious food and meditative activities such as walking the labyrinth and a gong sound bath. More than just a sporting event, it is a vibrant community celebration held in the embrace of nature. The event is organized by the Habitus Foundation and takes place as part of the Polány Pentecost event series.
course_highlights: A nature-focused running race for families and all ages
A meditative labyrinth walk offering a unique inner experience
A gong sound bath for inner calm and renewal
additional: The event is part of the Polány Pentecost event series. After the race, participants can enjoy a communal picnic and delicious food, including chili con carne and vegan salads. The program includes a gong sound bath and a meditative labyrinth walk offering a special inner experience. Several special prizes are also awarded, and the sense of community is a central part of the event. Participants can enjoy races, a family picnic, relaxation activities, refreshments, and spring water. Advance registration is required.

name: SALGÓTARJÁN – LOSONC MARATONVÁLTÓ
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a relay race between Salgótarján and Lučenec, covering 42.2 km in six stages for teams of 4–6. The route passes through scenic settlements, with runners completing the full distance in relay. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with refreshment stations and goulash at the finish, while cultural programs add to the day. The race takes place on August 23, 2025. Online registration is available until August 20; afterward, on-site registration is possible only if places remain.
course_highlights: A 42.2 km relay race in 6 stages, with legs of 5–7.8 km
Route through Salgótarján, Somoskőújfalu, Radzovce, Rátka, Trebeľovce, Hladký Majer, and Lučenec
Refreshment stations approximately every 5 km; goulash and cultural programs at the finish
additional: The relay is for teams of at least 4 and at most 6 runners, with handoffs at the relay points. Runners must be at least 15 years old. The full course runs alongside traffic, on the left-hand side, and traffic regulations must be followed. Members of the first 30 teams receive medals, and the top three finishers in each category win cups. The course passes through several towns, with refreshment stations every 5 km, online registration and the possibility of on-site registration, and cultural programs and concerts at the finish.

name: SALOMON TWIN PEAKS TRAIL
description: The Salomon Twin Peaks Trail is a 22-kilometre trail running race that is part of the Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary. The course runs around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna and includes the famous “two spikes,” which present runners with a special challenge. This race offers a unique finish-line experience in Hungary that only UTH can provide. It is ideal for those who want to get a taste of the atmosphere and trail-running challenges of Ultra-Trail Hungary.
course_highlights: 22-kilometre course around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna
The elevation gains of the dreaded two spikes
A unique finish-line experience in Hungary
additional: Registration was open until noon on 1 May 2026; registration transfers and distance changes could still be arranged on that day. The race is part of the Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary series, which offers several distances and races. The event is supported by sponsors at several levels and media partners. The race venue is Dömös, Szentfa-Kápolna; bus transfer is included in the entry fee; there is no water available at the start location.

name: SALOMON VISEGRAD TRAIL
description: The Salomon Visegrád Trail is a 30-kilometer trail-running race that starts at the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád and finishes in downtown Szentendre. Runners pass through the most beautiful and challenging-to-reach parts of the Visegrád Hills, on varied and demanding terrain. The race offers an unforgettable experience for both nature lovers and trail-running enthusiasts. The event is traditionally of a high standard, with well-organized support provided for participants along the course.
course_highlights: 30 km from the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád to Szentendre
The most beautiful and challenging-to-reach parts of the Visegrád Hills
Varied terrain and natural surroundings
additional: Registration has closed because the maximum capacity of 1,600 participants has been reached. The race headquarters and expo are at the Ferences Sports Hall, Áprily Lajos tér 3, Szentendre. Bag storage is in the Reformed Secondary School building. The race is supported by several well-known brands, including Salomon, TUI, Leki, Petzl, Garmin, and Rudy Project. Lists of the different distances, registration, volunteering opportunities, sponsors, and media partners.

name: VeganRun
description: VeganRun Slovakia je prvý oficiálny slovenský vegánsky beh, ktorý organizuje Slovenská vegánska spoločnosť. Podujatie spája šport, zdravie a súcit a prináša viac než len beh - je to spoločný krok za zdravšie telo, čistejšiu planétu a informovanejšiu spoločnosť. Trasy vedú z ikonického Amfiteátra v Rači cez rozhranie karpatského lesa a vinohradov, ponúkajúce lesnú terapiu, rôznorodý terén a epické výhľady na Bratislavu. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi 5 km, 10 km a Canicross disciplínou, ktorá umožňuje bežať so psom.
course_highlights: Trasy vedú cez karpatský les a rozkvitnuté vinohrady s čerstvým vzduchom a tieňom stromov
Panoramatické výhľady na Bratislavu z vinohradníckych chodníčkov
Rôznorodý terén od mäkkých lesných ciest po kľukaté cestičky v Malých Karpatoch
additional: Merač času na všetkých tratiach. Možnosť bežať so psom v disciplíne Canicross. Trasy sú vhodné pre začiatočníkov aj pokročilých bežcov. Výťažok z podujatia podporuje zvieratá v útulku a edukačný program o rastlinnej výžive pre lekárov. Podujatie je charitatívne a podporuje edukačné programy o rastlinnej výžive, pričom výťažok je venovaný zvieracím útulkom a vzdelávaniu lekárov.

name: Bytčiansky Kros
organizer: Behači Bytča a okolie, v spolupráci s Mesto Bytča
description: Bytčiansky Kros je tradičný bežecký pretek v Bytči, ktorý ponúka štyri trate rôznej dĺžky a náročnosti, vrátane Super Krosu s dĺžkou 21 km a prevýšením 500 m. Trať vedie prevažne terénom, ako sú poľné cesty, lúky a cyklochodníky, s 80 % terénnym povrchom a 20 % spevneným povrchom. Pretekári môžu očakávať tri občerstvovačky na dlhších tratiach a dôkladné značenie trasy. Súťaže sú rozdelené podľa vekových kategórií pre mužov aj ženy, pričom ocenení budú prví traja v každej kategórii.
course_highlights: Super Kros 21 km s prevýšením +500 m
Trať vedie 80 % terénom a 20 % spevneným povrchom
Tri občerstvovačky na dlhších tratiach
additional: Pretekári na trati Super Kros 21 km musia mať stiahnutý GPS súbor mapy trate v telefóne alebo hodinkách a mať pri sebe nabitý a funkčný mobilný telefón. Trať je značená stužkami, šípkami a dobrovoľníkmi. Zmena trate oproti predchádzajúcim ročníkom kvôli cyklochodníku, beží sa po ľavej strane Váhského kanála. Registrácia zahŕňa povinné stiahnutie GPS súboru a pripravenosť na mobilnom telefóne; preteky sa konajú v rôznych terénoch vrátane asfaltu, poľných ciest a cyklistických chodníkov.

name: Vysocká pětka - vzpomínka na Jirku S.
location: Vysoká nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Vysocká pětka is a 5 km running race held in the village of Vysoká nad Labem. The race is held in memory of Jirka S. and traditionally follows a cycle path. The start is scheduled for 9:00, with check-in from 8:00. The event is open to all runners and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with a chance to win a prize in the raffle.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Race along a cycle path
Friendly atmosphere with a raffle
additional: Participant check-in from 8:00; race starts at 9:00; the race follows a cycle path; chance to win a prize in the raffle. The race is part of the local sports calendar and is open to the general public. Exact course distances and registration information have not yet been published.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Kladno
location: Libčice nad Vltavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Libčice nad Vltavou is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the lives of people who witnessed history and helps them. The event offers timed 5 km and 10 km runs with a mass start, following paved paths and asphalt through a forest park and along a cycling path. It is suitable for all age groups and supports remembrance of history and the courage of freedom fighters. Race bibs are issued at the registration desk on race day. The event also includes a children's run and the option of a symbolic “Anywhere!” run outside the official courses.
course_highlights: Start by the entrance at Sletiště
The course runs through the forest park along a cycling path
Paved paths and asphalt
additional: Pupils, students under 18, members of the Friends of the Memory of the Nation Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Registration and race-bib pickup take place from 9:00 to 9:30 on race day. Participants are advised to write any medications, allergies, and an emergency contact on the back of their race bib in case of medical complications. The terrain includes paved and asphalt paths; registration is available online and on site; the event is part of a series of runs supporting national remembrance.

name: Půlmaraton údolím Moravské Sázavy
location: Zábřeh na Moravě, Olomouc, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: přihlášení do 15.5.2026 – 500 CZK – po tento termín bude jméno závodníka vytištěno na čísle

description: The Half Marathon through the Moravská Sázava Valley is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Zábřeh na Moravě. The 21.0975 km course is certified according to IAAF rules and runs mostly over flat terrain, with a gentle climb between Nemile and Hněvkov. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Running Series and offers good facilities, including refreshment stations and a children’s race. The start is at the swimming complex in Zábřeh, which is also the finish venue. Participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: Certified 21.0975 km course with a mostly flat profile
Surface: asphalt, with sections of gravel, cobblestones and concrete
Four refreshment stations serving sports drinks, water and fruit
additional: Runners expecting to finish in 2:30–3:00 hours may start as early as 9:30. The race time limit is 3 hours. After the race, participants can enjoy a buffet with drinks (Welzl beer and draft lemonade) and pasta salad. A children’s race is held after the adults’ start. Lockers are available for 10 Kč. Parking is available by the swimming pool and in the surrounding area; please follow the instructions of the parking attendants. The course is free of restrictions and construction work. The race takes place on 24 May 2026, registration is open, and the event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, with various categories and team competitions.

name: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany
description: The Říčany Forest Half Marathon is a running race held entirely on beautiful forest roads and trails, with no asphalt. The surrounding countryside near Říčany is especially picturesque in late May, adding to the enjoyment of the run. The race is suited to lovers of natural terrain and cross-country running who want to experience the forest atmosphere and the challenge of a half-marathon distance. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and encourage them to share their race experiences.
course_highlights: The course runs entirely on forest roads and trails
No asphalt on the course
Beautiful surroundings with tall, old beech trees

The race is open to all age groups; participants under 15 must be accompanied by someone aged 18 or older. The race supports charitable projects. Registration is available online or on site.

description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a running race organized by Plzeňští Tempo Makers, who organize running races, charity runs, and running training sessions. The event takes place in the picturesque Pytle area of Plzeň and offers an opportunity for runners of all levels. The race is part of a running community that promotes an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Úslava River
A distance of 7.5 km, suitable for runners of all levels
Pleasant setting in central Plzeň and along the river
additional: The race takes place in Pytli. Registration is available online or on site. The event is part of the running community in Plzeň.

name: Okolo svaté Juliány

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 50 Kč (junioři, juniorky a veteráni nad 70 let dobrovolné)

description: Okolo svaté Juliány is a running race in Prague-Přední Kopanina with a 5,600-metre course that runs mostly along forest paths with minimal elevation gain. The start and registration take place by the tourist shelter on the cycle path on K Juliáně Street, easily accessible by public transport. The race is open to various categories, including juniors, adults and veterans, and offers a friendly atmosphere with parking available nearby. The entry fee is symbolic, with a voluntary fee for some categories.
course_highlights: 5,600 m course, one lap
Mostly forest paths, with the first 600 m on asphalt
Minimal elevation gain
additional: The start and registration are by the tourist shelter on the cycle path on K Juliáně Street. Signs point the way from public transport stops served by routes 161 and 312 (about a 5-minute walk). Parking is available on nearby streets, preferably on K padesátníku Street. Categories: junior men, junior women, men and women up to 39, and veterans in various age groups. The race is suitable for runners and cyclists and offers an opportunity to discover the historic site of Svatá Juliána and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in nature.

name: Koutecká vertikála
location: Ski areál Kouty nad Desnou, Kouty nad Desnou, Šumperk, Czech Republic
description: Koutecká Vertikála is a 2.5 km uphill race with 510 metres of elevation gain, held at the Kouty nad Desnou ski resort. The race has interval starts and is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which includes cross-country races in Šumperk and the surrounding area. It offers a demanding, dynamic uphill run, ideal for mountain-running enthusiasts and fans of vertical challenges.
course_highlights: 2.5 km route
510 m elevation gain
Interval start at the Kouty nad Desnou ski resort
additional: An uphill race and part of a cross-country race series. Children can take part. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain.

name: Rasokros
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Rasokros is a running race in Krčský les in Prague 4, offering men a 7.5 km course and women a 2.5 km course. The race is part of the SABZO series and is suitable for runners looking for an enjoyable cross-country run in a natural setting. The route runs through woodland and offers the chance to enjoy running in a quiet part of Prague. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to test themselves in this attractive event.
course_highlights: Woodland terrain in Krčský les
7.5 km course for men and 2.5 km course for women
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race is very demanding, with approximately 315 m of total elevation gain for men. The start is at 17:00. Online registration is available. The race takes place in Krčský les near Hotel Nosál.

name: 3. Pekelný kilometr
location: Peklák, Česká Třebová, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Pekelný Kilometr is an uphill running race held at the Peklák ski resort in Česká Třebová. The race is part of the 2026 ISCAREX Cup series and features a 1 km course with staggered starts. Depending on the weather, the route climbs the ski slope over grass, snow and paths. The children’s race starts at 17:00, and the main 1 km race begins at 18:00. The event is suitable for a wide range of age categories and is known for its atmosphere and challenging climb.
course_highlights: Uphill run on the ski slope
Staggered starts, except for the youngest children
Course surface: grass, snow and paths, depending on the weather
additional: Registration is available on site. Awards are presented immediately for the youngest categories. For the other categories, the three best times count, with the awards ceremony held after the last race on 26. 8. 2026. The race is part of the 2026 ISCAREX Cup, and the overall results count toward the cup. The event takes place on Wednesday evening. The course is short and steep and crosses the ski slope and forest paths. Races are open to a wide age range, from children to adults.

name: Malá cena Kunětické devítky  květen 2
location: Kunětická hora, Ráby, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: První start v roce – Krátký okruh – 100 Kč

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Každý další start v roce – Krátký okruh – 50 Kč

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Velká cena Kunětické devítky – Krátký okruh – 150 Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: První start v roce – Dlouhý okruh – 100 Kč

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Každý další start v roce – Dlouhý okruh – 50 Kč

tiers.label: tier_3

description: Kunětická Devítka is a traditional Wednesday cross-country running series in the area around Kunětická Mountain, offering two routes: a short 4.5 km loop suitable for everyone and a long 9 km loop for more experienced runners. The race is known for its relaxed atmosphere, bringing together runners with different ambitions, and focuses on enjoying the race and the good spirits after the finish. The event takes place at the car park by Staročeská Hospoda and is the largest weekday running event in the Pardubice Region. The organizer invites all runners to enjoy the race and the beautiful surroundings of Kunětická Mountain.
course_highlights: A short 4.5 km loop suitable for everyone
A long 9 km loop with long flat stretches, off-road terrain, and a climb up the steps to Kunětická Mountain
Start and finish at the car park by Staročeská Hospoda, below Kunětická Mountain
additional: Race-day registration takes place at the finish area from 17:00 to 17:50 from April to August. An isotonic drink is available after the race. A series race number can be purchased for a one-time fee of 50 Kč at the first race of the year. Categories are divided by age and gender. Runners take part at their own risk; younger runners must have written parental consent. Cross-country run, start at the car park by Staročeská Hospoda, race takes place on 27 May 2026

name: BĚKODO – květen III
description: BĚKODO is the 40th edition of a traditional running stage race in Teplice, open to recreational, fitness and competitive runners aged 15 and over. The race consists of the ten highest-scoring starts during the season; in the event of a tie, the faster time decides. The timekeeping limit is 35 minutes, after which runners are recorded as 35+. A separate Mladé BĚKODO series is available for younger runners. The event is organised by TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and BK Běkodo.
course_highlights: A stage race with the ten best starts counting towards the overall standings
A 35-minute timekeeping limit; runners may still finish after the limit
For runners aged 15 and over, with a separate series for younger runners
additional: Only runners aged 15 and over (born in 2011 or earlier) may take part. Younger runners may enter the separate Mladé BĚKODO series. The race is held mostly on Wednesdays, except for the third round, which takes place on Saturday, 18 April (the Čudla Vorlíček Memorial). The race uses a multi-stage format, with the option of counting the 10 best performances. Registration is open to runners aged 15 and over. The race takes place in the natural surroundings below Teplická Doubravka.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (6) – květnový
description: Come and run on a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district, where personal records are often set! The race is part of the 16th season of VAŠE LIGA’s regular 5 km and 10 km runs, held every month. You can compare yourself with other runners and track your progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Republic Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere with refreshments and an awards ceremony for the top runners.
course_highlights: Fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified course measurer
Opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Republic Championships in the 10 km
additional: The race is timed using chip timing, and each runner also receives a chip time. Check-in takes place in the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, you can replenish your energy and vitamins at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. Toilets are available at the Hamr Braník complex (300 m from the start). Luggage can be stored in the organizers’ tent. You can withdraw from the race up to 24 hours before the start and receive a refund of the entry fee. The races include various types of terrain, from urban courses to trail sections, and are open to runners of all levels. Registration is available online, and the series offers regular updates to results and schedules.

name: Tolarova pětka
description: Tolar’s Five is a running race held in Stříbro, offering a 5-kilometer course. The race is part of the Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro calendar and is intended for amateur and recreational runners. The route passes through the town park and is suitable for all age groups. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and refreshments for participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the town park and crosses the Svatováclavská footbridge
The race takes place in the evening, starting at 18:00
A friendly atmosphere and the option to run in a group
additional: The race is part of the Běžec Tachovska series. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and refreshments. It is organized by Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro, z.s., which supports amateur and recreational athletes. Registration details and prices are not explicitly listed on the website. The race is part of the local sports calendar; exact distances and categories are not specified.

name: Černovírská osmička
description: Černovírská osmička is a traditional running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Černovír. The race is part of the Haná Running Cup, which offers courses of various distances and is open to all runners regardless of age or ability. The course passes through the picturesque surroundings of the Olomouc Region and is suitable for both beginners and experienced distance runners. The organizers emphasize a relaxed atmosphere and high-quality race organization.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque surroundings of the Olomouc Region
Part of the Haná Running Cup, with courses from 5 to 42 km
The race is open to all ages and abilities
additional: Registration is handled through a credit system using a chip card, which is used for electronic timekeeping. The entry fee is paid from prepaid credit in an account at Fio Bank. Runners can also top up their credit in cash after the results ceremony. The race is part of the year-round Haná Running Cup series, in which points are awarded for placements in individual races. The event features a trail/cross-country run, starts at 18:00, offers web registration, and starts in Olomouc-Černovír by the Bulgarian Club.

name: BUFF – GOMU 72H WC
location: Füred Kemping és Üdülőfalu, Balatonfüred, Veszprém County, Hungary
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 miles, 50 km, Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km
organizer: Central European Ultra Series /CEUS/, Balatonfüredi Atlétikai Club, Balatonfüredi Sport Club, Magyar Ultrafutó Liga /KAHU/, Bakonyország&Balcsipart Egyesület, Balatonfüred Város Önkormányzata
description: The BUFF-CEUS 72H World Cup is an international ultrarunning race held at Füred Camping and Holiday Village in Balatonfüred. The event features races of several durations, including 72, 48, 24, 12, and 6 hours, as part of the Central European Ultra Series. The course is a 898-meter loop with a minimal elevation gain of 1 meter, making it ideal for long-distance runners. Participants can enter individual and team categories, and every participant receives a commemorative medal. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, and a central refreshment table is available at the race centre.
course_highlights: 898-meter loop course with a minimal elevation gain of 1 meter
Race centre on the east side of Füred Camping
Central refreshment table with water, hot tea, isotonic drink, squash, and coffee
additional: The event features races of several durations: the 72H World Cup and 48H European Cup start at 12:00 on 2026.05.28; the 24H European Cup starts at 12:00 on 2026.05.30; the 12H European Cup starts at 08:00 on 2026.05.30; and the 6H European Cup starts at 06:00 on 2026.05.31. The opening ceremony and technical briefing take place on 2026.05.27 from 17:00 to 18:30. Race-number pickup is available at several times before and during the event. Accommodation and parking spaces are available from 2026.05.27 at 12:00 until 2026.05.28 at 10:00; vehicle movement is restricted during the race. Awards are given in age-group and gender categories, as well as in team competitions. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. The event takes place at Füred Camping and Holiday Village in Balatonfüred, from May 28 to 31, 2026. Participants can enter different distances, and the organizers provide runners with the necessary infrastructure and services.

name: Ružindolský víchor

price_tiers.distance: Beh 7 km a Nordic Walking 4 km

description: Beh Ružindolský Víchor je 12. ročník cestného behu, ktorý sa koná v športovom areáli Ružindol. Trať vedie po asfaltovom a hlineném povrchu v obci a zahŕňa aj trávnatý okruh na štadióne. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi behom na 7 km a Nordic Walking na 4 km. Štart je naplánovaný na 17:30 a sú pripravené kategórie pre mužov, ženy, domácich bežcov a Nordic Walking. Na účastníkov čaká štartovné číslo, čip na meranie času, občerstvenie a účastnícka medaila.
course_highlights: Trať s asfaltovým a hlineným povrchom v obci
Trávnatý okruh na štadióne
Dve disciplíny: beh 7 km a Nordic Walking 4 km
additional: Štartovný balíček obsahuje štartovné číslo, čip na meranie času (ktorý sa po skončení behu odovzdáva v cieli), občerstvenie na trase a v cieli, účastnícku medailu. K dispozícii sú šatne v priestoroch športového areálu Ružindol. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane kategórií pre domácich bežcov z Ružindola. Trať je kombináciou asfaltu, hliny a trávnatého okruhu; preteky sú určené pre mužov, ženy, domácich a Nordic Walking; registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste; súčasťou sú občerstvenie a medaily pre víťazov.

name: Kamenická 15
location: Kamenice u Jihlavy, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč (online), 150 Kč (na místě), zdarma pro mládež do 17 let

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kè - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line.

description: Kamenická 15 is a traditional running race in Kamenice u Jihlavy. Adult runners take on a 15 km loop along paved roads and paths. Young runners can choose shorter 1.75 km and 0.4 km loops on paved roads in the village. The course passes through scenic spots including the settlement of Brodek, Zátiší Chateau and the Cípy forester’s lodge, finishing at the start. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages, from 3 years old, and offers a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and prizes for winners and young runners.
course_highlights: A 15 km loop along paved roads and paths
The course passes through the settlement of Brodek, Zátiší Chateau and the Cípy forester’s lodge
Youth loops of 1.75 km and 0.4 km in the village
additional: Every participant receives a voucher for refreshments at the U Raimunda restaurant. Prize money for breaking the course record: men 1000 Kč, women 500 Kč. Bus transport to and from Jihlava is provided. Children’s and youth categories are divided by age, with the option of changing routes. The main race is 15 km on paved roads; shorter loops are available for young runners. Online registration is available before 12:00 on race day. The event includes refreshments and prizes for winners.

name: Kapličkobraní

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné od 170 Kč 100% jde na charitu

description: Kapličkobraní is a charitable, non-competitive run that passes 13 chapels around Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice, with 14 stops in total, including the finish. The 10–12 km route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, or even pushing a stroller. The event has a deeper purpose: all proceeds go to the family of Jan Rieml to support his sons Šimon and Matěj. Participants receive a commemorative magnet, light refreshments at the finish, and a tasting of sacramental wine at one of the chapels. Kapličkobraní received an award for the best low-budget sports project for small organisations.
course_highlights: The route passes 13 chapels around Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice
The 10–12 km route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, and strollers
A tasting of sacramental wine at one of the chapels
additional: The first 200 participants to check in receive a commemorative medal-design magnet. Light refreshments are available at the finish. Changing rooms, showers, and convenient parking are available. The event is charitable, and 100% of the proceeds go to the family of Jan Rieml to support his sons. Companies can pay employees’ entry fees by invoice or donation agreement and receive free registration codes. The event offers various activities, refreshments, parking, changing rooms, and showers. The route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, and Nordic walking.

name: Běh mimoňským parkem
location: Zámecký park, Mimoň, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Mimoň Park is a race held in the chateau park in Mimoň, offering a flat course on paved paths along the Ploučnice River. The race is run in 7-kilometre laps, with distances of 7 km and 21 km available. The event is suitable for the general public and competitive runners, and is organized by Lenka Zeťová. The main category starts at 17:00, while the first category starts at 9:00. The race is part of the Czech Running Club and is held under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: Flat course on paved paths
7 km loop along the Ploučnice River
Start in the chateau park in Mimoň
additional: Race registration takes place by the swimming pool, and the start is on Vranovská Alley. The race is mixed, with distances of 7 km and 21 km. It is organized by Lenka Zeťová, who can also be contacted by phone at 777 909 842. Races take place in the picturesque setting of Mimoň Park, with children and adults welcome to take part, and are part of a running league. Registration and further details are available on the official website.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Nové Město na Moravě
location: Vysočina Arena, Nové Město na Moravě, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: rodinný závod 2 km - registrace on-line/na místě od 100 Kč

description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Nové Město na Moravě is a charity event held in support of the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of eyewitnesses and helps preserve historical memories. The race takes place in and around Vysočina Arena, with 2 km, 5 km and 10 km routes; the 5 km route is one lap and the 10 km route is two laps. The event offers timed and untimed runs, including family and children’s races, and is suitable for the general public, including pupils, students and seniors, with a possible discount on the entry fee. The start and finish are at the Vysočina Arena stadium, which has facilities including changing rooms, a bag drop and refreshments.
course_highlights: Routes run on asphalt, paved paths and forest trails in and around Vysočina Arena
The 5 km route is one lap; the 10 km route is two laps
Start and finish at the Vysočina Arena stadium, with full facilities
additional: Registration and race-number collection take place on race day from 15:00 to 16:30. Pupils, students up to 18 years old, members of the Memory of the Nation Club and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Changing rooms, a bag drop, sanitary facilities and water at the finish are available. Route distances: 2 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: road; registration fee: 100–400 Kč; race in Vysočina Arena.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Warsaw – Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in picturesque locations, and the night edition stands out for its unique finisher medals. The race is designed for runners who appreciate scenic courses and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in picturesque locations around Warsaw
Night edition with unique medals
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts
additional: After the race, participants receive special medals that differ from those awarded at the spring edition. The organizers emphasize the scenic qualities of the courses and the event atmosphere. You can sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with race information. Night race, scenic routes, medals, registration via website

name: XXVII Bieg na Groń Jana Pawła II
location: Ponikiew, Wadowice County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Beh v Raji – prológ
description: Beh v raji je tradičný bežecký závod konaný v krásnom prostredí Dobšinskej ľadovej jaskyne a jej okolia. Pretekári si môžu vybrať z viacerých tratí vrátane prológu, polmaratónu, 10 km a 5 km tratí, ktoré vedú prevažne po asfaltových cestách s čiastočnou uzávierkou premávky. Prológ je kopcovitý 1 km beh lesným chodníkom od parkoviska k ľadovej jaskyni. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka aj nordic walking.
course_highlights: Prológ 1 km kopcovitá trať lesným chodníkom k ľadovej jaskyni
Polmaratónska trať vedie po asfaltovej ceste cez obec Stratená a Stratenskú pílu
10 km a 5 km trate sú rovinaté a vedú po asfaltovej ceste s čiastočnou uzávierkou premávky
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je v budove OOCR. Prológ štartuje v piatok 29.5.2026 od 16:00 do 17:15, sobotné preteky 30.5.2026 od 8:00 do 10:40. Pretekári dostanú čelenku z funkčného materiálu s logom Beh v raji (prvých 300 registrovaných) a občerstvenie po dobehnutí do cieľa. Preteky sa konajú za čiastočne uzavretej cestnej premávky s vyhradeným jedným pruhom pre bežcov. Časový limit preteku je 2 hodiny 30 minút. Podujatie zahŕňa kategórie pre mužov a ženy, štart o 17:30, registrácia je možná na webovej stránke, preteky sú podporované Košickým krajom.

name: Salibský polmaratón, Hornosalibská desiatka, Hornosalibská trojka
location: Areál futbalového ihriska TJ Horné Saliby, Horné Saliby, Slovakia
organizer: Obce Horné Saliby a Dolné Saliby
price_range: 13,-€ online do 31.3.2025, 16,-€ online do 28.5.2025, 10,- € pre seniorov nad 60 rokov, deti a nad 60 rokov štartovné neplatia
description: Salibský polmaratón, Hornosalibská desiatka a Hornosalibská trojka sú tradičné bežecké podujatia organizované RoniRun Clubom v obci Horné Saliby. Preteky ponúkajú certifikované trate s dĺžkami 21,1 km, 10 km a 3 km, ktoré vedú malebnou oblasťou s občerstvením a čipovým meraním času. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, pre ktoré sú pripravené špeciálne detské behy. Okrem športového zážitku sa návštevníci môžu tešiť na bohatý sprievodný program s hudbou, ukážkami bojových umení a tombolu.
course_highlights: Certifikované trate 21,1 km, 10 km a 3 km
Občerstvovacie stanice s nealko pivom Zlatý bažant a širokým výberom nápojov
Malebné prostredie obce Horné Saliby s areálom futbalového ihriska TJ Horné Saliby
additional: Štartovný balíček obsahuje štartovné číslo, občerstvenie počas preteku a v cieli, čipové meranie času, nealko pivo Zlatý bažant, lístok do tomboly a plastový pohár podujatia. Preteky sú ekologické s papierovými a vratnými pohármi s depozitom 2€. Detské behy sú zdarma a deti dostanú medailu. Počas podujatia je pripravený bohatý sprievodný program vrátane nafukovacích hradov, koní, koňských záprahov, bubeníkov, DJ-a a ukážok bojového umenia a lukostreľby. Podujatie zahŕňa trate na 21 km, 10 km a 3 km, štarty sú naplánované na 10:00, 10:30 a 10:35, s detským behom od 9:15. Súčasťou je aj charitatívny rozmer a ekologické poháre.

name: Self-Transcendence 6/12h a 100km beh / Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 100km beh
description: Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 6/12hod a 100km beh v Šamoríne je tradičný ultrabežecký závod, ktorý sa koná 30. mája 2026 v Mestskom parku Pomlé. Ide o 24. ročník 6-hodinového behu a 15. ročník 12-hodinového a 100 km behu, ktorý ponúka kategórie pre jednotlivcov aj štafety. Bežci môžu súťažiť v rôznych vekových kategóriách vrátane veteránov a veteránok nad 50 rokov. Štafety tvoria maximálne traja bežci, ktorí sa môžu striedať v ľubovoľnom poradí, pričom každý člen musí po odovzdaní absolvovať aspoň jeden okruh. Výkon sa meria podľa skutočne zabehnutej vzdialenosti s presnosťou na meter.
course_highlights: Pretek sa koná v Mestskom parku Pomlé v Šamoríne
Trať je okruh, kde sa bežci môžu striedať v štafetách v špeciálne vyznačenom úseku
Časový limit na 100 km beh je 12 hodín
additional: Bežci môžu kedykoľvek urobiť prestávku, ktorú musia nahlásiť zapisovačovi kôl. Po ukončení pretekov je potrebné umiestniť značku na ľavú časť trate a zotrvať v blízkosti, kým sa nezaznamená skutočná zabehnutá vzdialenosť. Z bezpečnostných dôvodov nie je povolené sprevádzanie bežcov na bicykli alebo korčuliach. Traťový lekár má právo kedykoľvek odvolať pretekára z pretekov. Preteky zahŕňajú kategórie 6h, 12h a 100km, s možnosťou štafiet, a majú stanovené pravidlá pre meranie vzdialenosti a správanie počas pretekov. Registrácia je otvorená s uvedenými termínmi a poplatkami.

name: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom
location: Športový areál, Veľké Lovce, Nové Zámky, Slovakia
description: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom je štvrtý ročník bežeckého podujatia, ktoré sa uskutoční 30. mája 2026 v športovom areáli vo Veľkých Lovciach. Preteky vedú ulicami a chotárom obce po asfaltových a poľných cestách. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské kategórie s rôznou dĺžkou tratí podľa veku, ako aj hlavné behy na 5 km a 10 km. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka ocenenia v kategóriách podľa veku a pohlavia. Organizátori kladú dôraz na pohodlnú online registráciu a kvalitné meranie časov pomocou čipov.
course_highlights: Trať vedie ulicami a chotárom Veľkých Loviec
Povrch trate je asfalt a poľná cesta
Detské kategórie s rôznou dĺžkou tratí od 40 m do 1000 m
additional: Limit účastníkov pre 5 km a 10 km beh je 250. Školské kolá majú limit 160 účastníkov. Prihlásení bežci dostanú účastnícke medaily. Registrácia na mieste je možná od 14:00 hod v deň pretekov, ak sa nenaplní limit. Meranie časov je zabezpečené čipmi, okrem škôlkárov. Odporúča sa registrácia s diakritikou a vytvorenie účtu na stránke pre jednoduchšie úpravy prihlášky. Trails include asphalt and dirt roads; registration online and on-site; medals for all finishers; optional T-shirts; health info on race bibs.

name: Memoriál Jozefa Gabčíka
organizer: Žilinský pluk Jozefa Gabčíka, Klub vojenských výsadkárov Slovenskej republiky, Železničná spoločnosť Slovensko, Ministerstvo obrany SR

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 23 € – pri registrácii cez online na www.gabcikrun.sk

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Účasť v detských behoch je bezplatná. Štartovné sa neplatí.

description: Memoriál Jozefa Gabčíka je každoročne organizovaný bežecký pretek na počesť výsadkára a hrdinu Jozefa Gabčíka, významného predstaviteľa protifašistického odboja. Tento 11 km cross run v zmiešanom teréne vedie zo Žiliny - Poluvsie, rodného domu Jozefa Gabčíka, do telovýchovného areálu 5. pluku špeciálneho určenia v Žiline. Podujatie spája civilných a vojenských bežcov a podporuje fyzickú výkonnosť a komunitného ducha. Súčasťou štartovného je pretekársky balíček, občerstvenie, pamätná medaila a meranie času s čipom.
course_highlights: 11 km cross run v zmiešanom teréne
Štart pri rodnom dome Jozefa Gabčíka v Poluvsí
Cieľ v telovýchovnom areáli 5. pluku špeciálneho určenia v Žiline
additional: Kapacita podujatia je 500 pretekárov. Registrácia je platná až po pripísaní platby do 1. apríla 2026, inak bude zrušená. Štartovné zahŕňa administratívu, pretekársky balíček, občerstvenie, ceny pre víťazov, pamätnú medailu a meranie času s čipom HRDOSPORT vrátane online výsledkov. Detské kategórie majú bezplatnú účasť, registrácia prebieha online a na mieste pred štartom. Preteky sa konajú v Žiline - Poluvsie, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, štartovné zahŕňa štartové číslo s čipom, občerstvenie, ceny, medaila a meranie času.

name: Kurimské pobehaňe
description: Kurimské pobehaňe je bežecké podujatie organizované o.z. Aktívna Kurima, ktoré sa koná v obci Kurima pred kaštieľom. Trať vedie po asfaltových a poľných cestách s povrchom hlina a štrk. Pretek je určený pre rôzne vekové kategórie od školákov až po veteránov, pričom súťažiť môžu muži aj ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách. Registrácia je možná online s rôznymi cenovými hladinami podľa termínu prihlásenia, pričom je zabezpečený aj školský beh pre deti. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov hľadajúcich príjemný a komunitný bežecký zážitok v prírode.
course_highlights: Povrch trate: asfalt a poľná cesta s hlinou a štrkom
Miesto štartu: pred kaštieľom v Kurime, okres Bardejov
Viacero vekových kategórií vrátane školského behu
additional: Kategórie zahŕňajú žiakov základnej školy, dorastencov do 17 rokov, mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách. Organizátorom je o.z. Aktívna Kurima. Kontakt na organizátora: Ing. Tomáš Bolišinga, tel.: 0910 902 784. Pretek sa koná v lokalite Kurima pri Pred kaštieľom, s registráciou online alebo na mieste, s detailmi o termínoch a poplatkoch dostupnými na oficiálnej stránke.

name: MEA GRATI Ultramaratón vďačnosti
location: Košice, Košice, Hlavná ulica - Dolná brána, Slovakia
