description: MEA GRATI Ultramaratón vďačnosti 2026 je charitatívny ultramaratón, ktorý vedie bežcov na trase 64 km z Košíc do Tokaja. Tento beh nie je len o fyzickom výkone, ale aj o prejave ľudskosti a podpore ľudí bez domova prostredníctvom organizácie Oáza. Každý kilometer symbolizuje cestu späť k ľudskej dôstojnosti a účasť generuje prostriedky na zlepšenie života ľudí v núdzi. Bežci si môžu užiť špičkovú organizáciu, svetovú atmosféru a víno ako odmenu za svoj výkon.
course_highlights: Trasa dlhá 64 km z Košíc do Tokaja
Charitatívny beh podporujúci ľudí bez domova
Symbolický význam každého kilometra ako cesta k ľudskej dôstojnosti
additional: Účasť na ultramaratóne zahŕňa špičkovú organizáciu a po výkone je pripravená svetová atmosféra a víno ako odmena. Beh cez Tokaj, registrácia cez oficiálnu stránku, trasa z Košíc do Tokaja, koná sa 30. mája 2026.

name: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso
price_range: 18€ - 42€ v závislosti od termínu a kategórie registrácie
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso je tradičný nočný beh v nádhernom prostredí Vysokých Tatier, ktorý sa koná už 14. rok. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi 5 km a 10 km traťou vedúcou okolo Malého a Veľkého Štrbského Plesa, Jazierok lásky a cez Areál bežeckého lyžovania Snow. Podujatie je súčasťou Grand Prix série a ponúka nezameniteľnú atmosféru s výhľadmi na Rysy a nočným dobehom za tmy. Okrem dospelých pretekov sú pripravené aj detské behy a Nordic walking. Telekom Night Run je obľúbenou každoročnou zastávkou bežcov, ktorí si užívajú krásne bežecké zážitky v horskom prostredí.
course_highlights: Trať vedie okolo Malého a Veľkého Štrbského Plesa a Jazierok lásky
Nočný beh s dobehom za tmy a výhľadmi na Rysy
Prechod cez Areál bežeckého lyžovania Snow
additional: Štart a cieľ na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS a hotelom Patria. Časový limit pre beh je 1,5 hodiny. Účastnícky limit je 1000 bežcov s riadne zaplateným štartovným. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské behy (300 m, 600 m, 800 m) a Nordic walking na 5 km. Registrácia je možná online do 29.05.2026 alebo osobne v deň preteku od 12:00 do 18:00 na Štrbskom Plese, ak nebude naplnený limit. Podujatie je súčasťou série Grand Prix 2026, umožňuje online aj osobnú registráciu, má obmedzený počet účastníkov (1000), a zahŕňa rôzne kategórie vrátane charitatívneho behu, detských pretekov a Nordic walking.

name: Turbo TV detské behy Štrbské Pleso
location: Main road between Hotel FIS and Hotel Patria, Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Slovakia
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso je tradičný nočný beh v nádhernom prostredí Vysokých Tatier, ktorý sa koná už 14. krát. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi 5 km a 10 km traťou vedúcou okolo Malého a Veľkého Štrbského Plesa s krásnymi výhľadmi na tatranské štíty. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské behy Turbo TV s rôznymi dĺžkami tratí pre najmenších až po teenagerov, ktoré ponúkajú nezabudnuteľné zážitky a medaily. Atmosféra podujatia je výnimočná, s povzbudzovaním na trati a dobehom do cieľa za tmy, čo robí tento beh obľúbenou zastávkou bežcov počas sezóny.
course_highlights: Trať vedie okolo Malého a Veľkého Štrbského Plesa s nádhernými výhľadmi na Rysy
Občerstvovacia stanica na 10 km trati a povzbudzovanie na trati
Nočný beh s dobehom do cieľa za tmy a jedinečnou atmosférou Vysokých Tatier
additional: Detské behy Turbo TV majú trate 300 m, 600 m a 800 m s medailou za výkon. Nordic walking 5 km je tiež súčasťou podujatia. #REŠPEKT run je nesúťažná disciplína s dobrovoľným štartovným, výťažok je venovaný detskej onkológii. Časový limit pre hlavné trate je 1,5 hodiny. Účastnícky limit je 1000 bežcov s riadne zaplateným štartovným. Registrácia je možná online do 29.05.2026 alebo osobne v deň pretekov od 12:00 do 18:00 na Štrbskom Plese, ak nebude naplnený limit. Traťové dĺžky od 300 do 800 metrov, kategórie podľa veku, štart na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS a hotelom Patria, registrácia počas prezentácie, občerstvenie a medaila sú súčasťou štartovného.

name: Fatranský Vĺčko
price_range: 15 eur (dospelí), 5 eur (deti), +5 eur za jedlo na cieľovej stanici

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: štartovné pre trasu KIDS dogtrekking do 23/4/2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: štartovné pre trasu KIDS dogtrekking do 22/05/2026

description: Fatranský Vĺčko je kynologický vytrvalostný šport, ktorý spája turistiku a beh so psom v krásnej prírode Veľkej Fatry. Podujatie sa uskutoční 30. mája 2026 v Turčianskom Jasene a ponúka dve trasy - dlhšiu MID s dĺžkou 44 km a prevýšením +2350 m a kratšiu SHORT s dĺžkou 14 km a prevýšením +500 m. Súťažiť môžete v kategóriách dogtrekking (človek so psom) alebo trail (beh bez psa). Počas celej trasy je pes povinne na vôdzke alebo v postroji, voľný pohyb psov znamená diskvalifikáciu. Organizátori odporúčajú trasu MID pre skúsených a SHORT pre nováčikov alebo menej trénovaných.
course_highlights: Trasa MID: 44 km s prevýšením +2350 m po turisticky značených trasách a vlastnom značení
Trasa SHORT: 14 km s prevýšením +500 m po turisticky značených trasách a vlastnom značení
Krásna príroda Veľkej Fatry s doplnkovým značením (fáborky) a aktuálnymi informáciami o trase
additional: Štartovné zahŕňa štartové číslo, meranie prostredníctvom kódu, účastnícky balíček so sponzorskými pozornosťami, občerstvenie na trase a nápoj v cieli. Možnosť dokúpiť jedlo v cieli (mäsové alebo vegetariánske) za 6 EUR. Účastníci mladší ako 15 rokov musia byť v sprievode dospelej osoby, účastníci od 15 do 18 rokov potrebujú písomný súhlas zákonného zástupcu. Počet účastníkov je limitovaný. Registrácia prebieha prostredníctvom externého odkazu, sú stanovené pravidlá vrátane povinného vodítka pre psy a bezpečnostných opatrení. Podujatie sa koná v oblasti Ovčín - Boulder & Bistro v Turci.

name: Běh osvobození – Lišanská silniční sedmička
description: The Liberation Run – Lišany Road Seven is a traditional road race over a 7 km course between the villages of Lišany and Lužná. The race is run on a low-traffic third-class road and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. The start is in Lišany, where registration also takes place, and the finish is by the U Hřiště restaurant. The race has four men’s and two women’s categories and offers cash prizes, as well as a bonus for breaking course records. The start time is 11:15. Entries are accepted on site on race day.
course_highlights: 7 km course along the low-traffic third-class road: Lišany – Lužná – Lišany
Start and finish by the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany
Bonus available over the first approximately 500 m and the opportunity to break course records
additional: Runner registration begins at 9:30 at the U Hřiště restaurant (Sokol hall) in Lišany. Entries are accepted on site no later than 30 minutes before the start. The race office is open from 9:30. The awards ceremony is at approximately 12:30. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and diplomas to the top six. Bonuses are also offered to the winners and for breaking course records. Responsibility for the runner’s health requirements rests with the sending organization or the runner. The race features a 7 km category on a lightly trafficked road; registration is also available on site, and the event is part of a regional running cup. Exact times and conditions are published on the official website.

name: Běh Emericha Ratha
location: Cyklodomu Broumov, Broumov, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: The Emerich Rath Run is a revived cross-country race held in Broumov, inviting runners to take part in the picturesque surroundings of Schroll Park near Cyklodům Broumov. The race offers a chance to enjoy running in nature, with access to services such as bicycle rental, luggage storage and an e-bike charging station. Check-in takes place in the morning before the start, traditionally at 10:00. The organizers warmly invite all runners to join this sporting event with its friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Schroll Park in Broumov
Start and check-in at Cyklodům Broumov
Natural surroundings, with bicycle rental and storage available
additional: Runner check-in takes place from 8:30 to 9:45 at Cyklodům Broumov. Available services include bicycle and e-bike rental, bicycle and luggage storage, an e-bike charging station and toilets. The race takes place on 31 May 2025, starting at 10:00 at Cyklodům Broumov. Online registration is available until 28 May 2025. A race is also planned for 2026, including 10 km and 7 km courses.

name: Tuháčkův běh
location: Chrást u Příbramy, Příbram, Czech Republic
description: Tuháček’s Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chrást u Příbrami as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The main race is approximately 8.2 km long and runs mostly along paved and gravel cycling paths around Chrást. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in dedicated children’s races. The main race starts at 11:00 at the Valcha grounds. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and the chance to compete with other runners in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: One lap along paved cycling paths around Chrást
Mostly paved and gravel surfaces
Main race distance: 8.2 km
additional: The race takes place at the Valcha grounds. Children’s races are also held alongside the main race. The course is mostly paved and gravel. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. Training activities can be followed on Garmin and Strava in the Brdy Running Cup group. Road race, paved and gravel cycling paths, races for children, online registration, course approximately 8.2 km, race held at the Valcha grounds.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton České Budějovice 2026
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival České Budějovice 2026 invites you to an unforgettable half marathon through the heart of the city’s historic centre. The start is on the Czech Republic’s second-largest square, Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., and the course offers a unique atmosphere and views of historic buildings and distinctive places. This race is part of the popular RunCzech running series and is suitable for all runners who want to experience the charm of the South Bohemian capital on a day of sport. Join thousands of runners and enjoy a great sporting event in České Budějovice.
course_highlights: The course runs through the historic centre of České Budějovice
Start on Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., the second-largest square in the Czech Republic
Run past numerous historic buildings and distinctive places
additional: The race starts at 15:30. The festival also includes other races, such as the Vodafone 5K Run, dm Family Mile, dm bambini run, half marathon relay, and more. The RunCzech mobile app is available to help with navigation and provide race information. The race takes place in the city centre; maps and GPX files are available to download, and online registration is available.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
location: Chlum u Plzně, Plzeň-sever, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Chlum Three Ways is the fourth race in the Moving Lookout Towers series, held near Plzeň. Runners tackle the prominent summit of Chlum in three ways: a mass-start uphill run, an interval hill climb, and a climb up the steps to the lookout tower. The overall ranking is based on the combined times from all three events, with bonuses for the top three places. Ten age categories are offered for children, with courses around the lookout tower. A relay race is also available, with teams of three runners completing all three disciplines.
course_highlights: 1.75 km uphill run with 111 m of elevation gain
450 m interval hill climb with 59 m of elevation gain
Climb up 121 steps to the lookout tower, with 22 m of elevation gain
additional: The race office is in a tent by the lookout tower at the summit of Chlum, open from 9:00 to 11:00. The uphill run starts at 11:45, the interval hill climb at 12:20, and the lookout tower stair climb at 12:45. Children’s races start at 10:00. Relay teams consist of 3 runners, each running one discipline; they start together with the individual competitors. After 20 competitors have completed the stair climb, there is a 2-minute break for descent. Items left at the start can be transported to the finish by the organizers’ car. Competitors must make their own way to the start. The race includes off-road sections, children’s categories, family relays, and registration and parking are available.

description: Třanovická 10 is a traditional running race held in the municipality of Třanovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The routes follow gravel-and-dirt, forest, field and asphalt roads within the cadastral areas of Třanovice and Dolní Domaslavice. The event is open to the general public and includes a 10 km main race, a 5 km race and a relay. The start and finish are by the municipal office, and the race begins at 9:00. Registration is available online and on site, with race bib and medal collection available for those who register in advance.
course_highlights: The route follows gravel-and-dirt, forest, field and asphalt roads
The cadastral areas of Třanovice and Dolní Domaslavice
Start and finish by the municipal office at No. 250
additional: The time limit is 90 minutes for the 10 km race, 60 minutes for the 5 km race and 90 minutes for the relay. Online registration closes on 27 May 2026; after that date, registration is available on site only. Race bibs bearing runners’ names are guaranteed only for participants registered by 25 May 2026. The organizers recommend paying by 27 May 2026 at the latest; otherwise, the entry fee must be paid in cash on site, with a surcharge. Children’s races are registered for directly on site. The race takes place on Saturday, 30 May 2026. Registration is open, and the event includes various age categories and accompanying activities.

name: DEVIL’S CHALLENGE – ČERTOVSKÁ VÝZVA – 666km aneb superantikontramultiextraunikátní běžecký závod
location: Hamru na Jezeře, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

description: The Čertovská výzva 666 km is an 8-day stage running race through the beautiful countryside of northern Bohemia, offering a 666 km route or a shorter 4-stage option. The race passes through Kokořínsko, the Máchův kraj region, the Lužické hory mountains, the Ještěd ridge and Český ráj. The final stage follows the same course as the Čertovský ultratrail 66.6 km. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of three, with the option to take turns between stages. Individual stages can also be selected. The start and finish are in Hamr na Jezeře, with group transfers to stage starts and GPS navigation. The entry fee includes a pre-race buffet.
course_highlights: 8 stages passing through Kokořínsko, the Máchův kraj region, the Lužické hory mountains, the Ještěd ridge and Český ráj
The route follows marked hiking trails for the most part, with GPX files available
The final, 8th stage follows the same course as the Čertovský ultratrail 66.6 km
additional: Starts for the shorter stages are at 7:00 (stages 2, 3, 5 and 7). For stage 8, there is a group bus transfer to Houska Castle at 6:00. The time limit for each stage runs until the start of the next stage. Chip timing and a GPS tracker with online route tracking are used. It is recommended to have the mapy.com app with offline maps on your mobile phone. The entry fee includes a pre-race buffet during registration on Friday, 29. 5. 2026. A personal drinking cup is mandatory and can be ordered during registration along with a T-shirt or socks. 8 stages, shorter route options, GPS tracking, offline maps, start in Hamr na Jezeře, final 66.6 km stage, pre-race buffet.

description: The 1/2Maraton Bělský les is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of Bělský les in Ostrava-Zábřeh. It offers a range of events, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 4x5 km relay and the Nachmelená 25 km hiking event. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and the general public, and supports a charitable cause. The start and finish are at Vodní areál Jih, providing a pleasant atmosphere and good facilities for participants.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque Bělský les, surrounded by natural scenery
A range of distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and relays
Start and finish at Vodní areál Jih in Ostrava-Zábřeh
additional: Race bibs and timing chips are distributed at different times depending on the event, from 6:00 to 10:00. You can register up to 9 additional participants under one email address, making this suitable for teams, companies, schools and families. The event supports Kamil, a young fighter, and offers the opportunity to donate plasma for financial compensation. Relays can be registered as mixed, men’s or women’s teams. The events start at staggered times from 7:00 to 10:15. Registration is online. The event offers various categories, the option to order a T-shirt, parking nearby, and information about the courses and accompanying programme.

name: Běh pro Paměť Národa – Ostrava
location: Komenského sady, Ostrava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: on-line registrace od 300 Kč, na místě od 400 Kč
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Ostrava is a charitable sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place on May 30, 2026, in Komenský Gardens, with timed 4 km (1 lap) and 8 km (2 laps) races. The event is open to all age groups, including children’s races, and offers the option of taking part in a symbolic run anywhere. The start and finish are by the statue of J. A. Comenius, with refreshments and sanitary facilities for participants.
course_highlights: The route runs through the popular Komenský Gardens park
The 4 km race is one lap; the 8 km race is two laps
Start and finish by the statue of J. A. Comenius
additional: Pupils and students up to age 18, members of the Memory of the Nation Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Changing rooms, sanitary facilities, water for rinsing off, and refreshments are available. Race numbers are issued during registration on race day. It is recommended that you write any medications and contact details on the back of your race number in case of medical complications. The event supports remembrance of historical figures and the fight for freedom; proceeds help fund filming and education.

name: Běh přes tři vsi
location: Sedlec u Starého Plzence, Plzeň-město, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Through Three Villages is a modern cross-country race that continues the tradition of a road race organised by Spartak Sedlec. The event is for both athletes and runners who want to enjoy the beauty of the countryside. The youngest runners are also welcome, as running can be a lifelong joy. The route passes through three villages—Sedlec, Lhůta and Tymákov—in the area around Starý Plzenec.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the three villages of Sedlec, Lhůta and Tymákov
Beautiful countryside and natural surroundings
A traditional event continuing the history of Spartak Sedlec’s road race
additional: Registration is available online or in person on race day. The race is supported by the town of Starý Plzenec and other local sponsors. Results are regularly published on the website. The race is also suitable for children and young people, with age-based categories. The event is open to the general public, including children, with registration available on site or online. It is usually held in May, and the route passes through fields and forests around Sedlec near Starý Plzenec.

name: Ostravské běhny
location: Forum Nová Karolina, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: The Ostravské běhny 2026 race is a sporting event primarily for women, offering joy, exercise and solidarity in the heart of Ostrava. The race starts at Forum Nová Karolina and continues through a tranquil green oasis on the right bank of the Ostravice River. Participants can choose between 2.5 km and 5 km runs, 2.5 km Nordic Walking, and shorter children’s races. After the race, entertainment and refreshments are available at Nová Karolina, where participants can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and meet one another. Winners in each category receive prizes, and participants have access to race numbers, results services and full facilities for a comfortable race.
course_highlights: Routes start at Forum Nová Karolina and pass through a peaceful green oasis on the right bank of the Ostravice River
Running routes of 2.5 km and 5 km, plus 2.5 km Nordic Walking
Children’s races of 250 m and 500 m for different age categories
additional: Entertainment and refreshments will be available at Nová Karolina after the race. Race numbers, results services and a secured course are provided as standard. Winners in each category receive prizes. The program includes a performance by the group Ballistic and warm-ups before each start. Routes for running and Nordic Walking, children’s races, an accompanying program, medals and T-shirts for early registrations

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
description: Chlum Three Ways offers a hill race to Chlum, a prominent peak near Plzeň, tackled in three different ways. The event begins with a mass-start hill race over 1.75 km. It appeals to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain and wanting to try different ways of climbing the same hill. The event is part of the running community and offers an enjoyable experience in nature near Plzeň.
course_highlights: Hill race to the summit of Chlum
1.75 km course with a mass start
Three different ways to reach the summit
additional: The race takes place in Plzeň and includes categories for children and adults, with different running segments and the opportunity to compete in several age categories.

name: Běh na Děvín
location: Kostel v Perné, Děvín, Perné, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh na Děvín is an uphill running race offering two distances: 4.4 km and 9.1 km. The route runs mostly over trails and finishes at the summit of Děvín, offering beautiful views and a challenging profile. The race is part of the Czech Uphill Running Cup and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in the natural surroundings of the South Moravian Region. The start is by the church in Perná and the finish is at the summit of Děvín, making for a unique mountain-running experience.
course_highlights: Two routes: 4.4 km and 9.1 km, mostly over trails
Finish at the summit of Děvín with beautiful views
Part of the Czech Uphill Running Cup
additional: The race takes place on 30 May 2026. The course is mostly on trails and challenging, with the start by the church in Perná and the finish at the summit of Děvín.

description: The AC Praha 1890 Praha–Brandýs running races are traditional race-walking events with a history dating back to 1892. The event takes place in Arborka Forest Park in Prague 14 and offers courses for men, women, juniors and children. The course is a paved loop suitable for fast running and race walking. The event is part of the men’s and women’s league and is open to both amateur and club competitors. Bibs and timing chips are issued at check-in; timing is provided by chips and a finish-line camera.
course_highlights: Paved loop in Arborka Forest Park
Course suitable for both race walking and running
Start and finish in the pleasant natural surroundings of Prague 14
additional: Competitors entered in the team competition do not pay an entry fee. Bibs and timing chips are issued at check-in. Timing is provided by chips and a finish-line camera. Properly registered competitors participate at their own risk. The event takes place on 30 May 2026, with starts at 11:15 and 12:00. Registration and further information are available on the organizer’s website.

description: The Devil’s Challenge is a unique 8-day, 666 km stage race through the beautiful countryside of northern Bohemia. Shorter options are also available: a 4-stage race or individual stages. The route passes through Kokořínsko, the Máchův kraj region, the Lusatian Mountains, the Ještěd Ridge and Český ráj, with the final stage following the same course as the 66.6 km Čertovský ultratrail. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of three, with the option to take turns. Chip timing and GPS trackers are provided. The start and finish are in Hamr na Jezeře, with group transfers available to stage starts. The entry fee includes a pre-race buffet.
course_highlights: 8 stages through Kokořínsko, the Máchův kraj region, the Lusatian Mountains, the Ještěd Ridge and Český ráj
The route is mainly along marked hiking trails; GPX files are available
The final, 8th stage follows the same course as the 66.6 km Čertovský ultratrail
additional: Individual shorter stages start at 7:00; the bus to the start of the 8th stage departs at 6:00. The time limit runs until the start of the following stage. The entry fee includes a pre-race buffet during registration on 29 May 2026. Competitors must bring their own drinking cup; a special Devil’s cup, T-shirt or socks can be ordered. Timing is by chip, with GPS trackers, and the runners’ routes can be followed online. The organizers recommend installing the mapy.com app on your phone and downloading offline maps. Stage race, GPX navigation, chip timing, offline maps, start in Hamr na Jezeře, different distances and participant categories

The event takes place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, and includes a training run along the course to help participants prepare. The atmosphere is friendly, welcoming all runners who want to take on a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.

Training run along the course before the race
The picturesque town of Jičín as the race’s backdrop
additional: The 10 km training run takes place on Sunday, May 18 at 17:30. The event also includes other races over 5 km and 21 km. Registration is available online and on site. Race day offers timing, refreshments, and prizes.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – edycja wiosenna 2026

The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has promoted running and the beauty of natural trails in Wielkopolska and other regions since 2014. The course in Zielona Góra consists of two loops, allowing participants to enjoy the natural surroundings and a challenging yet appealing terrain profile. The organizers are running enthusiasts who emphasize the aesthetics and character of cross-country courses.

Two laps with a total course distance of 5 km
Picturesque natural surroundings
additional: The course consists of two loops. The race takes place in the Botanical Garden of the University of Zielona Góra. The organizers are a group of running enthusiasts who have organized cross-country races since 2014, with an emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the courses. The event takes place amid beautiful natural surroundings, and details and registration are available on the event’s Facebook page.

name: RockRun Jarocin
description: Rock Run Jarocin is a unique running event taking place on 30 May 2026, combining sport, music and the atmosphere of Jarocin, a city known as the heart of Polish rock. The race attracts both experienced runners and newcomers, offering a route through the most interesting parts of the Jarocin municipality. It is not only a sporting competition, but also a community of enthusiasts and a great sporting adventure that stays in your memory for a long time. The event is part of the Wielkopolska Half Marathon Grand Prix and focuses on good organisation and enthusiastic support from spectators.

The event combines sport with the atmosphere of a city of music and a rock vibe
The race is part of the Wielkopolska Half Marathon Grand Prix
additional: Details of the race pack will be revealed around 2 weeks before the race. The event offers music, spectator, photo and finisher zones. Participants will receive a medal and a T-shirt at the finish. The junior race gives children the chance to enjoy their first sporting experience and the joy of being active. The distances include 21 km, 10 km and junior races. The event uses electronic timekeeping, and the start and finish are located on Maratońska Street. Participants can register on the STS-Timing website.

name: Run4aSmile 2026
organizer: Wyższa Szkoła Biznesu National-Louis University w Nowym Sączu
description: The 13th edition of the Run 4 a Smile 2026 Charity Run will take place on May 30, 2026, at the Galician Town in Nowy Sącz. This special initiative is organised by the community of WSB-NLU (Wyższa Szkoła Biznesu - National Louis University) in cooperation with the Sursum Corda Association, with the aim of supporting the treatment and rehabilitation of children with serious illnesses. This year, the run is dedicated to two children: Milena Ząber, who has the rare neurodegenerative disease CLN2, and Maciej Bogoń, who is battling a brain tumour. Taking part is not only a sporting competition, but above all a way to support children in need and their families.
course_highlights: Charity run supporting children with serious medical conditions
Option to participate in person or online
Distances from 150 m to 4 km, adapted to different age groups
additional: The run is a charity event aiming to support children’s treatment and rehabilitation. The organisers have prepared promotional materials and a QR code to make registration easier. The event is co-organised by WSB-NLU (Wyższa Szkoła Biznesu - National Louis University) and the Sursum Corda Association. The link to the fundraiser for the children is available online. A run for different age groups, an online option, a fundraiser for children’s treatment, an event supported by the SURSUM CORDA Association.

The race is held on a certified course and organized by running enthusiasts and volunteers who ensure a fun experience and sporting excitement. The event attracts recreational runners, families, and residents of the Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality and Lower Silesia. The organizers provide professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.

Road race around the town of Smolec

name: Bieg na Sleze
location: Ślęża, Sobótka, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg na Ślężę is one of the oldest mountain races in Poland, held in Sobótka on the slopes of the Ślęża Massif. The approximately 5 km route, with over 500 metres of elevation gain, follows scenic, challenging mountain trails and finishes at the summit of Ślęża, next to the mountain shelter. The race attracts both elite runners and amateurs who want to take on the legendary climb to the “Ślężański Olympus.”

Finish at the summit of Ślęża, next to the mountain shelter

The time limit for completing the route is 90 minutes. If turnout is high, the men’s start may be delayed. Minors must have permission from a legal guardian. A race pack is not guaranteed for registrations on race day. Mountain terrain, registration, memorial, edition history, statistics, archive

name: Ultraroztocze
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a unique running event taking place on 30 May 2026 in Józefów, in the Roztocze region. Participants can choose from a range of routes, from short night races to ultra distances of 60 km and 120 km, passing through the scenic Roztocze countryside. The event is organised by the Janosik Race Series Foundation, which has promoted an active and mindful lifestyle through sport since 2014. The race attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering unforgettable experiences and a chance to connect with nature.

Various forms of support and refreshment stations are available along the route. Ultra distances, mountainous terrain, online registration, various distances

name: 13 Bieg Konopielki
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury w Gminie Juchnowiec Kościelny
description: The 13th Bieg Konopielki is an annual running event held in Juchnowiec Dolny, scheduled for May 30 in 2026. The main 10 km race starts at noon, preceded as tradition dictates by the Family Run. After the sporting competition, participants are invited to a social gathering in Frampol, the birthplace of Edward Redliński, author of the novel "Konopielka." The race pack includes a soft blanket that can be used for a picnic after the race. The event has a family-friendly, literary atmosphere, making it unique.
course_highlights: 10 km main race course
Family Run of approximately 200 m
Social gathering in Frampol featuring a literary touch and regional dishes
additional: The race pack includes a soft blanket to use for a picnic after the race. After the race, the program includes a gathering with regional dishes, visits to Ranczo Frampol and the Edward Redliński House of Creativity, a draw for book prizes, and a music concert. Registration for the main race is also available at the Race Office on the day of the event, while places in the Family Run are limited. 10 km course, Family Run, gathering in Frampol, race packs with blankets

The organizers, Stowarzyszenie Biegające Śliwice, ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere for participants. The race is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich, underscoring its importance in the local running calendar.

Registration is open, and participants can look forward to sporting competition and a good time.

name: Bieg o Złotą Kaczkę
description: The Golden Duck Run is an annual running event held in Toszek. Its aim is to promote running and Nordic walking as recreational activities, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and foster social integration, including the participation of people with disabilities. The main race course is approximately 10 km long and runs over mixed surfaces, including paving stones, asphalt, dirt roads, and park paths, with soft surfaces predominating. The start and finish are by Toszek Castle. The organizers offer numerous age and special categories, as well as trophies for the top competitors.

Participants can choose from different distances, and the event also includes Nordic walking and 6 km races for people with disabilities.

A tradition spanning fifteen editions of the race

The race is a road event and has become a permanent fixture in the local sporting calendar. 10-kilometre course through the town streets, online registration, event date: May 30, 2026

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Grand Prix of Mysłowice is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing runners of all abilities together. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running levels. Participation is free, and registration is available only at the Race Office on race day. Truchtacz Mysłowice is a community that motivates and supports participants as they discover the joy of running.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Organized by the local running association Truchtacz Mysłowice
An event promoting health and physical activity in Mysłowice
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. The races are free and open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. No details about the course or registration fees were provided. This is an annual sporting event in Mysłowice that attracts local interest.

name: V. Tisza-tavi Sportpiknik, Tömegsport Hétvége
description: The 5th Tisza Lake Sports Picnic and Mass Sports Weekend will take place on May 30–31, 2026, in Sarud, on the shores of Lake Tisza. This community sports event offers participants the joy of exercise and the chance to enjoy the natural surroundings. The program includes a variety of sporting events and family activities, offering an enjoyable experience for all ages. The beautiful setting of Lake Tisza is ideal for relaxation and active recreation.
course_highlights: A sporting event on the shores of Lake Tisza
Community and family activities in nature
A wide range of sports opportunities around the lake
additional: The event takes place in Sarud, on the shores of Lake Tisza, where Élményfalu offers a variety of experiences and a range of sports and leisure activities, including bicycle and e-bike rental, sailing, water sports, and family and children’s programs. Several types of accommodation are available at the venue. The event also supports the Slow Food movement and showcases local culinary experiences. Participants can also enjoy a range of accommodation options, local attractions, and family activities in the Lake Tisza area.

name: Hegyen-Völgyön futás
description: Hegyen-Völgyön Running is a trail running race held at Tardos’s scenic football pitch. Organized by Sprint Futóklub, the event offers running enthusiasts the chance to enjoy nature and varied terrain. The race aims to promote the joy of sport and physical activity, and welcomes everyone who enjoys an active lifestyle. The organizers reserve the right to change the date and program.
course_highlights: Trail running course at Tardos’s football pitch
Varied, hilly terrain
A run close to nature
additional: The race takes place at Tardos Football Pitch, starts at 10:00, and is part of a series organized by Sprint Futóklub.

name: HEGYEN-VÖLGYÖN FUTÁS
price_range: 4500 forint a hosszabb távokra, ingyenes a 200 méteres, kedvezményes 2000 forint a tardosi és klubtagoknak
description: The Hegyen-Völgyön Run is a traditional running race for sports enthusiasts in Tardos, organized by the Sprint Running Club. The race offers challenges over three different distances: a 200-meter children’s run, plus 4 km and 12 km distances for more serious runners. The race starts at the Tardos sports field and uses chip timing to ensure accurate results. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere and attracts many runners from the surrounding area each year.
course_highlights: The race starts at the Tardos football field
Three distances: 200 m, 4 km and 12 km
Chip timing for accurate results
additional: Registration and race-day preparation are available at the venue from 9 a.m. The race is organized by the Sprint Running Club. The 33rd edition of the event is family-friendly and offers several age groups the opportunity to participate. Venue: Tardos / Sports Field. Multiple distances, prizes, medals, trophies, gifts and chip timing.

name: Beh Rajeckým rínkom
description: Beh Rajeckým rínkom je tradičný bežecký závod organizovaný Maratón klubom Rajec, ktorý sa koná na Námestí SNP v Rajci. Pretek ponúka bežcom možnosť zažiť krásy prírody a okolia Rajca počas májového dňa. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí a neplnoletých, ktorí musia mať súhlas zákonného zástupcu. Organizátori kladú dôraz na bezpečnosť a kvalitnú prípravu pretekárov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie malebným rajeckým rínkom
Štart a cieľ na Námestí SNP v Rajci
Prírodné prostredie s miernym prevýšením
additional: Pre účasť detí a neplnoletých je potrebné priniesť podpísané vyhlásenie zákonného zástupcu. Osobné údaje účastníkov sú spracúvané v súlade s platnou legislatívou o ochrane osobných údajov. Podujatie sa koná v Rajci, registrácia stojí od 3 € pri skorých prihláškach, je pripravené pre všetky vekové kategórie vrátane detí, a je súčasťou športového dňa v meste.

name: Beh na Zniev
description: Beh na Zniev je majstrovský beh do vrchu konaný v Kláštore pod Znievom, ktorý ponúka náročnú trať s dĺžkou 5 650 metrov a prevýšením 475 metrov. Pretek je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií od detí až po veteránov, vrátane mužov, žien, juniorov a dorastu. Štart hlavného preteku je o 14:00 hodine v areáli bývalého gymnázia. Organizátormi sú Obecný úrad Kláštor pod Znievom, Strive sport, TRIMAT a Slovenský atletický zväz, pričom pretek je súčasťou Slovenského pohára v behu do vrchu.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 5 650 m s prevýšením 475 m
Trať vedie v okolí Kláštora pod Znievom, okr. Martin
Súčasť Slovenského pohára v behu do vrchu
additional: Štart detských kategórií je o 14:30 hod., mládežníckych kategórií o 15:00 hod. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane viacerých vekových skupín od najmladších žiakov po veteránov. Organizátori sú Obecný úrad Kláštor pod Znievom, Strive sport, TRIMAT a Slovenský atletický zväz. Pretek je súčasťou slovenských majstrovstiev v behu do vrchu, je určený pre profesionálnych aj rekreačných bežcov, s možnosťou registrácie online alebo na mieste.

name: Pivovarsko-hradná sedemtisícovka
location: areál TJ Slavoj V. Šariš, Veľký Šariš, Prešov, Slovakia
description: Pivovarsko-hradná sedemtisícovka je bežecké podujatie organizované mestom Veľký Šariš v spolupráci s Pivovarom Šariš a Športovou komisiou pri MsZ vo Veľkom Šariši. Pretek sa koná v areáli TJ Slavoj Veľký Šariš a ponúka kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a nordic walking. Štart je naplánovaný na 15:00 hod. pre beh a 15:05 hod. pre nordic walking. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane dorastu, juniorov, žien a mužov rôznych vekových kategórií.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 7000 metrov vedie cez malebné prostredie Veľkého Šariša
Možnosť zúčastniť sa v rôznych kategóriách vrátane juniorských, dospelých a Nordic walking
Podujatie je súčasťou miestnej športovej tradície a organizuje ho mesto v spolupráci s miestnym pivovarom
additional: Kategórie zahŕňajú dorast, juniorky, ženy a mužov v rôznych vekových skupinách. Štart nordic walking je o 5 minút neskôr ako beh. Organizátorom je mesto Veľký Šariš v spolupráci s Pivovarom Šariš a Športovou komisiou pri MsZ vo Veľkom Šariši. Kontaktná osoba: PhDr. Mária Gáborová, tel.: 051/321 41 24, 051 776 22 33, 0948 593 266. Pretek sa koná na areáli TJ Slavoj V. Šariš, registrácia je možná aj na mieste, a podujatie je určené pre širokú verejnosť vrátane Nordic walking účastníkov.

name: Nekořský kros
description: Nekoř Cross-Country is a traditional running race held in Nekoř in the Pardubice Region and is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The race offers courses through highly varied terrain on forest paths, meadows, and partly on asphalt, making for an interesting and varied running experience. The start and finish are by the ice rink in Nekoř, where registration also takes place. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, including young people, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and practical prizes for winners in individual categories.
course_highlights: Highly varied terrain
Forest paths, meadows, and partly asphalt
Start and finish by the ice rink in Nekoř
additional: Registration is available online and on site, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. The first three finishers in each category receive practical prizes and diplomas. The race is part of the ISCAREX CUP 2026. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup in 2025 and 2026, offers various age categories, including children and veterans, and allows online registration. The course is technical and challenging due to the terrain.

name: Běh mezi náměstími
description: Běh mezi náměstími is a traditional running race held at náměstí Svobody in Frýdek-Místek, attracting a wide range of participants, from children to adults. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere, beautiful weather, and the chance to compete on a course that runs to Zámecké náměstí and back. Special races for children include medals, prizes, and refreshments, while adults run the main course, approximately 4.7 km long. Winners and all participants take home not only prizes but also the joy of exercise and socializing.
course_highlights: A 4.7 km course from náměstí Svobody to Zámecké náměstí and back
Children’s races with record participation and generous prizes, including medals and Marlenka
A pleasant atmosphere at náměstí Svobody, with refreshments and a prize draw
additional: The children’s race starts first, with a record number of children taking part (for example, 252 in 2025). Medals, Marlenka, and other prizes are awarded to the top finishers, while additional prizes are drawn among all participants. The men’s and women’s main-race winners receive traditional prizes, including kegs of beer for the overall winners. The main race starts at 11 a.m.; the city mayor traditionally fires the starting pistol. The event takes place on 31 May 2026. Advance registration is required. The start is at náměstí Svobody and Zámecké náměstí, and the race is open to all age groups.

name: Chodsko Grand Prix
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Chodsko Grand Prix is a 9.6 km race with 130 metres of elevation gain, running mostly on roads from the village of Klenčí pod Čerchovem to the summit of Hrádek. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska competition and offers runners an interesting route with a gradual climb. It is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in the scenic surroundings of the Plzeň Region.
course_highlights: Route length: 9.6 km
Elevation gain: 130 m
The route runs mostly on roads from Klenčí pod Čerchovem to the summit of Hrádek
additional: The race takes place on 31 May 2026, with the start scheduled for 11:00. The course includes a climb to Hrádek and passes through scenic landscapes of historical significance.

The race takes place on the streets of Zlín and starts near the Zlín Congress Centre. Other race options include a quarter marathon, relays and a 5K. The programme also includes a 1,400-metre Family Run. Part of Zlín’s festival, the event offers a unique atmosphere and the chance to run alongside well-known personalities.
course_highlights: A 21.097 km road course through the streets of Zlín
Race options: half marathon, quarter marathon, relays and 5K
A 1,400-metre Family Run as part of the accompanying programme
additional: The time limit for the first half-marathon lap is 1 hour 20 minutes; the limit for the second lap is 3 hours from the start. Total race capacity is 2,000 runners: 750 for the half marathon, 450 for the quarter marathon, 130 + 60 for the relays, and 150 for the 5K. A limited-edition CRAFT performance T-shirt is available for CZK 690. You can change your race distance at the registration venue for a fee of CZK 200; a new race number and chip will be issued. The race takes place on roads. Online registration is open until 27 May 2026. Race categories include the half marathon, quarter marathon, relays and Family Run. Capacity is 2,000 participants.

description: BOS Zahořanská 10 is a traditional running race organised by SK Zahořany under the auspices of the municipality of Zahořany. The eighth edition will take place on 31 May 2026 and features a 10.2 km main race for men and women, with +250 m of elevation gain on forest trails around Zahořany and Pleš. There will also be a 5.5 km accompanying race and children’s races of various distances. Timing and results are provided by 4Timing using chip technology. Registration is available online and on site, with different price categories for adults, juniors and children.
course_highlights: Main race: 10.2 km with +250 m of elevation gain
Forest trail around Zahořany and Pleš (490 m above sea level)
Accompanying race: 5.5 km with +125 m of elevation gain
additional: Timing and results are provided by 4Timing using chip technology. The race is held under the auspices of the municipality of Zahořany and organised by SK Zahořany. Trail course, online and on-site registration, children’s races, results count towards the Brdy Running Cup, original medals, support for non-profit organisations

name: Maraton a půlmaraton okolo Hracholuské přehrady
location: Hracholuská přehrada, Pňovany, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The marathon and half marathon around the Hracholusky Reservoir is a race taking place on May 31, 2026, offering a beautiful scenic route around the reservoir. The course runs mostly along paved paths beside the water, with a few short sections of natural terrain, giving it a mildly trail-like character without unnecessary difficulty. A highlight is crossing the Pňovany Bridge, with breathtaking views of the reservoir and surrounding countryside. The race loop is 21.1 km long—the exact half marathon distance—and is suitable for runners looking for a combination of beautiful nature, a motivating atmosphere, and a pleasant course profile.
course_highlights: Mostly paved paths beside the water, with short sections of natural terrain
Crossing the Pňovany Bridge, with views of the Hracholusky Reservoir
A 21.1 km loop with a pleasant course profile
additional: The course is mildly trail-like, combining paved paths and natural terrain. A GPX map of the course is available to download. The race is organized by Sportovní klub Marathon Plzeň. The event includes both a marathon and a half marathon. The course is varied and runs through forests, meadows, and along roads, with 433 m of total elevation gain in the half marathon.

name: Hněvošická desítka
description: Hněvošická desítka is a sporting running event organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Hněvošice, taking place on 31 May 2026 at the TJ Sokol Hněvošice grounds. The run offers an opportunity to enjoy an active day in the beautiful surroundings of the village of Hněvošice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The event is suitable for the general public and supports sporting traditions in the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Hněvošice grounds
A run through the pleasant natural surroundings of Hněvošice
A sporting atmosphere within the local community
additional: The event takes place at TJ Sokol Hněvošice, Lesní 242, 747 35 Hněvošice. It is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Hněvošice, z.s. The event duration is not specified. Option to add the event to Google Calendar. The race is intended for runners of all levels; the afternoon also includes a color run or walk.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Lesná
location: Lesná, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Lesná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km, the adventure route is 20 to 30 km, and children’s races are held. The routes are suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, offering a varied sporting challenge for all age groups. The series is organized by Živé Sokolovsko z.s. and Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s., in cooperation with local municipalities.
course_highlights: Main race: 6–9 km through the beautiful Ore Mountains countryside
Adventure route: 20–30 km, navigating with a map
Children’s races from 200 m to 1,600 m
additional: The series includes 6 races in various locations across the Ore Mountains. In addition to running, participants can take part in canicross, walking while finding checkpoints using a map, and children’s races. The varied routes pass through the region’s beautiful countryside. The event offers different routes, children’s categories, the option to choose a route individually, starts from 07:30, and award ceremonies after 13:00. Registration is at sokotime.cz.

name: Mezinárodní běh Měška a Doubravky
description: The Mieszko and Doubravka International Run is a summer running race for adults with a 12.5 km course. It starts in Mirošov and finishes at the AQA Land swimming pool in Meziměstí. The race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix and follows the scenic Polish-Czech borderland through meadows and forests. The start is beside the amphitheatre on Parkowa Hill at 11:00; the finish and awards ceremony take place at the swimming pool. Free bus transportation is provided for Czech competitors from Meziměstí to Mieroszów. Registration is free and available online or at the venue on race day.
course_highlights: 12.5 km course between Mirošov and Meziměstí
Scenic Polish-Czech borderland with meadows and forests
Start beside the amphitheatre on Parkowa Hill; finish at the AQA Land swimming pool in Meziměstí
additional: The bus for Czech competitors is free and departs at 9:15 from the Meziměstí swimming pool towards Mieroszów. Race-day registration is available from 9:30 at the race office or online. The awards ceremony takes place at the swimming pool after the race. The race includes various categories and is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix. Registration is available online or at the venue.

name: 1. Zielony Półmaraton
location: Chojnowski Park Krajobrazowy, Konstancin-Jeziorna, Mazowieckie, Poland
price_range: bezpłatne dla dzieci i uczniów szkół podstawowych, dorośli od 60 zł do 100 zł w zależności od terminu zapisów
description: “We Run, We Don’t Click! – Konstancin-Jeziorna 2026” is a charity 5 km run taking place on May 24, 2026, in the scenic Chojnów Landscape Park. The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all ability levels. The start and finish are at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, providing easy access and convenient viewing for spectators. The event combines sporting competition with community spirit and support for the local community, and all proceeds will go to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery.
course_highlights: A route through Chojnów Landscape Park, an environmentally valuable area south of Warsaw
Two 2.5 km loops among mature pine and mixed woodlands
A gently undulating course with small climbs, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The run is a charity event, and all proceeds will go to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery. Participation is free for primary and secondary school students. The start and finish are at the forest car park, providing easy access and convenient viewing for spectators. During the break between the main race and the awards ceremony, children’s races will be held over 250 m and 500 m. Scenic route, forest terrain, children’s races, support for a local school, registration at the event office on the day of the event, different distances for children.

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10K is one of the most important 10 km running events in Wielkopolska, held since 2012. It attracts leading Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with forest sections and a route through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also includes a Family Run and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, adding further excitement to the running festival.
course_highlights: A dynamic course profile with forest sections
An appealing route through the streets of Swarzędz
A new version of the course, highly praised by participants
additional: The event will include the 6th Family Run, open to participants of all ages, and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. A unique commemorative T-shirt will be available for purchase. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns for its fifth edition at the festival. The event features various age categories, the option to purchase a commemorative T-shirt, and a wide range of activities and support for participants.

The races are designed to help participants achieve their best times. The next edition will take place on May 31, 2026, and everyone is warmly invited to take part.
course_highlights: Courses run entirely along the paths of TAURON Park Śląski
Certified by PZLA and World Athletics
Course designed to help participants achieve their best times
additional: Registration for the races is open until May 22; the number of race packages is limited. The event promotes physical activity and supports charitable causes.

description: The 45th anniversary Krotos Run is an annual running event held in Krotoszyn, scheduled for May 30 and 31, 2026. The event includes races for children and young people at the Municipal Stadium, as well as the main races along the city streets over distances of 10 km and 5 km. The start and finish are at the stadium, and the course runs through the streets of Krotoszyn, allowing participants to experience the city’s atmosphere. The race is an excellent opportunity for families and runners of all ability levels to spend time actively.
course_highlights: A course along the streets of Krotoszyn
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Krotoszyn
Children’s and youth races at the stadium, divided into age categories
additional: The children’s and youth races take place on May 30 from 14:00 at the Municipal Stadium, with a warm-up led by a coach. Children’s age categories have different distances, from 100 m to 1,200 m. The race office is open on May 30 and 31, 2026, where registration is possible if places are available (without a T-shirt). Registration is open until April 15, 2026, and is available online with race packages and discounts for residents. The races will take place at the stadium and on the city streets, with different age categories.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon is a special running event taking place on 31 May 2026 in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops with a total distance of 21.097 km, taking runners on a scenic route around Lake Swarzędzkie. The race combines sporting excitement with professional organisation, a unique atmosphere and enthusiastic support from spectators, creating an unforgettable celebration of running. The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival also features a 10 km race and a Family Run, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A scenic, dynamic route around Lake Swarzędzkie
Two loops with a total distance of 21.097 km
Some sections of the course are shaded, providing comfort during the race
additional: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival features three races: the Half Marathon, the 10 km race and the Family Run. Participants can purchase a special commemorative T-shirt. The event combines sporting, educational and charitable elements. The organiser provides professional organisation, safety, and special medals and prizes. The race atmosphere is boosted by enthusiastic spectator support and extensive media coverage. A route around Lake Swarzędzkie; educational and charitable elements; the option to purchase a commemorative T-shirt; an event held as part of the Swarzędz Running Festival.

name: Bieg z okazji Dni Ziemi Ropczyckiej 2026
