name: Běžecká série Berounka – Zadní Třebaň
location: Country Hospoda na Ostrově, Zadní Třebaň, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher za celou sérii), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka running series in Zadní Třebaň is a scenic race set in the beautiful countryside of the Central Bohemian Region. The route follows the Berounka River, crosses meadows with views, passes along the Liteň nature trail, and winds through picturesque countryside reminiscent of Tuscany. The race culminates in a climb to the course’s highest point in Doubce, followed by a final descent to the finish at a pleasant campsite with refreshments. Every participant receives a race number, and the top three in each category receive certificates and medals.
course_highlights: The route starts along the Berounka River and passes through an underpass beneath the railway
The Liteň nature trail along Stříbrný Creek and the historic waterworks
A climb to the course’s highest point in Doubce, with beautiful views
additional: Registration is available online and on site. Every participant receives a race number. Refreshments and bag storage are available on site. The top three in each category receive certificates and medals. The route is marked with red-and-white streamers and red arrows on the ground. The recommended arrival time is by 17:45. The finish is at a campsite with refreshments and seating. The race offers online or on-site registration, refreshments, bag storage, and medals for category winners. The series consists of 12 races in total, with the best 10 results counting toward the points standings, and the winners receive certificates and medals.

name: Běh Advenťáka PLZEŇ

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 299 Kč Z toho 200 Kč jde na podporu našich hrdinů

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 149 Kč Z toho 100 Kč jde na podporu našich hrdinů

description: Běh Advenťáka Plzeň 2026 is a charity run held to support people who are facing difficult circumstances. The race takes place on June 2, 2026, at Krašovské Activity Centre and offers a 6.45 km course along paved paths around Krkavec. There are also children’s categories with shorter distances. Participants receive a race number, a diploma with their time, a gingerbread cookie and other gifts, while part of the entry fee goes to support heroes.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths around Krkavec
Trail shoes are recommended
Children’s categories with distances from 0.2 to 1 km
additional: Race number with the option to have your name printed if payment is made by May 22. Diploma with your time sent by email within 48 hours of finishing. Sports prizes for winners of the adult categories. Gingerbread baked with love. Bag storage and a supervised children’s corner. Still Mattoni water at the finish. A gift from sponsors for adults. Temporary tattoos for children (little elves). Capacity: 250 adults and 150 children. The race is part of a charity series, with the option to participate virtually. Starts take place in the afternoon; capacity is 150 and 250 participants. The race supports local heroes.

name: Krčská 12
description: Krčská 12 is a traditional race organized by the Sabzo Praha running club in Krčský les. The race takes place on asphalt and features a 12.5 km course consisting of four loops. It starts at the Large Gazebo in Kunratice, usually in the early evening. The event is part of the regular sports and entertainment program at Nové Roztyly Park, which is also suitable for families with children.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt through Krčský les
The total distance is 12.5 km, divided into 4 loops
Start and finish at the Large Gazebo in Kunratice
additional: The race is part of a sports and entertainment afternoon at Nové Roztyly Park, where activities for families with children are also available, including slacklining, sack races, a spider climbing frame, and disc golf. The race is part of Prague’s running activities, offers various course distances, and is suitable for a wide range of participants.

name: Běh Advenťáka Praha

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 299 Kč Z toho 200 Kč jde na podporu našich hrdinů

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 149 Kč Z toho 100 Kč jde na podporu našich hrdinů

description: Běh Advenťáka Prague 2026 is a charity running race held on June 3 in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague. The race offers a 6.45 km course on paved paths, suitable for trail shoes, as well as children’s categories with shorter distances. The event combines the joy of running with support for people facing difficulties in life, and participants contribute to a good cause. It also includes activities for children and facilities with refreshments and a baggage drop. The race is part of the Běh Advenťáka series, held in several cities.
course_highlights: The course runs along paved paths in Hvězda Game Reserve
Trail shoes recommended for adults
Children’s categories with distances of 0.2–1 km
additional: Race bib with the option to have your name printed if payment is made by May 22. Temporary tattoo for children (elves). A diploma with your time sent by email within 48 hours of finishing. Sports prizes for adult category winners. A gingerbread cookie baked with love. Baggage drop and a supervised children’s corner. Still Mattoni water at the finish. Hygiene facilities. A small gift from sponsors for adults. The race is part of a charity series, with the option to participate virtually. Registration includes a race bib, diploma, gifts, and accompanying activities; capacity is 500 adults and 250 children.

name: Štafeta 4 × 5 km v Braníku 2026
location: Hamr Braník, Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 4 × 5 km Relay in Braník is a team running race taking place on 3 June 2026 on the cycle path in Braník, Prague. The race is for teams of four runners, each of whom runs a 5 km loop. The event offers a chance to experience a team atmosphere, cheer each other on, and celebrate after the race at the Hamr Braník complex. The course follows the A2 cycle path along the Vltava and is suitable for a wide range of runners, with a time limit of 2 hours and 20 minutes for the entire race.
course_highlights: A 5 km loop (2.5 km out and back) along the A2 cycle path beside the Vltava
Start and finish at the Hamr Braník complex, with refreshments and restroom facilities available
A friendly team atmosphere, with the opportunity to review performances together after the race
additional: Check-in from 17:00; race instructions at 17:45; race time limit of 2 hours and 20 minutes; cancellation permitted until 02.06.2026 18:00 with a refund of the entry fee; isotonic drink and light refreshments at the finish; supervised baggage storage; restrooms at the Hamr Braník complex; medals and prizes for the top three teams in all categories. The course is a 5 km loop. The venue can be reached via the cycle path, by public transport, or by car. Information is available on race registration, team and category rules, refreshments at the venue, supervised baggage storage, and the 2-hour-and-20-minute time limit.

name: Okolo Peperku
description: Žďárák - Around Peperk is a cross-country race with a predominantly off-road course, held in the picturesque Vysočina region in the village of Najdek, Hamry. The 7 km course offers runners 85% off-road paths and 15% asphalt, with 180 metres of elevation gain, making for an interesting and challenging route. The race starts on 3 June 2026 at 17:00 by the small bridge near the sports field and is organised by SK Žďárák. This race is ideal for trail-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in nature.
course_highlights: 7 km course with 180 metres of elevation gain
85% off-road paths, 15% asphalt
Picturesque Vysočina region, Najdek, Hamry
additional: The race is part of a regular series of outdoor cross-country events, is suitable for runners of all levels, and trail shoes are recommended.

name: Pohár města Třemošnice
description: The O pohár starosty města Třemošnice fire sport competition is a traditional sporting event held in Třemošnice and is part of the Chrudim District League. Men’s and women’s teams compete, showcasing top-level performances in fire sport. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and plentiful refreshments for participants and fans. It is organized by the Třemošnice Volunteer Fire Brigade in cooperation with the town of Třemošnice. Everyone is invited to the next edition, which will take place on June 3, 2026.
course_highlights: Fire sport competition featuring men’s and women’s teams
Part of the Chrudim District League
Friendly atmosphere and plentiful refreshments
additional: The event is monitored and overseen by the mayor of Třemošnice. The organizers focus on the comfort of participants and fans and provide plentiful refreshments. The competition is open to men’s and women’s teams, with around 28 teams expected to start. It is organized by the Třemošnice Volunteer Fire Brigade and the town of Třemošnice. Fire sport races are attended by local teams; the event is part of the regional league, and results are regularly published.

name: 3. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park B. Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro zdraví is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that everyone can complete at their own pace. Proceeds from the entry fees go towards helping people in need, giving the event purpose and added value. Registration opens at 17:00, and the start is at 17:45 at Lodičky. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.
course_highlights: A 3 km route in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park
Cycle path surface
Charity run with proceeds going towards helping people in need
additional: Registration opens at 17:00, with the start at 17:45 at Lodičky. A series of seven runs in 2026, with dates from March to September. Proceeds from the entry fees go towards helping people in need. The event is suitable for the general public and recreational runners. It takes place in B. Němcová Park, with an emphasis on supporting charity and health.

name: Běh na Vysoký vrch
description: The Run up Vysoký vrch is a hill race to the highest peak in the Kladno region, offering a challenging but short run with 200 metres of elevation gain over a route approximately 2.8 km long. The race is divided into categories by age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place in Malé Kyšice and is organised by TJ Sokol Unhošť. The race is scheduled for the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike.
course_highlights: Hill race to the highest peak in the Kladno region
Approximately 2.8 km route with 200 m of elevation gain
Categories divided by age and gender
additional: The race is organised by TJ Sokol Unhošť. Registration and start-list management are handled through the naZávody.cz system, which allows runners to change their details and transfer registrations. The start list and further information are available on the official website. The race starts in the afternoon, between 16:30 and 19:00; the starting point is Restaurace U Netopýra - Poteplí. The race takes place on 4 June 2026. Registration is available through naZávody.cz, and the course is suitable for runners looking for a hill-running challenge.

name: Rozkvetlá Kaštanka
description: Rozkvetlá Kaštanka is a popular running race held in Lhota, Central Bohemian Region, traditionally in June. The race features a 7.5 km route on paved roads and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners Cup. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and the springtime atmosphere, as the surrounding area blooms with chestnut blossoms. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers a welcome opportunity to meet the local running community.
course_highlights: A 7.5 km paved route in the picturesque surroundings of Lhota
Part of the regional Kladno and Rakovník Runners Cup
Beautiful floral scenery with chestnut trees in full bloom
additional: The race is held annually in spring, is suitable for all age groups, and offers an opportunity to enjoy nature and sport in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Kolem Trpaslíka v Hybrálci
description: The Kolem Trpaslíka race in Hybrálec is a 10 km running race that runs mainly along unpaved forest paths in the Hybrálec area near Jihlava. It is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural terrain of the Vysočina region. The course is ideal for fans of forest running and a pleasant outdoor sporting experience.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Mainly unpaved forest paths
Part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup
additional: The race offers various courses around Hybrálec, including shorter distances, and is suitable for all age groups. A friendly atmosphere and the chance to meet the Vysočina running community await.

name: Valašské kilo
description: Valašské Kilo is a challenging 100 km ultramarathon through the beautiful, hilly landscape of Valašsko, with at least 3,500 metres of elevation gain. The race is a challenge not only for experienced athletes, but also for those who want to push their limits and experience an off-road adventure. After the mass start at 22:00, runners plan their own route between checkpoints, within a 30-hour time limit. Race facilities are at ZŠ Žerotínova in Valašské Meziříčí, where a gym, showers and a dining hall are available. Valašské Kilo offers the freedom to navigate the terrain and is one of the best ultramarathons in Czechia.
course_highlights: 100 km route with at least 3,500 metres of elevation gain
Choose your own route between checkpoints (Krpály)
Challenging Valašsko terrain with hills and natural beauty
additional: The race has a 30-hour time limit. At the start, runners receive a card listing the checkpoints they must visit. Race facilities are open from approximately 16:00 on Friday until 12:00 on Sunday and include a gym, showers, a dining hall, drinking water and baggage storage. Each runner must provide their own map of the route. The race focuses on endurance walking and running, with an emphasis on resilience and the ability to tackle the challenging terrain of the Valašsko region.

name: Dopesace Backyard Ultra
description: Dopesace Backyard Ultra is an endurance race held in the Aš Forests, where runners complete a loop of just under 7 kilometres every hour. The race continues until only one runner remains who can complete one more lap than the others. This unique format puts the emphasis not only on speed, but above all on endurance and determination. The winner receives a silver coin and the opportunity to represent the Czech Republic at the team world championships in October 2026. The race atmosphere is unforgettable, and the event is also linked to a charitable project.
course_highlights: A 6.71 km loop with approximately 80 m of elevation gain
The race takes place in the Aš Forests, with the start and race facilities at Kemp Pod Rozhlednou
Each lap starts exactly one hour after the previous one, with strict timekeeping
additional: Pre-race check-in is available the evening before the race between 5 and 7 p.m., or on race day from 8 to 9:15 a.m. Runners must be over 18. Each lap must be completed within 60 minutes, otherwise the runner is disqualified. No assistance or aids are permitted on the course, including running poles. The race supports charity, with runners contributing CZK 1–10 for every kilometre completed to a selected project. The race takes place in the Aš Forests, and headlamps are required for night sections. Registration is required. The event has a charitable dimension and emphasises community spirit and endurance.

name: Banskobystrický maratón
location: Námestie pred Europa SC, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
price_range: 33 € to 108 € v závislosti od kategórie a termínu registrácie
description: Banskobystrický maratón je najväčšie periodické športové podujatie na strednom Slovensku, ktoré ponúka magickú večernú atmosféru a rýchlu, zážitkovú trať s certifikáciou. Pretekári si môžu vybrať z viacerých disciplín vrátane maratónu, polmaratónu, desiatky, päťkilometrového behu STEFE a štafety. Trať je dobre zabezpečená s občerstvovacími stanicami a ozvučením, čo zaručuje kvalitný zážitok pre všetkých účastníkov. Podujatie je vhodné pre aktívnych bežcov aj rodiny, ktoré si chcú užiť pohyb a športovú atmosféru.
course_highlights: Magická večerná trať s certifikáciou
Polmaratón pozostáva z 3 rýchlych okruhov s 12 občerstvovacími stanicami
Superrýchla desiatka s minimálnym prevýšením
additional: Polmaratón má 12 občerstvovacích staníc a celá trať je ozvučená. Štafeta pozostáva z 3 úsekov po 7 km. STEFE päťka je určená pre rodiny a aktívnych bežcov. Podujatie sa koná 6. júna 2026, štart je na Námestí pred Europa SC, k dispozícii sú viaceré aid stations a rôzne kategórie pre všetky vekové skupiny

name: Poludnica Run
description: Poludnica Run je horský beh v Nízkych Tatrách s dĺžkou trate 23 km a prevýšením 1600 metrov. Trať vedie prevažne po značených turistických chodníkoch, cez krásne južne orientované singláče v lese, skalné mesto a vrchol Poludnice s panoramatickým výhľadom na Liptov a Tatry. Podujatie je súčasťou Slovenskej skyrunningovej ligy a Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia, pričom slúži aj ako kvalifikačné preteky na majstrovstvá sveta v skyrunningu. Atmosféra je priateľská a trať patrí medzi najťažšie na Slovensku vo svojej kategórii. V roku 2026 sa uskutoční posledný ročník tohto podujatia.
course_highlights: 23 km dlhá trať s prevýšením 1600 m
Trasa vedie po značených turistických chodníkoch, singláčikmi a skalným mestom
Vrchol Poludnice s panoramatickým výhľadom na Liptov, Západné a Vysoké Tatry
additional: Registrácia sa spustí 23. marca 2026. Prezentácia a vyzdvihnutie štartovného čísla je v deň štartu od 07:00 do 08:40 v priestoroch štartu. Hromadný štart je o 09:00. Maximálny počet účastníkov je 200. Na trati je občerstvenie na 19. km. Trať je považovaná za jednu z najťažších na Slovensku vo svojej kategórii. Po vyhlásení výsledkov o 14:00 sa uskutoční tombola s lístkami za 2 €. Podujatie je súčasťou sezónneho hodnotenia a zbierania ITRA bodov, s možnosťou získať body na majstrovstvá sveta. Súčasťou sú aj tombola, teplý obed a bezplatné parkovanie.

name: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Vyšná Myšľa, Košice, Slovakia
description: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou je bežecké podujatie organizované Bežeckým klubom obce Vyšná Myšľa a obcou Vyšná Myšľa. Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku vo Vyšnej Myšli a ponúkajú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny mužov, žien a detí. Súčasťou je aj štafeta dvojíc na 2 x 3 km. Štart detských kategórií je o 14:00 a dospelých o 16:00 hodine. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane členov klubu a občanov obce, ktorí majú výhody na štartovnom.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku vo Vyšnej Myšli
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a deti podľa veku
Štafeta dvojíc na 2 x 3 km
additional: Štart detí o 14:00 hod., dospelých o 16:00 hod. Štartovné neplatia Muži E, Ženy I, členovia BKO Vyšná Myšľa, občania obce Vyšná Myšľa a deti. Podujatie zahŕňa kategórie pre deti, dospelých a štafety, s možnosťou registrácie online aj na mieste, trať je situovaná na futbalovom ihrisku a v okolí obce.

name: Trail Run
description: Trail Run v Družstevnej pri Hornáde je bežecká súťaž, ktorá ponúka trať s prírodným charakterom a rôznorodým povrchom. Pretek sa koná 6. júna 2026 s možnosťou výberu medzi 8 km a 15 km okruhmi, ktoré vedú po asfaltových, betónových, lesných a poľných cestách s prevýšením až 309 metrov. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské kategórie s rôznymi dĺžkami tratí, čo robí podujatie vhodným pre širokú vekovú škálu bežcov. Štart a cieľ sú situované pri multifunkčnom ihrisku na Okružnej ulici v Družstevnej pri Hornáde.
course_highlights: 8 km okruh s prevýšením 162 m
15 km okruh s prevýšením 309 m
Povrch trate zahŕňa asfalt, betón, lesné a poľné cesty
additional: Registrácia je možná iba online s platbou prevodom alebo kartou, prípadne platba na mieste počas registrácie. Súčasťou programu sú aj detské kategórie s rôznymi dĺžkami tratí a nording walking o 16:00. Registrácia začína o 13:30 a končí o 15:30, deti sa registrujú do 14:30. Podujatie je podporované nadáciou e.SK a je zamerané na propagáciu trailového behu v Slovenskej prírode. Detaily o trase a registrácii budú zverejnené neskôr.

name: Starostovská desiatka
location: Futbalové ihrisko Kišovce, Hôrka, Poprad, Slovakia
description: Starostovská desiatka je bežecký pretek konaný v obci Hôrka okr. Poprad na futbalovom ihrisku Kišovce. Pretek ponúka 10 km trať s kategóriami podľa veku a pohlavia, ako aj hobby kategóriu na 5 km a preteky pre deti a žiakov. Štart hlavných kategórií je o 16:30, detské kategórie začínajú o 13:00. Organizátormi sú Obecný úrad Hôrka a TJ Baník Hôrka, ktorí vítajú bežcov všetkých vekových skupín a úrovní.
course_highlights: 10 km trať s kategóriami podľa veku a pohlavia
Hobby kategória na 5 km bez vekového obmedzenia
Preteky detí a žiakov s vlastným štartom
additional: Detské kategórie a žiaci majú štart o 13:00 a sú bez štartovného. Štartovné na mieste je 15 €. Registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, štartové časy sú o 13:00 a 16:30, súčasťou štartovného je teplé jedlo a nápoje

name: Beh pre dobrú vec
description: Beh pre dobrú vec je bežecké podujatie v obci Pača, ktoré ponúka trať dlhú 4,4 km. Preteky sú určené pre širokú vekovú kategóriu od mladších po starších bežcov, s kategóriami pre mužov a ženy. Ide o komunitný beh, ktorý spája šport a dobrú vec, pričom pretekári môžu súťažiť v rôznych vekových skupinách. Podujatie je súčasťou platformy pretekaj.sk a ponúka jednoduchú online registráciu.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 4,4 km v obci Pača
Jednoduchý okruh s jedným okruhom
Kategórie pre mužov a ženy od 15 rokov a starších
additional: Registrácia prebieha cez platformu pretekaj.sk, kde je potrebné si vytvoriť účet pre správu prihlášok. Partnerské kluby môžu ponúkať vernostné alebo členské karty pre rýchlu registráciu. Podujatie zahŕňa kategórie pre mužov, ženy a deti, štartové časy sú naplánované na 9:30 a 10:30, trať je prevažne asfaltová s časťami po štrkovej ceste.

name: Beh na vrchol Minčola
organizer: Turisti a priaznivci behu na Minčol v spolupráci s Mestom Lipany
description: Beh na vrchol Minčola je tradičný bežecký pretek v Lipanoch, ktorý ponúka náročnú trať s dĺžkou 7 300 metrov a prevýšením 649 metrov. Pretek je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií od najmladších detí až po seniorov a zahŕňa aj súťaž v rámci Vychodniarskej ligy behov do kopca 2025. Organizátormi sú Turisti a priaznivci behu na Minčol v spolupráci s Mestom Lipany. Pretek je vhodný pre všetkých, ktorí majú radi beh do kopca a chcú si zmerať sily v krásnom prírodnom prostredí.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 7 300 m s prevýšením 649 m
Štart v Lúčke nad obecným úradom v Lipanoch
Súťaž v rámci Vychodniarskej ligy behov do kopca 2025
additional: Kategórie pretekárov od prípravky (2017 a ml.) až po seniorov, vrátane kategórií pre Nordic Walking. Organizátorom je mesto Lipany v spolupráci s turistami a priaznivcami behu na Minčol. Štartovné je zvýšené v deň preteku. Súčasťou preteku je Vychodniarska liga behov do kopca 2025. Terén: horský trail, registrácia online alebo na mieste, súčasť pretekov Východniarskej ligy behov do kopca 2025

name: Single-Trail run 30
location: Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom, Slovakia
price_range: 15€ online pred 10.9.2025, 20€ online od 11.9.2025 do 26.9.2025, 20€ na mieste
description: Single-Trail run 30 je bežecký pretek v Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom, ktorý ponúka tri trate s dĺžkami 25 km, 15 km a 7 km. Preteky sú určené pre mužov a ženy bez vekového obmedzenia a organizuje ich O.z. Single-Trail Run 30. Štartovné je dostupné online a na mieste, pričom pretek ponúka možnosť zažiť náročný trailový beh v prírode. Organizátori poskytujú kontaktné informácie pre záujemcov o bližšie informácie.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 25 km, 15 km a 7 km
Preteky v prírodnom prostredí Ruská Nová Ves
Kategórie pre mužov a ženy bez vekového obmedzenia
additional: Preteky organizuje O.z. Single-Trail Run 30. Miesto štartu je Hostinec pod zámkom v Ruská Nová Ves pri budove obecného úradu. Kontaktné osoby sú Lukáš Ferenc, Peter Kačmár a Filip Kušnír s uvedenými telefónnymi číslami. Trať vedie náročným terénom, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, štart a cieľ sú pri Hostinci pod zámkom

name: Čertovskej Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné stejné pro obě trasy: 1 222 Kč

description: Čertovskej Ultratrail is a challenging trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of the mysterious Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj regions. It offers a main 66.6 km route that is also suitable for beginner ultrarunners thanks to well-stocked aid stations and a friendly atmosphere. A shorter 33.3 km course, called Letní půlčert, is also available. The race is part of the prestigious Ultracup series and offers ITRA points to runners. Capacity is limited, so early registration is recommended.

Regular monthly dates, entry fee 20 Kč, on-site registration, children's course 800 m, start at 9:00, registration from 8:15 to 8:55.

name: Běh na Čerchov
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Domažlice, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Čerchov is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series, which offers runners a variety of courses in the Chodsko region. It is suitable for all running enthusiasts who want to experience a challenging yet beautiful run in nature, with views of Čerchov. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: A challenging run over hilly terrain with views of Čerchov
Picturesque natural scenery around Klenčí pod Čerchovem
Part of the long-standing Běžec Chodska running series
additional: The race takes place on June 6, 2026. Runners from various clubs take part. Jiří Voják was the men's winner. The course is technically challenging, with 600 m of elevation gain.

name: Běh okolo Hostěnic
location: Hostěnice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Hostěnice is a running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Hostěnice. It offers a flat 5.83 km course combining paved and forest trails. The race takes place on Saturday, June 6, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. and is suitable for the general public, including children, who have a shorter, age-appropriate course. Organizers David Šálek and Jan Řebíček warmly invite all runners to take part in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Flat 5.83 km course
Combination of paved and forest trails
Age-appropriate children’s course starting at 3:00 p.m.
additional: The children’s run, with a course length suited to the ages of the registered children, starts at 3:00 p.m. The organizers are David Šálek and Jan Řebíček; their contact phone numbers are 777 741 393 and 607 879 140. Registration takes place on an external website; the email address is protected against spam and is not published directly. The race takes place on June 6, 2026, and registration is available through the official website. The event is suitable for all age groups, with shorter-distance races for children.

name: 5, 10, 21 km trail okolo hory pro každého
location: Vysoká u Valašského Meziřičí, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Trail Running Cup is a traditional trail-running race series with a history dating back to 2011. It offers courses of various distances, from 5 to 50 kilometres, in the beautiful countryside of the Czech Republic. The races are suitable for all runners, including children, and make for great fun for the whole family. The series features a range of terrain and difficulty levels, so everyone can find a course to suit them. Overall standings are based on results from individual races held throughout the season.
course_highlights: A range of courses from 5 to 50 km on natural terrain
Races across the Czech Republic in scenic locations
Suitable for all age groups, including children
additional: The 2026 series includes seven races at different dates and venues. Points are awarded according to race placings, with coefficients for selected races. Participants must complete at least one race to be included in the overall standings. The series is open to the general public, offers courses of various distances, and features races across the Czech Republic. Registration is open; exact pricing information is not provided.

name: Běh dobroučským krajem
location: Dolní Dobrouč, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh dobroučským krajem is a traditional running race organised by Atletický klub ISCAREX in the picturesque setting of Dolní Dobrouč in the Pardubice Region. The race offers technically interesting courses with gentle undulations and numerous turns, running along paved paths. The event is open to the public and welcomes experienced runners, recreational athletes and families with children. It is part of the regional ISCAREX pohár running series and provides a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for runners and spectators alike.
course_highlights: The course runs along paved park paths in picturesque surroundings
Undulating profile with gentle climbs and descents
Numerous turns on the loop course
additional: Registration is available online and on site until 20 minutes before the start. Spikes are not permitted. The race is part of the ISCAREX pohár 2026. A great sporting atmosphere and facilities are provided for runners. Categories include children, youth, adults and veterans. The programme also includes a 4×450-metre relay. The race takes place on 6 June 2026. On-site registration, race categories for various age groups, refreshments and a raffle are available.

name: NN Prague Run
location: Průmyslový palác, Holešovice, Praha, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: NN Běh pro SOS Vesničky (3 km)

description: NN Prague Run is a unique race in the heart of Prague, combining athletic performance with the beauty of Prague’s natural surroundings. The route runs through picturesque Stromovka, one of Prague’s largest and most popular parks. The race offers distances for all ages and fitness levels, from children’s races and recreational runners to experienced marathoners. Its flat course is ideal for setting personal records, and runners can choose from a range of distances to suit their abilities and goals.
course_highlights: The route runs through picturesque Stromovka, one of Prague’s largest parks
A flat course ideal for setting personal records
Start and finish at the Holešovice Exhibition Grounds
additional: The race pack includes a race bib with your name, a timing chip, an original medal, a race bag with gifts from partners, refreshments along the course and at the finish, free baggage storage and changing facilities, an SMS with your result as soon as you finish, online results, a downloadable certificate, medical services at the start, along the course and at the finish, nutrition advice from experts, and an accompanying programme including an EXPO village and partner stands. Race in Prague 7, start near the Industrial Palace, half marathon, nighttime atmosphere

name: Běháme pro radost - Help4Africa
description: Běháme pro radost is a traditional charity run held in the village of Smidary, celebrating its 10th edition in 2026. The event supports children’s projects in Africa through Help4Africa, an organization founded by Marcel Doubrava. The run combines physical activity with helping children in need, and participants can see the direct impact of their support through photo documentation from the project site. It is not only a sporting event but also an opportunity to find joy in helping others.
course_highlights: Charity event supporting children in Africa
Choose between 5 km and 10 km routes
Held in the scenic surroundings of Smidary, by the chateau
additional: The charity run supports the Help4Africa project, which helps children in Africa. Organizer Marcel Doubrava has direct contact at the project site and provides photo documentation confirming that aid has been delivered. The event also features a raffle, bringing joy to participants and children in Africa. The event supports children in Africa and takes place on 6 June 2026 in the area around Smidary, with 5 km and 10 km running options.

name: Kounovský kros
location: Kounov u Dobrušky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kounovský kros is a running race organized by TriClub Dobruška, held in the picturesque surroundings of Kounov near Dobruška in the Hradec Králové Region. The race is part of the Dobruška Cup and offers a sporting experience for the general public, including amateur runners. TriClub Dobruška is known for its long-standing tradition and the active involvement of its members and the public in sporting events. The race is suitable for all age groups and levels of running experience.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around Kounov
Part of the Dobruška Cup
Course suitable for amateur and advanced runners
additional: The race is part of the Dobruška Cup series, which includes runs, children’s races, and the Wednesday Cup. It is organized by TriClub Dobruška, z.s., which also provides refreshments and other accompanying activities. The club has a long-standing tradition and actively supports sporting activities in the region. The race takes place on June 6, 2026. The race has a history dating back to the past and is part of the local sporting calendar.

name: Řepočetův výběh
location: Areál přírodního divadla v Horní Rokytnici, Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Liberec, Czech Republic

description: Řepočetův výběh is a unique sporting and social event in Rokytnice nad Jizerou, taking place on 6 June 2026 at the open-air theatre grounds in Horní Rokytnice. The race offers two courses: 19.1 km with 650 m of elevation gain for Řepáci and 12 km with 400 m of elevation gain for Dumliky. The event supports the Run for the Memory of the Nation initiative and offers original race bibs, with the option to donate to the nonprofit organization Post Bellum. The race starts at 14:00, registration opens at 12:00, refreshments are provided after the race, and the venue is accessible on foot only, with parking within walking distance.
course_highlights: Řepáci course: 19.1 km with 650 m of elevation gain
Dumliky course: 12 km with 400 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the open-air theatre grounds in Horní Rokytnice
additional: Registration and participant check-in from 12:00. Categories: women, men under 45, men over 45, children under 15. The venue is accessible on foot only, with parking within walking distance. Refreshments provided after the race. Race bibs featuring a Run for the Memory of the Nation motif; option to donate to the nonprofit organization Post Bellum. Terrain: trail with 650 m of elevation gain; registration from 12:00; start at 14:00; categories: women, men under 45, men over 45, children under 15; parking within walking distance; maps and contact details on the website.

name: 12. Tarczyński Nocny Wrocław Półmaraton
location: Tarczyński Arena Wrocław, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 12th Tarczyński Night Wrocław Half Marathon is one of Wrocław’s most important sporting events and will take place on 6 June 2026. Runners will follow a new, wide and safe course, starting and finishing at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. The half marathon represents the city’s commitment to activity, health and openness, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad, as well as numerous spectators. The event aims to join the ranks of Europe’s largest half marathons, offering a record 21,975 entry packages—a number that refers to the race distance.
course_highlights: A new, wide and safe course
Start and finish at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław
A night race with symbolic significance for the city
additional: Start and finish by Gate A at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. The entry package limit is 21,975, a number referring to the half marathon distance (21.0975 km). The event aims to attract more than 20,000 participants and enter the top ten largest half marathons in Europe. The start has been moved from the Olympic Stadium to Tarczyński Arena to accommodate more participants. The new course starts and finishes at Tarczyński Arena, with a focus on safety and cooperation with emergency services, as well as changes to traffic and public transport arrangements.

name: II Półmaraton Miasteczkowskich Lasów
location: Miasteczko Śląskie, Tarnowskie Góry County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Góra Jerzego w Miasteczku Śląskim

description: The 2nd Miasteczkowskie Forests Half Marathon is organised by the Góra Jerzego Association in Miasteczko Śląskie and will take place on 6 June 2026. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.5 km long and runs through the town’s streets, the Świerklaniec Forest District and the Tarnowskie Góry municipality. The start and finish are at the stadium next to the Sports and Recreation Centre, allowing spectators to follow the race conveniently. The event will also include a 5 km race and children’s races over various distances, promoting physical activity among the local community.
course_highlights: The course partly runs through the streets of Miasteczko Śląskie
It passes through the Świerklaniec Forest District and the Tarnowskie Góry municipality
The start and finish are at the stadium next to the Sports and Recreation Centre, with spectator stands
additional: The time limit is 4 hours for the half marathon and 1 hour for the 5 km race. Children’s races cover distances from 100 to 500 m on the CSIR sports field. The start and finish are at the Sports and Recreation Centre field, at the intersection of Dworcowa and Sportowa streets. Participants should be at the start at 10:50. The programme includes children’s races; registration is via Raatiming; the course uses the stadium and streets; the promotional period runs until 10 May 2026; parking is available nearby.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
description: The Poznań Beer Mile is an annual cross-country race held in Poznań, attracting runners who appreciate scenic routes and a sporting atmosphere. The event is part of a series of races organized by enthusiasts from the Greater Poland region, who have been promoting running and the beauty of local areas since 2014. The race features start groups with participant limits, allowing for a comfortable experience and good organization. Particular emphasis is placed on the scenic qualities of the route and bringing runners together.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Start groups capped at 60 participants
Routes with scenic appeal and a sporting character
additional: Starts take place in waves every 20 minutes from 12:00 to 15:40, including two HARD waves and a “0%” group. Each group is limited to 60 participants. The schedule of group starts with participant limits, and the event on a summer evening promotes activity and having fun.

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: The Kurpiowski Pśejåk Half Marathon follows the route of the SGO "Narew" combat bunkers in Nowogród. The half-marathon course passes through historic areas dotted with numerous combat bunkers, giving the race a unique character and combining sport with history. The event attracts runners who value both off-road challenges and the atmosphere of the Kurpiowszczyzna region. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and learn about local history.
course_highlights: The course follows the route of the SGO "Narew" combat bunkers
The race takes place in the picturesque Kurpiowszczyzna region
A 21.097 km half marathon combining sport with history
additional: The event includes races over various distances, including a half marathon and shorter distances, with options for different age groups. The race promotes local history and nature, and participants can look forward to attractive routes and an atmosphere conducive to sporting competition.

description: Ultramaraton Babia Góra is a prestigious mountain race taking place on 6 June 2026 in Lipnica Wielka. The event offers various distances, including ultramarathons involving multiple laps of Babia Góra and shorter races such as SkyRace®. The course runs through the scenic areas of Babia Góra National Park, with challenging climbs and spectacular views. The event promotes an active lifestyle and supports the charitable work of the Rak’n’Roll Foundation. The organiser provides aid stations, medical support, and the option to have drop bags delivered to the course for the longest distances.
course_highlights: The course runs through Babia Góra National Park and includes multiple ascents of Babia Góra
Checkpoint cut-off times on key sections of the course
Scenic views and challenging climbs on mountain trails
additional: Start and finish at Polana Stańcowa in Lipnica Wielka. Race office open on 5 June from 18:00 to 20:00. Participant limits apply to individual races; registration is suspended once a limit is reached. Aid stations are available on the course, and drop bags can be delivered for the 6xBabia Góra Ultramarathon. Mandatory cut-off times apply at checkpoints; missing a cut-off results in disqualification from the remainder of the race. Medical and GOPR mountain rescue support is provided. Runners must report their withdrawal by SMS if they stop racing. Registration is limited for some distances; the course includes Polana Stańcowa and Lipnica Wielka, with a checkpoint at the PTTK Markowe Szczawiny Mountain Hostel. Accommodation is available in Lipnica Wielka.

name: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84
description: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84 is a race held in Wieluń and part of Liga Biegowa, a platform promoting physical activity and running competitions in Poland. The event is open to runners at various distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. Liga Biegowa allows participants to earn points and compete in numerous rankings throughout the year, encouraging regular running and athletic development. The race is open and inclusive, welcoming both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Marathon distance (42 km)
Scenic route in Wieluń
Annual traditional running event
additional: Liga Biegowa is a year-round running platform that automatically records results for races at 5 km, 10 km, half-marathon and marathon distances, converts them into points and enables competition in numerous rankings. Participants can create private leagues and access materials on training, diet and sports psychology. No details are available about the route, registration or other notes concerning this specific race.

name: Kwietny Bieg
description: The Kwietny Bieg in Lisowice is a unique 24-hour running relay that commemorates the spirit of freedom awakened by Pope John Paul II during his first pilgrimage to Poland. The race takes place on a certified 1,352-metre loop that is clearly marked and illuminated after dark. The event is open to everyone and is growing in popularity, attracting a record number of participants. Everyone who completes 10 Flower Miles (35.3 km) receives a certificate and commemorative medal. It is not only a sporting competition, but also a community event with an atmosphere full of positive energy.
course_highlights: A 1,352-metre loop certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
A clearly marked course illuminated after dark with torches and lights
A relay running along Poland’s borders, with the Flower Mile (3,530 m) as its symbolic unit
additional: The race takes place on a 24-hour loop, with participants running in a relay while carrying a red-and-white sash. After completing 10 Flower Miles (35.3 km), participants receive a certificate and medal. The course is illuminated after dark, and the race is open to everyone and free of charge. 24-hour relay race, 1,352 m course certified by the PZLA, free entry, record number of participants

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique street race held in the magical setting of Toruń, the city of Copernicus. Participants can choose from the 10 km and 5 km distances, Nordic Walking, and a special children’s race, “Odkrywcy Mocy” (“Discoverers of Power”). The event takes place at night, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and appeal. The start and finish are located in the city, and the organizers provide full logistical support and attractive race packs.
course_highlights: A night race through the streets of Toruń, the city of Copernicus
10 km start at Galeria Copernicus; finish at the Municipal Stadium
Available events: 10 km, 5 km, Nordic Walking, and children’s races
additional: The race office is open on June 6, 2026, from 15:00 to 21:00 at Galeria Copernicus, next to the Decathlon store. A baggage drop is available at the start, with bags transported to the finish. The 10 km starts at Galeria Copernicus; the 5 km and Nordic Walking start from Józef Piłsudski Bridge (Camping Tramp). The finish is at the Municipal Stadium. Time limits are 1 hour 20 minutes for the 10 km, 50 minutes for the 5 km, and 60 minutes for Nordic Walking. PZLA-certified courses; fast, flat routes; 22:00 start; various distances; children’s race; medals and prizes; opportunity to take a guided walk.

name: Sudecki Festiwal Biegów Gorskich
description: The Sudecki Mountain Running Festival is a continuation of the Runs Along the Riese Trail in a new format, held in the scenic area around Głuszyca. The festival offers three distances: Sudecki Olbrzym (43 km), Półmaraton Szlakiem Riese (22 km), and Historyczna Dycha (10 km), with routes available in GPX format. The event attracts mountain running enthusiasts with challenging yet beautiful routes in the Sudetes. The organizer provides professional support and rankings in the international ITRA and UTMB Index systems.
course_highlights: Mountain routes of 10 km, 22 km, and 43 km
Scenic Sudetes landscapes and historic trails
Route profiles available in GPX format
additional: The race routes are available to download in GPX format. The event is ranked in the international ITRA and UTMB Index systems. The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Walim Na Żądanie, based in Głuszyca. mountain routes, online registration, access to GPX files

name: XII Festiwal Biegu Rzeźnika
description: The 12th Rzeźnik Running Festival will take place from June 3 to 6, 2026, in Cisna. This exceptional running event in the Bieszczady Mountains offers a wide choice of distances, from 5 km to an extreme 500 km, including ultraruns, marathons, and children’s races. The routes pass through the picturesque mountain terrain of the Beskids, offering unforgettable views and challenges for runners of varying experience levels. The festival also offers the opportunity to take part in hiking and cycling events and other accompanying activities.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the Bieszczady Mountains, ranging from 5 km to 500 km
Scenic views and challenging climbs on the ultra and marathon routes
Special races for children and Nordic walking events
additional: The festival features numerous races at various distances, including Rzeźnicka Piątka (5 km), Dycha Na Jeleni Skok (12 km), Rzeźnicki Marsz z Walking Lovers (16 km), Rzeźniczek (28 km), Maraton Rzeźnika (52 km), Rzeźnik Ultra (95 km), Bieg Rzeźnika + Hardcore (80 km and 106 km), Rzeźnicki Szlem (175 km), and the stage-based Rzeźnik 500 hiking event. Children’s races cover distances from 100 to 2,000 m. The festival also includes hiking and cycling events and accompanying activities. Registration via voucher, children’s race participation, the detailed schedule, and results are available on the website.

name: XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny
location: Győr, Rónay Jácint u., Győr-Moson-Sopron, Hungary
description: The XXIV Büchl Night Run will take place on June 6, 2026, in Győr, at Tulipános Primary School. The event offers several distances, including a children’s race, individual 7, 14 and 21 km races, a three-person half-marathon relay, and 7 km Nordic walking. Runners receive a unique finisher’s medal, chip timing, refreshments and medical support. The courses are clearly marked and supported by police. Race packs are available to participants in the longer-distance races, and registration is confirmed once payment has been made by bank transfer.
course_highlights: Clearly marked route with course marshals and police support
7 km route on a designated loop through Sziget, the city centre and Révfalu
14 km and 21 km routes comprising two and three laps, respectively
additional: Registration is confirmed once the entry fee has been paid by bank transfer. On-site collection of race numbers in advance is available at two times: June 5, 2026, from 15:00 to 18:00, and June 6, 2026, from 9:00 to 12:00, at 51 Dózsa György Quay. Participants registering on the day are not guaranteed this year’s unique finisher’s medal; medals from previous years will be available only while stocks last. Entry fees are non-refundable, but 50% of the amount paid can be credited toward the entry fee for a future race, following prior arrangement. Awards, race-pack collection and safety services will be available at the event, and participants can transfer or amend their registration. Necessary equipment and support will be provided on site.

name: Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton
location: Bisinger József park, Győr, Győr-Moson-Sopron County, Hungary
description: The Büchl Night Half Marathon is a traditional nighttime running event in Győr, offering running enthusiasts several distances, including a children’s race, individual races, and relays. The event hub is Tulipános Primary School, and participants can expect a well-organized event with chip timing, refreshment stations, medical support, and police supervision. Entrants receive a unique finisher’s medal, and a race pack is also provided for the 14 km and 21 km distances. The event aims to offer runners of all ages an enjoyable and safe running experience.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.3 km children’s race; 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km individual races
Three-person half-marathon relay and 7 km Nordic walking distance
Marked route with marshals and police supervision
additional: Advance bib pickup is available at two times: on the day before the race and on race day. Early registrants receive a unique finisher’s medal. Chip timing, a downloadable certificate, refreshment stations, and medical support are provided. Once the entry fee has been paid, registration is final and non-refundable, but 50% of the payment may be credited toward a future race by prior arrangement. The event provides chip timing, a finisher’s medal, refreshments, route marshals, and medical support. Advance registration is recommended.

name: Bükk Hegyi Maraton
location: Majális park, Miskolc, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén County, Hungary
description: The Bükk Mountain Marathon–Ádám Kisgyörgy Memorial Race is Hungary’s oldest trail marathon. It will take place on June 6, 2026, at Majális Park in Miskolc. The race offers a range of distances, from the marathon to the minimarathon, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. Runners compete amid the scenic natural beauty of the Bükk Mountains, while the race unfolds continuously at the event center, known as the “forest stadium.” The event aims to foster friendships through sport, promote a healthy lifestyle, and showcase the natural values of the Bükk.
course_highlights: Forest roads of varying quality and paved sections in the Bükk Mountains
330 meters of elevation gain per lap on the 10.6 km course
Competitors return to the forest stadium after each lap, allowing spectators to follow the race throughout
additional: The race center is at Miskolc, Majális Park–Királyasztal, where relay team members send their teammates on their way from the forest stadium. The course consists almost entirely of forest roads of varying quality; the marathon time limit is 6 hours. The minimarathon distance can be completed either running or hiking. Competitors return to the race center after each lap, allowing spectators to follow the race throughout. A trail-running race with multiple distances for amateur and professional athletes in a nature-rich setting.

name: Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál
location: Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő, Cegléd, Pest County, Hungary
description: The 5th Ceglédfürdő Running Festival will take place on June 6, 2026, at the Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő és Szabadidőközpont. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and introduce people of all ages to the joy of running. Participants can choose from several distances, from a 300-meter toddler race to a half marathon and relay races. Runners can enjoy views of the beautiful lake and the spa as they make their way along the synthetic-surface running track. Related activities, awards, and admission to the spa add to the experience.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő és Aquapark grounds, along a synthetic-surface running track.
Runners circle the lake several times, with six opportunities to admire the spa.
Music stations and a variety of musical styles add to the running experience.
additional: On race day, the 300 m toddler race and 800 m children's race start at 8:20, the 2 km fun run and leisure walk at 8:40, and all other distances (from 3.5 km to 28 km, as well as relays) at 9:30. The cut-off time for the half marathon and 28 km distance is 2 hours 45 minutes. Participants can change, shower, and use lockers in the beach changing rooms. Runners receive a finisher's pack and medal, as well as admission to Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő on race day. Entry fees are non-refundable if an entry is cancelled, and the fee depends on when payment is made. Payment by bank card or bank transfer is accepted. Participants can choose from several distances in a family-friendly atmosphere, with wellness and leisure activities also on offer. The organizers place particular emphasis on ensuring that everyone enjoys themselves and spends the day actively.

name: Crazy5K
location: Budaörsi Repülőtér, Budaörs, Pest County, Hungary
description: CRAZY5K is a unique 5 km obstacle race featuring 10 enormous inflatable obstacles. The event is about having fun rather than performance, making it a great day out with friends, family or colleagues. A dedicated family race is also available for families with children under 10, with a surprise in store for the kids. The event takes place at Budaörs Airport, where parking is available. The entry fee includes a race bib, T-shirt, finisher’s pack, custom medal, refreshments, use of the bag drop and medical supervision.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 10 huge inflatable obstacles
Fun and playful challenges alongside the run
Family race for children under 10, with a surprise
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib, T-shirt (available for collection at the venue), finisher’s pack, custom finisher’s medal, refreshment point, free use of the bag drop, medical supervision, and access to the men’s and women’s changing rooms. Parking is available at the venue for 1000 Ft per car. Obstacles may be bypassed, but for safety reasons participants must go around them in a wide arc. Group entries receive a 10% discount for 10–19 people and a 15% discount for more than 20 people; the discount applies only to participants starting in the same time slot. Entries can be transferred for a modification fee of 2000 Ft per person. On-site transfers are also possible, subject to availability. Inflatable obstacles, family race, fun, registration available

name: MOKÜ Run
location: Kismaros Focipálya, Liget utca, Kismaros, Hungary

name: Bathory Run
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Sedliska, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Sedliska a MV Running team Sedliska
description: Bathory Run je bežecké podujatie v obci Sedliska pri Vranove nad Topľou, ktoré ponúka trate pre deti, dorast a dospelých. Pretekári bežia členitým terénom cez ovocný sad, čo dodáva behu príjemný prírodný charakter. Štart je rozdelený na detské kategórie o 10:30 a pre mužov a ženy o 13:00. Organizátormi sú Obec Sedliska a MV Running team Sedliska, ktorí zabezpečujú kvalitný priebeh pretekov pre všetky vekové kategórie.
course_highlights: Členitý terén cez ovocný sad
Štart na futbalovom ihrisku v Sedliskách
Viacero vekových kategórií vrátane detských a dorasteneckých
additional: Štart detí o 10:30, mužov a žien o 13:00. Kategórie pretekov zahŕňajú detské, dorastenecké, 10 km a 5 km trate s rozdelením podľa veku a pohlavia. Organizátori: Obec Sedliska a MV Running team Sedliska. Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku, registrácia je online, štarty sú naplánované na 11:00 pre deti a 13:00 pre dospelých.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Charity Run
location: Námestie pod OD Billa, Trebišov, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Trebišov, Stredná odborná škola služieb a priemyslu sv. Jozafáta
description: Charity Run v Trebišove je tradičným podujatím, ktoré spája beh, prechádzku, nordic walking a jazdu na bicykli. Tento charitatívny beh ponúka príležitosť spoznať mesto Trebišov a zároveň podporiť dobrú vec. Podujatie organizuje Majcher-Production s.r.o. a je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť, ktorá chce aktívne stráviť čas a prispieť na charitu.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie centrom mesta Trebišov, námestím pod OD Billa
Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne formy pohybu: beh, prechádzku, nordic walking a jazdu na bicykli
Charitatívny charakter podujatia spája šport s podporou komunity
additional: Podujatie zahŕňa aj aktivity ako cyklistika, prechádzky a behy v maskách, s možnosťou registrácie na rôzne vzdialenosti a úrovne. Súčasťou je aj sprievodný program, občerstvenie a koncerty.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 4. kolo

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 eur (len kategórie dospelých, deti štartovné neplatia)

description: Šamorínska bežecká liga (ŠBL) je séria bežeckých pretekov organizovaných 3klubom Šamorín, určená pre širokú verejnosť bez vekových a výkonnostných limitov. Pretekári sú hodnotení v kategóriách muži, ženy, chlapci a dievčatá, pričom detské behy majú kratšie vzdialenosti. Liga prebieha počas celého roka a zahŕňa aj tradičnú akciu Pomlé Run. Štartovné zahŕňa štartové čísla, meranie časov, občerstvenie a vyhodnocovanie ligy. V poslednom kole prebehne oficiálne vyhodnotenie celkovej ligy s ocenením najlepších pretekárov.
course_highlights: Lesopark Pomlé v Šamoríne ako štart a cieľ
Rôzne kategórie s kratšími a dlhšími vzdialenosťami (100 m až 5 km)
Bežecké trate v prírodnom prostredí s občerstvením v cieli
additional: Štart detských kategórií je postupný od 10:00 (predškoláci 100 m, mladší žiaci 700 m, starší žiaci 700 m) a dospelí štartujú o 10:30. Prezentácia prebieha od 9:00 do 30 minút pred štartom kategórie na lúke v lesoparku Pomlé. K dispozícii sú WC a šatňa v priestoroch Amfiteátra. Štartovné zahŕňa štartové čísla, meranie časov, občerstvenie v cieli a tombolu. Škôlkari dostanú medailu po dobehnutí, ale nebudú vyhodnocovaní. Podujatie je súčasťou série, ktorá prebieha od marca do októbra 2026, s rôznymi kategóriami pre všetky vekové skupiny, lokalita Lesopark Pomlé.

name: Šebešská pätnástka
location: Nevického chatu, Vyšná Šebastová, Prešov, Slovakia
price_range: 12,- € online pred 27.5.2025; 20,- € na mieste; 4 km zadarmo
description: Šebešská pätnástka sú bežecké preteky organizované klubom MTC Vyšná Šebastová v spolupráci s obecným úradom Vyšná Šebastová a športovými združeniami. Hlavná trať meria 15,5 km s výbehom na Nevického chatu, doplnená je o rekreačnú 3 km trať a detské disciplíny pre rôzne vekové kategórie. Preteky sa konajú každoročne v nedeľu prvého júnového víkendu s dopoludňajším štartom a bohatým kultúrno-spoločenským programom, ktorý priláka stovky návštevníkov. Podujatie je súčasťou viacerých bežeckých súťaží a ligy, pričom organizátori kladú dôraz na rozvoj športu a budovanie mena obce. Šebešská pätnástka získala ocenenie Bežecký diamant v rokoch 2011 a 2012.
course_highlights: Hlavná trať 15,5 km s výbehom na Nevického chatu
Rekreačná trať 3 km vhodná pre širokú verejnosť
Detské disciplíny pre predškolákov až juniorov
additional: Preteky sú sprevádzané bohatým kultúrno-spoločenským programom, tombolou a vystúpeniami hudobných skupín. Súčasťou je aj zaradenie do oblastných bežeckých súťaží a Východoslovenskej veľkej ceny vytrvalcov (VVCV). Riaditeľ pretekov Ján Tomčo je aktívny bežec a zakladateľ klubu MTC Vyšná Šebastová, ktorý vnáša do podujatia ducha fairplay a bojovnosti. Trať zahŕňa výstup na Nevického chatu, súčasťou sú aj detské disciplíny a bohatý kultúrny program, ocenenia a uznania.

name: Mnichovohradištská patnáctka, memoriál ing. Josefa Hrona
location: Náměstí T.G. Masaryka, Mnichovo Hradiště, Czech Republic
description: Mnichovohradištská Patnáctka is a road race featuring a gently rolling, out-and-back 15 km course, held in Mnichovo Hradiště at T.G. Masaryk Square. The course has a quality asphalt surface and marked kilometers, helping runners pace themselves. The race is held in memory of Ing. Josef Hron and offers a pleasant atmosphere for all runners. The start is at 10:00, and the organizer is Vladimír Koudelka. The race is suitable for runners looking for a quality road race with tradition.
course_highlights: Gently rolling out-and-back road course
Quality asphalt surface
Kilometer markers along the course
additional: The race is held in memory of Ing. Josef Hron. The organizer is Vladimír Koudelka; contact by phone: 606 432 483. The course is out-and-back, with marked kilometers. The race is dedicated to the memory of Ing. Josef Hron and offers two distances (15 km and 25 km). The start is at 10:00, and registration is available online and on site.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
description: Běh 2 míle Olomouc is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all age groups. Each participant primarily competes against themselves, giving the race a friendly and motivating atmosphere. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Smetanovy sady in Olomouc, making for an enjoyable running experience. The race is suitable for beginners as well as experienced runners looking to test their speed over a short distance.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.2 km) course
Race in the picturesque Smetanovy sady park in Olomouc
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race is part of a broader sporting calendar and is suitable for runners of all levels. No specific fees or registration requirements have been announced so far.

name: Běh přes Červený vrch
description: The Běh přes Červený vrch is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub ISCAREX in the picturesque setting of Dolní Čermná in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a technically interesting course with gentle undulations and numerous turns, suitable for a wide range of runners, from recreational athletes to experienced competitors. The event is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and provides quality facilities for both runners and spectators. You can register online or on site on race day, which takes place on June 7, 2026.
course_highlights: A technically interesting course with an undulating profile
Numerous turns on paved paths
Picturesque natural surroundings in Dolní Čermná
additional: The race is part of the Iscarex Cup series and offers races for children and adults. Registration is open until 11:30. The race takes place in June 2026.

name: Chotucká šlapka
location: Zámecký park, Křinec, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Chotucká šlapka is a traditional running race in Křinec. It began in 2012 as a duathlon and has been held as a trail-only run since 2020. The race offers two courses: the main 11 km course and a shorter 5.5 km course, both running mostly along trails with a small amount of asphalt. The start and finish are in the castle park, and the route passes through scenic countryside with several hills and aid stations. The race is open to the general public, with capacity limited to 100 runners. Participants receive personalized bibs, refreshments, and wooden medals.
course_highlights: The course is a 5.5 km loop comprising 80% trail and 20% asphalt
The main race covers two loops (11 km); the shorter race covers one loop (5.5 km)
The route passes through the castle park, Bažantnice, the cemetery, Chotuc, and other natural areas
additional: Race capacity is limited to 100 runners. Bibs are personalized with the runner’s name for registrations received by 30.05.2026. Men’s and women’s changing rooms are available, along with refreshments on the course and at the finish and wooden medals for all participants. Results are announced after the last runner finishes. Children’s races begin at 11:00, with staggered starts from 12:00. The race takes place on 7 June 2026, also offers children’s races, and is part of the Postřižinská Running League.

price_range: 400,- Kč pro hlavní závod, 50,- Kč pro dětské závody

description: Babický Trail 1/4 Marathon is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Babický Forest. The event offers two main routes, 10.55 km and 5.95 km long, running mostly along forest roads and trails with gentle elevation changes. Children’s categories with shorter distances are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and emphasizes a community atmosphere and the joy of exercising outdoors. The main race is limited to 200 participants, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly along forest roads and trails in Babický Forest
The main race is 10.55 km long with 160 m of elevation gain
Children’s races feature distances from 300 m to 1,500 m
additional: Registration and race bib collection take place from 08:30 to 09:45. The children’s races start between 09:45 and 10:01, and the main race starts at 11:00, with the 1/4 and 1/8 marathons starting together. The main race is limited to 200 participants. Parking is available at the Babice Sports Complex and on surrounding streets; participants are asked not to park in front of driveways to family homes. The main race route is 38% forest roads, 56% forest trails, and 6% road. The event offers participant medals, online registration, limited capacity for the main race, and results services.

name: Skalecký kros
location: Skalka, Mníšek pod Brdy, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: Skalecký Cross-Country Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Baroque grounds of Skalka in Mníšek pod Brdy. It offers 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races, running along forest paths and paved roads. The main race starts at 11:30 and is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children and teenagers. The event is organized by SK Mníšecko, z.s., which ensures professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs along forest paths and paved roads
Start and finish in the Baroque grounds of Skalka
The main course is approximately 10 km long
additional: Registration is available online and on site. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. Children’s races are available. Results are published in the system and as a PDF. The organizers provide timing and statistics. Start and finish in the Baroque grounds of Skalka. The event offers courses of various distances; the main race starts at 11:30, the terrain includes forest paths and paved roads, and children’s races are also included.

name: Červenkovská desítka
description: Červenkovská desítka is a 10 km road race held in Červenka, near Olomouc. The race is part of the 2026 Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners. The out-and-back course runs from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renoty and back, mostly on roads. Runners are divided into age categories, and category winners receive prizes in kind. The results ceremony will take place at the race venue, Hostinec u Nádraží, and results will be published on hanackybeh.cz.
course_highlights: Out-and-back course from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renoty and back
The course runs on roads
Start and finish at Hostinec U Nádraží in Červenka
additional: Race-day registration takes place at the venue. Runners must have a chip card with a balance of at least CZK 150; otherwise, they must top it up. The race is governed by road-running rules, and everyone runs at their own risk. The race is at the participants’ own risk; registration is conducted using a chip card and is subject to the credit requirements. Participants can look forward to small prizes in kind for category winners.

name: Milada Run
location: Milada Lake, Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem District, Czech Republic
description: Milada Run is a popular sporting event held in the unique landscape of a former lignite mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada. The event offers various routes, including a half marathon, 10 km race and children’s races, along undulating and flat paths with views of the lake. The atmosphere is family-friendly and welcoming, making it suitable for all ages and running levels. All races are part of the Milada Tour series, which runners themselves praise for its high standards and popularity.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route has two loops, one with views directly over the lake
The 10 km route follows paved paths with a flat profile, suitable for all runners
Children’s races of 500 m and 1 km take place near the main beach, with parents supervising
additional: A race bib printed with your name is available if the entry fee is paid by 16 May 2026. Medals for all participants. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. A free children’s T-shirt for the first 100 children to register. The event has a capacity of 500 participants. Family-friendly and welcoming atmosphere. Series points are awarded for the main adult races. Routes: half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and children’s races; the event takes place at Lake Milada; children’s activities; registration and winners’ awards.

name: Konopišťská desítka
location: Konopiště u Benešova, Benešov, Czech Republic
description: The Konopiště Ten is a traditional 10 km running race held in the beautiful setting of the Konopiště open-air theatre and park near Benešov. The race is part of the Benešov Running Festival and offers the chance to compete in the main race, relays and children’s categories. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a run in scenic surroundings with high-quality organisation. The 30th anniversary edition will take place on 7 June 2026.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Konopiště open-air theatre and park
A 10 km race with relay and children’s categories
Scenic surroundings, with high-quality technical support and timing by SPORT BASE
additional: The race is part of the Benešov Running Festival. The programme includes children’s races, relays and the Buď Fit run. Timing is provided by SPORT BASE. The organisers provide technical support, and the awards ceremony takes place at the venue. Results are available online and in PDF format. The race takes place on 7 June 2026; online registration is available, and the event includes various age categories and relays.

name: Bolfánek třikrát jinak
description: Bolfánek Three Ways is a running race organised by the Pro Sport Activities agency in Chudenice, in the Plzeň Region. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and offers an unusual format in which competitors complete the course in three different ways. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own categories. The organisers emphasise the sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Three different ways to complete the course in a single race
Beautiful natural surroundings and terrain around Chudenice
Children’s categories with appealing routes for young runners
additional: A relay race is possible: each team consists of 3 runners, each of whom runs one section of the race. Relay entries should be sent by email. Prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each category and relay. Pupils from the Kryry nursery and primary schools, and residents of the town of Kryry, can enter for free. The event consists of three runs featuring an uphill climb, stairs and a forest trail. Registration is available online or on site. The event is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series.

name: Mnichovická běhna

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrační poplatek : 150 Kč/osoba (při platbě předem). Platba na místě: 200 Kč

description: Mnichovická běhna is an amateur running race through the beautiful Central Bohemian countryside, featuring a challenging course approximately 7–8 km long with around 200 metres of elevation gain. The race offers varied terrain with steep climbs and descents, running on paved paths, through forest, meadows and pastureland, accompanied by domestic and wild animals. The start and finish have been moved to the sports complex at Šibeniční vrch, at the Podhorky sports field. All runners receive a commemorative medal and certificate; category winners receive trophies and a small surprise. Mnichovická běhna is part of the Ladův kraj Cup running series, and everyone who finishes the race safe and sound is a winner.
course_highlights: 7–8 km course with approximately 200 m of elevation gain
Terrain includes paved paths, forest, meadows and pastureland
Challenging sections with steep climbs and descents
additional: All participants receive race numbers and medals; the first three finishers in the women’s and men’s categories receive trophies and a surprise. Check-in and race-number collection take place from 9:00 to 9:45. There are drinking-water stations along the course, and additional refreshments are available at the Šibeniční vrch restaurant. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The race is limited to a maximum of 100 runners. Parking is available on Bezručova Street by the elementary school. The race is open to adults aged 15 and over. Registration takes place from 9:00 to 9:45. Refreshments are included in the entry fee, and all participants receive a medal. Parking is available by ZŠ Bezručova and at the Podhorky sports field. Dogs are not allowed on the course.

name: Babický Trail 1/4 maraton
location: Babice u Říčan, Praha-východ, Czech Republic
price_range: 400,- Kč za hlavní závod, 50,- Kč za dětský závod na 300 m, 150,- Kč za dětský závod na 1000 m
