description: The Babice Trail Quarter Marathon is a traditional running race held in the beautiful Babice forest near Říčany. It offers two main routes, 10.55 km and 5.95 km long, with 160 m and 60 m of elevation gain, respectively, running mostly along forest roads and trails. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who have their own shorter courses. The event has a community-focused feel, and the organisers emphasise a friendly atmosphere and support for the running community in Babice.
course_highlights: The main race route runs through the Babice forest, with 160 m of elevation gain over 10.55 km
Mostly forest roads and trails, with very little asphalt
Children’s races on courses from 300 m to 1,500 m, suitable for different age groups
additional: Registration and race-number collection take place from 08:30 to 09:45. Children’s races start from 09:45 to 10:01, and the main race starts at 11:00, with the quarter and eighth marathons starting together. The main race is limited to 200 participants. Online registration is available, as is registration on race morning for a 100% surcharge. Parking is available by the sports complex and on nearby streets; please do not park in front of driveways to family homes. Forest course; limited capacity for the main race; unlimited places in the children’s races; start at the Babice Sports Complex.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
location: Kazimierz Biskupi, Gniezno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Run Under the Millennial Oaks is a unique sporting event held in picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of Bieniszew Forest. The race brings together sport, history, and the beauty of the local landscape, taking participants along an avenue of millennial oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, beginners, and families alike, with races over various distances and a Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Aktywny Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Municipality of Kazimierz Biskupi, and the race tradition dates back to the beginning of the 21st century.
course_highlights: The course follows a picturesque avenue of millennial oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve
The race takes place in the heart of Bieniszew Forest, offering a chance to connect with nature
Running courses of 10 km and 5 km are available, along with a 5 km Nordic walking event
additional: Race-day check-in and race bib distribution take place the day before the race (June 6, 2026) from 17:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 8:30 to 12:15. The 10 km main race starts at 13:00; the 5 km accompanying race and 5 km Nordic walking event start at 13:10. The time limit for completing the race is 14:40. The winners’ awards ceremony and event closing take place after the race at 14:45. Participant limits: 250 for the main race, 150 for the accompanying race, and 100 for Nordic walking. The event was revived for the first time in 2007, with online registration available. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and certificates.

name: Bieg Śladem Konia
location: Wrocław, Tor Wyścigów Konnych na Partynicach, Wrocław, Poland
description: Bieg Śladem Konia is an annual running event organised by the Wrocław PIAST Running Club. It takes place at the Partynice horse racing track in Wrocław. The event has a recreational and sporting character and attracts both amateur and more experienced runners. The route runs through scenic surroundings, combining natural landscapes with an urban setting. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the running community together.
course_highlights: Route at the Partynice horse racing track
Scenic natural areas and urban surroundings
Organised by the experienced WKB PIAST running club
additional: The event is organised by the Wrocław PIAST Running Club, which also organises other races in the region. Results from previous years are available on the website. The main website and archived rules do not provide detailed information about start waves, participant limits or entry fees. The event takes place in the area around the horse racing track, with attractions for families, horse shows, activities for children, a market and food vendors.

name: I Bieg po Jagodę Kamczacką
location: Plantacja jagody kamczackiej, Muniakowice, Kraków, Poland
description: The 1st Haskap Berry Run is a unique sporting event that combines a passion for running with the idea of a healthy lifestyle and being close to nature. The event takes place at PLANTIN’s haskap berry plantation in Muniakowice near Kraków, with the start, finish and event base located in the heart of the plantation. The run is part of the Berry Relay and promotes conscious food choices and local products. It is not only a competition, but also a gathering of people who value outdoor activity and authentic experiences.
course_highlights: The course runs through a haskap berry plantation
The start and finish are located on the premises of PLANTIN in Muniakowice
The run combines sport with the ideas of health and natural energy
additional: The start, finish and event base are at PLANTIN’s haskap berry plantation in Muniakowice near Kraków. The run is part of the 2026 Berry Relay. Details and updates are available on the race’s Facebook profile. The start, finish and event base are at the haskap berry plantation in Muniakowice near Kraków; the event opens the 2026 Berry Relay; in cooperation with the Bieg Rolnika Foundation.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Warszawa

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za udział dzieci i młodzieży

description: IRONMAN 70.3 Warsaw is a prestigious triathlon held in the heart of Poland’s capital, combining a swim in Zegrze Reservoir, a 90 km bike ride to central Warsaw, and a half-marathon run. The event attracts both experienced triathletes and amateurs, offering the chance to qualify for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. The atmosphere is filled with sporting excitement and the historic spirit of Warsaw, and the finish line is at the Multimedia Fountain Park, adding a distinctive character to the competition.
course_highlights: 1.9 km swim in Zegrze Reservoir
90 km bike course leading to central Warsaw
21.1 km run finishing at the Multimedia Fountain Park
additional: The swim cut-off is 1 hour 10 minutes, and the combined swim and bike cut-off is 5 hours 30 minutes. The overall race cut-off is 8 hours 30 minutes. The start and finish are located at the Multimedia Fountain Park. Athletes can qualify for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship 2026 in Nice. Athlete services include bike rental, bike transfer, bike build and pack, finisher photos, medal engraving, a camper park, licenses, and accommodation. The event also includes IRONKIDS, Night Run, and other triathlon activities; it is sponsored by Enea. Relay options and services such as bike rental and transfers are available.

name: Pogórzański Festiwal Biegowy - Lato
location: Burzyn, Tuchów, Tarnów County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Pogórzański Running Festival - Summer is a running event taking place on June 7, 2026, in Burzyn near Tuchów. The event promotes running and a healthy lifestyle among the residents of Małopolska, offering races of various distances, including a 22 km mountain race, a 10 km race, a 5.5 km race, and Nordic Walking. The start and finish are at the LKS Burzyn stadium by the Primary School in Burzyn, where changing rooms and showers are also available. Participants receive a race package with a gift, water, and snacks along the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: 22 km mountain race with 800 m of total elevation gain
4 aid stations along the 22 km course
The time limit for the 22 km race is 240 minutes

The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 13:30–14:00. The race office, baggage deposit, changing rooms, and showers are in the hall at the Primary School in Burzyn, next to the stadium. The participant limit has been reached. The race office is in the sports hall; changing rooms, a baggage deposit, and showers are available. The race package includes a gift, water, snacks, and medical care.

name: Test Coopera dla wszystkich
description: Cooper Test for Everyone is a nationwide, free physical fitness test in which participants cover the greatest possible distance in 12 minutes. The test is open to everyone, regardless of age, gender or running experience. Participants receive a race bib, a certificate with their result and a bottle of water. It is a great opportunity to check your fitness and get motivated to stay physically active.
course_highlights: 12 minutes of continuous running or walking
An endurance test developed by Dr Kenneth H. Cooper
Open to participants of all ages and levels of running experience
additional: Participation is free. Each participant receives a race bib, a certificate with their result and a bottle of water. You can run, walk or hop, as long as you travel on foot. The test takes place nationwide in many cities, including Opole. Nationwide fitness test, various cities, online registration, certificate and prizes

name: VI EKO Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie
description: The 6th Eko Run with a Whistle for Health takes place on 7 June 2026 in Jerzmanowice. The event is organised by Tomasz Gwizdała, Head of Jerzmanowice-Przeginia Municipality, and KKS Jura Moto Sport. The run has an environmental focus and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can use the official race-pack exchange to safely buy or sell entry packs. The start and race office are at Chochołowy Dwór in Jerzmanowice.
course_highlights: An approximately 8 km off-road route through the picturesque Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Organised by KKS Jura Moto Sport and promoting a healthy lifestyle
Training plans are available to help participants prepare for the run
additional: The race office and race-pack collection are at Chochołowy Dwór, ul. Jana III Sobieskiego 172, Jerzmanowice, from 8:00 to 9:15. The official race-pack exchange allows participants to safely buy a pack or list one for sale. Registration includes a race pack, and the event takes place at Hotel Chochołowy Dwór in Jerzmanowice.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
description: The 13th DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon, named after Barbara Karaczyńska, is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie and organized by the Daszrade Foundation in cooperation with the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Centre. The marathon course is entirely paved and runs through the scenic fields and forests of Kociewie. It is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and features numerous fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race takes place on a June morning and offers unforgettable views and a unique atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal, and everyone who finishes receives a commemorative medal, diploma and T-shirt.
course_highlights: Paved route through the fields and forests of Kociewie
646 m of total elevation gain, with numerous steep climbs
Course marked every 1 km, with aid stations every 5 km and on-course refreshment points
additional: Aid stations every 5 km, plus on-course refreshment points. A recovery meal is served after the race. Participants receive a commemorative medal, diploma and T-shirt. The 10 km “Olka” route partially overlaps with the half-marathon, is on a firm surface and runs through the forest. Paved route, 646 m of elevation gain, aid stations every 5 km, commemorative medals and T-shirts, 10 km “OLKA” route.

Participants can choose from several distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge, whether it’s 2.5 km, 5 km, or 10 km. The festival aims to give participants a break from everyday life, let them enjoy the freedom of movement, and make them part of a shared community experience. At the finish, runners will receive a unique finisher’s medal and a running shirt to make the day memorable.
course_highlights: The course runs through City Park in the heart of Budapest
Participants can choose from several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, a 3 × 2 km relay, walking, and a family run
A unique finisher’s medal and running shirt at the finish

The venue is City Park, in the heart of Budapest. Various distances, refreshment stations, a finisher’s medal, gifts, online and on-site registration, and student and corporate discounts.

description: The Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Run is a road race connecting the towns of Pécs, Orfű and Abaliget, with 465 metres of elevation gain. The race aims to bring local running communities together and promote running among the hills and lakes. The event traditionally takes place in early June and offers several distances, including a children’s race. The organisers warmly welcome runners to enjoy nature and the sense of community together.
course_highlights: 465 metres of elevation gain on the road course
Passes through Pécs, Orfű and Abaliget
The programme also includes a children’s race and a dog-friendly race
additional: Race pack contents: chip-timed race bib with safety pins. On-site registration and race pack collection on 7 June 2026, between 08:30 and 09:30. It is traditionally held in early June and also offers family-friendly activities, such as a children’s race. With the support of local communities and the university, the organizers welcome runners to enjoy nature and sport together.

Passes through the towns of Pécs, Orfű and Abaliget
400-metre children’s race at Abaliget Beach

The races offer courses ranging from 200 to 1,650 metres and are divided into age categories. Results for individuals and teams are announced after each race. BK Běkodo is part of TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and has a long tradition dating back to 2001.

Categories for children and young people aged 2 to 15
Results announced approximately 10 minutes after the last category finishes

This series of races for children and young people takes place on 9 June 2026 and supports an active lifestyle and the sporting development of young people in the region.

The race offers a 6.45 km route on paved paths, suitable for runners of all levels, with trail shoes recommended. The event also includes children’s categories with shorter routes. Participants’ entry fees support people facing difficulties in life, and they can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere, sports prizes, and other benefits.
course_highlights: The route follows paved paths around Medlánecký Pond
Trail shoes are recommended for greater comfort
Categories for adults and children, with different route lengths

Children can also get an Advenťák-themed temporary tattoo. Sports prizes and a small surprise are prepared for adults. The race is part of a series of charity runs, offers great prizes, diplomas, and tattoos for children, and supports disadvantaged children.

description: The Beer Mile in Heřmanův Městec is a unique race on the Bažantnice athletics track, where runners complete four 400-metre laps with beer breaks. This unconventional sporting experience combines running and fun in a friendly atmosphere. This year marks the 10th edition of this popular event, which is part of the Heřmanův Městec running club.

4 × (400 m run + beer) — an unconventional combination of sport and fun
Around the training football pitch

The race takes place on the Bažantnice athletics track, includes several heats, and results are published. The event is part of the local running cup.

The course is approximately 6.2 km long, and the race has a long-standing tradition; this year marks its 11th edition. The race is supported by the Prague 4–Újezd Municipal District.
course_highlights: The course runs through Milíčovský Forest
The race is 6.2 km long
The race has a long-standing tradition; this year is its 11th edition

SABZO is known for its long history and for regularly organizing running events in Prague and the surrounding area. The race is part of the club’s wider calendar of running events, which promotes an active lifestyle and a running community.

An opportunity for runners of all levels
Organized by the SABZO club

The race offers two main categories: adults running 6.45 km and children running distances from 0.2 to 1 km. The course follows paved and compacted paths, so road-running shoes are recommended. A large portion of the entry fee supports heroes who face challenges in life, and participants receive a race bib, certificate, gingerbread and other benefits. The event is friendly, charitable and suitable for all age groups.

Adult course: 6.45 km; children’s distances: 0.2–1 km
Road-running shoes recommended

Registration includes a race bib, certificate, prizes, refreshments and the children’s corner; a virtual run is also available.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The VAŠÍ LIGY Trail through Zlíchov’s Viewpoints is an amateur trail race held in Prague, offering runners the experience of running in nature across varied terrain with interesting views. The races are part of VAŠÍ LIGY, the largest amateur league in the Czech Republic, which promotes the joy of sport and a community atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a friendly environment and the chance to compete with runners of all age groups. The races are regularly held, with medals awarded to the best runners in the under-40 and 40+ categories.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with views in Prague’s natural surroundings
Running in the setting of Modřany Gorges and the Zbraslav sawmill
Races with the atmosphere of an amateur league and community running
additional: At each race, the 3 fastest runners in the under-40 and 40+ categories are announced and awarded medals by Garko. The value of prizes for the best and regular runners is 44,000 Kč. A race number and a pistol start make the race an unforgettable experience for competitors. The race is aimed at trail runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting who want to enjoy beautiful views and technical sections along the course.

name: Červnová Krásná Morava
description: The June Krásná Morava is a running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Hejčín. The race is part of the rich tradition of running events in the Olomouc Region, which are open to all ages and levels of runners. It offers a chance to experience the picturesque Haná countryside and join a community of sports enthusiasts. STMSVS is known for its long-standing organization of endurance sports and its support for running, cycling, and triathlon disciplines in the region.
course_highlights: A running race through the picturesque Haná countryside of the Olomouc Region
Part of the Haná Running Cup, with distances from 5 to 42 km
A traditional running event with an open start for all age groups
additional: Registration is handled through a credit system using a chip card for electronic timekeeping. Entry fees are paid from prepaid credit held in an STMSVS bank account. The race is part of the year-round Haná Running Cup series, where competitors earn points based on their placements in individual races. The race takes place on 11 June 2026; on-site registration is available, and results are published online.

name: Yellow Ribbon Run
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
organizer: Czechia Yellow Ribbon Run (Gabriela Slováková a podporující organizace)
description: Yellow Ribbon Run is a running event taking place on June 11, 2026, in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6. It symbolizes second chances and supports the integration of people with criminal records. The run brings together sport, solidarity, and the courage to help those who want to start a new life and become valued members of society. The event offers various race categories, including the main relay, the easy relay, and a children’s run, while also raising awareness and helping to reduce recidivism. Join the largest community in the Czech Republic working to break down prejudice and support second chances.
course_highlights: Run in the beautiful surroundings of Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6
Various race categories: main 5 km relay, 2.5 km easy relay, and children’s run
A symbol of second chances and support for the reintegration of people with criminal records
additional: The event includes the main 5 km relay, the 2.5 km easy relay, the Connecting Hearts Race for Children, and VOL FANWALK. The project raises awareness about people with criminal records and gives institutions and companies the opportunity to take part in the run as a CSR project. The organizers welcome volunteers to help with preparations and the event itself. The event aims to raise awareness about the challenges of reintegrating people after serving a sentence and to support their social inclusion. Registration is available through Stopnito.cz.

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok je nočný bežecký závod na 5 kilometrov, ktorý sa koná v Areáli zdravia Rozálka v Pezinku. Bežci si môžu užiť rýchly a dynamický beh po trase vedúcej cez Malokarpatskú oblasť s umelým osvetlením, čo vytvára jedinečnú atmosféru. Podujatie je určené pre všetkých od 15 rokov a je rozdelené do štartových koridorov podľa výkonnosti. Organizátori kladú dôraz na bezpečnosť, preto je zakázané používať slúchadlá a odporúčajú reflexné prvky či čelovky. Registrácia je možná online a je viazaná na meno pretekára, pričom je možné vykonať preregistráciu do 9. júna 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km nočný beh s umelým osvetlením
Trasa vedie cez Areál zdravia Rozálka, Malokarpatskú oblasť a Radničné námestie
Štartovné koridory podľa zadaného času z predchádzajúcich pretekov
additional: Minimálny vek účastníka je 15 rokov dosiahnutých v kalendárnom roku 2025. Preregistrácia lístka na inú osobu je možná do 9. júna 2026 za poplatok 10 eur. Používanie slúchadiel počas behu je prísne zakázané. Odporúčané sú reflexné prvky a čelovky kvôli nočnému behu. Štartovné je neprenosné a viazané na meno pretekára. Trať vedie z Areálu zdravia Rozálka cez Malokarpatkú, Majakovského most, Okružnú ulicu, most SNP, Kupeckého, Holubyho a končí na Radničnom námestí. Prihlásiť sa je možné len online, preregistrácia je nutná, a štartovné je viazané na meno účastníka.

name: The Run Slovakia
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 je národný štafetový beh naprieč Slovenskom, ktorý prebieha počas troch dní. Bežci spoločne prekonávajú viac ako 530 km z Košíc do Bratislavy, prechádzajúc krásnymi prírodnými scenériami, historickými pamiatkami a malebnými mestami. Podujatie ponúka jedinečnú športovú atmosféru, tímovú spoluprácu a množstvo nezabudnuteľných zážitkov. Trasa vedie cez významné miesta ako Spišský hrad, Vysoké Tatry, Oravský hrad či Malé Karpaty, pričom bežci zažijú aj bohatý sprievodný program.
course_highlights: Trasa dlhá 530 km z Košíc do Bratislavy
Prechod cez významné prírodné a historické pamiatky ako Spišský hrad, Vysoké Tatry, Oravský hrad
Celkové stúpanie 7308 m a klesanie 7376 m
additional: Celkový počet štartujúcich tímov je limitovaný na 100 tímov. Registrácia prebieha cez webovú aplikáciu, ktorá umožňuje sledovanie bežcov v reálnom čase, aktuálne výsledky, navigáciu a notifikácie od organizačného tímu. Pretek je určený pre tímových bežcov, s možnosťou sledovania výsledkov v reálnom čase, registrácia je otvorená, sú k dispozícii rôzne propagačné predmety a mobilná aplikácia na sledovanie výkonov.

name: Přes tři hráze Opatov
description: Přes tři hráze Opatov is a traditional running race held in Opatov in the Vysočina Region and is part of the Pohár Běžce Vysočiny series. The race offers several distances, including the 8.8 km main course for men and veterans up to age 69, and shorter courses for women, veterans aged 70 and over, juniors, youth and children. The course runs mainly along field and forest paths, including crossings over the dams of three local ponds, giving the race its unique character. The event is open to a broad range of age groups and focuses on the sporting experience and supporting the local running community.
course_highlights: The course crosses the dams of three ponds near Opatov
Distances range from 210 m to 8.8 km for different age groups
Part of the Pohár Běžce Vysočiny series
additional: The main loop is 4.4 km, running along field and forest paths (30% asphalt). Children’s races range from 210 m to 1.5 km. The event caters to a broad range of ages, including veterans.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: Ultra Nízke Tatry je prvý ročník horského bežeckého podujatia, ktoré vedie hrebeňom Nízkych Tatier od západu na východ. Trať má dĺžku 49,7 km s prevýšením 2650 metrov a vedie po turistických značkách z Donovalov na Srdiečko. Podujatie je súčasťou kalendára Slovenskej Skyrunningovej asociácie a zároveň slúži ako Memoriál Milana Styka, významného bežca a horolezca, ktorý tragicky zahynul v roku 2025. Štart je plánovaný na 13. júna 2026 o 7:00 hodine v Donovaloch pri Donovalskom pivovare.
course_highlights: 49,7 km dlhá trasa s 2650 m prevýšením
Hrebeň Nízkych Tatier od Donovalov po Srdiečko
Trasa vedie po červenej, zelenej a žltej turistickej značke cez chatu M.R. Štefánika a Kosodrevinu
additional: Registrácia je možná online od 20.12.2025 od 0:00 hod. a tiež na mieste štartu v Donovalskom pivovare 13.6.2026 od 16:00 do 21:00 hod. a ráno pred štartom od 6:00 do 6:45. Predbežný stop čas na Chopku po 37 km je o 15:00 hod (8 hodín po štarte). Organizátor si vyhradzuje právo zmeniť trasu podľa počasia a stanoviť časové limity. Trať prechádza horským terénom, súčasťou sú informácie o registrácii, pamätný charakter podujatia, možné zmeny trasy kvôli počasiu, časové limity podľa podmienok

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska mašľa je horský ultramaratón a diaľkový pochod okolo Strečna, ktorý sa uskutoční 13. júna 2026. Pretek ponúka dve trasy - náročnú 50 km trasu s prevýšením približne 2985 metrov a kratšiu 25 km trasu, ktorá je vhodná aj pre bežcov so psom. Trasy vedú po turisticky značených chodníkoch cez obe časti Malej Fatry a časťou národného parku, pričom štart a cieľ sú na futbalovom ihrisku Radinové v Strečne. Organizátori zabezpečujú štartovné balíčky, ceny pre najlepších a kvalitné podmienky pre účastníkov.
course_highlights: 50 km trasa s prevýšením približne 2985 m cez Malú Fatru
Trasy vedú po turisticky značených chodníkoch a cez územie národného parku
Štart a cieľ na futbalovom ihrisku Radinové v Strečne
additional: Limit účastníkov: 300 pre 50 km, 300 pre 25 km, 50 pre 25 km so psom. Štartovné číslo a čip sú pridelené organizátorom. Povinná výbava zahŕňa lekárničku, platný doklad totožnosti, poistenie na zásah Horskej záchrannej služby, nabitý mobil, vlastnú nádobu na pitie, píšťalku alebo rolničky (odporúčané pre 50 km trasu), mapu alebo GPS trasu, slnečné okuliare a opaľovací krém. Možnosť prespať v šatniach alebo stanoch na futbalovom ihrisku. Ubytovanie dostupné aj v Pizzeria Alžbetka a SIP ŽSR Strečno. Preteky ponúkajú certifikované trasy, registrácia sa otvára 1. marca 2026, súčasťou je aj Slovenská Ultratrailová Liga, a trať vedie cez národný park Malá Fatra.

name: Krosak pod hradom
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
description: Krosák pod hradom je bežecký pretek v Trnave pri Laborci, ktorý ponúka rôzne kategórie vrátane veľkého krosáku na 10 km, malého krosáku na 5 km, behu zdravia a nordic walkingu. Trať vedie po poľných a lesných cestách s asfaltovým povrchom, pričom veľký krosák pozostáva z dvoch päťkilometrových okruhov. Pretek je súčasťou Bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance a je vhodný pre širokú škálu bežcov od juniorov až po veteránov. Štart pretekov je na Obecnom úrade v Trnave pri Laborci, pričom detské kategórie začínajú o 9:00 a hlavný pretek o 11:00.
course_highlights: Trať vedie po poľnej a lesnej ceste s asfaltovým povrchom
Veľký krosák je 10 km (2 x 5 km okruh)
Pretek sa koná v malebnom prostredí Trnavy pri Laborci
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov začína od 8:00 hod. na Obecnom úrade, detské kategórie od 7:30 hod. Nové registrácie v deň pretekov sú možné len do vypredania voľných štartových čísel. Platba na mieste je 25 €. Podujatie sa koná 13. júna 2026, s štartmi o 09:00 a 11:00, a zahŕňa kategórie na 10 km, 5 km a Nordic Walking, s dôrazom na charitatívne účely a komunitnú účasť.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca, Slovakia
price_range: 35 EUR do 1. 5. 2026, 40 EUR po 1. 5. 2026, 25 EUR pre účastníkov z okresu Čadca
description: Kysucký maratón je druhým najstarším maratónom na Slovensku a významnou športovou a spoločenskou udalosťou regiónu Kysúc. Trať vedie malebnou kysuckou dolinou pozdĺž rieky Kysuca, s bezpečnejšou a atraktívnejšou trasou po bežeckej cyklotrase od roku 2025. Súčasťou podujatia sú okrem maratónu aj polmaratón, maratónska štafeta a minimaratón pre deti. Štart a cieľ sú na Matičnom námestí v Čadci pred Domom kultúry. Preteká sa v rôznych vekových kategóriách a účastníci majú k dispozícii občerstvovacie stanice a zázemie vrátane šatní a wellness služieb.
course_highlights: Trať vedie malebnou kysuckou dolinou údolím rieky Kysuca
Bezpečná a atraktívna trasa po bežeckej cyklotrase (Bystrická cyklomagistrála)
Otočka maratónu na námestí pri Slovenskom orloji v Starej Bystrici
additional: Štart a cieľ pretekov sú na Matičnom námestí v Čadci pred Domom kultúry. Na trati je 8 občerstvovacích staníc. Po preteku je zabezpečené občerstvenie. Účastníkom sú k dispozícii šatne, bazén a sauna na miestnej plavárni. Limit na maratón je 5 hodín na 40 km, po prekročení tohto času nie je zaradenie do výsledkovej listiny garantované. Trať na certifikovaných tratiach, občerstvovacie stanice na trati, šatne, bazén, sauna, občerstvenie po preteku, registrácia online do 1.6.2026, bez poistenia organizátorov

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom

price_tiers.distance: Beh pre zdravie 4 km a Nordic walking 4 km

description: Beh Hodkovským parkom je bežecké podujatie v areáli Kaštieľa Hodkovce v Žehre, ktoré ponúka trať prevažne poľnými a lesnými cestami s asfaltovým povrchom. Pretek je rozdelený do kategórií na 8 km súťažný beh pre rôzne vekové skupiny mužov a žien, ako aj nesúťažné kategórie Beh pre zdravie a Nordic walking na 4 km bez vekového obmedzenia. Organizátorom je DOMOVINA n.o., ktorý zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pre všetkých účastníkov. Štartovné je dostupné online za zvýhodnenú cenu, čo podporuje včasnú registráciu.
course_highlights: Trať vedie prevažne po poľných a lesných cestách s asfaltovým úsekom
Pretek sa koná v areáli Kaštieľa Hodkovce v Žehre
Kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a nesúťažné varianty behu a Nordic walking
additional: Štartovné je 7 € pri online registrácii do 12.6.2025, na mieste 9 €. Trať je vhodná pre rôzne vekové kategórie a zahŕňa aj nesúťažné varianty behu a Nordic walking. Miesto štartu a cieľa je v areáli DSS DOMOVINA no. v Žehre, časť Hodkovce. Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne kategórie pre všetky vekové skupiny, registrácia je možná do 12. júna 2025, trať zahŕňa les, poľné cesty a asfaltové úseky.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: Beh Kalváriou je charitatívny bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v krásnom prostredí Kalvárie v Považskej Bystrici. Podujatie ponúka trate pre dospelých aj deti, pričom povrch trate tvoria lesné cesty. Tento štvrtý ročník preteku je príležitosťou zažiť spoločenstvo, pohyb a radosť, pričom výťažok z behu je venovaný deťom v núdzi. Organizátori kladú dôraz na kvalitnú organizáciu a podporu charitatívnych cieľov.
course_highlights: Lesné cesty v prostredí Kalvárie
Trate pre dospelých aj deti
Krásne členitá trať s pekným počasím
additional: Registrácia je možná len online cez vysledkovyservis.sk. Na mieste a v deň behu sa už registrácia neuskutoční. Po zaplatení štartovného sa meno účastníka zobrazí v zozname prihlásených a príde potvrdenie emailom. Možnosť dobrovoľného príspevku pri registrácii na podporu Hugovi a Simonke. Účastnícky limit je 500 dospelých a 250 detí. Podujatie sa riadi pravidlami Slovenského atletického zväzu. Registrácia je dostupná len online; podujatie má charitatívny účel; účastnícky limit je 500 dospelých a 250 detí; starty sú naplánované na 10:00 pre deti a 12:15 pre dospelých.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
price_range: dospelí: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste; občania obce: 5 € online, 10 € na mieste; deti a juniorské: 3 €; detské behy zdarma
description: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo je bežecké podujatie konané v Lemešanoch na lúke nad obcou. Pretek je rozdelený do viacerých kategórií podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane detských kategórií a nordic walking. Štart pre hlavné kategórie je o 17:00 hod., detské kategórie štartujú o 17:10 hod. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru letného bežeckého kola.
course_highlights: Rôzne kategórie pre všetky vekové skupiny vrátane detí a dospelých
Online registrácia s nízkym štartovným
Detské behy na lúke zadarmo
additional: Kategórie: Muži A (18-39 rokov), Muži B (40 a viac rokov), Ženy F (18-39 rokov), Ženy G (40 a viac rokov), Dievčatá/Chlapci 1 (12-14 rokov), Dievčatá/Chlapci 2 (15-17 rokov), Deti do 12 rokov (len v sprievode dospelej osoby), Nordic Walking muži/ženy. Detské behy na lúke zdarma, online registrácia do 12. júna 2026, štartovné doplatok 2 € na štartové číslo, štart o 17:00 a 17:10

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranský Mlyn pri Zelenom plese, Vysoké Tatry, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia
description: Beh na Chatu pri Zelenom plese je horský beh určený pre nadšencov športu a prírody, vhodný pre amatérskych aj profesionálnych športovcov. Podujatie sa koná pravidelne od roku 2005 počas druhého júnového víkendu a nesie spomienku na Karla Jakeša, významného československého horolezca. Trať vedie náročným horským terénom s výrazným prevýšením, čo robí beh výzvou pre všetkých účastníkov. Cieľom je spojiť rôzne športové skupiny a ponúknuť im jedinečný zážitok v krásnom prostredí Vysokých Tatier.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 7,7 km
Celkové stúpanie 651 m
Celkové klesanie 18 m
additional: Podujatie je realizované s finančnou podporou Ministerstva cestovného ruchu a športu SR. Beh spája atlétov, bežcov, alpinistov, lyžiarov, horolezcov, cyklistov a skialpinistov v jednu športovú osobnosť. Registrácia na 20. ročník bola ukončená. Pretek sa koná v júni 2026, registrácia je dostupná na oficiálnej stránke, trať začína pri autobusovej zastávke Biela voda a končí pri Chate pri Zelenom plese, vhodný pre bežcov všetkých úrovní s láskou k horským výkonom.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Olomouc 2026
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc 2026 is a traditional half marathon that takes you through the historic beauty of Olomouc. The start and finish are at Horní náměstí, where you can admire the Holy Trinity Column and the town hall with its unique astronomical clock. During the race, you’ll enjoy the city’s atmosphere, historic buildings, and beautiful parks. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers an accompanying program.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Horní náměstí, with landmarks including the Holy Trinity Column and the astronomical clock
The route passes through Olomouc’s historic center and beautiful parks
Enjoy the city’s atmosphere and rich history during the race
additional: The race is part of the Mattoni Running Festival, which also features events such as the Šantovka 5 km Run, the dm Family Mile, the dm bambini run, and a half-marathon relay. Starts are divided into several time waves from 15:00 to 19:00. The RunCzech mobile app provides all race information and a virtual package. The course covers historic streets, parks, and city roads; it is certified and fully closed to traffic. The race offers technical support, refreshment stations, and medical services.

name: Horem dolem Chospílem
description: Horem dolem Chospílem is a 9.2 km interval-start running race that follows meadows and dirt roads around Postřekov in the Chospíl area. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers runners pleasant terrain and a natural atmosphere. Its interval start makes for an interesting race format. It is suited to runners looking for a combination of nature and sporting challenge in the Plzeň Region.
course_highlights: A 9.2 km course through meadows and along dirt roads
Interval start
Natural surroundings near Postřekov in Chospíl
additional: The race takes place on June 13, 2026. Results and participant lists are available on the website. Exact registration details are not provided.

name: Sokolovský  ¼ maraton
organizer: Živý kraj – Destinační agentura pro Karlovarský kraj, z.s.
description: The Sokolov Quarter Marathon is a running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in Sokolov, in the Karlovy Vary Region. The route runs mainly through scenic parts of the town and the surrounding countryside, and the race is approximately 10.5 km long. The event is intended for recreational runners as well as those who want to experience the atmosphere of a race in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience for all participants.
course_highlights: A scenic route through Sokolov and the surrounding natural landscape
An approximate distance of 10.5 km, suitable for recreational and competitive runners
A relaxed and friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race is part of the Sokolov Colour Run. Registration details and further information are not specified. The race is suitable for the general public.

name: Barevný běh Sokolov
description: Barvám Neutečeš is a colourful run and a full day of fun for all ages, families and friends. Choose between two routes: 5 km with five colour zones, or 1.5 km with three colour zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about joy, friendship and unforgettable experiences filled with colour, music and laughter. The event takes place in Sokolov on 13 June 2026 and is part of a year-round colour tour visiting several cities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colour zones
1.5 km route with 3 colour zones and an Urban Challenge zone
The colour zones shower runners in colour from head to toe
additional: Enjoy a full day of fun from 9:00 to 16:00, with music, themed zones, photo booths and a 360° video. The race pack includes a T-shirt, race number, medal and other accessories. The event is also suitable for children, who can take part on shoulders, scooters or in strollers. There is no timing; the focus is on fun and sharing the experience. Registration is open. The event takes place on 13 June 2026 in Sokolov. The routes pass through Sokolov Island and the surrounding area, with a focus on fun and community.

name: Run Labe Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro ročník 2026 je 17 000 Kč za tým.

description: Run Labe Run is a relay race for teams of up to 12 runners, held on June 13–14, 2026. The route runs from Špindlerův Mlýn to Děčín along the Elbe River and covers a total of 380 km, divided into 36 stages of varying difficulty. The race starts in 8 waves between 5:00 and 11:00. Categories include mixed teams of 10–12 runners, mixed teams of 6–9 runners, women’s teams, and veterans. Teams compete for prizes in several categories, and registration is open until March 31, 2026, or until capacity is reached.
course_highlights: A 380 km route divided into 36 stages, with difficulty levels from 1 to 5
Start in Špindlerův Mlýn, finish in Děčín by the chateau
The race starts in 8 waves between 5:00 and 11:00
additional: The maximum team size is 12 runners. The captains’ meeting will take place online on May 24, 2026, at 19:00. Teams from previous editions have priority registration from June 26, 2025. The race starts in 8 waves between 5:00 and 11:00. A team is not considered registered until its payment has been credited to the account. Registration opens on July 1, 2025; the deadline is March 31, 2026, or until capacity is reached. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Krkonoše Mountains and the Elbe River.

name: JEŠTĚD SUMMER RUNNING WEEKEND
location: Skokanský areál u Ski Ještěd, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Ještěd Summer Running Weekend is a trail-running weekend event held in the beautiful setting of the Ski Ještěd ski jumping complex in the Liberec Region. It offers a range of running disciplines, including a 24-hour run, a marathon, a half marathon and shorter races. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners, from experienced ultramarathoners to families with children. The routes follow scenic mountain terrain with significant elevation gain and beautiful views of the Ještěd Ridge. The event is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series and provides quality facilities and a great atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Scenic mountain routes on the Ještěd Ridge
Significant elevation gain of up to 1,390 m on the longer routes
A range of distances, including a 24-hour run, a marathon and shorter races
additional: The event offers a range of running disciplines, including a 24-hour run, a marathon, a half marathon and shorter races. The routes are challenging, with significant elevation gain, and run through mountain terrain. The event also includes facilities with refreshments and accommodation options. Shorter races are available for children. The races take place on terrain around the ski jumps; registration and route details are available on the website. The event also includes trail camps, merchandise, a partner zone and environmental measures.

name: Dobročinný běh po stopách Silver A
location: Pardubice, Pardubice District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné na charitativní účely, přesná částka není uvedena
description: Join the 3rd annual charity run and walk, In the Footsteps of Silver A, organized by the Zámeček Memorial in Pardubice. The event is suitable for athletes and non-athletes, children and adults, and the entry fee goes to charity. The run offers two routes—a shorter 5 km route and a longer 10 km route—as well as a children’s race of approximately 1 km. There will also be a guided walk through the city to places associated with the Silver A parachute group, starting from the Zámeček Memorial.
course_highlights: Two running routes: 5 km and 10 km
Children’s race of approximately 1 km
Guided city walk in the footsteps of the Silver A parachute group
additional: Registration opens at 14:00, and the event is expected to end at 18:00. The entry fee includes a public transport ticket. Online registration is available until 11 June; after that, registration is available at the venue on the day of the event. Proceeds from the entry fees will go to charity, specifically towards buying a stroller for four-year-old Viktorka, who has autism spectrum disorder. Routes: 5 km, 10 km and a children’s race; guided city walk; start from the Zámeček Memorial; entry fee includes a public transport ticket; supports local charity and historical awareness.

name: Hradecký koloběh
location: Biřička, Nový Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Hradecký Koloběh is a mixed-pair race held in the beautiful surroundings of the city forests, starting at Biřička. The race combines running and cycling: one team member runs while the other rides a bike, and they can switch at any time during the race, adding strategy and dynamism. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of movement, with OPEN and FAMILY categories. It is held with the support of the City of Hradec Králové and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality event organisation.
course_highlights: Beautiful surroundings of the city forests
A combination of running and cycling, with teams free to switch at any time
Start at Biřička in Nový Hradec Králové
additional: The race pack includes a race number, event organisation, baggage storage, toilets, race marshals, refreshments at the finish, and photographs (a photo for every participant is not guaranteed). Toilets, baggage storage, catering, and parking are available. Parking is recommended at the parking lot on Partyzánská Street. Stopping is prohibited on Mužíkova Street, where the situation is monitored by the municipal police. Prizes are awarded to places 1–3 in each category. Terrain: 90% forest trails, 10% asphalt roads. Elevation gain: 108 m. Categories: OPEN and FAMILY. Start at Biřička, Nový Hradec Králové.

name: Jinecký kros
organizer: Městys Jince a Jinečáček, z. s.
description: Jinecký kros is a traditional running race held in Jince. It offers a challenging course of approximately 5.7 km with around 178 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are on the football pitch by the Bio Swimming Pool, which provides facilities for runners, including parking, changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The course runs on asphalt, forest paths and meadows, and includes a crossing over a wooden footbridge, asphalt roads and a climb up Vystrkov Hill. The race is suitable for adults and children, who have their own categories. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The course crosses a wooden footbridge over the Ohrazenický Stream
A challenging climb up Vystrkov Hill with approximately 30 m of elevation gain
A mix of asphalt, forest paths and meadows
additional: Race facilities include parking, changing rooms, showers, toilets and a refreshment stand. Registration is open until 13.6.2026 at 17:00, and is also available on race day. Children’s races are part of the programme. The course has +178 m and -187 m of elevation change. The start and finish are at the SK Jince 1921 sports complex. Course: approx. 5.7 km; terrain: asphalt, forest paths and meadows; children’s races; start on the football pitch by the Bio Swimming Pool.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc is a popular running event held in the historic center of Olomouc. The race offers an attractive route through the city’s picturesque streets, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of the RunCzech running league and offers a unique atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can enjoy excellent facilities and support throughout the race.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic center of Olomouc
Pleasant urban surroundings with cultural landmarks
Part of the RunCzech running league, professionally organized
additional: The event includes various race categories, an expo and accompanying activities. Registration is available through the RunCzech website. The races are certified and suitable for all age groups.

name: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton
location: Jindřichův Hradec, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Jindřichův Hradec Half Marathon 2026 is the 10th anniversary edition of a running event offering a unique experience that combines the city’s picturesque historic centre, sections along the water and natural trails with significant elevation gain. The race is open to individual runners covering 21.1 km, as well as relay teams, families and schools taking part in shorter races. The atmosphere is enhanced by spectators, music and event services including refreshment stations and showers. A special Rebel Run for schools is also planned, focusing on teamwork rather than time. The race starts on 13 June 2026. Participants will receive an original medal and may win prizes.
course_highlights: A beautiful combination of city and countryside: historic lanes and peaceful landscapes around Jindřichův Hradec
Sections along the water and natural trails with considerable elevation gain
An unforgettable atmosphere, with spectators, music and encouragement along the course
additional: The event schedule includes the Rebel Run starting at 15:00, the Family Run at 16:00, and the half marathon and relay races at 17:00. Refreshment stations, showers, a baggage area, and professional photos and video from the course and finish are available. The Rebel Run is a special team race for primary schools, where teamwork and everyone’s participation matter more than time. The event features a course through the historic centre and natural trails, various races including relays, family and school runs, refreshments, showers, facilities, medals and prizes.

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SUMMER - Running Weekend
description: LEKI JEŠTĚD SUMMER - Running Weekend is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series, which offers challenging and beautiful routes in the mountain terrain of the Ještěd Ridge. The races are intended for a wide range of runners, from children to experienced skyrunners, with distances ranging from 200 metres to 42 km. The event takes place in the picturesque setting by the ski jumping hills at Ještěd and offers a unique experience of running in nature with significant elevation gain. The running weekend is complemented by activities, refreshments and accommodation options close to the races.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain routes with up to 1390 m of elevation gain
Distances ranging from children’s races to a 42 km ultramarathon
Picturesque Ještěd Ridge setting with views and technical sections
additional: The winners’ ceremony takes place from 16:00. The races are held at the ski jumping hills at Ještěd. Children’s races, refreshments and an accompanying programme are available. Accommodation and volunteer support are also available. The routes are technically challenging, with significant elevation gain. The race emphasises ecology, for example by not using disposable cups, and offers a wide range of activities throughout the weekend.

name: Neveklovské běhy
organizer: kulturní a sportovní komise města Neveklov
description: Neveklov Runs is a traditional running event held in the picturesque Castle Park in Neveklov. The race gives runners of all abilities the chance to enjoy a run in the park’s pleasant setting and friendly atmosphere. It is part of the wider Běžec Podblanicka race calendar, which promotes an active lifestyle and brings the region’s sporting community together.
course_highlights: Run in Neveklov Castle Park
Peaceful natural park setting
Traditional regional running event
additional: The races are part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup, with distances ranging from 50 m to 5 km, and offer an outdoor sporting experience for the general public.

name: 7 pohoří Jeseníky
location: Dolní Morava, Jeseníky, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Jeseníky 2026 race is a technical trail run in the beautiful countryside below Králický Sněžník, offering three routes of different lengths and elevation gains. The routes have been prepared by members of the local mountain rescue service and run mainly through natural terrain. Participants can enjoy a professionally marked course, chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and a commemorative medal. The event takes place in all weather and is suitable for all trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience epic views and an atmosphere they won’t find elsewhere.
course_highlights: Main course: 23.5 km with 830 m of elevation gain
Alternative course: 11.3 km with 410 m of elevation gain
Kari Traa RUN: 7 km with 230 m of elevation gain
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours; after that, a runner is marked as DNF. Participants can leave small items at the registration tent. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a race bib, chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and use of the facilities at the start and finish area. The event takes place in all weather, and participation is at the runner’s own risk. The race offers registration, timing, medals, and other facilities. The routes run through mountainous terrain with technical trail sections and are suitable for both experienced and beginner trail runners. The race takes place in June 2026.

name: Okrouhelský běh
description: The Okrouhlá Run is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, held in the picturesque village of Okrouhlá in the Liberec Region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy running in a natural setting with a friendly atmosphere. The Okrouhlá Run is part of a series of regional races that promote an active lifestyle and community sport.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around the village of Okrouhlá
Picturesque views and peaceful surroundings
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League
additional: Part of a series of regional races, including cross-country races and half marathons; exact race distances are not specified

name: Extrem Run 5Hills
location: Vojtanov, Karlovy Vary District, Czech Republic
description: Extrem Run 5 Hills is an ultratrail running race in the westernmost part of the Czech Republic, offering a challenging 91-kilometre course with 2,174 metres of elevation gain. The route crosses five Egerland peaks and combines paved roads, cycling and hiking trails, and forest terrain. The race is for experienced runners looking for an extreme sporting challenge and stunning panoramas. The organisers place an emphasis on accurate timekeeping and runner safety. The race takes place in the picturesque area of Vojtanov and also offers relay and two-person duathlon formats.
course_highlights: 91 km course with 2,174 m of elevation gain
Five Egerland peaks: Kapellenberg, Háj Aš, Zelená hora Bismarck, Dyleň, Lesný
A combination of paved roads, cycle paths, and forest terrain
additional: The race starts by the municipal office in Vojtanov. Timing is provided using highly accurate passive or active chips. Runners receive a technical T-shirt with the logo and a finisher medal. Refreshments are provided during the race and at the finish. The relay race is for teams of 3–6 runners, with at least one woman on each team. The two-person duathlon combines a runner and a cyclist, with the order of the legs fixed. The race is authorised by Lesy ČR and the Slavkov Forest Protected Landscape Area. Registration requires a team with at least one woman. The time limit is 18 hours, and the entry fee is 2,400 CZK, payable in cash on site. Accommodation is not provided.

name: Běh na Pajrek
description: Běh na Pajrek is the second edition of a running race organized by TJ Nýrsko, taking place on June 13, 2026, at the grounds below the ski slope in Nýrsko. Men run 8.6 km (2 laps) and women 4.2 km (1 lap), with 152 meters of elevation gain per lap. The finish is at the same location as the start. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Ešus League, with refreshments available at the venue. The organizers note that the course may change due to construction work and provide prizes in kind for the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: Men’s course: 8.6 km (2 laps); women’s course: 4.2 km (1 lap)
152 m of elevation gain per lap; an uphill and downhill course
The finish is at the same location as the start, at the grounds below the ski slope
additional: On-site registration is open from 12:00 to 13:45. Payment by bank transfer; include your first name, surname, and year of birth in the payment reference. All participants compete at their own risk. Refreshments are available at the venue. Prizes in kind for the top three in each category. The organizer reserves the right to change the course due to construction work. The race takes place at Pajrek; on-site registration is available. The event is part of a series of local running races. Registration is open from 12:00 to 13:45 on race day.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha
organizer: Zakład Gospodarki Komunalnej i Rekreacji w Morawicy
description: The 3rd Bilczańska Dycha is a 10 km road race held in the recreational area of Bilcza Park in the Municipality of Morawica. The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages, and children’s races and a family festival are also held on race day. The race is open to all and promotes active recreation in the scenic surroundings of the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: The course runs through the recreational area of Bilcza Park
A 10 km road race
Scenic surroundings in the Municipality of Morawica
additional: A family festival and children’s races are also held on race day. The event includes children’s races, a family festival, and recreational activities at Bilcza Park. Registration is available online, and the event promotes active recreation and integration within the local community.

name: 23 Wilcza Dycha
location: Osieczna, Powiat choszczeński, województwo zachodniopomorskie, Poland
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association. The event promotes an active lifestyle and attracts runners from the region, offering a scenic route through the Tuchola Forests. The race takes place in Osieczna and is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. Participants can expect professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km route
Scenic terrain in the Tuchola Forests
The race takes place in Osieczna
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich series, with the chance to win a unique collection as part of the series. Participants can expect competitive racing and attractive prizes.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the town’s streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level with officially recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime atmosphere. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing refreshments after the race and awards ceremonies for the winners.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Night race starting at 21:55
Urban course through the streets of Szamotuły
additional: Temporary traffic arrangements will be in place on race day, with parking disruptions and designated detours. Race packs can be collected from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments for participants and awards ceremonies for the winners are planned after the race. There are 26 free race packs available for people with disabilities in the family race, accompanied by a caregiver, upon request by email. The event includes road closures and detours, and offers various distances, including 5 km, 255 m, and 555 m. Participants can find news and information on the website and Facebook.

name: 8 Bieg Chwalisza
description: The 8th edition of the Chwalisz Run is an annual charity race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Ściernie. The start and finish are located at Preschool No. 1 – Ściernie branch. The 5 km course runs mainly along forest paths, with very little asphalt, offering both challenges and the joy of running for experienced runners and beginners alike. All entry fees will go towards supporting Antoś Synowiec, a child with a rare genetic disease, highlighting the charitable nature of the event. The organizers also invite participants to join group training sessions every Thursday at 19:00.
course_highlights: 5 km course with very little asphalt
Challenging forest sections
Start and finish at Preschool No. 1 – Ściernie branch
additional: Professional timing accurate to one-hundredth of a second. The event combines sport with charitable support. Group training sessions take place every Thursday at 19:00, starting from the preschool in Ściernie, at 17 Kamienna Street. A family festival accompanies the race. The 5 km course includes forest sections; the event is charitable and includes a family festival and Thursday training sessions at 19:00.

name: Bieg Iskry
description: Bieg Iskry is a unique running event taking place on June 13, 2026, at Mielec Airport. Participants will cover a 6.5 km route along the runway with the lights on and the sun setting, creating a one-of-a-kind aviation atmosphere. The organizers provide professional medals, T-shirts featuring the Iskra aircraft, and prizes including trophies and vouchers for tandem flights. After the race, participants can admire the aircraft and enjoy refreshments and dietary supplements.
course_highlights: A 6.5 km route along the runway at Mielec Airport
A race with the lights on and the sun setting
Start, finish, and awards ceremony in the hangars of the White-and-Red Wings Foundation
additional: Participants will receive running T-shirts featuring the Iskra aircraft, commemorative medals, and trophies and diplomas in the open and age categories. Medical and sanitary facilities will be available. At the end, there will be a draw for a glider flight sponsored by the Polish Aviation Foundation. Event partner DepilConcept salon is providing a voucher for photoepilation treatments for the first woman to cross the finish line. Airport grounds, online registration, medals, T-shirts, prizes, aviation attractions, post-race meals

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
location: Łódzki Park Arturówek, Łódź, Łódzkie, Poland
description: The eighth national “Recepta na Zdrowie” run will take place on 13 June 2026 in Arturówek, Łódź. This healthy running event promotes physical activity, integration between the running and pharmaceutical communities, and a healthy lifestyle. The race routes follow a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest, with 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as 5 km Nordic Walking. Shorter races on the same route are planned for children and young people. A family picnic with free health checks and consultations will be held near the start and finish.
course_highlights: The running and Nordic Walking routes follow a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest
Two 5 km loops for the 10 km distance
Family picnic with blood pressure and blood sugar checks and consultations
additional: The start and finish are by the Arturówek recreational facilities. The race office will be open from 8:00 on race day. The 5 km run and Nordic Walking start together at 10:00, the children’s and youth races begin at 12:00, and the 10 km run starts at 13:30. The course is not certified. Awards and prizes for children and young people will be presented immediately after their races. Registration for children requires an account on zapisy.inessport.pl. The event, supported by organizers from the pharmaceutical industry, places strong emphasis on promoting a healthy lifestyle and preventive healthcare. It takes place in June 2026 in Arturówek, Łódź.

name: Biegi w Rogoźniku
organizer: Gminne Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Bobrownikach
description: The Rogoźnik Runs is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Rogoźnik. The races offer a variety of courses, including races for children and young people, as well as distances of 8.4 km and 15.5 km. The event is supported by local institutions and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. It is a great opportunity to enjoy the outdoors and compete in sport.
course_highlights: Courses of 8.4 km and 15.5 km
Races for children and young people
Picturesque surroundings of Rogoźnik
additional: The start list is available online. Supported by local institutions and sponsors. Race courses are available as maps on the website. Races for children and young people are held alongside the main races. Various distances and courses; online registration; support from local sponsors and institutions.

name: Leśna ZaDyszka
location: Leśnictwo Szulmierz, gmina Regimin, Mazowieckie, Poland
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin municipality, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in forest areas. The course is a 5 km loop along forest tracks and a section of asphalt, showcasing the beauty of the Mazovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (two loops), and 5 km Nordic Walking. Children can take part in a 1.5 km run with no classification. The start and finish are on a forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.
course_highlights: A 5 km loop along forest tracks and asphalt
Views of the Mazovian countryside and a fallow deer farm
The course is safeguarded by volunteers
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 on the forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road. Participants receive a commemorative medal and a restorative meal after the race. They can choose a standard T-shirt at no extra cost or a Premium LAS T-shirt for an additional 20 zł. Times are recorded using chips attached to participants’ shoes. Prizes are awarded for age-group and overall placements, with a prize draw among participants. Courses include forest tracks and asphalt, with various distances and categories, including running, Nordic Walking, and Cross Duathlon. Entry fees depend on the registration date.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Radomsku
description: The 13th Radomsko Street Run, the Marian Szymański Memorial, is an annual running event held in Radomsko to commemorate Marian Szymański. The race takes place on the city streets, giving participants the chance to compete in a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Radomsko and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Radomsko, with timing provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 17:30, and online registration is open until 10 June 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km street race
Participation in a memorial race commemorating Marian Szymański
Organized by MOSiR Radomsko, with electronic timing
additional: The event is scheduled for 13 June 2026, with a 17:30 start. Online registration is open until 10 June 2026. The race takes place on the streets of Radomsko.
