tiers.description: Pakiet Smyki na Piątkę 35 zł ( numer startowy, chip, medal)

description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual road race in Szamotuły, certified by the Polish Athletic Association. The 5 km course runs through the town streets, offering official results and a unique night-race atmosphere. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races. It attracts considerable interest, and participants can look forward to refreshments and an awards ceremony after the race.
course_highlights: A 5 km course certified by the Polish Athletic Association
A night race starting at 21:55
Route through the streets of Sportowa, Lipowa, Szczęsnego, Kolarska, Wioślarska, Łąkowa, 3 Maja and Staszica
additional: Temporary traffic changes apply on race day, with parking restrictions and designated detours. Race packs are distributed from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the winners are planned after the race. Free race packs are available for people with disabilities taking part in the family race with a guardian. The 5 km race starts at 21:00; the course is marked every 1 km and has a limit of 800 participants. Various categories are available, including family and children’s races, with race packs containing T-shirts and medals. An event schedule and traffic restrictions for the duration of the race are planned.

name: XII Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar ...
location: Zagwiździe, Gmina Murów, Opole Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 12th Voivodeship Badger Cup Cross-Country Run is a running event organized by the Municipality of Murów. It will take place on June 13, 2026, in Zagwiździe, on the grounds of the historic Ironworks complex. The event includes several categories: a 12 km run, a 3.5 km run, children’s races, and Nordic Walking. The race office will be open from 8:00 to 9:30, and timing will be electronic. This sporting event combines competition with a beautiful historic setting, encouraging physical activity and community engagement.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of the historic Ironworks complex
Several distances and categories are available: 12 km, 3.5 km, children’s races, and Nordic Walking
Electronic timing provides accurate results
additional: The race office is open from 8:00 to 9:30. Categories include a 12 km run, a 3.5 km run, children’s races, and Nordic Walking. The organizer is the Municipality of Murów. Timing is electronic. Registration is open from 8:00 to 9:30. Various age categories are available. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.

name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: The 19th Marshal’s Run is an annual road race held in Sulejówek, commemorating the traditions of the pre-war Sulejówek–Belweder marches. The main race, approximately 10 km long, takes place in June and commemorates Józef Piłsudski settling in Sulejówek. The event also includes accompanying races, including the Halina Zielińska Memorial over 3.6 km and races for children. The race has a patriotic and sporting character, with uniformed services and museum staff taking part. The start and finish are at 94 Paderewskiego Street, next to Willa Bzów.
course_highlights: Main race of approximately 10 km on the streets of Sulejówek
Halina Zielińska Memorial over approximately 3.6 km
Traditional start and finish by Willa Bzów, 94 Paderewskiego Street
additional: The main race and the Halina Zielińska Memorial start at 10:20, the Little Kids’ Run at 10:30, and the Older Kids’ Run at 10:40. A flower-laying ceremony at the monument to Marshal Józef Piłsudski takes place at 9:50. Race packages can be officially and safely transferred to another participant. Uniformed services and museum staff also compete in separate categories. Registration and race-package collection take place at the Józef Piłsudski Museum, with registration also available by email. The event features various distances and forms of competition, including races for children and seniors.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego
description: The 15th Run in the Footsteps of King Sigismund the Old is an annual race held in Kozienice, commemorating a historic route associated with King Sigismund the Old. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a scenic course and sporting competition. The organizers provide professional support and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: A race course following the historic route of King Sigismund the Old
Scenic landscapes of Kozienice and the surrounding area
A well-marked and prepared running course
additional: Registration for the event is available online; the event attracts nearly 180 runners, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the region.

name: XV Siemiatycka Wieczorna Dycha
location: Amfiteatr miejski, Grodzieńska 31, Siemiatycze, Podlaskie, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Siemiatyczach
description: The XV Siemiatycze Evening 10K is a 10 km road race held in Siemiatycze. The start and finish are at the municipal amphitheatre at 31 Grodzieńska Street. The course follows the city’s asphalt streets. In addition to the main 10 km race, there are also 5 km races and a 400 m race for children. The event takes place in the evening, with a start time of 18:00. Participants can use municipal parking near the amphitheatre.
course_highlights: Asphalt course through the streets of Siemiatycze
Start and finish at the municipal amphitheatre, 31 Grodzieńska Street
Additional 5 km races and a 400 m race for children
additional: Participants can park at the municipal car park along Nadrzeczna Street and at the municipal car park behind the Biedronka store. The race office is located at the municipal amphitheatre at 31 Grodzieńska Street. Participants in the M65, M70+ and K60+ categories in the 10 km race, and the M65+ and K60+ categories in the 5 km race, are exempt from the entry fee. Participants can take part free of charge in the M65+, M70+ and K60+ categories. Registration is through the Time2go.pl platform. The race takes place on asphalt, and its evening format makes it an attractive sporting and social event in the region.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
Bieg Wolności Podatkowej IFirma Bieg Stacjonarny i Wirtualny
XIX Bieg Zajączkowski
location: Zajączki Drugie, Gmina Krzepice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Brutálfutás 15.0
description: Brutálfutás 15.0 is a fun obstacle race in Nyáregyháza, where participants can take on a mix of a military training course and an obstacle race over 2, 3 or 7 kilometres. It’s not about performance, but about having a great time and creating unforgettable memories—with mud and water guaranteed. Runners can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud, and can also enter as charity runners. The event attracts participants from hundreds of towns and villages across the country and offers a truly entertaining, family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A mix of a military training course and an obstacle race
Plenty of mud and water, with unforgettable obstacles
A unique finisher’s medal and a party atmosphere
additional: Registration is available exclusively online at nevezes.futanet.hu, with payment by bank card or SZÉP card. The venue is the MotoCross track in Nyáregyháza, easily accessible from the M5 motorway. The student discount is available to school-age participants upon presentation of a full-time student ID. Traditional running gear is not needed for the race; a good mood and a spirit of adventure are what matter most. Trail running, online and on-site registration, a unique finisher’s medal, challenging obstacles and a mud-filled course.

name: Bábolna Bio Sunset Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ovis futam -> ingyenes, de regisztrációhoz kötött

description: The Bábolna Bio Sunset Run is a lively evening running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in the center of Bábolna, in front of the Strand- és Termálfürdő. Along the route, runners pass the riding stables and the famous Bábolna Arboretum and Animal Park. The race starts at sunset with extra atmospheric lighting, and participants can choose from three distances, including a half marathon relay. Runners receive a premium race pack with BioTechUSA refreshments, and everyone who finishes within the time limit receives a unique finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: The route passes the riding stables
Runs through the Bábolna Arboretum and Animal Park
Evening start at sunset with extra atmospheric lighting
additional: BioTechUSA refreshments are provided at the aid stations. Participants can choose between ECO and premium race packs; the premium pack includes a Mizuno event T-shirt. At the finish, runners are welcomed at the Athletes Garden with a unique finisher’s medal. The race starts in the evening at sunset, so the summer heat is not a problem. Time limits apply to the 5.25 km, 10.5 km and half marathon distances; there is no time limit for the preschoolers’ and family runs. The race office is located on Tüzér Street in Budapest, with opening hours and a phone contact. Evening event, multiple distances, registration required, an eco-friendly and family-friendly atmosphere, and the option to buy discounted bath admission after the race.

name: Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök 3 / 7 / 14 / 21
description: The Edelény Castle Island Evening Circuits is a charming running race held around the L'Huillier-Coburg Castle. The race offers several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. It is an ideal choice for those who enjoy the castle park’s distinctive atmosphere and the experience of running in the evening. The organizers welcome participants with professional timekeeping and a convenient registration platform.
course_highlights: Run in the grounds of L'Huillier-Coburg Castle
Evening atmosphere and a distinctive setting
Several distances: 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km
additional: Registration takes place on korido.hu, where chip timing (RFID, HuTag) is provided. Participants can choose from several distances, and the organizers send automatic confirmation of registration and payment. Bib production and safety pins are provided, and payment is also possible by card via SimplePay. The race offers several distances and RFID timing, with varied terrain including forest and asphalt sections. Registration takes place on korido.hu.

name: Kecskeméti Sport Fesztivál
description: The Kecskemét Sport Festival is a traditional community sporting event in Kecskemét, near Benkó Hill. The event promotes recreational exercise and sport, welcoming participants in a family-friendly atmosphere with a variety of running activities. Alongside running, the festival also features charity events and community activities, bringing sport and social responsibility together. The organizers warmly invite everyone who wants to run to enjoy the pleasures of exercise and the closeness of nature together.
course_highlights: Running route near Benkó Hill in pleasant natural surroundings
Community running events with a family-friendly atmosphere
Charity running programs and additional sporting events
additional: The event also includes charity activities, with proceeds supporting local foundations. There is usually a raffle for runners, and the organizers provide refreshments and food for participants. The event may include ultramarathons, easy runs, and other sporting activities that encourage active participation by the venue and the community.

name: UTBT (Ultra Tokaj-Bodrogkeresztúr-Tarcal)
description: The Ultra Tokaj - Bodrogkeresztúr - Tarcal running race is a challenging 63 km ultra-distance event that winds through the scenic vineyards and hills of Tokaj-Hegyalja. The race offers three different distances, giving both beginners and experienced runners the chance to find the challenge that suits them. The event is more than just a running race: it is an experience set amid the landscapes of one of Hungary’s most beautiful wine regions. Races start in mass-start format, and refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: 63 km ultra distance through vineyards and hills
Legendary Tokaj-Hegyalja route
Refreshments along the course and at the finish
additional: Both individual and team categories are available, with teams of 2, 3, or 4 members. Starts are mass starts; team start times will be published no later than June 5, 2026. The entry fee can be paid by bank card or bank transfer. Participants receive a downloadable electronic certificate, and related programs and discounts are also available. Cutoff times: Ultra 8 hours, Marathon 6 hours, Half Marathon 3 hours. Age limits vary by distance, from 12 to 18 years. There are three different distances; registration details have not been provided. The event venue is in the vicinity of Fesztiválkatlan.

name: BRUTÁLFUTÁS
description: Brutálfutás is a fun obstacle race in Nyáregyháza, offering an unforgettable muddy, water-filled experience over distances of 2.3 and 7 kilometres. The race is a mix of a military training course and an obstacle race, with fun and community spirit at its heart. Participants arriving from hundreds of towns and villages across the country can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud. The race is not about taking things seriously, but about fun and challenge, so everyone can find a distance that suits them.
course_highlights: A mix of a military training course and an obstacle race
Muddy, water-filled 2.3- and 7-kilometre courses
A unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud
additional: Registration is available exclusively online at nevezes.futanet.hu. Payment by bank card or SZÉP card. A BSI account is required to register. Participants can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud. The event welcomes participants with online registration, charitable elements and a festival atmosphere. The race offers both challenges and a community experience.

name: Račiansky kros – leto
location: Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros LETO je bežecké podujatie v Bratislave-Rači, ktoré ponúka tri trate s rôznou dĺžkou a prevýšením. Hlavná trať má 16 km s prevýšením 503 m, ďalšia trať 9,5 km s prevýšením 335 m a sú pripravené aj detské behy. Trate vedú prevažne lesným terénom s asfaltovými úsekmi a sú dobre značené tromi spôsobmi. Podujatie je vhodné pre rôzne vekové kategórie a ponúka ocenenia pre najlepších v kategóriách. Štart je v Knižkovej doline a časový limit je 3 hodiny pre hlavnú trať.
course_highlights: Trať 16 km s prevýšením +503 m, časový limit 3 hodiny
Trať 9,5 km s prevýšením +335 m, časový limit 2 hodiny
Povrch: 80% les, 20% asfalt, značenie ružovými stuhami, bielymi šípkami a zalaminovanými šípkami na stromoch
additional: Trať je značená tromi spôsobmi: ružovými stuhami s potlačou preteku na stromoch, bielymi múčnymi šípkami na zemi a zalaminovanými šípkami na stromoch (modré, ružové, oranžové). Počet občerstvovačiek: 2 na 16 km trati, 1 na 9,5 km trati. Povinná výbava je štartové číslo upevnené na hrudi viditeľne. Vyhodnotenie pretekárov je krátko po dobehu. Trať je prevažne lesná s asfaltom; registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste; súčasťou sú detské behy s medailami a cenami; podujatie je súčasťou série Račiansky kros s viacerými edíciami počas roka.

name: Vranovská desiatka
location: Dom kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský športový klub Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský dom kultúry
description: Vranovská desiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek v meste Vranov nad Topľou, ktorý ponúka trate na 10 km a 5 km. Pretek je organizovaný Mestom Vranov nad Topľou, Mestským športovým klubom a Mestským domom kultúry. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, pričom sú vyhodnocovaní aj najlepší traja bežci z Vranova. Štart a cieľ sú pri Dome kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť, od rekreačných bežcov po súťažiacich.
course_highlights: Trate na 10 km a 5 km v meste Vranov nad Topľou
Kategórie podľa veku a pohlavia vrátane vyhodnotenia najlepších Vranovčanov
Štart a cieľ pri Dome kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou
additional: Kategórie pretekov sú rozdelené na 10 km (muži a ženy podľa vekových skupín) a 5 km (muži a ženy bez kategórií). Štartovné je 15 € pri online registrácii a 20 € pri registrácii na mieste. Organizátormi sú Mesto Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský športový klub a Mestský dom kultúry. Kontaktnou osobou je Eva Fedorňáková s telefónnym číslom 0917 127 502. Pretek ponúka kategórie na 10 km a 5 km, štartuje sa v priestoroch Domu kultúry, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste.

name: Čeľovská sedmička
description: Čeľovská sedmička je bežecké podujatie konané v obci Čeľovce, okr. Trebišov, pred Kultúrnym domom. Pretek je určený pre rôzne kategórie vrátane mužov, žien, rodín a detí, pričom ponúka letnú prechádzku a súťaž pre najmenších bežcov. Podujatie je súčasťou bežeckej komunity Beh.sk a podporuje aktívny životný štýl v príjemnom prostredí obce.
course_highlights: Udalosť sa koná pred Kultúrnym domom v Čeľovciach
Podujatie je určené pre rôzne vekové kategórie a rodiny
Dátum konania je 14. jún 2026
additional: Miesto štartu je pred Kultúrnym domom v Čeľovciach. Kategórie zahŕňajú mužov, ženy, rodiny a deti, vrátane najmenších bežcov a letnej prechádzky. Pretek je súčasťou miestnych aktivít a je vhodný pre všetky vekové skupiny, vrátane detí a rodín.

name: Tatranská 15
organizer: Obecný úrad Mlynčeky, Športoví nadšenci z Mlynčekov
description: Tatranská 15 je bežecký pretek organizovaný Obecným úradom Mlynčeky a športovými nadšencami z Mlynčekov. Pretek sa koná na futbalovom ihrisku v Mlynčekoch a ponúka príležitosť pre bežcov zažiť atmosféru športového podujatia v krásnom prostredí. Štartovné je dostupné za zvýhodnenú cenu pri včasnej registrácii, pričom je možné sa prihlásiť aj v deň pretekov. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov a športových nadšencov na tomto tradičnom podujatí.
course_highlights: 15 km trať v malebnej prírode Mlynčekov
Súčasť OCR pretekov vrátane Barbarian a Spartan
Priaznivé ceny štartovného, 10 € pri prihlásení do 21.6.2024
additional: Štartovné sa platí pri prezentácii v deň pretekov. Organizátorom je Obecný úrad Mlynčeky a športoví nadšenci z Mlynčekov. Miesto štartu je futbalové ihrisko v Mlynčekoch. Startovne: 10€ pri prihlásení do 21.6.2024, 12€ pri prihlásení v deň pretekov; miesto konania: Futbalové ihrisko, Mlynčeky

name: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře
location: Zámecký park, Kravaře, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Kravaře Chateau Park is a traditional running race organized by the Prajzský běžecký klub Kravaře, held in the picturesque chateau park in Kravaře. The race offers an 8.7 km course for adults and shorter courses for children, divided by age category. The surface consists of gravel paths, and the course follows three loops through the park. The event is suitable for recreational runners and families with children, with welcoming facilities and refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: The course follows three loops through the chateau park
The surface consists of gravel paths
The main course for adults is 8.7 km long
additional: Children’s check-in takes place from 8:30 to 9:10, and children start at 9:15. Children’s categories are divided by age, with course distances ranging from 150 m to 1,800 m. Adults are provided with cake and drinks, while children receive a sweet reward. Facilities include changing rooms and showers at the MFK Kravaře complex. A trail run on gravel paths in the chateau park, registration for adults and children, various age categories, refreshments and prizes.

name: Půlmaraton okolo Prahy 4
location: Žluté lázně, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Prague 4 Half Marathon is a unique individual running event offering a meditative running experience on the varied terrain of an urban trail. The course is approximately 21 kilometres long and follows the perimeter of the Prague 4 district, giving participants a chance to get to know the area and test their own running fitness. There is no mass start: runners set off individually or in small groups between 9:00 and 10:00, eliminating stress and congestion at the start and on the course. Following a successful debut, the half marathon is being held for the second time and is suitable for anyone who wants to combine athletic effort with an enjoyable experience in nature and the city.
course_highlights: Urban trail with varied terrain
Approximately 21 km loop around Prague 4
Individual start between 9:00 and 10:00, with no mass gathering
additional: The event is run individually, with a flexible start between 9:00 and 10:00. Participants can run alone or in small groups, using a map on their phone or on paper. With no congestion at the start, on the course or at the finish, the event offers a relaxed experience. Individual course, marked route, start between 9:00 and 10:00, event is part of the Trail Running Cup series, run at your own risk, take extra care when crossing roads

name: Přespolní běh areálem zdraví Chábory
location: Chábory u Dobrušky, Chábory, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Chábory Health Centre Cross-Country Run is a traditional race organized by the Chábory Volunteer Fire Brigade, held in the picturesque health centre grounds near Dobruška. The event features a main 10,000-metre race and other categories on a 3,330-metre loop, for men, women, juniors and the general public aged 4 to 90. It is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix in running and welcomes all generations under the motto “GET FIT!”. Participants can look forward to certificates, prizes and a raffle, while the overall winner of the main race receives a perpetual trophy.
course_highlights: A 3,330 m loop along field and forest paths
Main race: 10,000 m
Categories for everyone aged 4 to 90
additional: Race check-in takes place from 8:00 to 9:30. The 50 Kč entry fee is paid at check-in as a contribution towards administration and refreshments. The results announcement and prize presentation are scheduled for 11:25. Competitors take part at their own risk and must comply with current hygiene measures. The race takes place on 14 June 2026; registration is open until 13 June 2026 at 20:00. In addition to the main 10,000 m race, shorter distances are also available. Certificates, prizes and a trophy for the overall winner are up for grabs.

name: Chaloupecký kros
location: Chaloupky, Komárov, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Chaloupecký Cross-Country Race is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Chaloupky near Komárov. It offers two main routes of approximately 8 km and 4 km, running on asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. The main race starts at 10:00, giving participants a combination of natural beauty and sporting challenge. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for the general public. There are no children’s categories.
course_highlights: Surface: asphalt, forest paths, meadows
Route distances: 8 km and 4 km
Start in Chaloupky near Komárov
additional: The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. Children’s races are not part of this event. The route surface combines asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. Routes: 8 km and 4 km; start at 10:00; no children’s races; different distances for different categories.

name: Běh na Hraničář
location: Lesní divadlo u Úhlavy, Nýrsko, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Běh na Hraničář is a traditional and prestigious hill race held in the picturesque surroundings of the forest theatre by the Úhlava River in Nýrsko. The 5 km route, with 380 metres of elevation gain, passes the ruins of Pajrek Castle and finishes at the summit of Hraničář, with a stunning view of Mount Ostrý. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and has been held again since 2020 after a three-year break. After the race, participants must make their own way back to the start.
course_highlights: Start by the forest theatre on the Úhlava River
380 metres of elevation gain over a 5 km course
Finish at the summit of Hraničář, with a view of Mount Ostrý
additional: The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup. After the race, participants must make their own way back to the start. The event includes a 5 km main category and children's races; on-site registration is open from 9:15 to 10:15; the course is mostly trail, with a hilly profile and a climb to the summit of Hraničář.

name: Dobývání Dívčích hradů
description: Conquering Dívčí Hrady is a 2 km uphill race with 135 metres of elevation gain, held in Hlubočepy, Prague 5. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and offers runners the challenge of a demanding climb. The course runs through scenic terrain with beautiful views, making the race appealing to fans of mountain running and uphill running. It is suitable for anyone looking to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: 2 km course with 135 m of elevation gain
Demanding uphill race in Hlubočepy, Prague
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series
additional: The race is part of the cycling section—a duathlon, with the option to compete in various categories and results recorded for over 78 runners in the past.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: TATRA FEST 2026
location: Zakopane, Tatra County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird – 460 zł dla zawodników, którzy opłacą udział do 31.12.2025

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Regular – 500 zł – dla zawodników, którzy opłacą udział do 31.05.2026

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Regular – 180 zł – dla zawodników, którzy opłacą udział do 31.05.2026

description: Tatra Fest is a unique mountain festival held in Zakopane, bringing together a range of outdoor disciplines, including mountain running, climbing, cycling, trekking, and family activities. The event includes challenging races along Tatra trails, such as the 68 km Tatra Fest Bieg and the 22 km Tatra Fest Run, offering participants unforgettable experiences amid the Tatra Mountains’ scenic landscapes. The festival attracts both professionals and amateurs, promoting physical activity, contact with nature, and environmental responsibility. The organizers invite everyone to celebrate life and the mountain spirit together.
course_highlights: Tatra Fest Bieg 68 km: a skyrunning course with 5000 m of elevation gain, running above 2000 m above sea level, with exposed trails and fixed ropes
Tatra Fest Run 22 km: a route through Magura Witowska, Mietlówka, Butorowy Wierch, and Gubałówka, with rocky paths and views of the Tatras
Start and finish in Zakopane’s Municipal Park, with time limits at key points along the course
additional: The 68 km Tatra Fest Bieg has time limits at key points along the course: 7:30 at Kasprowy Wierch (11 km), 10:00 at the PTTK mountain hut at Hala Ornak (24 km), 14:00 and 17:00 at the PTTK mountain hut in Polana Chochołowska (39 and 49 km), and 21:00 at the finish in Municipal Park. The Tatra Fest Run 22 km race package includes transport to the start. The finish in Zakopane’s Municipal Park offers food and drinks. The event includes various distances, including 68 km, 22 km, and 11 km, as well as vertical and family competitions. The races take place on scenic routes in Zakopane, including Municipal Park, Kasprowy Wierch, and Polana Chochołowska.

name: Zawojski Festiwal Biegowy
location: Zawojskie Babiogórskie Park Narodowy, Zawoja, Poland
description: The Zawoja Running Festival is one of the region’s largest sporting events, set amid the picturesque scenery of Babia Góra and the Polica Range. The festival attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering a variety of mountain-running distances and a unique atmosphere. The event aims to popularize mountain running and promote the beauty of Babia Góra National Park, combining a sporting adventure with the chance to discover the region’s natural and cultural wealth.
course_highlights: 63 km ultra course with 3,340 m of elevation gain
42.9 km mountain marathon course with 2,060 m of elevation gain
Picturesque views of Babia Góra and the Polica Range
additional: Participant limits for each distance: 63 km – 200 runners, 42.9 km – 200 runners, 21.097 km – 300 runners, 6.2 km – 250 runners. Start times vary by distance: ultra at 5:00, marathon at 10:00, half marathon and 6.2 km run at 15:00. Time limits are 15 hours for the longest distance, 10 hours for the marathon, 3.5 hours for the half marathon, and 1.5 hours for the 6.2 km run. Short races of 100 m to 800 m, adapted to age, are organized for children. Courses range from 6 km to 106 km, with runner limits of 200 to 300; various distances and elevation gains are available, and the event includes mountain running and Nordic walking competitions.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
location: Park przy dworcu kolejowym, Oława, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The CZTERY PORY ROKU Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking event on the same course. The event is charitable and coordinated by the Biegnij Oławo Association of Active People and Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the start is scheduled for the same day. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.
course_highlights: A course of approximately 5 km for both the run and walk
Start and finish in the park by the railway station in Oława
Participants can choose between running and Nordic Walking
additional: The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30 near the start. Registration for the run is closed. Race coordinators: Mariusz Jarosławski (698-025-555), Mateusz Bularz (721-162-604). Runs of approximately 5 km; registration closed; events held across the different seasons; charity activities for Michał Proć; accompanying attractions, prize draws, massages, cycling trips, and meals.

name: Dziki Trail
description: Dziki Groń is a challenging mountain course for Pieniny Ultra-Trail®, following hiking and courier-smuggling trails as well as routes across the mountain pastures of the Little Pieniny. The race offers scenic views of the Tatras and the Beskid Mountains, with the start and finish at Dietl Square in Szczawnica. It is intended for experienced mountain runners looking to take on demanding natural terrain. The event is part of the Pieniny Ultra-Trail mountain running festival, which promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region.
course_highlights: Follows hiking and courier-smuggling trails
Views of the Tatras and the Beskid Mountains
Crosses the mountain pastures of the Little Pieniny
additional: The start and finish are at Dietl Square in Szczawnica. The race office and EXPO are located in Upper Park in Szczawnica. There are 5 aid stations on the course, including one at 12 km by the mountain shelter. Mandatory equipment is required in accordance with the regulations. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region. Registration opens in November 2025. Date: June 14, 2026. The course is approximately 64 km long. The event takes place in Szczawnica, and the route includes mountain trails and the pastures of the Little Pieniny.

name: Grodziski Półmaraton Słowaka
location: Grodzisk Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Hunters Grodziski “Słowaka” Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Grodzisk Wielkopolski since 2007. The race commemorates Juliusz Słowacki, the patron of the local high school, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among residents. The half-marathon course is flat and runs through the town streets over two laps, with numerous refreshment and hydration stations. After the race, participants receive medals and can enjoy a hot meal and drinks. The event also provides an opportunity to promote the town and its local running community.
course_highlights: Flat course through the town streets, with two laps of approximately 10.5 km each
Course marked every 1 km with vertical and horizontal signs
Four nutrition stations and four hydration stations on each lap
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours. The race office is located at Grodziska Sports Hall, ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A. Timing is provided by chips attached to race bibs. After the race, the organizer provides a hot meal and drinks. A team classification for sponsor teams is held in the 5 km race. The combined participant limit for the 5 km and 10 km races is 500. Registration and race-pack collection take place in Grodzisk Wielkopolski, ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A, on 13 June 2026 from 12:00 to 20:00 and on 14 June 2026 from 6:00 to 8:00. Training sessions are held from registration until race day.

name: IV Charytatywny Bieg z Żonkilem
location: Wyspa Bolko, Opole, Opole County, Poland
organizer: Zespół Szkół Ekonomicznych im. Gen. Stefana Roweckiego "Grota" w Opolu
description: The 4th Charity Daffodil Run is a sporting event organized by the General Stefan Rowecki “Grot” School of Economics in Opole. The event will take place on June 14, 2026, on Bolko Island near Laba Café. Participants can take part in a 5 km run, a 2.5 km Nordic walking event, or support the initiative without competing. The run is a charity event that promotes physical activity and support for those in need.
course_highlights: 5 km running route on Bolko Island in Opole
Nordic walking over a distance of 2.5 km
Scenic surroundings near Laba Café
additional: Entry categories: 5 km run, 2.5 km Nordic walking, and the “I’m supporting, not competing” option. The regulations, parent/legal guardian consent form, and authorization to collect a race pack are available for download. The organizer provides electronic timekeeping. Location: Bolko Island; online registration; the event supports charitable causes; distances: 5 km and 2.5 km; date: June 14, 2026.

description: Suszecki Dziki Bieg is a running event organized by the Suszec Municipal Sports Centre, promoting active recreation among children, teenagers, and adults. The races will take place on June 13–14, 2026, at the Gwaruś Recreation Centre in Suszec. Participants can compete in the 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon (21 km) races, as well as races for children and teenagers. Combined classifications are available for the most persistent runners over 5+21 km and 10+21 km, with prizes. The event has a friendly atmosphere and welcomes both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon (21 km) courses at the Gwaruś Recreation Centre
Option to enter the combined Dziki Dublet 5+21 km and Dziki Super Dublet 10+21 km classifications
Races for children and teenagers over various age-appropriate distances
additional: Race office hours: Saturday 12:00–14:45, Sunday 8:00–9:30. Participant limits: 300 for the 5 km and 10 km races, and 300 for the half-marathon. Registration must be completed at least 30 minutes before the race starts. Medical support will be provided on the course. Participants in the Dziki Dublet and Super Dublet combined classifications will receive commemorative caps, with prizes for the top finishers. Participant limit: 300; registration online and at the race office; medical support; Gwaruś Recreation Centre grounds.

name: Maraton Smolecki
location: Smolec, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Mrowna Run Grodzisk łączy w biegu
X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25
organizer: Sopron Város Polgármesteri Hivatal Sportfelügyeleti Csoportja, SMAFC Tájfutó Szakosztálya, SMAFC Tájfutó Sportjáért Alapítvány, Sopron-Trail
description: The Sopron Trail 2026 trail-running race will take place in the scenic surroundings of Sopron-Brennbergbánya on June 14, 2026. The race aims to promote trail running and showcase the wild landscapes of the Sopron Hills. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5.9 km, 10.7 km and 25.9 km. One of the distances is part of the Alpokalja Trail King running series. The race also offers a special extra challenge: a timed uphill section, with special prizes for the fastest male and female runners. Race headquarters will be at the Brennbergbánya Cultural Centre, which has toilets and showers.
course_highlights: Wild, scenic trails in the Sopron Hills
A separate timed uphill section on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km courses
Aid stations on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km courses; cups will not be provided for environmental reasons
additional: The start and finish are on Brennbergbánya’s main square. The awards ceremony is scheduled for Sunday at 12:30 at the finish. Showers and toilets/WC are available at race headquarters. Cups will not be provided at aid stations for environmental reasons, so runners are advised to bring their own bottle or cup. Registration is through e-nevezés, with a deadline of June 13, 2026, at 12:00. Challenging uphill sections receive special awards; registration is online through the E-nevezés system; the organizers use environmentally friendly solutions.

name: Lussonium Trail 1 / 5 / 14
description: Lussonium Trail is a family-friendly trail running race among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering wonderful panoramas and challenging climbs. The race has a friendly, cheerful atmosphere where runners can meet again year after year. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal, but it is also possible to register without a medal. The event is also a points-collection station for the Ötpróba program, so participants can earn points and redeem them for rewards. The start area is at the Lussonium Roman Ruins, where parking, toilets, a playground, and a first-aid point are available.
course_highlights: Wonderful panoramas among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging climbs and varied terrain
Impressive start/finish venue at the Lussonium Roman Ruins
additional: The race will be held if there are at least 100 registrants. Entries are capped at 400, including a maximum of 100 preschool and lower-primary-school children. Parking, toilets, a playground, and a first-aid point are available on site. The finish medals can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a points-collection station for the Ötpróba program. The race takes place at the Lussonium Roman Ruins in Dunakömlőd and offers sporting opportunities for families and individual runners alike.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: The Crosskovácsi Dockyard Trail Running Race is a trail-running event offering a variety of distances in the picturesque surroundings of Nagykovácsi, near Teleki-Tisza Castle. The race features four distances: mini (3 km), short (7 km), middle (13.5 km) and mountain half marathon (21.7 km), each starting with a 1 km lead-in lap in the castle park. The courses cross varied terrain with significant elevation gain, and participants can refuel at aid stations. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. The race uses electronic timing, and the organizers pay particular attention to runners’ safety and medical care.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 7 km, 13.5 km, 21.7 km (mountain half marathon)
Significant elevation gain: 85 m+ on the mini course, 595 m+ on the mountain half marathon
Two aid stations on the course; three aid stations on the mountain half marathon. Bringing your own soft cup is recommended.
additional: The race has two starts: the Mountain Half Marathon at 9:00 and the School, Mini, Short and Middle distances at 9:30. Mountain half marathon participants must use their own soft cup at the aid stations. The race uses electronic timing, and the rescue system is supported by off-road vehicles and medical staff. Registration is via SPORTNAPTAR.HU; pre-registration opens on December 6, 2025. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Multiple distances, aid stations, medical services, parking, car-free start/finish area.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: Lussonium Trail is a trail running race among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning views, tough climbs and an impressive start/finish venue. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, with participants of all ages able to test themselves over several distances. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be joined together with the Feldwar Trail medal, but a lower-priced entry without a medal is also available. The event is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program. Parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid station are available at the venue.
course_highlights: Stunning views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Tough climbs on the trails
An impressive start and finish venue at the Lussonium Roman Garden
additional: The race will be held if there are at least 100 entrants, and entries are accepted for a maximum of 400 people, including a maximum of 100 preschool- and primary-school-aged children. Parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid station are available at the venue. The finisher medals can be joined together with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program. Several distances, family and children’s categories, hilly trails, medals and refreshments are available to participants.

name: Unicredit Pražská štafeta RunCzech
location: Výstaviště Praha Holešovice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The UniCredit Prague Relay is a team running event taking place on 16 June 2026 in Prague, featuring a relay race with four 5 km legs. The race starts at 18:00 in Stromovka Park, directly in front of Výstaviště Praha Holešovice, which is easily accessible by tram. The event is designed for teams and is suitable for corporate team-building, school events, and other groups looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and have fun together. After the race, a Team Box with comfortable facilities and catering is available for participants and their fans.
course_highlights: Team relay race: 4 x 5 km
Start and finish in Stromovka Park, Prague
Easy tram access to the Výstaviště Holešovice stop
additional: The Team Box offers a fully equipped tent with catering, alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, an electrical connection, and branding for 50 visitors. Only runners whose race number ends in "A" will be allowed to enter the start area. The use of skates, bicycles, and strollers is strictly prohibited, as is running with dogs or taking children onto the course. The event takes place in Stromovka Park and offers team registration, refreshments, and an accompanying programme including an evening party. The start and finish are at Výstaviště Praha Holešovice.

name: Kros Otakara Pachmanna
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Otakar Pachmann Cross-Country Race is a 4.4 km race through the beautiful natural surroundings of Krčský les in Prague 4. It is part of the SABZO series and gives runners the chance to enjoy natural terrain and a woodland atmosphere. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and wants a sporting challenge in a peaceful forest setting.
course_highlights: 4.4 km course
Off-road running in Krčský les
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race is part of the SABZO series, which offers various course distances, including 6 km, 3 km and 12 km, as well as activities for families with children in Krčský les.

name: 401. Malá cena Monaka
location: Restaurace Monako, Slatiňany, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Malá cena Monaka is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race is part of the long history of running events organized by the KRB Chrudim club and gives athletes the opportunity to test themselves on interesting courses. Kategórie pre mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách

Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia. Trať je z 80% asfaltová a spevnená, registrácia je možná online do 15. júna 2026, maximálny počet účastníkov je 300.

name: Beh k Iliašovskej kapličke
price_range: 10,00 € (5 € pre obyvateľov Iliašoviec, deti do 12 rokov zadarmo)
description: Beh k Iliašovskej kapličke je bežecké podujatie konané v Iliašovciach na futbalovom ihrisku FK56. Preteky ponúkajú dve hlavné trate s dĺžkami 5,6 km a 10,8 km, ktoré vedú prevažne po poľných a lesných cestách. Štart pretekov je o 10:00 hodine pre hlavnú kategóriu a o 13:00 hodine pre deti. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú vekovú kategóriu bežcov, vrátane detí, a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru v prírode.
course_highlights: Prevažne poľné a lesné cesty
Dve hlavné trate: 5,6 km a 10,8 km
Štart na futbalovom ihrisku FK56 v Iliašovciach
additional: Štart detí je o 13:00 hodine. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia pre obe trate. Kontakt na organizátora: Mgr. Ladislav Petrek, tel.: 0901 712 711. Trať vedie po poľných a lesných cestách; registrácia je možná telefonicky na čísle 0901 712 711 alebo e-mailom na info@bik.sk

description: Doby vežu je extrémny prekážkový beh a trail, ktorý sa koná v Brezne na Slovensku. Pretekári sa musia popasovať s náročnými prekážkami a zdolať trasu vedúcu na vrchol druhej najvyššej vyhliadkovej veže na Slovensku s výškou 40 metrov, odkiaľ sú krásne výhľady. Trať vedie prevažne lesnými chodníkmi, lúkami a potokom s minimom asfaltu a obsahuje strmé stúpania a zbehy. Okrem športového zážitku je pripravený aj sprievodný program plný zábavy pre všetky vekové kategórie. Organizátorom je M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., riaditeľom pretekov Marek Janoštiak.
course_highlights: Lesné chodníky, lúky, potok, minimum asfaltu
Prevýšenie 450 m s náročnými prekážkami (plazenie v blate, šmýkačka, bradlá, slackline, šplhanie, cargo sieť a ďalšie)
Vrchol druhej najvyššej vyhliadkovej veže na Slovensku s výškou 40 metrov
additional: Online prihlasovanie končí 13.06.2026 o 23:55 alebo pri naplnení limitu. Po tomto termíne je možná registrácia na mieste v deň pretekov, ak nie je naplnený limit. Penalizácie za nezdolanie prekážok sú angličáky (15 pre Hobby, 20-30 pre Open). Pomoc medzi pretekármi je povolená v Hobby, zakázaná v Open. Občerstvenie na trati a v cieli (ovocie a nápoj). Deti môžu súťažiť len so súhlasom zákonného zástupcu. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a typu trate. Pretek zahŕňa prekážkový beh a trail, registrácia končí 13. júna 2026, sú k dispozícii kategórie pre deti a juniorov, súčasťou je občerstvenie a sprievodný program.

name: Revírní POHO běh
description: Revírní POHO Run is a traditional running race held in Karviná, with its hub at Masaryk Square. The race offers various distances, including 50 km, a half marathon, 10 km, 6 km, and relays, with routes through the scenic countryside around Karviná Sea and the Olše River. The course is mostly flat with minimal elevation gain and offers beautiful views of nature and the lake, making it an enjoyable experience for runners of all levels. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, where runners also traditionally loop around the fountain. The race is suitable for experienced runners, families, and amateurs alike.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Masaryk Square in Karviná, with the traditional loop around the fountain
The route passes through Božena Němcová Park and around Karviná (Darkov) Sea, with beautiful views
Mostly flat course with minimal elevation gain, on pleasant paved paths through reclaimed floodplain meadows
additional: Participants can order a POHO50 technical T-shirt for 390 Kč and collect it on race day with their race pack. Relay teams can add or edit members after payment. Runners can use the opened barrier on the road to Karviná Sea for easier access to the course. The 50-kilometre race is also the Czech Republic Championship.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
location: Veliše, Podblanicko, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is a cross-country race for experienced runners, enthusiasts, and amateurs, held in the picturesque Podblanicko region. The race offers two routes, 10 km and 5.2 km long, running mostly along field and forest paths for an enjoyable experience in nature. It is ideal for anyone who wants to run in a clean environment and test their abilities against other runners. Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional event that attracts a broad running community.
course_highlights: Routes run mostly along field and forest paths
Picturesque Podblanicko region
Two race distances: 10 km and 5.2 km
additional: Children’s races from 50 to 1000 m, timed with stopwatches; the race is suitable for runners of different levels and offers a friendly atmosphere in nature.

name: Prague Park Race – Divoká Šárka
location: Divoká Šárka, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Nejlevnější startovné na Divokou Šárku do konce dubna

description: Prague Park Race - Divoká Šárka is a running race held on June 20, 2026, amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. The race offers a unique atmosphere and breathtaking views, which runners can enjoy on routes of 8 and 14 kilometres. The routes follow paved and unpaved roads, meadows and trails, partly including asphalt roads with limited traffic. The race is suitable for the general public and offers refreshments on the course and at the finish. The start and race-day registration take place at the SK ARITMA grounds in Prague-Vokovice, which are easily accessible by public transport and car.
course_highlights: Routes follow paved and unpaved roads, meadows and trails
Approximate route distances of 8 and 14 km, with every kilometre marked
The course passes through a castle, with two sections featuring stairs and narrow trails
additional: Race-day registration is open from 9:00 to 10:45, and the children's races start from 10:00. There is a refreshment station at approximately the 8 km mark on the longer, 14 km route, with refreshments for everyone at the finish. Race capacity is limited; on-site registration is available if capacity has not been reached. Public transport is recommended to Nádraží Veleslavín stop (700 m from the grounds); parking is available by Džbán Reservoir (300 m). The race takes place in a natural setting, registration is available online, and the event features scenic trail routes of varying lengths and difficulty.

name: Krosový běh Chudenickým Žďárem
location: Sportovní areál Jalovčí, Chudenice, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh chudenickým Žďárem is a young cross-country race founded in 2016, held amid the picturesque autumn scenery of Žďár Hill above the village of Chudenice. The course is a challenging cross-country run with no paved sections, a gently rolling profile, and an appealing climb up the forest steps to Bolfánek. The start and finish are located in the grounds of the local sports club. The main race is 6.2 km long and offers runners both a challenge and beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: No paved sections
Gently rolling profile with a climb up the forest steps to Bolfánek
Start and finish in the grounds of the local sports club
additional: The race is part of Ešus liga, a traditional and prestigious series of off-track runs in the Klatovy District. In previous years, Ešus liga races have offered original prizes such as running caps, bottles of drinks, fairground cakes, and Šumava cheeses. The course is known for being exactly 6.2 km long—as long as you don't get lost. The course is approximately 6.2 km long; the race is open to all age categories, has no paved sections, and includes a climb to Bolfánek. The race takes place in June 2026; the exact date is June 20.

name: Run 4 HELP Praha

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrace ONLINE: Do - 18.06.2026 do 18:00 s balíčkem

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrace ONLINE: Do - 18.06.2026 do 18:00 s balíčkem

description: Run4Help 2026 is a charity run taking place on June 20, 2026, in Prague’s Letná Gardens nature park. The event offers races for adults over 4 km and 8 km, children’s races in various age categories from birth to 14 years, and a non-competitive 1 km run for people with disabilities. Entry fees are donated to the nonprofit organization No Foot No Stress, and every participant receives a commemorative medal at the finish. The race is suitable for both professional and amateur runners who want to support a good cause.
course_highlights: The route follows wide paths through Letná Gardens nature park
A charity run supporting the nonprofit organization No Foot No Stress
Categories for children from birth to 14 years, plus a special run for people with disabilities
additional: On-site registration is available without a race pack. Entry is free for people with disabilities and their companions. The official Run4help T-shirt can be ordered until 20.05.2026. The number of participants is limited to 1000. A beautiful medal awaits every runner at the finish. The program includes children’s races, a non-competitive run for people with disabilities, and 4 km and 8 km races. This charity run supports NO FOOT NO STRESS with its proceeds and includes various race distances and an accompanying program.

name: Příborský běh
organizer: město Příbor, Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice
description: The Příbor Run is a traditional race organized by the town of Příbor in cooperation with the local Scout troop and the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race is for both athletes and recreational runners, who can choose a distance to suit their abilities. It offers a 4.6 km hobby category, a 9.2 km sport category, and relays of four runners (2 men + 2 women), with each runner completing a 2.3 km lap. Children’s races over various distances are also part of the event. The friendly atmosphere supports the region’s broad running community.
course_highlights: Hobby category – 4.6 km (2 laps)
Sport category – 9.2 km (4 laps)
Four-person relays (2 men + 2 women), each runner completes a 2.3 km lap
additional: The race is part of the Lašská Running League. The categories start in sequence: first the sport category, then the hobby category 2 minutes later, followed by the relays after another 2 minutes. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, and offers different distances according to age and ability. It is open to various age categories, including children and relay teams, and takes place in the historic center of Příbor. Details about registration and the exact terrain are not specified.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Praha
location: Park u Čeňku, Sokolský ostrov, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Barvám Neutečeš is a colourful run and a full day of fun for all ages, families and friends. Choose between two routes: 5 km with five colour zones, or 1.5 km with three colour zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about joy, friendship and unforgettable experiences filled with music, laughter and bursts of colour. The event takes place in Prague at Park u Čeňku and on Sokolský ostrov, and is part of a year-round colourful tour through several cities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colour zones
1.5 km route with 3 colour zones and an Urban Challenge zone
Colour zones shower runners in colour from head to toe
additional: The all-day event runs from 8:00 to 17:00 in Prague and includes music, themed zones, photo booths, 360° video and an accompanying programme. The run is not timed; children can take part on someone’s shoulders, on scooters or in strollers. The event also includes the charitable Barvám Neutečeš Heroes project for children with disabilities. The festival features a variety of colour zones, music and activities, and is suitable for all age groups. It takes place at Park u Čeňku and on Sokolský ostrov, with a focus on fun and shared community experiences.

name: POHO50 - Revírní pohodová padesátka
description: POHO50 – Revírní Pohodová Padesátka is a traditional running race held in Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to enjoy a run in the region’s beautiful surroundings. Participants can also order an original POHO50 performance T-shirt, which they can pick up on race day. Registration is simple and also allows relay teams to sign up and manage their members after paying the entry fee.
course_highlights: A course of approximately 50 km around Karviná and the Karviná Sea
Shorter distances of 21 km, 10 km, and 6 km are also available
Natural scenery and varied terrain around the Karviná Sea
additional: Participants can order an original POHO50 performance T-shirt for 390 Kč. They can pick it up on race day together with their race number and race pack. Relay-team registration allows members to be managed after the entry fee has been paid. Participants consent to the processing of their personal data and to the creation of photo/video recordings for the organizer’s advertising purposes. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, offers various distances, including an ultramarathon, and is suitable for all ages and running abilities.

name: Běh Jana Opletala
location: Lhota nad Moravou, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Run in the Footsteps of Jan Opletal and Jiří Vaci Memorial is a traditional running event organized by Jan Opletal Grammar School in Litovel. The race commemorates notable figures and the history of the school and town. It takes place in the beautiful Litovel region and is suitable for the general public looking for a sporting experience with a historical touch.
course_highlights: Start at Jan Opletal’s birthplace in Lhota nad Moravou
The race is 8 km or 10 km long, depending on the year
The races include school teams and regional runs
additional: The races take place in June, often with school teams participating and as part of regional running series.

name: Běh okolo Vraní skály
location: Černín u Zdic, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Vraní skála is a traditional running race held in Černín near Zdice, offering a challenging course approximately 9 km long. The race combines a steep uphill road section, forest tracks and narrow trails leading to the summit around Vraní skála, followed by a rolling, mostly downhill section with a steep descent to the finish. The race starts in the square in Černín near Zdice, and the main race begins at 10:30. It is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár and is suitable for runners who enjoy a mix of road and trail with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: Steep uphill road section at the start, up to the 1 km mark
Gentler climb along a forest track and narrow trail to the summit around Vraní skála
Rolling, mostly downhill section followed by a steep road descent to the finish
additional: The entry fee is 200 Kč for on-site registration; a sausage is included. The course runs on both roads and trails. There are no children’s races on the main event date. Results are available in the system and as a PDF. The organizer is Instalatérství Ivan Raboch. The course is 9 km, starts at 10:30, and has no children’s races; registration is on site, and a sausage is included. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár series, which features various distances and categories throughout May and June.

name: Běh na Kozlovský kopec
location: Kozlovský kopec, Česká Třebová, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kozlovský Kopec Run is a traditional Czech Třebová road hill race, taking place on June 20, 2026. The race starts at 10:00 a.m. on Habrmanova Street in front of the Secondary Vocational School building, and finishes at Max Švabinský Cottage on Kozlovský Kopec. The 5.2 km course, with 230 metres of elevation gain, runs on asphalt and is among the more challenging races in the regional ISCAREX Cup series and the Czech Hill Running Cup. Race facilities are available in the school building, including registration, changing rooms and toilets. Entries can be submitted online in advance at a discounted entry fee or on race day.
course_highlights: 5.2 km course with 230 m of elevation gain
Road hill race finishing at Max Švabinský Cottage
The entire course is on asphalt
additional: Race facilities are in the building of the Gustav Habrman Secondary Technical and Transport School, where participant registration takes place and changing rooms and toilets are available. Entries can be submitted online in advance at a discounted entry fee or on race day. The race is part of regional cup series; registration is available online. The start is on Habrmanova Street and the finish is at Max Švabinský Cottage.

location: Masarykovy sady, Louny, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic

description: The Petra Hézlová Memorial is a charity sporting event held in Louny, offering running races for adults and children. The main event features 5 km and 10 km races for men, women and students, timed with chip timing. The event is part of a family sports afternoon and offers a varied programme of accompanying activities in addition to the races. All participants receive a commemorative wooden medal, and there is a raffle for a LIFEFIT.PRO treadmill. The memorial supports health and social projects, especially oncology.
course_highlights: Adult 5 km and 10 km routes in Masaryk Gardens in Louny
Chip timing
Children’s races of 100 m, 400 m and 1,000 m, depending on age
additional: The start and finish are in Masaryk Gardens in Louny. Registration and race-number collection take place from 13:00 to 13:45. The children’s races start after the main race, from 15:45. All runners receive a commemorative wooden medal. In the evening, there is a raffle for a LIFEFIT.PRO treadmill. GPX files of the adult routes are available to download. Participation is at your own risk. Group registration for running clubs is available by email. The event includes children’s races, family activities, chip timing and a treadmill competition; registration is available online and on site; the start and finish are in Masaryk Gardens in Louny.

name: Krakonošova pětadvacítka - B25
description: Krakonošova pětadvacítka (B25) is a 25-kilometre trail run held in Vrchlabí and part of the Krakonošova stovka race series. The course crosses mountainous terrain with approximately 903 metres of elevation gain and offers challenging conditions suited to experienced runners. The event takes place every year in June and attracts participants from across the Czech Republic who want to enjoy the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains and the challenge of a mountain run.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with over 900 metres of elevation gain
Scenic views of the Krkonoše Mountains and Vrchlabí
Part of the long-running Krakonošova stovka series
additional: Start: 16 June 2026 at 11:00; on-site registration at DDM Vrchlabí. The course includes the summit of Žalý and other mountain locations.

name: Jirkovský crossmarathon a půlmarathon
description: The Jirkov Cross Marathon is a mountain marathon through the Ore Mountains around the town of Jirkov, offering runners a personal approach. The event is open to runners, cyclists, scooter riders, and hikers, and includes a marathon, half marathon, and shorter 9-kilometre route. The routes pass through the beautiful natural scenery of the Ore Mountains and suit a range of sporting abilities, as well as recreational participants. The start and finish are at 2nd Jirkov Primary School. The event takes place on 20 June 2026.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in the Ore Mountains
Routes for running, cycling, scooter riding, and hiking
Scenic views and natural landscapes
additional: Registration and the start for hikers are from 7:00 to 8:30; cyclists and scooter riders start at 9:00, and runners at 9:05. The start and finish are at 2nd Jirkov Primary School, Vinařická Housing Estate, Studentská Street. The routes are being updated, and refreshment and checkpoint locations will be added. Participants can also walk the route. Mountain terrain, routes for running, cycling, and scooter riding, half marathon since 2018, race in June 2026

name: FarmaRun
location: Cyklostezka Varhany, Česká Lípa, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: FarmaRun 2026 is a family sporting event organized by the Libchavští chlupáči animal sanctuary in Horní Libchava. The race offers a main 5 km run along a pleasantly shaded, flat cycle path, suitable for runners and walkers alike. Children can take part in a short 300 m run, and there is an exhibition race for the youngest participants, aged up to 4, right on the farm grounds. After the race, participants receive a commemorative medal, a refreshing drink, and light refreshments. There is also an accompanying program for the whole family.
course_highlights: The 5 km route follows a shaded, flat cycle path
Start in Česká Lípa, finish at the Libchavští Chlupáči animal sanctuary
Children’s 300 m races and an exhibition race for the youngest participants on the farm grounds
additional: At the finish, every runner receives a commemorative medal, a refreshing drink, and light refreshments. The race for children aged up to 4 is a fun exhibition event held under the supervision of judges right on the farm grounds. The event focuses on families and supporting the rescue farm. The races take place on the Varhany cycle path in Česká Lípa. Registration is via naZávody.cz, with an accompanying program throughout the day.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
description: Velíšskej Přespolňák is a traditional cross-country race with a long history, held in Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race is open to all age groups and offers a range of distances, from children’s races to the men’s 7,800-metre race. The Lucka Náprstková Memorial commemorates a tragic event and is part of the sporting event. It is organised by the Czech Union of Sport, which encourages the general public to stay active and take part in sport.
course_highlights: A range of distances for children and adults
Cross-country running on natural terrain in Louny
The Lucka Náprstková Memorial is part of the race
additional: The race is open to all categories. Children running with their parents cover 100 m, children in the preparatory category run 500 m, and men run 7,800 m. Registration and the schedule are available at www.askelna.cz. The Lucka Náprstková Memorial commemorates a tragic event in the High Tatras in 2002. The event is part of a wider series of sporting events in the Czech Republic, aimed at encouraging the general public to stay active and take part in sport.

name: XII BIEG WIERCHAMI
location: Rytro, Gmina Rytro, Powiat nowosądecki, Małopolska, Poland
description: Bieg Wierchami is a mountain ultra race held in the scenic Sądecki Beskid Mountains, covering 100 km with substantial elevation gain. The course follows a variety of mountain trails, offering runners a top-level challenge and beautiful views. The race starts in the courtyard of Rytro Castle, and the route features numerous aid stations and notable locations such as the Łabowska Hala Mountain Hut and Żłobki Pass. It is an event for experienced mountain runners who value a challenge and being close to nature.
course_highlights: 100 km distance with approximately +3,809 m / -3,821 m of elevation change
The course follows the Main Beskid Trail and numerous marked trails (blue, green, red, and black)
The toughest section is an approximately 10 km climb to Wielki Rogacz, with aid stations along the way
additional: The race starts at 3:00 a.m. in the courtyard of Rytro Castle. The course features numerous aid stations and passes through notable locations and mountain trails. Race packs are available to registered and paid-up participants. Organizer: Visegrad Maraton Rytro Association. Eight different routes, children's races, ultramarathons, mountain marathons, races for beginners and advanced runners, and an event bringing the local community together.

name: I Nocny Półmaraton Piaseczyńśki
description: The Piaseczno Night Half Marathon is a unique road race held at night along the scenic, illuminated streets of Piaseczno. The 21.0975 km course is flat and fast, making it ideal for setting personal bests. Participants can expect professional organization, certified timekeeping, well-stocked aid stations, and full medical support. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and a recovery area with drinks and a meal awaits at the finish. It’s an unforgettable experience under the stars in a nighttime atmosphere.
course_highlights: A nighttime, illuminated course through the scenic streets of Piaseczno
A flat, fast course with minimal elevation changes
A PZLA-certified course with professional timekeeping
additional: The race package does not include a T-shirt, which can be purchased separately for PLN 75 until 29.05.2026. The half marathon is limited to 2,000 participants. The half marathon time limit is 3 hours gun time, with a 1.5-hour limit at the halfway point. Starting corrals are assigned according to projected finish time. Free baggage storage is available. After the race, participants receive water, isotonic drinks, and a recovery meal. A group warm-up led by an instructor takes place at 20:30. Online registration, urban setting, 21:00 start, fluorescent and personalized medals, event held under the patronage of the Mayor of Piaseczno

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Biegach Przełajowych. Bieg 4: Kąty Wrocławskie
location: Kąty Wrocławskie, Wrocław County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality Cross-Country Running Championships 2026 is a series of four races held in scenic locations across the municipality, including Krobielowice, Zachowice, Sadowice and Kąty Wrocławskie. The courses delight with their varied terrain and the natural beauty of the Bystrzyca Valley Landscape Park. Participants can enter individual races or the entire series, and those who complete three races are included in the overall standings. Each race ends with the presentation of a commemorative medal. When all four medals are collected, they form a visually cohesive whole featuring the outline of the municipality’s boundaries.
course_highlights: A classic cross-country course starting and finishing by the palace in Krobielowice
Hills and vineyards, with the greatest elevation gains in Zachowice
A technical course with turns and changing surfaces in the woodland setting of Sadowice
additional: Participants can order the event’s official T-shirt, made from lightweight, breathable VF100 fabric, with a unisex athletic fit and durable full-print design. After each race, runners receive a medal. When all four medals are collected, they form a visually cohesive whole featuring the outline of the boundaries of Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality. The event includes several locations and distances, with the option to register for all or selected races. Participants can look forward to commemorative medals, official T-shirts, and age-group and team categories.

name: ULTRA TURNICKI
description: Ultra Turnicki is a unique running festival taking place on June 20, 2026, in Huwniki in the Przemyśl Foothills. The event offers summer courses of 10, 24, 48, and 75 km, winding through scenic forests, meadows, and mountain pastures, combining sporting competition with the rich cultural dimension of the Wianki festival. The race is for runners seeking adventure and contact with nature, away from crowded mountain trails. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing transport, aid stations, and accommodation options nearby.
course_highlights: The courses pass through Carpathian forests, meadows, and mountain pastures, with opportunities to spot golden eagles and lesser spotted eagles
Scenic views from the Arłamowskie and Rybotyckie mountain pastures, as well as historic sites such as St. Onuphrius Church
Varied elevation and technical sections, including the highest massif, Suchy Obycz

Heats divided according to predicted finish times
