description: The 18th Ursynów Run is an annual running event taking place on June 20, 2026, in Warsaw’s Ursynów District. The 5 km race runs entirely along Aleja Komisji Edukacji Narodowej, which will be closed to traffic during the event. The course is fast, flat and certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), making it suitable for personal-best attempts by both experienced and beginner runners. The start and finish are near the Ursynów District Office. Participants will receive a race pack with a bib, timing chip and T-shirt, and a medal at the finish.
course_highlights: 5 km course entirely along Aleja Komisji Edukacji Narodowej (KEN)
Flat, fast course certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Asphalt surface, markers every 1 km, 45-minute time limit
additional: Participant limit: 2,200. The race pack includes a race bib, timing chip, T-shirt and water; participants receive a medal at the finish. The start and finish are near the Ursynów District Office at Al. KEN 61. The course will be closed to traffic during the race. More than 100 volunteers will be on the course to support event operations and safety. The time limit is 45 minutes. The race starts at 10:00. Participants can register online, and the event promotes sports activity in Ursynów District.

name: 43 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Wzgórza Strzelińskie, Opole Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a foot orienteering event organized by the PTTK Strzelin Land Branch since 1996. It has a long-standing tradition and welcomes participants of different ages and experience levels. Teams of 2–5 plan their own routes, aiming to visit as many checkpoints as possible within the allotted time. Checkpoints have different point values, and participants travel exclusively on foot using a map and compass. The event combines tourism and sport, making it appealing to enthusiasts, recreational participants, and families. It takes place in the scenic Strzelin Hills, with routes ranging from a few to several dozen kilometers.
course_highlights: Teams choose their own route, from 5 to 70 km
Checkpoints have different point values depending on difficulty
Travel on foot with a map and compass through the Strzelin Hills
additional: The event is open to participants of different ages and both sexes. Teams consist of 2–5 people. Routes can be changed during the event. The event combines tourism and sport and is also suitable for families. It offers routes of varying difficulty and length, with the event base in Kamiennik. Participants can choose from different distances and enjoy the surrounding forests and scenery.

name: Bieg 12h mocy
price_range: zgłoszenia przez e-gepard.eu do 10 czerwca, brak informacji o opłatach
description: The 12h MOCY Run in Bełchatów is an ultramarathon held on a 5-kilometre forest loop and lasts 12 hours. Competitors aim to cover the greatest possible distance within the allotted time, starting from the athletics stadium at 96 Czapliniecka Street. The route runs 99% along forest trails, offering close contact with nature, while the start and finish are on the stadium’s professional running track. To earn the title of “MOCY” finisher, participants must cover at least 30 km, or six full loops. The participant limit is 100, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and motivation to overcome personal limits.
course_highlights: A 5-kilometre loop that is 99% forest trails
Start and finish on the professional track at the athletics stadium
The route offers close contact with nature
additional: The participant limit is 100. Runners may stop at the event base for any length of time after each lap. Results are verified by judges using GPS. The event runs from 6:00 to 18:00. 96 Czapliniecka Street, forest loop, limit of 100 participants, minimum 30 km to earn the finisher title

name: Drabina Wałbrzyska
location: Jedlina-Zdrój, Wałbrzych County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Drabina Wałbrzyska is a physically demanding mountain route in the Sudetes, running through the Wałbrzych and Kamienne Mountains. Over a distance of approximately 78 km, participants cover nearly 4,000 metres of elevation gain and summit more than 30 peaks. The route forms a loop, and the start and finish can be at any point along the route. It is an excellent option for those who want to discover the scenic and natural attractions of this part of the Sudetes, offering an ambitious challenge without having to travel to high mountains.
course_highlights: Approximately 78 km, with 3,910 m of elevation gain and descent
More than 30 peaks to summit, including the highest, Waligóra (935 m above sea level)
A loop through the Kamienne Mountains, Wałbrzych Mountains and Wałbrzych Foothills
additional: The route is accessible year-round, although icy conditions may occur on steep sections in autumn and winter. You can receive a pin for completing the route by contacting the Facebook group administrator. The “Drabina Wałbrzyska” Facebook group shares project updates. Accommodation is available in a mountain hostel, private lodgings, hotels and guesthouses. The route is not marked on the ground, so you will need to use a map. There are observation towers, mountain hostels and shops along the route. The route is accessible year-round, although icy conditions may occur in winter.

name: VI Bieg Świętojański
description: The 6th Świętojański Run is a 10 km road race taking place on June 20, 2026, in Zawichost. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic, moderately challenging course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with training plans tailored to different experience levels and offer expert support. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, which promotes running and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Scenic areas of Zawichost in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship
A moderately challenging course
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels, as well as expert support. The website also features a Runner’s Zone with tools to track progress, courses, and running resources. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. On event day, several distances will be available, including 600 m and 800 m races for children, and on-site registration will be possible. The event promotes physical activity among people of different age groups.

name: VIII Nocny Bieg
description: The 8th Open Łomża Academic Championships in Night Street Running is an annual sporting event organized by Łomża Academy under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Łomża. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, at 9:00 p.m. on the streets of Łomża, with two routes: 10 km, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), and 5 km, uncertified. The event commemorates the founding of Łomża Academy and promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants must be at least 18 years old, and the time limit for completing the route is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: 10 km route certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Night race on the streets of Łomża
Mandatory timing checkpoint on the route
additional: Participant limit: 100 runners for the 5 km and 100 for the 10 km, plus places reserved by the organizers. Runner check-in at the Race Office on race day is from 7:00 p.m. to 8:45 p.m. The office closes after 8:45 p.m. Runners registered after the limit has been reached may still take part, but will not receive a race package (backpack). Proof of identity must be shown to collect the race package. Minors must provide consent from a parent or legal guardian. 10 km route certified by PZLA; 5 km route uncertified; limit of 100 runners per distance; start and check-in in Łomża; night street race

name: XII Półmaraton Wierchami
description: The 12th Wierchami Half Marathon is a mountain race held in the picturesque Sącz Beskids, near Rytro. The half-marathon course follows challenging mountain trails with numerous aid stations, offering participants beautiful views and a genuine off-road challenge. The event is organized by the Visegrad Marathon Association, which looks after runners’ comfort and safety. It’s a great opportunity for mountain-running enthusiasts to test themselves on a demanding but attractive course.
course_highlights: Mountain trails in the Sącz Beskids with substantial elevation gain
Aid stations along the course
Scenic sections, including the viewing platform by the snail
additional: The race starts at 3:00 a.m. in the courtyard of Rytro Castle (for the 100 km distance). The route follows a variety of mountain trails, including the Main Beskid Trail, with numerous aid stations and demanding climbs, such as the ascent to Wielki Rogacz. The organizer recommends using suitable trail-running gear, including shoes and technical clothing, due to the changeable weather and difficult terrain. The event offers various distances, activities for families, regional food, special merchandise for the fastest runners, and a relaxation area with Piwniczanka.

The event offers distances ranging from approximately a quarter marathon to an ultramarathon, following forest roads, tracks and ravines among nature reserves and lakes. It is known for its excellent organisation, well-stocked refreshment stations, and a unique atmosphere of sporting competition and camaraderie. The event centre is in Owińska, near Poznań, and the finish is at the bathing area. The event will take place on 20 June 2026.
course_highlights: Routes follow forest roads, tracks, trails and ravines
Scenic nature reserves and lakes in the Zielonka Forest
Long-distance, point-to-point cross-country running and walking

The organiser provides refreshment stations and post-race recovery meals. Distances range from 10 km to 100 km. The event takes place in forest areas and features cross-country routes, Nordic Walking events, a 12–14-hour time limit, and registration online and on Facebook.

The event celebrates the start of the summer season and welcomes families and community sports enthusiasts as well as runners. The race is part of the Ötpróba program, which offers the opportunity to collect points for valuable rewards.

Refreshment point at approximately 2.6 km on the 5.25 km course

Balatonszárszó residents receive a 30% discount, and a season discount is also available based on previous participation. A technical T-shirt can be purchased separately (8,500 HUF). The event supports the Ötpróba program and offers discounts for local participants and season pass holders, as well as various running options and prizes.

The race is held in honor of Saint Ladislaus, the patron saint of the infantry and the firearms branch. It has taken place regularly since 2010, with only one cancellation, in 2013, due to flooding. Runners test their strength on varied terrain, forest trails, and hilly routes. This friendly community event is recommended for anyone interested in both nature and sport.

A scenic, challenging course close to nature

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava je najväčší slovenský prekážkový pretek, ktorý sa koná v areáli Divoká Voda v Čunove. Po preteku si účastníci môžu oddýchnuť pri bazéne, vychutnať si občerstvenie a sledovať silové súťaže. Režim Fitness (nesúťažne, bez merania času, bez trestných cvikov, prekážky možno vynechať) a režim Na čas (meranie času, trestné cviky pri nezdolaní prekážky). Po preteku oddych pri bazéne, občerstvenie, možnosť vyskúšať vodné športy a sledovať silové súťaže od 14:00. Štartovné sa nevracia, možnosť prevodu štartovného na inú osobu alebo na ďalší rok za poplatok. Podujatie zahŕňa aj detský pretek, tímové alebo individuálne štarty, a po preteku sú pripravené vodné aktivity a zábava pre všetky vekové kategórie.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy

description: Běhej lesy Týmovka is a unique team relay race held in the heart of the Vysočina region, offering an adventure for teams of 4 to 8 runners. The race consists of three different loops with a total distance of approximately 27.5 km, which each runner must complete over the weekend. The race also takes place at night, with headlamps, adding to its distinctive character and challenge. Alongside the race, there is a packed program of sports activities, cultural events and workshops. The facilities include a comfortable campsite with sanitation and refreshments.
course_highlights: Three loops with a total distance of approximately 27.5 km and elevation gain of 100 to 300 m
Night running with a headlamp as part of the relay race
Forest trails in the heart of the Vysočina region, with loops of varying difficulty

There are no disposable cups at the refreshment stations, so runners must bring their own container (Speedcup). The race includes various team and individual categories, with the option to take part overnight and as part of the Běhej lesy race series, including ultramarathons and charity runs.

The race takes place on the last Saturday in June, with other shorter routes and children’s categories also available.

Part of the Primátor Cup series, with different distances and categories

course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km routes in the centre of Plzeň

name: Sunrise Marathon / Halfmaraton
location: Olympia Brno, Modřice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sunrise Marathon and Half Marathon take place on 21 June 2026 at Olympia Brno, Modřice. The race starts early in the morning at 4:46, giving runners the chance to experience the magical atmosphere of sunrise as they run. The course is flat and consists of five equal-length laps, running partly through nature and partly through shaded sections. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping and support at key points along the course. The race is suitable for all runners who want to welcome summer actively and enjoy the unique experience of running at dawn.
course_highlights: Flat course with five equal-length laps
Start and finish at Olympia Shopping Mall Brno, Modřice
Part of the course runs through nature and shaded sections
additional: Electronic chip timing. The course is marked with directional signs, and organizers are stationed at important points. Baggage storage is available until 10:00. Early-morning start, bus transport from Brno available, refreshment stations, medical service, and race merchandise available for purchase.

name: Hradecký kros
description: Hradecký kros is a traditional 10 km trail race held in the forests around Biřička in Hradec Králové. The race offers a unique experience on natural terrain with fewer paved sections, making it suitable for the general public and recreational runners. The event is part of the East Bohemia Running Grand Prix and attracts runners of all levels every year. The course consists of two 5 km loops over gently rolling terrain, highlighting both the beauty and the challenge of the race.
course_highlights: The course follows forest trails around Biřička
Two 5 km loops over gently rolling terrain
Suitable for the general public and recreational runners
additional: Forest trails, minimal paved sections; registration available on site or online; the race takes place on June 21, 2026, starting at 10:00; race distance: 10 km

name: Ivčin kopeček
description: Ivčin kopeček is a 3.4 km uphill race with 240 metres of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series. The race offers runners a challenging yet appealing course in the beautiful natural surroundings of Beroun in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill running who want to test their endurance and strength on a short but intense route. The race is open to the public and welcomes all runners looking to enjoy a sporting challenge in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: 3.4 km course with 240 m of elevation gain
Challenging uphill run in the natural surroundings of Beroun
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series

description: The 8th “Lotna” Run in Haczów is an annual running event commemorating the Lotna Assault Company of Lieutenant Stanisław Maczek and the Haczów Heroes of the Battles for Poland’s Independence in 1918–1921. The events take place on routes of approximately 12 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking course, mostly on paved and gravel roads in the Haczów municipality. The run promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and integration within the local community. Free shorter-distance races for children, tailored to their age, are also planned. The race office and event base are located in the Manor Park by the Municipal Cultural and Recreation Centre in Haczów.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 12 km and 5 km, mostly on paved and gravel roads

The event takes place in Haczów, in the Manor Park and at the LKS stadium.

The race will take place on June 21, 2026, at 18:00 at the Kasztelania Local Cultural Institution in Kije, where the start and finish will be located. Participants can compete over two distances: 10 km and 5.5 km (“Piątka z plusem”), either running or walking with Nordic walking poles. The event offers a great atmosphere, cash and non-cash prizes, and commemorative medals and race packs for all participants.

The T-shaped course consists of two 5 km loops along the town’s streets, with turnarounds by a wayside shrine and on Brzozowa Street. The start and finish are at Social General Secondary School No. 5 at 41 Herberta Street. The race is organized by running enthusiasts from the STO-nogi group, who promote running among residents and visitors.

The organizers provide a commemorative medal and a voucher for a post-race meal, with a choice of a race package with or without a T-shirt. The event is charitable, supporting the rehabilitation of a girl named Maja.

description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Trail Run is a trail race held in the wooded grounds of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The course features varied terrain, climbs and descents of different lengths and gradients, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. Its cross-country character attracts runners looking to get away from the asphalt or prepare for mountain races. The event offers three distances: 4, 8, and 12 km, as well as a 4 km Nordic walking event and races for children and young people. Participants receive symbolic medals inspired by raspberries, while the top female and male finishers in each distance receive trophies.

description: Kros Sázava is a running race in Pikovice, Central Bohemian Region, offering three routes of varying distances and elevation gains. The longest route is 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain, the middle route is 10 km with approximately 230 m of elevation gain, and the hobby route is 5 km with 120 m of elevation gain. All courses run exclusively through natural surroundings, promising beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of different levels who want to enjoy a cross-country run in a picturesque setting.

description: Chuchelský Cross-Country Race is a traditional cross-country running event organized by the SC Radotín athletics club. It takes place on the racecourse in Velká Chuchle. The event offers various categories for all age groups, from young children to adults, including the Prague Cross-Country Championships. The course runs mostly on grass, with some gravel sections, making for an interesting and challenging terrain. Refreshments are available, and the venue is conveniently accessible by public transport and car. Race numbers and timing chips are issued on site on race day.

The course has been measured by a certified measurer, and the 10 km offers a chance to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships. After the race, you can review your performance and refuel at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. Prizes are awarded to the top runners and loyal participants.

Běh Vídrholcem
description: The Vídrholec Run is a popular running race held in Prague 9-Klánovice. It is part of the local running calendar and attracts runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. The event is held under the auspices of the Czech Running Association and the Czech Athletics Federation, and offers not only competition but also the pleasure of exercising outdoors.

Open to runners of all levels

name: Excalibur Race MOON Zámek Duchcov
location: Duchcov Castle, Duchcov, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
description: Excalibur Race MOON Duchcov Castle is an obstacle race taking place from June 26 to 28, 2026, in the historic setting of Duchcov State Castle and its surroundings. Racers will follow in the footsteps of the legendary Giacomo Casanova and take on a fast course with beautiful views of the Ore Mountains, the Central Bohemian Uplands, and the foothills of the Bílina mine. The race features modern, certified obstacles on professional ALU structures, with an emphasis on safety and quality. A knightly theme adds to the atmosphere, bringing together physical challenge and the values of honor, loyalty, and cooperation. A varied program and facilities, including refreshments and support services, are available for racers and fans.
course_highlights: The course runs up the castle staircase and across nearby meadows, with views of the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands
Modern obstacles on ALU structures, TÜV-certified and regularly inspected
An atmosphere inspired by the legend of Giacomo Casanova and tales of knights
additional: Race pack, electronic timing chip, online results, race photos and videos, fresh fruit and refreshing drinks on the course and at the finish, rescue and event staff, support services for racers and their families at the race center, fan zones and fun activities for children and adults, and the chance to watch the race from attractive vantage points. The race takes place at Duchcov Castle and offers various routes from 6 to 12 km, with obstacles and scenic surroundings. Registration and pricing details are available on the official website.

After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, encouraging them to collect them. The course consists of four loops, and all runners start together. After each loop, the 20 runners who completed it in the longest time are eliminated and receive a so-called “almost medal” at the finish. The top runners competing for the win complete the final loop. The race is open to participants over the age of 16.

description: Run with the Ghosts is a unique night trail run taking place on June 26, 2026, in Leśniów. Participants will tackle two courses, 15 km and 9 km long, full of dark corners and surprises that create a one-of-a-kind, thrilling atmosphere. Runners are encouraged to dress up as apparitions, ghosts, and other spooky characters, adding magic and atmosphere to the event. It is not only a competition, but also a test of endurance and courage in the dark, where participants face their own weaknesses and mysterious figures along the course.

name: Malofatranská stovka
description: Malofatranská stovka je horský ultramaratón v pohorí Malej Fatry, ktorý ponúka náročné trasy s výraznými stúpaniami a klesaniami. Pretek je určený pre skúsených bežcov s výbornou fyzickou kondíciou a prechádza celým pohorím vrátane Krivánskej a Lúčanskej Fatry. Podujatie je registrovaným členom ITRA a slúži ako kvalifikačný pretek pre ďalšie prestížne ultratraily. Organizátorom je Slovak Ultra Trail v spolupráci s dobrovoľníkmi a partnermi.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez celé pohorie Malá Fatra (Krivánska a Lúčanská Fatra)
Výrazné stúpania a klesania s exponovanými miestami

Zľavy na štartovné sú možné na základe ITRA Performance Index. Prezentácia a štart prebiehajú v Terchovej. Trail race through Malá Fatra with significant ascents and descents, exposure, and mountain terrain; registration details not specified.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
description: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši je tradičný bežecký pretek konaný v rekreačnom stredisku Domaša Dobrá. Pretekári si môžu vybrať medzi dvoma traťami - krátkou 5 km a dlhou 13 km, ktoré vedú prevažne lesnými cestami a trailmi s rôznorodým prevýšením. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane kategórií podľa veku a pohlavia, pričom organizátori zabezpečujú občerstvovacie stanice, šatne, toalety a zdravotnú službu. Atmosféra je priateľská a športovo súťažná, s hodnotnými vecnými cenami pre víťazov.
course_highlights: Dlhá trať 13 km s prevýšením približne 356 m nahor a 314 m nadol
Krátka trať 5 km vedúca lesnou cestou s prevýšením 70 m
Občerstvovacie stanice na 5 km, 10 km a v cieli dlhej trate, občerstvenie v cieli krátkej trate
additional: Detský beh je bez štartovného. Šatňa, toalety a úschovňa sú v prístave pri Lodi Bohémia. Každý pretekár musí mať viditeľne pripevnené štartové číslo na hrudi. Zdravotnú službu zabezpečuje organizátor. Štartovné sa vráti v plnej výške pri odhlásení do 8. júna. Preteká sa podľa pravidiel atletických súťaží a propozícií podujatia. Trať 13 km a 5 km, detský beh, kategórie pre mužov a ženy rôznych vekových skupín, štart od 09:45 do 10:15, parkovisko pri Bogárke, rekreačné stredisko Domaša Dobra

Podujatie je otvorené všetkým vekovým kategóriám a kondičným úrovniam, pričom podporuje zdravý životný štýl a pomoc znevýhodneným osobám. name: Velvet Run Košice
location: Košice, pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici, Košice, Slovakia
organizer: Progres Promotion Košice, s.r.o., Maratónsky klub Košice
description: Velvet Run v Košiciach je bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa uskutoční 27. júna 2026 pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici. Pretekárky si môžu vybrať z disciplín 5 km, 10 km a Velvet Nordic Walking na 5 km. Podujatie je určené výhradne pre ženy a ponúka hodnotné vecné ceny pre víťazky v rôznych kategóriách. Organizátori zabezpečujú meranie časov pomocou systému MyLaps a výsledky budú zverejnené na oficiálnych stránkach.
course_highlights: Trate Velvet Run 5 km a 10 km v centre Košíc pri Urbanovej veži
Disciplína Velvet Nordic Walking na 5 km
Prezentácia a štart na Hlavnej ulici
additional: Registrácia prebieha online do 23. júna 2026 alebo do naplnenia limitu. Možnosť registrácie aj na mieste od 14:00 za predpokladu, že neboli naplnené technicko-bezpečnostné limity. Vyhlasovanie víťaziek začína o 18:00, záver podujatia o 19:00. Súťaže dvojíc "Mama a dcéra" a "Sestry" v behu na 5 km a 10 km. Meranie časov zabezpečuje ChampionChip systém MyLaps. Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny, s časovým meraním pomocou systému ChampionChip; registrácia je možná aj na mieste.

name: Čergovský umirak
location: Drienica, Sabinov District, Prešov Region, Slovakia
organizer: Marián Gargalovič, Ondrej Janiga, Slavomír Uličný

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 25,– € Po úhrade štartovného a následnom odhlásení sa z preteku si organizátor nárokuje na 50% z ceny štartovného.

description: Čergovský umirak je horský beh v dĺžke približne 30 km s prevýšením okolo 1000 metrov, určený pre trénovaných bežcov. Pretek sa koná v rekreačnom stredisku Drienica, s možnosťou občerstvenia a doplnkových aktivít pre rodiny. Trať vedie značeným turistickým chodníkom a pretekári sú povinní mať štartovné číslo viditeľne pripevnené na hrudi. Bezpečnosť na trati zabezpečuje Horská služba Čergov, pričom každý účastník štartuje na vlastné riziko. Po dobehnutí posledných pretekárov je pripravené vyhodnotenie a odovzdávanie cien pre najlepších mužov a ženy.
course_highlights: Horský beh s dĺžkou cca 30 km a prevýšením cca 1000 m
Značený turistický chodník v oblasti Čergov
Štart a cieľ pri Chate Ride pub v Drienici
additional: Povinná výbava: nabitý mobilný telefón, min. 0,5 l fľaša na vodu, alufólia v prípade nepriaznivého počasia. Spoločný brífing o 8:30 hod. na Chate Ride pub s oboznámením s traťou a orientáciou. Občerstvenie zabezpečené. Štartovné číslo je neprenosné a musí byť viditeľne pripevnené na hrudi. Počas preteku je zabezpečená bezpečnosť Horskou službou Čergov. Trať je turisticky značená, odporúčajú sa trailové topánky. Pre registráciu je možné kontaktovať organizátorov telefonicky alebo emailom.

name: Hámornický polmaratón
description: Hámornický polmaratón je tradičný bežecký závod organizovaný bežeckým klubom Spartak Medzev v rámci osláv dní mesta Medzev. Podujatie zahŕňa polmaratón, sprievodný beh Hámornícka desiatka a detské kategórie Hámorníček, ktoré sú súčasťou detskej bežeckej ligy. Štart je symbolicky odštartovaný úderom kladiva na kovadlinu, čo dodáva podujatiu jedinečnú atmosféru. Bežci sa môžu tešiť na pekné funkčné tričká, medaile s moderným dizajnom a občerstvenie počas pretekov. Trať vedie krásnym hlbokým údolím s prírodnými krásami a historickou atmosférou mestečka Medzev.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie krásnym hlbokým údolím s prírodnými prameňmi a spevom vtákov
Symbolický štart úderom kladiva na kovadlinu
Sprievodné behy vrátane Hámorníckej desiatky a detských kategórií Hámorníček
additional: Účastníci dostávajú pekné funkčné tričká a medaile s moderným dizajnom. Deti majú bezplatnú účasť v 14 kategóriách s balíčkom sladkostí a džusom v cieli. Podujatie je podporované mestom Medzev a obcou Štós, pričom organizátori oceňujú pomoc z 2% daní. Trať zahŕňa aj futbalový štadión; registrácia online aj na mieste; kategórie pre mužov, ženy a seniorov

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Futbalový štadión, Horné Orešany, Trnava, Slovakia
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany
description: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky - Memoriál Františka Hečka je bežecký pretek v Horných Orešanoch, ktorý ponúka trať dlhú 10 300 metrov s prevýšením 100 metrov. Povrch trate je kombináciou asfaltu a terénu v pomere 50:50, čo robí pretek zaujímavým a náročným. Pretek je otvorený pre všetky vekové kategórie, od detí od 1 roka až po seniorov, vrátane kategórií mužov, žien, juniorov a domácich bežcov. Organizátorom je Bežecký klub Viktoria spolu s Obecným úradom v Horných Orešanoch. Štart pre žiakov je o 15:35 a pre ostatných o 17:00 hod.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 10 300 m s prevýšením 100 m
Povrch trate 50 % asfalt, 50 % terén
Trať vedie cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky s krásnymi výhľadmi
additional: Štart pre žiakov je o 15:35 hod., pre ostatných o 17:00 hod. Kategórie zahŕňajú všetky vekové skupiny od detí od 1 roka, juniorov, mužov a žien rôznych vekových kategórií, vrátane domácej kategórie trojčlenných družstiev. Trať má približne 10,3 km, rozdelená na 50% asfalt a 50% terén, možnosť registrácie online alebo na mieste, štartové časy o 15:35 a 17:00

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava je rodinný bežecký festival, ktorý ponúka trate pre všetky vekové kategórie a výkonnostné úrovne. Pretekári si môžu vybrať z tratí 3, 5 a 10 km, ako aj z detských behov na 500 a 1000 metrov. Podujatie sa koná v dvoch lokalitách a ponúka štartovací balíček so všetkým potrebným pre bežcov. Okrem samotného behu je pripravený bohatý sprievodný program, občerstvenie na trati aj v cieli, zdravotnícky a vodičský servis, a zázemie s možnosťou prezliekania a úschovne. Celý deň je ladený ako zážitok pre bežcov aj ich rodiny s tombolou a možnosťou rytia osobných údajov do medailí.
course_highlights: Trate na 3, 5 a 10 km pre hobíkov aj elitných bežcov
Detské behy na 500 a 1000 metrov
Občerstvovacie stanice na trati a v cieli, zdravotnícky a vodičský servis
additional: Bežci majú k dispozícii vodičov s vlajočkami, ktorí pomáhajú udržať tempo. Po behu je možné si nechať vyryť osobný čas a meno do medaily. K dispozícii sú sprchy, úschovňa a bohatý sprievodný program vrátane detskej zóny a tomboly s hodnotnými cenami. Trať na 3, 5 a 10 km, detské behy na 500 a 1000 m, občerstvenie, sprchy, úschovňa, medaily, fotografie, tombola, rodinná atmosféra

name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun, Slovakia
description: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina je trailový beh v nádhernej prírode Vysokých Tatier, ktorý ponúka bežcom jedinečný zážitok z behu na mäkkom povrchu s čerstvým horským vzduchom. Trasa vedie cez Chodník korunami stromov, Monkova dolina a hrebeň Spišskej Magury, pričom štart je zabezpečený lanovkou. Preteky sú súčasťou série Behaj lesmi, ktorá spája športový výkon s podporou miestnych rodín a charitatívnych príbehov. Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina je výzvou pre skúsených bežcov aj nováčikov, ktorí chcú zažiť horskú prírodu a nezabudnuteľné výhľady.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez Chodník korunami stromov
Výhľady na Vysoké Tatry a hrebeň Spišskej Magury
Štart lanovkou v Bachledovej doline
additional: Preteky sú zaradené pod UTMB Index Races s medzinárodným bodovým hodnotením. Na trati je rýchlostný úsek Conti Speed Section s možnosťou vyhrať voucher na pneumatiky a bežecký dres. Možnosť preregistrácie a zmeny štartovného poplatku online cez profil SportID alebo na mieste pretekov. Súťaž zahŕňa ekologické poháre, vodné stanice, rôzne kategórie pretekov vrátane detských, a ponúka zľavy pri registrácii viacerých účastníkov.

name: Běh týnišťskými pralesy
location: Týniště nad Orlicí, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma pro děti do 15 let, ostatní ceny nejsou uvedeny

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Závodníci do 18 let včetně mají závod bez poplatku

description: The Run Through the Týniště Rainforests is a charity race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Týniště nad Orlicí. It offers courses for different ability levels and age groups. The race takes place in a forest, mainly on paved forest roads, with some asphalt sections. The event includes a free family run for children under 18 and main races of 6, 10 and 21 km. It brings together sport, families and support for a good cause, benefiting RENEDA, a nonprofit organization that helps children with neurological challenges.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest roads with some asphalt sections
Beautiful, forest-surrounded natural scenery in Týniště nad Orlicí
Courses for different ability levels, including a family run
additional: Race number with your name if you register by 7.6.; baggage storage; refreshments on the course and at the finish (water, bananas, oranges, pastries); time limits: 3 km – 30 minutes, 6 km – 1 hour, 10 km – 1:30 hours, 21 km – 3 hours. The race takes place on paved forest roads and has a charitable purpose. Registration opens on 1.5.2026. The event supports the local community and charitable projects.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v dlouhém horském běhu
location: Janské Lázně, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The World Masters Mountain Long Distance Running Championships will take place on 27 June 2026 in the picturesque setting of Janské Lázně in the Hradec Králové Region. This race is intended for masters athletes and offers a challenging long-distance mountain run that will test runners’ endurance and strength in beautiful mountain scenery. The event is part of the prestigious trail-running calendar and attracts runners from around the world. For more information, we recommend following the organization’s official website.
course_highlights: A long-distance mountain run over the mountainous terrain of Janské Lázně
A challenging course profile with elevation changes
Picturesque views and natural scenery in the Hradec Králové Region
additional: Participants must be members of the Czech masters athletics section and compete in the national team uniform; the event also includes local races such as the Běh Dlouhými Záhony.

name: ROZKOŠný 1/2 Maraton
location: Česká Skalice, Česká Skalice, Czech Republic
description: The ROZKOŠný 1/2 Marathon is a half marathon held in Česká Skalice, following a new cycle path around the Rozkoš Reservoir. The event offers a main 21.1 km race and a 2 km fun run for children and mothers with strollers. Entertainment, refreshments and the option of camping accommodation create a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators alike. The main category starts at 12:30; the first category starts at 10:00.
course_highlights: Half marathon along a new cycle path around the Rozkoš Reservoir
2 km fun run for children and mothers with strollers
Camping accommodation and refreshments available on site
additional: The first category starts at 10:00; the main category starts at 12:30. The race takes place on the cycle path by the Rozkoš campsite in Česká Skalice. The fun run is for children and mothers with strollers. Entertainment, refreshments and camping accommodation are available. Terrain: road. Registration: not stated. Other notes: entertainment, refreshments, camping accommodation.

name: Záblatská osmička
description: Záblatská osmička is a running race in Bohumín-Záblatí, offering a welcoming local atmosphere and a friendly pace. The course passes over a variety of surfaces, including paved roads, forest sections, and dirt-and-gravel trails, keeping runners engaged from start to finish. The race is open to everyone who wants to enjoy a run and a great atmosphere. Registration is open until 24 June 2026, and the race starts at 10:00 at the football field in Záblatí.
course_highlights: The course follows paved roads, forest sections, and dirt-and-gravel trails
A welcoming local atmosphere and a friendly pace
Refreshments at the 4 km mark and at the finish
additional: Check-in is from 9:00 to 9:45. The awards ceremony and raffle are scheduled for 11:30. Toilets are available at the event, but there is no secure storage for belongings in the start and finish area. The race takes place on 27 June 2026, starts at 10:00, and registration closes on 24 June 2026. Refreshments are provided at the 4 km mark and at the finish. The course is similar to the 2025 route and includes categories for men and women, including local runners from Bohumín.

description: The Běh lužanskými hvozdy is a traditional running race held in the recreational area of the municipality of Lužany near Jičín, specifically at the campsite by Marešák Pond. The 50th anniversary edition will take place on 27 June 2026 and offers various categories and race distances suitable for a wide range of runners, including children. The race is supported by the Hradec Králové Region and organized by the Municipality of Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., and TJ Sokol Lužany. Participants can expect medals, prizes in kind, and cash awards for the top runners in each category.
course_highlights: Routes up to 1,000 m run within the campsite grounds; the shorter courses are almost straight
Longer courses consist of laps of 300, 400, and 500 m
The race takes place in a scenic recreational area by Marešák Pond
additional: Awards for the top runners in each category, traveling trophies, cash prizes for breaking records, free entry for residents of the municipality of Lužany who register by 30 April 2026, and medals and prizes in kind for the top three in each category. The race offers multiple categories, including children’s and recreational runs. Registration is available on the official website. The event takes place at the campsite by Marešák Pond and is supported by regional partners.

name: Žhavé běhy Slováckého léta
location: Uherské Hradiště, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hot Runs of Slovácké Summer are traditional running races held in the historic centre of Uherské Hradiště. Participants can choose from three distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, which pass through the picturesque countryside along the Morava River, through Kunovský les forest park and past the Nová Ves lakes. The races are suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offer a unique opportunity to enjoy being active in the beautiful surroundings of Slovácko. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, giving the race the atmosphere of the historic heart of the town.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic centre of Uherské Hradiště
Run along the Morava River and its confluence with the Olšava
The route connects with Kunovský les forest park and the Nová Ves lakes
additional: The races start and finish at Masaryk Square in Uherské Hradiště. The routes follow urban and natural paths, including cycle paths. The races are part of the Slovácké Summer sports and cultural festival, which also offers other sporting and cultural activities. The festival is suitable for all age groups, including families with children. The course includes the town centre, the river, parks and cycle paths; registration requirements are not specified.

name: Sudecka 100
location: Boguszowo-Gorce, Boguszów-Gorce, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Sudecka 100 is the oldest night ultramarathon in Poland, held in the mountain terrain of Boguszów-Gorce. The course is demanding and full of excitement, giving participants the chance to test themselves over 100 km. In 2026, organizers are introducing a new event—the Sudecki Morning Half Marathon over 21 km—as well as a Night Mountain Marathon over 42 km. The event attracts runners from across the country, offering generous race packs and plenty of attractions, including personalized medals and aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: A demanding course in mountain terrain
A night ultramarathon over 100 km
New: the Sudecki Morning Half Marathon over 21 km
additional: Medal personalization (first name, last name, time) is available during registration. Aid stations along the course and a stand selling sports nutrition and running accessories. Free accommodation from June 27 at 12:00 to June 29 at 12:00. The participant limit for the 21 km and 42 km distances is 200; there is no limit for the 100 km distance. A demanding course in mountain terrain, medal personalization, sports nutrition and accessories available, accommodation from Friday to Sunday, and a course that is marked for most of its length.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
location: Brodnica, Brodnica County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Anna Vasa 10K is a 10 km road race taking place in Brodnica. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a middle distance, and the organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race is open and welcoming to runners, offering expert support and the chance to take part in a sporting event in the picturesque Kuyavian-Pomeranian region.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Picturesque surroundings in Brodnica
Designed for a moderate difficulty level
additional: The organizer offers training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels, as well as expert support. Educational materials on warming up, foam rolling, and running preparation are also available on the website. The event includes several distances, including the 10 km main race, children’s races, and a 3 km race. Registration is available online, and the event promotes active leisure and discovering the region.

name: Supermaraton Gor Stolowych
location: Karlów, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Table Mountains Supermarathon is a demanding mountain race held in the scenic Table Mountains near Karłów. The course follows hiking trails and is highly technical, with numerous rocks and turns, as well as significant elevation changes. Participants should expect variable conditions, including possible snow and ice, and are required to carry appropriate equipment. The event is part of the Grand Prix DFBG mountain-running series and attracts fans of ultra running and mountain half-marathons.
course_highlights: The course follows hiking trails in Poland’s Table Mountains
Significant elevation changes and technical challenges, with numerous rocks and turns
Heavy snow and ice are possible; the use of snowshoes is permitted
additional: The time limit for finishing the race is 7 hours. The race office and start are at the Table Mountains National Park Training and Education Centre in Karłów. Participants can use drop bags (maximum 3 kg), which are transported to the finish. The course is marked with the organizer’s tape. The race goes ahead regardless of the weather, with the possibility of shortening the course in difficult conditions. A post-race recovery meal and awards ceremony are planned. The time limits are 11 hours for the ultramarathon and 5 hours for the half-marathon. The course has elevation changes of +2400/-2300 m for the ultramarathon and +1050/-925 m for the half-marathon. The event is part of a regional mountain-running series.

name: 7 Maraton Pędziwiatra
organizer: Amatorski Klub Miłośników Biegania Pędziwiatr Gliwice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Niższa kwota opłaty startowej obowiązuje do 28 lutego 2026 r.

description: The 7th Pędziwiatr Marathon is organized by the Pędziwiatr Gliwice Amateur Running Enthusiasts Club and will take place on June 27, 2026. Participants will complete 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop, mostly along sheltered park paths. The event is amateur in character and dedicated to the memory of Marek Dworski. Individual, team, and relay categories are planned. The race starts at 10:00, at the same time as the Gliwice Park Running Challenge.
course_highlights: 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop
The course runs mostly along sheltered park paths
The race takes place in Gliwice, surrounded by greenery
additional: The marathon starts at the same time as the Gliwice Park Running Challenge. Planned categories include individual open, women’s, men’s, age-group, team, and relay classifications. The marathon course consists of 10 laps of a 4.2195 km park loop. The Pędziwiatr Gliwice Club has been active since 2011 and organizes amateur running events. The participant limit is 300; online registration is available. The time limit is 6 hours. The course runs through park and woodland areas. Individual and team classifications are offered.

name: Bieg Szlakiem Pluderskich Stawów
description: The Bieg Szlakiem Pluderskich Stawów is a 10-kilometre road race held in Dobrodzień. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course combining paved roads and urban areas. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different ability levels so everyone can prepare optimally for the race. The event is open and welcoming to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Road race in Dobrodzień
Scenic route combining paved roads and urban areas
additional: The organizer offers training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, as well as expert support. Organizers can use a platform to manage the race’s listing and collaborate on marketing. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. The event includes races for adults and children, with a participant limit of 200. Training sessions and preparation plans are available on the organizer’s website.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
location: Polana za stadionem Piasta, Gliwice, Śląskie, Poland
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026, organized by the amateur running club „Pędziwiatr”. The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation, with the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!” The approximately 4.2 km course runs mainly along forest tracks and gravel paths, with a refreshment point at the start/finish. Events take place on Saturdays once a month, starting at 10:00, in the clearing behind Piast Stadium in Gliwice.
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m course along forest tracks and gravel paths
A refreshment point at the start/finish line, available after each lap
The course is not closed to other members of the public
additional: The event series comprises 12 monthly Saturday starts. The course is not certified and is not closed to other members of the public. The race office opens at 9:00 in the clearing near Piast Stadium. Registration is available online and at the race office. Participants can take part in running and Nordic Walking events, as well as the e-Prowokacja online event. A participant wishing to start in another event must register again and receive a new race number. The event takes place in the clearing behind Piast Stadium, with the start at 10:00; advance registration and an entry fee are required.

name: III Bieg w Sławicach
description: The 3rd Sławice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on 27 June 2026 in Sławice, Masovian Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness over a middle distance in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers welcome both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Designed for a moderate difficulty level
Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available to help runners prepare
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available and tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support is available during preparation. Runners can use the Runner’s Zone, which offers additional materials and courses. No detailed information is available about entry fees, registration, or the exact course. Follow official sources for updates.

name: X Lubeński Cross
description: The X Lubeński Cross is a mountain cross-country race held in the picturesque area of the Lubenia municipality. The start and finish are at the market square in Lubenia. The main race routes are 13.8 km and 22.3 km long, covering varied terrain: asphalt, paved roads and field paths, as well as 3 or 5 green hills. The race is known for its high level of difficulty and beautiful views, creating a unique sporting celebration. Children’s and youth races are also held at the stadium, divided by age and gender categories.
course_highlights: The routes pass over 3 green hills on the shorter distance and 5 on the longer distance

Picturesque mountain terrain in the Lubenia municipality

description: The 13th Cichociemni Run is a cross-country race held in Sochaczew, dedicated to the memory of the Polish heroes and soldiers known as the Cichociemni. The course is challenging, with numerous natural and artificial obstacles of varying difficulty that require participants to get wet, jump over obstacles, and crawl beneath them. The race takes place once a year in June and attracts people who want to overcome their weaknesses and aren’t afraid of mud. It’s a unique opportunity to get to know the banks and bed of the Bzura River and feel the wind in your hair during a sporting competition.
course_highlights: Cross-country course with natural and artificial obstacles
Route along the banks and bed of the Bzura River
Challenging features: mud, water, ditches, jumps, and crawling beneath obstacles
additional: Registration is available through the Zmierzymy Czas platform. Entry fees increase as the race date approaches and depend on the date payment is made. A race-specific T-shirt can be ordered during selected periods. Running groups of at least 6 people can receive a discount by contacting the organizers by email in advance. Payment must be made within 30 days of registration. The organizer is UKS Dragon Fight Club Sochaczew. terrain, online registration, obstacles, challenging course

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners from the region and beyond. The races take place on a permanent course that is familiar to participants, and the atmosphere is welcoming to both experienced runners and amateurs. The event attracts large groups of runners, Nordic walkers, and canicross participants, and participation is free. The organizers ensure the event runs smoothly and support the development of the local running community.
course_highlights: A permanent course with more than 100 races held to date
Routes for runners, Nordic walkers, and canicross participants
Participants from many cities in the Upper Silesian metropolitan area and from outside the voivodeship
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in the Grand Prix races is free. Nordic walking and canicross participants also take part. Women make up a high proportion of participants, ranging from over 27% to 34% in individual races. The event fosters a welcoming atmosphere and brings together runners from different clubs and cities. The event is planned for June 27, 2026, with the option to register online. It promotes health, physical activity, and fun in a sporting atmosphere.

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The XXI Unisław 10K is an annual 10 km race and Nordic Walking event organized in Unisław as part of Unisław Days. The race route follows paved roads through the picturesque Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty. The race is certified by the Polish Athletic Association and is part of the 2026 Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running. All running and Nordic Walking enthusiasts are invited to take part in this sporting event.
course_highlights: The route passes through Chełmno Landscape Park
A 10 km distance certified by the Polish Athletic Association
Passes through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty
additional: The race and Nordic Walking event take place on 27 June 2026. The race routes follow paved roads. The race counts toward the 2026 edition of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running. Nordic Walking is also available as an event, and the route is marked and supported by medical services. The race starts at 10:00, and participants can expect refreshment points along the route.

name: XXVII Bieg Górski Żar
organizer: Urząd Gminy Czernichów i Stowarzyszenie Bajeczne Beskidy
description: The 27th Żar Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race taking place on June 27, 2026, in Międzybrodzie Żywieckie. It’s a great opportunity for mountain-running enthusiasts to take on a challenging course and test their fitness. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race combines sporting competition with the beauty of the mountain scenery.
course_highlights: A 10 km mountain course
Scenic views around Międzybrodzie Żywieckie
A challenge for runners of different experience levels
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. The website also has educational materials on warm-ups, diet, and running motivation. Distance: approximately 8.5–10 km; mountain terrain; on-site registration; includes a cable-car ticket among the prizes.

name: 32. DECATHLON Futóest
description: The 32nd Decathlon Night Run is a special night race in the heart of Budapest, taking place at the illuminated Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue. Runners can compete in quarter-marathon, half-marathon, pairs and trios, while enjoying the city’s magical nighttime atmosphere. Thousands of runners from towns and cities across the country take part, and every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal and a finisher’s pack. The race starts at 21:00 on the evening of June 27, 2026, giving runners the chance to experience running amid the city lights.
course_highlights: Run through Budapest’s historic Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue
A night run through the illuminated city, with a special play of light and shadow
Join thousands of runners and receive a unique finisher’s medal and finisher’s pack
additional: Online registration is available only by bank card or SZÉP Card. On-site registration at the event venue opens at 18:30. Assistance with generating a unique email address is available for minors and people without an email address. A limited-edition technical running shirt can be ordered in advance. Several distances and team races (pairs and trios) are available. Every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal and finisher’s pack. night race, multiple distances, city center route, online registration, promotional merchandise available

description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running race with a voluntary entry fee, held in Dióskert. Runners can complete the half-marathon distance by running four laps, but they may also run fewer laps. The event has a welcoming, family atmosphere. All participants are offered an apple, hot tea and mulled wine, and receive a commemorative medal. The top three male and female runners also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The course is in Dióskert, in a natural setting
The half-marathon consists of 4 laps, but runners can choose to run fewer
A friendly, family atmosphere, with a voluntary entry fee per lap

The half-marathon is 4 laps; runners can do fewer laps. Registration is on site. Refreshments and commemorative medals.

description: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu 2026 je prestižní mezinárodní závod veteránů v horském běhu, který se koná v malebném prostředí Janské Lázně. Závody nabízejí několik náročných tratí s výrazným převýšením, které prověří vytrvalost a sílu závodníků z více než 30 zemí. Pořadatelem je TJ Maratonstav Úpice pod patronací měst Janské Lázně a Úpice. Registrace je otevřena do 24. května 2026 a závodníci se mohou těšit na profesionální organizaci a podporu sponzorů.

Pretek sa koná v príjemnom prostredí kultúrneho strediska v Košiciach-Šaci a ponúka možnosť súťažiť v rôznych vekových kategóriách. Štartovné je symbolické, pričom domáci pretekári majú štartovné zdarma. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje aktívny životný štýl v regióne.

organizer: Občianske združenie Grúň, Chata na Grúni
description: Beh na Poludňový Grúň je horský bežecký závod v malebnej Vrátnej doline, v pohorí Malej Fatry. Trať vedie cez náročný horský terén s krásnymi výhľadmi na vrcholy ako Poludňový Grúň, Stoh a Veľký Rozsutec. Pretek je ideálny pre milovníkov prírody a horského behu, ktorí chcú zažiť jedinečnú atmosféru a výzvu v srdci Malej Fatry. Organizátori vás srdečne pozývajú vychutnať si túto športovú udalosť v krásnom prostredí Terchovej.
course_highlights: Horský terén s výstupom na Poludňový Grúň (1460 m)
Prechod cez Stohové sedlo a okolie Veľkého Rozsutca

Trasa prechádza cez národnú prírodnú rezerváciu s množstvom vodopádov a bizarných skalných útvarov. Pretek je súčasťou regionálnych športových podujatí, registrácia zahŕňa poplatok a parkovanie, štart je na Vrátna Paseky o 10:00 hod.

The event is organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until May 24, 2026, and the event offers several course options of varying distances and elevation gains.

The event takes place in Janské Lázně on June 28, 2026, with masters age categories available. The race focuses on mountain running, with challenging climbs and the beautiful natural scenery of the Krkonoše Mountains.

The event has a long history and attracts runners from the wider area, who enjoy the beauty of nature and the sporting atmosphere.

Substantial elevation gain
Road race in the natural surroundings of the Moravian Karst

name: Lochovice - Plešivec
description: Lochovice - Plešivec is a running race in the Brdy Running Cup, taking place on June 28, 2026, in Lochovice. The course is approximately 5.5 km long, with 350 metres of elevation gain. It starts with 2 km on asphalt and continues along forest paths, with a steeper climb around the 3 km mark. The finish is at the summit of Plešivec, which offers a beautiful view. The event also includes children’s races and a family run in support of the Mezi břehy home hospice.
course_highlights: Course length: approx. 5.5 km, with 350 m of elevation gain
2 km on asphalt; the remainder is on forest paths, with a steep climb at the 3 km mark
Finish at the summit of Plešivec, with a beautiful view

The main 21.1 km race follows a turnaround course repeated three times, on paved paths and third-class roads with minimal elevation gain. Shorter races are also available for teenagers, schoolchildren, and preschool children, making the event appealing to runners of a wide range of ages. Refreshments are provided after the race, and the winner of the main race receives a cash prize. The start is traditionally in the square in Nové Veselí.

The winner of the main race receives a cash prize of CZK 2,000, plus CZK 1,000 for breaking the course record. On request, each runner can receive a certificate showing their placing and finishing time. The race takes place on 28 June 2026, with the main race starting at 9:45. The event is open to the general public, including young people, veterans, and children.

Walking routes and children’s races are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a chance to discover the beautiful nature of the Ore Mountains.

description: Izery Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the heart of the picturesque Izera Mountains, with the start and finish in Świeradów-Zdrój. Routes of varying lengths and difficulty levels lead through wild, little-known areas, offering runners unforgettable views and challenges. The event attracts both experienced ultramarathoners and trail-running enthusiasts who want to take on demanding terrain and enjoy the beauty of nature. The organizers provide full support at aid stations and specify the required equipment, ensuring participants’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: Routes pass through wild, little-known areas of the Izera Mountains
Start and finish in the heart of Świeradów-Zdrój, in Zdrojowy Park
Significant elevation gain: up to +2,650 m on the longest, 100 km route
additional: The start and finish are in Zdrojowy Park in Świeradów-Zdrój. Routes have aid stations (6 on the 100 km route, 4 on the 50 km route). Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a water cup, a hat or neck gaiter, a rain jacket, a water container with a capacity of at least 1 litre, an elastic bandage and a sterile dressing. Runners receive a race bib with a chip, route maps and a GPS device with the route loaded. A working phone must be kept available for contact throughout the race. The start and finish are in Świeradów-Zdrój; registration for 2026 opened at the beginning of the year; the event features various distances, including Ultra 50, Ultra 70 and Ultra-Trail® 100.

name: Kresowe Trail #7
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale, non-commercial trail races held amid the scenic natural landscapes of eastern Poland and the Vilnius Region. The courses pass through unspoiled forests, varied climbs, sand and roots, offering challenges for both beginners and experienced runners. The races feature two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), which is an ultra-distance race. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature and bringing together runners from different backgrounds.
course_highlights: Courses pass through forests with natural obstacles, including climbs, sand and roots
Courses are marked to cycling standards with clear arrows and ribbons
Scenic views, abundant nature and the region’s multicultural heritage
additional: The races take place in an intimate atmosphere, with participant numbers limited for safety and to protect nature. Competition includes overall and team classifications, with awards for the top runners in age categories. The courses are easy to navigate thanks to the markings, and the event promotes physical activity in a healthy forest environment. To be included in the Kresowe Trail series classification, participants must complete at least six races; registration details are not provided.

Participants can choose from ten different distances, ranging from night races and Nordic walking to an ultramarathon and a half marathon, across the picturesque landscapes of the Lubaczów region. The event combines sporting competition with a festival atmosphere, attracting experienced runners and amateurs alike.

Columbia Triton Trail
description: Columbia Triton Trail 2026 is an exciting trail running race in Nagybörzsöny, Hungary, organized by Trailrun.hu and Andrew Erdei. The race offers a unique experience for runners who enjoy being close to nature and taking on a challenge. The event takes place on June 28, where participants can test their strength and endurance on varied terrain in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail running through varied natural surroundings
Beautiful forest and mountain sections
Challenging climbs and technical sections
additional: The race takes place in Nagybörzsöny, Hungary. Participants can choose from different distances, and the event is characterized by its closeness to nature and its community atmosphere.

name: Rácalmás Szigetfutás
location: Jankovich Kúria, Rácalmás, Tolna County, Hungary
description: The Rácalmás Island Run is a friendly, family-oriented trail-running event held in the scenic surroundings of Rácalmás, on the protected Nagy Island and along the banks of the Danube. The varied terrain features shaded forest trails, views across farmland, riverside routes and paved sections, with minimal elevation gain. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and provide accessible sporting opportunities for all ages, whether running, walking or cycling. The event centre is the historic Jankovich Manor, an ideal venue for the start and finish as well as the accompanying activities. Participants can look forward to custom medals and T-shirts, and a friendly atmosphere close to nature.
course_highlights: Routes on the protected Nagy Island and along the Danube
Varied terrain: forest trails, views across farmland and paved sections
Minimal elevation gain; routes pass beneath shady trees and beside a picturesque boat harbour
additional: Race number collection is from 8:00 to 10:00. Several aid stations are available along the courses. Participation is free for RSE members, but registration is required. On-site registration is available in limited numbers only; advance registration is recommended. Various accompanying activities, health checks and food and drink options are available on race day. Custom medals and T-shirts can be ordered in advance. Participants can also look forward to finisher medals, aid stations, medical services and family activities. Registration is online via Köridő.hu, with favourable prices and early-bird registration options.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Boskovická etapa
description: MUM – Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage race held in Boskovice and part of a seven-day ultramarathon consisting of seven marathons. The race is known for its demanding nature and long tradition, attracting runners seeking the challenge of a stage race. The Boskovice stage gives runners the opportunity to experience the beauty of the Moravian countryside while testing their endurance on demanding terrain. The race is suitable for experienced ultramarathon runners who want to compete against others in a prestigious international event.
course_highlights: A stage race of 7 marathons in 7 days
Demanding terrain around Boskovice
Beautiful Moravian scenery
additional: Stage ultramarathon, part of the ČAU ULTRA CUP 2019, Czech Championship in stage ultramarathon, varied routes and terrain difficulty

description: The Ócsa Cellar Row Run in memory of József Radics is a community trail-running event that takes runners past landmarks in the town of Ócsa. The race is run on a 10.5 km course, which can be repeated for the longer distances of 21 km and 42 km. The event uses individual chip timing and aims to bring sport and community together in memory of József Radics. The start and finish are in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre, and the course includes a variety of paved and dirt paths.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km course passes Ócsa landmarks, including the Öreghegy cellar row and the Reformed Church
The 21 km distance consists of two laps, and the 42 km distance four laps, of the 10.5 km course
Varied terrain: paved streets and dirt paths; 100% trail running through the cellar row
additional: The race uses individual chip timing, recording both net and gross times. Placings are determined by gross time. Residents of Ócsa receive a discount on the entry fee upon presentation of proof of address. Entry is free for people born in 1960 or earlier. The race is limited to a maximum of 550 participants. The start and finish are on the street in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre. The event features multiple distances, including commemorative runs and community events in keeping with the local spirit; it is open to participants and takes place on varied terrain.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červen
description: Tempo Makers Osmicka is a running race in Plzeň, offering an 8 km course. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and over. The start and finish are at the same location, with registration and bib pickup from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race, the top runners are announced and a raffle is held. The race is limited to 75 participants, and each participant takes part at their own risk.
course_highlights: 8 km course in Plzeň
Start and finish at the same location, with parking available
Evening start time, with registration from 17:00 to 17:45
additional: Registration and bib pickup take place from 17:00 to 17:45. The top runners are announced at 19:05, and the raffle is held at 19:15. The race is limited to 75 participants. Categories are divided by age, starting at 16 years and over. Parking for participants is available at the location shown on the map. The race takes place on 30 June 2026. Registration is available online or on site, and the course is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

description: In Prague 6, Prague, the sealion is primarily associated with the breeding and conservation of the South African sea lion at Prague Zoo. A theatre performance titled “The White Sea Lion” is also held here, mainly for children and school groups, offering interactive experiences with an environmental theme. The program is suitable for families and schools looking to combine education with entertainment and raise awareness of nature conservation.
course_highlights: Breeding and conservation of the South African sea lion at Prague Zoo
“The White Sea Lion” theatre performance with an environmental theme
Interactive programs for children and schools
additional: Sea lion breeding at Prague Zoo, an environmental theatre performance for schools and children, teaching materials for educators

name: Kolem Libotína
description: The Běh Kolem Libotína is a traditional race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice and held in the area around Štramberk. The race features a challenging 6.5 km loop whose route has been revised in recent years, resulting in new course records. The event is part of the Lašská Running League and attracts runners from various categories, who enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and sporting atmosphere. Winners in each category are announced after the race, and a raffle is held for all participants. The Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice organizes the event and ensures its smooth running while supporting the running community.
course_highlights: A challenging 6.5 km loop
The area around the local swimming pool in Štramberk
A route with a new direction that brought course records
additional: The race is part of the Lašská Running League. A raffle is held for participants after the race. Registration is online through the EOS app, where proof of a medical examination must be provided. The race is suitable for the general public and competitors of all categories, offering the opportunity to set personal records and enjoy the atmosphere of a regional running event.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Lomnická etapa
location: Lomnice u Tišnova, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: MUM – the Moravian Ultramarathon is an international multi-stage running race held over seven consecutive days, with the Lomnice stage as one of its stages. The race is one of the most demanding ultramarathons in the Czech Republic, challenging runners with long distances and difficult terrain in the South Moravian Region. It is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners looking to test their endurance and strength amid beautiful natural scenery. The Lomnice stage takes place around Olešnice and Lomnice u Tišnova and is part of the full ultramarathon series.
course_highlights: A stage race comprising 7 marathons in 7 days
Challenging terrain in the South Moravian Region
Beautiful natural scenery around Olešnice and Lomnice u Tišnova
additional: The race passes through various parts of Moravia, with the start and finish in Olešnice or Lomnice u Tišnova, and is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners. Registration is available using the contact details listed on the official website.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Bystřická etapa
location: Bystřice nad Pernštejnem, Morava, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage race consisting of seven marathons on seven consecutive days. The Bystřice stage is one part of the race, offering a challenging, long run through the picturesque Moravian countryside. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners looking for the challenge of long stages and beautiful nature. Come and test your limits in this prestigious ultramarathon and experience the unique atmosphere of a stage race.
course_highlights: A stage race comprising 7 marathons in 7 days
Challenging Moravian terrain with beautiful views
International participation and a prestigious running event
additional: The race is part of an ultramarathon series. The Bystřice stage is 42.2 km long and is part of the ČAU ULTRA CUP 2019.

description: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA - VISEGRÁD is a 220 km trail relay race connecting the historic towns of Banská Štiavnica and Visegrád. The race consists of 18 stages that pass through the Štiavnica Mountains and Duna-Ipoly National Park, with abundant natural and cultural attractions along the way. Runners can take part in teams of different sizes or in individual categories, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. The race aims to connect the two royal towns and showcase the region’s natural and historical heritage.
course_highlights: Passes through the Štiavnica Mountains and Duna-Ipoly National Park
18 stages, 8–16 km long, with varied terrain and difficulty
Historical and natural attractions, including Drégely Castle, Esztergom Basilica, and Prédikálószék
additional: The race is open to teams of 3–8 runners and individual runners. Teams take turns over 18 stages, each 8–16 km long. Individual runners may complete the full distance at their own risk and with their own support, and may use the refreshment stations. The course passes through protected natural areas and historical sites. The race route includes sections through Duna-Ipoly National Park and other nature reserves, highlighting both natural beauty and cultural heritage.

description: Na hoľu je ITRA certifikované podujatie vertikálneho kilometra, ktoré sa koná na Kráľovej holi v Horehroní. Bežci štartujú z námestia obce Šumiac a trasa vedie priamo po modrej turistickej značke na vrchol Kráľovej hole. Podujatie je nominačným pretekom na Skyrunning World Championships 2024 a ponúka kvalitné zabezpečenie vrátane občerstvenia a zdravotnej služby. Registrácia je otvorená do 1. júla 2026 s limitom účastníkov a štartovné zahŕňa upomienkový predmet a občerstvenie.
course_highlights: Trasa dlhá 5,2 km s prevýšením 1035 m
Štart na námestí obce Šumiac, cieľ na vrchole Kráľovej hole
Trať vyznačená farebnými stužkami na stromoch po modrej turistickej značke
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je od 7:00 do 9:30 za budovou základnej školy alebo v prípade nepriaznivého počasia v budove obecného úradu Šumiac. Pretekári mladší ako 15 rokov musia byť sprevádzaní zákonným zástupcom. Organizátori zabezpečujú prepravu suchého oblečenia do cieľa. Počas preteku je občerstvenie na Prednom sedle a v cieli. Povinná výbava zahŕňa turistickú výbavu a fľašu s tekutinami (min. 0,5 l). Protesty je možné podať do 13:00 s vkladom 50 EUR. Podujatie zahŕňa aj regionálne outdoorové aktivity a kladie dôraz na podporu turistiky a športu v regióne Horehronie.

description: Špačinský trojuholník je bežecký pretek organizovaný v obci Špačince v okrese Trnava. Pretek sa štartuje o 17:00 hodine v strede obce pri Základnej škole s materskou školou. Súťažia muži v absolútnom poradí bez rozdielu veku a ženy od 40 rokov. Organizátormi sú Obec Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, Základná škola s materskou školou v Špačinciach a JDS Špačince. Štartovné je 10 € s výnimkou obyvateľov obce, ktorí majú štartovné zdarma.

Kategórie pre mužov bez vekového rozdielu a ženy od 40 rokov
Organizovaný v spolupráci s miestnymi inštitúciami a bežeckým klubom
additional: Obyvatelia obce majú štartovné zdarma. Kategórie mužov sú absolútne poradie bez vekového rozdielu a ženy sú hodnotené od 40 rokov. Štart je v strede obce pri Základnej škole s materskou školou. Podrobnosti o teréne nie sú špecifikované, pretek sa koná v centre obce, registrácia je pravdepodobne potrebná
