description: Trailová štafeta Banská Štiavnica - Vyšehrad je unikátny 220 km dlhý štafetový beh, ktorý spája dve historické kráľovské mestá cez prírodné krásy Štiavnických vrchov a Dunaj-Ipeľ Národného parku. Pretek je určený pre 3-členné, 4 až 8-členné a 6-členné tímy, pričom ponúka kategórie pre skúsených bežcov aj väčšie tímy. Trasa vedie prevažne po turistických chodníkoch a prírodných rezerváciách, čím umožňuje spoznať kultúrno-historické pamiatky a prírodné krásy regiónu Slovenska a Maďarska. Organizátori kladú dôraz na budovanie susedských vzťahov a propagáciu regiónu.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez Štiavnické vrchy a Dunaj-Ipeľ Národný park
Prechod cez historické a prírodné lokality ako Hrad Drégely, NPR Burdov, Esztergomi bazilika a Dunakanyar
220 km rozdelených do 18 úsekov s rôznorodým stúpaním a klesaním
additional: Trasa je rozdelená do 18 úsekov s rôznym stúpaním a klesaním, prechádza cez prírodné rezervácie a historické miesta. Kategórie zahŕňajú ULTRA pre skúsených bežcov a sólo kategóriu pre jednotlivcov od roku 2025. Registrácia prebieha cez web, kde kapitán tímu vytvára svoj tím po registrácii. Pretek zahŕňa rôzne kategórie vrátane ultra, mix, Nordic walking a jednotlivcov; registrácia je otvorená od februára do marca 2026; trať vedie cez turistické a prírodné trasy s dôrazom na zážitok a spojenie krajín.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - červenec
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop covering just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children up to 12 years old (boys and girls). Each runner is timed, and the first three places in both adult and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). Registration takes place on the first Saturday of the month from 8:15 to 8:55, with the start at 9:00. The run can be completed on foot, by bike, on roller skates, or by car. The route is a 3.2 km road course suitable for all age groups.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - červenec
description: The 2-Mile Run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children under 12, who run 1.6 km. It’s ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park setting. After the finish, every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows Stromovka’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children one. Everyone’s time is recorded, and results are published online.
course_highlights: The course follows Stromovka’s paved paths
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km + 70 m)
The race takes place in the beautiful setting of the Královská obora – Stromovka park
additional: Registration takes place at Bruselská brána (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Pre-registration online is available for faster check-in. Arriving by bike, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský ostrov on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings (unattended), along with a mobile valuables storage service. Toilets are also available on site. Times adjusted using the age coefficient count toward the year-long Lívancový Cup. The race takes place in Stromovka Park; registration is voluntary, the start is at 9:07, changing facilities and toilets are available, and parking is by the bridge to Císařský ostrov.

name: Třtická punčocha
description: Třtická Punčocha is a traditional summer running race held in the village of Třtice since 1980, always on the first Sunday in July. The race is 8.8 km long and attracts runners from all over Bohemia. Originally intended for children, it now also offers categories for adults by age and gender. The village also hosts the 4.8 km Christmas Run on December 26. The races are popular and have a long tradition, with results and photos archived on the village website.
course_highlights: Summer race distance: 8.8 km
Categories by age and gender (A, B, C, D, E)
Traditional race held since 1980 in the pleasant surroundings of Třtice
additional: The race is divided into categories by age and gender: Category A, up to 39 years; B, 40–49 years; C, 50–59 years; D, over 60 years; E, women. Results and photos from previous editions are available on the website. The village also has a children’s playground and sports facilities, a tennis court, and a community hall that was renovated in 2024/2025. The race offers various age categories, including children’s and adults’ categories, and is part of the local sports calendar. Results and photos are regularly published on the official website.

name: Náchod - Dobrošov
description: The Dobrošov Military Fortress is located near the town of Náchod in the Kladské pomezí area of the Orlické Mountains. The fortress is an important part of the Czechoslovak fortifications along the northern border and offers visitors tours of the main bunkers, ammunition depot, barracks and infirmary. An educational trail runs through the fortress, following the line of fortifications all the way to the Běloves spa. The surrounding area has plenty of hiking and cycling routes, offering a chance to discover the beauty of the Orlické Mountains and nearby historic towns.
course_highlights: Tours of artillery bunkers and fortifications from the era of Czechoslovak fortifications
The Dobrošov Fortress educational trail, following the line of fortifications all the way to the Běloves spa
Hiking and cycling routes nearby, with views and access to other military fortresses
additional: Parking at the fortress is free. The visitor centre, including the toilets, closes 60 minutes before the end of opening hours. There are 171 steps leading underground, where the temperature remains at 6°C. Group sizes are limited to a maximum of 28 people. The last tour starts 90 minutes before the end of opening hours. Nearby accommodation is available at family-run guesthouses and mountain hotels in Deštné v Orlických horách. The race is part of the region’s sporting calendar, and participants can make use of the hiking and cycling routes nearby. Exact details about registration and course distance have not yet been published.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Cimrmanova etapa
location: Lomnice u Tišnova, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon / Cimrman Stage is the final, seventh stage of an international stage race held in Lomnice u Tišnova. The race offers challenging and varied terrain with 740 metres of elevation gain, providing a test for experienced ultrarunners. The start is staggered according to the results of the previous six races, adding to the competition and excitement. This race is ideal for runners looking for a combination of technical difficulty and stage racing amid the beautiful countryside of the South Moravian Region.
course_highlights: Challenging, varied terrain
740 metres of elevation gain
Staggered start based on results from the previous stages
additional: The race is the final stage of an international stage race, with a staggered start based on the results of the previous six races. The start is at the elementary school in Lomnice u Tišnova. Challenging terrain, staggered start, part of a stage race

name: Grill Run=Fun 2026

It is organized by the LUXTORPEDA Association, which guarantees high-quality event organization and support for runners. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and experience the spirit of sporting community.

Start and finish in Palowice
Organized by the experienced LUXTORPEDA Association
additional: The event offers professional timing using RFID technology, an electronic LED clock at the finish, and live results on time-sport.pl. Event date: 2026-07-04; Location: Palowice; Registration deadline: 2026-07-01; Participant requirements: bring your own water bottle; The course is approximately 82.5 km long (11 laps).

name: XXIV Atlantis Bieg Opolski
location: Wyspa Bolko, Opole, Opole County, Poland
description: The XXIV Atlantis Bieg Opolski is an annual race that has been held since 2003 on the first Saturday of July on Bolko Island in Opole. The course runs through a designated quiet, green area in the city center, offering participants the chance to compete over 5 km and 10 km distances. Since 2015, the race has been called Atlantis Bieg Opolski, thanks to the support of Atlantis-Deweloper. The event is organized by the Bieg Opolski Association, which promotes physical activity and sports-based community integration.
course_highlights: A course on Bolko Island—a quiet, green area in the center of Opole
Two distances to choose from: 5 km and 10 km
The race takes place on the first Saturday of July, as it has traditionally since 2003
additional: Volunteers support the organization of the race in various teams, including the race office, start/finish, baggage storage, course safety, and refreshment stations. The association engages people of different ages and encourages them to help organize the event. The event takes place in urban areas, including streets and parks, with registration available at designated locations. The race is popular with the local community and attracts participants from various regions.

name: Grill+Run-Fun
description: The 8H GRF Ultramarathon “Szychta na Gichcie” is a unique running event held on the forest trails of the Palowice Lake District. The race lasts 8 hours, during which participants take on an endurance challenge and enjoy being close to nature. The event is organized by the Luxtorpeda Association and attracts fans of prolonged physical exertion. Children’s races are also held as part of the event, highlighting its family-friendly character. The start and finish are located at the Orzeł Palowice sports field.
course_highlights: Forest trails of the Palowice Lake District
Timed format — an 8-hour race
Family-friendly children’s races held during the event
additional: Participants must bring their own water bottle or cup. The race office opens at 6:15, and the technical briefing is at 7:45. The race starts at 8:00 and ends at 16:00. The award ceremony is scheduled for 16:30/17:00. The event also includes children’s races in memory of Jacek Kostrzewa. There will also be a barbecue and an opportunity for participants to socialize. Registration is available online, and the course passes through the picturesque forest areas of Palowice.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: The Kalisz Night Amber Hellena Half Marathon is a unique night-time half marathon held in Kalisz. The race attracts hundreds of runners from various cities, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a running challenge after dark. The half-marathon course passes through charming parts of the city, giving participants an unforgettable experience. The event has become an established tradition and is popular with both amateur and professional runners.
course_highlights: A night run through the streets of Kalisz
Half-marathon distance (21.097 km)
A sporting celebration with hundreds of runners
additional: The race starts at 22:00 and runs until 2:00 a.m. The list of confirmed participants is available online. The event has a participant limit, with more than 860 runners currently confirmed. The event includes a half marathon, and the course passes through sports facilities and streets in Kalisz. Registration is online, and participants can expect a well-organized event with extensive race-day arrangements.

name: VI Półmaraton Gęstwinami Murckowskimi

The half-marathon course runs through varied woodland, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy a unique atmosphere. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors, both for experienced runners and amateurs. The organizers provide convenient access by public transport and parking near the start.

Varied woodland terrain with views and natural obstacles
Access to a relay changeover zone

Date: 2026-07-04; location: Katowice; information about training and preparations

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowska ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different age groups and ability levels. additional: Registration takes place at the race venue from 17:15. The children’s race starts at 17:45, and the women’s and men’s main races start at 18:00. Runners take part at their own risk. 1.7 km and 5.1 km courses, pre-race registration, refreshments after the finish, baggage storage, access by public transport and car at the race venue

name: VUM – Valašské Ultramaraton – DEN1 – Zahřívání 🏃‍♂️

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: DEN1 - Zahřívání / DAY1 - Warm-up 999 Kč do / until 15.12.2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Všechny 3 tratě / All 3 Stages 2 099 Kč do / until 15.12.2026

description: VUM – Valašský Ultra Marathon is a demanding three-day stage ultramarathon in the heart of Valašsko and the Beskydy Mountains. The race is for runners seeking a challenge and discomfort, with progressively tougher stages that test physical and mental endurance. Each day is longer and more demanding, emphasizing self-sufficiency and the ability to recover. The race is not about speed, but about finishing safely and managing fatigue and decisions along the course. The organizers emphasize respect for nature and provide basic facilities, accommodation, and refreshments.
course_highlights: Three days, three stages with progressively increasing distance and elevation gain
Routes pass through the landscape of Valašsko and the Beskydy Mountains, including hiking trails, cycle paths, and forest roads
Maximum self-sufficiency for runners, with no conventional aid stations
additional: The entry fee includes camping in your own tent at the race venue, with the option of accommodation at a school (limited capacity). Refreshments during the race include coffee, tea, and basic refreshments before each stage, followed by fruit, vegetables, meat products, and sweet snacks after the stage. One liter of water per runner is available on the course at approximately the halfway point of each stage. Electronic timing and online runner tracking are provided. If exhausted, runners can use the organizers’ transport from the course. Every runner who completes at least one stage receives a finisher medal, while the exclusive finisher T-shirt is reserved for those who complete all three stages. The date differs between sources: the supplied date is July 11, 2027, while the event pages list July 9, 2027.

name: VUM Valašský ultramaraton
description: The Valašský Ultra Maraton (VUM) is a challenging three-day stage ultramarathon in the heart of Valašsko and the Beskids. The race is for runners seeking a challenge and discomfort, with progressively tougher stages that test both physical and mental resilience. Each day is longer and more demanding than the previous one, with an emphasis on self-sufficiency and the ability to recover. VUM is not a race for speed, but for endurance and safely completing all stages. The organizers emphasize respect for nature and runner safety.
course_highlights: Three days and three stages, with progressively increasing distance and elevation gain
Routes pass through the landscapes of Valašsko and the Beskids, including hiking trails, cycle paths, and forest roads
Maximum self-sufficiency for runners, without traditional aid stations
additional: The entry fee includes a participant pack with a cotton T-shirt, a race bib with your name or nickname, access to facilities with toilets and showers, accommodation in your own tent or at a school (limited capacity), refreshments before and after the stages, 1 liter of water on the route halfway through each stage, electronic timing, and online runner tracking. Every participant who completes at least one stage receives a finisher medal, while the exclusive finisher T-shirt is awarded only to those who complete all three stages. If you become exhausted, you can use the organizers’ transport from the course. This is not a team race, but you can run as a pair while competing as individuals. The race is self-supported: runners carry their own refreshments, and the course is not routinely marked, so navigating with GPX is mandatory. Approximately one liter of water per runner is available halfway through each stage. The ALL entry package includes access to facilities and the option of accommodation in your own tent or at a school.

name: Ultramarathon Górski - 3 x Sniezka = 1 x Mont Blanc
description: The 3 x Śnieżka = 1 x Mont Blanc Mountain Ultra is a challenging mountain race held in Karpacz. It is also a qualifier for the prestigious UTMB and a member of ITRA. Runners can choose from three distances of varying difficulty and elevation gain, earning ITRA points. The course follows scenic trails in the Karkonosze Mountains and includes multiple ascents of Śnieżka, offering challenges for experienced ultrarunners as well as an opportunity for beginners to take part in a mountain race.
course_highlights: Elevation gain from 1,100 to 3,300 metres and distances from 18 to 58.5 km
Multiple ascents of Śnieżka (1, 2 or 3 times, depending on the distance)
Scenic Karkonosze trails with refreshment points along the course
additional: The start and finish are in central Karpacz, at 48 Konstytucji 3 Maja Street, near the sports and entertainment hall. As part of the World Championships, accreditations, conferences, opening and closing ceremonies, and transport for teams from Wrocław Airport are planned. Time limits for the different distances range from 7 to 11 hours, and GPX files of the courses are available to download. The event promotes tourism and mountain activities, encouraging runners to take part alongside family and friends, who can accompany participants along the course.

name: Nízkotatranská stíhačka
description: Nízkotatranská stíhačka (NTS) je ultra trail pretek jednotlivcov s hlavným okruhom dlhým 98 km vedúcim z Telgártu na Donovaly cez hlavný hrebeň Nízkych Tatier a polovičnou trasou s cieľom na Čertovici. Pretek je kvalifikačným podujatím pre Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc a je certifikovaný ITRA. Organizuje ho občianske združenie Time Out - OZ v spolupráci so STS HIKING a Slovak Ultratrail. NTS ponúka náročnú horskú trať s krásnymi výhľadmi a výzvami pre skúsených bežcov horských tratí.
course_highlights: Hlavná trasa 98,5 km vedie cez hlavný hrebeň Nízkych Tatier z Telgártu na Donovaly
Polovičná trasa 49 km s cieľom na horskom priechode Čertovica
Náročný horský terén s krásnymi výhľadmi a kontrolnými bodmi
additional: Prezentácia účastníkov je v piatok 10. júla 2026 od 18:00 do 22:00 v ZŠ Telgárt, kde je aj brífing. Štart preteku je v sobotu 11. júla 2026 o 06:00 z Telgártu. Organizátor zabezpečuje prevoz batožiny (dropbagy). Limit účastníkov je 200. Pre prihlásenie na hlavnú trasu je potrebné splniť kvalifikačné predpoklady. Počas preteku sú zabezpečené kontrolné body a občerstvenie. NTS je súčasťou Slovak Ultra Trail a je certifikovaný ITRA. Pretek je určený pre skúsených ultramaratóncov, s možnosťou registrácie online a splnenia kvalifikačných kritérií. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj kratšie trasy 49 km, pričom pretek sa koná v dňoch 11. a 12. júla 2026.

name: Rozbehni Majerovce
description: Rozbehni Majerovce je bežecké podujatie konané v obci Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom. Preteky ponúkajú kategórie pre deti aj dospelých s hlavnými behmi na 5 a 10 km. Štart detských kategórií je o 09:15 a hlavného preteku o 10:15. Organizátorom je Martin Folenta spolu s obcou Majerovce, ktorí srdečne pozývajú bežcov všetkých vekových kategórií na príjemný športový deň.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú v obci Majerovce pred Obecným úradom
Hlavné trate sú na 5 km a 10 km pre dospelých
Samostatné kategórie pre deti s vlastným štartom
additional: Štart detských kategórií je o 09:15, hlavný pretek začína o 10:15. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane mužov a žien v rôznych vekových skupinách. Registrácia na mieste je možná za zvýšené štartovné. Preteky začínajú o 09:15 a 10:15, trať pravdepodobne vedie po miestnych cestách, registrácia je dostupná online aj na mieste.

name: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto
location: Námestie SNP Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Slovakia
description: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto je bežecké podujatie v malebnom prostredí Rajeckej doliny, ktoré ponúka kombináciu asfaltových a poľných ciest. Trať vedie prevažne po poľných cestách s približne 20 % asfaltového povrchu, čo vytvára príjemnú a rozmanitú bežeckú skúsenosť. Podujatie je známe svojou výbornou organizáciou a priateľskou atmosférou, ktorá láka bežcov rôznych úrovní. Štart je na Námestí SNP v Rajeckých Tepliciach a organizátorom je Ján Valúch ml., ktorý je k dispozícii pre informácie a podporu.
course_highlights: Trať vedie 20 % po asfaltových cestách a 80 % po poľných cestách
Štart na Námestí SNP v Rajeckých Tepliciach
Malebné prostredie Rajeckej doliny
additional: Štartovné je 12 € pri online registrácii a 20 € na mieste. Organizátorom je Ján Valúch ml., kontaktovateľný na telefónnom čísle 0904 255 310 a e-maile valuch.jan@gmail.com. Podujatie je súčasťou športového dňa v Rajeckých Tepliciach, s krásnou traťou a skvelou atmosférou.

name: Beh malý Caesar
location: Námestie SNP, Rajecké Teplice, Žilina, Slovakia
description: Beh sv. Andreja a Detský beh Malý Caesar sú tradičné podujatia v Rajeckých Tepliciach, ktoré prinášajú športovú a rodinnú atmosféru na Námestí SNP. Beh sv. Andreja je asfaltový beh na 4,5 km trati s online registráciou, zatiaľ čo Detský beh Malý Caesar je určený pre deti vo veku 1 až 9 rokov a je bezplatný. Súčasťou podujatia je aj súťaž o najkrajšie vyzdobený detský kočík, ktorá obohacuje celkový zážitok pre účastníkov i divákov. Podujatie sa koná v popoludňajších hodinách s prezentáciou a štartom na námestí.
course_highlights: Asfaltová trať dlhá 4,5 km pre Beh sv. Andreja
Detské kategórie pre vekové skupiny 1 - 3, 4 - 6 a 7 - 9 rokov
Súťaž o najkrajšie vyzdobený detský kočík priamo na námestí
additional: Prezentácia pre Beh sv. Andreja je od 14:30 do 16:30, štart o 17:00. Pre Detský beh Malý Caesar je prezentácia od 14:00 vo vestibule MsÚ. Počet miest pre detský beh je obmedzený na 150. Podujatie sa koná na Námestí SNP v Rajeckých Tepliciach. Detský beh je určený pre všetky vekové kategórie, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, podujatie je vhodné pre celé rodiny.

name: Běhej lesy Klínovec
location: Vrcholek Klínovec, Krušné hory, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Klínovec is a trail race in the Ore Mountains, taking place on July 11, 2026. The race offers various routes, including short and long options, as well as a charity race. The start is at the summit of Klínovec, with the option to take the cable car up before descending to the Klínovec Ski Area. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races and features special speed sections, Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Start at the summit of Klínovec, followed by a descent to the ski area
150-metre Conti Speed Section
500 m Generali Investments Finish straight with a timed section
additional: The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, with international ranking points. The course features special speed sections, Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, with rewards for the fastest runners. The start is at the summit of Klínovec, with the option to take the cable car up. The finish straight has been extended to 500 m and is timed for performance analysis. Routes range from 3 to 50 km; the races are suitable for a wide audience, including children. Registration is also possible on site, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Libečovská 14
location: Podkozí, Libečov, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Libečovská 14 is a 14.2 km race with approximately 170 metres of elevation gain, running on both asphalt and trails. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník District Runners’ Cup and offers runners an interesting combination of asphalt and trail sections. The course is suitable for runners looking for a challenge with a gentle climb and varied surfaces. The race takes place in the picturesque Podkozí area of the Central Bohemian Region and attracts runners from a wide surrounding area.
course_highlights: Course distance: 14.2 km
Elevation gain: approx. 170 m
The course runs on both asphalt and trails
additional: The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník District Runners’ Cup, offers a varied course for runners looking for a challenge, and takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Podkozí.

name: Králický Sněžník Beze stopy
location: Heřmanice u Králík, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Králický Sněžník BEZE STOPY is a challenging mountain race covering 14 km with 1,050 m of elevation gain. It starts in Heřmanice and runs via Klepáč and Malý Sněžník to the summit of Králický Sněžník. The route features beautiful ridge running with views of Poland’s Kłodzko Basin and the Lower Morava Valley, as well as short, demanding descents. The race is for lovers of mountain terrain and is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Iscarex Cup. A shorter 5 km race with 440 m of elevation gain is available for younger runners. The main race starts at 9:30, and the junior race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with 1,050 m of elevation gain over 14 km
A ridge route with views of Poland’s Kłodzko Basin and the Lower Morava Valley
Demanding descents and chamois trails
additional: The junior race starts at 11:00, with transport to the start leaving at 10:15 from the accreditation area. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Iscarex Cup. It takes place on 11 July 2026. Online registration opens on 1 January 2025. The start and finish are in Heřmanice u Králík. The course includes border paths and chamois trails, with a short stretch of asphalt after the start.

name: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov
description: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov is a 5.75 km uphill race with 255 meters of elevation gain, starting in Hvězdonice. This running race offers challenging terrain and beautiful views in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for runners looking for a climbing challenge and wanting to test themselves in a mountain race. The race is part of the Svět běhu running calendar and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: Route length: 5.75 km
Elevation gain: 255 m
Start in Hvězdonice
additional: The race is held regularly in July. Registration and further information are not explicitly provided, but the event is well known among the regional running community.

name: MiniTMMTR - TransMoravský Masochistický Terénní Běh
organizer: Česká atletická unie (ČAU) ve spolupráci s Tomášem Ruskem
description: MiniTMMTR is a challenging 100 km trail run starting in Lomnice in the South Moravian Region. The route passes through beautiful places in the Blansko District to Luleč, where runners turn around, and then follows the same route back. The race is part of the TransMoravian Masochistic Trail Run, known for its distance, challenging profile, and typically warm summer weather. It offers a chance to discover some of Moravia’s most beautiful places and enjoy running in the forest and along quiet country roads. The race was founded by Czech ultrarunner Tomáš Rusek and is playfully called “masochistic” to reflect its difficulty.
course_highlights: The route passes through beautiful places in the Blansko District
Turnaround in Luleč; out and back along the same route
Running in the forest and along quiet country roads
additional: Trail race, marked route, refreshment stations, online tracking available, registration and accommodation in the area

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a course of moderate difficulty. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, making event logistics convenient. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km course in Bukowiec
Race office in the sports hall in Bukowiec
A commemorative medal for every participant who finishes the race
additional: The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec. Every runner who crosses the finish line receives a medal. A registration form is available, allowing you to contact the organizer and system administrator quickly. Registration takes place online, the event is local in nature, and results are available electronically.

name: X Świerczyniecki Bieg Uliczny
description: The 10th Świerczyniec Street Race for the Village Head’s Cup is an annual running event held in Świerczyniec. The race takes place on the town’s streets, with the start scheduled for 10:00. It is organized by the Świerczyniec Volunteer Fire Brigade, and timing is professionally provided using RFID technology. The race attracts both local runners and sports enthusiasts from nearby areas, offering exciting competition and a chance for the community to come together.
course_highlights: A street race in the picturesque village of Świerczyniec
Professional electronic RFID timing
Start at 10:00 on 11 July 2026
additional: The race is organized by the Świerczyniec Volunteer Fire Brigade. Registration closes on 10 July 2026 at 23:59. Timing is provided electronically using RFID technology. Live results are available at the finish, along with personalized certificates showing race times that can be downloaded from the website. The start is at 10:00, registration closes on 10 July 2026 at 23:59, and the event features two distances: 5 and 10 km.

name: Bieg na Bucze
location: Górki Wielkie, Brenna, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Pozytywny Bieg Przełajowy - reaktywacja
location: Kalej, Wręczyca Wielka, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIII Otwarte Mistrzostwa Zakopanego w Bi...
VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: The 7th Csillagok útján… night run is a unique running experience at Balatonboglár’s Platán Beach, where runners and walkers are welcomed on July 11 in a summer setting on the shores of Lake Balaton. The new venue offers a wider start-finish corridor, a firm surface throughout, and full street lighting along the route. Participants can choose from 3.5, 7, and 10.5 km distances, while walking and a 500-meter children’s distance are also available. The event warmly welcomes all ages and running levels to experience the magic of running at night together.
course_highlights: Balatonboglár’s Platán Beach in a beautiful lakeside setting
A wide start-finish corridor and a firm surface throughout
Street lighting along the entire route for a night-running experience
additional: Walking is also available on the 3.5 km distance, and children can test their strength over 500 meters. Street lighting along the entire route supports safe night running. The new venue offers a wider start-finish corridor and a firm surface. The event is part of the summer events on Lake Balaton, and the organizers aim to increase interest in active leisure activities in the region.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
location: Barcs, Városháza, Barcs, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The Dráva Half Marathon is a traditional 21-kilometer race between Barcs and Heresznye, held for the fifth time. Runners from several counties take part, and men and women compete in separate categories. The course is varied, and record times have been set in previous years, reflecting the race’s competitive nature and popularity. The event is organized by the local Dráva Running Club and the Heresznye municipality, creating a friendly yet competitive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer course between Barcs and Heresznye
Varied route that has seen record times
Runners from six counties take part in the race
additional: The event includes several sports, including running, hiking, and cycling, and the races are usually held in July between Barcs and Heresznye.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Köcsi Lake running event is a traditional race with a friendly, family atmosphere, held near Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred, in the scenic surroundings of Köcsi Lake. Everyone who wants to run or walk is warmly welcome to enjoy the natural setting and the community sporting experience. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sports and Environmental Protection Association, which is committed to sport and environmental protection. The race offers several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.
course_highlights: A nature-rich course around Köcsi Lake
A friendly, community atmosphere
Several distances for different age groups
additional: Results are available for the 1 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances, broken down by age group. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sports and Environmental Protection Association, which also supports several health and environmental projects. Photos are available for participants on the website. Multiple distances for children and adults, refreshment facilities, the opportunity to swim at the beach, finisher medals.

name: Malý Štrbský maratón
organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
price_range: 20,- € to 25,- € depending on registration date, free for some categories
description: Malý Štrbský maratón je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná každoročne v druhej júlovú nedeľu v obci Štrba pod Tatrami. Pretekári majú na výber z dvoch hlavných tratí - 31 km a 10 km, ktoré vedú po asfaltovej ceste medzi Štrbou a Liptovskou Tepličkou. Podujatie je súčasťou projektu Tatry v pohybe a priláka bežcov z viacerých krajín, pričom atmosféra na námestí pred Kultúrnym domom je vždy živá a športovo naladená. Organizátormi sú obec Štrba, obec Liptovská Teplička a Športový klub Štrba.
course_highlights: 31 km trať po asfaltovej ceste III. triedy zo Štrby do Liptovskej Tepličky a späť
Občerstvovacie stanice na 8., 12., 16., 20., 25. a 28. kilometri
10 km trať novinka od roku 2021
additional: Účastnícky limit je 500 pretekárov celkovo, s prioritou pre 31 km trať (limit 200) a 10 km trať (limit 300). Preteky prebiehajú bez vylúčenia dopravy, preto je potrebná zvýšená pozornosť. Zdravotné zabezpečenie poskytuje Tatranská horská služba, NsP Poprad a miestny Červený kríž. Pretekári štartujú na vlastnú zodpovednosť. Organizátor zabezpečuje dopravu od vybraných vlakových spojov z Tatranskej Štrby. Trať zahŕňa 48 km, 10 km a detské preteky; súčasť Východoslovenskej mládežníckej bežeckej ligy; registrácia má stanovené termíny a vekové kategórie; Nordic Walking je súčasť podujatia.

name: S-Race
location: Kolonáda Ferdinandova pramene, Mariánské Lázně, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: S-Race is an OCR run in Mariánské Lázně, held in front of the Ferdinand Spring Colonnade. The race offers 6 km, 12 km and 18 km courses, which run mostly along paved forest paths and feature more than 20 obstacles per lap. Races adapted to different age groups are available for children. The start and finish are right by the colonnade, where facilities include changing rooms, toilets, a baggage storage area and refreshments. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages and features staggered starts, with activities for children during the main race.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly along paved forest paths
More than 20 obstacles on the 6 km lap, 40+ on the 12 km course, and 60+ on the 18 km course
Start and finish in front of the Ferdinand Spring Colonnade in Mariánské Lázně
additional: The main race starts at 120-second intervals, with five runners per start. The 18K course starts first, followed by the 12K and 6K courses. Registration and chip collection on race day are open from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race and from 12:30 to 13:45 for the children’s race. Participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. Men’s and women’s changing rooms, toilets, baggage storage and refreshments are available. Activities for children are provided during the main race. The terrain includes paved forest paths and obstacles. The race is suitable for the general public, including younger participants born in 2011 or earlier, who need parental consent. The race takes place on 12 July 2026.

name: Koblížkový pasecký běh
location: Paseka u Olomouce, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Koblížkový Pasecký Run is a traditional road race in Paseka near Olomouc, offering an 8.2 km course. The race runs on asphalt, paving stones and park paths, passing through the village, along the cycle path to the sanatorium and through the park of the Specialist Treatment Institute, before returning to the start at the municipal office. The first categories start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The organiser is Ivan Elischer, who ensures the event runs smoothly and supports the runners.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt, paving stones and park paths
It passes through Paseka and along the cycle path to the sanatorium
It includes the park of the Specialist Treatment Institute
additional: The race starts at the municipal office in Paseka. The course is suitable for running on asphalt, paving stones and park paths. The organiser is Ivan Elischer, who can be contacted for information. The race takes place on 12 July 2026; registration and further information are available on the official website. The event is open to the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Halda Trail Run
location: Kuřimská Nová Ves, Brno-Country District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running adventure in Kuřimská Nová Ves, following the picturesque landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka River. The longest route is approximately 24 km and includes 23 stream crossings that are runnable and pleasantly refreshing in summer. The race offers three route distances (4, 14 and 24 km), which connect to one another and allow runners to change distance during the race. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, with panoramic views, two short, steep climbs and varied terrain—something both recreational runners and ambitious trail runners will appreciate.
course_highlights: 23 ankle-deep stream crossings that are runnable and refreshing in summer
Panoramic views and two short, steep climbs with gradients of over 30%
The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. The timing checkpoint at the start of the second lap (14.5 km) closes at 12:00; slower runners will be stopped and classified on the middle-distance route. The 4, 14 and 24 km routes connect to one another, and runners can change route distance during the race. The route surface combines challenging terrain (rocks and roots), easy terrain and asphalt. The route will be clearly marked with arrows and flagging tape. Trail, stream crossings, scenery, challenging terrain; registration details are not specified.

name: Běh letním ránem
location: Štítná nad Vláří, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 300 CZK předem, 500 CZK na místě; děti a mládež do 18 let 100 CZK předem, 200 CZK na místě

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 300,- CZK při přihlášení předem, platba přes stránky behyzlin.cz

description: Běh letním ránem is a trail running race held in Štítná nad Vláří - Popov, offering two routes of approximately 7 and 15 km. The race traverses varied terrain, including asphalt, forest trails and hills, with beautiful views and challenging sections that test runners’ fitness. The start and finish are by the pub in Popov. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, with an emphasis on participants’ safety and responsibility. It is part of the Běhy Zlín series and is organized by the Martinát family and their friends.
course_highlights: A trail race combining asphalt and forest trails
A challenging climb to the saddle below Hložecká Chapel
Beautiful views of Popov and the surrounding countryside
additional: Online registration is available until 2 business days before the race, and on-site registration is available until 9:30. Timing uses Race Result chip technology. Water and Kofola are available on the course; sweets, fruit and goulash for pre-registered participants are available at the finish. The start and finish are by the pub in Popov. Parking is by the bus stop, as directed by the organizer. Children under 15 must be accompanied by someone over 18; participants aged 15–18 may start with written consent from a parent or legal guardian. The race takes place on 12 July 2026, starts at 10:00, and registration closes 2 days before the race. Chip timing. Suitable for runners aged 15 and over.

name: Běh o Ludgerův meč
description: The Run for Ludger’s Sword is the third edition of a running race organized by Běžecký klub Náchod in cooperation with the municipality of Hořičky. The race is part of the Primátor CUP running series and the Velká cena východních Čech cup. The routes run around Hořičky, offering beautiful views of the Kladské pomezí, across gently rolling terrain with gravel and forest paths and very little asphalt. Courses are available for children, as well as an 8 km main race and a 4 km FIT course. The start and race check-in take place at the grounds by the football pitch in Hořičky.
course_highlights: 8 km main race on gently rolling terrain with gravel and forest paths
4 km FIT course with very little asphalt
Beautiful views of the Kladské pomezí
additional: Race check-in opens at 8:00 at the grounds by the football pitch in Hořičky. Check-in closes 30 minutes before each children’s category starts and at 10:00 for adults. Children’s races start between 9:00 and 9:35, according to age category. The main race and FIT course start at 10:30. The entry fee includes chip timing; homemade cakes, pastries, juice and tea are served at the finish. Parking is available by the football pitch; please follow the organizers’ instructions. Prizes are awarded to the fastest children, with medals and non-cash prizes in the adult categories. Cash prizes go to the first three men and women overall in the main race (600 Kč, 400 Kč, 200 Kč). Terrain: gently rolling, with gravel and forest paths and very little asphalt. Online registration via sportchallange.cz. The race includes medals and prizes and takes place at the grounds by the football pitch in Hořičky.

name: II Galicyjska 10
description: The 2nd Galician 10K of the Podkarpackie Regional Chamber of Civil Engineers is a sporting event bringing Chamber members and their families together. It will take place on July 12, 2026, in Urzejowice, in the park by the stadium. The event includes a 10 km run, a 7 km Nordic Walking march, and children’s races in various age categories. It’s a great opportunity to spend active family time outdoors, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring the civil engineering community together. Participants can look forward to a sporty atmosphere and fun at the finish line.
course_highlights: 10 km run
7 km Nordic Walking march
Children’s races in various age categories
additional: The event is open to active Chamber members and their families. In addition to the run and Nordic Walking march, children’s races are held in various age categories. The event promotes integration and a healthy lifestyle. The detailed programme and registration form will be published soon. The start and finish are in the park by the stadium in Urzejowice. Race categories: 10 km run, 7 km Nordic Walking, children’s races; scheduled for July 12, 2026; in Urzejowice, park near the stadium

name: 43 Bieg o Złoty Kłos
location: Kołaczkowo, Września County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: LÁZBÉRCI SRI CHINMOY MARATON
location: Lázbérci Természetvédelmi Terület, Lázbérc, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén, Hungary
description: The Lázbérc Sri Chinmoy Marathon is a nationally organized running race in Hungary, held in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy. The race traditionally offers the experience of running close to nature and gives participants a unique opportunity to experience physical and spiritual harmony. Runners can test their strength and endurance on varied terrain in a picturesque setting. The race has a friendly, intimate atmosphere, and all running enthusiasts are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: Varied terrain close to nature
Picturesque surroundings in the Lázbérc landscape
An event held in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy
additional: The event will take place in 2026, and the organizers aim to bring together the community of peace and running.

name: Dvě kola při zdi
price_range: 50 Kč děti online, 100 Kč na místě; dospělí 250 Kč na místě po online uzávěrce

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150 Kč při registraci online uzávěrka online registrací: 6. července – do tohoto termínu nutno zaplatit startovné.

description: Dvě kola při zdi is a traditional cross-country race in Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve, offering courses for men, women, and children. Men run the main 7.8 km course along the reserve’s perimeter walls. Women have a shorter 4 km course, but may also run the men’s course. Two shorter loops are prepared for children. After the race, participants can enjoy a raffle and hearty refreshments.
course_highlights: The course runs along the perimeter walls of Hvězda Game Reserve
The main men’s course is 7.8 km long, with approximately 120 m of total elevation gain
The women’s course is 4 km long, with approximately 60 m of elevation gain; women may also run the men’s course
additional: On-site registration is available from 16:30 to 18:00 (for children, from 16:00 to 16:30). Runners receive an electronic chip for accurate timekeeping. The start and finish are in Hvězda Game Reserve, by the main entrance from Vypich. Hearty refreshments are available, including soft drinks, beer, and bread with English bacon. A raffle with prizes takes place after the race. Portable toilets are available. The race offers refreshments, electronic timekeeping, a raffle with prizes, and various age categories, including children.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: Lussonium Trail is a trail running race among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering wonderful views, challenging climbs and a friendly, family-like atmosphere. The race offers several distances for participants of all ages, with unique finisher medals that can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The race headquarters are at the Lussonium Roman Ruins, where parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid point are also available. The race is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program, so participants can earn points and redeem them for rewards.
course_highlights: Wonderful views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging trail climbs
Impressive start and finish venue at the Lussonium Roman Ruins
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 valid entries. Entries are accepted for a maximum of 400 runners, including no more than 100 preschool- and primary school-aged participants. Parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid point are available on site. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal. It is also possible to register at a lower price without a medal. The race is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program. Medals and refreshments await participants, and the event has a friendly atmosphere and is ideal for families.

name: Halda
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running adventure through the beautiful landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka River. It offers three connected routes of 4, 14 and 24 kilometres, allowing runners to change distance during the race. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, and features 23 stream crossings, two short, steep climbs and panoramic views. The race is suitable for both relaxed runners and ambitious trail runners, and is clearly marked with arrows and ribbons.
course_highlights: 23 ankle-deep stream crossings that are runnable and refreshing in summer
Panoramic views and two short, steep climbs with gradients of over 30%
The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. At the start of the second lap (14.5 km), the time checkpoint closes at 12:00; slower runners will be stopped and classified on the middle-distance route. The route combines challenging terrain (rocks and roots), easy terrain and asphalt. Runners may switch to a shorter route during the race. Routes: 4 km, 14 km, 24 km; trail terrain, brooks, scenic views, 3-hour time limit.

name: Běh o Neplachovský Hrneček
description: The Neplachov Mug Run is a traditional running race held in Neplachov, South Bohemia. Its 14th edition takes place on Friday, July 17, 2026. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is supported by the South Bohemian Region’s budget. The event offers a sporting experience in the region’s beautiful surroundings and attracts runners from the wider area. The organizers warmly invite all runners to take part in this popular event.
course_highlights: 10 km course with paved and natural-surface sections
Includes various age categories, including children
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: The course consists of two 5 km loops. Registration is available through the website, and results are published online. The run is supported by the South Bohemian Region.

name: Kružberský Tesák
location: Kružberský přehradní areál, u přehrady Kružberk, Kružberk, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kružberský Tesák is a sporting event held at the Kružberk Dam grounds, offering courses and categories for experienced runners, intermediate participants, and complete beginners. The race is suitable for solo runners, walkers, and families with children. The event also includes Pejskiáda, a fun dog show and competitions for dogs of all sizes and breeds. Organizers Kateřina and Lucie, nature lovers and fans of sports with dogs, aim to create a friendly atmosphere and make the event enjoyable for everyone.
course_highlights: Courses suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to experienced athletes
The area around Kružberk Dam, with beautiful natural scenery and views
Pejskiáda, featuring a dog show and competitions for dogs of all breeds and sizes
additional: Registration opens in May 2026. After submitting the entry form, you will be sent a variable payment reference for paying the entry fee to the organizer’s account. Payment must be made as soon as possible after registration. The event also includes dog competitions and shows, and is suitable for families with children and dog lovers. A two-day event with the option of camping in tents, competitions, and a traveling trophy for the winner.

name: Leśna Eko Piątka
location: Lesna Eko Piątka, Piekary Śląskie, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa uiszczona do dnia 05.2026 r. ( płatność online )

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Opłata startowa uiszczana od 19.05.2026 r. do 18.06.2026 r. ( płatność online)

tiers.label: tier_3

description: Leśna Eko Piątka is a race held in Piekary Śląskie that promotes the city and supports social integration and efforts to prevent addiction among children and young people. The route follows paved and gravel roads through Dioblina Forest, with the start and finish at the MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Piekary Śląskie. Participants receive a race pack with a bib, timekeeping, a medal and medical care. The time limit is 45 minutes, and the participant limit is 500.
course_highlights: The route follows paved and gravel roads through Dioblina Forest
Start and finish at the MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street
Course checkpoints and a 45-minute time limit
additional: The race office will be open on 17 July 2026 from 16:00 to 18:30 at 3 Olimpijska Street. Changing rooms, baggage storage and toilets are available near the race office. The race pack includes a race bib, electronic timekeeping, a medal, medical care, surprises and access to baggage storage. A T-shirt can be purchased separately for an additional fee of 70 zł until 18.06.2026. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and integration within the local community. The participant limit is 500, and fees can be paid online or in cash. Race packs include, among other things, T-shirts, making them attractive to participants.

name: XIII Bieg po Chrust
location: Chróścice, Dobrzeń Wielki, Opole County, Poland

name: Kordícky Extrém
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Kordícky Extrém je náročný horský beh, ktorý vedie cez malebné okolie Kordíkov v okrese Banská Bystrica. Trať je určená pre bežcov, ktorí hľadajú extrémne výzvy v prírode s výrazným prevýšením a technickými úsekmi. Podujatie je súčasťou série Marathon Tour a ponúka jedinečný zážitok z behu v krásnom horskom prostredí. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí chcú otestovať svoju vytrvalosť a odvahu v tomto extrémnom teréne.
course_highlights: Horské prostredie s výrazným prevýšením
Technicky náročné úseky na prírodných chodníkoch
Malebné výhľady na okolie Kordíkov
additional: Viaceré kategórie a možnosti registrácie vrátane online a osobne, podujatie je spojené s veľkou spoločenskou akciou s jedlom a zábavou.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Mestisko, okres Svidník, Slovakia
description: Mesciské pancaky je bežecké podujatie v Mestisku, okres Svidník, ktoré ponúka trate na 5 km a 10 km bez vekových obmedzení pre mužov aj ženy. Trať vedie prevažne po asfalte, s časťou po trávnatej ploche a poľnej ceste, čo zabezpečuje rôznorodý povrch pre bežcov. Štart pretekov je na futbalovom ihrisku v Mestisku. Registrácia je možná online alebo priamo na mieste podujatia.
course_highlights: Povrch: 60% asfalt, 20% trávnatá plocha, 20% poľná cesta
Dve kategórie: 5 km a 10 km bez vekového obmedzenia
Štart na futbalovom ihrisku v Mestisku
additional: Kategórie sú bez rozdielu veku pre mužov aj ženy. Miesto štartu je futbalové ihrisko v Mestisku. Povrch trate je kombinovaný asfalt, trávnatá plocha a poľná cesta. Podujatie je otvorené pre všetky vekové kategórie, registrácia je dostupná online aj na mieste, a trať je kombináciou asfaltu, trávy a terénu.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
location: Hrabovo, Národný park Veľká Fatra, Slovakia
description: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra sú trailové preteky v Národnom parku Veľká Fatra, ktoré ponúkajú bežcom nezabudnuteľné výhľady na Nízke Tatry, lesné single traily a špeciálne lesné cesty. Trasy vedú cez UNESCO lokalitu Vlkolínec a zahŕňajú aj lanovku a Sidorovo. Preteky sú súčasťou medzinárodného UTMB Index Races, kde bežci získavajú body podľa výkonu a dĺžky trate. K dispozícii sú tri trate s rôznou dĺžkou a prevýšením, vhodné pre rôzne úrovne bežcov.
course_highlights: Nezabudnuteľné výhľady na Nízke Tatry
Lesné single traily a špeciálne lesné cesty
Trasa vedie cez UNESCO lokalitu Vlkolínec
additional: Súčasťou trate sú rýchlostné úseky Conti Speed Section na 150 metroch, označené vlajkami Continental. Bežci môžu získať body do UTMB Index Races podľa výkonu a dĺžky trate. Trasy majú rôzne prevýšenia: 730 m na 18 km, 405 m na 11 km a 267 m na 5 km. Trasy sú vedené prevažne na mäkkom povrchu v prírode. Pretek je súčasťou série podporujúcej environmentálne a charitatívne projekty, s detailmi o registrácii, štartovnom a sprievodnými aktivitami dostupnými na oficiálnej stránke.

name: Zkus Noční Kuks
location: Kuks, Trutnov District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: Zkus Noční Kuks is a night running race in the picturesque Baroque setting of Kuks. It offers two routes—10 km and 5 km—that pass historic landmarks such as Braun’s Nativity Scene and Kuks Hospital. Running in the dark, lit only by headlamps, offers a unique experience and an atmosphere that runners will remember for a long time. The 10 km route includes the 21st Century Stations of the Cross pilgrimage route, while the shorter 5 km route follows the Elbe at night and the Count’s Avenue, lined with 222 trees.
course_highlights: The 10 km route leads through the magical heart of the Baroque landscape, past Braun’s Nativity Scene and the 21st Century Stations of the Cross
The 5 km route starts at the hospital and runs along the Elbe at night and the Count’s Avenue, lined with 222 trees
A night run illuminated by headlamps, with an unforgettable atmosphere beneath the illuminated façade of Kuks Hospital
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib and chip. Entry can also be purchased as a gift voucher with a unique code. Registration takes place online via myresult.cz; the contractual relationship begins upon payment of the entry fee. The race is organized by TURN ON EVENTS s.r.o. from Hradec Králové. The race offers 5 km and 10 km routes, the option to run with a headlamp, refreshments during and after the race, and dogs are allowed. Registration is available via the website; the entry fee is payable within 14 days of registration.

name: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Olomouc District, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc is a family-friendly running event offering 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km races for recreational and elite runners, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Smetana Gardens and is part of a nationwide series featuring unique courses. The organisers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, including a programme of activities and a charitable element. Every participant receives a race pack and can look forward to refreshments and support from the pacer team. ČEZ RunTour is not only a sporting event, but also a full-day experience for all ages.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km races, plus children’s races of 500 and 1,000 m
Start and finish in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
A programme of activities and a charitable element
additional: The event offers 2 x 5 km and 4 x 2.5 km relay races as part of the 10 km race. The pacer team helps runners achieve their target time. There are refreshment stations on the course, including at least two on the half marathon. Children receive a race pack and can enjoy activities in the children’s zone. A dedicated emergency medical service phone line is also available during the race. The event includes various race distances, family activities, charitable support, medals, photos and facilities for runners. The start and finish are in Smetana Gardens, and capacity is approximately 1,700 runners.

description: Noční běh Rusava is an unforgettable night race in the Hostýnské Mountains, offering a 12-hour run on a single loop as well as a 5 km race. The event is suitable for both individuals and relay teams, and participants are not required to run for the full 12 hours. Race facilities include a gymnasium for resting, an all-night buffet, and aid stations. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of the ski slope and forests around Rusava, offering a unique sporting experience beneath the starry sky.
course_highlights: A night run on the ski slope and through the forests of the Hostýnské Mountains
A single 5 km loop that can be repeated for 12 hours
All-night aid stations and facilities at the local school
additional: Race facilities include a gymnasium at the local school for resting, where participants can bring sleeping bags and sleeping mats. A buffet and aid stations serving drinks, fruit, and food are open throughout the night. Parking is available in designated areas in the village. You do not have to run for the full 12 hours; you can also walk with poles. A belt for attaching the race bib is available for 150 Kč. Terrain: forests and ski slope; registration; relay system; environmental requirements for cups; refreshments throughout the night.

name: 7 pohoří Krušné Hory
description: The Krušné hory 2026 race is a technical trail run that takes you through the beauty of the Krušné Mountains and a former mining landscape listed by UNESCO. The route starts in Abertamy and passes the former Eva mine, Jelení, Švýcarská chata on Plešivec, Merklín, the former settlement of Kaff, Pstruží and the ski area before reaching the finish. It offers three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments on the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: A scenic route through the Krušné Mountains and UNESCO-listed mining landscape
Main course: 22 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain
Alternative courses: 13 km and 8 km with 510 m and 220 m of elevation gain
additional: The race has a time limit of 4 hours; after this time, a runner is marked DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration tent. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a professionally marked course, race bib, chip timing, a commemorative medal, and refreshments on the course and at the finish. The event takes place in all weather conditions, and participation is at your own risk. The entry fee includes the course, medal, refreshments, facilities, and recommended equipment, including a windbreaker and a mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The race is organized by a local mountain rescue team.

name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou - Dvoračky
location: Dvorská bouda, Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The route from Rokytnice nad Jizerou to Dvoračky is a popular hiking trail in the western Krkonoše Mountains. It starts at Horní náměstí in Rokytnice. Marked blue, the trail follows the Huťský stream to the picturesque Huťský Waterfall and continues to the Dvoračky mountain lodge, known for its history and traditional cheese-making. The route offers beautiful natural scenery, especially in autumn, when the surrounding beech forests are ablaze with colour. It is suitable for hikers, ski mountaineers and cross-country skiers, who can enjoy the snowy landscape and refreshments at the Štumpovka restaurant in Dvoračky.
course_highlights: Blue-marked trail following the Huťský stream
Huťský Waterfall, surrounded by beech forests with beautiful autumn colours
Historic Dvoračky mountain lodge, known for traditional cheese-making
additional: Parking is available at the Tesco car park on Dolní náměstí in Rokytnice. Refreshments are available at the Štumpovka restaurant in Dvoračky and the U Vocta pub in Rokytnice. The route is also suitable for winter hiking, ski mountaineering and cross-country skiing. Please respect the groomed ski tracks and do not enter them. The race is part of the local sports calendar, with several distances available, including an uphill race to Dvoračky. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers beautiful views and a rewarding sporting experience.

name: Nocna zaDyszka 2026
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piekarach Śląskich
description: Nocna zaDyszka is a 10 km race held as part of the 7th PKO Piekary Śląskie Half Marathon, taking place on 18 July 2026 in Piekary Śląskie. The event attracts many runners, and the entry limit for this distance is 900 participants. The day before, on 17 July, the accompanying Leśna Eko Piątka 5 km race will also take place. The organizers invite runners to take part and say they expect nearly 3,000 runners across all distances in 2026.
course_highlights: Night race over 10 km
Entry limit of 900 participants
Accompanying Leśna Eko Piątka 5 km race, with a limit of 500 participants
additional: Entry limits: 1,500 for the half marathon, 900 for Nocna zaDyszka (10 km), and 500 for Leśna Eko Piątka (5 km). Online registration is available. The accompanying race takes place the day before the main event. The event also includes races for children, the option to register online in advance, and a course time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes. The race draws strong interest from the local community and is one of the region’s most important sporting events.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogrod Botaniczny UMCS, Lublin, Lublin County, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin is the spring edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, combining athletic competition with the beauty of nature. The race aims to promote running and showcase attractive, scenic running routes. The organizers place particular emphasis on the natural features of the locations, making the race a unique experience for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin
Picturesque natural surroundings
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts since 2014
additional: 5 km race, course in the Botanical Garden, children's races, Nordic walking, July 2026

XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bančanská desiatka
description: Bančanská desiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek v Banskom okrese Vranov nad Topľou, ktorý sa koná pred Kultúrnym domom v Banskom. Ide o obľúbené športové podujatie s dlhoročnou históriou, ktoré každoročne priláka rekordný počet účastníkov. Pretek je známy svojou náročnosťou a krásnym prostredím behu do vrchu, pričom organizuje ho Športový klub Banské. Okrem hlavného behu sa konajú aj časovky do vrchu a ďalšie sprievodné podujatia.
course_highlights: Beh do vrchu v obci Banské - Mláčky
Tradičný štart pred Kultúrnym domom v Banskom
Náročný profil trate s novým rekordom trate 14:35 min
additional: Organizátorom je Športový klub Banské, ktorý má dlhoročnú tradíciu od roku 1985. Podujatie sa koná pravidelne, pričom v roku 2025 sa uskutoční už 30. ročník Bančanskej 10/5. V rámci podujatia sa konajú aj časovky do vrchu JANTEX Banské - Mláčky, ktoré majú samostatnú históriu a kategórie. Pretek zahŕňa 10 km a 5 km štafetu, registrácia online alebo na mieste, bohatý sprievodný program vrátane nafukovacieho hradu a vystúpení.

name: YOUNG RUN Nestlé
location: Námestie J. C. Hronského, Prievidza, Prievidza, Slovakia
description: YOUNG RUN Nestlé je bežecké podujatie v Prievidzi, ktoré ponúka trate dlhé 21 km, 10 km a 5 km. Pretekári sú rozdelení do kategórií podľa veku a pohlavia, pričom sú k dispozícii aj štafetové disciplíny pre deti. Štart pretekov je na Námestí J. C. Hronského s rôznymi časmi štartu podľa trate. Organizátormi sú YOUNG RUN, Nestlé a Mesto Prievidza, ktorí zabezpečujú kvalitný športový zážitok pre všetky vekové kategórie.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 21 km, 10 km a 5 km v centre Prievidze
Kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny vrátane juniorov a veteránov
Štafetové preteky pre deti s okruhmi 2 x 5 km a 2 x 2,5 km
additional: Štart pretekov: 8:00 hod. pre 21 km, 8:15 hod. pre TRUE okruh a štafetu, 9:20 hod. pre STARTIN, 9:55 hod. pre deti. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia s presnými ročníkmi narodenia. Organizátor poskytuje kontaktné telefónne číslo +421915574850. Podujatie zahŕňa aj VIP zóny, online časomieru, podporu pre zdravotne znevýhodnených a 600 medailí pre účastníkov.

name: Ipelský Beh
location: Lučenec - Kalonda, Hrádza na Ipli, Lučenec, Slovakia
description: Ipelský Beh je bežecké podujatie konané v lokalite Lučenec - Kalonda, na hrádzi rieky Ipeľ. Trať vedie prevažne po tráve a zahŕňa aj úsek nefunkčnej železničnej trate dlhý 100 metrov. Pretek je otvorený pre rôzne vekové kategórie mužov, žien aj mládeže, vrátane nordic walking. Organizátormi sú mesto Lučenec, obec Kalonda a OZ-Novohrad, ktorí srdečne pozývajú bežcov všetkých úrovní zúčastniť sa tejto tradičnej akcie.
course_highlights: Povrch trate prevažne tráva
Úsek 100 metrov nefungujúcej železničnej trate
Lokalita hrádze na rieke Ipeľ v Lučenci - Kalonde
additional: Registrácia online je možná do 18.7.2025 za zvýhodnené štartovné 13 €. Na mieste bude štartovné 18 €, ak bude voľná kapacita. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane nordic walking pre mužov a ženy. Organizátorom je Marian Duzbaba (tel.: 0907 146 181). Pretek je organizovaný v rôznych kategóriách vrátane Nordic Walking, s možnosťou online registrácie a pretekmi na rôznych tratiach vrátane 10 km a 6,5 km asfaltovej trate. Podujatie je súčasťou športového kalendára v regióne a je vhodné pre všetky vekové skupiny.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Fojtovice
location: Fojtovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. Across six races in different destinations, you can choose from main races of 6 to 9 km, adventure routes of 20 to 30 km, a walk with checkpoint-finding, and children’s races. The series is suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a varied selection of routes through the picturesque Ore Mountains. The Fojtovice race takes place on 19 July 2026 and offers a main race, an adventure route, a walk, and children’s races.
course_highlights: Main race of 6–9 km through the picturesque Ore Mountains
Adventure route of 20–30 km, following a map
Children’s races from 300 m to 1,600 m
additional: The series includes 6 races in different locations in the Ore Mountains. In addition to running, participants can take part in a walk with checkpoint-finding using a map and in canicross. Children’s races are divided by age and course distance. The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s., in cooperation with Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. The races include different distances and categories, including walking and children’s races; the series takes place at several locations in the Ore Mountains region.

name: Šachty - Štěpánka
location: Vysoké nad Jizerou-Sklenařice, Vysoké nad Jizerou, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Český Ski klub Vysoké nad Jizerou
description: Běh Šachty - Štěpánka is a traditional race organized by the Czech Ski Club in Vysoké nad Jizerou. The race is part of the Maratonstav Czech Cup in hill running and offers runners a challenging course in beautiful Krkonoše surroundings. The event attracts athletes and hill-running fans, who can enjoy both the challenge and the atmosphere of a mountain race. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test themselves on this traditional course.
course_highlights: A challenging course in the Krkonoše Mountains
A hill run with beautiful views
Part of the Maratonstav Czech Cup
additional: The race is part of a hill-running series with a long-standing tradition and offers challenging terrain suitable for experienced runners and mountain-sports enthusiasts.

description: The Lower Silesian Mountain Running Festival is a prestigious trail-running event held in picturesque Lądek-Zdrój. As part of the festival, runners can take on a variety of courses with different distances and elevation gains, from short night runs to mountain ultramarathons. The event attracts mountain-running enthusiasts, offering unforgettable views and technically challenging courses. In 2026, the festival will take place from 16 to 19 July, and participants can look forward to a varied accompanying programme and professional organisation.
course_highlights: 7 Summits Course – approximately 240 km with approximately 7,670 m of elevation gain
Super Trail – 130 km, with its highest point at approximately 1,425 m above sea level
Night Trail – 15 km, ideal for beginners, with beautiful views
additional: Participants can purchase a commemorative technical T-shirt (99 PLN) and running sleeves (60 PLN). DFBG CAMP takes place during the festival (7–10 May 2026). Starts are held at various locations in Lądek-Zdrój and the surrounding area. Bag drop and gear-drop points are available along the courses. The accompanying programme includes an opening ceremony and an awards presentation. The event lasts four days and features various distances; participants can purchase commemorative T-shirts and running sleeves. Registration opens on 17 November, and participants can use various amenities, such as the expo and accommodation.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, known for its scenic courses and friendly atmosphere. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this special summer edition.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the UMCS Botanical Garden
Picturesque, scenic green surroundings
Organized with a focus on both natural beauty and sport
additional: The event is planned for July 19, 2026, in Lublin, with options to participate in different distances and age categories.
