description: Queen Bona’s Five is a 5 km race held at the Municipal Stadium in Różan. The event takes place on July 19, 2026, and is open to people aged 15 and over. Minors must provide written consent from a parent or guardian. The start and finish are located at 3 Szkolna Street. The event is organized by the Municipality of Różan and Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Club, and participants can expect professional support and timekeeping.
course_highlights: 5 km race
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Różan
Urban route located in Różan
additional: The race office is open from 8:00 to 9:30. Race briefing at the start line is at 9:45. The finish line closes at 11:00, and the winners’ award ceremony takes place at 11:30. Timekeeping uses a modern UHF RFID system, with immediate results and SMS messages sent to runners after the race. Venue: Municipal Stadium in Różan; online registration; distance: 5 km; participant age: 15 and over

name: VII Bieg Górski o Złotą Paproć
description: The 7th Golden Fern Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race taking place in the picturesque town of Tymbark. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a challenging course with varied terrain. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event attracts runners who enjoy a challenge and connecting with nature.
course_highlights: A 10 km mountain course
Picturesque landscapes of Małopolska
Challenging terrain with uphill sections
additional: The organizer offers training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to a runner’s VDOT level, along with expert support. The website also features a runner zone with tools for tracking progress and following training plans. The event is very popular, and participants can expect sporting competition and beautiful views. The race is open to a wide range of runners, and the organizer provides various categories and attractions.

name: XXII Bieg Szlakiem Partyzantów z Lubatowej
FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban
description: FUTABUDA in the Danube Bend is a self-funded, nonprofit running race taking place in Dunabogdány on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at 10:00. The race offers two challenges: 6.1 km with 205 m of elevation gain and 14 km with 356 m of elevation gain. Runners receive a unique metal finisher’s medal, and top finishers are awarded prizes in age-group and overall categories. The race is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it, and registration allows for on-site changes. Places are limited to a maximum of 200 participants.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with 205 m of elevation gain
14 km distance with 356 m of elevation gain
Unique 60 × 60 mm metal finisher’s medal
additional: On-site registration is also available for an increased fee. The distance can still be changed before the start, but only participants who do not switch distances during the race will be included in the results. There is no time limit. When registering, participants must provide their year of birth, chosen distance, and, if they have one, the number of a race bib brought from home. Participants without a race bib will receive a paper bib. Competitors’ names will appear in the start and results lists, and photos and videos taken during the event may be used on the website. Two distances, elevation gain, prizes, age-group categories, unique metal finisher’s medals, online and on-site registration, limited capacity (200 participants).

name: FUTABUDA
description: FUTABUDA is a running race held in the Danube Bend, starting at 10:00 a.m. on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at the Kisoroszi Ferry Port in Dunabogdány. The race offers two distances, 6.1 km and 14 km, with significant elevation changes that challenge runners. Participants who finish receive a unique metal finisher’s medal, and the top finishers receive awards. The race is part of the Ötpróba series, but is an independent event. Registration is available online or by email, and on-site registration is also possible for a higher fee.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with +/- 205 m elevation change
14 km distance with +/- 356 m elevation change
Unique 60 x 60 mm metal finisher’s medal for those who finish
additional: When registering, participants must provide their name, year of birth, chosen distance, and any preferred bib number. The chosen distance can still be changed before the start, but only runners who do not change distance during the race will be included in the results. There is no time limit. The race is a non-profit, self-funded event, with a limit of 200 participants. Awards will go to those who break the men’s and women’s course records, the overall 1st–3rd-place finishers, and the 1st–3rd-place finishers in each age group. On-site registration is available for a higher fee. Bibs can be collected at the venue, or after 9:30 a.m. in the case of advance bank transfer. Participants can look forward to medals, prizes, and awards in various categories. Registration is available online and on-site, offering a varied experience depending on weather conditions.

name: Běh za Sliveneckou saní
description: Běh za Sliveneckou saní is an uphill race in Prague 5-Velká Chuchle, covering 2.54 km with 130 meters of elevation gain. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. It is suitable for anyone who wants to test their strength and endurance on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Course length: 2.54 km
Elevation gain: 130 m
Uphill race in Prague 5-Velká Chuchle
additional: The race takes place as part of a series of hill races, with starts in three waves and results published by category. The event is suitable for runners of all levels who want to tackle a hilly course in pleasant surroundings.

name: 402. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Little Monaco Race is a traditional running event organized by the KRB Chrudim club, held in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race gives athletes the opportunity to compete over various distances and enjoy the atmosphere of the running community. Part of a long-standing tradition, the event attracts runners of all ages. The organizers emphasize quality event management and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A traditional running race in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany
Various distances suitable for a wide range of runners
Part of the long-standing running tradition of the KRB Chrudim club
additional: The race takes place in July 2026; exact courses and registration information are not specified.

name: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák
description: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák is part of the KOPEC series, which features hill races in Prague and the surrounding area. This traditional race gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging hilly courses in the scenic surroundings of Kazín. The KOPEC series is known for its community atmosphere and support for runners in all categories, who are automatically included in the overall standings. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and the challenges of hilly terrain.
course_highlights: A hill race in Prague and the surrounding area
Challenging hilly courses in Kazín’s natural surroundings
Part of the traditional KOPEC series, with points and a league
additional: By taking part in any KOPEC series race, competitors are automatically included in the league’s overall standings. The series rankings are determined by the total points from a maximum of 10 best races. Competitors must follow the category-specific start rules and wear their race number visibly pinned on. If health is at risk, the race director may interrupt or end the race. The event is part of a series of hill races in Prague; the exact course distances are not specified. The race has a long tradition and is popular among local runners.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon 2026
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatras, in Zakopane. The course runs along the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch, featuring two demanding vertical climbs with an elevation gain of around 1,200 m each, interspersed with challenging Tatra descents. The race is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of Podhale and Orawa, offering participants and spectators an unforgettable experience. The organizers invite everyone to take part and cheer along the course.
course_highlights: Course along the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch
Two demanding vertical climbs with an elevation gain of around 1,200 m each
Challenging Tatra descents
additional: Participants in Orava 120 and Orava 80 are provided with additional transport to the start from Siwa Polana (paid during registration: 45 zł for Orava 120, 60 zł for Orava 80). Buses depart at 17:45 and 4:00, respectively. Mandatory gear is required, and interactive course maps and elevation profiles are also available to download. The event includes various distances, such as Orava 120, Orava 80, Marathon, Tatra Trail, Mini Tatra Sky, and Tatra Skyline. Participants can look forward to a rich festival program, and registration details are available on the official website.

name: Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka
description: Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka je bežecké podujatie v lokalite Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, ktoré ponúka trate 7 km a 2 km. Pretek je vhodný pre rôzne vekové kategórie mužov a žien, vrátane detí. Organizátorom je spoločnosť Matore s.r.o. Humenné a BAMM Bratislava, pričom pretekárov čaká príjemná atmosféra a možnosť súťažiť v rôznych vekových skupinách. Štartovné je dostupné online alebo na mieste do naplnenia limitu pretekárov.
course_highlights: Trate 7 km a 2 km vhodné pre rôzne vekové kategórie
Kategórie pre mužov a ženy podľa veku od 18 rokov a viac
Preteky sa konajú v krásnom prostredí Domaše
additional: Štartovné je možné zaplatiť online alebo na mieste do naplnenia limitu pretekárov. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane detských kategórií. Organizátorom je Matore s.r.o. Humenné a BAMM Bratislava. Kontaktná osoba: Ing. Dušan Matanin, tel.: 0905 271 190. Preteky sa konajú v lete, s možnosťou registrácie vopred alebo na mieste, vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie.

name: Night city run Piešťany
description: Piešťany Night City RUN je tradičný nočný beh, ktorý sa koná na Námestí Slobody v Piešťanoch. Pretekári majú možnosť zúčastniť sa na 10 km trati, ktorá vedie mestom a ponúka jedinečnú atmosféru nočného behu pod záštitou Mesta Piešťany. Podujatie je otvorené pre rôzne vekové kategórie a všetci účastníci dostanú pamätnú medailu. Počas pretekov je zabezpečená elektronická časomiera a slávnostné vyhlásenie výsledkov sa koná večer po behu.
course_highlights: Nočný beh mestom Piešťany s atmosférou pod lampami
Štart a cieľ na Námestí Slobody
Elektronická časomiera zabezpečená firmou SunBell s.r.o.
additional: Registrácia prebieha od 16:30 do 19:45 v budove Školy Fyzioterapie, Rehabilitácie a Balneológie. Parkovanie je zabezpečené v Aupaku a na Záchytnom Parkovisku na Nálepkovej ulici. Prvých 100 pretekárov má najnižšie štartovné. Po pretekoch je tombola a slávnostné vyhlásenie výsledkov o 21:45. Deti od 15 rokov môžu pretekať samostatne, mladší účastníci potrebujú súhlas zákonného zástupcu. Podujatie je určené pre všetkých bežcov, vrátane detí, ktoré môžu štartovať zadarmo. Súčasťou je aj medaila, občerstvenie a odporúčanie na použitie čelovky počas behu.

name: Extrém maratón Košice – Furča
description: Extrém maratón Košice - Furča je náročný bežecký závod organizovaný O5 Bežeckým klubom Furča Košice. Pretek sa koná v príjemnom prostredí Furče, kde si bežci môžu vychutnať výzvy trate a atmosféru tradičného maratónu. Tento závod je určený pre vytrvalostných bežcov, ktorí hľadajú extrémnejší zážitok v rámci maratónskej vzdialenosti. Organizátori zabezpečujú kvalitné podmienky a podporu pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Náročná trať v prostredí Furče
Tradičný maratón s extrémnym charakterom
Organizovaný O5 Bežeckým klubom Furča Košice
additional: Štart maratónu je o 10:00 hod. Informácie o certifikácii trate sú dostupné na stránke. Prihlásenie na Furčiansky maratón 2026 je ukončené. Trať je určená pre skúsených bežcov, registrácia je možná až do dňa pretekov, podujatie zahŕňa ultramaratón s náročným terénom a prevýšením.

name: Smilovice pomáhají - Běh pro Theu

description: Run for Thea is a charity race organized by the Smilovice Help Foundation, taking place on July 25, 2026, at the Sportcentrum Smilovice grounds. The race supports the treatment and rehabilitation of young Thea, who is facing serious health complications. Participants can choose from several routes of different lengths and age categories, whether they want to race or simply take a walk. The event is open to everyone who wants to support a good cause and enjoy being active in a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: The routes run along paved and compacted paths and are also suitable for strollers and wheelchair users (barrier-free course).
Available routes: 600 m children’s race (ages 0–5 and 6–10), 2 km junior race, 4 km hobby race, and 12 km main race.
The start and finish are at the Sportcentrum Smilovice grounds, where parking is available.
additional: Registration and bib-number collection take place from 8:00. Starts are staggered by category from 9:30 to 11:11. Proceeds from the entry fees go entirely toward supporting Thea’s treatment and rehabilitation. Raffle tickets are available for purchase. Routes are marked in different colors according to distance (green for 4 km, red for 12 km). running, charity event, fundraisers, charity ball, support for Thea and Klárka

name: Běh na Lysou horu
location: restaurace Zlatník, Krásná-Nižní Mohelnice, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Lysá hora is a traditional race held every year on the last Saturday in July in Krásná - Nižní Mohelnice. This 41st edition welcomes runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, who aim to conquer Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains. The race starts near the Zlatník restaurant at the crossroads to Lysá hora, where registration and the awards ceremony also take place. The course follows an asphalt road along a service road managed by Lesy ČR all the way to the summit of Lysá hora.
course_highlights: Start near the Zlatník restaurant at the crossroads to Lysá hora
The entire course follows an asphalt road along a service road managed by Lesy ČR
Finish at the summit of Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: The race is open to runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, takes place in the Beskydy Mountains, and is part of regional and national running competitions.

description: Borovská desítka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque village of Havlíčkova Borová in the Vysočina Region. The race offers a 10 km course with moderate elevation gain, running mostly through forests and along paved roads. The trees provide pleasant shade, even on sunny days. The start and finish are in the centre of the village, with aid stations on the course and at the finish. After the race, refreshments are provided, followed by an awards ceremony for the winners in various categories.
course_highlights: 10 km course with a total elevation gain of 139 m
The first third of the course runs along a forest path; the rest is on a paved road
Aid stations at the 5 km mark and at the finish; the course runs through forest, offering pleasant shade
additional: Registration for the main category is open from 14:30 to 16:15, and the main race starts at 17:00. Showers, changing rooms, toilets and luggage storage are available. Refreshments are provided at the finish throughout the event, including drinks, grilled food, draft beer and ice cream. Timing is provided by a chip integrated into the race bib, with a timing mat placed at the finish only. The race is part of a local running tradition; results can be viewed online, and children’s categories are also available.

name: Bieg Powstania Warszawskiego

description: The Warsaw Uprising Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw in remembrance of the Heroes of the Warsaw Uprising. The event attracts thousands of participants who take part in the 5 km and 10 km races, creating a unique, solemn atmosphere of patriotism and historical remembrance. The run uses staggered starts and takes place in the evening, further highlighting its distinctive character. The organizers also offer a virtual edition, allowing participants to take part from anywhere in the world.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Staggered evening starts: 5 km at 20:30, 10 km at 21:20
Time limits: 60 minutes for 5 km, 90 minutes for 10 km
additional: Staggered starts are divided into 3 waves, starting approximately every 6 minutes for the 5 km and every 7 minutes for the 10 km. Participants in the 10 km race are ceremonially escorted to the start line at 21:15. Participant limits: 7,500 for the 10 km and 5,000 for the 5 km. Race bibs can be collected at the Race Office at ul. Konwiktorska 6 in Warsaw from July 24–26, 2025. On race day, participants from outside Warsaw can collect their race packs between 16:00 and 18:00. Valid identification documents and a QR code are required to collect a race pack. Minors must present a statement from a parent or legal guardian. The event offers in-person and virtual participation options, with medals, T-shirts, and certificates, and aims to commemorate the Warsaw Uprising.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatras, in Witów in the Podhale region. The course follows the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch, featuring two demanding vertical-style climbs with approximately 1,200 m of elevation gain each, interspersed with difficult Tatra descents. The race is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of the Podhale and Orava regions, offering participants and spectators an unforgettable experience. The organizers invite you to take part and cheer along the course.
course_highlights: Course along the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch
Two demanding vertical-style climbs with approximately 1,200 m of elevation gain each
Difficult Tatra descents
additional: Additional transport to the start of Orava 120 and Orava 80 from the parking area at Siwa Polana (for a fee). Orava 120 starts at 19:00 on 24.07.2026; Orava 80 starts at 6:00 on 25.07.2026. Mandatory and recommended equipment is listed on the website. The festival includes several mountain races of varying distances and types. The event features different race categories, a festival atmosphere, information about registration and accompanying attractions, as well as volunteer opportunities.

name: 9 Bieg Lubliniecki
description: The 9th Lubliniec Run is an annual running event organized by Mafia Team Lubliniec, taking place on July 25, 2026. The main distance is a 10 km race, and participants can also take part in races for children and young people. The race office is located at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec. The course will be announced soon. The event has earned recognition and numerous awards in the categories of small-scale races and 10 km races.
course_highlights: 10 km course (details to be announced soon)
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec
Races for children and young people as part of the event
additional: The race office is located at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec, at 1 74th Upper Silesian Infantry Regiment Street. The course will be published soon. The event has received numerous distinctions and awards from Maratony Polskie. Cross-country, 10 km, online and on-site registration, age categories and official championships

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic walking events held in Gliwice in 2026. The events take place on Saturdays, once a month, on a 4,219.5-metre course in the municipal forest, with the start and finish by Piast Stadium. The event promotes a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle and encourages regular physical activity under the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!”
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m course in Gliwice’s municipal forest
Runs along forest tracks and gravel paths, with some asphalt sections
Refreshment point with drinks at the start/finish line after each lap
additional: The events take place in Gliwice’s municipal forest, with the start and finish by Piast Stadium. The race office opens at 9:00 on race day. Participants can take part in the e-Prowokacja if in-person events are prohibited. Runners can choose to complete 1 to 5 laps (4.2 km to over 21 km). Timing is recorded after each lap. The course is not closed to other members of the public. Participation by wheelchair users is not permitted. Events in the park, regulations, race office, email contact

name: Pogórze Ultra Trail
description: Pogórze Ultra Trail is a mountain race organized by the Pogórze Ultra Trail Association, which brings together a passion for running and exploring the natural beauty of the Strzyżów Foothills. The routes pass through scenic areas with diverse landscapes, including old deciduous forests, coniferous woods, loess ravines, and unique rock formations. Participants have the opportunity to run through historic shelter tunnels in Strzyżów and Stępina, as well as admire the Brzeżanka Range, the Kiczora Massif, Herby, and Mount Chełm. It is the region’s largest running event, attracting trail and ultramarathon enthusiasts every year.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Brzeżanka Range and the Kiczora Massif
The course runs through the shelter tunnels in Stępina and Strzyżów
Scenic areas of the Strzyżów Foothills, with forests, ravines, and rock formations
additional: In 2026, the competition will be held over 4 distances. New features are planned for the finishers’ area. The organizers are a group of running and photography enthusiasts who take care of logistics and timekeeping. The routes include unique historical and natural features of the region. The event attracts trail-running enthusiasts, offering beautiful views, support from local spectators, and professional organization.

name: GAJA-VÖLGY TRAIL
description: Gaja Valley Trail is a trail-running event organised by the Gaja Valley Association for the second time on 25 July 2026 in Fehérvárcsurgó, near Károlyi Castle. Runners and hikers can choose from three different distances. The focus is not on competition, but on the joy of exercise, a shared community experience and being close to nature. The event aims to promote running at every level, from beginners to experienced runners, in a pleasant summer woodland setting. The start and finish are at the Károlyi Castle Visitor Centre, while the sound of Gaja Stream and the quiet of the valley create a special atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: A route featuring the castle, reservoir and the babbling Gaja Stream
Scenic woodland trails in Gaja Valley
The Károlyi Castle Visitor Centre is the start and finish venue
additional: Gaja Valley Trail is not a race and has no timing, so beginner, amateur and recreational runners can all take part. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal. The event offers a friendly community atmosphere, a healthy lifestyle and an experience close to nature. Alongside trail running, the event also features hikes and cycling challenge tours. The venue is easy to reach, and the varied terrain is rich in natural features.

name: GULYATERELŐ FUTÓVERSENY
location: Tápiógyörgye Falumúzeum, Béke utca 2, Tápiógyörgye, Hungary

name: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, mem. J. Morgoša
organizer: BS TATRAN Turany, LK NÁDEJ Turany
description: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, memoriál J. Morgoša je horský bežecký pretek, ktorý sa koná v lokalitách Turany, Šútovo a Zajacová. Trať má dĺžku 3,1 km s prevýšením 680 metrov a vedie po horských cestách a chodníkoch. Pretek je súčasťou Turčianskej bežeckej ligy 2025 a je určený pre rôzne vekové kategórie mužov a žien. Organizátormi sú BS TATRAN Turany, mesto Turany a LK NÁDEJ Turany. Pretek ponúka výzvu pre bežcov, ktorí majú radi náročnejší horský terén.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 3,1 km s prevýšením 680 m
Povrch horské cesty a chodníky
Pretek v horskom prostredí Turany - Šútovo - Zajacová
additional: Kategórie: Juniori, Juniorky, Muži do 40, Muži do 50, Muži nad 50, Muži nad 60, Muži nad 70, Ženy do 35, Ženy nad 35, Ženy nad 50. Súťaž je súčasťou Turčianskej bežeckej ligy 2025. Horské terény, možnosť registrácie online alebo na mieste, kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny

name: Běh na Kozubovou
location: Dolní Lomná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Elektronické přihlášení do 24.7.2026 ráno, bez nároku na tričko

description: The Kozubová Run is a traditional mountain race held in Dolní Lomná. It follows marked hiking trails and features a challenging elevation gain. The race starts by the bakery in Dolní Lomná and runs via Polana and the saddle below Kykula to the mountain hut on Kozubová. The course is approximately 5 km long, with around 500 metres of elevation gain, challenging runners with steep climbs and beautiful mountain views. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and generous prize raffle for participants.
course_highlights: The entire course follows blue and green hiking trail markers
A challenging climb with approximately 500 metres of elevation gain
Start by the bakery in Dolní Lomná; finish at the mountain hut on Kozubová
additional: Race check-in takes place at the museum, 300 m from the start by the bakery. Runners who register in advance receive a race number bearing their name and a T-shirt. After the race, there is a generous prize raffle featuring prizes from local sponsors. All categories start together at 10:00. Prizes and cash awards are presented in each category and overall for men and women. Start at 10:00 by the bakery in Dolní Lomná; registration deadline: 21.7.2026; extensive accompanying programme; prizes for the top three in each category; accommodation available; photo gallery from previous editions.

name: XRUN - Ucieczka Św. Kingi
location: Krościenko nad Dunajcem, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: St. Kinga’s Escape is a mountain trail race held in Krościenko nad Dunajcem, combining scenic routes in the Sącz Beskids and the Pieniny Mountains. Participants can choose distances from 14 km to 40 km, with different time limits and Sunday morning starts. The 40 km route passes through Przysłop, the Przechyba Mountain Hut, Wielka Przechyba, and Pieniny National Park, finishing on a scenic path along the Dunajec River. The event is organized by the Beskid Foundation and takes place at the amphitheatre in Krościenko nad Dunajcem.
course_highlights: 40 km route with 1,800 m of elevation gain, linking the Sącz Beskids and the Pieniny Mountains
Scenic loop via the Przechyba Mountain Hut and Wielka Przechyba (1,191 m)
Scenic path along the Dunajec River at the finish
additional: The race office and start/finish are at the Centre for Culture and Promotion in Krościenko nad Dunajcem (amphitheatre). Age categories for children’s races range from 3 to 15 years. Time limits: 40 km – 9 h, 26 km – 7 h, 14 km – 5 h. Routes are marked and available on maps on the website. Organizer: Beskid Foundation. The event offers various trail distances, with routes along mountain trails and the option to register online. The start and finish are in Krościenko nad Dunajcem, and the event is part of the XRUN mountain running series.

name: Kresowe Trail #8
description: Kresowe Trail #8 is a 10 km race taking place on July 26, 2026, in Chełm. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic trail course designed for runners of varying experience levels. The organizers encourage participants to use training plans tailored to their individual levels to help them prepare optimally for the race. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform that supports runners in their development and in organizing races.
course_highlights: A 10 km trail course
Scenic areas of Chełm in the Lublin Voivodeship
A course suited to runners of varying experience levels
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels and supported by experts. The platform TreningBiegacza.pl offers the option to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. Participants can look forward to attractive trail routes, and the event is part of a series of trail races in the region. More information about dates and locations is available on the series’ homepage.

name: V Festiwal Biegowy pod Chełmcem Bieg Babinicza
location: Szczawno-Zdrój, Wałbrzych County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczawnie-Zdroju
description: The 4th Bieg Babinicza Running Festival beneath Chełmiec is a running event held in the picturesque town of Szczawno-Zdrój, at the foot of Mount Chełmiec. Participants can choose from a range of distances, from 1 km to a full marathon, making the festival appealing to runners of varying abilities. The course passes through charming scenery, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event takes place in July, when typical summer weather brings temperatures of around 25°C and sunny skies.
course_highlights: Course at the foot of Mount Chełmiec
A range of distances from 1 km to a marathon
Picturesque areas of Szczawno-Zdrój
additional: Start location: Dworzysko – at the foot of Mount Chełmiec, aleja Spacerowa 22, 58-310 Szczawno-Zdrój. Typical July weather is around 25°C, with a minimum of 15°C, mostly sunny days, and average precipitation of 75 mm. The event will take place on 26 July 2026, with on-site registration available on 25–26 July in Szczawno-Zdrój. The start and finish are located near Dworzysko.

name: MONORERDEI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
location: Makkos Park, Monorierdő, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Monorierdő Running Festival is a friendly, family-oriented running event held every year in Makkos Park in Monorierdő. Participants can choose from several distances, and the course starts and finishes in Makkos Park. A special feature of the event is a live-music refreshment station, where the band "The Little Pea" energizes the runners twice. The event aims to promote the joy of sport and exercise, and everyone is warmly welcome to join the running community.
course_highlights: The race starts and finishes in Makkos Park
Live-music refreshment station featuring the band "The Little Pea"
A choice of distances to suit runners' preferences
additional: The railway station is just 200 metres from the event centre, making the venue easy to reach by train. Participants are advised to choose a train that will get them there in time to collect their race numbers. The event is part of the Ötpróba series. Online registration is available until July 18, and other sports and leisure events are also offered in connection with the races.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon is part of Zátopek’s Golden Week, a series of running races held in Plzeň in honour of Emil Zátopek’s Olympic victories. The main marathon takes place on 27 July and also offers accompanying races, including a half marathon, marathon and half-marathon relays, and a 10.5 km road race. The start is in the afternoon in Štruncovy sady and the surrounding area, with a varied programme and categories for men, women, and young people. The race is known for its tradition, high-quality organisation, and welcoming atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Plzeň, in Štruncovy sady and the surrounding area
Options to enter the marathon, half marathon, relays, and shorter races
Categories for all age groups, including young people
additional: The start for marathon runners with an expected finish time of over 5 hours is at 13:00. Registration opens at 12:00; race check-in and bib pickup are in Plzeň at Pallova 19. The entry fee includes a race bib, chip-use fee, refreshments, a commemorative medal, and a T-shirt for marathon runners. Changing rooms and showers are available at the venue. The race offers several distances, online registration, technical and medical support, and has a capacity of approximately 1,000 participants.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červenec
description: Tempo Makers Osmička is a regular running race in Plzeň, held along the Úslava River. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and over and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The field is limited to 75 starters, making for a small-scale, relaxed event. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking nearby. After the race, the top finishers are announced and a raffle is held.
course_highlights: An 8 km course along the Úslava River
Start and finish at the same location in Pytel, Plzeň
Friendly atmosphere, with the field limited to 75 runners
additional: Registration and race-number pickup take place from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race, the top male and female runners are announced at 19:05, followed by the post-race raffle at 19:15. Parking for participants is available near the start and finish. The course is flat. Registration is available in advance or on-site. The race takes place on 28 July 2026.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (8) – červencový
description: The 5 km and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 race in Prague-Braník offers a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava, where personal records are often set. This race is part of the 16th season of regular monthly runs, giving runners the chance to compare their performances with others. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments, and awards for the top runners.
course_highlights: A pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague-Braník
Course measured by a certified measurer
Opportunity to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships in the 10 km race
additional: Registration opens at 18:00; the 10 km race starts at 19:00 and the 5 km race at 19:05. After the race, refreshments are available at Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. A post-race prize draw offers prizes such as free entry to the next race, a massage voucher, and more. The course is suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals. First-place finishers in the categories receive prizes worth 103,000 Kč. The races are part of a series of running events in Prague.

name: Bear Foot Poľana
price_range: € 1 - € 40 (podľa vlny registrácie a dostupnosti na mieste)
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 je horský beh v divokom a jedinečnom prostredí pohoria Poľana, ktoré je najvyššou a najzachovalejšou sopkou v strednej Európe. Pretek ponúka dve hlavné trate: 24 km s kumulovaným stúpaním 1300+ metrov a 10 km s 600+ metrami stúpania. Trať vedie cez turisticky atraktívne miesta ako Vodopád Bystrô, keltské hradisko Kaľamárku a vrchol Predná Poľana, pričom bežci si užijú krásu hlbokých lesov, horských bystrín a pastvín. Pretek je súčasťou ligy Slovenskej Skyrunningovej Asociácie a limitovaný na 150 pretekárov na každú trať.
course_highlights: 24 km trať s 1300+ m kumulatívnym stúpaním cez Vodopád Bystrô a keltské hradisko Kaľamárku
10 km trať s 600+ m stúpaním, štart a cieľ pri Horskom hoteli Poľana
Povrch trate tvorí kombinácia turistických chodníkov, lesných ciest a horských lúk
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je od 7:30 do 9:30, neskoršia registrácia nie je možná. Počas celej trate je povinné používať rolničku alebo zvonček. Na trati sú tri občerstvovacie stanice na 4,4 km, 10 km a 15 km. V štartovnom je zahrnuté občerstvenie počas a po skončení preteku, unikátne štartovné číslo, účastnícky balíček a časomiera. Limit pretekárov je 150 na každú trať. Pretek zahŕňa 24 km s viac ako 1300 m stúpania, limit účastníkov je 150, súčasťou Slovenskej Skyrunningovej Ligy, registrácia je obmedzená, pretek sa koná 1. augusta 2026.

name: Porubska 11-ka
description: Porúbska 11-ka je bežecký pretek konaný v obci Porúbka v okrese Bardejov, ktorý sa vyznačuje mierne zvlneným, pahorkatinným až rovinatým terénom v nadmorskej výške 196 m. Trať vedie cez oblasť Karpatskej sústavy, ktorá ponúka kombináciu rovín a kopcov, ideálnu pre bežcov hľadajúcich príjemný a prírodný beh. Pretek je organizovaný obcou Porúbka a je súčasťou miestnych športových aktivít s tradíciou a komunitným duchom. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje aktívny životný štýl v regióne.
course_highlights: Mierne zvlnený, pahorkatinný až rovinatý povrch
Nadmorská výška 196 m
Trasa vedie cez oblasť Karpatskej sústavy
additional: Pretek sa koná 1. augusta 2026; registrácia je možná cez Google Forms; trate vedú prírodou v okolí Porúbky; podujatie podporuje miestna komunita a športové nadšenie.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia je OCR pretek, ktorý preverí tvoju silu, vytrvalosť a odhodlanie v autentickom prírodnom prostredí Slovenska. Trať vedie cez lúky, lesy, potoky a kopce s rôznymi technickými úsekmi a prekážkami ako steny, plazenie, ťahanie, balans a nosenie bremien. Pretek je otvorený pre mužov aj ženy, začiatočníkov aj skúsených športovcov, s časovým limitom 3 hodiny. Každý účastník získa oficiálne tričko, medailu, štartovací balíček a elektronické meranie času. Island Gladiator nie je len súťaž, ale výzva prekonať samého seba a stať sa silnejším gladiátorom.
course_highlights: Trať vedie cez lúky, lesy, potoky a kopce
Technické úseky s prekážkami ako steny, plazenie, ťahanie, balans a nosenie bremien
Časový limit 3 hodiny na dokončenie trate
additional: Každý účastník dostane oficiálne tričko, unikátnu medailu, elektronické meranie času, štartovací balíček s prekvapením od partnerov, pitný režim a občerstvenie v cieli alebo na trati. Neúspešné zvládnutie prekážky znamená trest 20 burpees alebo trestný okruh. Pomoc zvonka je povolená len so súhlasom organizátorov. Pretek začína o 09:00 v časových vlnách, registrácia je možná cez ich webovú stránku, k dispozícii sú aj skoré zľavy.

name: Krkonošská 50
location: Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonošský národní park, Czech Republic
description: Krkonošská 50 is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque setting of Krkonoše National Park, starting in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The field is limited to 300 runners, and the race is divided into several age categories for both men and women. The organizers emphasize environmental responsibility and safety, including a requirement to carry a mobile phone and a ban on littering outside refreshment stations.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,784 m of elevation gain
The route follows marked paths in Krkonoše National Park
Refreshment stations at 13, 18, 27, 33 and 39 km, and at the finish
additional: The field is limited to 300 runners. Start and finish at the Svatý Petr complex in Špindlerův Mlýn. Parking at the central car park in Špindlerův Mlýn. Runners may switch from the long course to the short course after notifying the checkpoint at Svatý Petr – Hotel Horal. The route is marked with black arrows on a yellow background only at junctions and turns. A mobile phone is mandatory equipment for all runners. Trail race on marked paths, online registration, limited to 300 participants, categories for men and women, and the possibility of route changes.

name: Běhej lesy Bílá
location: Bílá, Beskydy, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Bílá is a mountain trail race held in the beautiful Beskydy Protected Landscape Area. The race offers several routes, including short and long options, with the long ČSOB 20 km route included in the international UTMB Index. Runners can take the cable car to the summit and look forward to special speed sections, the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add extra competitive challenges and rewards. The race is suitable for all mountain trail running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of the Beskydy Mountains while competing on well-marked routes.
course_highlights: Routes run through the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area, with respect for nature and a ban on leaving marked trails
Conti Speed Section – a timed 200-metre speed section on the Nova 11 km and ČSOB 20 km routes
Generali Investments Finish – an extended 500 m finishing straight with a timed section and performance analysis
additional: The race is part of the UTMB Index Races, with international ranking points. A cable car to the summit of the Bílá ski resort is available. At the finish, there is an extended 500 m straight with the timed Generali Investments Finish section, where the fastest men and women are announced and receive a Craft technical running shirt. Trail routes of varying lengths, a cable-car ride to the summit, speed sections, a charity race, respect for the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area, and GPX routes available for download.

name: Zlatá stezka
location: Stožec, Šumava, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Golden Trail is a historic international hiking route connecting Bohemia with the Danube region, passing through the beautiful landscapes of the Šumava and Bavarian Forests. The 631 km route offers a unique experience by linking up with Germany’s Golden Trail and passing through several national parks and nature reserves. Hikers can discover historic towns, castles, observation towers and cultural landmarks along the trail, which is equipped with information boards and rest areas. The Golden Trail is ideal for hiking and exploring the natural and historical attractions of the South Bohemian and Plzeň regions.
course_highlights: The route passes through Šumava National Park and the Bavarian Forest, the largest forested areas in Central Europe
The historic towns of Prachatice, Vimperk and Kašperské Hory, with cultural landmarks and museums
A cross-border connection with Germany’s Golden Trail, with 13 border-crossing points
additional: The route is marked with the Golden Trail logo and equipped with information boards and rest areas. It offers various stages of differing difficulty and length. Cultural and natural attractions near the route include the Volary Museum, Libín Lookout Tower, and historic landmarks such as Hus Castle and Vimperk Castle. The route offers different distances and difficulty levels, including an ultra challenge and sports challenges, with the option to register in advance. The event is suitable for runners, cyclists and hikers who want to explore the region actively and with respect for nature.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - srpen
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race also includes an 800-metre children’s course. Every participant can enjoy a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration from 8:15 to 8:55 and the start at 9:00.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop, just under two laps long (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to 12 years old. Every runner is timed, and the top three in each category receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is 3.2 km long with an asphalt surface; the children’s course is 800 m. The run is for all age groups, including children up to 12 years old. It takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration from 8:15 to 8:55 and the starting gun at 9:00.

name: Běh na Kamenný stůl
location: Rataje nad Sázavou, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to the Stone Table is a traditional running race held in Rataje nad Sázavou, celebrating its 10th anniversary this year. The race offers a challenging and beautiful course from the castle courtyard to the Stone Table landmark, with varied surfaces and hilly terrain. It is open to professional runners, amateurs, and families with children, for whom shorter routes are available. The race is part of the Run the Castles series, which brings together running events at attractive castle locations.
course_highlights: The course leads to the Stone Table landmark and includes varied surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt, and paved and unpaved forest paths
Hilly terrain, with part of the course running through the forest and along field paths
Start and finish directly in the courtyard of the castle in Rataje nad Sázavou
additional: Race bibs with a chip and name, water, a biscuit, promotional materials, and a castle admission ticket. Children receive a voucher for ice cream and adults a voucher for a sausage. Fruit, cakes, and refreshments are available at the event facilities. Parking is available at the sports field on Zámecká Street and at other nearby locations. Results are announced after participants finish each route. Registration includes a race pack, refreshments, and castle admission; races take place under normal traffic conditions.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - srpen
location: Stromovka Park, Praha 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, including children under 12, who run 1.6 km. The race is friendly and focused on the joy of running, whether you want to improve your personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in beautiful surroundings. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children one. At the finish, everyone is rewarded with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course follows the paved paths of Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children under 12 run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Královská obora–Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská brána area from 8:15 to 8:45, with online pre-registration available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age and gender; results are adjusted using an age coefficient and count toward the year-long Lívancový pohár. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables-storage facility, and toilet cubicles are available. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský ostrov on Za elektrárnou Street. The race takes place in Stromovka Park, starts at 9:07, and registration is open from 8:15 to 8:45. Online registration is available; there are categories for different age groups, parking near the bridge to Císařský ostrov, changing facilities, and toilets. The race is held regularly on the first Saturday of each month.

name: Mšecká sedmička
organizer: Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec
description: Mšecká sedmička is a traditional running race held in Mšec, in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 7 km long and follows forest and field paths, offering runners a pleasant natural setting. It starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field and is suitable for the general public. It is organized by the Municipality of Mšec and TJ Sokol Mšec, who provide a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: 7 km course
Forest and field paths
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field
additional: The race is organized by the Municipality of Mšec and TJ Sokol Mšec. It is a mixed-type race on forest and field paths. It starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field. The course includes forest and field paths; registration requirements are not specified.

name: Libeř - Radlík
description: Libeř - Radlík is a 2.47 km uphill race with 170 m of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series. The route is not entirely uphill: it includes several flat sections and one downhill, adding interest and variety to the race. The atmosphere is friendly, and the entry fee is symbolic, with generous prizes for the winners from Botanicus. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain near Prague.
course_highlights: 2.47 km route with 170 m of elevation gain
The route includes flat sections and one downhill
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series
additional: The entry fee is symbolic, and the winners receive generous prizes from Botanicus. The route follows wide, partly gravel roads, which some runners mention in comments as a drawback compared with forest trails. The race has a friendly atmosphere despite somewhat punk-rock conditions. The route is not entirely uphill, with a few flat sections and one downhill; it follows wide, partly gravel roads; part of the Běhy do kopců series.

name: Trail Running Cup - Krkonošská padesátka
description: The Krkonoše 50 is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Špindlerův Mlýn in the Krkonoše Mountains. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The start is at the Svatý Petr resort, and participants can use the central car park in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race is limited to 300 starters. Overall male and female winners are announced, along with winners in ten age categories for both men and women.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,784 m of elevation gain
The route follows marked paths and mountain trails in the Krkonoše Mountains
Checkpoints at 13, 18, 27, 33 and 39 km, and at the finish
additional: The race starts at the Svatý Petr resort in Špindlerův Mlýn. Parking is available at the central car park in Špindlerův Mlýn. A mobile phone is mandatory for all starters and must be working and fully charged. Littering outside aid stations is strictly prohibited. Switching from the long route to the shorter one is possible after notifying the checkpoint at Svatý Petr – Hotel Horal. The route is marked with black arrows on a yellow background only at junctions and turns. The participant limit is 300 runners. The race is open to men and women, registration is online, and race day is 1 August 2026.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź edycja letnia
price_range: w formularzu zgłoszeniowym na edycje letnie
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the aesthetic appeal of the locations. The organizers aim to popularize running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and join a close-knit running community.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The aesthetic appeal of the proposed locations
Organized since 2014, with an emphasis on popularizing running
additional: Registration for the main distance and children’s races in the Summer Edition has closed. The organizers run a newsletter to share updates. Trzymsie.pl is a partner of the autumn Botaniczna Piątka series. Scenic routes, cross-country races, locations in Łódź

name: IX Rudzki Półmaraton Industrialny
organizer: RUDA Śląska i MOSiR Ruda Śląska
description: The 9th Ruda Industrial Half Marathon will take place on August 1 at 9:00 p.m. in Ruda Śląska. The 10.5 km course runs through the city center, showcasing the region’s industrial character and post-industrial landmarks such as Chebzie railway station, the Mikołaj Shaft, the Kaufhaus estate, and the blast furnace at Pokój Steelworks. In addition to the half marathon, an accompanying race of approximately 10 km is organized for people who do not feel able to run the full distance. The start and finish are at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, which also houses the race office and organizational facilities.
course_highlights: A 10.5 km loop through the city center
Passes post-industrial landmarks: Chebzie railway station, the Mikołaj Shaft, and the Kaufhaus estate
Passes the only blast furnace in Silesia, at Pokój Steelworks
additional: The start and finish are at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, which also houses the race office and facilities. An accompanying race of approximately 10 km is available for those not ready to run a half marathon. Registration takes place on the DO:ST:AR:TU platform. The course passes post-industrial landmarks; the start and finish are at the athletics stadium; registration is on the DO:ST:AR:TU platform; accompanying events include a 10 km race and Nordic walking; the half marathon is certified by the PZLA.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: The 11th Czastary Five is an annual road race held in the Czastary municipality, attracting runners from various regions. The event combines sport and recreation and follows a 5-kilometer route through the municipality’s picturesque areas. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and support for participants, promoting an active lifestyle and integration within the local community.
course_highlights: 5 km route
Road race through the picturesque areas of the Czastary municipality
Sport and recreation event
additional: Registration for the race opens on May 5, 2026; route details have not been provided in detail

name: Bieg z okazji 82. Rocznicy Wybuchu Powstania Warszawskiego
II Wielgomłyński Dycha
location: Wielgomłyny, Radomsko County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Półmaraton Cross Laskowa
location: Laskowa, Limanowa County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: CSERNYE TRAIL
description: Csernye Trail is a trail running race that will be held for the sixth time in Bakonycsernye in 2026. Starting from the area beside the sports field, runners can choose from various distances that pass through varied terrain, forests and hills. The organizers promise excellent event management and an enjoyable running experience, while participants can admire the natural beauty of the Bakony. The race is family-friendly and recommended for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Trail running on varied forest and grassy routes
Beautiful views of Bakonycsernye and the surrounding area
Various distances, including a half marathon on strictly off-road terrain
additional: Toilets, washbasins and showers are available at the race center. Parking is available on the grassy area beside the football field. A technical T-shirt or singlet can also be ordered at registration for a fixed price of 4600 HUF. Places are limited: a total of 300 runners can enter the three longer distances, with a separate limit of 100 for the Fun Run. Registration for the race runs from March 12 to July 30, 2026. The race starts at 09:00 on August 1, 2026. Race packs can be collected at the venue or at the Cultural Center between 07:00 and 08:30. Detailed routes and schedules are available on the official website.

name: ORFŰI TÓ – SHOW FUTÁS
location: Orfűi tó és strand nagyparkoló, Orfű, Baranya, Hungary
description: The Orfű Lake Show Run is a traditional running race organized by the Melitta Recreation Sports Association, held around the large car park by Lake Orfű and the beach. During the race, participants must run once or twice around Lake Pécs on public roads, clockwise, not on the promenade. The event is family-friendly, and everyone takes part at their own risk. Both professionals and amateurs are welcome. The event is held with the support of Barta Textilház and offers valuable prizes to runners, not only based on their finishing times.
course_highlights: 6.2 km lap around Lake Pécs on public roads
12.4 km distance, running twice around Lake Pécs
The race takes place on public roads, not on the promenade
additional: Timing and an awards ceremony are provided only for the running races, and the top finishers receive trophies. Other prizes are awarded by drawing, giving every participant an equal chance. The event also offers family activities, and children can enjoy well-equipped playgrounds at the venue. Participants run at their own risk. The venue is around the large car park by Lake Orfű and the beach. The event takes place on August 3, 2024.

name: TATAI MINIMARATON ÉS FÉLMARATON - Tata, Váralja út 13,5-21km. eredmények
Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 8. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamom v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Pretek je na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km) s kategóriami pre deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:30 a štart je o 10:00. Súťaž je súčasťou série pretekov, kde bežci zbierajú body do putovného pohára podľa výkonov a účasti v jednotlivých kolách.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 2 míle (3,218 km)
Prezentácia a štart pri volejbalovom ihrisku v areáli Kuchajda
Kategórie pre deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30. Súťaž o Putovný pohár Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, kde sa body prideľujú podľa výkonov a účasti. Pri rovnosti bodov rozhoduje najlepší čas a potom veľkosť topánky. Deti majú samostatnú kategóriu s kratšou traťou cca 200 m. Preteky sa konajú na verejnej ceste v Kuchajde, registrácia je možná aj na mieste, štart je naplánovaný na 10:00. Súčasťou je aj kategória pre deti s kratšími vzdialenosťami.

name: Malý Kavečianský maratón
organizer: TJ Mladosť Kavečany a MÚ MČ Košice - Kavečany
price_range: 21 km: 15,- € online, 20,- € na mieste; 7 km: 12,- € online, 17,- € na mieste; zadarmo pre ženy nad 60 rokov a mužov nad 70 rokov
description: Malý Kavečianský maratón je bežecké podujatie v Kavečanoch pri Košiciach, ktoré ponúka trate 21 km a 7 km, ako aj detské behy. Pretek sa štartuje na futbalovom štadióne a je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií od detí až po veteránov. Organizátorom je TJ Mladosť Kavečany spolu s Mestskou časťou Košice - Kavečany. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov rôznych vekových kategórií a výkonnostných úrovní, pričom štartovné je dostupné za priaznivé ceny s možnosťou online registrácie.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ na futbalovom štadióne v Kavečanoch
Trate 21 km a 7 km vhodné pre rôzne vekové kategórie
Detské behy so štartom o 9:10 hod.
additional: Ženy nad 60 rokov a muži nad 70 rokov majú štartovné zdarma. Kategórie zahŕňajú detské, žiacke, dorastenecké, absolútne a vekové skupiny mužov a žien. Detské behy štartujú o 9:10 hod. Trať zahŕňa mestské ulice a futbalový štadión; registrácia online do 1.8.2025; štart o 9:00 pre všetky kategórie

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - srpen
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The event focuses on the joy of running and personal achievement, with everyone competing primarily against themselves. It is usually held in Smetana Gardens by the fountain, except for the June and August races, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. The event also includes a cup competition, where results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.2 km) course; 600 m children’s race
The course usually runs through Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, by the fountain
The June and August races take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street
additional: Registration is from 9:30 to 10:00. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. Results are adjusted using an age coefficient, and points are accumulated in the cup competition for the period September 2025–August 2026. The event includes a 3.2 km asphalt course and a 600 m children’s race; registration is from 9:30 to 10:00; the event takes place on 2 August 2026.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Moldava
location: Moldava, Krušné hory, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in different locations, including Moldava, with routes for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers. Each race offers a main running race of 6 to 9 km, an adventure route of 20 to 30 km navigated by map, a 5 to 8 km walk with checkpoints to find, and children’s races from 200 to 1600 metres. The series is suitable for the general public who want to explore the beauty of the Ore Mountains actively and through sport.
course_highlights: Main race: 6–9 km through the natural landscapes of the Ore Mountains
Adventure route: 20–30 km, navigated by map with orienteering elements
Children’s races and a 5–8 km walk with checkpoints to find
additional: The series includes 6 races in different locations across the Ore Mountains. The routes are suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers. Children’s races range from 200 to 1600 metres. The adventure routes are navigated by map, and the walking route includes finding checkpoints. The races are part of a series with an overall ranking and winners announced at the final race in Stříbrná; the event also includes races with dogs and children’s categories.

name: XI Gorce Ultra-Trail
location: Ochotnica Dolna, Nowy Targ County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Gorce Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the picturesque area of Ochotnica Dolna. Participants can choose from five varied courses ranging from 5 to 102 km, suited to different experience levels, from beginners to seasoned ultramarathoners. The routes pass through the beautiful Gorce Mountains, featuring challenging climbs and spectacular views. The time limit for the longest course is 20 hours, underscoring the challenge and character of the event.
course_highlights: Five courses ranging from 5 to 102 km
Routes pass through the picturesque Gorce Mountains
20-hour time limit on the longest course, GUT 102
additional: Registration is online via time-sport.pl. Discount codes may be available to podium finishers from previous editions, residents of the Ochotnica Dolna municipality, and seniors. Refunds, distance changes, and transfer of race packages are governed by the regulations. Invoices can be requested during registration or by email. The time limit for the longest course is 20 hours. The event takes place in the summer, with registration open and details available about the regulations, logistics, and courses.

name: Kresowe Trail #9
description: Kresowe Trail is a small-scale trail-running event organized by the Kresowe Maratony Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The event in Narewka offers two running distances: Szpurt (7 km) and Wertep (16.6 km), along scenic routes with course markings and an aid station. Participants can expect electronic timing, commemorative medals, and a hot post-race meal. The event emphasizes ecology and the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Szpurt course – 7 km, marked with green arrows on a yellow background
Wertep course – 16.6 km, marked with red arrows
Aid station on the Wertep course and careful course marking
additional: Online registration closes 3 days before the event. Registration is available on race day from 8:30, although the race package may be incomplete (for example, it may not include a medal). The time limit is 2 hours 15 minutes. Littering is strictly prohibited; gel and bar wrappers may be left in the aid-station area. The package includes a hot post-race meal with a vegetarian option, electronic timing, medical coverage, an aid station at the finish and on the Wertep course, points toward the series’ overall standings, and a special photography service. The event is scheduled for August 2, 2026, with previous results and archives available on the website. Participants can choose from different distances, and the event is very popular with the local community.

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic Walking event held in the picturesque Panewnickie forests in Katowice. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle and the charms of the local natural environment. The approximately 4.9 km course is marked every kilometre and can be completed up to four times, within a time limit of 3 hours. The event is open to recreational participants and athletes affiliated with sports clubs. Participants can also learn about proper conduct in the forest.
course_highlights: Approximately 4,882 m loop through the Panewnickie forests
Course marked every 1 km
The loop can be completed up to 4 times, within a 3-hour time limit
additional: The time limit for completing the course is 3 hours. The course is marked every 1 km. Participants can run or walk the loop up to 4 times. Those born in 1950 or earlier are exempt from the entry fee. Entry fees can be paid by bank transfer to the KS AZS AWF Katowice account. A package covering all starts during the year is available for purchase. The event is recreational and educational in nature and promotes proper conduct in forest areas. Online registration; 3-hour time limit; running and Nordic Walking events; Panewnickie forest setting; race preparation and training plans.

name: XXXIV Bieg Jezior
location: Stary Uścimów, Lubartów County, Lublin Voivodeship, Poland

name: KERESZTÚRI ÖNTÚLSZÁRNYALÁS FESZTIVÁL
description: The Keresztúri Self-Transcendence Running Festival is a friendly, family-oriented race that combines being close to nature with the spirit of self-transcendence. The race takes place in Keresztúri Forest, near Budapest, and offers challenges over several distances, including 5.2 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, 31.6 km and marathon, as well as the special Yes, I can! event. The event is organised by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has supported running enthusiasts since 1977. The aim is for every participant to experience camaraderie in sport and the joy of going beyond their limits.
course_highlights: A nature-filled running route in Keresztúri Forest
A forest nature trail and running loop, with short sections on roads
The Yes, I can! event consists of hourly starts, one lap at a time, with each lap covering 5,274 m
additional: On-site registration is available on race day between 6:30 and 7:30. The entry fee does not include a T-shirt, but a commemorative technical T-shirt can be ordered in advance. The Yes, I can! event consists of 6 laps, with one lap starting every hour; the lap starting at 13:00 is devoted to self-transcendence. Participants support one another in completing the race; starting late results in disqualification. Several distances are available, and on-site registration is also possible. Detailed information about fees and T-shirts is available on the organiser’s website.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Karlštejn
location: Autokemp Karlštejn, Karlštejn, Středočeský, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)
