description: The Berounka running series in Karlštejn is a community trail race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Autokemp Karlštejn. The route crosses fields, meadows and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry, continues along the red-marked St. James’ Way to Karlštejn Castle, and finishes with a downhill run to the finish line. The race offers a friendly atmosphere, a marked route, refreshments and a place to store belongings. Each participant receives a race number, and the top finishers in each category receive diplomas and medals.
course_highlights: The route crosses fields, meadows and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry
It continues along the red-marked St. James’ Way to Karlštejn Castle
The route finishes with a downhill run towards the finish line
additional: The route is marked with red-and-white ribbons and red arrows on the ground. Refreshments and a place to store belongings are available on site. The top three finishers in each category receive diplomas and medals. The recommended latest arrival time is 17:45. Race number, refreshments, storage for belongings, start by 17:45, marked route, online or on-site registration available.

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
location: Kladno-Rozdělov, Kladno, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Rozdělov Quarter Marathon is a running race organized by Maratón klub Kladno and held in Kladno-Rozdělov. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing races in the region. The race offers runners of all levels the opportunity to test themselves on a quarter-marathon course in the pleasant surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The event is part of the club’s running calendar and supports the running community around Kladno.
course_highlights: A quarter-marathon course in Kladno-Rozdělov
Organized by Maratón klub Kladno, which focuses on endurance running
The race is part of the regional running calendar
additional: The race takes place on a Wednesday or Thursday in the first half of August, starting at 18:00. The route follows forest trails. The event has an intimate atmosphere, and participant numbers are growing.

name: Krčský lomcovák
description: Krčský lomcovák is a traditional running race held in Krčský les in Prague 4. The race offers a 5 km route starting near the Velký altán, suitable for both men and women, with different start times. The event is part of a sports and fun afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and families with children can try various activities such as slacklining, sack races and disc golf. The race is organized by Krčák žije magazine, which covers activities and news in and around Krčský les.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through Krčský les
Start near the Velký altán
Mostly forest terrain with natural features
additional: Men start at 18:30, and women start half an hour earlier. The start is near the Velký altán. The event is part of a sports and fun afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, with accompanying activities for families with children. The race is open to all age groups, offers various running disciplines and is part of a community sports day in Prague 4.

name: Východniarska

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatok za štart jedného účastníka je 70 EUR

description: Východniarska je horský ultra trail a diaľkový pochod pre jednotlivcov, ktorý nadväzuje na populárnu Východniarsku stovku. Trasa vedie východnou časťou Slovenského rudohoria, prevažne cez Volovské vrchy, a ponúka náročný 85 km dlhý beh s prevýšením +4200 m. Štart je v Kluknave a cieľ v Kysaku, s časovým limitom 22 hodín. Podujatie je otvorené pre verejnosť s minimálnym vekom 18 rokov a vyžaduje riadnu registráciu a úhradu štartovného poplatku.
course_highlights: 85 km dlhá trasa s +4200 m stúpania
Prechod Volovskými vrchmi v Slovenskom rudohorí
Kontrolné a občerstvovacie stanice na trase s časovými limitmi
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je vo štvrtok v Košiciach od 16:00 do 20:00 a v piatok 7. augusta 2026 od 18:00 do 23:00 v Kaštieli hotela Biela dáma Čierny rytier. Pred štartom je možnosť prespať v telocvični pri Základnej škole v Kluknave, vlastnú karimatku a spacák si treba priniesť. Na občerstvovaciu stanicu Vyšný Klátov (56 km) je možné poslať dropbag, ktorý sa odovzdáva ráno pred štartom do 8:30 v telocvični ZŠ v Kluknave. Doprava do Kluknavy je možná vlakom a autobusom, odporúča sa prísť vlakom do Margecian a odtiaľ autobusom do Kluknavy. Trať je dlhá 85 km s časovým limitom 22 hodín, povinnou výbavou vrátane izotermickej fólie, GPS, vlastného pohára a ďalších, možnosť poslať dropbagy na 56 km, štart v Kluknave a cieľ v Kysaku. Súčasťou podujatia je aj možnosť prespať v telocvični a doprava vlakom alebo autobusom do Kluknavy.

name: Hámorská dvadsiatka
location: Obecný úrad Remetské Hámre, Remetské Hámre, Slovakia
description: Hámorská dvadsiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný obcou Remetské Hámre. Napriek zrušeniu posledných dvoch ročníkov kvôli pandémii Covid-19 sa organizátori tešia na obnovenie podujatia a hojnú účasť bežcov. Pretek sa koná v krásnom prírodnom prostredí Vihorlatských vrchov, ktoré ponúka atraktívne trasy pre športových nadšencov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez prírodné prostredie Vihorlatských vrchov
Krásne výhľady a turistické zaujímavosti v okolí
Organizované obcou Remetské Hámre s dlhoročnou tradíciou

name: Rajecký maratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: Rajecký maratón je tradičný bežecký závod organizovaný Maratón klubom Rajec, ktorý sa koná v malebnom prostredí Rajca a jeho okolia. Pretekári môžu očakávať náročnú trať s prevýšením a krásnymi prírodnými scenériami, ktoré preveria ich vytrvalosť a kondíciu. Atmosféra podujatia je rodinná a priateľská, čo potvrdzujú aj sprievodné akcie a pohostinnosť v cieli. Okrem maratónu sa organizujú aj polmaratón, štafeta, kros duatlon a populárny Rajecký Borošovec, ktorý je krosovou klasikou s prevýšením viac ako 200 metrov.
course_highlights: Trať s prevýšením viac ako 200 metrov
Krosová klasika Rajecký Borošovec s dĺžkou 14,1 km
Prírodné scenérie Rajca a okolia
additional: Rajecký Borošovec je súčasťou podujatí, ktoré otvárajú bežeckú sezónu v Rajeckej doline. Po pretekoch je pre účastníkov pripravený guľáš a domáce koláče. Trať Rajeckého Borošovca je suchá a rýchla, s možnými prekážkami ako spadnuté stromy. Podujatie má rodinnú atmosféru a priláka aj mladších bežcov a juniorov.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
description: Rajecký In-line polmaratón je súťažný inline korčuliarsky pretek, ktorý sa koná v Rajci na Námestí SNP. Trať vedie z Rajca do obce Čičmany a späť, pričom cieľ je na obrátke maratónu v Čičmanoch. Pretekári sú povinní mať počas celej trate prilbu a zapožičané čipy, ktoré sa vracajú v cieli. Organizátor zabezpečuje občerstvenie, šatne a sprchy, ako aj bezplatnú dopravu späť do Rajca pre inline pretekárov. Záverečná cieľová rovinka je vyhradená pre bežcov, preto je potrebné rešpektovať pravidlá organizátora.
course_highlights: Trať vedie z Rajca do Čičman a späť
Preteká sa pravým jazdným pruhom
Záverečná cieľová rovinka na Námestí v Rajci je vyhradená pre bežcov
additional: Pretekári musia mať počas pretekov prilbu a pripnuté štartové číslo na pravom stehne. Zapožičané čipy sa musia vrátiť v cieli. Občerstvenie (bagety) je zabezpečené na námestí v Rajci na základe štartového čísla. Šatne a sprchy sú v telocvični na Lipovej ulici. Mikrobus pre odvoz osobných vecí bude pristavený od 8:00 do 8:30 v priestore štartu. Inline pretekári musia použiť bezplatný autobus späť z Čičman do Rajca a nesmú vstupovať do priestoru štartu a cieľa určeného pre bežcov, inak hrozí diskvalifikácia. Pretek má stanovený limit 120 účastníkov, registrácia závisí od dátumu platby, a zahŕňa rôzne poplatky podľa termínu registrácie.

name: Rajecká štafeta
description: Rajecká štafeta je bežecké podujatie organizované Maratón klubom Rajec, ktoré sa koná na Námestí SNP v Rajci. Ide o štafetový beh, ktorý je súčasťou Rajeckého maratónu a ponúka športovcom možnosť súťažiť v tímoch. Organizátor zabezpečuje štartové čísla, meranie času a kompletnú starostlivosť o účastníkov počas pretekov. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov rôznych úrovní a podporuje komunitného ducha a športové nadšenie v regióne.
course_highlights: Štafetové kategórie pre mužov, ženy a zmiešané tímy
Uskutoční sa na Námestí SNP v Rajci, v malebnom prostredí okolia Žiliny
Registrácia je spoplatnená, s cenami od 90 do 120 eur v závislosti od termínu prihlásenia
additional: Organizátor spracúva osobné údaje účastníkov v súlade s GDPR a zákonom o ochrane osobných údajov. Registrácia prebieha online cez webovú stránku organizátora. Účastníci dostávajú štartové čísla pri prezentácii a ich výsledky sú zverejňované na oficiálnych stránkach a športových portáloch. relay race, registration fees increase closer to the event date, terrain details not specified

name: Rajecký detský beh
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: Rajecký detský beh je bežecké podujatie organizované Maratón klubom Rajec, ktoré sa koná na Námestí SNP v Rajci. Zameriava sa na detských a neplnoletých pretekárov, pričom kladie dôraz na bezpečnosť a zodpovednosť, vyžadujúc podpis zákonného zástupcu pre účasť. Podujatie je súčasťou širšieho bežeckého programu v Rajci a ponúka príležitosť pre mladých bežcov zažiť atmosféru pretekov v príjemnom prostredí mesta.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú na Námestí SNP v Rajci
Určené pre deti a neplnoletých pretekárov
Bezpečnosť zabezpečená podpisom zákonného zástupcu
additional: Pre účasť detí a neplnoletých je potrebné priniesť podpísané vyhlásenie zákonného zástupcu, bez ktorého nebude účasť povolená.

name: Měřínský kros
description: Měřín Cross-Country is a traditional cross-country race through the beautiful Vysočina countryside. It features a 13 km main race over Dědkovská hora and a relaxed 8 km course suitable for recreational runners. Children aged 5 to 12 can take part in the Junior Cross obstacle race, with a giant bouncy castle also available. The race is timed using chip timing, and an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place after the run. The start and finish are at the sports field behind the elementary school in Měřín, where parking, a baggage drop, toilets, changing rooms and showers are available.
course_highlights: The 13 km main course runs mostly on dirt and forest roads and trails (about 70%), with the remainder on paved sections in the village
The route crosses Dědkovská hora, with new views thanks to bark beetle damage
A small refreshment station along the route
additional: Junior Cross is a free obstacle race for children aged 5–12, with 700 m and 1,400 m courses. A giant bouncy castle is available after the race. Parking is available at Měřín Elementary School. On-site registration closes 20 minutes before the start. The entry fee includes a sausage and a drink. The race is limited to 100 runners. Participants race at their own risk; no insurance is provided. An evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place after the run. The course is mostly on dirt and forest roads, with a marked route; the race is limited to 100 runners. Children’s obstacle races are free, and an evening volleyball tournament takes place after the race.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Pardubice
description: Barvám Neutečeš is a colourful run in Pardubice offering two routes: 5 km and 1.5 km. The event isn’t about speed, but about joy, friendship and fun as participants make their way through colour zones where they are showered with colour. The run is suitable for all ages and is ideal for families, friends and individuals looking for a day full of colour, music and a great atmosphere. The event also includes a music programme and various fun activities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colour zones
1.5 km route with 3 colour zones and an interactive sports zone
Colour zones, music and fun activities along the route
additional: The event runs from 9:00 to 16:00 in Park Na Špici, Pardubice. The music programme features Pavel Calta and others. The event is charitable, and participants can contribute by purchasing a symbolic heart. There is an opportunity to enter an Instagram prize competition with prizes from partner STANLEY. The event offers BASIC and WOW race packs, and registration is available online and on site. It is suitable for team-building and charitable activities, with rules including paid entry fees and wearing a visible participant T-shirt.

name: Mořice Run
location: Mořice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Mořice Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque village of Mořice near Olomouc. The race is part of a series of running events focused on fitness and performance running, organized by the club in central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and endurance races, and Mořice Run gives runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a quality race atmosphere. The club also provides support and advice to runners who want to get started or improve their training.
course_highlights: An 8 km course on paved roads around the château in Mořice
A 1.5 km children's run as part of the event
A friendly atmosphere and facilities for competitors at the local venue
additional: The race takes place on August 8, 2026, as part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region. Start at 9:00. Registration and further details are not specified.

name: Slatinická sedmička
location: Slatinice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Slatinická sedmička is a 7 km charity run that follows mostly off-road routes around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc. The race is held in memory of Šárka Krčková and offers runners a pleasant route with a natural feel. The event is suitable for all runners who want to combine sport with supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: A 7 km route that is mostly off-road
Around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc
A charity run held in memory of Šárka Krčková
additional: The run is part of charitable activities supporting cancer care, and the event is linked to fundraising and support for local sport.

name: Vnorovská desítka
location: Vnorov, Vnorovy, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: platba přes bankovní účet, ceny nejsou explicitně uvedeny
description: Vnorovská Desítka is a popular 10 km running race held every August in the village of Vnorovy. It is part of the Moravian-Slovak Running Cup and attracts more than 200 runners from various countries, including Czech elites and African runners. The course follows a closed asphalt loop with minimal elevation gain, with both the start and finish by the elementary school. The race has a lively atmosphere thanks to the large crowds and high number of participants; nearly 700 runners take part across all categories.
course_highlights: 4 × 2.5 km course on an asphalt road with minimal elevation gain
Closed loop with traffic excluded
Start and finish by the elementary school in Vnorovy
additional: Online registration is open until 6 August; registration on race day is not possible. The main race is timed using AMB chip technology. Women and men over 70 run a shorter 2 × 2.5 km course. The main race awards ceremony will take place at the Ajax pub grounds in Lidéřovice. Race bibs for runners starting at 17:00 are entered into a running raffle with valuable prizes. 4 × 2.5 km race on a closed loop, online registration until 6 August, start at 17:00, start and finish by the elementary school, spectator atmosphere and raffle

name: Dačického 12
location: GASK Kutná Hora, Kutná Hora, Czech Republic
description: Dačického 12 is a traditional cross-country running race in Kutná Hora, now being held for the 18th time. The race offers 12 km and 6.7 km courses, as well as shorter children’s races. The route runs through the scenic Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys, passing historic landmarks such as St. Barbara’s Church and the Cathedral of the Assumption of Our Lady and St. John the Baptist in Sedlec. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an enjoyable sporting experience in the beautiful surroundings of Kutná Hora.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys
The course passes between St. Barbara’s Church and the Cathedral in Sedlec
Refreshment station near the Holy Trinity
additional: Children’s races are divided into categories by year of birth, with course lengths ranging from 300 m to 1,000 m. The start is at the Jesuit College/GASK on Barborská Street. The route includes sections along Pod Hrádkem and Na Podskalí streets, past the Šafrán guesthouse and the Great Pond. After the race, custom badges can be ordered for clubs or events. The event includes a main 12 km course, a 6 km course, children’s races in four categories, online registration, and a start and finish at GASK Kutná Hora. The event also features music and supports the Světluška charity collection.

name: niedamiRUN - Ultramaraton Sudecki
organizer: Stowarzyszenie NIEDAMIRÓW WIOSKA CUDÓW i Foxter Sport
description: NiedamiRUN is a Sudetes ultramarathon taking place on 8 August 2026 in Niedamirów, a picturesque village situated at the crossroads of three cultures. Runners can choose from four distances: 10K, 20K, 50K and 100K, which run through the Karkonosze Mountains, the Lubawka Gate and the Bóbr Valley, offering challenging elevation gains and beautiful views. The routes pass historical and natural attractions of the region, with the start and finish in Niedamirów. It is a unique opportunity to take on a Sudetes ultra surrounded by wild nature and local culture.
course_highlights: Routes run through the Karkonosze Mountains, the Lubawka Gate and the Bóbr Valley
Elevation gain of up to 3,970 m on the 100K distance
Views of Lake Bukówka and historic roadside crucifixes along the 10K route
additional: The participant limit for each distance is 100. Distance changes are possible until 4 August 2026, with an additional fee or no refund of the difference. The routes have aid stations and time limits. The start and finish are at the former WOP Border Guard post and sports field in Niedamirów. Routes can be downloaded to Garmin, Suunto, Polar and other GPS devices. Routes through the Karkonosze Mountains and the Sudetes, time limits from 3 to 18.5 hours, various distances, activities for children and local treats at the finish.

name: Bieg Zbója
description: Bieg Zbója is a mountain race held in the picturesque area of Bielsko-Biała, on trails around the summit of Klimczok. The race takes its name from the legend of the bandit Klimczok, who formed a gang that helped the poor and left traces behind in the form of a mountain hut and a cave. The course is demanding, with significant elevation gain and technical climbs that test runners’ character and endurance. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a unique atmosphere and beautiful mountain views.
course_highlights: Mountain course with over 1,530 m of elevation gain over 25 km
Legendary climbs and sections requiring great endurance
The “Hilton” aid station, with a generous buffet along the course
additional: The race package includes a limited-edition running band and a neck gaiter in a color assigned to the distance. An extended package with a T-shirt and race-number belt is available for purchase. At the finish, runners receive a cast medal, a recovery meal, and a certificate of completion showing their time and place. The “Hilton” aid station offers a generous buffet along the course. Mountain race, limited distances, race packages with T-shirts and belts, certificates, medals, meals

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny UAM, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a series of races that have promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate the aesthetics and character of cross-country routes. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań
Picturesque natural surroundings
Alternative location by Lake Rusałka, 500 m from the start
additional: Race packets can be collected by an authorised person. The organiser places particular emphasis on the aesthetic qualities of the routes and the character of cross-country races. Trzymsie.pl is a partner of the autumn series. The alternative race location is Lake Rusałka, 500 metres from the UAM Botanical Garden. The 5 km route runs through parkland; online registration; participant limit: 500; start and finish in the UAM Botanical Garden. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor activity.

name: I Jura Night Dog Run
location: Klucze, Olkusz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 10 km KOBIETA indywidualnie z pełnym pakietem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 10 km MĘŻCZYZNA indywidualnie z pełnym pakietem

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 10 km TEAM (co najmniej 1 kobieta lub 1 mężczyzna) z pełnym pakietem

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 21 km KOBIETA półmaraton indywidualnie z pełnym pakietem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 21 km MĘŻCZYZNA półmaraton indywidualnie z pełnym pakietem

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 21 km półmaraton TEAM (co najmniej 1 kobieta lub 1 mężczyzna) z pełnym pakietem

description: The Jura Night Dog Run is a night canicross race taking place on August 8, 2026, in Klucze, Poland. The event offers two main distances: 10 km and a 21 km half marathon, with the option to compete individually or as part of a team. The event is limited to 500 participants, creating an intimate atmosphere and a comfortable racing experience. The race is scheduled to start at 8:00 p.m., highlighting the unique experience of running with a dog at night.
course_highlights: Night canicross race
10 km and 21 km (half marathon) routes
Limited to 500 participants
additional: The number of participants is limited to 500. Competitors can participate individually or as part of a team. Team participation is available, training plans are available, and the event promotes activity with dogs.

name: Złota Dycha
description: The 6th Złota Dycha is a road race held in the heart of Złotoryja, the oldest city in Poland. The event is scheduled for August 8, 2026, combining sporting excitement with the European Gold Panning Championships. The race offers two distances—5 and 10 kilometers—and participants can compete on the city’s picturesque streets. It is organized by the Złotoryja City Office and the Złotoryja Cultural Centre, with support from the local running community.
course_highlights: A road race through the picturesque streets of the oldest city in Poland
Two distances to choose from: 5 and 10 kilometers
An event held alongside the European Gold Panning Championships
additional: The participant limit is 300, split between the 5 km and 10 km distances. Starts are scheduled for Saturday morning at 9:00 and 10:00. The race is part of the European Gold Panning Championships celebrations, and participants will receive special medals and trophies. 10 km and 5 km races, Złotoryja city center, the center closed to traffic on race day, registration at the Złotoryja Cultural Centre, transfer of race packages, training sessions from the time of registration

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: The Jazz Capital Run takes place in Kecskemét at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre, offering a running experience as a sporting complement to the jazz festival. Traditionally, the event puts the joy of running and the sense of community first, and is open to all ages and types of runners. It is not only a sporting event but also strengthens the local community, while participants can enjoy exercising in beautiful surroundings and fresh air. The organisers also value charity, so the run is an opportunity to support a cause.
course_highlights: The run takes place beneath beautiful trees in a pleasant natural setting
The race is a sporting companion event to the jazz festival
The run is also a community and charity event
additional: The event is open to everyone, and community activities and charity initiatives accompany the run. Runners can enjoy exercising in pleasant natural surroundings and fresh air. Participants can choose from several distances and register online or on site. Participants receive a T-shirt bearing the event logo, as well as a snack and mineral water at the finish. Festival programmes are free for runners.

name: Beh na Kráľovu studňu
location: Motorest Javorina Lenartov, Lenartov, Bardejov, Slovakia
description: Beh na Kráľovu studňu je tradičný bežecký pretek do kopca, ktorý sa koná v malebnom prostredí obce Lenartov pri historickej Kráľovej studni, mieste stretnutia troch kráľov. Trať vedie cez krásnu prírodu a ponúka jedinečný zážitok z behu v horskom teréne s bohatou históriou a výhľadmi. Podujatie je súčasťou miestnej bežeckej ligy a priláka bežcov z celého regiónu. Organizátori vytvárajú priateľskú atmosféru a vítajú všetkých účastníkov bez ohľadu na výkonnosť.
course_highlights: Beh do kopca v horskom teréne okolo Kráľovej studne
Historické miesto stretnutia uhorského a poľského kráľa
Krásne výhľady a prírodné scenérie v okolí Lenartova
additional: Beh patrí do Východoslovenskej ligy behov do kopca. Podujatie má dlhoročnú tradíciu, v roku 2025 sa konal 14. ročník, v roku 2024 13. ročník. Atmosféra je priateľská, vítaní sú všetci bežci, vrátane najstarších účastníkov. Po behu je zabezpečené občerstvenie a kultúrny program v okolí. Trať zahŕňa asfalt, lesné a horské úseky; možnosť registrácie online alebo na mieste; súčasť Východniarskej ligy behov do kopca 2025

name: Černovírský kros
location: Černovír u Ústí nad Orlicí, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Černovír Cross is a traditional running race held in Černovír near Ústí nad Orlicí. Its routes cross hilly terrain and combine paved and unpaved forest and field paths with asphalt. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. The start and registration are at the Sokol hall in Černovír, and the main race covers a distance of up to 5 km. The atmosphere is friendly, and the event is popular with both local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with a mix of paved and unpaved forest and field paths
Mixed surfaces, including asphalt
A route of up to 5 km, suitable for children and adults
additional: On-site registration from 9:00. Children's race starts at 10:00; main race at 11:30. Entry fee: 100 Kč for adults, 20 Kč for children. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The route is up to 5 km and has varied surfaces. The event offers various distances, from 0.08 km to the main 4.85 km race, and is part of a sports series supporting running in the region.

name: Běh na Krušnou horu
description: The Run to Krušná hora is a traditional uphill race held in the village of Hudlice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race starts at the end of Dolejší Street by the forest and follows a wide forest gravel path to the Máminka lookout tower at the summit of Krušná hora. The course is 2.7 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering runners a challenging but beautiful experience in nature. The race is organised by TOBI Sport s.r.o. and is part of the Czech Running Club.
course_highlights: 2.7 km course
Run along a wide forest gravel path
Finish at the Máminka lookout tower on the summit of Krušná hora, with 190 m of elevation gain
additional: The race starts near the village of Hudlice, 9 km from Beroun, at a crossroads by the forest. It is organised by TOBI Sport s.r.o.; the contact person is Pavel Kundrát. The course is certified, and the race is part of the Czech Running Club. The event includes trail running in the forest, registration is available on the KOPEC website, and the race is suitable for runners of different levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and nature experience. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations
Organized with passion since 2014
additional: The event takes place on August 9, 2026, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents of Kielce and the surrounding area.

name: Chudy Wawrzyniec
description: Chudy Wawrzyniec is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Żywiec Beskids, offering six distances from 3 km to 100 km. The event takes place on 8–9 August 2026, starting in Rajcza and finishing in Ujsoły. The courses are technically demanding, with significant elevation gain and beautiful views, and the 80 km race is the venue for the Polish Mountain Running Championships over the Ultra Distance. The organizers provide professional race organization and aid stations along the course, as well as the option to transfer a race entry.
course_highlights: Courses with significant elevation gain: 50 km (+2,525 m), 80 km (+3,825 m), 100 km (+5,115 m)
Technically demanding mountain trails with numerous ascents and descents
Start in Rajcza, finish in Ujsoły, with routes passing through Wielka Rycerzowa, Pilsko and other peaks
additional: The time limit for the 50/80/100 km distances is 16 hours. On the 100 km course, runners must reach the checkpoint at Trzy Kopce within a maximum of 11 h 30 min to continue. Aid stations are provided along the courses (3 on the 100 km, 2 on the 80 km, 1 on the 50 km), with no disposable cups. Race entries can be transferred to another participant from 1 April to 31 July. Registration for the event opens on 11 December 2025. The race takes place in the Żywiec Beskids, with several distances available and sections involving mountain climbing. The time limit for finishing is 16 hours.

name: VII Charytatywny Bieg świętego Dominika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Bieg Świętego Dominika w Ustroniu
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious annual running event held in Gdańsk since 1994 and an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. This unique sporting event attracts both recreational and professional runners, offering races over various distances in the picturesque city centre, on a course that loops around Neptune. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration, while creating an unforgettable atmosphere with thousands of spectators cheering and a rich programme of accompanying activities. It is valued by local authorities and sponsors, underscoring its stature and importance in Poland’s running calendar.
course_highlights: A 1,412 m course in central Gdańsk, looping around Neptune
A loop along Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników and other streets
More than 25,000 spectators cheering along the course at each race
additional: The event includes four races under the slogan “Chase St. Dominic”, including a prologue open to all fair visitors, a race for people with disabilities, and classic women’s and men’s races over 5 km and 10 km. The course is a closed loop, allowing spectators to follow the competition closely. The event is accompanied by a rich programme of attractions, including partner stands, presentations, shows and concerts at St. Dominic’s Fair. A charity race over 10 km and 5 km, with entry fees donated to charitable causes, included in the USTRON GRAND PRIX.

name: XI Bieg Lucka

price_tiers.distance: Bieg rekreacyjny i Nordic Walking 5,2 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa za Biegi Dzieci wynosi 10 zł

description: The 11th Bieg Lucka is a memorial race commemorating Lucjan Chorąży, taking place on 9 August 2026 in Skawinki near Lanckorona. The event includes a main race of approximately 14 km, a recreational run and Nordic Walking over approximately 5.2 km, and shorter races for children. The main race route leads up Mount Chełm, and participants can get together for refreshments after the event. The race has a family-friendly, mountain-running character and aims to honor Lucjan, who was passionate about the mountains and running.
course_highlights: The approximately 14 km main race route leads up Mount Chełm
A recreational run and Nordic Walking over approximately 5.2 km
Children’s races on the sports field and meadows near the race office
additional: Race number collection and additional on-site registration take place on race day from 9:00 to 11:00. The children’s races start at 10:30. If there are fewer than 5 participants in an age category, groups may be combined. The children’s race routes are laid out on the sports field and meadows near the race office. Refreshments will be provided for participants after the race. Registration is available online, and the event uses RFID timing. The participant limit is 270. The routes run around Skawinki and Lanckorona, and the event is part of local sporting traditions.

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SZUFLA Running Festival is a traditional community running event organized by the Enthusiastic Team of Szigethalom Ultrarunners every second weekend in August. The 2026 event, the 20th anniversary festival, will take place in Tököl Park Forest and features a variety of distances, including an ultramarathon, relay, half marathon, shorter races, and hiking. The event has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere, with plenty of activities for children as well as runners. Its aim is to promote sport and support the local community, with particular emphasis on helping people with disabilities.
course_highlights: A 6.178 km loop course in Tököl Park Forest, with 30 m of elevation gain
A 52 km relay race for teams of 2–4 runners
Aid stations every 3 km with a generous selection of refreshments
additional: The event uses chip timing. The chip deposit is 2,000 HUF, refundable at the finish or available to donate to charity. Starts are staggered, and on-site registration opens at 7:00 on race day. Activities for children include face painting, glitter tattoos, a creative corner, and a bouncy castle. The event closes at 15:00, which is also the time limit. Aid stations are located every 3 km and offer a generous selection of refreshments. Online and on-site registration are available. Events include ultrarunning, a half marathon, and shorter distances. The festival puts community and a love of sport at its heart.

Check-in begins at 17:00 and the start is at 17:45 at Lodičky. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.

Cycling path surface
Charity run with proceeds going to help people in need

description: The 15th Diocesan Running Pilgrimage is a special running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The race follows a route from Radom to Częstochowa and combines a passion for sport with the spiritual dimension of a pilgrimage. It is not only a competition, but also a shared experience that attracts runners from different backgrounds. The event takes place on August 11–13, 2026, and is an important fixture in the region’s running calendar.

The event combines running with a pilgrimage of a spiritual nature
Organized by the local “Biegiem Radom!” Association
additional: The race takes place on August 11–13, 2026. Registration is available through the time-sport.pl platform. The event is a running pilgrimage, highlighting its unique spiritual dimension. Participation is limited to 40 pilgrims aged over 18. The entry fee includes meals, insurance, a medal, and a T-shirt, with overnight stays in tents and buildings.

Pretek sa koná na futbalovom ihrisku OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves v okrese Prešov a ponúka kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny mužov, žien aj dorastu. Ide o komunitnú športovú udalosť, ktorá podporuje aktívny životný štýl a športové nadšenie v regióne.

Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a dorastencov podľa veku
Organizovaný obcou Chminianska Nová Ves a Pavlom Uličným

Pretek ponúka jedinečný zážitok v srdci Slovenska, kde si bežci môžu užiť príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu. Trať je vhodná pre rôzne úrovne bežcov a podujatie je súčasťou bežeckej série Marathon Tour. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí chcú zažiť športové vyžitie v peknom prostredí.

Príjemné prostredie v okrese Žiar nad Hronom
Súčasť bežeckej série Marathon Tour

name: Štafetový beh 345 km od Tatier k Dunaju Jasná – Bratislava
location: Demänovská dolina, Jasná, Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilina, Slovakia
description: Štafetový beh od Tatier k Dunaju je najväčší štafetový beh na Slovensku s dĺžkou trate 345 km. Tímy pozostávajúce zo 6 alebo 9 až 12 členov štartujú v Jasnej v Nízkych Tatrách a bežia nonstop cez deň aj noc, aby v cieli na nábreží Dunaja v Bratislave ukončili pretek. Trať je prevažne asfaltová s celkovým prevýšením približne 3990 metrov stúpania a 4870 metrov klesania. Bežci absolvujú 36 úsekov rôznej dĺžky a náročnosti, pričom každý člen tímu pri 12-člennom družstve beží tri úseky. Preteky sú výzvou pre tímového ducha a vytrvalosť v krásnom prostredí Slovenska.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 346 km s prevýšením cca +3990 m a -4870 m
95 % trate vedie po asfalte, cesty 2. a 3. triedy
36 úsekov dlhých 7 až 12 km s rôznou obťažnosťou
additional: Tímy môžu mať 6 alebo 9 až 12 členov. Pri 12-člennom tíme každý bežec absolvuje 3 úseky s odstupom 8-10 hodín, spolu cca 30 km počas dvoch dní. Organizátor poskytuje detailné charakteristiky úsekov vrátane máp, výškových profilov a slovných popisov pre bežcov aj motorové vozidlá. Kapitán tímu sa registruje ako užívateľ a zastupuje celý tím. Preteky prebiehajú nonstop dňom aj nocou. Trať je 345 km, štart v Demänovskej doline, beh je nonstop, pre tímové skupiny, v auguste 2026. Registrácia je rozdelená podľa kategórií a termínov, s rôznymi poplatkami.

The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves on an interesting course in the South Bohemian Region. It is organised by Zdeněk Richtr and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including registered Cup members and other runners. The course surface is not specified in detail, but the race is part of a long-running series with clear rules.
course_highlights: 12.5 km course
Start at Kemp Poslední štace, Boršov nad Vltavou
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: Registration for the South Bohemian Running Cup requires payment of a membership fee of 250 Kč, valid for the entire Cup season. Registration is available online, with payment made by bank transfer and the runner’s name and year of birth included as the payment reference. For registrations made during the year, points from races are counted retroactively for a maximum of 3 months. The race includes trail and cross-country terrain, with the start and finish at Kemp Poslední štace; on-site registration is available until 10:00. The event also includes an 800 m children’s race.

name: Běžecký mítink Bohuňovice

description: The running meet in Bohuňovice near Olomouc is a cross-country race, offering men a 12.2 km course and women a 6.1 km course. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners’ Grand Prix and attracts runners who enjoy challenging terrain. The meet is suitable for anyone who wants to test their strength in a natural setting with varied surfaces. The event is a traditional gathering for the region’s running community.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain with varied surfaces
Course distance: 12.2 km for men and 6.1 km for women
Part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners’ Grand Prix
additional: The race is part of a series of running events in the region, offers the option to register and borrow running equipment, and attracts runners from a wide area.

name: 7 pohoří Šumava
description: The Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you across seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races feature technical trails, epic views and a unique atmosphere that will test every runner’s strength, willpower and determination. Whether you are an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains challenges you to conquer every route and become a legend. The Šumava race offers routes crossing the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř, passing glacial lakes and deep forests, with up to 900 m of elevation gain.
course_highlights: The route crosses the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř, with views of the glacial lakes Černé and Čertovo
Mostly natural terrain, with 900 m of elevation gain on the main 23.5 km course
An atmospheric race and technical trails prepared by mountain rescue service members
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours; after that, runners are marked as DNF. Participants can leave small items at the registration tent. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a professionally marked course, race bib, chip timing, commemorative medal, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and use of the facilities at the start and finish area. The races include registration with chip timing, medals, refreshments and the option to take part in different distances in the beautiful surroundings of Šumava.

name: Jablonská osmička
location: Jablonné nad Orlicí, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Jablonská osmička is a running race in Jablonné nad Orlicí, taking place on August 15, 2026. This fifth edition features an 8 km main race, children’s races, and a fun beer relay for teams of four. After the race, the program continues with a Food Festival and Jabloffest, featuring music and activities for children at the swimming pool grounds. Children’s races divided into three age categories

After the race, there is a generous raffle and an accompanying program including the Food Festival and Jabloffest. Registration by 31.7.2026; start and finish at the athletics track; T-shirts for registered participants; a generous raffle and gift bags.

name: Křivinský kros
description: Křivinský Kros is a running race held in Křivice, featuring a 7.5 km main course with 275 metres of elevation gain and an 800-metre children’s course. The race runs mostly along forest roads and trails through hilly terrain, making for a challenging and interesting run. Starts are staggered from 9:30 a.m., with children first, then juniors, and finally the main categories. The race is part of the Velká cena východních Čech series and is open to the general public, with a voluntary entry fee. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a short raffle for participants.
course_highlights: Main course: 7.5 km with 275 m of elevation gain
90% of the course runs along forest roads and trails
Hilly terrain on Křivina
additional: You can register on site before the race or in advance by email. The entry fee is voluntary. The start for all categories is about 150 m from the registration area. The course is marked with red-and-white plastic ribbons and white arrows on trees or stakes, or with white spray paint on the ground. The awards ceremony takes place after the race at approximately 11:30, followed by a raffle. Before the race, participants can join a group training session and run the main course. The race features hilly terrain, forest roads and trails, and is part of the Velká cena východních Čech series.

Online training plans available

The event also includes other local races, such as the Sztumski Bieg Solidarności. Details about registration and participation are available on the organizer’s website.

The aesthetic qualities of the locations
Organized with a passion for running since 2014

name: Žebrácká pětadvacítka
description: Žebrácká Pětadvacítka is a traditional August road race along the roads and forest trails of the Křivoklátsko region, held every year in Žebrák. It offers several distances, including the main 25 km race, a 10 km run, a 10 km walk and a family run for children. The main race starts at 10:00 by the Primary School in Žebrák, while the senior categories start at 9:00. The race is held as part of the celebrations of the St. Lawrence Pilgrimage and offers a wonderful sporting experience amid the picturesque scenery of the Křivoklátsko region.

Two loops around the housing estate in Žebrák at the start of the race
Family run with activities for children on a 1.1 km loop

The course is 1.1 km long, open to all ages, with a reward for children at the finish. The main 25 km race starts at 10:00, and the senior categories start at 9:00. After the main race starts, a non-competitive 10 km run and a 10 km walk with poles (Nordic walking) also start. Online registration, with the option to order a T-shirt, closes on 20 July 2025. On-site registration is available on race day from 7:30 to 9:15 at the Cultural Club. The race is suitable for all age groups, including children and families, and is open to participants in all weather, with dogs and with wheelchair access.

name: MFB MarathOn LABE

The event is suitable for runners of all levels and features a rich program, including children’s races and family entertainment. It is organized by the Kolínská 14 association, which has supported an active and healthy lifestyle in the region since 2011.

Check-in and race-bib collection take place on Saturday and on Sunday morning. Parking and changing facilities are available in Kolín. The event takes place on August 16, 2026, features various race categories and a festival atmosphere, and offers online registration.

name: Tyršův běh na Sokol

Runners start at one-minute intervals, and the race has a long-standing tradition; in 2021, it was held for the 36th time. Everyone interested in this type of race is warmly welcome.

2 km long with 300 m of elevation gain
Starts at one-minute intervals

The scenic appeal of the proposed locations
Route available on Garmin Connect

The event has a friendly atmosphere, is open to all age groups, and fosters a sense of community among runners. The race takes place in Súr, Hungary, and the organizers place great emphasis on smooth event management and participant satisfaction.

A friendly race with a strong community atmosphere

Participants can enjoy the beautiful Šumava countryside and a varied programme of cultural activities.

Children’s off-road cycling races on a cyclocross course in six categories

The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere, refreshments, and on-site baggage storage.

name: Šárecká 5

description: Šárecká 5 is a 5.3 km cross-country race held in the picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. Cross-country/trail race format
The picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6

name: Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho
description: Beh Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho sa koná v Trebišove pri Mestskom kultúrnom stredisku a ponúka rôzne kategórie vrátane behu, letnej prechádzky, jazdy na bicykli, nordic walkingu a virtuálneho preteku. Štart je plánovaný na 21. augusta 2026 o 16:15 pre deti a o 16:25 pre hlavnú kategóriu. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie, vrátane detí do 7 rokov a starších detí do 13 rokov. Organizátorom je Ing. Michal Majcher, ktorý zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pretekov.
course_highlights: Miesto štartu a cieľa pri Mestskom kultúrnom stredisku v Trebišove
Viacero kategórií vrátane behu, prechádzky, bicyklovania a nordic walkingu
Virtuálny pretek ako novinka pre účastníkov mimo miesta konania
additional: Štartovné sa platí na mieste. Kategórie zahŕňajú deti do 7 rokov, deti 8-13 rokov, hlavnú kategóriu, letnú prechádzku, jazdu na bicykli, nordic walking a virtuálny pretek s možnosťou zakúpenia medaily. Podujatie zahŕňa viacero kategórií vrátane detských a virtuálnych, registrácia je možná na mieste, trať je situovaná v okolí kultúrneho centra v Trebišove.

name: Běh městem Strakonice
location: Letní kino, Strakonice, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
organizer: Město Strakonice, Okresní sdružení Česká unie sportu Strakonice
description: The XXIII Strakonice City Run is a traditional running race held on August 21 at the Summer Cinema in Strakonice. Runners of all ages can test themselves on 3.3 km and 6.6 km routes through the city. Both routes start together at 18:00. All participants have a chance to win prizes in a large raffle, drawn using race numbers. Entries can be submitted by email or on race day.
course_highlights: Two routes through the city: 3.3 km and 6.6 km
Start and finish at the Summer Cinema
All runners start together at 18:00
additional: Entries can be submitted by email until August 20 or on race day, no later than 60 minutes before the start. All race numbers will be entered into a large raffle. The race features an accompanying program with military vehicles and is part of the city's traditional sporting calendar.

name: Rusínska 100 a 66
description: Rusínska 100 a 66 je neskoro letný ultrabeh a diaľkový pochod so štartom aj cieľom v meste Stropkov. Trasy vedú Ondavskou vrchovinou v Zemplínskej župe a pokračujú do Šarišskej župy cez mesto Svidník, prechádzajúc regiónom rusínskych obcí a po hranici s Poľskom. Trasa R100 sčasti prechádza chránenou krajinnou oblasťou Východné Karpaty. Podujatie je súčasťou Slovenskej Ultratrailovej Ligy a je certifikované u ITRA, zaradené medzi preteky ITRA National League. Organizátorom je o.z. Klub bežcov Stropkov, ktorý zabezpečuje srdečnú pohostinnosť a kvalitnú organizáciu.
course_highlights: Trasy vedú Ondavskou vrchovinou a cez severnú časť Nízkych Beskýd
Prechod chránenou krajinnou oblasťou Východné Karpaty
Región s historickými sakrálnymi stavbami, vyhliadkovými vežami a kultúrnymi pamiatkami
additional: Podujatie sa koná počas 23.-24. augusta 2025. Rusínska 100 a 66 sú súčasťou 11. ročníka Slovenskej Ultratrailovej Ligy. Trasy sú určené pre ultrabežcov a diaľkových turistov, prechádzajú náročným terénom s bohatou históriou a prírodnými krásami. Organizátori a dobrovoľníci zabezpečujú srdečnú pohostinnosť a kvalitnú podporu pre účastníkov. Trasy vedú prevažne lesnými a trailovými cestami, s niekoľkými úsekmi asfaltu; registrácia je otvorená od 1. mája do 20. septembra 2025; podujatie zdôrazňuje prírodné krásy a historické pamiatky regiónu.

name: Hradný gaštanový beh Modrý Kameň
location: Park pred vstupom do Hradu Modrý Kameň, Modrý Kameň, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Modrý Kameň v spolupráci s občianskym združením Bežci VK
price_range: 15 eur pre hlavný 10 km beh, 5 eur pre hobby a Nordic Walking, juniors 7 eur, zľavy pre seniorov nad 60+

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Nordic walking a hobby beh 5 km - 15 eur

description: Hradný gaštanový beh Modrý Kameň je bežecké podujatie konané v parku pred vstupom do Hradu Modrý Kameň. Preteky ponúkajú rôzne kategórie vrátane hobby pretekov pre deti a juniorov na 5 km, hlavného preteku na 10 km pre dospelých a nordic walking na 5 km. Trať vedie po asfalte, lúkach, lesných a poľných cestách, čo poskytuje pestrú a príjemnú bežeckú skúsenosť. Organizátorom je Mesto Modrý Kameň v spolupráci s občianskym združením Bežci VK. Štart pre deti je o 10:00 hod., pre dospelých o 11:00 hod.
course_highlights: Trať vedie po asfalte, lúkach, lesných a poľných cestách
Preteky sa konajú v parku pred vstupom do Hradu Modrý Kameň
Rôzne kategórie vrátane hobby, juniorské a nordic walking
additional: Zľava 50% na štartovnom pre vekovú kategóriu 60 rokov a viac. Možnosť registrácie na mieste minimálne 30 minút pred štartom hlavného preteku a nordic walking s príplatkom na štartovné 17 eur. Trať zahŕňa asfalt, lúky, lesné a poľné cesty; kategórie pre deti, hobby bežcov a súťažných bežcov; štarty o 10:00 a 11:00

name: Čachtický polmaratón

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: elektronicky do 20. augusta 2026 /streda/ štartovné 1-100 pretekár cena 10,- EUR

description: Čachtický polmaratón je tradičný polmaratónsky beh, ktorý sa uskutoční 22. augusta 2026 v obci Čachtice. Trať vedie prevažne po asfaltovom povrchu cez ulice Čachtíc do Višňového a Hrachovišťa, s krátkym úsekom lesnej cesty. Profil trate je mierne zvlnený s maximálnym prevýšením do 90 metrov. Štart je na námestí v Čachticiach a cieľ v areáli Základnej školy v Čachticiach. Počas trate sú zabezpečené občerstvovacie stanice na viacerých miestach.
course_highlights: Asfaltový podklad s krátkym úsekom lesnej cesty
Mierne zvlnený profil s max. prevýšením do 90 m
Občerstvenie na 6 km, 10,5 km, 12 km, 15 km a v cieli
additional: Maximálny počet pretekárov na polmaratón je 250, na štafetu max 10 štafiet. Štafetový beh je osobitná kategória pre 3-4 členné družstvá. Prezentácia pretekárov je v deň preteku od 06:30 do 08:30 v areáli Základnej školy Čachtice. Ceny sú finančné odmeny pre 1.-3. miesto v kategóriách a zlosovateľná tombola podľa štartovného čísla. Registrácia je možná online do 20. augusta 2025, maximálny počet účastníkov je 250, pretek má viacero kontrolných bodov s občerstvením.

name: Forbaský beh pomoci
location: areál Ščava, Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, Slovakia
description: Forbaský beh pomoci je charitatívny bežecký pretek, ktorý sa koná v areáli Ščava vo Forbasoch, okres Stará Ľubovňa. Ide o podujatie s dobrovoľným štartovným, ktoré podporuje pomoc a solidaritu. Bežci si môžu užiť príjemnú atmosféru a zároveň prispieť na dobrú vec. Organizátorom je Valer Kuffa, ktorý je k dispozícii pre informácie a podporu účastníkov.
course_highlights: Pretek sa koná v areáli Ščava vo Forbasoch
Charitatívny beh s dobrovoľným štartovným
Príjemná atmosféra a podpora pomoci
additional: Štartovné je dobrovoľný príspevok, podrobnosti na https://www.behpomoci.sk/fbp-2025/dobrovo%C4%BEn%C3%BD-pr%C3%ADspevok. Organizátorom je Valer Kuffa, tel.: +421 949 765 543. race categories for different age groups, registration via voluntary donation

name: Lukačovská 5

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 10,-€ na mieste v deň preteku do naplnenia limitu 80 pretekárov

description: Lukačovská 5 je bežecký pretek konaný na futbalovom ihrisku v Lukačovciach, okr. Humenné. Pretek ponúka hlavný beh na 5 km a detské behy, pričom kategórie sú rozdelené na mužov, ženy a nesúťažnú kategóriu Nordic Walking. Organizátorom je obec Lukačovce, ktorá zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pretekov. Štart pre deti je o 10:00 a hlavný beh začína o 11:00 hodine.
course_highlights: Pretek na 5 km trať v príjemnom prostredí futbalového ihriska v Lukačovciach
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a nesúťažná kategória Nordic Walking
Limit 80 pretekárov pre hlavný beh
additional: Detské behy štartujú o 10:00 hod., hlavný beh o 11:00 hod. Limit účasti pre hlavný beh je 80 pretekárov. Organizátorom je obec Lukačovce v zastúpení Ing. Martin Sabol - starosta obce. Kontaktné osoby: Ing. Martin Sabol (riaditeľ pretekov, tel.: 0948 922 600) a Adrián Turik (tel.: 0948 228 212). Podujatie zahŕňa aj detské kategórie, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, a povrch je pravdepodobne rovný, vhodný pre všetky úrovne bežcov.

name: Harhovská desiatka
price_range: 10 € za hlavnú trať, 5 € za 3,5 km pretek
description: Harhovská desiatka je bežecké podujatie v Spišskom Hrhove, ktoré ponúka trať dlhú 10 km a kratšiu 3,5 km pre rekreačných a začínajúcich bežcov. Preteky sú rozdelené do viacerých vekových kategórií pre mužov aj ženy, vrátane špeciálnej kategórie pre obyvateľov obce Spišský Hrhov. Organizátorom je obec Spišský Hrhov a štart pretekov je pred Obecným úradom. Štartovné sa platí na prezentácii a je 10 € pre 10 km a 5 € pre 3,5 km trať.
course_highlights: Trať 10 km pre pokročilých bežcov
3,5 km trať pre rekreačných a začínajúcich bežcov
Štart pred Obecným úradom v Spišskom Hrhove
additional: Štartovné sa platí na prezentácii v deň pretekov. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane kategórie pre obyvateľov Spišského Hrhova. 10 km trať je certifikovaná Slovenským atletickým zväzom, preteky sa konajú v lete, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste

name: Brezovský letný beh
location: Športové ihrisko, Rimavské Brezovo, Bardejov, Slovakia
description: Brezovský beh zdravia je tradičný bežecký pretek v obci Brezov, okres Bardejov, ktorý ponúka trať vedúcu po asfalte, poľnej a lesnej ceste. Pretek je určený pre mužov a ženy, vrátane mládeže do 15 rokov a nad 15 rokov. Organizátori pripravili dve štartovné kategórie s veľkým a malým balíčkom, ktoré umožňujú zúčastniť sa tejto športovej udalosti v príjemnom prostredí pri Obecnom úrade v Brezove. Pretek je vhodný pre bežcov rôznych vekových kategórií a úrovní výkonnosti.
course_highlights: Povrch trate: asfalt, poľná cesta, lesná cesta
Miesto štartu: pri Obecnom úrade Brezov
Kategórie: muži/ženy, mládež do 15 rokov a nad 15 rokov
additional: Trať zahŕňa asfaltové, vidiecke a lesné cesty; preteky sú určené pre mužov, ženy aj mládež; registrácia je spoplatnená

name: Behaj lesmi Čičmany
price_range: €17 - €24 per race, discounts for multiple registrations
description: Behaj lesmi Čičmany je bežecký pretek v malebnom prostredí slovenskej ľudovej dediny Čičmany, ktorý ponúka trať cez Strážovské vrchy s nádhernou prírodou, neporušenými lesmi a rozľahlými lúkami. Preteky sú súčasťou série Behaj lesmi a sú zaradené do UTMB Index Races, čo zaručuje medzinárodné uznanie a hodnotenie. Súťažiť môžete na rôznych tratiach vrátane dlhého 20 km behu s prevýšením 718 m, strednej 11 km trati Lesnícka s prevýšením 380 m a krátkej 5 km trati. Súčasťou pretekov je aj špeciálna Conti Speed Section, kde najlepší bežci môžu získať hodnotné ceny.
course_highlights: Trať vedie cez Strážovské vrchy s prevýšením až 718 m na 20 km trati
Pretek sa koná v autentickom prostredí slovenskej ľudovej dediny Čičmany s maľovanými drevenými domami
Súčasťou trate je Conti Speed Section na 150 metroch s cenami pre najlepších bežcov
additional: Súčasťou pretekov je možnosť preregistrácie a zmeny štartovného poplatku online cez profil SportID. Na trati je vyznačená Conti Speed Section s cenami pre najlepších bežcov. Preteky sú zaradené do UTMB Index Races, čo umožňuje získanie bodov do medzinárodného hodnotenia trailových pretekov. Preteky sú zaradené do UTMB Indexu, s možnosťou stiahnutia GPX súborov, kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny, a prebieha registrácia online.

name: Morava Run - proti proudu
location: Pohansko, Břeclav, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné na VI. MORAVA RUN (2026) je stanoveno na 11.000,- Kč / A tým (7-9 členů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné na VI. MORAVA RUN (2026) je stanoveno na 15.000,- Kč / B tým (10-12 členů)

description: Morava Run – Upstream is a relay running race across Moravia along the course of the Morava River, held in teams of 7 to 12 members. The approximately 280 km route is divided into 30 legs of around 9 km, which teams assign according to their abilities and strategy. The race starts in southern Moravia in the Soutok Protected Landscape Area and follows the river upstream through Slovácko, Haná, the Litovelské Pomoraví Protected Landscape Area and on to the source of the Morava on Králický Sněžník. The event is aimed at amateur runners and emphasizes teamwork and team building, with no pace limit.
course_highlights: The route follows the Morava River upstream from Břeclav to Dolní Morava
30 legs in total, each approximately 9 km long
Passes through the Soutok Protected Landscape Area, Slovácko, Haná, the Litovelské Pomoraví Protected Landscape Area and the Jeseníky Mountains
additional: The race starts in Břeclav by Pohansko Castle and finishes at the Dolní Morava campsite, where participants can also camp overnight. Teams start in waves, and there is no pace limit. Each team plans its logistics and distributes its effort across the 30 legs. The organizer provides an emergency hotline for unexpected events and a WhatsApp group for team leaders. The race is for teams of 7–12 members and includes logistics, support along the route and the option of facilities at the campsite. The event is intended for both athletes and team-building groups, with an emphasis on experiences and cooperation in nature.

name: Brdský půlmaraton
location: Kytín, Kladno District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Brdy Half Marathon is a traditional trail running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Kytín in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers two routes: a more challenging 21 km course with 430 m of elevation gain and a shorter 9 km course with 158 m of elevation gain, both with refreshment stations. Overall winners and age and gender categories are recognized on the longer course, while the shorter course awards the fastest men and women overall. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for nature-running enthusiasts, with beautiful views and varied terrain.
course_highlights: 21 km course with 430 m of elevation gain
9 km course with 158 m of elevation gain
Refreshment stations along the course with water and isotonic drinks
additional: The 21 km course has refreshment stations at 3.7 km, 9 km and 17 km, serving water and isotonic drinks. The 9 km course has refreshments at 3.7 km, and water, an isotonic drink and light refreshments are available at the finish. Children's races are free. Age and gender categories are recognized on the 21 km course, and overall winners on the 9 km course. The race offers 21 km and 9 km courses, suitable for trail runners and families with children, with registration available through the official website.

name: Hrabovský 1/2 a 1/4 maraton
description: The Hrabová Half and Quarter Marathon is a traditional running race held in Ostrava-Hrabová, offering half-marathon and quarter-marathon distances. The race is part of the Hrabová Cup and the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup. Participants receive medals, and refreshments, changing rooms, and an accompanying program are available. The start and race-day check-in take place at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports ground. The route passes through an urban setting with a pleasant atmosphere and is suitable for a wide range of runners.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course: 21.1 km
Quarter-marathon course: 10.5 km
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports ground
additional: The race bib is returnable and includes a chip. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish, along with changing rooms and toilets. An accompanying program is part of the event. Online registration is available, with payment by bank transfer required within 5 days of registration. Race-day check-in and registration take place at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports ground, Paskovská 209, Ostrava. The event includes not only races, but also children's races, Nordic Walking, a raffle, and other fun activities. The event takes place on August 22, 2026.

name: Jesenický maraton
description: The Jeseníky Marathon is a legendary and challenging mountain marathon in the Czech Republic, held in the Jeseníky Mountains since 2009. The marathon and half-marathon follow the same course each year, but changeable weather and mountain terrain make it feel different every time. Runners follow the ridges of forested mountains, passing springs, primeval forests, stone fields and peat bogs, creating a unique atmosphere and challenge. The Jeseníky Marathon is intended for experienced endurance runners who want to conquer the highest mountain range in Moravia and Silesia.
course_highlights: Ridges of forested mountains with rounded peaks
Springs of fresh water and deep valleys
Centuries-old primeval forests, mountain tundra and stone fields
additional: The race is limited to 700 runners. The time limit for completing the marathon is 6 hours and 30 minutes. Refreshments are available at several stations, with water, isotonic drinks, fruit and energy foods. Hot food and drinks can be purchased at the finish. Runners with a valid registration by 30 June 2026 will receive a T-shirt unless they choose otherwise. The organizer may cancel the race in the event of adverse weather, without compensation for damages. The course is mountainous, with refreshments at two stations, free parking, free bus transport from the start, a time limit and an age limit of 18+.

name: Panevropský půlmaraton
description: The Pan-European Half Marathon is a cross-border running race from Stadlern in Bavaria to Poběžovice. The course runs through the picturesque countryside of the Bavarian-Czech border region, including the former “Iron Curtain” and a low pass in the Bohemian Forest near the source of the Radbuza River. The race is accompanied by a rich cultural programme at both the start and finish, with activities for children. The start is traditionally at 10 a.m., and the finish is in Míru Square in Poběžovice. The organisers warmly invite athletes and spectators to come and support the runners.
course_highlights: Cross-border course from Germany to the Czech Republic
Passes through the former Iron Curtain via the Švarcava border crossing
Undulating course with two climbs to low passes in the Bohemian Forest
additional: Refreshment stations on the course at 6, 9, 12, 15 and 18 km, serving water and isotonic drinks. After the finish: hot food, drinks, fruit, muesli and chocolate. Race-day registration is available at the start in Stadlern for 600 CZK in cash. Bus transport to the start and back after the race. Winners are announced and prizes presented immediately after the race. Every runner receives a commemorative medal and a T-shirt bearing the race emblem. Buses to the start depart from Poběžovice and Domažlice. The race takes place in August 2026. The course is mostly on asphalt and features varied terrain. Part of the Běžec Chodska series.

name: Běh na Svatý Hostýn
location: Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Svatý Hostýn is a mountain race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem in the Zlín Region. It is part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running and offers a challenging 5 km race with 422 metres of elevation gain, with most of the course on asphalt. The race is open to both experienced runners and the general public, attracting running enthusiasts from across the country. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 422 m of elevation gain
Runs mostly on asphalt, with a challenging climb
Part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running
additional: Registration is also available on-site. The race uses chip timing and takes place in August 2026.

name: Běh k Božímu hrobu
location: Svatý Hostýn, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to the Holy Sepulchre is a traditional running event held at Svatý Hostýn in the Zlín Region, part of the wider range of pilgrimages and sporting events at the site. The event features an uphill race finishing at the Holy Sepulchre and is an important part of the regional sporting calendar. Get ready for the atmosphere of this pilgrimage site and enjoy a sporting experience in the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.
course_highlights: Uphill race at Svatý Hostýn
Part of the Czech Hill Running Cup
Pilgrimage and sporting atmosphere, with the option to take part during pilgrimages
additional: The event includes a run to Svatý Hostýn and the Holy Sepulchre and is part of the pilgrimage activities. Registration and results are available on the website.

name: Běh na Čupek
description: The Run to Čupek is a newly established running race in Metylovice that has already attracted two hundred runners. The course is scenic and challenging, making for an engaging experience for participants. The race is part of the Slezan Frýdek-Místek Physical Education Association calendar, and its future place in the schedule is being watched with anticipation.
course_highlights: A challenging course in Metylovice
Scenic running surroundings
The race has already attracted two hundred runners
additional: Entry fee: 50 Kč for youth and 150 Kč for adults; the race takes place at the football pitch in Metylovice; changing rooms, showers, toilets, stadium facilities, a restaurant, and parking are available.

name: Vavřinecký běh Moravským krasem
location: Vavřinec, Moravský kras, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Vavřinec Run through the Moravian Karst is a sporting event held in the village of Vavřinec in the South Moravian Region, and is part of the District Running League. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, and offers various running categories suitable for the general public. It is an ideal opportunity for running enthusiasts to discover the beauty of the Moravian Karst and enjoy an outdoor sporting experience.
course_highlights: Held in the picturesque Moravian Karst
Part of the District Running League
Various age categories and race distances
additional: The race is suitable for all age groups, with entry fees of CZK 200 for adults and CZK 50 for children. The event promotes an active lifestyle and exploring the region’s natural beauty.

name: IV Festiwal Pustelnika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz rozwoju Wysowej-Zdroju „Przekrocz Granice”
description: The 4th Pustelnik Festival is an annual sports and recreation event organized in the picturesque town of Wysowa-Zdrój by the Przekrocz Granice Association. The festival brings together sport, culture, and nature, offering participants the opportunity to take part in runs, marathons, and MTB and E-BIKE competitions. It is a unique opportunity to discover the charms of the Low Beskids, spend time actively, and connect with the local community.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes in the Low Beskids
Picturesque landscapes and the natural surroundings of Wysowa-Zdrój
A blend of sport, culture, and the region’s history
additional: Participants can take part in running and MTB/E-BIKE competitions. The organizer can be reached by phone from Monday to Saturday, 8:00–22:00, at +48 600 091 196. The competitions take place on mountain trails, with online registration and distances for different ability levels. Participants can choose a marathon, half marathon, or shorter-distance runs.

location: Festetics-kastély hátsó park, Keszthely, Zala County, Hungary
