tiers.description: A gyermek nevezési lapok és regisztráció a VERSENYIRODA sátorban, részvételi díj 1.500,-Ft/gyermek. Csak helyszíni nevezés lehetséges.

description: Keszthely Kilometers is a traditional running race on the shores of Lake Balaton, taking place on August 22–23, 2026, in the rear park of Festetics Palace. Participants can choose from several distances, from 3 km to the half marathon, and compete individually or in a relay. There are also children’s races for the youngest runners, with different distances for each age group. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and its lakeside setting offers runners a special experience.
course_highlights: Held on the shores of Lake Balaton, in the rear park of Festetics Palace
Distances from 3 km to the half marathon, with individual and relay events
Children’s races by age group in a family-friendly program
additional: The race office is on site by Lake Balaton, at the pier, where runners can collect their race numbers and register on the day. A separate registration desk is available for the children’s races. Runners are advised to arrive early because of traffic restrictions and parking difficulties. The children’s races cover different distances by age group, and the youngest participants may run accompanied by a parent. The awards ceremony takes place after the races. Multiple distances, children’s and adult races, relay races, on-site registration, parking and traffic restrictions, start times subject to weather

name: Minimaratón
location: Atletický štadión na Štiavničkách, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT OZ, Minimaratón OZ
description: Minimaratón je jedinečné bežecké podujatie určené výhradne pre rodiny s deťmi, ktoré sa koná na atletickom štadióne na Štiavničkách v Banskej Bystrici. Podujatie ponúka rôzne kategórie podľa veku detí, od najmenších bežcov po staršie deti, vrátane mamičiek s kočíkmi. Trať je prispôsobená vekovým skupinám, s okruhmi 400 m a 200 m. Okrem športového zážitku je pripravený aj sprievodný program s aktivitami pre deti a stretnutiami so športovcami. Každý účastník dostane pamätné štartové číslo, medailu a občerstvenie po dobehu.
course_highlights: Trať pre deti 2011-2020 a mamičky s kočíkmi - 400 m okruh
Skrátená 200 m trať pre deti do 5 rokov
Atletický štadión SNP na Štiavničkách - krásny ovál a prostredie
additional: Registrácia je možná online do 22.8.2026, osobne 21.8.2026 v Europa SC a 23.8.2026 na štadióne od 8:00. Štartovné nezahŕňa vrátenie ani presun na ďalší ročník. Po dobehu je zabezpečené občerstvenie a zdravotná služba. Nebudú k dispozícii úschovňa a šatne. O 11:50 sa uskutoční žrebovanie o hodnotné ceny pre všetkých, ktorí dobehli do cieľa. terrain: atletický štadión; registrácia online a osobne; medaily a ceny pre účastníkov; jubilejný 11. ročník; sprievodný program vrátane preletu lietadla a aktivít pre rodiny

name: Beh na boso Tatry
location: Golfový rezort Black Stork, Veľká Lomnica, Slovakia
description: Beh na boso Tatry je bežecké podujatie v krásnom prostredí Golfového rezortu Black Stork vo Veľkej Lomnici. Pretekári si môžu vybrať medzi nesúťažnými behmi pre deti a dospelých a súťažným behom na 5 km. Trať vedie po pokosenom trávniku, cez cestičky a kamienky, čo vytvára krosový charakter trate. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru v prírode Tatier. Organizátorom je OZ Beh na boso Tatry, ktorý zabezpečuje kvalitný priebeh pretekov.
course_highlights: Trať vedie po pokosenom trávniku
Prechody cez cestičky a kamienky pokryté kobercom
Krosová trať v prostredí Golfového rezortu Black Stork
additional: Štart nesúťažných behov je o 9:30 hod., súťažný beh na 5 km štartuje o 10:30 hod. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia. Nesúťažné behy majú dĺžku 250 m pre deti do 12 rokov a 1 km pre deti a dospelých. Trať zahŕňa pokosený trávnik, cestičky, kamienky a krosovú trať; registrácia je možná aj na mieste; podujatie podporuje charitatívne aktivity a ponúka občerstvenie a sprievodné aktivity pre deti.

name: Slopenská desítka
location: Slopné, Luhačovice, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: pro běžce ze Slopného na místě

description: Slopenská Desítka is a traditional cross-country race held in the picturesque village of Slopné near Luhačovice. The race features a challenging course with varied terrain, including paved roads, steep climbs, and descents through forest terrain. The start is located below the church and the finish is at the sports field, where runners are greeted by enthusiastic cheers from spectators. The event is suitable for the general public, including junior categories and family relays. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín competitions and the KRAKONOŠ Czech Mountain Running Cup.
course_highlights: Start on a paved road below the church, with plenty of space for runners
A long 1,500 m climb on paved road and a steep climb through the forest up to the 2.5 km mark
The final three kilometres are entirely downhill, ending with a finishing straight at the sports field
additional: The family relay has three members and is run in three legs. Members must be related, with a minimum age difference of 18 years between two members. Registration closes 5 minutes before the start of the category. The overall winner receives a cash reward for every second under the set time. The main race starts about 100 m from the sports field, on a paved road below the church. The race is part of the local sports calendar and also offers family relays and prizes in various categories.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Stříbrná
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series comprises 6 races in different locations, including Stříbrná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and the experience route covers 20 to 30 km. Children’s races and walking routes with checkpoints to find using a map are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a beautiful natural setting in the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Main race: 6–9 km through the Ore Mountains
Experience route: 20–30 km, navigated using a map
Children’s races: 200 m to 1,100 m
additional: The series comprises 6 races at different locations in the Ore Mountains. In addition to running routes, walking routes with checkpoints to find using a map and children’s races are available. The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s., in cooperation with Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. The races include various categories, including dog trekking and walking. Routes are unmarked, with checkpoints along the course; overtaking is prohibited. The series includes multiple locations and races in the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh pro Střížák
location: Střížovický vrch, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro Střížák is a traditional race held on Střížovický Hill in Ústí nad Labem, now in its 16th year. The course is a loop run three times, with one significant climb and descent; otherwise, it is gently undulating. The event also includes shorter children’s and youth races, making it accessible to the wider community. The race has an interesting story: the course passes through an area once threatened by a planned development, which was cancelled after residents objected.
course_highlights: The loop is run three times
One challenging climb (220 m, 25 m elevation gain)
Gently undulating terrain with one descent of approximately 20 m over a 400 m section
additional: Shorter children’s (700 m) and youth (2.7 km) races are available. The course passes through an area once threatened by a planned indoor ski slope for year-round downhill skiing, which was cancelled after residents objected. The event includes a raffle and refreshments and is part of the local cross-country cup, with children and young people also welcome to take part.

name: 7. PKO Tarnogórski Półmaraton oraz Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka
description: The 7th PKO Tarnogórski Half Marathon and Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka are the region’s biggest running celebration, taking place on August 23, 2026. The 21.0975 km half-marathon course runs entirely on paved streets in Tarnowskie Góry, with vehicle traffic partially closed. Refreshment and hydration stations will be available for participants. The time limit for completing the half marathon has been extended to 3 hours, so everyone can cross the finish line with a smile and earn a medal. The Srebrna Dyszka is a run of approximately 10.5 km, complementing the event’s running program.
course_highlights: Course runs entirely on paved streets in Tarnowskie Góry
Refreshment and hydration stations on the half-marathon and Srebrna Dyszka courses
Vehicle traffic partially closed along the course
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon has been extended to 3 hours. The half marathon is certified by the PZLA, while the Srebrna Dyszka is not certified. The half-marathon course has checkpoints; shortening the course results in disqualification. Paved course, 3-hour time limit, refreshment and hydration stations, limited number of participants.

name: IV BIEG PEŁNEJ MISKI
description: Bieg Pełnej Miski is a charity running event held in Szubin to support animal shelters through the “Pełna Miska” campaign. The race has been held annually since 2023, and the next edition is scheduled for August 23, 2026. The event combines sporting competition with the goal of helping homeless animals, bringing together the local community and running enthusiasts. The organizers encourage people to take part and work together to support animals.
course_highlights: 5 km main race
Children’s races and a dog walk
Virtual race, with participants able to take part from anywhere
additional: The event includes the main race, children’s races, a dog walk, and a virtual race option. Fees vary depending on the package and registration date. Proceeds support animal shelters, and participants can receive commemorative medals by post.

name: Běh Smetánkou
description: The Smetánka Run is a 3.5 km off-road race held in Prague 9 and is part of the SABZO series. It offers runners the chance to enjoy a run in a natural setting with varied terrain. It is suitable for anyone looking for a short but dynamic race in a pleasant atmosphere. The race is a traditional part of Prague’s running season and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: 3.5 km off-road course
Part of the SABZO series
Natural setting in Prague 9
additional: The race is intended for runners of all levels; registration and exact details are not explicitly provided.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (9) – srpnový
description: The 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running series in Prague-Braník, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The races are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals, and personal bests are often set here. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships (MČR). After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant. The series is part of its 16th edition and rewards not only the top runners but also loyal participants.
course_highlights: Pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague-Braník
Course measured by a certified course measurer
Opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships (MČR) in the 10 km race
additional: Check-in from 18:00; 10 km start at 19:00; 5 km start at 19:05. Post-race refreshments (food, beer, sports drink) at Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. Toilets are available in the Hamr Braník complex. You can withdraw up to 24 hours before the start and receive a refund of the entry fee. Public transport is recommended; P+R parking is available at Nádraží Braník. Prizes for the top runners and loyal participants, plus a post-race raffle. Registration includes the option to sign up early, with possible discounts. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to professional competitors.

name: Běh Modřanskou roklí - Memoriál Zdeňka Buriana
location: Modřanská rokle, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Běh Modřanskou roklí - Zdeněk Burian Memorial is a 4 km race on a gently undulating course in the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series and features a staggered start, allowing the event to run smoothly. The course is suitable for runners who want to enjoy a run in nature with gentle elevation changes. It is ideal for anyone looking for a short but technically interesting run in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 4 km course in the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve
Gently undulating terrain with natural features
Staggered start for a smooth race
additional: The race has a staggered start. It is part of the SABZO series. The course is gently undulating and runs through the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series, which supports the running community in Prague. Exact registration and entry fee details have not yet been published.

name: Beskydská sedmička
description: IMOS Beskydská sedmička is an extreme mountain marathon across the entire Beskydy Mountains, running from Třinec to Frenštát pod Radhoštěm. This challenging race, approximately 101 km long with 5,500 m+ of elevation gain, is the Czech Championship in individual mountain marathons and is open to individuals and pairs. The race starts at night at 23:00 from the athletics stadium in Třinec, and the finish gate closes 28 hours later on Sunday morning. The race offers a unique experience of the Beskydy mountain landscape and well-equipped aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: Approximately 101 km with 5,500 m+ of elevation gain across the main Beskydy range
Starts in Třinec at 23:00 and finishes in Frenštát pod Radhoštěm, with a 28-hour time limit
Aid stations along the course in locations including Ostravice, Pustevny, Morávka, and others
additional: Accreditation takes place on Friday, 28 August 2026, from 13:00 to 22:00 at the STARS sports hall in Třinec. Free shuttle transport from Frenštát pod Radhoštěm to the start in Třinec is provided for competitors. Soup and sausages are available at the aid stations, though soup is offered only at designated stations. Competitors can use baggage storage, with bags identified by race number. The athletics stadium stands will be open to supporters and fans, making the start a memorable experience for them too. The race includes aid stations, course changes compared with previous editions, the option to download a GPX file, a 28-hour finish limit, a 23:00 start, and a finish at 3:00 the following day.

name: Letni Ultra Świr
description: Letni Ultra Świr is a unique 24-hour ultramarathon on a 15 km loop near Grybów. It is a challenge for runners who want to test the limits of their endurance and enjoy an atmosphere full of sweat, dust and fatigue, but also laughter and madness. The event attracts long-distance running enthusiasts, offering a one-of-a-kind experience and plenty of thrills.
course_highlights: 15 km loop
Race duration: 24 hours
A course full of sweat, dust and fatigue
additional: The race takes place on a 15 km loop and lasts 24 hours. The event is characterized by a lack of limits on common sense and a big dose of excitement. In previous editions, a 17 km Nordic Walking event was also held, but no details about other formats have been provided for Letni Ultra Świr 24h. The start and finish are located at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa (information from other editions). The event includes various distances and formats, including ultra, trail and Nordic Walking, with online registration. Start and finish in Ptaszkowa, with an exciting atmosphere and a passion for running.

name: Beh vďaky Senica – Prietrž – pamätník SNP u Rehušov
location: Pamätník SNP u Rehušov, Prietrž, Senica District, Trnava Region, Slovakia

name: Kácovský běh
location: Náměstí kněžny Toskánské, Kácov, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kácov Run is a traditional running race held on the last Saturday in August in the picturesque Posázaví region. It offers three main routes—the Devatenáctka, the Desítka and the Kolečko—with varied terrain and elevation that challenge both experienced runners and beginners. The start and finish are in the centre of Kácov, with refreshment stations on the longer routes. The race is timed using chip timing and accompanied by a varied programme, including children’s races and a raffle.
course_highlights: Devatenáctka: 18.8 km with 380 m of elevation gain, a mix of surfaces including forest trails and asphalt
Desítka: 10.4 km with 160 m of elevation gain, similarly varied terrain to the Devatenáctka
Kolečko: 2.9 km with 20 m of elevation gain, suitable for children and beginners
additional: The race uses chip timing, with instructions on how to position the chip correctly. Refreshment stations are available along the course and at the finish for the Devatenáctka and Desítka. A bonus competition for the fastest Kácov man/woman is available to permanent residents of Kácov. Children’s races have a voluntary entry fee and are divided by age. The race includes various categories, the surface combines roads and trails, registration is available online and on site, and the event supports local tourism.

name: Cross Parkmaraton
location: Krásná Lípa, Česká Švýcarsko, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Cross Parkmarathon in Krásná Lípa is a traditional race set in the picturesque surroundings of Bohemian Switzerland National Park. The course runs through hilly terrain, mainly along forest trails, with beautiful views of the Lusatian Mountains. The event offers various disciplines, including a marathon, half marathon, shorter runs, Nordic walking, canicross, and relay races. It is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages. In 2019, it received the Bohemian-Saxon Switzerland Regional Product certificate as a certified experience.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain, mainly along forest trails
Picturesque scenery in Bohemian Switzerland National Park
Views of the Lusatian Mountains
additional: Start times: Canicross and marathon at 8:00; all other races at 10:00. Relay teams have four members, each running approximately 5 km. Each team is responsible for transporting its members to the relay handover points. Awards are presented in age and gender categories. The marathon time limit is 15:00. Runners who cannot finish the marathon within the time limit may switch to the half marathon. The entry fee includes a race number. The race is part of Bohemian Switzerland Day and attracts regional and international runners. The event offers aid stations along the course and support from local sponsors and craftspeople.

description: The Chomutov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Chomutov in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a fast and attractive course that passes through the historic town centre, around the unique Kamencové Lake and through beautiful natural areas such as Bezruč Valley. The event also includes children’s categories and relay races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. Participants in the main race can look forward to refreshments along the course and at the finish, as well as a participant medal.
course_highlights: The historic town centre, with its Town Tower and diverse architecture
The world-unique Kamencové Lake and extensive recreational area
Romantic Bezruč Valley and the Chomutovka stream
additional: Registration for adults and the Kamencové Circuit is online from 8:00 to 10:30; children up to 15 years old can register on site from 11:00 to 13:30. The entry fee includes refreshments along the course and at the finish (fruit, water and an isotonic drink) and a participant medal. Free headbands are available with online registration and advance payment; T-shirts can be purchased together with headbands. Children’s races start at 14:00. The organiser reserves the right to change the order of the individual races. Trail course, online and on-site registration, refreshments at the finish and along the course, medals, T-shirts and free headbands with registration.

name: Běhej lesy Jizerská
location: Bedřichov, Jizerské hory, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Jizerská is a trail race held on 29 August 2026 in the picturesque Jizera Mountains in Bedřichov. It offers a range of routes, including short and long distances and an ultramarathon, passing through beautiful natural areas such as Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka and Olivetská hora. The race is part of the Běhej lesy series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, providing international ranking points. Runners can also take part in the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add competitive elements and prizes.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka and Olivetská hora
Conti Speed Section — a 150-metre speed segment on the Nova 11 km and ČSOB 23 km routes
Generali Investments Finish — a 500 m finish straight with a timed segment and prizes for the fastest men and women
additional: The race is part of the UTMB Index Races, with international ranking points. The Conti Speed Section is a speed segment with a prize worth 5,000 CZK. Generali Investments Finish is a 500 m finish straight with a timed segment and special jerseys for the winners. Online and on-site options are available to transfer registration and change the entry fee. The race includes a charitable component and offers fast, scenic routes in the Jizera Mountains. The start is at the cross-country skiing stadium in Bedřichov.

name: Mizuno Neon Run Praha
description: Mizuno Neon Run Prague is a night running event full of glowing neon lights and colorful zones, offering a unique experience rather than a race focused on speed. The run takes place in Bohnice, and participants receive a starter pack with a neon glow stick and a beautiful Unicorn medal at the finish. The event is held under the auspices of the mayor of Prague 6, and registration proceeds are donated to nonprofit organizations. After the race, there is an after-party with DJ René, adding to the evening’s overall atmosphere.
course_highlights: Night run with neon lights and colorful zones
Start and finish in Prague 8 – Bohnice
Glowing neon experience, with a neon glow stick included in the starter pack
additional: The race is split into start waves for the 5 km run and walk, including the charitable 2 km Fénix Run. After the race, the NEON NIGHT RUN after-party takes place with DJ René. You can purchase the SUPER package for an additional 300 Kč until 20.08.2026. The starter pack includes a neon glow stick. Registration and check-in take place from 17:00 to 20:00; the bag drop is open until 21:45. Neon glow sticks, medals, a festive evening atmosphere, online and on-site registration, and support for FénixRun charitable projects.

name: Proběhni si Zoo Ústí nad Labem
location: Zoo Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Run through Ústí nad Labem Zoo is a running event held on the grounds of the zoo in Ústí nad Labem. The run offers a unique opportunity to combine physical activity with a visit to the zoo and the chance to admire animals in their natural surroundings. The event is suitable for all age groups and encourages spending free time actively in nature. We look forward to your participation and sharing a memorable experience in the beautiful setting of the zoo.
course_highlights: Run through the zoo grounds with views of the animals
The route passes through varied terrain and natural scenery in the zoo
Combine a sporting challenge with a family visit to the zoo
additional: The zoo is open 365 days a year, and admission is charged at the zoo’s standard rates. Discounts are available for visitors with disabilities. The event is part of the zoo’s events calendar, which may be updated during the year. The event is primarily intended to support animal protection and nature conservation, with an emphasis on environmental education and community involvement.

name: 11 Bieg Kurierów Sądeckich
location: Rytro, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: od dnia 18.06.2025 i w dniu biegu: 60 zł lub 14€

description: The Bieg Kurierów Sądeckich is a historic mountain race held in the Beskid Sądecki Mountains, on a route from Rytro to the PTTK mountain shelter on Przehyba. The route is marked and covers a variety of surfaces: 15% asphalt, 5% gravel roads, and 80% forest trails, offering participants a chance to connect with nature on challenging terrain. The race commemorates couriers from World War II, and the course record is just under an hour. The organizer provides timekeeping, medical support, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race.
course_highlights: Marked route: 15% asphalt, 5% gravel roads, 80% forest trails
Start at Rytro PKP railway station; finish at the PTTK mountain shelter on Przehyba
Historic route associated with World War II couriers of the Home Army (AK)
additional: The race office is open on 30.08.2025 from 08:00 to 09:45. Participants receive a clothing bag for the baggage deposit, which will be transported to the finish. After the race, vouchers for a hot meal and tea are available. Timing is electronic, with manual recording as well. Medical support is provided during the race. A special prize of 500 zł is offered for beating Andrzej Długosz’s course record (00:57:58). The race includes asphalt, gravel, and forest sections, with electronic timing, medals, race bibs, and drinks for participants. Registration is available online, and the event is part of the local sporting tradition.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
location: Park za stadionem Piasta, Gliwice, Poland
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
price_range: wymagana wcześniejsza opłata startowa, szczegóły na stronie
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026. The events take place once a month on Saturdays in the park behind Piast Stadium. The 4,219.5-metre course runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt, and there is a refreshment point at the start/finish line. The event aims to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation under the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!”
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m course on forest trails, gravel paths and asphalt
A refreshment point with drinks at the start/finish line, available after each lap
The event takes place in a municipal forest in Gliwice, near Piast Stadium
additional: Events are held on Saturdays once a month in 2026. The run starts at 10:00 and Nordic Walking at 10:03. The course is not closed to other members of the public. The race office opens at 9:00 on the clearing near Piast Stadium. Online registration is available throughout the year, as well as at the race office on event day. Wheelchair participation is not permitted due to the terrain. The start and race office are on the clearing behind Piast Stadium. Information about the regulations and archival photos are available on the website.

name: Kunicki Bieg Reggae
location: GOKiS, Kunice, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Kunicach

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Opłata startowa do dnia poprzedzającego bieg

description: The Kunice Reggae Run is a nationwide sporting event held beside the picturesque Lake Kunickie in Kunice. Participants can choose from three certified race distances: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The start and finish are in front of GOKiS in Kunice, at 11 Słoneczna Street. The event combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and reggae music, attracting a growing number of participants from across Poland.
course_highlights: Race routes beside picturesque Lake Kunickie
Polish Athletics Association certification for all distances
Start and finish in front of GOKiS in Kunice, 11 Słoneczna Street
additional: A race pack for every participant, a commemorative finisher’s medal, prizes for category winners, timing provided by DataSport, and a post-race meal. The event takes place alongside the Reggae by the Lake Festival, and participants can look forward to support from the organizers and musical attractions.

name: NorDan RUN
price_range: 75 zł - 155 zł depending on distance and registration date
description: NorDan RUN is a race held in picturesque Wolsztyn, with routes along paths in the town park beside Lake Wolsztyn. Participants can choose from several distances, from shorter races for children to challenging 48 km routes with checkpoint and refreshment stations. The start and finish are located at the “Fala Park” venue, providing comfortable event facilities and beautiful views. The race is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Routes follow paths in Wolsztyn town park
Views of Lake Wolsztyn and the UMKS ZRYW kayak marina
Checkpoint and refreshment stations on the 10 km, 24 km and 48 km routes
additional: The start and finish are at the “Fala Park” venue, ul. Poznańska 1, 64-200 Wolsztyn. The routes have checkpoint and refreshment stations, with time limits on the longer distances (24 km and 48 km). There is no time limit at the station on the 10 km distance. Children’s races cover shorter distances from 300 m to 900 m, with different start times between 13:00 and 14:30. The event takes place in Wolsztyn, with online registration, an annual edition and a range of distance options.

name: Tatraman
location: Łapsze Niżne, Nowy Targ County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Tatraman is a challenging triathlon over the 1/2 Ironman distance, held in the scenic areas of the Polish and Slovak Spiš and the Tatra Mountains. The course runs from Niedzica on Lake Czorsztyn, through mountainous terrain, all the way to the summit of Kasprowy Wierch. The event is aimed mainly at experienced athletes, but amateurs can also test their skills on this extreme course. Tatraman combines sporting competition with beautiful views and Highland hospitality.
course_highlights: 2 km swim in Lake Czorsztyn; wearing a wetsuit is mandatory
90 km bike ride on the mountainous roads of the Polish and Slovak Spiš, with approximately 1,400 m of elevation gain
21.1 km run finishing at Kasprowy Wierch and following mountain trails
additional: The race office is located at Polana Sosny Campground in Niedzica and is open on August 28, 2026, from 16:00 to 21:00. The race starts at the Water Marina in Niedzica-Zamek and finishes at Kasprowy Wierch. The event is non-drafting; road and triathlon bikes are permitted. The time limit for completing the swim is 60 minutes, and the bike leg must be completed by 14:00. Transport is provided for participants and accompanying persons, along with recovery meals and an afterparty. Triathlon, mountain course, ½ Ironman distance, from Niedzica to Kasprowy Wierch

name: X Jubileuszowy Charytatywny Cross
description: The 10th Anniversary Charity Cross-Country Run and Nordic Walking event in Iwonicz-Zdrój is an annual sporting event held at Dietl Square in Iwonicz-Zdrój. The event combines a cross-country run and a Nordic walking march, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in this beautiful spa town. This anniversary edition attracts participants of different ages and skill levels. The organizers invite everyone to take part and emphasize the charitable nature of the event.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the spa town of Iwonicz-Zdrój
Nordic walking march as an integral part of the event
Start and finish at Dietl Square, the town’s central point
additional: The event takes place on August 28–30, 2026, at Dietl Square in Iwonicz-Zdrój. It is organized by the Centre for Culture and Reading in Iwonicz-Zdrój. No information is available about entry fees, start times, or participant limits. The event also includes Nordic walking, training preparations, and online registration. The run is part of local social and cultural initiatives.

BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL
location: Sportcsarnok, Kamilla utca 1-3, Telki, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Budai Night Trail is an exciting trail running race held at night on the scenic forest trails of the Buda Hills. Participants run with headlamps, enjoying a unique experience in the dark across varied terrain. The race offers two challenging distances, 13.5 km and 17.3 km, with significant elevation gain. The event has a friendly, intimate atmosphere, and the start is in Telki, at the Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Night trail running on the forest trails of the Buda Hills
Headlamp running across varied terrain
Marked route with significant elevation gain (490 m+ and 527 m+)
additional: Start times: 19:30 for the 17.3 km distance and 20:00 for the 13.5 km distance. Race-pack pickup: 18:00–19:15 (M distance), 18:00–19:45 (S distance). Cutoff times: 23:00 (S distance), 23:30 (M distance). Registration is online only; on-site registration is not available. The participant limit is 600 across the two distances. The race takes place outdoors in the dark, with headlamps, offering participants a unique experience.

name: MOVE SZOMBATHELY SUNSET RUN
description: The MOVE Szombathely Sunset Run is a unique evening and night running race held in Szombathely’s main square, offering children and amateur runners alike the opportunity to take part. The sunset and the atmosphere of the city centre give the race its special character, making for a pleasant and motivating running experience. The event aims to make running accessible to all age groups while also providing a shared community experience.
course_highlights: Run in Szombathely’s main square
Evening atmosphere after sunset
Distances suitable for children and amateurs
additional: The race is special because it is an evening and night run, something that has not previously been held in Szombathely. The organisers also share training tips for the 6 km distance, highlighting the importance of gradual progress and training 3–4 times a week to complete it successfully. Night running race, venue: Fő tér, Szombathely; starts at 17:00 and 19:00.

description: SUHANJ! 6 is a charity running race that supports people with disabilities and helps fund the nonprofit work of the SUHANJ! Foundation. The race takes place at the Margaret Island Athletic Centre, where participants run as many laps as possible in 6 hours on a flat, accessible 3.5 km loop. The race starts at midnight, and participants are guaranteed to see the sunrise. You can enter individually or in teams of 2–10, with unlimited relay changes allowed. The Éj Félmaraton (Midnight Half Marathon) also starts at midnight and takes place on the SUHANJ! 6 course; it is limited to 200 participants.
course_highlights: A 3.5 km-long, completely flat, accessible loop
2,500 metres of paved path along Margaret Island’s central road
A 400-metre synthetic track loop at the Margaret Island Athletic Centre
additional: Bib pickup is available August 25–29, 08:00–20:00, at SUHANJ! Fitness (6 Tátra Street, District XIII, Budapest). Headlamps are mandatory until dawn during the race. Using your own cup or bottle at the refreshment stations is recommended. The race centre has changing rooms, showers, toilets, baggage storage and a dedicated refreshment zone. Before the race, from 22:00 to 23:00, the SUHANJ! Handbike Grand Prix for athletes with mobility impairments takes place on the MAC track. After the race, participants can enjoy breakfast and a charity raffle. Completing the race supports the work of the SUHANJ! Foundation. Participation requires online registration; the programme also includes a course map, breakfast and a raffle.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, loop-based running race held in Dióskert, Törökbálint. Runners complete the half-marathon distance in four laps, but they can also choose to run fewer laps. The entry fee is voluntary: 500 Ft per lap, which helps cover the costs of the race. Every participant receives an apple, hot tea, mulled wine and a commemorative medal. The top three men and women receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The course is located in Dióskert, Törökbálint
The half-marathon consists of four laps, but runners may choose to run fewer
Friendly race with a voluntary entry fee of 500 Ft per lap
additional: Registration takes place at the venue. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women receive a special medal. Apples, hot tea and mulled wine will be provided. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. Participants may run fewer laps.

description: Draždiak Run je bežecké podujatie konané v Bratislave, v lokalite Veľký Draždiak, Petržalka. Pretekári môžu očakávať trate vedúce po štrkových a turistických chodníkoch, vhodné pre rôzne vekové kategórie a úrovne. Súčasťou sú detské behy, 5 km trate pre dospelých, nordic walking a rodinný beh so psom. Organizátorom je Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, ktorá zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu.
course_highlights: Povrch: štrkový chodník a turistický chodník
Miesto štartu: pláž pri bufete Barracuda, Veľký Draždiak, Petržalka
Trate pre deti, dospelých, nordic walking a rodinný beh so psom
additional: Štart detských behov je o 10:00. Kategórie zahŕňajú detský beh, 5 km beh pre mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových kategóriách, nordic walking 5 km a rodinný beh so psom na 1,8 km. Štartovné pre deti je nižšie ako pre dospelých. Registrácia je možná online do 21. augusta za výhodnejšiu cenu, potom nasleduje drahšia online registrácia do 4. septembra 2025, a nakoniec možnosť registrácie na mieste za najvyššiu cenu, ak nie je naplnená kvóta. Registrácia online do 21. augusta 2026, štart o 10:00, trať zahŕňa šotolínu, trávnaté a asfaltové úseky, rôzne kategórie vrátane rodinného behu a Nordic Walking

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom
location: Rekreačná oblasť Sninske rybníky, Snina, Slovakia
description: Beh pod Sninským kameňom je bežecké podujatie v rekreačnej oblasti Sninské rybníky v Snine, ktoré ponúka trate pre deti aj dospelých. Preteky sa konajú na povrchu asfaltu a poľných ciest, pričom detské kategórie majú vzdialenosti od 50 do 600 metrov podľa veku. Hlavná kategória štartuje o 16:30 hodine a je rozdelená podľa vekových skupín mužov a žien. Organizátorom je BehajmeSpolu o.z. v spolupráci s mestom Snina, pričom štartovné je 15 € pri online registrácii a 20 € na mieste.
course_highlights: Povrch: asfalt a poľné cesty (10%)
Rekreačná oblasť Sninské rybníky - OMW Snina
Viacero vekových kategórií od detí po seniorov
additional: Štart detských kategórií je o 15:00 hod., hlavná kategória štartuje o 16:30 hod. Kategórie sú detailne rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane juniorov a viacerých vekových skupín mužov a žien. Súčasťou podujatia sú trate pre deti od 50 m do 600 m, hlavná kategória na 6000 m, štart detí je naplánovaný na 15:30 a hlavný beh na 16:30.

name: Běh teplickými skalami
location: Teplicích nad Metují, Náchod District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
price_range: Základní 200 Kč, zvýšené 300 Kč, dodatečné 400 Kč (La Sportiva Cross); 100 Kč, 150 Kč, 200 Kč (Bufo Cross)
description: The Run through the Teplice Rocks is a public cross-country race held every year on the last Sunday in August in Teplice nad Metují. The race has been a tradition since 1994 and is part of the sporting programme of the International Mountaineering Film Festival. The 9 km course follows the Metuje River to the rock city, includes sandy sections and stairs, and returns along the same route. Since 2011, the event has also included a children’s race with age categories. The start and finish are at the TJ Slavoj football field.
course_highlights: 9 km course along the Metuje River and the Teplice rock city
Sandy sections and stairs on the sightseeing route
Start and finish at the TJ Slavoj football field
additional: Online registration until 26 August 2026 at the standard entry fee; 27–29 August 2026 at the increased entry fee; late registration on race day at double the entry fee. The children’s race starts in age categories on loop courses. The race office is located in the start and finish area at the football field. The race is part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series. A 9 km cross-country course with sandy sections and stairs; races for different age categories; online registration; the race takes place at the TJ Slavoj football field; part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series.

name: Běh zámeckou zahradou
location: Zámecký park, Lysá nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The Run Through the Castle Garden is a traditional running race held in the castle park in Lysá nad Labem. The 62nd edition takes place on August 30, 2025, and is open to a wide range of participants, from preschoolers to seniors. The race offers a pleasant setting in a historic park and encourages people of all ages to take part in sport. It is organized by T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem, which has long supported sport for everyone.
course_highlights: Castle Park, Lysá nad Labem
A route suitable for all age groups
A pleasant setting in a historic garden
additional: The race is part of Sokol’s long-standing tradition and is open to the general public, including children and seniors. It is organized by T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem. Information about the race is available on Sokol’s website in the events section. The race takes place in the castle park, is part of a long-standing tradition, and offers different categories for all age groups.

name: Běh Bezděkovem
location: Bezděkov pod Třemšínem, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh Bezděkovem is a traditional cross-country race with a course approximately 9 km long, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bezděkov pod Třemšínem. The course runs mainly along forest paths over varied terrain with gentle elevation changes and includes a mix of asphalt and rocky sections. The race starts by the hunting lodge and features a challenging climb with gradients of up to 7%, putting runners’ fitness to the test. After this demanding section comes a final descent and a flat finish, giving runners a chance to show their pace. Children’s races are also part of the event, making it appealing to a wide audience.
course_highlights: 90% forest paths over varied terrain, 10% asphalt
Clockwise loop with gentle descents and climbs
A 360-metre climb with gradients of up to 7% as a test of fitness
additional: Children’s races are part of the event. The start and finish are by the hunting lodge in Bezděkov pod Třemšínem. The course runs mainly along forest paths over varied terrain. Results are available from the organizers in PDF format. The course is approximately 9 km long; children’s races are available, and registration is possible in advance or on the day. The race takes place amid the Brdy countryside, with various categories and course lengths.

name: Kolínská desítka
location: Sportovní stadion Mirka Tučka, Kolín, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Kolínská desítka is a 10 km out-and-back race that runs on asphalt and a well-maintained forest path around the Mirek Tuček sports stadium in Kolín. The race is part of the Kolín Grand Prix and offers runners a pleasant mix of asphalt and natural surroundings. It is suitable for anyone looking for a fast yet scenic run in nature. Come and enjoy the race atmosphere and test yourself against other runners in the beautiful surroundings of Kolín.
course_highlights: A 10 km out-and-back course
A mix of asphalt and well-maintained forest paths
Start and finish at the Mirek Tuček sports stadium in Kolín
additional: The course is gently hilly, with an edge in the area around Veltruby. Registration is online. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners.

name: Rakovnická 15
description: Rakovnická Patnáctka is a 15 km road race whose start alternates each year between the towns of Rakovník and Křivoklát. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves on an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for anyone looking for a quality road race with tradition and the atmosphere of a regional running cup.
course_highlights: 15 km road course
The start alternates each year between Rakovník and Křivoklát
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup
additional: The race takes place in 2026, with the start scheduled for August 30 in Křivoklát. The course includes climbs and descents and is part of the region’s running cup.

name: Sázava - Lázek
location: Sázava u Lanškrouna, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Sázava-Lázek is an uphill race covering 7.9 km with 375 metres of elevation gain. The course starts on asphalt and continues along field and forest paths, with the steepest climb near the finish. This race offers challenging and varied terrain for runners seeking an outdoor challenge in the Pardubice Region.
course_highlights: 7.9 km course with 375 m of elevation gain
Route runs along asphalt, field and forest paths
The steepest climb is in the final section of the race
additional: On-site registration is available until 9:00; the race starts at 9:30. The race is open to runners of all levels, and the course offers technical challenges and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Běh okolo Hříšné Milady
location: okolí České Lípy, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Hříšná Milada is a cross-country race in the area around Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region, offering two courses of 12 km and 6 km. The route runs mostly along forest roads and footpaths that are open to regular use. The race is part of the District Running League and is suitable for trail-running enthusiasts looking for natural, technically interesting terrain. The main category traditionally starts at 11:45, making it convenient for a wide range of runners to take part.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly along forest roads and footpaths
Cross-country/trail character
Around Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region
additional: The race is part of the District Running League (www.oblcl.cz). The organizer is Pavel Souhrada; contact: 736 138 052. The race offers courses for children and adults, with loops of different lengths, and takes place around Česká Lípa at a water reservoir. Registration and further details are not specified.

description: The 11th Bieg po Oddech is a charity 5 km run through the streets of Zakopane, taking place on 30 August 2026. The event supports people with cystic fibrosis, and every participant receives a T-shirt and a medal. After the run, a family picnic with games and contests is held. The run promotes physical activity as part of rehabilitation and support for people with the condition, as well as social integration.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the picturesque streets of Zakopane
Start and finish in the City Park
The route is marked with vertical signs every 1 km
additional: Electronic timekeeping is provided by S-Time. After the run, there is refreshments and a family picnic with games and contests. The route, start and finish are in the City Park. The route is marked every 1 km. The virtual run of at least 5 km can be completed anywhere from 1 April to 30 September 2026. Participants can take part in the virtual run from April to September 2026, covering at least 5 km, or join the live event in Zakopane on 30 August 2026. Participants can expect race packs and a family charity picnic.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: The Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY are challenging cross-country races held in picturesque Przewodziszowice near Żarki, in the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The routes wind through Jurassic hills, limestone outcrops, dense forests, winding paths, rocky climbs and open spaces with views of the Jurassic Landscape Park. The event offers a variety of distances, from short races for beginners and Nordic walkers to the demanding Trentaraton for experienced runners. It’s a great opportunity to compete and enjoy the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Jurassic hills and limestone outcrops
Winding paths and rocky climbs
Views of the Jurassic Landscape Park
additional: The race office is open on 30 August 2026 from 8:00 to 10:00. Online registration is available until 24.08.2026; from 24.08.2026, registration is available only on race day at the race office. Children can participate for free. The event also includes Nordic walking over distances of 14 km and 7 km. Distances from 7 km to 30 km, races for children, on-site registration from 8:00, Jurassic terrain, races and walks, a sports and recreational event.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
location: Jezioro Kierskie, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held by historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim; a fast, flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań; and a run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds, a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swim in the calm, warm waters of Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon
A flat, fast bike course through villages and the western part of Poznań
A run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds
additional: The race starts in a rolling-start format. The start and finish venues are Lake Kierskie and the Poznań International Fairgrounds. IRONKIDS will take place the day before, on August 29, 2026, with a start time of 11:00. Registration for the main race is sold out; notifications are available in case additional places open up. Participants can change their race date free of charge under the Flex90 offer. The event also includes activities such as the Night Run and IRONKIDS, and the participant limit is 1,500. Registration requires a credit card.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are intended for both beginners and experienced runners, and aim to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. They are non-commercial and intimate, with a limited number of participants to ensure safety and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Trail routes through scenic forests and hilly areas of eastern Poland
Respect for nature and local communities
Small-scale events with a limited number of participants
additional: The races are small-scale, with a limited number of participants. The organizer provides electronic timing, medical cover, aid stations along the course and at the finish, and commemorative medals. Participants can earn points toward the overall standings and titles of Finisher and Super Finisher by completing multiple races. The organizer encourages respect for the environment and asks participants not to litter on the routes. The event brings together the trail-running community, promotes outdoor activity, and supports the development of the local running scene. Registration takes place through an online platform, and the event is part of a series held at various locations.

description: The Busko Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Busko-Zdrój. In 2026, it will take place on August 30. The race starts at 8:30 a.m. from the Municipal Stadium. The half-marathon route passes notable hotels and sanatoriums, the picturesque Spa Park, and charming promenades, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The time limit for covering the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The race is open to both experienced runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: The route passes notable hotels and sanatoriums in Busko-Zdrój
The race goes through picturesque Spa Park and charming promenades
A unique atmosphere and scenic surroundings along the route
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The route is established and popular, and this is the fourth year the race has been held on the same course. The event is organized by the Busko Sports and Recreation Centre and Athletics Busko-Zdrój Sports Club. GPX files of the route are available to download for Suunto and Garmin devices. Registration is open until May 31, 2026. Start time: 8:30 a.m. Time limit: 3 hours and 30 minutes. The route covers urban and park areas.

name: VII Maraton od Zmierzchu do Świtu
NYAKVÁGÓ MARATON
location: Kiskunság, near Ballószög, Bács-Kiskun County, Hungary

description: The Nyakvágó Marathon is a challenging trail-running race in the Kiskunság region, near Ballószög. It offers the marathon distance, but in tougher conditions. Distances include 14 km, 22.5 km and 42 km, as well as a mountain-bike race. The course runs through natural surroundings on agricultural dirt roads, with aid stations every 4–5 kilometres. The event aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local community together. Competitors must protect the environment and follow the rules; mountain bikers are required to wear helmets.
course_highlights: Natural terrain, agricultural dirt roads and woodland sections
Aid stations every 4–5 kilometres with water, fruit and glucose tablets
Red cinder running track for the children’s races, with no elevation gain
additional: Refreshments are provided every 4–5 kilometres, including water, glucose tablets and fruit; alcoholic refreshments are available at the finish. Wearing a helmet is compulsory for mountain biking. T-shirts can be ordered until August 10 and cost 5,000 HUF. The race runs on agricultural dirt roads, and participants must observe traffic rules. Competitors must protect the environment; littering will result in disqualification. The event includes chip timing, various running and cycling races, and hikes, giving participants the opportunity to explore the natural scenery and take part in sports.

description: The UFÓ Ócsa Run is a popular city race held in Ócsa, around the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre. The event offers several distances, including 10.5 km and 21 km races that pass through the town’s landmarks. The race uses a unique chip timing system, and places are ranked by gun time. With an informal, family-friendly atmosphere, age restrictions and a limited number of places, the event welcomes runners.
course_highlights: Urban setting, with a route passing Ócsa’s landmarks
10.5 km loop, completed multiple times on the longer distances
Varied terrain: asphalt, dirt road and cellar row
additional: The race uses a unique chip timing system that records both net and gun time. Placings are determined by gun time. The race is limited to a maximum of 550 participants. Residents of Ócsa receive a discount on the entry fee, which must be verified with a proof-of-address card. Registration is free for anyone born in 1960 or earlier. The race is part of the Ötpróba points-collection program, and participants can support the local community and promote physical activity at the event.

name: 3 x 1 km
location: Atletický stadion v Novém Jičíně, Kopřivnice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Atletika Nový Jičín, SVČ Fokus Nový Jičín
description: Atletika Nový Jičín and SVČ Fokus Nový Jičín are organizing a 3 × 1.5 km running race at the athletics stadium in Nový Jičín. The race is part of the Novojičínská běžecká liga and takes place on a varied surface comprising trails, asphalt and tartan. It is intended for adult runners divided into age categories by year of birth. Registration is online, and the race is scheduled to start at 17:00. The event offers an opportunity for sport and competition in the friendly atmosphere of the athletics complex.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the athletics stadium, in the Bocheta complex and on the asphalt surface of the former gardens of Gymnázium Nový Jičín
The course surface includes trails, asphalt and tartan
Race distance: 3 × 1.5 km
additional: Adult registration is online, with the following schedule: 16:00–16:45 registration, 17:00 start, followed by the awards ceremony. Categories are divided by age and gender, from men and women born in 1987 or later to older age groups. The race takes place on 2 September 2026. Registration is online, and the event is open to the general public, including children and adults.

name: Běh Anny-Marie
description: The Anna-Marie Run is a race held in Prague 4, featuring a 6.6 km course over mixed terrain through Milíčov Forest and over an artificial hill. The event is organized by the SABZO Praha association and is part of its running series, attracting runners of all levels. The course includes both forest trails and paved sections, making the race appealing to different types of runners. The race takes place on September 2, 2026, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere in Prague.
course_highlights: 6.6 km course through Milíčov Forest
Mixed terrain including forest trails and paved sections
Organized by the SABZO Praha association
additional: The race is part of the SABZO series and is intended for runners of all levels, with the opportunity to enjoy nature in Prague 4.

name: EMU 6 DAYS RACE / GOMU 6 DAYS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP
description: The EMU 6-Day Race, also known as the GOMU 6-Day World Championship, is one of the world’s most prestigious multi-day ultramarathon events, held in Balatonfüred. During the race, participants run for six days, testing their endurance and perseverance. The race is traditionally the pinnacle of multi-day ultrarunning, and world records have been set there. Competitors face a unique challenge that tests both physical and mental strength.
course_highlights: Six days of continuous running on the Balatonfüred course
Venue for world records in multiple categories
A challenging multi-day ultramarathon
additional: The event focuses on setting multi-day ultramarathon records; details of the race and the type of terrain have not been specified.

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
description: Beh Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč je tradičný bežecký pretek, ktorý štartuje v obci Ľubotín pri Polyfunkčnom dome. Pretek ponúka kategórie pre mužov, ženy, juniorov, nordic walking a hobby beh na 4 km. Štart hlavnej kategórie je o 17:30, detské kategórie začínajú o 16:30. Organizátormi sú obce Ľubotín a Plaveč, ktoré vítajú bežcov všetkých vekových kategórií a úrovní. Pretek je vhodný pre tých, ktorí chcú zažiť beh v peknom prostredí s cieľom na hrade Plaveč.
course_highlights: Štart v obci Ľubotín pri Polyfunkčnom dome
Cieľ na historickom hrade Plaveč
Trasa vhodná pre hobby bežcov aj nordic walking
additional: Štart detských kategórií je o 16:30, hlavnej kategórie o 17:30. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane nordic walking a hobby behu na 4 km po asfaltovej ceste. Obyvatelia Ľubotína a Plavča, ženy nad 60 rokov a muži nad 70 rokov majú štartovné zdarma. Možnosť zvýhodneného balíčka štartovného 20 € pre pretekárov, ktorí sa zúčastnia aj behu Jastrabskými vŕškami 2025. Podujatie zahŕňa kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny, vrátane juniorov a Nordic walking, s registráciou online a na mieste, s možnosťou získať zľavy pri včasnej registrácii. Súčasťou je aj detský beh a preteky na asfaltovej trati.

name: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3
description: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3 is a night race covering 10 km, taking place on September 4, 2026, in Jelcz-Laskowice. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for autumn races. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels so that everyone can prepare for the race in the best possible way. The event is aimed at runners who enjoy the atmosphere of running at night and sporting competition.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
A night race in the scenic town of Jelcz-Laskowice
A course suited to an intermediate difficulty level
additional: The organizer offers training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, as well as expert support. The event is promoted on the TreningBiegacza.pl platform, which enables race listing management and marketing collaboration. The event is part of local sports initiatives promoting outdoor activity and bringing the running community together.

name: Beh Novoveskou Hutou
location: Novoveská Huta, Spišská Nová Ves, Slovakia
organizer: Športový Klub ROHALS a Mesto Spišská Nová Ves

tiers.label: tier_2

price_tiers.distance: Dorast a beh pre zdravie 5 km

description: Športový klub Rohals vás srdečne pozýva na 16. ročník Behu Novoveskou Hutou, ktorý sa uskutoční v Novoveskej Hute. Pre dospelých je pripravená nová trať dlhá 12,2 km vedúca na Vojtechovu samotu a späť, jednotná pre ženy aj mužov. Pre tých, ktorí preferujú kratšie trate, je k dispozícii 5 km trať. Deti a mladí bežci budú súťažiť na kratších tratiach v uliciach Huty podľa vekových kategórií. Po behu si účastníci môžu doplniť energiu gulášom, deti sa môžu tešiť na divadielko a dospelých zabaví kapela 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: Nová trať pre dospelých vedie na Vojtechovu samotu (Šadroň) a späť
Dĺžka trate pre dospelých je 12,2 km, jednotná pre ženy a mužov
Krátke trate pre deti v uliciach Novoveskej Huty podľa vekových kategórií
additional: Prezentácia pre žiactvo je od 11:30 do 12:45, pre dorast a dospelých do 14:45. Štart možný len v jednej kategórii. Po behu je zabezpečený guláš, deti majú divadielko a dospelých zabáva kapela 3násť ciest. V kategóriách dospelých sa súťaží o body do Bežeckej ligy okresu Spišská Nová Ves. Trať 12,2 km a 5 km, kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny, registrácia v deň podujatia, sprievodné aktivity pre deti a dospelých

name: Marathon Chopok
description: Marathon Chopok je náročný horský beh v nádhernom prostredí Nízkych Tatier, ktorý preverí vaše schopnosti na rôznych povrchoch a terénoch. Pretek sa koná 5. septembra 2026 so štartom o 7:00 zo Srdiečka a cieľom na Chopku vo výške 2004 m n.m. K dispozícii sú dve hlavné trate: SkyMarathon Chopok s dĺžkou 43 km a prevýšením 2600 m, a kratšia Sky Race Jasná Trail s dĺžkou 21 km a prevýšením 1400 m. Na dlhej trati je tiež možnosť štartovať v štafetách. Trať vedie po južnej aj severnej strane Chopku, vrátane hlavného hrebeňa, a ponúka krásne výhľady a rôznorodý terén.
course_highlights: 43 km trať s 2600 m prevýšením cez Nízké Tatry na južnej a severnej strane Chopku
Prechod hlavného hrebeňa s rôznorodým povrchom náročným na výber obuvi
Cieľ na Chopku vo výške 2004 m n.m. s možnosťou rýchlej lanovky
additional: Možnosť štartu v štafetách na dlhej trati zo 4 alebo menej členov po cca 10-11 km úsekoch. Pretek je zaradený do kalendára Slovenskej skyrunningovej asociácie pre rok 2026. Trate sú rovnaké ako v predchádzajúcich ročníkoch, čo umožňuje porovnávať výkony. Diváci môžu sledovať pretekárov na viacerých miestach trate. Trail race s možnosťou relay tímov, štart o 07:00 a 10:00, súčasť kalendára Slovenskej skyrunningovej asociácie, trať vedie zo Srdiečka na Chopok a späť.

name: Kokava Trail
location: Kokava nad Rimavicou, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Kokava Trail je certifikovaný trailový beh so štartom a cieľom v Kokave nad Rimavicou, ktorý vedie okruhmi pohorí Veporské vrchy a Stolické vrchy. Preteká sa na dvoch tratiach - hlavná trať má dĺžku 78 km s prevýšením +3330 m a časovým limitom 18 hodín, kratšia Pasiečky Trail má 23 km a +1200 m prevýšenia s limitom 7 hodín. Trasa je rôznorodá, s 45 % lúčnych úsekov, 45 % lesných chodníkov a 10 % asfaltu, pričom neobsahuje ťažké technické pasáže, ale niekoľko strmších zostupov a výstupov. Pretekáči ocenia šesť občerstvovačiek a povinnú výbavu, ktorá zahŕňa izotermickú fóliu, čelovú lampu, mobil s nabitou SIM kartou, GPS zariadenie, reflexnú vestu a dostatok tekutín. Víťazi v kategóriách Muži, Ženy, Muži 50+ a Ženy 50+ získajú medaily a vecné ceny počas vyhlásenia v kultúrnom dome.
course_highlights: Rôznorodý povrch: 45 % lúka, 45 % les, 10 % asfalt
Prevýšenie +3330 m na hlavnej trati 78 km
6 občerstvovačiek na trati
additional: Povinná výbava zahŕňa izotermickú fóliu, čelovú lampu s novými batériami, nabitý mobil s aktivovanou SIM kartou, GPS zariadenie s trasou pretekov (power banka povinná pri navigácii mobilom), reflexnú vestu alebo pásky, minimálne 1,5 l tekutín, vlastný pohár alebo fľašu s širokým hrdlom, doklad totožnosti a viditeľné štartovné číslo. Ocenení sú prví traja v kategóriách Muži, Ženy, Muži 50+ a Ženy 50+. Trasa nemá ťažké technické úseky, ale obsahuje niekoľko strmších zostupov a výstupov. Na trati je 6 občerstvovačiek. Dve trasy: 78 km a 23 km, povinná výbava, certifikovaná trať, horský terén, registrácia online, súčasť Slovenskej Ultratrailovej Ligy

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo je súčasťou série bežeckých podujatí v Prešove, ktoré sa konajú počas roka 2026. Podujatie je určené pre všetky vekové kategórie a úrovne bežcov, od začiatočníkov až po profesionálov. Trate sú pripravené tak, aby spájali komunitu, podporovali zdravý životný štýl a prinášali radosť z pohybu. Súčasťou štartovného je časomiera, medaila, občerstvenie a sprievodný program. Deti, ktoré sú členmi Prešov Running Team, môžu bežať zdarma.
course_highlights: Trate pre rôzne úrovne bežcov od začiatočníkov po profi
Podujatie na Hlavnej ulici v Prešove s komunitnou atmosférou
Sprievodný program a občerstvenie pre všetkých účastníkov
additional: Štartovné zahŕňa štartovacie číslo s čipom, časomieru, medailu, občerstvenie, sprievodný program, zdravotnú službu, organizáciu pretekov a fotografie. Registrácia na mieste je možná podľa kapacity, ale odporúča sa včasná online registrácia. Štartovacie čísla sa odporúča vyzdvihnúť deň vopred v OC Novum. Deti členovia Prešov Running Team majú preteky zdarma po zaplatení ročného členského poplatku. Séria zahŕňa tri preteky v rôznych lokalitách Prešova s témami z fantasy, histórie a športu; registrácia je povinná; k dispozícii sú mapy, medaily a detské kategórie; súčasťou je aj tombola.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
description: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom je vytrvalostný bežecký pretek konaný v lokalite Veľký Šariš, okr. Prešov. Pretek je určený pre jednotlivcov i štafety, pričom kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia. Štartovné je jednotné pre všetkých bežcov a pretek ponúka možnosť otestovať svoju vytrvalosť v šesťhodinovom behu v krásnom prostredí pod hradom. Organizátormi sú Gejza Sabanoš a Ondrej Fedor, ktorí zabezpečujú hladký priebeh podujatia.
course_highlights: Pretek sa koná v okolí historického Šarišského hradu s krásnym výhľadom na okolitú krajinu
Možnosť zúčastniť sa v rôznych kategóriách vrátane reláknych pretekov
Dlhá, šesťhodinová výzva na vytrvalosť pre všetky úrovne bežcov
additional: Pretek zahŕňa rôzne kategórie a relákné možnosti; trať je situovaná v okolí hradu, avšak podrobnosti o teréne nie sú špecifikované

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
description: Ozorovská dvanástka je bežecký pretek konaný v Malých Ozorovciach, ktorý ponúka trate pre deti aj dospelých. Pretek je organizovaný OZ Zorovčan v spolupráci s obcou Veľké Ozorovce a pretekári môžu súťažiť na 6 km a 12 km tratiach s kategóriami podľa veku a pohlavia. Štart pre deti je o 9:00 a pre dospelých o 10:00 hodine. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru v blízkosti kultúrneho domu.
course_highlights: Trať vedie v Malých Ozorovciach s parkoviskom pred kultúrnym domom
Dve hlavné trate: 12 km a 6 km s kategóriami podľa veku a pohlavia
Štart detí o 9:00, dospelých o 10:00
additional: Kategórie pretekov zahŕňajú detské kategórie a vekové rozdelenie mužov a žien na 12 km trati (Muži A do 39, B 40-49, C 50 a viac rokov; Ženy F do 39, G 40-49, H) a 6 km trati pre mužov a ženy. Preteky sa konajú 5. septembra 2026, štart o 9:00 a 10:00, trať zahŕňa miestne cesty, registrácia online alebo na mieste

name: Horský kros Gerlach
description: Horský kros Gerlach je tradičný horský beh do vrchu, ktorý vedie z obce Gerlachov cez Velickú dolinu až k horskému hotelu Sliezsky dom. Trať má dĺžku 8400 metrov s prevýšením 879 metrov a pretekári prekonávajú kamenistý chodník a miestami asfaltovú cestu. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov, ktorí majú radi náročný horský terén a krásne výhľady na Vysoké Tatry. Súčasťou pretekov sú aj detské behy a možnosť zakúpiť si štartovné s originálnymi ponožkami Horského krosu Gerlach.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 8400 m s prevýšením 879 m
Kamenistý chodník a miestami asfaltová cesta
Cieľ pred horským hotelom Sliezsky dom
additional: Maximálna kapacita 200 pretekárov. Časový limit na Velickom moste (5,7 km) je 1:30 hod. Počas pretekov je zabezpečené občerstvenie na trati a v cieli, vývoz vecí do cieľa, a jedlo po pretekoch. Detské preteky (100-500 m) sa nevyhodnocujú, každé dieťa dostane medailu a sladkosť. Možnosť zakúpiť si štartovné s ponožkami HKG za 7 €. Pretek sa koná v horskom teréne, registrácia je možná na obecnom úrade, súčasťou sú aj detské preteky
