description: Vorkloster Run is a stage race held in the picturesque foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands and in the medieval atmosphere of Porta Coeli Monastery. The race features three stages of varying lengths and profiles, from a fast, flat stage to more challenging hilly sections. It is organised by the experienced DálRunDál team in cooperation with the Porta Coeli Monastery Brewery, adding to the authentic experience. The routes are carefully marked and run mostly away from traffic, with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape and historical sights.
course_highlights: Stage 1: 5 km, a fast, flat route on quality asphalt and a cycle path along the Svratka River, with views of Květnice Hill
Stage 2: 11.4 km, a hilly route on paved forest and field roads, with panoramic views of the foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands
Stage 3: 14.7 km, a moderately challenging route with one hill and a flat finish, passing beneath unique railway viaducts
additional: The first stage starts at 10:00 on Saturday. The route runs mostly away from traffic, along cycle paths and on quality asphalt. Bus transport is available approximately 10 minutes before the start from the car park near the start. Accommodation is available on the grounds of Porta Coeli Monastery in Předklášteří near Tišnov. The routes are carefully marked with arrows and course tape. The starting number must not be started on the bridge over the Svratka River, where an intermediate time is recorded. The race includes multiple stages with different distances and terrain, including team relay options. The event takes place in the beautiful setting of the historic monastery and surrounding countryside, with different start times and routes.

name: Běh s Klokanem
description: Běh s Klokanem is a traditional cross-country race in Olomouc-Hejčín, held every year in late September. The race is open to children and young people as well as adult athletes, and is part of the Olomouc Region Children’s and Youth Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. Men run 9 km and women 7 km, while shorter courses are available for children according to age group. The event is both sporting and social, with activities for children and parents, including games, scooter rides, puzzles and a raffle. Check-in takes place at Hospoda U Travise by Mlýnský potok.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on trails by Mlýnský potok in Olomouc-Hejčín
Men run 9 km, women 7 km, and children’s courses range from 60 m to 1.5 km depending on age
Part of the Olomouc Region Children’s and Youth Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners
additional: Check-in takes place at Hospoda U Travise. The accompanying programme includes scooter rides, sack races, puzzles, horse rides, a kangaroo-themed photo booth, an educational trail about kangaroos, a performance by the band 3+1 and a raffle with valuable prizes. All children receive sweets at the finish. Cross-country terrain, registration at Hospoda U Travise, an event for the whole family

name: Ostrava City Marathon
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 600-1500 Kč podle druhu závodu a data registrace
description: The Ostrava City Marathon is the oldest marathon in the Czech Republic and a summer running festival full of fun for all runners. It takes place on 6 September 2026 in the centre of Ostrava, at Masaryk Square, and offers distances for different ability levels, including a minimarathon, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. The event is for competitive runners and recreational runners alike, and also includes a charitable MiniMarathon. Alongside the races, a rich programme of activities will bring sport and culture to the city centre.
course_highlights: The course passes through Ostrava’s historic, industrial and green areas
Refreshment stations are placed approximately every 5 km and offer water, isotonic drinks and food
The start and finish are at Masaryk Square in the centre of Ostrava
additional: Runner check-in takes place on Saturday 5 September 2026 from 14:00 to 19:00 and on Sunday 6 September 2026 from 6:30 to 8:00 at the University of Ostrava City Campus. Timing chips are attached to the race bibs, which are non-refundable. Portable toilets and baggage storage are available at Masaryk Square. Showers and changing rooms are available in the City Campus building. Refreshments are available approximately every 5 km and at the finish. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square in the centre of Ostrava. Men over 70 and women over 60 can enter the marathon for free after obtaining a registration code by emailing info@ostravacitymarathon.cz. On-site registration is also available. The event offers refreshments, showers, medals and other participant amenities.

name: Podčerchovský kros
location: Chodov u Domažlic, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Podčerchovský Cross-Country Race is a challenging cross-country run held on Babí hora near Chodov. The course follows forest paths and includes several difficult climbs. The longest loop is 2.5 km and is suitable for runners wearing spikes. The race is open to all age groups, with distances ranging from children’s races to the men’s main race. Results are announced shortly after the race, and winners receive medals and prizes; cash prizes are also awarded in the main category.
course_highlights: The course follows forest paths
The longest loop is 2.5 km and includes several challenging climbs
Spikes may be worn
additional: Results for all categories are announced at 12:30. Categories have different distances: 1,100 m (2 × 550 m), 4,000 m (2 × 2,000 m), 5,000 m (2 × 2,500 m), and 7,500 m (3 × 2,500 m). Cash prizes are awarded in the men’s main category and to the women’s overall winner, subject to the organizer’s means. Runners can register in advance or on site. More than 100 runners take part, including children and young people, and the race is part of the Běžec Chodska series.

name: Běh na Lahti
description: We invite you to the 47th edition of the traditional Běh na Lahti running race, taking place on September 6, 2026, in Děčín. The race offers two courses: the main course is almost 10 km long with 230 metres of elevation gain, passing the Kvádrberk viewpoint and continuing above the village of Ludvíkovice; the shorter course is just under 5 km long with 130 metres of elevation gain. The route runs through the terrain of the Děčín forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River, offering beautiful views and a challenging run. Check-in and registration take place at the start from 8:00 to 9:45. The race starts at 9:00.
course_highlights: Off-road route through the Děčín forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River
Main course: 9.8 km with 230 m of elevation gain; starts at the Kvádrberk viewpoint
Short course: 4.9 km with 130 m of elevation gain; turnaround point by the cemetery in Ludvíkovice
additional: Check-in and registration at the start (Kvádrberk viewpoint) from 8:00 to 9:45. Children’s races are 100 to 1,000 metres long, depending on category. The main course is a loop with a turnaround point after 5 km; the short course has a turnaround point after 2.5 km. Registration is available online and on site. Course maps and GPX files are available on the race website. The race takes place above the sandstone canyon and offers different course lengths suitable for a wide range of participants.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - září
description: The Olomouc 2 Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. It takes place in the scenic Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily against themselves. The event also includes a cup competition, in which results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. Winners are announced in each category.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
Suitable for runners of all ages and abilities
Scenic setting by the park fountain, except for the June and August races, which take place by the river
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The top three finishers are announced in each category. The race is part of a year-round cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and points accumulated for taking part in multiple races. The race is run on paved paths in Smetana Gardens. Registration is optional and takes place from 9:30 to 10:00. The event focuses on the joy of movement and promoting sportsmanship.

name: Rychnov pomáhá během
location: Rychnov nad Kněžnou, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Rychnov Helps Run is a charity running race held in Rychnov nad Kněžnou, offering routes for children and adults in various age categories. The race takes place in early September and is known for its friendly atmosphere, accompanying program, and support for those in need. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, and the top runners in each category win valuable prizes. The event also includes an autograph session and a fun prize quiz, contributing to a family-friendly atmosphere and community spirit.
course_highlights: Routes for children from 400 m up to 10 km for adults
Start and finish at Poláčkovo Square in Rychnov nad Kněžnou
Childcare available during the race
additional: The accompanying program includes free taping and physiotherapy for runners, Spartan obstacles for children, a bouncy castle, creative workshops, face painting, InBody body composition analysis, and a photo booth. Food and drinks include sweet and savory options, lemonade, coffee, beer, and grilled specialties. A storage area, changing room, and toilets are available. The event supports charitable causes, offers online and on-site registration, and features photo galleries and support for female athletes.

name: Běh mezi mosty
description: Běh mezi mosty is a charity sporting event organized by Domácí hospic Athelas and Spolek Přátelé Kamenného mostu Písek. This run, which revives the tradition of the original race, is for everyone who wants to support seriously ill patients and their families. Participants can run, walk, or make a symbolic contribution. The entry fee is a donation that helps provide care at home for those who can no longer run. The event takes place in Písek and offers a range of routes, including children’s runs and family walks.
course_highlights: Routes run over concrete, asphalt, cobblestones, footbridges, and forest terrain
The courses are mostly flat, with a hilly elevation gain of 144 m
The race takes place around the Stone Bridge in Písek, with safety measures and volunteer support
additional: Registration is available online and on site on race day by the Stone Bridge. Race numbers and timing chips are distributed from 11:00. The program starts at 12:00, with a warm-up for children at 13:00. Children’s races start from 13:15, and the main races from 14:00 to 15:30. Routes are marked with white arrows, and there is a lead cyclist and volunteers along the course. Parking, facilities, and refreshments are provided. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a raffle. Terrain: concrete, asphalt, cobblestones, footbridge, forest terrain; T-shirts available to buy on site; various age categories and route lengths.

name: Jihlavský půlmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 500 Kč na osobu při elektronickém přihlášení a bezhotovostní platbě

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 600 Kč při osobním přihlášení na místě závodu

description: The Jihlava Half Marathon is a traditional 21.0975 km race run over two laps in the centre of Jihlava. The race is open to individual runners, pairs and teams of four, and features an officially measured course with kilometre markers. The event also includes a Family Run and children’s races, which support a charity project for Filípek. It takes place at the Český mlýn complex and offers quality facilities, chip timing and refreshments for runners.
course_highlights: Officially measured 21.0975 km course over two laps
Course marked at every kilometre
Start and finish at the Český mlýn Sports and Recreation Centre in Jihlava
additional: The race bib includes a timing chip, which does not need to be returned. The time limit for the half marathon is 3 hours; the course will close at 15:00. T-shirts can be ordered during online registration for 250 Kč, or purchased on site for 300 Kč while supplies last. The event also includes relay races for pairs and teams of four, a Family Run (1.1 km) and children’s races. Race-day check-in takes place from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Český mlýn complex. The race is run over two laps, with the start in the centre of Jihlava. Registration is available online or on site. The time limit is 3 hours, and race day is 6 September 2026.

name: Běžíme pro náhradní rodiny
description: We Run for Foster Families is an event organised by CPNRP, o.p.s., which supports children growing up in alternative family care and their foster and adoptive parents. The event aims to raise awareness of these children’s needs and to support a stable, loving environment for their development. The run gives the general public an opportunity to show support and solidarity with alternative families. The organisation has long provided professional counselling, training, and support for foster and adoptive families.
course_highlights: A choice of route distances, including 4 km, 8 km, and 1 km for strollers and walkers
Proceeds support alternative families and children in care
Family activities, face painting, and an accompanying programme
additional: The event takes place on 6 September 2026. It is part of a wider charitable project supporting child care, with online registration and accompanying activities.

name: Horský čtvrtmaraton Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch
location: Jablonné nad Orlicí, areál koupaliště, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Jablonné nad Orlicí–Suchý vrch Mountain Quarter Marathon is a mountain race taking place on September 6, 2026, in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The course crosses mountain terrain to Suchý vrch and is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Krkonoše Mountain Running Cup. The race covers approximately 10 km with around 580 metres of elevation gain. The course challenges both endurance and trail-running technique. On-site registration is available, and the race is for runners looking for a challenge in nature.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain around Suchý vrch
Approximately 580 metres of elevation gain over a course of around 10 km
Part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup
additional: The race starts at the swimming pool grounds in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The course runs over mixed terrain. On-site registration is available. The start is at 10:30, and registration closes before the race begins.

name: 14 Tyski Półmaraton
location: Stadion Lekkoatletyczny w Tychach, Tychy, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 14th Tychy Half Marathon is a PZLA-certified half-marathon (21.0975 km) run through the streets of Tychy and around Paprocany Lake. The start, finish and race village are located at the Tychy Athletics Stadium. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the city’s sporting atmosphere, and also offers numerous accompanying attractions, such as children’s races, massages and sports demonstrations. The course was modified in 2022 to reduce the number of uphill sections, making it more participant-friendly. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Tychy and has been growing in popularity since 2012.
course_highlights: Street course and route around Paprocany Lake (asphalt, paving stones and paved path)
Vertical signs mark every kilometre
Finish at the Tychy Athletics Stadium
additional: The time limit is 3 hours. Electronic timing uses a chip in the race bib, with net-time classification. Water stations are available along the course. The race office and race-pack collection will be available on 4–5 September 2026 at Gemini Park Tychy, and on race day from 6:30 to 8:30 at the stadium. The race pack includes a chip bib, technical shirt (if the entry fee is paid by 2 August), medal, hot post-race meal, drinks, medical support and course safety measures. Children’s races take place before and after the main race. The event will take place in an urban setting, with race offices at Gemini Park Tychy and the Athletics Stadium. The programme also includes races for the youngest participants.

name: 26 Eco Półmaraton Wałbrzych
description: The 26th Toyota Eko Półmaraton Wałbrzych is one of the most important running events in the region and across the country, attracting runners from all over Poland. Following last year’s organisational success and record attendance, the event once again confirms its strong position on Poland’s sporting map. Participants rated the half-marathon course very highly, and the unique atmosphere created by the supporters of Wałbrzych gives the event its distinctive character. We warmly invite you to take part and cheer on the runners.
course_highlights: New, highly rated half-marathon course
Unique atmosphere thanks to Wałbrzych’s supporters
An event with an established place on Poland’s sporting map
additional: On 24.08.2025, there will be traffic disruptions and special transport for participants and supporters. A Racebook is available—a practical guide with essential information before the start. In addition to the half-marathon, accompanying races and junior races are also organised. Registration opens on 27 January 2026; the event includes a half-marathon, 10 km races and children’s races. Participants can choose from different race packages and enjoy attractions at the Old Mine.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
description: Join the 44th International Open Cross-Country Race for the Forest Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, taking place on 6 September 2026 in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two 3.2 km loops, with the start and finish in the same place. The event has a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for the whole family amid nature. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and an athlete, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.
course_highlights: Main race course: two 3.2 km loops
Start and finish at the same point
Forest and natural surroundings in Obliwice
additional: Race schedule for 6 September 2026: ceremonial opening at 11:00; races for children and young people over 600 m and 1.609 km; main race start at 13:20 over 6.4 km; mayors’ and VIP race at 14:00; International Mile in memory of Piotr Gładki at 17:00; and the Ecological Feast at 17:30. Around 300 athletes are expected to take part in the main race. The top athletes in the main race qualify for the International Mile. Forest terrain, online registration, accompanying events, sports memorial.

name: Bieg KoBBiet
location: Stadion Miejski, Bielsko-Biała, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: KoBBiet Run is an annual race held in Bielsko-Biała. In 2026, it will take place on September 6 at the Municipal Stadium. The event is dedicated to the memory of Ewa Szymanek-Płaska, Head of the Education and Sport Department at Bielsko-Biała City Hall. This year’s race supports children on the autism spectrum, and registration opens on April 10, 2026, at 10:00. The race is held under the honorary patronage of Bielsko-Biała Mayor Jarosław Klimaszewski.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of central Bielsko-Biała
Start at the Municipal Stadium, finish at Wojska Polskiego Square
5 km distance with attractions at the finish
additional: The event supports children on the autism spectrum. Registration is available at datasport.pl. The race is dedicated to women, and commemorative medals and attractions await at the finish.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness on an easy asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual level, with support from experts. The event has a friendly, motivating atmosphere and is ideal for anyone looking to improve their fitness and enjoy running.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Easy asphalt surface
Scenic surroundings of Bukownica
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels and accompanied by instructions and expert support. Training preparation is available to participants, and the event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in the local community.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (9)
organizer: AWF Katowice, KS AZS AWF Katowice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w wysokości 20 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: pozostałe osoby – w wysokości 45 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_5
tiers.description: małżeństwa – w wysokości 80 zł przelewem na konto

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the scenic Panewniki forests in Katowice. The event aims to promote an active, healthy lifestyle and the beauty of the local natural environment. The course is a loop of approximately 4.9 km, which participants can complete up to four times, with a time limit of 3 hours. The event is open to both recreational participants and athletes affiliated with sports clubs. Participants can also learn about appropriate conduct in the forest.
course_highlights: A course of approximately 4.9 km through the Panewniki forest
The loop is marked every 1 km
The course can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for completing the running and Nordic walking course is 3 hours. Participants can purchase a package of entries for the entire year 2026. People born in 1950 or earlier are exempt from the entry fee. Entry fees are non-refundable, but can be transferred to a later event after notifying the organizer. The event includes training preparation and information about training plans, making it appealing to runners of different experience levels.

name: XVIII Bieg Koguta
description: The 18th Bieg Koguta is a 10 km race in Oława, taking place on September 6, 2026. The event is organized by the Oławska Grupa Biegowa in cooperation with local institutions, and participants can expect professional timing. The race office will be open both the day before the race and on race day, making it easier to collect race packs. The race is open to runners of different ability levels.
course_highlights: A 10 km distance in the picturesque surroundings of Oława
Professional electronic timing
Support from local institutions and partners, including the “Termy Jakuba” Municipal Swimming Pools
additional: The race office is open on September 5 from 16:00 to 20:00 and on September 6 from 07:00 to 09:15. Participants must accept the race regulations and consents related to the processing of personal data. A third party may collect a race pack upon submission of the appropriate consent. The race office is located at the venue the day before the race. Online registration is available. Participant limit: 891.

name: Bieg na Rowerze - Rower na Biegu
41. Wizz Air Budapest Félmaraton
location: Budapest, Pázmány P. rakpart, Budapest, Hungary
description: The 41st Wizz Air Budapest Half Marathon is Hungary’s largest half marathon and will take place in Budapest on September 6, 2026. The race follows a beautiful and varied route through some of Budapest’s most scenic areas, with more than ten thousand fellow runners taking part. The course is fast and scenic, and the atmosphere is electric, with music points and enthusiastic spectators cheering on the runners. The half marathon is an ideal distance for both beginners and experienced runners, with a unique finisher’s medal waiting at the finish line.
course_highlights: Fast course through some of Budapest’s most scenic areas
Varied, scenic route
Fun music points and enthusiastic crowds of spectators
additional: Registration is currently open only for the individual 21.1-kilometre race, but the 10 km, pairs and trio events will be available soon. Online registration is available exclusively with card payment at nevezes.futanet.hu. A BSI account registration is required to enter. The unique finisher’s medal can be collected at the finish line. Advice is available on preparing for warm weather, hydration and race preparation, and virtual participation is also an option.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Srbsko
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka Running Series in Srbsko is a community trail race held mainly on the Heart of the Bohemian Karst Educational Trail. The route starts by the railway station and passes over the Srbsko footbridge, by the Bubovice Waterfalls and through the Kačák Valley along the Berounka River to the finish. The race offers beautiful natural scenery, a friendly atmosphere, and refreshments and bag storage on site. Every participant receives a race number, and the top three in each category receive certificates.
course_highlights: The route follows the Heart of the Bohemian Karst Educational Trail, marked in red and white
A climb past the Bubovice Waterfalls and over Doutnáč Hill
Running through the Kačák Valley alongside the stream and the Berounka River
additional: Registration is available online and on site. Every participant receives a race number. Please arrive by 17:45 at the latest. Refreshments and bag storage are available on site. The top three finishers in each category receive certificates. The race is part of a series of 12 trail races held around the Berounka River, from Radotín to Nižbor, with varying distances and elevation gain. The start is generally accessible by train; races have water stations and category awards. The race takes place on 7 September 2026 in Srbsko.

name: S kopečka do kopečka
description: The S kopečka do kopečka Run is a traditional endurance race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, giving runners the chance to test themselves on a challenging course in Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is ideal for anyone looking to enjoy a run in beautiful surroundings and take on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Challenging hilly terrain in Olomouc
Part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix
Traditional endurance run with a long history
additional: A 7.8 km cross-country race in Olomouc, taking place on 9 September 2026. The race is open to runners of all levels and offers the chance to take part in a friendly atmosphere with support from the local running community.

name: Okolo Lováku
description: Okolo Lováku is a running race in Šumperk that is part of the Šumperk Winter Running League. The course runs through the picturesque countryside around Sklený vrch and Lovák, features interesting off-road sections, and offers an opportunity for athletes of all levels. The race is popular with local runners and promotes an active lifestyle in the region. It is organized by the Šumperská sportovní project, which supports sports and leisure activities in Šumperk and the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The route runs around Sklený vrch and Lovák
Interesting terrain with natural panoramas
Part of the Šumperk Winter Running League
additional: The race is part of the winter running league in Šumperk. It is organized by the Šumperská sportovní project, which supports sports and leisure activities in the region. Runners can look forward to an interesting course and a friendly atmosphere. The race is part of a winter running series, registration is available online, and the race includes timing and refreshments after the race.

name: Novostrašecký běh - Memoriál Vildy Šubrta
location: Nové Strašecí, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Novostrašecký Run – Vilda Šubrt Memorial is a traditional running race held in Nové Strašecí, offering a 6 km course. The race takes place at the SK Nové Strašecí football stadium and in the surrounding area, on a mix of asphalt, dirt roads and forest trails. The main category is scheduled to start at 18:00. The race is open to the general public; the entry fee for adults is 100 Kč, while children can take part for free. Online registration is available even on race day, making it easy to enter.
course_highlights: The course follows asphalt, dirt roads and forest trails
Start and finish at the SK Nové Strašecí football stadium
Mixed-terrain race with a distance of 6 km
additional: Online registration is available even on race day. The race is organized by the town of Nové Strašecí; the contact person is Ivana Rezková. Children can take part for free. The race takes place at the football stadium and in the surrounding area. Online registration; an event suitable for the whole family.

name: Geofyzikální běh
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Geophysical Run is a traditional running event organized by the Institute of Geophysics of the Czech Academy of Sciences, held in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4. It has a long history dating back to 1985 and offers a sporting experience in nature with a scientific setting. The event is suitable for the general public and combines physical activity with the promotion of geophysics and the natural sciences.
course_highlights: The route runs through picturesque Krč Forest in Prague 4
The run is part of a traditional event held since 1985
Natural terrain suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The event is organized by the Institute of Geophysics of the Czech Academy of Sciences and is part of the institute’s social activities. The run is held regularly in September and is associated with promoting science and geophysics. The website also lists other institute activities, but specific information about registration and entry fees is not published. The race is held annually, with both scientists and members of the public taking part, and is part of a broader series of runs in Prague.

name: 7. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park B. Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: The Run for Health is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km course that everyone can run at their own pace. Proceeds from entry fees go to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. The start is traditionally at 17:45 at Lodičky, with check-in beginning at 17:00. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.
course_highlights: A 3 km route in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park
A running-friendly cycle path surface
A charity run with proceeds going to help those in need
additional: Check-in begins at 17:00, and the start is at Lodičky. A series of seven runs where everyone can run at their own pace. Proceeds from entry fees go to help those in need. Course: cycle path; distance: 3 km; registration from 17:00, race at 17:45; series of seven races during 2026

name: Witzenmann Opavská míle

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrace do 25. 8. 2025 budou mít na startovním čísle jméno

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Registrace od 26. 8. do 3. 9. 2025, platba pouze kartou, na startovním čísle nebude jméno

description: Witzenmann Opavská míle is a prestigious one-mile (1609 m) running race that continues the tradition of the Stanislav Mikeska Memorial. The race is open to a wide range of participants, including professionals, amateurs, children, families, corporate and school teams, people with disabilities, and wheelchair users. It takes place in Opava and is supported by its general partner, Witzenmann Opava. The course record is held by Filip Sasínek, with a time of 3:55 minutes set in 2023. The race is held regularly and is one of the most significant running races in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: A course exactly one mile long (1609 m)
An official middle-distance athletics event
Suitable for all age groups and different types of teams (corporate, family, and school)
additional: Race categories include men and women in various age groups, children’s categories, and corporate, family, and school teams, with rules for team composition and scoring. Team registration allows members to be added using the team name and PIN code. Payment is possible by card or bank transfer. The organiser reserves the right to make changes. The race takes place on 4 September 2025, with payment by card or bank transfer, and is part of the TIPSPORT SPORTUJ S NÁMI 2025 series. Historical results and information about previous editions are available on the official website.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Liberec

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Liberec is a charity running event taking place on September 10, 2026, at the Vesec sports complex. Participants can choose between a 3 km course (1 lap) and a 6 km course (2 laps), with the run starting at 20:00. The entry fee is CZK 500, half of which supports the Světluška project and half of which goes toward direct assistance for people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program, including a concert, and race packs with a headlamp or a sports headband for those who register early.
course_highlights: Night run at the Vesec sports complex
Choice of a 3 km or 6 km course
Start at 20:00, with an accompanying program and concert
additional: Registration desks open at 18:00. Race packs come in two options: with a headlamp or with a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards, together with a companion, can enter free of charge, but are not entitled to a race pack, which can be purchased on site for CZK 250. Registration is via the GoOut.cz portal. An admission ticket with a unique code is required to enter the venue (printed or on a mobile device). Start at 20:00; registration from 18:00; free registration for holders of ZTP and ZTP/P cards; proceeds from the event support people with visual impairments.

name: Běh Akátkami

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: Běh Akátkami is a regular running race in Brno-Židenice, offering courses for men, women, and children. Men run 5.2 km (3 laps), women run 3.6 km (2 laps), and children of any age have their own 1.6 km loop. The race takes place in the evening, with registration from 17:15 and the main race starting at 18:00. Refreshments and bag storage are available after the finish. Participants run at their own risk and can use public transport and nearby parking.
course_highlights: A 1.6 km loop in Brno-Židenice
Men run 3 laps (5.2 km); women run 2 laps (3.6 km)
Children's race, with the loop distance set before the start
additional: Registration takes place at the race venue from 17:15. The children's race starts at 17:45, and the men's and women's main race starts together at 18:00. Water and a tent for bag storage are available after the finish. Transport: parking is available in the adjacent streets; trolleybus lines 25, 26, and 27 stop at Pálavské náměstí. The start is scheduled for 18:00. The race provides refreshments, water, and bag storage; on-site registration is also available.

name: Prajzské kilo
description: Prajzské kilo is an ultratrail race through the Hlučín region, recalling the historic borders and stories of a region divided in 1742. The race offers three distances—30, 50 and 100 km—with different time limits and elevation gain. You’ll run through a landscape of old roads, chapels and field tracks, bearing the marks of history and local identity. The race is scored as part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and also offers UTMB Index and ITRA points. It includes a unique medal, a T-shirt, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and childcare for the shorter distances.
course_highlights: 30, 50 and 100 km routes with 270, 350 and 600 m of elevation gain
Run through the Hlučín region, passing historic landmarks and chapels
7 aid stations on the 100 km route, GPS live tracking and online tracking
additional: The entry fee includes a unique metal finisher’s medal, a commemorative magnet, a cotton logo T-shirt, a hot meal at the finish (meat or vegetarian), refreshments on the course, GPS live tracking (100 km), childcare for the 30/50 km distances (registration required), online tracking at checkpoints (30/50 km), timing, and scoring in the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup, with UTMB Index and ITRA points. Course records are waiting for your time; race distances: 30 km, 50 km and 100 km; time limits: 6–24 hours; childcare for 30/50 km; GPS live tracking; scoring for UTMB and ITRA points.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026
location: Radkowskie Lake, Radków, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: 50 mil, Ultramaraton, Maraton, 24 km, Półmaraton, 10 km
description: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026 is a mountain trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Stołowe Mountains, near Radków Reservoir. The courses pass through rocky labyrinths, technical trails and beautiful rock formations such as Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały. The event attracts both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners, offering a variety of distances and a special atmosphere close to nature. Radków is an ideal place for a sporting adventure and recovery amid nature.
course_highlights: Scenic trails in the Stołowe Mountains with rock formations
Courses passing near Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały
Radków Reservoir nearby as a place to recover
additional: Award ceremonies take place after each distance. Race packets are distributed at specified times before the start and during the event. Starts take place in waves, with the longest distance starting at 05:00 and shorter distances starting in the following hours. Garmin Junior races are also available for children in various age categories. Participants can visit the EXPO and follow results online and download finisher certificates. Trail running, multiple distances, registration details, scenic mountain terrain, event dates September 11–13, 2026

name: Nočný beh mestom Lučenec
location: Synagóga, Adyho 69/7, Lučenec, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
description: Nočný beh mestom Lučenec je nočný bežecký pretek vedený osvetlenými ulicami mesta Lučenec s dĺžkou trate 4,5 km. Podujatie je určené pre širokú verejnosť vrátane juniorov a dospelých, s kategóriami podľa veku a pohlavia. Organizátorom je Mesto Lučenec a OZ Novohrad, pretek sa koná pri Synagóge s elektronickou časomierou a čipovou technológiou. Štart je plánovaný na 19:30 a pretekárov čaká pamätná medaila, štartové číslo, občerstvenie a sprievodný program.
course_highlights: Nočné osvetlené ulice mesta Lučenec
Dĺžka trate 4,5 km
Elektronická časomiera s čipovou technológiou
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je 15.9.2025 od 17:00 do 19:00 pri Synagóge. Kapacita pretekárov je limitovaná na 350 účastníkov. Štartovné zahŕňa pamätnú kovovú medailu, štartové číslo s logom podujatia, koláž fotografií zaslaných e-mailom, zdravotnú službu, občerstvenie a program show. Preteky sa konajú za čiastočne obmedzenej premávky a na vlastné nebezpečie. Podujatie zahŕňa registráciu online a na mieste, maximálny počet účastníkov je 350, sú súčasťou aj medaily, štartovné čísla, fotografie, zdravotná starostlivosť a občerstvenie.

name: Školáčik detský beh
description: Školáčik detský beh je bežecké podujatie pre deti rôznych vekových kategórií, ktoré sa koná v Lučenci pri synagóge. Organizátormi sú mesto Lučenec a OZ Novohrad. Preteky sú určené pre chlapcov a dievčatá od 3 do 15 rokov vrátane, vrátane detí so zdravotným hendikepom. Štartovné je symbolické a podporuje účasť detí na športových aktivitách v príjemnom prostredí mesta.
course_highlights: Preteky pre deti od 3 do 15 rokov v rôznych vekových kategóriách
Bežecké trate prispôsobené veku a schopnostiam detí
Organizované v centre mesta Lučenec pri synagóge
additional: Štartovné je 5 € pri online registrácii do 12.9.2025, na mieste 7 € ak bude voľná kapacita. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku od 3 do 15 rokov vrátane detí so zdravotným hendikepom. Organizátormi sú mesto Lučenec a OZ Novohrad. Kontaktná osoba: Marian Duzbaba, tel: 0907146181. deti rôznych vekových kategórií, štartovné online a na mieste, lokalita Lučenec, synagóga

name: Beh okolo Lysej
location: Lysá pod Makytou, Púchov District, Slovakia
description: Beh okolo Lysej je tradičný bežecký pretek v obci Lysá pod Makytou, ktorý ponúka rôzne kategórie pre deti, juniorov, ženy a mužov podľa veku. Preteky sa konajú pri kultúrnom dome a sú organizované Bežeckým klubom Lysá pod Makytou. Štart pre deti je o 11:00, pre kategórie E, ženy a juniorov o 12:30 a pre mužov o 13:00. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje aktívny životný štýl v regióne.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú v obci Lysá pod Makytou pri kultúrnom dome
Viacero vekových kategórií od materskej školy po veteránov nad 70 rokov
Štart rozdelený podľa kategórií: deti, juniori, ženy a muži
additional: Štart pre deti o 11:00, pre kategórie E, ženy a juniorov o 12:30, pre mužov o 13:00. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku od materskej školy až po veteránov nad 70 rokov. Organizátorom je Bežecký klub Lysá pod Makytou. Pretek pravdepodobne prebieha v prírodnom alebo horskom teréne; podrobnosti o registrácii nie sú špecifikované; dátum konania: 12. september 2026

name: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky
description: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky sú nočné trailové preteky v krásnej vinárskej oblasti Topoľčianok, ktoré sa uskutočnia 12. septembra 2026. Bežci si užijú trasy vedúce okolo Zámku v Topoľčiankach a Hradu Hrušov, s lesnými cestičkami a atmosférou pod hviezdami. Preteky sú súčasťou série Behaj lesmi a sú zaradené do medzinárodného UTMB Indexu, čo zvyšuje ich prestíž. Súťažiť sa bude na dvoch hlavných trasách - 11 km a 22 km, pričom na trati je aj rýchlostný úsek Conti Speed Section s hodnotnou výhrou.
course_highlights: Trasy vedú cez vinársku oblasť s výhľadmi na Zámok Topoľčianky a Hrad Hrušov
Lesné cestičky s mäkkým povrchom vhodné na trailový beh
Nočný beh pod hviezdami s označeným rýchlostným úsekom Conti Speed Section
additional: Súčasťou pretekov je Conti Speed Section - rýchlostný úsek na 150 metroch s možnosťou vyhrať voucher na pneumatiky a bežecký dres. Preteky sú nočné, čo prináša jedinečnú atmosféru a zážitok. Trasy sú z 80 % na mäkkom povrchu a 100 % na čerstvom vzduchu. Súčasťou série Behaj lesmi s viacerými podujatiami po Slovensku a Česku. Pretek ponúka viacero trás vrátane detského preteku s cenami od 5 EUR pri kúpe 7 a viac pretekov, súčasťou je aj zábavný program pre deti, registrácia mimo stránky Terminovka.sk a možnosť účasti na nočnom behu.

name: Marina Liptov RUN
organizer: Olympijský klub Liptova a rezort Marina Liptov
description: Marina Liptov RUN je športovo-rekreačné podujatie v krásnom prostredí rezortu Marina Liptov pri Liptovskej Mare. Tento netradičný beh ponúka spojenie prírody a kvalitných služieb v harmónii so štyrmi živlami - ohňom, vodou, zemou a vzduchom. Bežci si môžu užiť pokojné a inšpiratívne prostredie s výhľadmi na okolitú prírodu a možnosťou relaxu po behu v rezorte. Marina Liptov je ideálnym miestom pre športovcov aj rodiny, ktorí hľadajú zážitok v prírode.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie v prírodnom prostredí pri Liptovskej Mare
Krásne výhľady na okolitú prírodu, lúky, hory a lesy
Pokojné a harmonické prostredie štyroch živlov prírody
additional: Marina Liptov ponúka ubytovanie, wellness, vodné aktivity, lodenicu a prístav, čo môže byť využité bežcami pred alebo po pretekoch. Otváracie hodiny rezortu sú denne od 09:00 do 19:00. V okolí je možnosť turistiky, cyklistiky, lyžovania a rybolovu. Trať je 9 km trail s možnými zmenami, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, sú zabezpečené technická a zdravotná podpora.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 3. Jesenné kolo
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany
price_range: 7€ online, 10€ na mieste; zľavy pre obyvateľov obce a deti
description: Lemešanská bežecká liga - III. jesenné kolo je bežecká súťaž organizovaná v obci Lemešany v krásnom prostredí Záhrady pohybu. Pretek je určený pre všetky vekové kategórie a výkonnostné úrovne, ponúkajúc príjemnú atmosféru a možnosť športového vyžitia na čerstvom vzduchu. Organizátorom je Záhrada Pohybu, ktorá sa stará o kvalitné podmienky pre šport a rekreáciu.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú v areáli Záhrady pohybu v Lemešanoch
Trasa vhodná pre všetky vekové a výkonnostné kategórie
Príjemné prírodné prostredie s pumptrackom a ihriskom
additional: Pretek je súčasťou série Lemešanskej bežeckej ligy, ktorá zahŕňa štyri kola v roku 2024 s možnosťou štartovať na všetky za zvýhodnené ceny. Podujatie je vhodné pre rekreačných aj výkonnostných bežcov, s možnosťou registrácie online alebo na mieste.

name: Beh pre Labky jesenný špeciál
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: Beh pre Labky jesenný špeciál je bežecké podujatie v Košiciach, časť Kavečany, pri chate Hrešná, ktoré organizuje Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov UVP. Pretek je určený pre rôzne kategórie vrátane žien, mužov, detí a bežcov so psami, vrátane psov z útulku. Trať má dĺžku 5 km a ponúka príjemnú jesennú atmosféru v prírode. Štartovné je dostupné online za zvýhodnenú cenu a na mieste za vyššiu sumu. Podujatie podporuje adopciu psov a spája bežcov so zvieratami v priateľskom prostredí.
course_highlights: Trasa dlhá 5 km v prírodnom prostredí Kavečian pri chate Hrešná
Možnosť bežať so psom, vrátane psov adoptovaných z útulku
Kategórie pre ženy, mužov, deti do 15 rokov a bežcov so psami
additional: Kategórie zahŕňajú ženy, mužov, deti do 15 rokov a bežcov so psami vrátane psov z útulku. Štartovné je 10 € pri online registrácii do 19.9.2025, na mieste 15 €. Organizátorom je Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov UVP. Miesto štartu je chata Hrešná v Kavečanoch, Košice. Podujatie je outdoorové, vhodné pre psíkov a ich majiteľov, s dôrazom na charitatívne účely a komunitnú atmosféru

name: Night run Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, R M s.r.o.
description: Night run Michalovce je nočný bežecký pretek, ktorý sa koná na Námestí osloboditeľov v Michalovciach. Pretek ponúka tri trate rôznych dĺžok: 10 km, 5 km a 3 km, vhodné pre rôzne vekové kategórie a výkonnostné úrovne. Štart pre dospelých je o 19:00 hod., detské preteky začínajú o 17:00 hod. Organizátormi sú Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce a R M s.r.o. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť, ktorá si chce užiť športovú atmosféru v nočnom prostredí mesta.
course_highlights: Nočný beh v centre Michaloviec na Námestí osloboditeľov
Tri trate: dlhá 10 km, stredná 5 km a krátka 3 km
Kategórie pre všetky vekové skupiny vrátane detských pretekov
additional: Pri úhrade štartovného na mieste je možné platiť aj platobnou kartou. Preteky majú kategórie podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane juniorské, mužské a ženské kategórie. Detské preteky štartujú o 17:00 hod. Podujatie začína o 19:00 pre dospelých a o 17:00 pre deti; je možné sa registrovať online, registrácia je spojená s poplatkami a termínmi; podrobnosti o registrácii a termínoch sú dostupné na oficiálnej stránke.

name: Beh do Choča

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Výška štartovného v dátume od 14.8.2023 do 28.8.2023 (vrátane) je 20 EUR pre všetky kategórie s výnimkou kategórie Juniori, Juniorky, Muži D, Ženy H a Muži X.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Pre kategórie Juniori, Juniorky, Muži D, Ženy H a Muži X je štartovné 15 EUR.

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Po 28.8.2023 je výška štartovného 25 EUR pre všetky kategórie s výnimkou Juniorov, Juniorky, Mužov D, Žien H a mužov X.

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: Pre Juniorov, Juniorky, Mužov D, Ženy H a mužov X je štartovné 20 EUR po 28.8.2023.

description: Beh do Choča je unikátna bežecká akcia v srdci Oravy, ktorá preverí vaše fyzické schopnosti pri behu na vrchol Veľkého Choča. Trať vedie po turistických značkách s prevýšením a ponúka krásne výhľady a prírodné prostredie Národnej prírodnej rezervácie Choč. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetkých milovníkov behu, športu a prírody, ktorí chcú zažiť výnimočnú atmosféru a zároveň si užiť kvalitné občerstvenie a odmeny. Beh je zároveň spomienkou na Joža Čajku, športovca a priateľa s veľkým srdcom.
course_highlights: Výstup po zelenej a červenej turistickej značke na vrchol Veľkého Choča
Občerstvenie na poľane Drapáč a na vrchole Choča
Stop čas na poľane Drapáč s limitom 1:15 hodiny
additional: Maximálny počet štartujúcich je 250. Registrácia je možná online do 6.9.2023 alebo ráno v deň pretekov od 7:30 vo Vyšnom Kubíne. V cene štartovného je občerstvenie na trati, obed a darčekový predmet. Trať je vyznačená farebnými stužkami, skracovanie trasy vedie k diskvalifikácii. Prví traja v kategóriách získajú vecné ceny a finančné odmeny, vrátane prémií za traťový rekord. Pretek je súčasťou série horských pretekov, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, súčasťou sú občerstvenia a finisher darček. Pretek je organizovaný v rámci Národného parku Choč a je určený pre všetky úrovne bežcov.

name: Okolo Kolovrat
description: Běh Okolo Kolovrat is a traditional race that takes you through the beautiful surroundings of Kolovraty, including the neighboring communities of Uhříněves and Lipany, and part of Říčany. It offers 11 km and 21 km routes, with the shorter distance also available as a two-person relay. The courses run mostly along tree-lined country, meadow, and forest paths, offering a wonderful running experience in nature. The race is suitable for all runners looking to improve their time or set a personal course record.
course_highlights: Routes follow the Okolo Kolovrat walking loops, with a short stretch through neighboring communities
Mostly tree-lined country, meadow, and forest roads and paths
The main course crosses beyond Prague’s borders to Říčany, along the 50th parallel
additional: The shorter distance is also available as a two-person relay. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Detailed race information is available in the attached PDF and on the race website: https://ok.nasekolovraty.cz. Trail running, distances of 11 km and 21 km, relay option, beautiful natural scenery, event held in September 2026, support for the local community, and refreshments at the start and finish area.

name: Přeloučská desítka
description: Přelouč Ten is a running race held in Přelouč, offering 10 km and 5 km courses and a 1 km children’s race. The race takes place on asphalt roads, paved surfaces and paths, with minimal elevation gain. The start and finish are on Masaryk Square. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes running as a social phenomenon. Refreshments and SMS delivery of results are provided after the race.
course_highlights: Course with no significant elevation gain
Surface: 60% asphalt, 40% paved surfaces and paths
Start and finish on Masaryk Square in Přelouč
additional: Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. An SMS with your finishing time will be sent after the race. On-site registration will not be available. You can purchase a Přelouč 10 technical T-shirt for CZK 490. Trophies and prizes will be awarded to the top three men and women. Races: 5 km, 10 km and a 1 km children’s race. Online registration only. Start and finish on Masaryk Square in Přelouč. The event supports patients with butterfly skin disease (DEBRA ČR).

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
price_range: 500 Kč - 200 Kč (dle tratě a data registrace)
description: ČEZ RunTour Brno is a family-friendly running event held by the Brno Reservoir, offering courses for all ages, from children to experienced runners. Choose from 500 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon (21.1 km) distances. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent facilities, and activities for the whole family. Every participant receives a race pack and contributes to charity. ČEZ RunTour is ideal for recreational and elite runners who want to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of the Brno Reservoir.
course_highlights: Courses run around the Brno Reservoir, with unique views
Children’s races over 500 m and 1,000 m, with a kids’ corner and childcare
Aid stations on the half-marathon course and other longer courses
additional: The event provides a race pack, pacer and medical teams, a special emergency-service phone line during the race, refreshments at the finish and on the course, an official gymsack with gifts from partners, a kids’ corner with childcare, and activities for the whole family, including warm-ups and fun in the children’s zone. Multiple courses, a charitable contribution, medal engraving, online and on-site registration, facilities by the Brno Reservoir

name: Běh na Boží horu
location: Ivančice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Boží hora is a traditional race in Ivančice, challenging participants to run up 109 steps to Boží hora. Participants start individually at one-minute intervals, ensuring a smooth race. The event is part of the wide range of activities organized by the Ivančice Leisure-Time Centre, which has a long-standing tradition and support from the town. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a unique sporting experience in an attractive setting.
course_highlights: Run up 109 steps in Ivančice
Individual starts at one-minute intervals
A traditional event with a long history in Ivančice
additional: Participants start individually at one-minute intervals. The race regulations are available to download in the events section of the website. The race is open to all age categories, with the option to download the regulations and register online. The event is held regularly and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Běh Kovohutěmi
location: TJ Kovohutě stadion, Lhota u Příbramě, Příbram District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 50,- předem, 100,- na místě, děti a nad 60 let zdarma
description: The Kovohutě Run is a traditional running race held in Lhota u Příbramě since 1967. It offers a 12 km main race as well as races for children and young people. The event takes place at the TJ Kovohutě stadium and is popular with runners of all ages. It attracts many participants every year and is part of the Brdy Running Cup.
course_highlights: 12 km main race
Races for children and young people
Start and finish at the TJ Kovohutě stadium in Lhota u Příbramě
additional: The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. Registration and provisional start lists are available for the main race, children’s and youth races, and the milers’ race. The races include the 12 km main course and children’s and youth races across various age categories. They take place on a hilly road with asphalt and grass surfaces.

name: Strojařská desítka
description: Strojařská desítka is a traditional road race in Zlín, now being held for the 42nd year. The race offers 10 km and 5 km courses with 153 metres of elevation gain on a certified out-and-back route between Zlín’s Maják, the U Boudy junction, Salaš, and back. The start is always at 10 a.m. by the headquarters of the Road Maintenance Administration on K Majáku Street. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all categories who want to compete in Zlín’s beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 10 km out-and-back road course with 153 metres of elevation gain
Certified route between Zlín’s Maják, the U Boudy junction, and Salaš
Start and finish by the Road Maintenance Administration on K Majáku Street
additional: The race is part of the Běhy Zlín running series. Junior and children’s categories have specific registration and scoring rules. Results and photo galleries are regularly published online. Bib numbers and other race information are available on the official website. The race is run on a forest road: a hilly, asphalt surface. Registration is available in advance or on the day; results are available online.

name: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run of Friendship Klenčí pod Čerchovem–Waldmünchen is part of the Běžec Chodska running series, which offers a diverse range of races around the Chodsko region. This race takes place in the picturesque setting of Klenčí pod Čerchovem and attracts runners of all ages. The course is suited to nature lovers and trail runners, while the race atmosphere encourages a friendly gathering of the running community. The Běžec Chodska series is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, ensuring an enjoyable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Run in the picturesque setting of Klenčí pod Čerchovem
Trail course suited to nature lovers
Part of the Běžec Chodska running series, which has a long tradition
additional: The race takes place in September 2026. The course is approximately 15.5 km long and is suitable for runners of all levels. The event combines a celebration of friendship with a sporting competition.

name: Bezdězský půlmaraton
location: Doksy, Liberec District, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Bezděz Half Marathon is a running race held in the picturesque Máchův kraj region around Bezděz Castle. It offers two routes of approximately 13.6 km and 21.2 km, with 200 to 300 metres of elevation gain, running along forest roads, trails and short sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants and is complemented by children’s races. Refreshments, luggage storage, toilets, and a results ceremony with a raffle are available at the venue. Capacity is limited to 500 participants, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the extensive forests of Máchův kraj and around Bezděz Castle
The course surface includes paved and unpaved roads, trails and short sections of asphalt
Two refreshment stations on the 21 km course, one on the 13 km course
additional: On-site check-in and registration are available from 8:30 to 10:30; race capacity is limited to 500 participants. Luggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments and a raffle are available for runners. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main 13 km and 21 km races begin at 11:00. The route is marked with streamers, signs and flour, with approximate markers every kilometre. Registration is available via the official website. The race takes place in September 2026, and the course includes natural terrain and forest roads.

name: 7 pohoří Krkonoše
description: The Trail Run Seriál 7 pohoří is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races feature technical trails, epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. Whether you’re an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 pohoří will test your strength, willpower and determination. Conquer all the mountain ranges and become a trail-running legend.
course_highlights: Technical trails with around 900–1,230 m of elevation gain on the main courses
Epic views of prominent peaks and landscapes, including Ještěd, Bezděz, Kozákov, Trosky, Zvičina and Velká Deštná
Routes follow mountain paths, ancient trails and natural areas in national parks
additional: The time limit for completing the race is 4 hours. After that, runners are marked as DNF. Every participant receives a commemorative finisher’s medal and has access to refreshments on the course and at the finish. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. Small items can be stored at the registration tent. The event takes place in all weather conditions, and participation is at your own risk. The course includes mountain trails, technical sections and scenic viewpoints. Registration includes a course map, chip timing, a medal and refreshments.

name: Běh k Mohyle Hanče a Vrbaty
location: Bílý most přes Labe, Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Run to the Hanč and Vrbata Memorial is a traditional mountain race held in the Krkonoše Mountains. It starts at the White Bridge over the Elbe in Špindlerův Mlýn and finishes at the Hanč and Vrbata Memorial. The 9 km course with 696 m of elevation gain runs mainly on asphalt and trails, offering beautiful views and unforgettable experiences. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners across different age categories. Refreshments and a raffle are available after the race, and public transport can be used to return from the finish area.
course_highlights: 9 km course with 696 m of elevation gain
65% asphalt, 35% trails
Start at 715 m above sea level, finish at 1,411 m above sea level
additional: The maximum number of entrants is 100. Race-day check-in takes place from 9:30 to 10:30 in Špindlerův Mlýn. There are two aid stations on the course with water and sports drinks. After the race, there is a raffle and refreshments are available at Vrbatova Bouda. Changing rooms and showers are not provided. Light personal belongings can be transported from the start to the finish. Trail race with 696 m of elevation gain, starting at the White Bridge over the Elbe and finishing at the Hanč and Vrbata Memorial. Registration is available online and on site. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup.

description: Dětmarovická 10 is a traditional running race held in the village of Dětmarovice, featuring a main 10 km race, a 2 x 5 km relay, and children’s races called Cipísek’s Run. The route runs mainly along asphalt roads and forest trails, combining fast sections with gentle challenges and offering scenic corners of the village. The race is intended for both experienced runners and enthusiastic amateurs, with the joy of running and sporting atmosphere more important than performance. Short children’s courses with a cheerful atmosphere and illustrations of Cipísek are also on offer. Registration is online, with the option to sign up on site. Participants receive a race number with a timing chip and gifts from the event’s partners.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along asphalt roads and forest dirt-and-gravel trails within the cadastral area of Dětmarovice
A combination of fast sections and gentle challenges suitable for experienced and amateur runners
Scenic corners of Dětmarovice with a unique atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are by the Dětmarovice Sports Hall. Participants receive a race number with a timing chip. Refreshment stations are at the 6 km mark and at the finish. Medical services are available at the finish. Transport between relay legs is provided for the 2 x 5 km relay. Children’s races are divided by age into 100 m, 200 m, and 400 m distances. On-site registration is possible, but the same benefits as with online registration are not guaranteed. The race includes electronic registration, chip timing, medical coverage, refreshments, and a raffle. The route includes asphalt, forest, and gravel paths and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines the excitement of sport with tangible support for an important social cause: the mental health of children and young people. The event will take place across Poland on September 12, 2026, encouraging participants to run together and take action for their communities. Every lap, kilometre and minute on the course matters, highlighting the spirit of community and helping others. This anniversary edition invites runners to take part and show their support.
course_highlights: Multiple locations across Poland, including Gdańsk, Ruda Śląska, Łomża, Krosno and Stalowa Wola
Virtual run option using an app
Charity relay races and runs for children and adults
additional: The event takes place across Poland, combining physical activity with a charitable cause supporting the mental health of children and young people. The PKO Charity Run is an initiative where it is not just the result that matters, but above all, acting together and supporting the community. The event supports the mental health of children and young people, includes relay races and fundraising for therapy, participation in many cities across Poland, and a virtual participation option.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
location: Piwniczna-Zdrój, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg 7 Dolin is a 100 km mountain ultramarathon held in the scenic Sądecki Beskid Mountains, starting and finishing in Piwniczna-Zdrój. The course follows demanding mountain trails with significant elevation gain, offering participants exceptional views and a chance to connect with nature. The race is part of the Running Festival, which combines sporting competition with promoting the region and an active lifestyle. The time limit is 19 hours, and there are aid stations and drop-bag points along the course. It is a challenge for experienced mountain runners looking to take on demanding but beautiful terrain.
course_highlights: +3,740 m / -3,740 m elevation change over the 100 km course
6 aid stations and 3 drop-bag points along the course
The route follows trails in the Sądecki Beskid Mountains, with views of the mountains and the Poprad Valley
additional: The time limit to finish the race is 19 hours (until 21:00). Intermediate cutoffs: Rytro (36 km) — 7 hours (until 09:00); Krynica (62 km) — 12 hours (until 14:00); Wierchomla (89 km) — 17 hours (until 19:00). Recommended technical gear includes a reusable cup or bottle, a running backpack or belt, an emergency blanket, a headlamp, reflective gear, health insurance, a whistle, hand sanitizer, and a working phone with an ICE number written on the back of the race bib. The event features several distances, including 100 km, 42 km, 61 km, 23 km and 11 km, as well as accompanying attractions such as festivals and an expo. The races take place in early September 2026.

name: 5 Aktywna Piątka
price_range: 100 zł w dniu zawodów, wcześniejsza rejestracja
description: The 5th edition of the “Aktywna Piątka” race will take place on September 12, 2026, in Frydek, in the Miedźna Municipality. It is a fast road race on a route exactly 5 km long, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), starting at 11:00. The event will also host the Silesian Voivodeship 5 km Championships, and the participant limit is 600. The accompanying Family Run is for children and teenagers up to 15 years old and features three distances.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km route certified by the PZLA
Asphalt course, marked every 1 km
Water station and cooling mist arches along the route
additional: The participant limit for the main race is 600. The first five women and men in the OPEN classification will be awarded. The race starts at 189C Modowa Street. The accompanying Family Run is for children and teenagers up to 15 years old, with three distances: 800 m for ages 10–15 and shorter distances for younger age groups. The commemorative medal is awarded only to the registered main participant in the Family Run. The limit for paid entries is 400. Running with a dog, wheelchair, or stroller is not permitted.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of races organised by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing runners together from different regions. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or experience, and participants can compete in running, Nordic walking and canicross. The races take place on forest and urban routes, creating a welcoming atmosphere of sporting competition and community. The Grand Prix is a tradition and a passion that has brought runners together for many years.
course_highlights: Forest routes near Bolina
A range of events: running, Nordic walking and canicross
Participants from many cities and sports clubs in the Silesian and Lesser Poland Voivodeships
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in Grand Prix events is free of charge. Both runners and Nordic walking and canicross participants take part. Competitors come from various cities and sports clubs, and women make up more than 27% of participants. The event includes various distances and seasonal races, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.

The event has a friendly, family-like atmosphere and provides professional RFID chip timing. Participants can enjoy the natural beauty of the Bódva Valley and its varied terrain.

Varied terrain close to nature in the Bódva Valley
Professional chip timing (RFID, HuTag)

The event offers several distances and race categories, so every member of the family can find a suitable option. description: The 3rd Pannonhalma Decem Run is a friendly and varied running race set in the picturesque surroundings of Fenyvesalja in Pannonhalma. The race offers two distances, 5 and 10 kilometers, for running enthusiasts to enjoy the natural surroundings and clearly marked routes. The event aims to provide a motivating and enjoyable sporting experience for all ages, while participants discover the beauty of the local landscape. The race is part of the Ötpróba series, a recreational sports program encompassing multiple sports and events.
course_highlights: 5 and 10 km distances around Fenyvesalja in Pannonhalma
Varied terrain close to nature
Clearly marked and safe route
additional: Participants receive a medal, gifts, and refreshments at aid stations. The venue is easy to reach, and the community experience is a key focus.

description: The XI Moonlight Run is an atmospheric running race in the town of Szob, taking place on September 12, 2026. Participants receive timing, a race bib, and a unique finisher’s medal. The event takes place under medical supervision, and the organizers prioritize the experience of taking part.

Refreshments on the course and at the finish
A unique finisher’s medal for every participant
additional: Medical supervision is provided at the race. Runners are welcomed at the finish with traditional bread spread with lard and onions. Every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal. The race offers runners several distances, including options for children and adults at different difficulty levels. The event is traditionally held in mid-September and offers participants a unique experience through its location and organization. The event’s patron is Olympic champion Dr. Antal Kovács, further enhancing the race’s prestige.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5–2 km kids’ race, 4–4.5 km light, 8–9 km classic

Separate awards for girls and boys in every distance

Participants must select and confirm their distance in the registration system. The course is a varied obstacle course. Online and on-site registration are available, and registration is also possible on race day. The event includes a children’s race, chip timing, refreshment stations, outdoor showers, and changing facilities.

Refreshments and medical supervision are provided during the event, and runners are welcomed at the finish with traditional bread with pork fat and onions. The race is organized by Proathlon Bt., with support from the local municipalities.

Refreshments on the course and at the finish, with medical supervision

Preteká sa na tratiach 2,5 km a 5 km, pričom kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, dospelých aj seniorov. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí si chcú užiť športový deň v príjemnom prostredí obce.

description: Okolo Muňáku is a family running race in Munice near Hluboká nad Vltavou, offering a relaxed atmosphere and a fast course around Munický Pond. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is open to all age groups, including children’s races. Each year, it supports the Centrum Bazalka charity, which receives part of the entry fees. After the race, a varied accompanying programme is prepared, including a raffle and prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: 10 km course with 35 metres of elevation gain
Mostly paved cycle paths (60% asphalt, 40% gravel)
The route goes around Munický Pond, Hluboká, the ZOO and Bažantnice
additional: Children’s registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:30, and the main race starts at 13:30. A race bib printed with your name can be ordered until 10 September. Members of #tymdejvid can enter for free. After the race, there is a raffle, and children receive a ZOO ticket and a medal. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup; the course is fast and flat. Starts take place from 9:30 to 15:30, and registration is open until 13 September 2026.

name: Vrchlabský 1/2 Maraton
location: Náměstí T. G. Masaryka, Vrchlabí, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Vrchlabí City Half Marathon is the first edition of a half marathon held in the heart of the Krkonoše Mountains, at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí. During the race, participants will enjoy a sporting challenge on paved roads and field and forest paths, as well as a cultural programme and a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main half marathon, shorter 2 km and 9 km routes are available for children, juniors and families with children, taking them through the town and its side streets. The event brings together running, experiences and community, and is co-financed by the State Environmental Fund of the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: The course follows paved roads and field and forest paths
Start and finish at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí
The town’s side streets are part of the shorter routes for children and juniors
additional: The 2 km race starts at 13:00, with age categories 7–9, 10–12 and 13–15. The half marathon (21.1 km) starts at 15:00, with age categories 18–29, 30–39, 40–49 and 50+. Parking is available in the town centre; some car parks charge a fee, while others are free. The larger car park near the monastery is temporarily closed. The car park by the cultural centre is recommended; it is within a 10-minute walk of the square. The course includes paved roads and field and forest paths; registration is available using the contact details on the website.

name: Forestova čtrnáctka

description: Forestova čtrnáctka is a 14 km running race around Záluží near Plzeň, featuring a mix of field, forest and gravel roads with light trail terrain. The race is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, who can take part for free. Runners can look forward to plenty of refreshments, a participant medal and race photos. Check-in begins at 9:00 and the start is scheduled no later than 9:45. The race takes place in all weather. The organizer emphasizes participants’ safety and fitness to compete; everyone takes part at their own risk.
course_highlights: 14 km route along field, forest and gravel roads with light trail terrain
Pink arrows on the ground, supplemented by red-and-white tape, mark the course
Plenty of refreshments at the finish, including drinks, fruit and homemade cake
additional: Check-in begins at 9:00. On-site registration is available until 30 minutes before the start, and the organizer issues race numbers 20 minutes before the start. Runners receive a participant medal and refreshments at the finish. Toilets are provided by Johny servis mobile toilets. The start is in Záluží near Plzeň, which is best reached by tram no. 4. Each participant takes part at their own risk and is not insured by the organizer. Registration takes place 30 minutes before the start; the start is scheduled for 9:00 in the morning. The race is part of a series of trail events in the region and is suitable for the general public.

The race offers various distances, from short children’s categories to the 8 km main race, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The main race starts at 11:30, while the children’s categories start from 10:30. The race is suitable for the general public and offers prizes to winners in individual categories. Entries can be submitted on-site on race day from 8:00 to 9:45.

Additional distances for children and youth, from 200 m to 5 km
The race is part of the 2026 ISCAREX Cup
