The race starts at the Amálka cottage and focuses on mountain running in nature, with on-site registration available from 8:00 to 9:45. The event is part of a cup series and offers different distances for various age categories and levels of runners.

name: Kokořínský kros
description: Kokořínský Kros is a trail run held in the picturesque Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, near Prague. The race offers three main routes of 15 km, 10 km and 5 km, winding through romantic ravines and past unique sandstone towers. The start and finish are at the municipal spa complex in Mšeno, where facilities include refreshments and a children's corner. The race is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offers a wide range of categories, with the option to change route distance even on race day.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque landscape of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, with sandstone rocks and ponds
Romantic ravines and unique sandstone towers, which are rare in the Czech Republic
Start and finish at the municipal spa complex in Mšeno, with the option to go swimming
additional: A children's corner for children aged 3 to 10, with art activities and supervision by an experienced teacher. Route distance can be changed during race-day registration. Finish-line refreshments include Corny bars, bananas, water and Ionilyte sports drink. Parking is available in a designated car park approximately 200 m from the race facilities. Dogs are not allowed in the swimming pool complex. Trail courses with registration available, gift vouchers, on-site parking and refreshments, and the option of individual entry fees with a personalized race number.

name: Hostivařská 15°
price_range: 500 Kč online / 700 Kč na místě (15 km), 400 Kč online / 500 Kč na místě (5 km), 200 Kč online / 250 Kč na místě (děti)
description: Hostivařská 15 is a family-friendly trail race in the natural surroundings of Prague’s Hostivař district, offering more than just a test of performance. The race takes place around the reservoir, golf course and meanders of the Botič, mostly on forest trails with very little asphalt. The race is run without timing equipment; the winner is the person who most accurately predicts their finishing time. It has a nature-inspired, brewery-themed atmosphere and is suitable for all ages, including children.
course_highlights: Forest trails with very little asphalt
Around the reservoir, golf course and meanders of the Botič
Family-friendly, nature-inspired atmosphere with brewery facilities
additional: Race pack collection is from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Hostivar 2 brewery, with a bag drop available. Refreshments are provided on the 15 km course and at the finish. Participants who register online receive a commemorative gift. The accompanying programme includes a raffle, a dance show and entertainment for families with children. Parking at the brewery is limited; additional parking is available nearby. Public transport: Praha-Horní Měcholupy, buses 154, 183, 224 and 240, and train. Forest surface; online registration until 11. 9. 2026; start at the Hostivar brewery; refreshments on the course and at the finish; accompanying programme; raffle; family-friendly atmosphere.

name: 4Drun
location: Dubany u Prostějova, Prostějov, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: 4Drun is a traditional running race organized by Sportovní klub DDsport, z.s., held in the picturesque surroundings of Dubany near Prostějov. The race features a 10.2 km course through the area around Dubany, neighboring villages, and nearby cycle paths, combining paved and cross-country sections. The program also includes a 2 × 5 km relay, a 4 km family run, and children’s races, making the event suitable for all age groups. A varied program of accompanying activities is planned for race day, and every participant receives a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: The 10.2 km course runs through the area around Dubany, the neighboring villages of Hablov and Bystročice, and a newly built cycle path
A combination of paved and cross-country sections
A 4 km family run, suitable for participation with a stroller
additional: Race packs and bib numbers can be collected at the 4Drun Expo at Sokolovna Dubany on Friday 11.9 from 16:00 to 18:00, Saturday 12.9 from 9:00 to 10:00 and 18:00 to 19:00, and on race day 13.9 from 8:00 to 12:30. On-site registration on race day is not possible. Every participant who finishes the race receives a commemorative medal. Participants are advised to collect their race pack well in advance, ideally one hour before the start. Only runners aged 18 and under may place on the podium in the family run. The accompanying program includes children’s races, the family run, relay races, and a prize draw. Advance online registration is required; the race is part of multiple categories and accompanying events.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two laps of 5 km each, for a total distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Social Activity Center and aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local running community together. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of two laps of 5 km each
A road race in the center of Złotów
Organized at the Municipal Stadium and on nearby streets
additional: The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Złotów and on nearby streets. The course consists of two 5 km laps. Registration is available through the Domtel-Sport platform. The organizer, the Złotów Social Activity Center, provides contact and support. A 10 km road race with online registration, support from local businesses, an appealing course, and prizes

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
location: Tor Poznań, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting motorsport events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants have the opportunity to compete, train, and take part in qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at motorsport enthusiasts and also offers car rentals and one-to-one instruction with instructors. It is a great opportunity to experience the thrill of motorsport and improve your skills on a professional track.
course_highlights: Race track in Poznań with professional facilities
Opportunity to take part in various rounds and qualifying sessions during the 2026 season
Training sessions and one-to-one instruction with instructors
additional: Cars can be rented for track use, for yourself or as a gift. The entry package includes participation by a team member, the option to co-drive (age >17), full catering, individual lap-time measurement, and the option of instruction with an instructor. Participation payments must include the correct payment reference to confirm entry. Multiple rounds include training sessions, qualifying, and night races, with a focus on sporty driving and the excitement of the track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
location: Środa Wielkopolska, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are a charity run organized in Środa Wielkopolska to support the work of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social cause, engaging the local community and the legal profession. It is an established tradition that promotes physical activity and solidarity.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Old Market Square in Środa Wielkopolska
Charity run supporting the hospice
Various distances and activities, including children’s races and Nordic walking
additional: The run is a charity event supporting the Piotr Hospice. Registration opens on March 1, 2026. The website has no details about the course, start times, or fees. The event is scheduled for September 13, 2026, and includes various running and activity options; participation supports the work of the Piotr Hospice.

name: XRUN - Vistula Trail
location: Wisła, Cieszyn County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Vistula Trail is a mountain trail race held in Wisła, offering a range of distances from short routes for children to challenging mountain courses. Runners can enjoy scenic views of the Beskids, starting in the center of Wisła or on the Czech side in Třinec. The routes pass notable locations such as Soszów Wielki, Soszów Mountain Hut and Czantoria, combining an international adventure with the character of the Beskids. This event is for mountain-running enthusiasts who value variety and beautiful natural landscapes.
course_highlights: Start in the heart of Wisła at Skolnity Ski & Bike Park
The route passes Soszów Wielki, Soszów Mountain Hut and Czantoria
Scenic descents along the green trail to the center of Wisła and Kopczyński Park
additional: Time limits: 35 km – 9h, 24 km – 7h, 15 km – 4h. Start times vary: 35 km at 07:00, 24 km at 08:00, 15 km at 09:30. Age categories for children aged 3 to 15 on the short distances. Start and finish in Wisła, with transport to the start of the Classic Trail distance from Třinec. The event offers various distances divided into age categories, organized transport for some routes, marked trails and a children’s category. The start is in a scenic area, with the opportunity to enjoy mountain landscapes.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km course follows the city’s prominent avenues, including the area around Jasna Góra, giving the race a distinctive prestige. The course is officially certified, attracting runners aiming for a fast pace and personal bests. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in picturesque urban surroundings.
course_highlights: 10 km course through the center of Częstochowa
Route passes near Jasna Góra
Officially certified course suited to fast running
additional: Registration takes place at the Sports Hall of IV High School; the fee is payable in cash. The event also includes training sessions and information from sponsors.

name: Bieg na Skałę
organizer: Centrum Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Skale
price_range: 30 zł do 19.09.2025, 50 zł w dniu zawodów, 120 zł w dniu biegu
description: Bieg na Skałę is a unique sporting event that combines physical activity with the natural beauty of Ojców National Park. The course follows scenic trails and hills, offering participants varied terrain, including forest paths, rocky sections, and steep climbs. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to embrace the spirit of adventure and enjoy the fresh air. After the race, participants can look forward to commemorative medals, prizes, and a range of attractions, including activities for children. The event takes place in a friendly, sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: A course along scenic trails and hills in Ojców National Park
Varied terrain: forest paths, rocky sections, and steep climbs
Stunning views of the surrounding area
additional: Available distances: Bieg po Pstrąga Ojcowskiego (8 km), with team rankings and a prize for the best resident of the Skała municipality, and Bieg Szlakiem Skał i Dolin (15 km), with a similar ranking. Children’s races are available over 100 m (ages 2–5, no ranking), 800 m (ages 10–11), and 1,300 m (ages 12–15). After the race, activities for younger children include inflatable castles, entertainers, and prize competitions. The course follows scenic trails and hills, with varied terrain ranging from forest paths to rocky sections and steep climbs. The event offers races at various distances, including children’s races, and GPX files are available to download. Race packs can be collected on 19–20.09.2025.

name: Chyża 10
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix in running. The race starts at 9:00, and the race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared course.
course_highlights: Fast 10 km course
Race counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix
Start at 9:00; race office opens at 7:00
additional: The race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The winners’ award ceremony takes place at 10:45. The race is co-funded by the Municipality of Nowy Tomyśl and Nowotomyski County. The event also includes 5 km races, and registration opens on June 1, 2025. The race is part of a series of sporting events organized by the club.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The 15th Damak Half Marathon in Tarczyn is a family celebration of running, promising a great atmosphere and unforgettable experiences. The half-marathon route passes through scenic areas alongside fields, forests and apple orchards, giving the race a distinctive character. The event attracts runners of all ages and also features races for children and teenagers. The organizers take care of participants by providing attractive race packs and support from sponsors.
course_highlights: The route passes alongside fields, forests and apple orchards
Scenic surroundings create a distinctive race atmosphere
A family-friendly event with races for children and teenagers
additional: Race packs include eco-friendly bags, reflective bands and thermal mugs bearing the Fakro sponsor logo. The race packs also contain Kamis spices. The participant limit for the children’s and youth races is 150. The race office is located at 8 Szarych Szeregów Street in Tarczyn. Urban area, online registration, family event, local sponsors and partners.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
location: Jedlnia-Letnisko, Kozienice County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Radom Sobriety Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The races take place on scenic routes in the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, giving participants the opportunity to compete in the marathon, half marathon, and other accompanying races. The marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and sobriety, while also bringing the local running community together. It is a well-established event that attracts both amateur and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Routes run through the Kozienice Forest
Scenic forest trails and natural surroundings
Available distances: marathon and half marathon
additional: Medals can be personalized for a symbolic fee of 10 zł. The organizer encourages participation in the marathon, half marathon, and other accompanying races. The “Biegiem Radom!” Association also works to bring people together and promote running in the region. The event includes various distances, including the marathon and half marathon, with training plans and support for participants. Registration opens on September 14, 2025.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów w Biegu is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cycling Association, taking place on September 13, 2026, by the Żyrardów Reservoir. Participants can choose between two distances: 10 km and 5 km. Both routes go around the reservoir, with multiple laps and a finish at the reservoir grounds. The race promotes physical activity, community spirit and a welcoming sporting atmosphere, while also helping promote the city of Żyrardów and the Mazovia region. The event is open to adults, and athletes using active wheelchairs may also compete in the 10 km race.
course_highlights: Route around the Żyrardów Reservoir
4 laps for the 10 km distance; 2 laps for the 5 km distance
Start and finish by the Żyrardów Reservoir, 17 Ziołowa Street
additional: Online registration is available until September 10, 2026. After that date, registration is available only at the race office until 9:00 a.m. on race day. Each participant collects a race number with a chip at the race office. Athletes using active wheelchairs may compete in the 10 km race. The event base, start, finish and parking are by the Żyrardów Reservoir, 17 Ziołowa Street. Distances: 10 km and 5 km; online registration; a 100-minute time limit for the main race; wheelchair athletes may participate; the swimming area is open during the event weekend.

Kis-Balaton RUN 2026
description: The Kis-Balaton Circuit Running Race is a nationally advertised and increasingly popular running event in Zalakaros, organized by the Zalakarosi Futrinkák. It offers several distances, including a 35 km individual and relay race, a half marathon, and children’s and family races. Traditionally held in September, the event starts and finishes at Karos Korzó. The race is cup-free, so participants must bring their own hydration equipment. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere and offers valuable prizes and finisher medals.
course_highlights: 35 km SZABADICS Kis-Balaton Circuit individual and relay race
Karos Spa Half Marathon
Children’s and family races over 700 m, 1,400 m and 2,800 m
additional: The race is cup-free: the organizer does not provide plastic or paper cups at the refreshment stations, so participants must bring their own soft cup or bottle. Race packs can be collected on September 12 and 13 at Karos Korzó. Award ceremonies are held after the different distances. The organizer reserves the right to change the program and schedule. The event supports environmental protection through its cup-free approach and offers various prizes to participants. It is organized by the Zalakarosi Futrinkák and takes place at Szőlő u. 16, Zalakaros.

name: Malý Pieninský maratón – mem. Bohuša Ježíka
organizer: Malý pieninský maratón – memoriál Bohuša Ježíka
description: Malý Pieninský maratón - memoriál Bohuša Ježíka je bežecké podujatie v Červenom Kláštore, ktoré ponúka trať dlhú 18 km s prevýšením 163 metrov. Trať vedie prielomom rieky Dunajec, pričom povrch je z polovice asfaltový a z polovice lesný. Štart je naplánovaný na 10:00 hod. a súčasťou štartovného je medaila, darček, štartové číslo, občerstvenie na trati a v cieli, obed a tombola. Okrem hlavného behu je k dispozícii aj nesúťažná štafeta 9+9 km.
course_highlights: Trať vedie prielomom rieky Dunajec
Povrch 50% asfalt, 50% les
Prevýšenie +163 m na 18 km
additional: Štartovné zahŕňa medailu, darček, štartové číslo, občerstvenie na trati a v cieli, obed a tombolu. Registrácia prebieha mimo portál Terminovka.sk. Počet účastníkov je limitovaný, možná je aj registrácia v deň podujatia vo výnimočných prípadoch. Účastníci štartujú na vlastnú zodpovednosť a sú povinní dodržiavať pravidlá cestnej premávky a pokyny organizátorov. Trať zahŕňa asfaltové a lesné cesty, registrácia je uzavretá kvôli naplnenému kapacite, pretek je určený pre bežcov všetkých úrovní.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - září
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a regular 8 km running race held in the pleasant surroundings of Plzeň. The race is for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking available for participants. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and is suitable for various age groups.
course_highlights: An 8 km course in the Pytel area of Plzeň
Start and finish at the same location, with parking for participants
Age categories for runners aged 16 and over
additional: Registration and race-number pickup take place from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race, the top runners are announced and a raffle is held. The race is limited to 75 participants. Each participant takes part at their own risk. The race is part of a series of runs in Plzeň, including events of various distances and charity events, and is held regularly throughout the year.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (10) – zářijový
description: The 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running series in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava where personal bests are often set. The races are part of the 16th annual edition and suit runners of all levels, from beginners to pros. The course is certified, and the 10 km race allows runners to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships. After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant, adding to the relaxed running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Certified course, with the 10 km race offering the chance to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships
Friendly atmosphere and the option to enjoy refreshments after the race
additional: Registration opens at 18:00; the 10 km race starts at 19:00 and the 5 km race at 19:05. After the race, refreshments are available at Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the event tent. After the race, there is a prize draw with prizes such as free race entries, massage vouchers and more. The course is measured by a certified course measurer. Cancellation is possible up to 24 hours before the start, with the entry fee refunded. The race is part of the VAŠÍ LIGY running-event series in Prague, which includes various distances and categories. Registration is available in advance, and the event supports both regular and recreational runners.

description: The Autumn Run around Europlant is a traditional running race held in Prague-Horní Počernice. The race is 7.5 km long and follows a combination of paved and off-road sections. It starts in the early evening, with slower runners starting earlier. The event is open to all runners and is supported by the Prague 20 municipal district. After the race, potatoes provided by sponsor Europlant are ready for participants.
course_highlights: 7.5 km course
Combination of paved and off-road sections
Early-evening start, with faster and slower runners starting at different times
additional: Registration is available at the start venue until 17:45. Slower runners start at 17:30. Transport: Metro Line B to Černý Most, then a bus to the Vojická or Vysokovská stop. Runners participate at their own risk. Organizer: Tomáš Procházka, contact: 606629062. After the race, potatoes are provided for participants by sponsor Europlant šlechtitelská spol. s r.o. Course: 7.5 km on paved and off-road sections; on-site registration until 17:45; start: 17:30 for slower runners; participation at your own risk; the organizer is not responsible for belongings left unattended.

location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Praha, Czech Republic

description: The Run Against Violence is a traditional charity run held in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6. It supports the Stop Violence programme and clients taking part in long-term therapies focused on managing anger and aggression. The event brings together runners of all ages who want to show their support and offer hope to people working to change their behaviour. The 5 km course is suitable for anyone who wants to support a good cause while enjoying exercise outdoors. It is organised by Diakonie ČCE, a major provider of social services in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: The course runs through Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6
The main course is 5 km long
A charity run supporting the Stop Violence programme
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day at the registration tent; they are labelled by gender and T-shirt size. A baggage storage area, changing facilities, refreshments during the race and at the finish, and free massages before and after the run are available. Race numbers and chips are non-transferable and must be worn visibly on the chest. The race is a charity event supporting the Stop Violence programme. The programme includes children’s races, the 5 km main race, activities in the children’s corner, relaxation techniques and massages. The event supports therapy programmes and violence prevention.

name: Maraton 3 Jezior / Three Lakes Marathon
location: Międzybrodzie Bialskie, Żywiec County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 3 Lakes Marathon is a mountain running festival held in the picturesque Beskid Mały region, in the Soła River valley. The main event is an ultramarathon of approximately 43 km with around 2,485 m of elevation gain, traversing the highest parts of the Beskid Mały mountains and offering beautiful views of three lakes and the surrounding mountains. The course combines demanding climbs with technical descents, giving participants the chance to experience both the region’s wild nature and its historic sites. The event takes place during the beautiful transition from summer to autumn, adding to the charm of the course and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon course of approximately 43 km with +/- 2,485 m of elevation change
Views of three lakes: Międzybrodzkie, Tresna, and the surrounding area
Technically demanding climbs and descents, including a steep climb to Magurka and the summit of Czupel
additional: Start and finish: the race starts at 8:00 in Międzybrodzie Bialskie and finishes at the stadium in Porąbka. Course time limit: 10h30min. The course passes through varied terrain, including forests, meadows, and a suspension bridge over the Soła. There are refreshment points along the course and a spectator zone in Czernichów. The course is technically demanding, with significant elevation gain. Other distances and accompanying races are also available as part of the festival. The event features a range of distances, a festival atmosphere, electronic timing, and courses through lakes and mountains, offering an unforgettable experience.

name: 23 Przejście Dookoła Kotliny Jeleniogórs...
location: Jelenia Góra, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Walk Around the Jelenia Góra Valley is one of Poland’s best-known long-distance hiking events, held since 2004. Participants cover a route of approximately 140 km around the Jelenia Góra Valley, crossing the Karkonosze, Rudawy Janowickie, Kaczawskie Mountains, and Izera Mountains. The event commemorates GOPR rescuers. The entry fee includes race materials, a souvenir, a hot meal, and a certificate. The route is demanding, with approximately 5,500 m of elevation gain, and participants have 48 hours to complete it.
course_highlights: A long route of approximately 140 km around the Jelenia Góra Valley
Approximately 5,500 m of total elevation gain
Crosses the Karkonosze, Rudawy Janowickie, Kaczawskie Mountains, and Izera Mountains
additional: There is no timekeeping or ranking. The entry fee includes race materials (a race number and route map), a logo souvenir (T-shirt), a hot meal and drinks at the refreshment point, water at selected checkpoints, a certificate, photography, a prize draw, and GOPR safety support. Long distance, mountain terrain, difficult weather conditions, and a memorial honoring GOPR rescuers.

name: 3 Backyard Ultra Zagłębie
description: Backyard Ultra Zagłębie is a unique ultramarathon run on a 6.706 km loop around Pogoria 3 Lake in Dąbrowa Górnicza. Runners start every hour, and the last person to finish each lap continues running until only one winner remains. The course combines a variety of surfaces—asphalt, dirt and forest trails, and a beach section—requiring both endurance and technical precision. The event is the final of the Polish Backyard Ultra League and attracts fans of extreme challenges from across Poland.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km loop around Pogoria 3 Lake
A mix of surfaces: 60% dirt and forest trails, 40% asphalt, paving stones, and concrete
A beach section of approximately 250–300 metres near the pier, plus steps at the finish
additional: Each lap starts exactly on the hour. Runners must be at the starting line within 3 minutes of the start of the lap or they are eliminated. The event village is located at the Summer and Water Sports Centre. The organizer reserves the right to adjust the course for weather or safety reasons. All runners except the winner receive a DNF (Did Not Finish) designation as a symbol of perseverance. Participant limit: 140; start time: 12:00; location: Dąbrowa Górnicza; ultramarathon format with hourly laps

name: Big Bear's Ultra
location: Žilina, Považské múzeum, Budatínski hrad, Žilina, Slovakia
description: Big Bear's Ultra je náročný ultra trailový pretek okolo mesta Žilina, ktorý ponúka jedinečný zážitok z behu v prírode s krásnymi výhľadmi na okolitú krajinu. Preteky sa konajú v blízkosti Považského múzea a Budatínskeho hradu a zahŕňajú rôzne vzdialenosti, ktoré preveria vytrvalosť a odhodlanie bežcov. Trať vedie cez kopce a horské oblasti s výrazným prevýšením, čo robí z tohto podujatia výzvu pre skúsených bežcov. Organizátori kladú dôraz na ekologický prístup a bezpečnosť účastníkov.
course_highlights: BBU 100+ má dĺžku 118 km s prevýšením 6300 m, vedie cez Budatínsky hrad, Straník, Lysicu, Veľký Kriváň a ďalšie horské sedlá
BBU 60+ má dĺžku 62 km s prevýšením 3500 m, štartuje v Strečne a končí v Budatíne, vedie po časti trasy BBU 100+
Trať prechádza cez historické a prírodné pamiatky ako Považské múzeum, Budatínsky hrad a Hričovský hrad
additional: Registrácia pre 4. ročník pretekov začala 17. decembra 2025 o 20:00. Trať je rozdelená na viaceré kontrolné body s občerstvovacími stanicami. Pretek je súčasťou Europe Trail Cup. Organizátori zdôrazňujú ekologický kódex a povinné vybavenie pre bežcov. Registrácia sa otvára 17. decembra 2025; preteky sa konajú v Žiline, v blízkosti Považského múzea a Budatínskeho hradu; podujatie je známe svojou komunitou a rôznorodosťou trás.

name: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: Half Marathon
price_range: 30,00€ to 60,00€ depending on category and registration date
description: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: Half Marathon je certifikovaný polmaratón s medzinárodným statusom World Athletics, ktorý sa koná v historickom centre Nitry na Svätoplukovom námestí. Podujatie spája šport, komunitu a charitu a ponúka bežcom jedinečný zážitok v atmosfére Oktoberfestu. Okrem polmaratónu sú súčasťou festivalu aj štafety, rodinné a seniorské behy, charitatívne behy a detské kategórie. Organizátori kladú dôraz na zdravý životný štýl, inklúziu a komunitnú spoluprácu v regióne.
course_highlights: Certifikovaná trať polmaratónu s dĺžkou 21,0975 km podľa štandardov World Athletics
Štart a cieľ na Svätoplukovom námestí v centre Nitry
Možnosť zapojiť sa do štafety, rodinných a charitatívnych behov
additional: Registrácia online končí 17.9.2026 o 23:59 alebo pri naplnení limitu. Možnosť registrácie na mieste v deň pretekov od 08:00 do 09:30, ak nebude limit naplnený. Podujatie je súčasťou Európskeho týždňa mobility a dopĺňa ho kultúrny program v štýle Nitrianskeho rínku s lokálnym streetfoodom a programom pre rodiny. Podujatie má status svetového rebríčka, ponúka rôzne kategórie vrátane detských a rodinných behov, a je súčasťou festivalovej atmosféry s miestnou kuchyňou a zábavou.

name: Kopaničiarska 10-tka
location: Mestský úrad v Myjave, Myjava, Slovakia
organizer: TJ Spartak Myjava Atletický oddiel a mesto Myjava

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: on-line prihlásenie do 18. 9. 2025 do 15.00 h, (platba na mieste)

description: Kopaničiarska 10-tka je bežecký pretek v Myjave, ktorý ponúka trať dlhú 10 km pre mužov a ženy, s kratšími variantmi pre ženy a kategóriu Buď - fit. Preteky sa konajú pred Mestským úradom v Myjave a sú organizované TJ Spartak Myjava Atletickým oddielom a mestom Myjava. Štart hlavného preteku je o 13:00 hod., zatiaľ čo žiaci a žiačky základných škôl štartujú o 10:00 hod. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú vekovú škálu bežcov, vrátane kategórií podľa veku a špeciálnych skupín Buď fit a detí.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 10 km pre hlavný pretek
Ženská trať 6,6 km a Buď - fit 3,3 km
Štart pred Mestským úradom v Myjave
additional: Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane kategórií muži A-D, ženy E-G, Buď fit ženy a muži, a kategórie pre žiakov a predškolákov. Pretek je organizovaný TJ Spartak Myjava Atletickým oddielom a mestom Myjava. Kontaktná osoba: Pavol Michalčík, tel.: 0908 532 753. Preteky zahŕňajú rôzne dĺžky tratí od 200 m po 10 km, súčasťou sú detské kategórie, občerstvenie, medaily, tombola a sprievodný program s vystúpeniami.

name: Memoriál vdp. Jána Laktiša
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Sklabiná, Veľký Krtíš, Slovakia
organizer: Občianske združenie Telovýchovná Jednota družstevník Sklabiná v spolupráci s OZ Bežci VK
description: Memoriál vdp. Jána Laktiša je tradičný cestný beh, ktorý sa koná v obci Sklabiná v okrese Veľký Krtíš. Tento bežecký závod má dlhoročnú históriu a je organizovaný farským úradom Sklabiná. Pretekári sa stretávajú na futbalovom ihrisku v Sklabinej, kde sa koná štart aj cieľ. Podujatie je známe svojou komunitnou atmosférou a úctou k starším bežcom.
course_highlights: Cestný beh v obci Sklabiná
Štart a cieľ na futbalovom ihrisku
Tradičný bežecký závod s dlhoročnou históriou
additional: 19. ročník sa koná na futbalovom ihrisku, nie pred farou. Usporiadateľom je Farský úrad Sklabiná. V minulosti sa pretekov zúčastnili bežci rôzneho veku, od najmladších po najstarších. Výsledkové listiny a fotky z pretekov sú pravidelne zverejňované na stránke. Pretek sa koná na futbalovom ihrisku, registrácia je dostupná online, a sú k dispozícii výsledky a informácie o kategóriách na oficiálnej stránke.

name: Dobšinská desiatka
price_range: 16 eur – do 18.9.2025 online, 21 eur – v deň pretekov (hotovosť)
description: Dobšinská desiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný občianskym združením ŠK Dobšiná, ktorý sa koná v malebnom prostredí Lányiho Huty v Dobšinej. Preteky ponúkajú členitú trať s kombináciou lesných ciest a asfaltu, vhodnú pre bežcov rôznych kategórií vrátane nordic walking. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj sprievodné akcie ako autogramiáda slovenských olympionikov a rodinné aktivity, ktoré vytvárajú príjemnú atmosféru pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trať pozostáva zo 4/5 lesnej cesty a 1/5 asfaltu
Profil trate je členitý s rôznymi prevýšeniami
Štart a cieľ sú v lokalite Lányiho Huta, Dobšiná
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov prebieha od 9:00 do 10:45 v Horskej chate Stará Horáreň. Štart je hromadný pre všetky hlavné kategórie. V štartovnom je zahrnutý doplnok z funkčného materiálu s logom preteku, produkt zdravej výživy, štartovné číslo slúžiace ako tombola, občerstvenie na trati aj po dobehnutí, vrátane nápoja a jedla. Po pretekoch nasleduje detská a rodičovská štafeta. Prví traja v každej kategórii získajú finančné alebo vecné ceny, a je vyplatená finančná odmena za prekonanie traťového rekordu. Trať je prevažne lesná s 4/5 lesných ciest a 1/5 asfaltu; registrácia je možná online aj osobne na mieste; súčasťou podujatia sú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a štafety.

name: Kapušianska 5-ka
price_range: online  ,- €; on-site  ,- € (if participant limit not reached)
description: Kapušianska 5-ka je bežecký pretek konaný v Kapušanskom parku v obci Kapušany. Pretek je určený pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane juniorov, dospelých a veteránov. Ide o príjemnú športovú udalosť, ktorá podporuje aktívny životný štýl a komunitné športovanie. Organizátorom je obec Kapušany, ktorá zabezpečuje aj kontaktnú podporu pre účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trať vedie Kapušanským parkom
Preteky sú rozdelené do viacerých vekových kategórií
Príjemné prostredie vhodné pre rekreačných aj súťažných bežcov
additional: Štartovné sa platí online alebo na mieste len v prípade nenaplnenia účastníckeho limitu. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane zlúčených kategórií juniorov a veteránov. Pretek sa koná v areáli Kapušanského parku, je vhodný pre všetky vekové skupiny, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste.

name: Letné športové hry pracovníkov U.S.STEEL
location: Vstupný areál USS Košice, Košice, Košice, Slovakia
description: Letné športové hry pracovníkov U. S. Steel Košice sú tradičným podujatím, ktoré sa koná už 34 rokov a prináša zamestnancom možnosť súťažiť v rôznych športových disciplínach. Hry zahŕňajú atletiku, bedminton, bowling, tenis, futbal, stolný tenis, plážový volejbal, cyklistiku, šach a šípky. Podujatie je určené pre zamestnancov U. S. Steel Košice a podporuje športového ducha a kolektívnu súťaživosť v príjemnom prostredí areálu USS Košice Šaca. Okrem súťaží sa organizujú aj golfové turnaje a ďalšie športové aktivity.
course_highlights: Viacero športových disciplín vrátane atletiky, cyklistiky a futbalu
Súťaže pre zamestnancov v areáli USS Košice Šaca
Golfový turnaj v Golfovom areáli Malá Ida
additional: Podujatie je určené pre zamestnancov U. S. Steel Košice s viacerými športovými disciplínami vrátane novinky šípok. V prípade nepriaznivého počasia sa niektoré disciplíny dohrávajú v náhradných termínoch. Organizátori poskytujú kontakty na organizáciu a elektronickú registráciu. Podujatie je určené pre zamestnancov spoločnosti, s možnosťou registrácie cez platformu The X App Košice. Súčasťou sú aj výsledky, fotografie a golfový turnaj naplánovaný na 21. septembra 2025.

name: Generali Trail Hubkovou
location: Humenné, námestie pri MsKS, Humenné, Prešov, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 11,- € základný balíček (účastnícka medaila, reklamnýbalíček, lístok tombola a občerstvenie na trati)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 16,- € strednýbalíček (obsahuje základnýbalíček + obed podľa vlastného výberu a alko/nealko nápoj)

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 25,- € hlavný balíček (obsahuje základný aj stredný balíček + ďalšie 2 tombolové lístky a funkčné tričko)

description: Generali Trail Hubkovou je bežecký pretek v Humennom, ktorý organizuje Bežecký klub Humenné s podporou mesta a miestnych sponzorov. Pretek sa koná na námestí pri MsKS a ponúka kategórie pre mužov, ženy, juniorov a deti. Štart hlavného preteku je o 13:00, detské kategórie začínajú o 11:00. Účastníci si môžu vybrať z viacerých štartovných balíčkov, ktoré zahŕňajú medailu, reklamný balíček, tombolu, občerstvenie a funkčné tričko. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru s občerstvením na trati.
course_highlights: Trať vedie cez náročný horský terén
Rôzne kategórie pre dospelých a deti
Preteky s možnosťou výberu vzdialenosti a časov štartu
additional: Štart detských kategórií je o 11:00. Po dátume 16.9.2025 je štartovné pre všetky balíčky online aj na mieste vyššie o 5 €. Balíčky obsahujú rôzne kombinácie medaily, reklamného balíčka, tombolových lístkov, občerstvenia na trati, obeda a funkčného trička. Trailové prostredie, rôzne kategórie, registrácia od 4 do 25 eur, štarty o 11:00 a 13:00

name: Běh pro hospic Červený Kostelec
location: Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti: jednotné startovné 100 Kč (online i na místě)

description: The Run for Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, with courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children’s courses along a forest path, as well as 2, 5 and 10 km courses on rolling mixed terrain, mostly asphalt with some forest and field paths. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services provided by the Červený Kostelec Regional Charity. Participants can enjoy the pleasant countryside around the Kostelec ponds, with views of the surrounding mountains.
course_highlights: The children’s courses follow a forest path
The 2, 5 and 10 km courses follow rolling mixed terrain, mostly asphalt
Beautiful countryside around the Kostelec ponds, with views of the Orlické Mountains, the Krkonoše Mountains and Hejšovina
additional: Online registration is available until September 19, 2026, at 6:00; on-site registration is also available for a higher entry fee. A small gift is prepared for the first 300 registrants. Parking is available on a grassy meadow near Náchodská Street, approximately a 10-minute walk from the race venue. The race is part of the Primátor CUP 2026 running series, with fair-play rules and no accompanying participants (dogs, bicycles, scooters, etc.). The event is part of the Primátor CUP series, and all proceeds will support Anežka Česká Hospice.

name: Zátopkova 10
location: Lomená alej, Stará Boleslav, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 600 Kč od 1. 1. 2026 až do závodu (v případě volné kapacity)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 Kč od 1. 1. 2026 až do závodu (v případě volné kapacity)

description: Zátopkova 10 is a traditional running race held in Lomená Alej in Stará Boleslav. It consists of two 5-kilometre laps on forest paths. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup 2026 series and offers a 10 km main race, a two-runner relay, and children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres. The course is mostly flat, with staggered starts and an on-course refreshment station. Runners receive a race bib with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, and other services, including refreshments and course photos.
course_highlights: Two 5 km laps on forest paths
The course is practically flat
An on-course refreshment station with isotonic drinks, water, and fruit
additional: Starts are staggered. The main race has a capacity of 500 runners and the children’s races a capacity of 100 runners. The entry fee includes a race bib with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, an SMS with the result, an electronic certificate, photos from the course or finish, and refreshments on the course and at the finish. Parking is near the start and finish. Trail terrain, forest paths, online and on-site registration; race categories include the main race, relay, and children’s races.

name: Li.T.R. – Lipno.trail.run.
location: Lipno nad Vltavou, South Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registruji dítě na dětský závod 250 Kč

description: Li.t.r. is a weekend trail festival featuring a 108 km main race with over 2,000 metres of elevation gain around Lipno. The race offers a unique opportunity to discover the little-known landscape of the Lipno region, its history and stories during a challenging ultratrail. It is open to both solo runners and teams, with a programme of accompanying events from Friday to Sunday. The atmosphere is friendly and community-minded; the event is organised by runners for runners, with respect for nature and local culture.
course_highlights: A 108 km trail with over 2,000 metres of elevation gain
The route follows narrow forest trails around the Czech Republic’s largest body of water, Lipno
The route is divided into 8 stages (8–14 km); all relay points are easily accessible by car
additional: The race starts and finishes in front of the Stodola restaurant in Lipno nad Vltavou. Changing rooms, showers and parking are available at the start. The route is divided into 8 stages, with relay points accessible by car. The entry package includes a drop bag for solo runners, refreshments at relay points (water, isotonic drinks and fruit), timing and results services. The accompanying programme runs from Friday to Sunday and includes talks, music and group activities. Entry fees are non-refundable but transferable. Participants must be aged 18 or over, or 15 or over with the consent of a legal guardian. Children under 6 may attend only when accompanied. A multi-segment trail race with an accompanying programme, accommodation options, and opportunities to experience local cuisine and history.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem 2026 is a traditional running event with a fast, flat course that runs along the Elbe River and through the local chemical plant. This half marathon is known as the “Ferrari among races” for its speed and the records that often fall here. During the race, runners can enjoy beautiful views of the Central Bohemian Uplands and Střekov Castle. The festival offers several race distances, including the half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km race and family runs.
course_highlights: Fast, flat course along the Elbe River
Route through the local chemical plant
Views of the Central Bohemian Uplands and Střekov Castle
additional: Another person may be authorised to collect the race bib. Start times for the various races throughout the day: half marathon from 09:00, other races at 11:00, 14:30 and 14:45. 16th edition, with approximately 3,500 runners. The race is part of running series and offers the RunCzech mobile app for participants. The event takes place on 19 September 2026 and includes various races, an expo with official merchandise and the option to register. The course passes through city landmarks as well as industrial areas and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Mladé Běchovice
description: Mladé Běchovice is a traditional running race for children aged 1 to 18, held on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. The race offers courses of various lengths, from 50 to 1,300 metres, to accommodate a wide range of ages. Approximately 800 children take part each year, making it an important sporting event for young runners. In 2026, the popular race will be held for the 61st time.
course_highlights: Courses from 50 to 1,300 metres, suitable for children aged 1 to 18
The race takes place on a grass field
Approximately 800 participants each year
additional: The race is suitable for children and takes place on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. It is organised by the Mladé Běchovice, z.s. association. The organisers can also be contacted by phone at +420 606481222. The race is intended for children and young people and takes place in September 2026. It attracts approximately 800 participants and promotes sport and a healthy lifestyle among young people.

name: Běh Moravským krasem
location: Sloup v Moravském krasu, Blansko, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through the Moravian Karst is part of the Blansko District Running League, which has a tradition dating back to 1976. This race gives runners from the Blansko area and beyond the opportunity to test their strength in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Moravian Karst. It is suitable for the general public and is part of a year-round competition that promotes running in the region. The organizers aim to provide quality services and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque terrain of the Moravian Karst
The race is part of the traditional Blansko District Running League
Natural scenery and quality race facilities
additional: The race takes place on September 19, 2026, in Sloup in the Moravian Karst. It is part of a regional running league with multiple events throughout the year.

name: Litovelská nealkoholická čtrnáctka
description: The Litovel Non-Alcoholic 14K is a traditional running race organised by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque town of Litovel in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of a running series and offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public, and its name, which refers to the event’s non-alcoholic nature, adds to its friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque surroundings of Litovel
Mostly asphalt and paved surfaces, suitable for fast running
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Endurance Runners
additional: The race is part of a series of local running events in and around Olomouc, with equipment available for organisers and other races in the region.

name: Podzimní běh Heřmanův Městec
location: Zámecký park, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Autumn Run in Heřmanův Městec is a traditional running race held in a beautiful château park. It offers two main distances, 5 km and 10 km (two laps), as well as children’s races in the start and finish area. The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league and attracts runners of all ages, who enjoy the pleasant autumn atmosphere and quality facilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the château park in Heřmanův Městec
Two race distances: 5 km and 10 km (two laps)
Children’s races in the start and finish area
additional: The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league, which includes a series of races and open timed training sessions throughout the year. The race takes place on 19 September 2026. Registration is available on the official website. Exact course profiles are not provided, but the routes run through the countryside around Heřmanův Městec.

name: Hořovický cvoček
price_range: 150 CZK v předprodeji, 200 CZK na místě
description: Hořovický cvoček is a traditional running race held in Hořovice, offering a course approximately 12 km long. The route follows forest paths and paved roads. The race starts on Valdecká Street by the water tower, heading towards Hvozdec. The main race starts at 10:00 and is for adult runners; there are no children’s categories. The entry fee is CZK 150 with pre-registration and CZK 200 on the day. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár and has a long history, with results and statistics available.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km course combining forest paths and paved roads
Starts in Hořovice, on Valdecká Street by the water tower, heading towards Hvozdec
Traditional race with a history and results dating back to 2014
additional: There are no children’s categories. The start and finish are on Valdecká Street by the water tower, heading towards Hvozdec. Results are available in the system and in PDF format. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár, which includes other races during the season. The course features varied terrain, and registration is available in advance or on the day.

name: Kačina Run
description: Kačina Run is a running race held in the beautiful grounds of Kačina Chateau and its expansive park. It is part of the BĚHEJ ZÁMKY STŘEDNÍ ČECHY series. The race offers courses of up to 800 metres for children and 5 km and 10 km courses for adults, mainly on crushed-stone and forest paths. The event is suitable for everyone who loves exercise and nature, and offers a welcoming atmosphere with refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and event facilities are located at the rear of Kačina Chateau, where registration and the awards ceremony also take place.
course_highlights: Routes pass around Kačina Chateau and through its expansive park
70% crushed-stone path, 30% forest path
Refreshments along the course and at the finish (bananas, orange, apple, water)
additional: Registration opens at 9:00 for the children’s races and at 12:30 for the adults’ races, at the rear of the Kačina Chateau grounds. Children receive a participation medal as soon as they finish. Parents may run with children in the 2–3 and 4–5 age categories. The race takes place in all weather; participants must observe safety guidelines and fair play rules. A disposable race bib with safety pins must be attached to the chest. Parking is available as shown on the parking map; please do not park on the road shoulders. Course maps and videos are available on the website; the race takes place in Kačina Chateau Park.

name: Leskros Mácháč
location: Doksy, Máchovo jezero, CHKO Kokořínsko, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Mácháč is a new event this season, with beautiful routes ideal for running and canicross in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, near Lake Máchovo. The routes follow soft, sandy ground covered with pine needles, making for a pleasant running experience in a natural setting. The event offers various distances, from children’s races to 21 km, with running, canicross, walking/running and dog-trekking categories. Facilities include refreshment stations for people and dogs, massages, taping and canine physiotherapy advice, helping all participants feel their best.
course_highlights: Soft sandy routes covered with pine needles
Location in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area near Lake Máchovo
Refreshment stations for people and dogs at the finish and along the route
additional: Race registration opens at 8:00. Facilities include a bag check, changing room, Leskros kids’ club (10:30–14:00), massages and taping for runners, canine physiotherapy advice, canicross equipment available to borrow by prior arrangement, and parking and toilets near the start. The event includes charity activities, children’s races, equipment rental, refreshments and an accompanying programme in the natural setting of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area near Lake Máchovo.

name: Štramberský Jasoň
location: Frýdlant nad Ostravicí, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Spolek Bezva běh pro bezva lidi z. s.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Do 30.4.2026 390 Kč nad 15 let a dospělí

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Do 30.4.2026 300 Kč děti v kočárku (s nárokem na medaili, start. číslo se jménem atd.)

description: Štramberský Jasoň is a traditional hiking and running event taking place on 19 September 2026 in Frýdlant nad Ostravicí and the surrounding area. It offers 22 routes of varying lengths, from 6 km to 67 km, including both race and hiking options. Participants can choose routes passing through Lysá hora, the Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník and other scenic locations in the Moravian-Silesian Region. At the finish in Štramberk, all registered participants receive an original medal and can order a printed T-shirt. The event is suitable for the general public, including families with children, and also offers routes suitable for strollers and seniors.
course_highlights: 22 routes from 6 km to 67 km, including both race and hiking options
Routes pass through Lysá hora, the Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník and other natural attractions
Finish in Štramberk, with an original medal for all participants
additional: Registration is available online only. A printed cotton T-shirt can be ordered during registration for 390 Kč (children’s T-shirt: 350 Kč). Registration can be transferred to another participant until 11.9.2026 at 20:00 by emailing redakce@bezvabeh.cz or in person at the event. The finish in Štramberk closes at 21:00. The event offers routes of various lengths, online registration, medals for participants, optional T-shirts and detailed route maps available for download.

name: Havlíčkova pětka
location: Havlíčkův Brod, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při on-line registraci a zaplacení na účet do 31. května 2026

description: Havlíčkova pětka is a running race of approximately 5.2 km, held mostly on cycle paths and sidewalks along the banks of the Sázava River in Havlíčkův Brod. It is suitable for those who do not have a relay team or find a half marathon too challenging. The race starts in Havlíčkovo Square, and part of the entry fee goes toward supporting sports equipment for young people. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny running series and offers refreshments at both the start and finish.
course_highlights: The route follows public cycle paths and sidewalks, much of it along the Sázava River
No significant elevation gain (up to 20 m)
Surface: 95% asphalt paths, 5% trail or paving
additional: Refreshments are available at the start and finish. Race numbers for registrations paid by September 1, 2026, include the runner’s name. The race offers a medal, refreshments on the course and after the race, facilities including a changing room and storage for belongings and bikes, portable toilets, drinking water, music, and professional electronic chip timing with online results. Fifteen percent of each entry fee goes toward supporting secondary schools and youth sports programs in the town. The route includes asphalt paths, trails, and paving; registration is available online or on site. The race supports youth sports activities and offers various additional events as part of the running day.

name: Běh rodným krajem Emila Zátopka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400 Kč - platí pro závodníky přihlášené do 17. září 2026 - startovné se hradí na účet

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 800 Kč - platí pro závodníky přihlášené 19. září 2026 (v den závodu) - startovné se hradí při prezentaci

description: The Run Through the Homeland of Emil Zátopek is a traditional race honoring the legacy of the famous Olympic athlete Emil Zátopek. It is held each year on the Saturday closest to his birthday, September 19. The race starts in his hometown of Kopřivnice, by the statue of Emil Zátopek, and finishes at the Wallachian Open Air Museum in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, after a challenging 22.3 km course with a hilly profile. The race is open to participants aged 15 and over and also offers accompanying runs for children and the public. After the race, a ceremonial awards presentation takes place with distinguished guests in attendance.
course_highlights: A 22.3 km course from Kopřivnice to Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Asphalt and gravel surfaces on forest sections
375 m elevation gain, with a rolling, hilly profile
additional: There are three refreshment stations and one water station along the course. The race takes place on roads open to traffic. The time limit is 3 hours from the start, with an intermediate cutoff of 1:20 hours to Veřovice. Changing rooms are available at the Cultural Centre in Kopřivnice and at the Wallachian Open Air Museum in Rožnov. Luggage is transported by bus to the finish. The organizer provides bus transport from Rožnov to the start and back after the race. Accommodation is available at Hotel Stadion in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm at the runner’s expense. Runners under 18 require consent from a legal guardian. The event also includes accompanying runs for children and the public. The route includes asphalt and forest paths; registration is required. Team and relay races are available, transport and accommodation are provided, and prizes are awarded.

name: Kocelovice-Hornosín-Kocelovice
description: The Kocelovice–Hornosín–Kocelovice cross-country race is a traditional sporting event organized by the municipality of Kocelovice in the South Bohemian Region. The race takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, and participants can expect a route from Kocelovice to Hornosín and back. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts and anyone looking for an active day out in scenic terrain popular with hikers and cyclists. The start and finish are at the former school building in Kocelovice, which also serves as the race headquarters. The event lasts approximately 4 hours.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic South Bohemian countryside with ideal terrain for hiking and cycling
Start and finish at the former school building in Kocelovice
A cross-country race connecting the villages of Kocelovice and Hornosín
additional: The event lasts approximately 240 minutes (4 hours). The start and finish are at the former school building in Kocelovice. The organizer is the Municipality of Kocelovice. The race is held annually in autumn; the most recent edition was in September 2023, and the next is planned for September 2026. The course is approximately 18 km long, with varying levels of difficulty and terrain.

name: Havlíčkobrodský půlmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při on-line registraci a zaplacení na účet do 15. března 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1200 Kč: zvýhodněné týmové startovné při online registraci a zaplacení na účet do 18. září 2026 (do 12:00)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při on-line registraci a zaplacení na účet do 31. května 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při online registraci a zaplacení na účet do 18. září 2026 (do 12:00)

description: The Havlíčkův Brod Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Havlíčkův Brod, celebrating its 14th edition in 2026. The main half marathon follows public cycle paths and pavements, mostly along the Sázava River, and passes through Havlíčkův Brod Square. Alongside the main race, the event includes children’s races, relays, and the shorter Havlíčkova Pětka, welcoming participants of different ages and ability levels. The race offers quality facilities, refreshments on the course and after the race, professional timing, and a varied accompanying programme.
course_highlights: The course follows public cycle paths and pavements, mostly along the Sázava River
The 5.2 km loop is run four times for the half marathon
Start and finish at Havlíčkův Brod Square, with no significant elevation gain
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib (with the runner’s name for registrations paid by 1 September 2026), a medal, refreshments on the course and after the race, free admission to an amusement park in the Vysočina Region, facilities (changing room, storage for belongings and bicycles, portable toilets, drinking water, and seating), music, event announcing, professional electronic chip timing, online results, medical services, and race organisation. The half-marathon time limit is 3 hours. 15% of each entry fee goes toward supporting secondary schools and sports programmes for children in the city. Results from the children’s races and Havlíčkova Pětka count toward the Běžec Vysočiny running cup. The event is traditionally held in September and offers a varied programme for all age groups and ability levels, including relays and children’s races.

name: Běh pro Hospic Anežky České
location: Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti: jednotné startovné 100 Kč (online i na místě)

description: The Run for Anežka České Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, with courses for all age groups. The race takes place on 19 September 2026 and includes children’s courses along a forest path, as well as 2, 5 and 10 km courses over undulating mixed terrain, mostly asphalt with some forest and field paths. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services. Race bibs are distributed from 8:15, and the main race winners’ awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The children’s courses follow a forest path
The 2, 5 and 10 km courses follow undulating mixed terrain, mostly asphalt
Beautiful scenery around the ponds of Červený Kostelec, with views of the Orlické Mountains, the Krkonoše Mountains and Hejšovina
additional: Race bibs are distributed from 8:15; registration closes 30 minutes before the start. A small gift is available for the first 300 registered participants. Parking is available on the grassy meadow by Náchodská Street, about a 10-minute walk from the race venue. The race is part of the Primátor CUP 2026 running series, with fair-play rules and no accompanying dogs, scooters or bicycles. The race takes place on 19 September 2026 in Červený Kostelec and supports hospice services. Registration and further details are available on the website.

name: Jilemnice - Žalý
description: Jilemnice - Žalý is a hill race with a total elevation gain of 569 metres, held in the scenic surroundings of Jilemnice in the Liberec Region. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and features a challenging 9.5 km course. The start is in Jilemnice’s town square, and the race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. It is organized by ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., which provides professional organization and support for the runners.
course_highlights: 9.5 km course with 569 m of elevation gain
Hill race in the scenic surroundings of Jilemnice
Start in Jilemnice’s town square
additional: The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup. It is organized by ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s. Contact person: Roman Koucký, tel. 602 265 857. The race regulations are available to download on the official page. The race takes place on a mountain course; registration details are not specified, results are announced at the finish line, and the event is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup.

name: Soběchlebský Š-krpál
organizer: místní běžečtí nadšenci ve spolupráci s obcí Soběchleby a SDH Soběchleby
price_range: 200 Kč dospělí, 150 Kč kondiční běh, děti zdarma
description: Soběchlebský Š-krpál is a traditional running race held in the area around the village of Soběchleby since 2017. The main course is approximately 11.7 km long with 268 m of elevation gain and runs 90% on unpaved farm and forest roads. Since 2024, the event has also included a 6 km fitness run, suitable for beginner runners and walkers. The start and finish are at the football field in Soběchleby, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The accompanying program includes children’s races for different age groups.
course_highlights: Main course: 11.7 km with 268 m of elevation gain
The route runs 90% on unpaved farm and forest roads
6 km fitness run with 137 m of elevation gain, suitable for beginners
additional: Registration for the children’s races is always available on site on race day. The main race and fitness run can be entered online or on site until 11:30. Facilities at the football field include changing rooms, showers and toilets. Refreshments are provided after the race (soup, beer/non-alcoholic drinks). Parking is available in the immediate vicinity of the venue. The route runs on farm and forest roads; the start and finish are at the football field; refreshments and showers are available; parking is nearby.

name: Černošický běh
location: Černošice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Černošice Run is a traditional running race held in Černošice, offering courses for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The race takes place at the sports field at the end of Husova Street and includes short children’s races, a family relay, and longer courses for adult runners. Starts take place in stages from 14:00 to 15:40, allowing participants in different age groups to take part comfortably. The event is suitable for families and for runners looking for a sporting challenge in a pleasant town setting.
course_highlights: 200 m course for children born in 2018 or later
Family relay: 3 x 900 m
Longer 3 km and 10 km courses for adults and older youth
additional: Registration opens at 13:00 and closes 30 minutes before the start of each category. Starts take place in stages from 14:00 to 15:40. The event is held at the sports field at the end of Husova Street in Černošice. Categories are divided by age and course distance, including a family relay. The course is cross-country in style, running on paved and unpaved paths; competitors take part at their own risk; the event is sponsored by community activities in Černošice.

name: 17. PKO Bytomski Półmaraton
organizer: Klub MKS MOSM Bytom, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Bytomiu, Centrum Handlowe Plejada
description: The 17th PKO Bytom Half Marathon is an event promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing together the local community of Bytom and the surrounding area. The race takes place on a certified, fully asphalt 21.097 km course consisting of a single loop. The start and finish are located at G City Plejada Shopping Centre in Bytom. Participants can expect refreshment and water stations, as well as pacemakers. After the race, they can personalize their medal by having their result engraved.
course_highlights: A certified PZLA half-marathon course, one loop and 21.097 km long
100% asphalt surface, with markings every 1 km
Refreshment and water stations along the course; 3-hour time limit
additional: After the race, participants can personalize their medal with their result engraved (cost: 25 zł). Pacemakers wearing balloons and special shirts will be on the course. The half-marathon time limit is 3 hours. After that, runners must stop and travel to the finish in a minibus marked KONIEC PÓŁMARATONU. A group warm-up is scheduled for 9:45. An activity zone is available for children. The event attracts over 1,200 participants each year and offers personalized medals, a 3-hour time limit, and activities for children. Registration is available online and at the race office.

name: PKO Wieczorny Półmaraton Łódź
description: The PKO Łódź Evening Half Marathon is a new, atmospheric running event held in the centre of Łódź. The start and finish are located at the revitalised EC1 combined heat and power plant, which is now a cultural and science centre. The 21.097 km course passes through the city’s best-known landmarks, bringing together its industrial history and modern character. This is a race where it’s not just the result that matters, but also the unique atmosphere and energy of the city.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the revitalised EC1 combined heat and power plant
The course passes through Łódź’s best-known landmarks
An evening road race in the city centre
additional: The participant limit is 5,000. The race pack includes a commemorative drawstring backpack, and everyone who finishes the race receives a medal. An official SMMASH technical shirt is available to purchase. Discounts are available to PKO Bank Polski customers paying online. Registration opened one week before the event. The course includes key locations in Łódź.

name: 44 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Wzgórza Strzelińskie, Strzelin, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is an orienteering foot rally organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin Land Branch, since 1996. Teams of 2–5 plan their own route, aiming to visit as many checkpoints as possible within the allotted time. The checkpoints have different point values, so success calls for both navigation skills and strategy. The event is open to participants of different ages and ability levels, making it an appealing activity for enthusiasts and families alike. It takes place in the scenic Strzelin Hills, offering a chance to enjoy nature and spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: The varied checkpoints of the Strzelin Hills
A route of any chosen length, from approximately 5 km to 70 km, planned by each team
Foot navigation using a map and compass
additional: Teams of 2–5 plan their route independently and may change it during the competition. Checkpoints have different point values depending on how difficult they are to find. The competition is open to everyone, regardless of age or gender, and results are divided into age and gender categories. Routes range from 6 to 70 km, with the option to register and plan a route before the start. The event takes place in the Strzelin Hills, among forests and varied terrain.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
location: Gontyniec, Chodzież, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the picturesque Gontyniec Massif. Competitors cover the greatest distance they can, with well-stocked aid stations available after every loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, with beautiful views of the Noteć Valley and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It is a unique experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable impressions.
course_highlights: Non-stop race on loops of approximately 10 km
Aid station for competitors after every loop
Views of the Noteć Valley and unique figurative beehives along the course
additional: The race lasts 6 or 12 hours non-stop. The course consists of loops of approximately 10 km. An aid station is available after every loop. Competitors can choose the 6- or 12-hour option. The course runs through the Gontyniec Massif, with scenic views and natural attractions. Trail, mountain and forest paths; participant limit of 150 in each race; preparation period of 8 to 20 weeks.

name: XIV Jastrzębska Dziesiątka
location: Hala Widowiskowo-Sportowa, Aleja Jana Pawła II 6, Jastrzębie-Zdrój, Poland
description: The 14th Jastrzębska Dziesiątka Street Run is an annual road race held in Jastrzębie-Zdrój. Runners cover a 10 km route along the city’s central streets. The start and finish are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall, Aleja Jana Pawła II 6. The participant limit is 600, and the race is scheduled to start at 17:00 on September 19, 2026. The accompanying race takes place from 15:00 to 15:50 on the same day.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the city’s central streets
Start and finish at the Sports and Entertainment Hall, Aleja Jana Pawła II 6
Urban course in Jastrzębie-Zdrój
additional: The participant limit is 600. The race office is open on race day from 14:00 at the Sports and Entertainment Hall, Aleja Jana Pawła II 6. The accompanying race takes place before the main race, from 15:00 to 15:50. The event includes the main 10 km race and shorter events at the venue, and the participant limit is 600.

description: The dm Balaton RUN will take place in Zamárdi on September 19, 2026, offering runners the chance to run along one of the most beautiful stretches of the Balaton shoreline. The race is family-friendly and suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, with several distances: 2.3 km, 5.25 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, and half-marathon relay. The race pack includes a premium Mizuno T-shirt, a custom-designed finisher’s medal awaits participants at the finish, and environmentally friendly, cup-free refreshments are provided. The route runs mostly along the lakeshore, allowing participants to enjoy the atmosphere of the Balaton and the early autumn sunshine.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly along the Balaton shoreline
Panoramic views of Tihany on the opposite shore
Environmentally friendly, cup-free refreshment stations along the course
additional: The race provides cup-free, environmentally friendly refreshment points, where no single-use plastic or paper cups are used. dm products will be available to runners at the refreshment stations, with several opportunities to refuel on the longer distances. Runners must bring their own soft cup or water bottle, but a soft cup can be borrowed at the race center in exchange for a deposit. The race offers various distances and categories; participants can register online, and timing and medals are provided during the race.

name: BAKONYALJA FUTÁS
location: Tárkány és Ászár, Veszprém megye, Hungary
description: The Bakonyalja Run is a traditional trail-running race held around Tárkány and Ászár. It is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which supports running and orienteering through several departments. Runners can test their strength on varied terrain in a natural setting while enjoying the scenic landscapes of Bakonyalja. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is open to all age groups.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around Tárkány and Ászár
Varied trail-running routes
Scenic Bakonyalja landscape
additional: Participants can enter several distances. Details are available on the registration page, and the event is held with the support of the local community.

name: DOMB42X (2.)
location: Benkó Domb, Kecskemét, Bács-Kiskun County, Hungary
description: DOMB42X is a unique running race at Kecskemét’s highest point, Benkó Hill, where participants run up and down the nearly 50-metre-high hill several times. One lap of the course is 1.0047 km, and runners complete between 3 and 42 laps, depending on the distance, making the event span from half-marathon to ultramarathon. The race is distinguished by its substantial elevation gain, which exceeds 2,000 metres over the marathon distance. The event is family-friendly: entry is free for spectators, and the recreation park offers them a variety of activities and sports facilities.
course_highlights: Repeated ascents and descents of nearly 50-metre-high Benkó Hill
One lap is 1.0047 km, with substantial elevation gain
More than 2,000 metres of elevation gain over the marathon distance
additional: A display shows the number of completed laps after each lap, so runners do not have to keep count in their heads. The event is family-friendly, with free entry for spectators. The recreation park has a playground, beach volleyball, beach football, a basketball court, hiking trails, lakes, fishing facilities, a snack bar and a restaurant. The different distances have age limits and participant caps, and prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each gender category. Trail running, multiple distances, family-friendly activities, a commitment to sustainability, children’s races, elevation gain, multi-lap courses
