name: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI
organizer: Občianske združenie MAPENZI by Generation of love, Obec Bešeňov
description: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI je bežecké podujatie organizované občianskym združením MAPENZI by Generation of love a obcou Bešeňov. Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku v Bešeňove a ponúkajú kategórie na 10 km, 5 km, detské behy a rekreačný beh 2 km. Štart detských behov je o 15:00 a hlavného behu o 16:00. Podujatie má charitatívny charakter a je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane rôznych vekových kategórií.
course_highlights: Trasy 10 km a 5 km pre mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových kategóriách
Detské behy so štartom o 15:00 hod.
Rekreačný beh na 2 km
additional: Štart detských behov o 15:00 hod., štart hlavného behu o 16:00 hod. Organizátori poskytujú kontakty na štyroch zodpovedných osôb s telefónnymi číslami. Podujatie je charitatívne a organizované v spolupráci s obcou Bešeňov. Podujatie zahŕňa charitatívny beh na podporu MAPENZI, registrácia je dostupná online aj na mieste, a trať vedie cez futbalové ihrisko v Bešeňove.

name: Olšavský pohár – Memoriál Júliusa Kažimíra
organizer: Obec Ruskov and Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Ruskov

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 € pre prihlásených a vyplatených účastníkov najneskôr do 15.9.2025

description: Olšavský pohár - Memoriál Júliusa Kažimíra je bežecký pretek konaný v obci Ruskov v okrese Košice okolie. Pretek ponúka dve hlavné trate s dĺžkami 16,8 km a 9,7 km, pričom štart je pred Obecným úradom. Súťažiť môžu muži, ženy aj deti v rôznych vekových kategóriách. Organizátormi sú obec Ruskov a Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Ruskov v spolupráci s okolitými obcami. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť, vrátane seniorov a detí, ktorí majú štartovné zdarma.
course_highlights: Dve trate: 16,8 km a 9,7 km
Štart pred Obecným úradom v Ruskov
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a deti podľa veku
additional: Štart detských kategórií je o 13:00, dospelých o 14:00. Seniori muži nad 70 rokov, ženy nad 60 rokov a deti majú štartovné zdarma. Pretek sa koná 20. septembra 2026; registrácia je možná na mieste; traťové podmienky nie sú špecifikované

name: Trail Český ráj
location: Branžež, Český ráj, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Český ráj is a popular off-road half marathon that takes you through the heart of Český ráj, including the courtyard of Kost Castle, pine groves and sandstone cliffs. This race continues the eleventh edition of the popular ELEVEN PŮLMARATON ČESKÝ RÁJ and offers what is probably the most beautiful off-road half-marathon route in the Czech Republic. The start is at Komárovský Pond, and every runner has a finish to look forward to. The race also offers a wide range of services for participants, including refreshments, changing rooms and medical support.
course_highlights: The route passes through the courtyard of Kost Castle
Surroundings featuring pine groves and sandstone cliffs
An off-road half marathon with beautiful natural scenery in Český ráj
additional: The start and registration are at the race centre by Komárovský Pond. Changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, catering and parking are available near the race centre. Participants receive an original medal, a race pack and an electronic timing chip, and can use the medical service. Photos and certificates can be downloaded after the race; a programme of accompanying activities and prizes for the top three in each category are provided. The event offers medals, race packs, refreshments, medical support and parking. Online registration is available, with late entry also possible. The event also includes obstacle races and special categories for dogs and children.

name: PoHodová devítka
location: Velká Bíteš, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: PoHodová Devítka is a traditional running race in Velká Bíteš, held in September after the local festivities. The main course is 9 km and is suitable for runners of all abilities; children can race shorter distances. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and is open to the general public, including children’s and youth categories. About one third of the route is on asphalt and two thirds on unpaved roads. The race takes place in open traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: Main course: 9 km
Approximately one third asphalt and two thirds unpaved roads
The race takes place in open traffic
additional: Children start by category from 11:00, beginning with the youngest, followed by the younger and older pupils. The fun run starts immediately after the main race. Children can enjoy a bouncy castle and face painting, and every child receives a small prize. Race bib numbers are entered into a raffle for a voucher for an extended PoHodová Devítka running weekend. Registration includes entry into the draw for a weekend running package. The race is part of the local festivities and offers various age categories and distances.

name: Memoriál Matěje Mauera
description: The Matěj Mauer Memorial is a 9 km running race that follows mostly forest trails, with one longer climb. The race takes place in the scenic location of Capartice near Plzeň and is part of the Běžec Chodska series. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves in a natural setting on a more challenging course. It is suited to runners looking for a trail challenge and wanting to enjoy the atmosphere of a traditional race.
course_highlights: 9 km course
Mostly forest trails
One longer climb
additional: The race is part of the “Best Runner of Chodsko” competition, offers various age categories and detailed results from previous editions, and takes place on September 20, 2026.

description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The competition takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an appealing course and sporting competition. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and community engagement. The organizers provide professional event services and a comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: The course runs through the town park in Mosina
Scenic surroundings with natural greenery
A well-marked and prepared running course
additional: The event is organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. Telephone: +48 61 813 29 03. Detailed information and registration will be available soon. The event is part of the Mosina municipality’s calendar of sports and recreational events. It also includes races for children and young people, with medals and accompanying attractions for participants. The races are part of the Mosina Grand Prix series.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechitów Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at Saint Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, recalling the historic journey of Otto III. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timing and course safety, while participants receive a race pack with a medal and a recovery meal.
course_highlights: Start at the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki; finish at Saint Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno
A 21.0975 km PZLA-certified route, entirely on asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the route, including water and isotonic drink
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours and 30 minutes. Timing is provided by chips attached to race bibs. The organizer provides coach transport to the start in Ostrów Lednicki. The race pack includes safety pins for attaching the bib, a medal at the finish and a recovery meal. Registration and race-pack collection take place at the sports hall of II LO in Gniezno on 19 September from 15:00 to 20:00 and on 20 September from 7:00 to 9:00. The participant limit is 2,000; minimum age is 18. Travel by coach or own transport.

The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organisation and attractive race conditions.

The event promotes running and physical activity among Wrocław residents, offering participants professional organisation and a friendly atmosphere. The race has a 3-hour time limit and provides hydration points and a post-race recovery meal.

Overall and age-group classifications; 3-hour time limit for the half marathon. Online registration. The race package includes a bib, water, a meal, a medal and a giveaway. Activities for participants and spectators.

name: Festiwal Górski Maraton Trzech Jezior
description: The Three Lakes Mountain Marathon Festival is a unique running event in the scenic land of the Beskid lakes, featuring four distances: the 3.5 km Czupel Vertical with 600 m of elevation gain, a 43 km marathon, 21 km, and 17 km. The routes pass through the wild mountain terrain of the Little Beskids, offering participants beautiful views, varied terrain, and a connection with the region’s nature and history. The event brings the running community together and promotes an active lifestyle as well as the area’s tourist and cultural attractions. Races take place from September 18–20, 2026, and the main marathon is an ultramarathon with demanding climbs and technical descents.
course_highlights: The main marathon route is approximately 43 km long, with +/- 2,480 m of elevation change
Views of three lakes and the dam in Tresna, as well as Czupel, the highest peak in the Little Beskids
Varied terrain: punishing climbs, fast traverses, technical descents, and scenic meadows
additional: The festival takes place from September 18–20, 2026. Four distances: Czupel Vertical 3.5 km (starts September 18 at 16:30), Three Lakes Marathon 43 km (starts September 19 at 8:00), Rollercoaster 21 km (starts September 19 at 10:00), and Wołoski Shepherds’ Trail 17 km (starts September 20 at 9:30). The race office is open September 18–20, with hours varying by distance. The marathon route finishes at the stadium in Porąbka. Four distances, mountain routes, scenic views, mountain terrain, sports festival

Race numbers can be collected at the start venue from 18:00 to 19:30. Chip timing is provided by Datacontrol.cz. The race takes place around three lakes. Registration is available online and on site, and prizes are prepared for the best finishers and those who register early.

Trasy vedú kombináciou asfaltových a lesných ciest s krásnymi výhľadmi a občerstvovačkami na trati. Pretekári štartujú a cieľia pred kultúrnym domom v Pači, pričom organizátori zabezpečujú navigáciu a označenie trasy. Podujatie je vhodné pre pokročilých aj rekreačných bežcov a ponúka športovú atmosféru s občerstvením a tombolou.

Hobby beh 6,3 km s prevýšením 203 m, kombinácia asfaltu a lesnej cesty
Občerstvovačky na trati a panoramatické výhľady na Pačanský chotár

description: Behaj lesmi Devín sú jedinečné trailové preteky pri Bratislave, ktoré ponúkajú beh po trase s výhľadom na sútok Dunaja a Moravy a Devínsku Kobylu. Trasy vedú historickou Jantárovou cestou a rozkvitnutými alejami medvedieho cesnaku, čo robí beh nezabudnuteľným zážitkom. Preteky sú súčasťou série Behaj lesmi a sú zaradené pod UTMB Index Races, čo zaručuje medzinárodné bodové hodnotenie. course_highlights: Trasa s výhľadom na sútok Dunaja a Moravy a Devínsku Kobylu
Historická obchodná Jantárová cesta a aleje medvedieho cesnaku

description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering 10 km and 21 km courses. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, and the route passes historical and natural landmarks around the town. After the race, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a prize raffle. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own races free of charge. The loop includes crossing the lock and running through Hořín Park
On-course refreshment stations, including a turnaround point near Vrbno
additional: Registration and changes are not possible on race day. Race bibs can only be collected until 9:30. After the race, every participant receives a commemorative glass and can take part in a tasting of local wines. Lunch is free for all runners, including a vegetarian option. A prize raffle will take place after the winners are announced. The race capacity is 500 runners for the 10 km and 21 km courses. Children’s races are free of charge. Entry fees vary depending on the registration date. The event supports charitable causes helping people with cystic fibrosis, and the race is limited to 500 runners.

name: Grymovská pětka
description: Grymovská pětka is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering athletes the chance to test their abilities in the pleasant surroundings of the town of Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc is a club specializing in recreational and competitive running that organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of its running calendar and attracts runners of different ages and ability levels. The club also supports runners with training and race preparation, helping to ensure a high-quality sporting experience.
course_highlights: Road course in a beautiful sports complex by the Bečva River
An opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners
Part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The race takes place on 26 September 2026. The course is adapted to different ability levels; exact registration information is not provided.

name: Běh Bohutínem
location: Fotbalové hřiště Litavan, Bohutín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 CZK pro dospělé, 20 CZK pro děti
description: Běh Bohutínem is a traditional running race organized by SK Sporting Bohutín, held at the Litavan football pitch. The race offers an 8 km course for men and a 4 km course for women, with a surface combining asphalt and forest trails. The event also includes children’s races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The main race starts at 13:00, and the atmosphere is friendly and sporty.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt and forest trails
Men run 8 km; women run 4 km
Start and finish at the Litavan football pitch
additional: Children’s races are part of the event. The course is GPS-measured at 4.88 km; according to the race details, men run 8 km and women 4 km. Results are regularly published in the system and as a PDF. The organizer offers neoprene chip straps for purchase for 100 Kč. The race starts at the Litavan football pitch at 13:00. The event also includes children’s races and running in a natural setting, with asphalt and forest sections.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zlín Region Run is part of the celebrations for Zlín Region Day, taking place on 26 September 2026 in Zlín. The event offers not only a sporting experience in the form of a 6 km run, but also a cultural program, regional cuisine, and family activities. The run is open to the general public and is part of a full day of entertainment, crafts, and regional products. The organizer is the Zlín Region, which supports sport and local traditions through the event.
course_highlights: The course follows a closed asphalt loop in the Baťa industrial complex
The day also includes a children’s run and other sporting activities
The program features regional cuisine, crafts, and cultural performances
additional: Regional cuisine, running, sports and cultural program, family activities, regional products

name: Běh Velké skály
description: Běh Velké skály is a traditional running race held in Děčín, offering 11 km and 6.5 km courses through forest and urban terrain. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who have special races prepared for them. The start is at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium, and the race atmosphere is enhanced by the beautiful natural surroundings and rock formations. The event is now in its 56th edition and is known for its exceptional atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Forest and urban terrain
11 km and 6.5 km courses
Start and finish at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium
additional: Registration is available online at www.nazavody.cz until midnight on 23. 9. 2026. The entry fee must be paid in advance to receive the lower price; on-site payment is available at a higher price. The race office accepts late registrations up to 30 minutes before the start of each category. The course covers forest and urban terrain. Registration is via www.nazavody.cz. Children’s races and relay races are held, and the main race is part of the Děčín Running Cup.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
description: The Plzeň Cardiovascular Run is the largest cross-country race in Plzeň, with 5.8 km and 10 km courses. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and also serves as the Czech Republic Cross-Country Championship for healthcare professionals. It is organized by Pro Sport Activities, an agency with a long-standing tradition of organizing sporting events in Plzeň and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a quality sporting experience in the natural surroundings of Plzeň-Roudná.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Plzeň-Roudná
Two courses: 5.8 km and 10 km
Czech Republic Cross-Country Championship for healthcare professionals
additional: The races include cross-country and asphalt routes. There are children’s races and an accompanying program with activities. Registration is through Apachi, and parking is available at Rychtářka.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Konopiště
description: KEEN Prague Park Race - Konopiště is a running race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Konopiště, offering a unique running experience in the picturesque Central Bohemian Region. The course runs along both paved and unpaved paths and combines natural scenery with historic sites. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, known for its relaxed atmosphere and high-quality organization. Runners of all levels are welcome to take on a sporting challenge close to nature.
course_highlights: The course runs along paved and unpaved paths in the natural surroundings of Konopiště
A combination of natural scenery and historic sites
A friendly atmosphere and well-organized race
additional: Choose between an 8 km or 14 km course, with the option to change your distance before race day. The longer course has a refreshment station at approximately 8 km, and refreshments are also available at the finish. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, which includes pre-race group runs. Registration is through irontime.cz; payment must be made within three days of registering. The event includes a children’s race, on-site registration, parking nearby, and a detailed schedule on the website. The event also features test runs and presentations of KEEN running shoes.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
location: Ski Areál Severák, Trojanovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountain Ranges is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The Beskydy race takes place in the amphitheatre at Horečky in Trojanovice and offers technical trails, epic views and an atmosphere you won’t experience anywhere else. The routes follow forest roads and paths, with climbs up interesting hills and long descents. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can look forward to refreshments and professional facilities.
course_highlights: Technical trails with 1,230 m of elevation gain on the main 23 km course
Routes follow forest roads and paths, with climbs up interesting hills
Beautiful views and an atmosphere in the amphitheatre at Horečky in Trojanovice
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours; after that, a runner is marked as DNF. Participants can leave small items at the registration booth. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and a commemorative medal. The races take place at Ski Areál Severák in Trojanovice. Registration includes a race bib, chip timing, a medal, refreshments and facilities. The time limit is 4 hours.

name: ŠumpeRUN
description: ŠumpeRUN is a popular urban running race held through the historic centre of Šumperk. The eighth edition will offer races for the general public, including the 10 km main race, a 3.33 km race, relay races for teams of three, and children’s races over various distances. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit while celebrating the city’s cultural heritage. For 2026, a varied programme of activities is planned, including group warm-ups and music along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs through Šumperk’s historic centre, its urban conservation area, pedestrian zones and parks
The 10 km main race consists of three 3.33 km laps, with approximately 60 m of total elevation gain
Children’s races take place in Sady 1. máje Park, with distances from 100 m to 2 km depending on age
additional: Registration opens on 1 June 2026. Entry to the children’s races is free. Group warm-ups led by professional instructors will take place before the children’s races (10:30) and the adult races (14:00). There will be music along the course from a DJ or live band. The start and finish are at Svobody Square, near Hotel PERK and the Business Academy. Capacity is 350 runners for the main race, 100 runners for the 3 km race, 50 relay teams and 100 children in each age category. The event is aimed at the general public, offers a range of categories and makes results available online. It is part of the local sports calendar and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: K3-run
description: K3 – Krčmaň Run Over Three Peaks is an 11.3 km race with approximately 350 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through beautiful countryside over three peaks, mainly on paved paths and partly on grass, with predominantly firm surfaces. This run offers athletes an enjoyable experience in nature and a challenge in the form of climbs and trail running.
course_highlights: Route length: 11.3 km
Elevation gain: approx. 350 m
The route passes over three peaks, mainly on paved paths
additional: The race runs mainly on paved paths and grass, is suitable for runners of all levels, and offers beautiful views of the surrounding countryside.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Provocation is an annual running event in Gliwice that combines sport, a friendly atmosphere, and time in the city’s green spaces. The race is open to both experienced runners and people who want to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The race traditionally starts in the clearing behind Piast Stadium, and the race office opens at 9:00, with the start at 10:00. Participation requires advance registration and an entry fee. It’s a great opportunity to end February actively and head into the upcoming spring season with renewed energy.
course_highlights: Start in the clearing behind Piast Stadium (entrance from Leśna Street)
A route through urban green spaces, offering a chance to connect with nature
An event combining sport and a friendly atmosphere without the pressure of competition
additional: The race office is open from 9:00. Advance registration and payment of the entry fee are required to be included in the results. The race takes place on the last day of February, offering a symbolic way to start the new month actively. The event encourages the local community to come together and promotes an active lifestyle among Gliwice residents.

name: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Koło Towarzystwa Przyjaciół Lasu "Dolina Małej Panwi"
description: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi – In Pursuit of the Beaver is a running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque surroundings of Zawadzkie. The event offers 5.3 km and 10.3 km courses that run through the Mała Panew Valley, giving participants the chance to enjoy nature and active recreation. The event is organized by the Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Association and the “Dolina Małej Panwi” Circle of the Society of Friends of the Forest.
course_highlights: 5.3 km and 10.3 km courses through the Mała Panew Valley
Picturesque woodland and natural scenery
Option to take part in a 5.3 km Nordic walking event
additional: The race office is open from 10:00 to 11:40 on the day of the event. Electronic timing using passive chips. Online registration and payment available. The organizer provides race bib distribution and technical support for the event. Online registration; event in Zawadzkie, promoting physical activity and contact with nature.

name: XIII Bieg Branicki
description: The 13th Branice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Branice, Opole Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide expert support and the option to manage race information through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Scenic surroundings in Branice, Opole Voivodeship
Tailored training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks
additional: Training plans tailored to runners’ experience levels and expert support are available. The TreningBiegacza.pl platform offers the option to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. The event includes training preparations and is part of local sporting events in Branice.

name: XXI Mikołowski Bieg Uliczny
description: The 21st Henryk Biskupiak Mikołów Street Run is the biggest sporting event in Mikołów and is held annually. The street race attracts runners of different age groups and abilities, promoting physical activity and the spirit of sports competition. Participants can take on a route through the city streets, while the organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere full of sporting excitement. The event is an excellent opportunity to bring the local community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A street race in the center of Mikołów
Option to receive a commemorative T-shirt
Organized by MOSiR Mikołów
additional: The race office is open on race day from 16:00 to 18:45. Commemorative T-shirts can be purchased until 31.08.2025; after that date, it will no longer be possible to buy one. More than 50 people have already registered for the race. The event offers various registration options, and participants can look forward to commemorative T-shirts. The race is part of the local sporting events and promotes physical activity in the community.

name: VIII Bieg Szlakiem Kolejowym
location: Czerwona Woda, Gmina Węgliniec, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

description: The Masterprint Tihany Cross trail-running and freestyle Nordic walking race takes place on the picturesque Tihany Peninsula, with a variety of distances: 5, 10, 20 and 30 km. The course runs through beautiful autumn lavender fields and hilly forest trails marked with red ribbons. The event is family-friendly and also welcomes participants with children’s races and a relay. The race centre is located on the shore of Lake Belső, where the well-equipped aid stations and finish area are also situated. Participants can order a professional technical running shirt.
course_highlights: 5 km fun run over the hilly terrain of Tihany
10 km cross-country course featuring four autumn lavender fields
Aid stations with water, energy drink, fruit and salted pretzels
additional: Children’s races in kindergarten and primary-school categories, with on-site registration. Relay race for teams of two or three, with a shared race pack and an ankle chip for the relay. The technical race shirt can be ordered; it is made of microfibre polyester and elastane and has a silver-grey design. Aid stations at several points, with <i:am> hypotonic fueling drink. On-site registration for all distances costs a flat 10,000 Ft; a finisher’s medal is not guaranteed with on-site registration. Terrain: forest roads and trails; registration: on-site and online; event atmosphere: friendly, sporty and close to nature

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, loop-based running race held in Dióskert. Runners can complete the half-marathon distance by running four laps, but they can also choose to run fewer laps. The entry fee is voluntary, at 500 HUF per lap, and supports the costs of the race. All participants receive an apple, hot tea and mulled wine, as well as a commemorative medal. The top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The course is a loop located in Dióskert.
The half-marathon distance consists of four laps, but runners may choose to run fewer.
A friendly, community atmosphere, with apples, hot drinks and mulled wine at the finish.
additional: On-site registration is available; the suggested voluntary entry fee is 500 HUF per lap. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00. Runners are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. Runners may choose to complete fewer laps. On-site registration, refreshments and commemorative medals are available; the awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: Mariatálsky štvanec je tradičný bežecký závod v krásnej prírode Malých Karpát, ktorý ponúka rôzne disciplíny pre hobby bežcov aj výkonnostných pretekárov. Podujatie sa koná v obci Marianka s rodinnou atmosférou a vrcholí prekrásnym západom slnka. Súťažiť môžete v kategóriách na 6 km, 10 km, 15 km, v trojčlenných tímoch na 3×6 km, alebo v detských behoch Beh Záhoráčik. Štart a cieľ sú na futbalovom ihrisku, pričom preteky sa riadia pravidlami Slovenského atletického zväzu.
course_highlights: Trate vedú Malými Karpatmi s krásnou prírodou
Rodinná atmosféra s detskými behmi Beh Záhoráčik
Prekrásny západ slnka ako vrchol podujatia
additional: Prezentácia a vyzdvihnutie štartových čísiel je možná v pobočke TUI v nákupnom centre BORY MALL. Počet dospelých účastníkov je limitovaný na 500, detí na 400. Počet tímov nie je obmedzený. Časové limity sú 1 hodina pre 6 km, 1:30 hodiny pre 10 km, 2 hodiny pre 15 km a 1,5 hodiny pre tímovú súťaž 3×6 km. Podujatie zahŕňa viacero tratí, kategórie pre dospelých, deti a štafety, registrácia online aj na mieste, časomiera s čipmi, občerstvenie a medaily, limit účastníkov je 900.

name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
description: MTHIKER Kylof Ľubietová je bežecký závod, ktorý spája históriu, prírodu a dobrú náladu v malebnom prostredí srdca Slovenska. Preteká sa na troch tratiach: 4,3 km hobby trať pre začiatočníkov a mladých od 13 rokov, 10 km hlavný beh pre výkonnostných aj hobby bežcov a detské behy na 850 m pre deti od 6 do 12 rokov. Trať ponúka stúpania, krásne výhľady na Nízke Tatry a pretekári môžu súťažiť o finančné odmeny a hodnotné ceny. Po dobehu čaká na účastníkov tradičný granadír a originálna medaila patriaca do Marathon Tour.
course_highlights: 4,3 km hobby trať s pekným okruhom a stúpaním
10 km trať s výhľadmi na Nízke Tatry a banský chodník
Detské behy v centre Ľubietovej na 850 m
additional: Detské behy štartujú od 9:30 podľa vekových kategórií, hobby trať štartuje o 10:40 a hlavný beh o 10:30. Každý účastník dostane originálnu medailu do Marathon Tour. V cieli je pripravený granadír. Najrýchlejší bežci získajú poukazy a trofej, absolútni víťazi 10 km aj finančné ceny. Všetci dobehnutí sú zaradení do žrebovania o zážitkové ceny ako zoskok s padákom alebo vyhliadkový let. Trail running, registrácia, rodinné podujatie, historické témy, krásne výhľady

name: Gréta Run
location: Koliba Gréta, Liptovská Sielnica, okres L. Mikuláš, Slovakia
description: Gréta Run je tradičný bežecký pretek v malebnom prostredí Kvačianskej doliny a Liptovskej Sielnice, ktorý ponúka trate rôznych dĺžok pre deti aj dospelých. Preteky vedú po žltej turistickej značke a hrádzi, s cieľom v Kolibe Gréta, kde pretekárov čaká občerstvenie a kultúrny program. Súčasťou podujatia je aj bohatý sprievodný program pre rodiny a deti. Organizátorom je Olympijský klub Liptova, ktorý zabezpečuje kvalitné technické a zdravotné služby.
course_highlights: 7,4 km trať z Kvačianskej doliny po žltej značke do Koliby Gréta
15 km trať z Koliby Gréta cez Kvačiansku dolinu a Prosiecku dolinu späť do Koliby Gréta
3 km trať po hrádzi k Liptovskej Sielnici a späť
additional: Prvých 200 registrovaných účastníkov dostane štartový balíček s gulášom, špagetami, tričkom a medailou. Prevoz bežcov na štart 7,4 km zabezpečený autobusom o 15:30. Po pretekoch guláš a vyhlásenie výsledkov v Stodole Gréta, následne koncert. Šatne a toalety k dispozícii v Kolibe Gréta. Organizátor nezodpovedá za osobné veci a batožinu. Možnosť zvýhodneného ubytovania priamo na mieste. Traťové úseky vedú z Kvačianskej doliny a Koliby Gréta, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, súčasťou štartovného je guláš, medaila, občerstvenie a ďalšie služby. Preteky ponúkajú viacero kategórií vrátane detských a veteránskych, s vyhodnotením a cenami pre víťazov.

description: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 - 5. kolo je bežecké podujatie organizované 3klubom Šamorín v spolupráci s mestom Šamorín. Preteky sa konajú v príjemnom prostredí Lesoparku Pomlé v Šamoríne a sú určené pre rôzne vekové kategórie od predškolákov až po dospelých. Štart detských kategórií je o 10:00 hod., hlavný beh začína o 10:30 hod. Podujatie ponúka možnosť zapojiť sa do ligy a zažiť športovú atmosféru v komunitnom prostredí.
course_highlights: Preteky v prírodnom prostredí Lesoparku Pomlé
Kategórie pre deti aj dospelých
Štart detí o 10:00, hlavný beh o 10:30
additional: Kategórie: Predškoláci (0 - 6 rokov), Mladší žiaci (7 - 10 rokov), Starší žiaci (11 - 15 rokov), Dospelí (ženy, muži). Organizátorom je 3klub Šamorín o.z. v spolupráci s mestom Šamorín. Kontakt na organizátora: Juraj Nagy, tel.: 0905 984 190. trasy na asfaltových a lesných chodníkoch, kategórie od predškolákov po dospelých, bez výkonnostného a vekového limitu

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
description: Běchovice–Prague is a legendary 10 km road race with the longest uninterrupted tradition in Europe, now being held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech Republic Road Running Championship and features a challenging 10,031-metre course that tests every runner. The atmosphere is exceptional and complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying programme and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and also offers a relay race.
course_highlights: The course is 10,031 metres long, 31 metres more than the traditional 10 km
Start in Běchovice, finish at Pražačka in Prague
Official Czech Republic 10 km Road Running Championship with 26 categories
additional: Race numbers are distributed at the hall at Masaryk Railway Station in Prague in the days before the race, and in Běchovice on race day. The race includes a Joma technical T-shirt and a commemorative medal in the entry fee. The relay race starts at the same time as the third wave of the race, at 11:50. Each relay team consists of 4 members, with predetermined legs. The race has a capacity of 3,333 runners. Race photos and a personalised race video are free. The race is part of Prague’s running traditions and celebrations, offers online registration, and starts on Českobrodská Street in Běchovice.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
location: Praha 1, Centrum Prahy, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in different districts of Prague. It aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and a sense of belonging to one’s district. The race is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, as well as participants with disabilities, who represent their district. Each start earns points in the competition to find Prague’s most sports-oriented district. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with original medals and gifts for participants.
course_highlights: Races take place in different districts of Prague, including the city centre
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit among Prague residents
Categories for all age groups, including participants with disabilities
additional: Each participant represents the district where they have permanent residence and contributes to the districts’ points tally. The project emphasises competition between Prague’s districts to be named the most sports-oriented. Original medals and running magnets for bib numbers are prepared for participants as keepsakes. The races offer different course distances and are part of a series, with medals and updates about the event location; registration is available online and on site.

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: The 48th Warsaw Marathon is a special running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting thousands of runners. The course passes through the capital’s most beautiful and historic locations, offering unique views and an unforgettable atmosphere. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and T-shirt, while spectators can enjoy numerous attractions and cheering zones. It is a celebration of running that brings together sport, culture, and community.
course_highlights: Start beneath the Palace of Culture and Science in the centre of Warsaw
The course passes along Krakowskie Przedmieście and Nowy Świat, over Poniatowski Bridge with views of the Vistula, and by PGE Narodowy
Road closures ensure safe and comfortable running conditions
additional: The race number must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or altered. The start and finish are in the city centre, near metro stations. On race day, baggage storage, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event features numerous attractions and cheering zones, as well as a programme at the Marathon Fan Zone and EXPO Sport&Fitness. Participants can join the #BiegamDobrze charity programme with a free race number. Races include a 10 km event (Warszawska Dycha) and the Mini Marathon for children and young people, held during the same weekend. Registration is available through the official website, and the event also includes a half marathon and a 5 km race. The organisers provide attractions and support for participants.

name: 21. Kamień Extreme - Rybnik
description: The 21st Kamień Extreme is a demanding mountain race held in Rybnik that attracts fans of extreme running challenges. The event takes place on 27 September 2026 and offers professional timekeeping using RFID technology. It is organized by MOSiR Rybnik, ensuring smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at 12:00, and registration closes on 17 September 2026 at 23:59.
course_highlights: An extreme mountain course
Professional RFID timekeeping
Organized by MOSiR Rybnik
additional: Date: 2026-09-27, start at 12:00, registration until 17 September 2026, location: Rybnik

name: 16 Bieg im. Pawła Lorensa
location: Lake Paprocańskie, Tychy, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 16th Paweł Lorens Run is an annual 10 km race held in the scenic surroundings of Lake Paprocańskie in Tychy. The race commemorates the achievements of outstanding runner Paweł Lorens, a multiple Polish Championships medalist and promoter of athletics in the region. The route is flat and fast, following compacted paths along the pedestrian promenade and a paved sidewalk. Free children’s races are also held on race day, with registration available on the day of the event.
course_highlights: 10 km route in the scenic surroundings of Lake Paprocańskie
Flat and fast route along compacted paths and a paved sidewalk
Free children’s races, with registration on race day
additional: Free children’s races take place on race day, with registration available on the day of the event. The race route is flat and fast, following compacted paths along the pedestrian promenade and a paved sidewalk. Race on a flat, fast route around Lake Paprocańskie, includes free children’s races, registration on the day.

name: Kresowe Trail #11
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale, non-commercial trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation to promote a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The races take place mainly in Podlasie and the surrounding area, with two distances: Szpurt (approx. 6–8 km) and Wertep (approx. 17–21 km). Participant numbers are limited to help ensure safety and respect for nature and local communities. The events welcome both beginner and experienced runners and also include Nordic walking competitions. The 2026 season concludes with a final race in Michałowo on September 27.
course_highlights: Two distances: Szpurt (6–8 km) and Wertep (17–21 km)
Trail routes through the scenic areas of Podlasie and the surrounding region
Carefully marked courses, with aid stations on the longer distance
additional: Races start at 9:00 (except in Mielnik, where the start is at 11:00). Participant limits apply to each event. New race bibs will be used in the 2026 season. The race package includes, among other things, a hot post-race meal, electronic timing, medical support, aid stations along the course and at the finish, and a commemorative medal (for those who register at least 10 days before the event). Registration is available on race day until 8:40, but the race package may then be incomplete. The entry fee can be transferred to another date at no extra cost before online registration closes. The race is part of a trail-event series, with training preparation and online registration available. The event promotes outdoor activity and sporting competition amid the beautiful natural scenery of Podlasie.

name: X Półmaraton Crossowy
location: Nad Stawem, Jelcz-Laskowice, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The X TOYOTA Cross Half Marathon is a cross-country race taking place in Jelcz-Laskowice on 27 September 2026. The event is organised by KB Harcownik Jelcz-Laskowice. The race office is open from 08:00 to 10:30 at the Nad Stawem centre. Participants can compete over 21.1 km and 10.5 km, or take part in the 10.5 km Nordic Walking event. The event is supported by local institutions and partners, and timing is electronic, using modern equipment.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the area around Jelcz-Laskowice
Three categories: half marathon, 10.5 km race and 10.5 km Nordic Walking
Electronic timing with a finish-line display
additional: The race office is open from 08:00 to 10:30 on event day at the Nad Stawem centre in Jelcz-Laskowice. Timing uses passive chips and timing mats. The organiser provides race-bib distribution and electronic timing with a finish-line display. The event is supported by local partners and businesses, including Toyota Motor Manufacturing Poland. Participants will receive medals, and training preparations are available to those taking part.

The races take place on cross-country courses, giving participants the chance to compete amid beautiful autumn scenery. The event is part of the Grand Prix in cross-country running and Nordic walking, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in the local community.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes through the scenic area of Małkinia Górna
Autumn scenery suited to running and Nordic walking
An event included in the Grand Prix in cross-country running and Nordic walking
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix in cross-country running and Nordic walking organized by the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre in Małkinia Górna. name: ESZTERGOM FÉLMARATON
location: Kis-Duna sétány, Esztergom, Komárom-Esztergom County, Hungary
description: The Esztergom Half Marathon is a running event with a variety of distances, held across Esztergom’s historic districts, including Castle Hill, the Watertown district, and the riverside cycle path. Individual and relay runners can choose from several distances, and shorter races are organized separately for children. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also serves as a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and rewards. The event’s patrons include the mayor of Esztergom and well-known athletes, adding to its prestige.
course_highlights: The course has a mixed surface, with cobblestone and asphalt sections.
The course runs through Esztergom’s Castle Hill, Watertown district, and riverside cycle path.
The relay consists of three laps, each approximately 7 km long.
additional: Children’s races are free, but registration is required. The first relay runner may also compete in the individual half marathon. The event is a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program; participants can earn points by completing the distances. The relay exchange zone is located in the start/finish area in front of the Basilica. Distances: half marathon, 14 km, 7 km, relay, children’s races; terrain: mixed surface; registration online and on-site; the event is part of the Ötpróba program.

name: HÍRÖS FÉLMARATON
description: The Hírös Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Kecskemét, taking place on September 27, 2026, at the Benkó Center. The event offers several distances, including 0.3 km, 1 km, 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 42 km, so runners of all ages and abilities can find a suitable option. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and provide a shared community sports experience. Participants receive a custom finisher medal, and qualified first-aid providers are on hand during the race. Race bibs can be collected on race day and beforehand.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.3 km to 42 km, with individual and relay events
Time limits: 2 hours 45 minutes for 21 km and 5 hours 45 minutes for 42 km
Start times: the marathon at 9:00 and the 300 m race at 10:45
additional: Race bib pickup is available on race day and beforehand, on September 27 from 15:00 to 17:00. The entry fee includes participation in the course finish event and a pre-race pasta party. Race bibs must be worn visibly and may not be exchanged. Qualified first-aid providers will be on standby during the race. Participants can collect their race pack, attend the pasta party, receive finisher medals, and visit local attractions.

description: The Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026 will be held for the fifth time in Kapuvár, in Eszterházi Park. The course is completely flat and runs along city streets, attracting more and more runners from Hungary and abroad each year. The event aims to share the joy of community and exercise, with a friendly atmosphere and togetherness at its heart. The experience continues after the finish, with awards and a large event tent where spectators can comfortably cheer on the runners.
course_highlights: A completely flat course along city streets
Race center with a large event tent and a start-finish gate
A shared community experience and mass-participation event atmosphere
additional: The race center will be in a large event tent on the grassy area in front of the municipal building, where the start-finish gate is also located. Part of the course is closed to traffic, and refreshments are provided. Participants receive custom iron medals and certificates. Personalized finisher ribbons bearing the runner’s name can be ordered for the marathon, half-marathon, and ultramarathon distances. The race uses disposable-chip timing, except for the BabyRace distance. Multiple distances, an urban course, a community event, online registration available, venue: Eszterházi Park.

description: The Ivančice Hour Run is a traditional athletics race organized by Atletický klub Ivančice and held at Městský stadion Ivančice. The race takes place at the stadium by Malovaný mlýn, offering a sporting experience in the pleasant surroundings of a town rich in history. The start is scheduled for the morning, allowing participants to enjoy the race as well as other activities in Ivančice. The event is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Race at Městský stadion Ivančice
Pleasant sporting surroundings in a historic town
Start at 10:30 a.m.
additional: The race is organized by Atletický klub Ivančice at the FC Ivančice sports ground in Malovansko. The venue is Městský stadion Ivančice, U Malovaného mlýna č.e. 1515, 664 91 Ivančice. The race offers chip timing, registration online and on-site, and is part of the local sporting tradition.

name: Svatováclavský běh Blažovicemi
organizer: Spolek přátel Svatováclavského běhu - sdružení Vévoda
description: The St. Wenceslas Run through Blažovice is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Blažovice in the South Moravian Region. It offers two main routes, 10 km and 5 km long, which run mostly along natural paths and through woodland. The event also includes fun runs and children’s races ranging from 50 to 1,100 metres, making it appealing to the general public and families with children. It is organised by the Friends of the St. Wenceslas Run Association, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail-style routes
Two main routes: 10 km and 5 km
Fun runs and children’s races from 50 to 1,100 m
additional: The race starts at the football field in Blažovice. The main categories start at 12:45. The organiser is the Friends of the St. Wenceslas Run Association – Vévoda Association; contact person: František Kubínek, tel. 739 150 283. The race is part of the Czech Runners Club and the Czech Athletics Federation. It is part of the local running tradition and offers races of various distances, including children’s categories, making the event suitable for the whole family.

name: Běh Neumannovou stezkou
description: The Neumann Trail Run is a traditional running race organized by the T. J. Sokol Unhošť running club in the picturesque wooded surroundings of Unhošť. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in nature and also features children’s races. Runners who register in advance receive a discounted entry fee. The event has a long-standing tradition and is held regularly in autumn.
course_highlights: Picturesque wooded surroundings of Unhošť
Traditional running race with children’s races
Natural terrain suitable for running
additional: The race also includes children’s races. Those who register in advance pay a lower entry fee. Results and statistics are regularly published on the website. Course maps are available in the photo album. The start is scheduled for September 28, 2026, at 10:00. Exact registration information is not provided. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners.

name: MilešovKa(p)
location: Teplice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: MilešovKa(p) is a traditional running race from Teplice to Milešovka, covering 17.5 km with 846 m of elevation gain. The course runs along paved roads, hiking trails, and dirt and forest roads, and is marked with the red and blue signs of the Czech Tourists Club. The race is open to the general public and offers awards for the top finishers in each category, hill climbers, and age-group record holders. It is organized by SPONA Teplice, an association that supports amateur sport in the region. The awards ceremony takes place in November alongside other running events.
course_highlights: 17.5 km course with 846 m of elevation gain
Surface: paved roads, hiking trails, dirt roads, and forest roads
Course marked with the red and blue signs of the Czech Tourists Club
additional: Awards for the top five in each category, medals and certificates, trophies for winners and teams, bonuses for hill climbers and the fastest Václav, and plaques for five and ten consecutive participations. The course is marked by the Czech Tourists Club. The awards ceremony takes place in November alongside BĚKODO. Registration is open until August 31, 2025. Participants receive a T-shirt and a race medal. The race is part of a series of local runs in Teplice.

name: Běh kolem Panské skály
location: Kamenicko Šenov-Prácheň, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh kolem Panské skály is a popular trail race taking place on September 28, 2026, in Kamenický Šenov-Prácheň in the Liberec Region. The race offers 3 km and 6 km routes through hilly terrain around Panská skála and is part of the Českolipsko District Running League. The event is open to recreational runners and experienced competitors alike, offering a unique experience of running in nature with beautiful views.
course_highlights: Trail courses over hilly terrain with views of Panská skála
Two distances: 3 km and 6 km, suitable for runners of different levels
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League
additional: The race is supported by local organizations. Results and race information are published regularly. The event has a long tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area and across the country.

location: Krčský les, Praha 4-Krč, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Designers’ Autumn Run “From Pub to Pub” is a traditional running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4-Krč. The race has been popular with runners for many years and welcomes everyone who enjoys running and nature. Organizers Pepa Krejčí and Honza Vočko warmly invite you to take part on this popular course, which offers an enjoyable experience in nature. Registration is open on race day, approximately one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The course runs through picturesque Krč Forest
A traditional running course popular with local runners
Pleasant natural surroundings in Prague 4-Krč
additional: Registration for the race is open on race day, approximately one hour before the start. A running course in Krč Forest; an event for designers and running enthusiasts.

description: The Karel Havlíček Borovský Run is a traditional circuit race in Havlíčkův Brod, offering courses for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The route passes through Budoucnost Park and by landmarks such as the memorial to the victims of the world wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský. The race is suitable for all age groups and combines paved and unpaved paths with gentle elevation changes. The start and finish are at the primary school at V Sadech 560, where showers and toilets are also available.
course_highlights: Circuit route with a section through Budoucnost Park
Passes the memorial to the victims of the First and Second World Wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský
The highest point of the route is at Kalvárie, with its three crosses
additional: The start and finish are at the primary school at V Sadech 560. Showers and toilets are available in the school building. Parking is available at several locations nearby, some paid and some free. Runners aged 3 and over may take part. Participants aged 17 and under can enter for free. The event includes various age groups, with registration available online and on site. Parking is available nearby. Races take place at the Havlíčkův Brod Primary School and around the park.

name: Baran Trail Race
location: Węgierska Górka, Żywiec County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Baran Trail Race is a recurring running event held in picturesque Węgierska Górka. The event offers a range of distances from 10 km to 100 km, following challenging mountain routes with beautiful views and natural terrain. It attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering unique challenges and a distinctive atmosphere. The organizers ensure the event runs professionally and that participants are safe.
course_highlights: Mountain routes of varying difficulty
Picturesque views of the Beskids
Natural forest and rocky terrain
additional: Start and finish in Węgierska Górka. The routes pass through the Beskids over varied terrain. The event takes place on 2–3 October 2026. Four distances are available: 10 km, 25 km, 60 km and 100 km. Refreshment points along the route and medical support are provided. The event offers different participant categories, as well as an archive of results and event partners.

name: Karpaty Run – Bratislava Trail Run
location: Malokarpatské Námestie 1, Bratislava - Lamač, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Karpaty Run - Bratislava Trail Run je najväčší bežecký trailový festival v Malých Karpatoch, ktorý ponúka trasy rôznej dĺžky a náročnosti pre bežcov aj turistov. Preteky sa konajú v príjemnom prírodnom prostredí s dôrazom na ochranu prírody a zdravý životný štýl. Trasy vedú prevažne lesnými zvážnicami a trailmi s minimálnym asfaltovým povrchom, vhodné pre mierne pokročilých až pokročilých bežcov. Organizátorom je občianske združenie Hojta, ktoré podporuje športovanie a ekologické hodnoty.
course_highlights: Trasy vedú 65 % lesnou zvážnicou a 33-35 % lesným trailom
Prevýšenie od 80 m do 876 m podľa dĺžky trate
Občerstvenie na trati na viacerých miestach podľa dĺžky trate
additional: Štart je 700 m od Malokarptského námestia v Lamači s presunom 20 min pred štartom. Časový limit nie je stanovený pre väčšinu tratí, okrem najdlhších, kde je limit 5 alebo 7 hodín. Na trati sú občerstvovacie stanice podľa dĺžky trate. Možnosť zakúpiť občerstvenie na Bielom Kríži. Preteky sa konajú 3. októbra 2026, registrácia je možná prostredníctvom oficiálnej stránky, pretekárske kategórie zahŕňajú rôzne vekové skupiny, preteky sú bez časového limitu pre väčšinu vzdialeností.

name: Jarabský polmaratón
description: Jarabský polmaratón je jedinečný horský trailový pretek v Nízkych Tatrách s dĺžkou 22,1 km, ktorý ponúka náročnú trasu plnú stúpaní, klesaní a technického terénu. Pretek je určený pre milovníkov trailového behu a aktívneho oddychu, ktorí si môžu vychutnať krásne výhľady a atmosféru komunity bežcov od profesionálov po rekreačných športovcov. Podujatie má tradíciu od roku 2015 a nesie v sebe ducha priateľského bežeckého stretnutia „Choď ako môžeš okolo Jarabej“. V roku 2025 je zaradený do Slovenskej skyrunningovej ligy, čo podčiarkuje jeho kvalitu a výzvu.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez čistú prírodu, lesy a horské chodníky
Náročný trailový terén s výstupmi a zostupmi
Krásne výhľady na centrálny hrebeň Nízkych Tatier
additional: Trať má prvky pravého Sky Race-u a je súčasťou Slovenskej skyrunningovej ligy od roku 2025. Pretek je určený pre širokú komunitu bežcov od profíkov po rekreačných športovcov. V minulosti bola trať niekoľkokrát upravovaná podľa počasia, aktuálna dĺžka je 22,1 km. Podujatie má priateľskú atmosféru a vychádza z neformálneho bežeckého stretnutia bez časomiery. Náročný horský trail s prevýšením 1240 m, registrácia cez web, občerstvovacie stanice, značenie, zdravotná služba, technológie na zlepšenie skúseností.

name: U.S.Steel Family Run – Minimaratón
description: U. S. Steel Family Run - Minimaratón je bežecké podujatie v Košiciach, ktoré je súčasťou tradičného Medzinárodného maratónu mieru. Bežci všetkých vekových kategórií sú vítaní bez vekového obmedzenia. Podujatie sa riadi pravidlami World Athletics a Slovenského atletického zväzu, pričom organizátori zabezpečujú kvalitnú prípravu a organizáciu. Štart a cieľ sú situované na Hlavnej ulici v Košiciach, čo umožňuje atraktívny mestský beh.
course_highlights: Trať vedie centrom mesta Košice po Hlavnej ulici
Podujatie je vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie bez vekového limitu
Organizované podľa pravidiel World Athletics a Slovenského atletického zväzu
additional: Presun štartu na nasledujúci ročník nie je možný. Presun štartu na nového účastníka je možný za určitých podmienok. Registrácia a platba štartovného sa kontroluje online cez účet pretekára. Registrácia je otvorená pre všetkých záujemcov, pričom účastníci môžu očakávať priateľskú atmosféru a možnosť zúčastniť sa na krátkom, ale dynamickom behu v srdci Košíc.

name: PUMA Třeboňský půl/maraton 10 a 5 km
description: The Puma Třeboň Marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races take runners through the unique natural landscape of the Třeboňsko Protected Landscape Area. The routes are flat with minimal elevation gain and run mostly along paved cycling paths and forest trails, helping runners achieve personal bests in beautiful, peaceful surroundings. The race starts in Třeboň’s Renaissance square and passes through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO listing. The ideal October timing offers pleasant running weather and a motivating atmosphere, with professional pacers on the course.
course_highlights: Flat routes with minimal elevation gain in the protected natural area of Třeboňsko
Most of the course follows paved cycling paths and quality forest trails
Start in the Renaissance square and pass through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO listing
additional: Registration allows a refund of the entry fee until 8 September 2026, subject to a 150 Kč administrative fee, or transfer of the entry fee to the following year until 30 September 2026. After the race, participants can also receive a voucher worth 777 Kč toward the purchase of running shoes. The race has a participant limit, and transferring registration to another runner is not possible. The entry fee includes a free 12-month subscription to the Svět běhu magazine. Routes are available to download in .GPX format. The race includes a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, is supported by regional authorities, and offers gift vouchers for purchase. The event takes place in October 2026.

price_range: 3,300 Kč za tým; 800 Kč pro jednotlivce v kategorii Ultra

description: Run Berounka Run is a relay race for teams and individuals, following the Berounka River from Újezd u Svatého Kříže to Prague-Radotín. The 130 km route is divided into 6 legs, with over 3,100 metres of elevation gain, and runs mostly along forest and field paths. The race starts on 3 October 2026 from 5:00 in several waves; the Ultra category starts on the evening of 2 October. The race is open to teams of 2 to 6 runners and individuals in the Ultra category. Winners are announced in several categories, and refreshments are available at the finish.
course_highlights: 130 km route along the Berounka River, divided into 6 legs
Total elevation gain of 3,182 m, mostly on forest and field paths
Starts in Újezd u Svatého Kříže and finishes in Prague-Radotín, by the Říční Lázně kiosk
additional: Starts take place in waves from 5:00. The Ultra category starts on 2 October at 20:00 and at midnight. Teams have a 4-hour limit to complete each leg. Each team receives a race pack with bib numbers, a GPS chip and gifts from sponsors. Portable toilets are available at the relay points. Refreshments are available at the Říční Lázně kiosk at the finish. The maximum number of teams is 80; teams may have up to 6 runners, and the Ultra category is limited to 55 individuals. The race starts in Újezd u Svatého Kříže and finishes in Prague-Radotín. Registration is open from 1 November 2025 to 20 September 2026. The Ultra category starts on Friday evening. The route runs mostly along forest and field paths, with a total elevation gain of 3,182 m.

name: 24DS (24 Dlouhé Stráně)
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Jeseníky, Czech Republic

description: 24DS is a 24-hour endurance challenge in the unique setting of the Hrubý Jeseník mountains, running from Kouty nad Desnou to the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage power plant. The race offers stunning views of the Jeseníky Mountains and combines daytime and night running with sunrise and sunset. The demanding route has 820 metres of elevation gain and is 90% trail, and is suitable for solo runners and pairs. The Kouty nad Desnou resort offers comfortable facilities, including restaurants, accommodation and parking.
course_highlights: 14.7 km loop with 820 m of elevation gain
90% trail surface
Views from the upper Dlouhé Stráně reservoir at an altitude of 1,354 m above sea level
additional: Registration runs from 1 May 2026 to 30 August 2026, or until capacity is reached. Every participant must have a GPS tracker, which is activated on race day during check-in. The race package includes a cable car voucher for viewing the course. Teammates in pairs may take turns as often as they like. Participants must follow the rules on the course and carry a working mobile phone. The organizer provides maps and marks the route with white spray paint and yellow course markers. At the finish, participants must return their chip and GPS tracker. The race takes place on 3 October 2026, offers accommodation options nearby, and is associated with support for MORAVA FLOW projects.

name: Běh kolem Hejtmanu
location: Chlum u Třeboně, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh kolem Hejtmanu is a traditional sporting event held in Chlum u Třeboně in the Třeboň region, always on the second Saturday in October. The main event is a 10 km race with a time limit of 1 hour and 20 minutes, running along local roads and pond dams through a picturesque setting. The race is open to the public and takes place amid normal road traffic, with an emphasis on safety and compliance with the rules. Shorter races are arranged for children and young people up to 15 years old, with on-site registration on race day. The event is organized by TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně, z.s.
course_highlights: The main race route crosses the dam of Hejtman Pond and the dam of Staňkovský Pond
The race follows local roads with picturesque views of the Třeboň region
The start and finish are at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium
additional: Race-day registration takes place from 8:30 to 10:15 at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium, where race numbers and timing chips are issued for the main 10 km race. Competitors participate at their own risk and must comply with road traffic regulations. Competitors under 18 must be accompanied by a legal guardian or provide a declaration from one. The race follows local roads and a cinder track; registration is available on-site or online. The start is at the stadium grounds, and races of varying distances are open to all age groups.

name: ČEZ RunTour Praha
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: ČEZ RunTour Prague is a family-friendly running race offering courses for recreational runners and elite athletes over 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, as well as children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ladronka Park and is part of a nationwide series spanning eight unique locations. The organizers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, with an accompanying programme and a charitable dimension. Every participant receives a race pack and can support charity by taking part.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km courses in Ladronka Park
Children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres
Excellent service, including pacers and a medical team
additional: Pacers, a medical team and refreshment stations are available on the course (1 station for the 5 and 10 km races, at least 2 for the half marathon). Every runner receives a gymsack with gifts; children receive a race pack from Lidl. A children’s zone, warm-ups for children and an accompanying programme for families are available. A special emergency medical service phone line is set up for the race. More courses, family activities, charity support, medals, photos, refreshments and facilities for participants.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - říjen
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of less than two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and a 9:00 start. Every participant will be rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake for their effort.
course_highlights: Precisely measured 3.2 km (2-mile) asphalt loop
The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone
The children’s course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children aged 12 and under. Each runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the men’s, women’s, and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). A regular monthly race, 3.2 km course, road surface, a run for all age groups, 800 m children’s course, access by bike, car, or trolleybus No. 11.

name: Běh na Čerťák
location: Flemmichova zahrada, Rýmařov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma pro děti do 14 let, 150 Kč pro ostatní při online přihlášení, 200 Kč při prezenci na místě

price_tiers.distance: všechny kategorie mimo děti do 14 let

description: Běh na Čerťák is a traditional race organized by AK Běžci z Rýmařova, held in the grounds of Flemmich Garden in Rýmařov. The race offers courses for various age categories, from preschoolers to seniors, with the main route running along forest paths and over the summit of Kamenná hora. The race starts in the SKI Flemmich Garden grounds, and the course includes field tracks, meadows and forest trails with beautiful views. Refreshments are provided after the race, followed by the awards ceremony at the SKI grounds. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners, and category winners receive prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the SKI Flemmich Garden grounds
Route over the summit of Kamenná hora (799 m above sea level), passing the Čerťák balancing rock
Forest and field paths with beautiful views
additional: Registration takes place at the facilities in the SKI grounds at Flemmich Garden from 9:30 to 10:30. Men’s categories D and E and all women run the shortened course. After the race, refreshments are provided: beer, soft drinks, coffee and tea. The awards ceremony takes place at the SKI grounds after all runners have finished. The course includes forest paths and meadows. Online registration is open until 3.10.2025. The start is in the SKI grounds at Flemmich Garden. The race takes place on 3 October 2026.

name: Benešovská osmička
location: Benešov u Semil, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Benešovská osmička is a traditional cross-country race in Benešov u Semil, held for more than half a century. The race offers courses for the whole family, from preschool children to veterans, with the main 8,000-meter race running through the picturesque countryside around the village and along the slopes of Benešov Hill. The start and race facilities are at the sports complex in Horní Benešov. Prizes are awarded, and light refreshments are available for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: The main 8,000 m course runs mostly over meadows and farm and forest tracks of varying quality
Children’s courses follow paved paths within the sports complex
The area around the village and the slopes of Benešov Hill (567 m above sea level)
additional: Registration and check-in take place at the start venue from 12:30, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. The race is divided into categories: preschool children (50 and 100 m), youth (400–1,200 m), juniors, women, men, and veterans (2,250 m and 8,000 m courses). The first three finishers in each category receive prizes. Light refreshments are available for participants and spectators. Courses from 50 m to 8 km, a family event, refreshments, prizes.

name: Běh města Příbrami
price_range: dospělí - předem 200 Kč, na místě 300 Kč; štafety - předem 400 Kč, na místě 600 Kč; děti a studenti zdarma; rodinné startovné 200 Kč
description: The Příbram City Run is a traditional running race, held for the 32nd year in the picturesque surroundings of Nový rybník in Příbram. The race offers various categories, including the 10 km main race, relays, and children’s races, welcoming a wide range of runners. The event is suitable for families, students, and individuals looking to enjoy a sporting day in a friendly atmosphere. Start times and check-in are tailored to the different categories to ensure everything runs smoothly and in an orderly manner.
course_highlights: 10 km main race in the natural surroundings of Nový rybník
Categories for children and adults, as well as family and student relays
Traditional race with a history of more than thirty years
additional: Check-in is from 8:00 to 10:30 for children and from 10:30 to 11:00 for adults. The schoolchildren’s category starts at 9:00; the 10 km main race and relays start at 11:30. Family relay teams must be made up of relatives. Student relay teams must consist of students from primary, secondary, or higher education institutions; student status may be checked at check-in. Starts from 8:00; the 10 km main race starts at 11:30; registration is from 8:00 to 10:30. Various categories, including relays and children’s races.

name: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run
location: Liberec, Jizerské hory, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run is a race in nature, offering runners the chance to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy running along forest trails in the Jizera Mountains. It is the final race of the season and leads through the forest, around a reservoir, through a granite quarry, and back. Runners can choose between a shorter 12 km route and a longer 22 km route, allowing them to test their strength amid beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: Forest trails in the Jizera Mountains
Running around the reservoir
Passing through a granite quarry
additional: The race takes place on 3 October 2026, with staggered starts from 10:00 to 12:15. Two routes are available: 12 km and 22 km. The event includes an accompanying program and a virtual package. The race is part of the RunCzech running league and is in its ninth year, with approximately 2,000 participants. The terrain includes forest trails. The race offers various categories, registration is possible using a code, and the race map is available in JPG/PNG and GPX formats. The event also includes family races.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - říjen
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open race for all ages and running levels. It’s for people who run for fun and want to improve their personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. The course follows Stromovka’s paved paths. Adults run two laps (3.2 km), while children up to 12 years old run one lap (1.6 km). After the race, everyone gets a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward. The race is part of the year-round Lívancový pohár, which encourages regular participation and reflection on performance.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
A warm cinnamon pancake for all participants after the race
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská brána area from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by rollerblades, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský ostrov on Za elektrárnou Street. Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage service, and toilet cabins are available. Categories are divided by age and gender, every participant is timed, and results are published online. Times adjusted using an age coefficient count toward the Lívancový pohár. The course is 3.2 km long and starts in Stromovka Park. Registration is available in advance or on site. The race is suitable for all age groups and running levels.
