description: SILESIA Cross 1/2 Marathon is a traditional cross-country running race held in Opava-Kylešovice, with its hub at the U Chovatelů grounds. The race offers 21 km and 13 km courses that pass through scenic locations such as Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka and Opava. The course is challenging and partly follows roads open to traffic. Participants must follow fair-play rules and respect nature. Times are recorded electronically without chips, and the awards ceremony takes place at the finish area. The 2026 race has been cancelled, but information about previous editions and courses is available.
course_highlights: The route passes through Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka and Opava
The race takes place on roads open to traffic, with electronic timekeeping and no chips
Course changes have been made because of fenced private property; the 21 km course does not go to Raduň Chateau
additional: Race-day registration takes place at the race centre on Friday from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday from 7:30 to 9:00. The start is at the sports field behind the primary school in Raduň, and the finish is at the U Chovatelů grounds in Opava-Kylešovice. The race takes place on roads open to traffic, and participants run at their own risk. Times are recorded electronically without chips. Because there are few entrants in the shorter races, the 750 m, 1,500 m, 3 km and 5 km races start directly at the finish area. The course is marked year-round, with additional temporary markings and course marshals provided for race day. From 1 October 2025, entry fees increase to 350 CZK for 21 km, 250 CZK for 13 km and 150 CZK for the shorter distances. If the entry fee is paid by 26 September, participants can have their name printed on their race number. Registration usually takes place in October. The event offers various distances and is known for its distinctive cross-country terrain. In the past, course changes have been made because of private property.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
location: Zámecký park ve Vlašimi, Vlašim, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Through the Chateau Park is a race through the picturesque grounds of Vlašim Chateau Park. The 8.4 km course combines off-road and paved sections, offering runners a varied experience. The race is organized by Atletika Vlašim, z.s., and is included in the official Czech Running calendar. It is suitable for runners looking to enjoy a run in a beautiful park with a historic atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through Vlašim Chateau Park
A combination of off-road and paved sections
Course length: 8.4 km
additional: The race is part of a running series and offers various course lengths, including off-road and paved sections.

name: Z(a)tracené vrchy
description: Z(a)tracené vrchy is an adrenaline-fueled orienteering, beer-drinking running, walking and crawling race for teams, held in the scenic terrain of Bordovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. Competitors must complete the course carrying a 10-litre keg of beer on their backs, take part in mini-games at checkpoints and drink beer at the checkpoints. The race combines a physical challenge with teamwork and fun, with a route through varied terrain featuring climbs and descents. The winning team receives a travelling trophy and gift packages. The event is for adults over 18 and emphasises participant safety and responsibility.
course_highlights: The course runs through varied terrain with climbs and descents
Complete the course carrying a 10-litre keg of beer on your back
Five checkpoints with mini-games and beer drinking
additional: Mandatory gear includes a charged phone, a tap (bayonet fitting), a pump, a keg harness, a rubbish bag and a headlamp. Recommended gear includes a basic first-aid kit, water and nutritious food. Beer may be consumed only at checkpoints, where it is served from a single competition vessel in portions of max. 0.5 l. Keg collection takes place from 7:30 to 7:35 at the start location. The race is for competitors over 18 who sign a declaration accepting personal responsibility. The use of transport is prohibited, except for trekking poles. The event is part of an ultratrail series, with results from 2024 available, and is aimed at experienced runners seeking a challenge in demanding terrain.

name: Běh Pístovickou riviérou
location: Pístovice, Vyškov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Pístovická Riviera Run is a traditional cross-country race along forest roads above the Pístovická Riviera recreational area in Pístovice near Vyškov. The race is open to everyone who enjoys healthy exercise, from children to adults, and takes place in all weather conditions. The course is uneven, with possible puddles and mud, and includes running and walking uphill and downhill. The organizers from the Vyškov Ski Club warmly invite runners and spectators to take part and support sport in the region.
course_highlights: Forest roads above the Pístovická Riviera recreational area
Uneven terrain with possible puddles and mud
Cross-country course with uphill and downhill sections
additional: The course is not closed, and participants must follow the organizers’ instructions. The race takes place regardless of the weather; only extreme conditions may result in postponement or cancellation. Runners under 15 must be accompanied by someone over 18. Participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. The race number must be worn visibly on the chest. Skates, bicycles, trekking poles, and taking shortcuts are prohibited. The race is open to all age groups and offers a varied program, refreshments, and activities for children. The event is supported by the City of Vyškov and Lesy České republiky, s.p.

name: Cibulka - Košířský okruh
description: Cibulka - Košířský okruh is a popular running race held in Prague’s Košíře district, offering a course approximately 4.5 km long. The race is part of a series of local running events and is intended both for recreational runners and for those looking to improve their performance in a natural setting. The course follows forest roads and trails around the Cibulka lookout tower, providing a pleasant and varied setting for running. The event is suitable for all ages and running levels, with an emphasis on the joy of exercising outdoors.
course_highlights: An approximately 4.5 km course featuring forest roads and trails
Natural surroundings near the Cibulka lookout tower in Prague 5
Open to both recreational and competitive runners
additional: The race takes place in Prague 5-Košíře, with the start near the 'U lesíka' stop.

name: Běh za bořetickým burčákem
price_range: 150 Kč / 6 EUR pro hlavní závod, zdarma pro mládežnické kategorie
description: The Run for Bořetice Burčák is a traditional sporting event held in the picturesque wine-growing village of Bořetice, in the heart of the Blue Mountains. The run gives participants the chance to experience the beautiful landscape of vineyards and wine cellars characteristic of this part of South Moravia. The event is organized by the Bořetice Municipal Cultural Commission, SDH Bořetice, and the Republic of Kraví hora, and is part of the village’s rich cultural calendar. The run is scheduled to start in the afternoon on October 3, 2026, at Sólo by the cultural centre.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque wine-growing countryside of Bořetice and Kraví hora
Surroundings of wine cellars and fertile vineyards
Start and finish by the cultural centre in Bořetice
additional: The event is organized by the Bořetice Municipal Cultural Commission, SDH Bořetice, and the Republic of Kraví hora. The start is at Sólo by the cultural centre. Bořetice has a rich cultural and sporting programme, complemented by other events throughout the year. The race takes place on asphalt; registration opens at 13:20. There is a bouncy castle for children, and after the race participants can taste burčák and local specialities.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Biegnij Warszawo is one of Poland’s best-known running events, bringing together thousands of participants in the heart of the capital every year. The race takes place on the first Saturday of October and features a 10-kilometre route through Warsaw’s most iconic locations. The FUNRUN format focuses on the joy of movement, without pressure or competition, and encourages participants to run, walk or jog at their own pace. Along the route, participants are supported by music zones, cheering spectators and motivating partner stations, and everyone receives a commemorative Nike Dri-FIT T-shirt and a medal at the finish.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Warsaw’s most atmospheric and iconic locations
Music zones and cheering spectators along the entire route
A hydration station halfway through the distance and comprehensive medical support
additional: The race pack includes a Nike Dri-FIT T-shirt with a commemorative print, a race bib with a timing chip, partner gifts and a commemorative medal. Race packs can be collected at Legia Sports Bar at Legia Warsaw Stadium from 29 September to 3 October 2026; early collection is recommended. Drivers using the food and drink facilities get 2 hours of free parking. The route is certified by PZLA and is beginner-friendly. The event brings together more than 6,000 participants, and the route has been changed to the right bank of the Vistula, with strong involvement from ING employees and a charity fundraiser.

name: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazow...
location: Czerwonka Włościańska, Gmina Błędów, Mazowieckie, Poland
price_range: 40 zł – przelew online do dnia 25.09.2025 r., 60 zł – płatne w biurze zawodów

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – przelew online do dnia 25.09.2025 r.

description: The 8th Run Along the Green Trail of the Masovian Lowland is a 5 km race taking place on 27 September 2026 in Czerwonka Włościańska. The start and finish are located at the Primary School in Czerwonka. The event is organised by local sports clubs and institutions, and the course runs through the scenic Masovian Lowland. The event is open to adults and young people over 15 with the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Start and finish at the Primary School in Czerwonka Włościańska
Scenic terrain of the Masovian Lowland
additional: The race office is located on the school sports field in Czerwonka. Participant check-in takes place from 08:30 to 10:00. An awards ceremony for the winners, followed by a summary and closing of the event, is planned after the race. The participant limit is 200. Timing is provided using a modern UHF RFID system with passive chips; results are displayed immediately at the finish and sent to participants by SMS. Details: 5 km course, registration from 8:30 to 10:00, limit of 200 participants, minimum age 15 with a guardian’s consent, payment online or at the race office.

name: XIII Podbieg na Makowicę
location: Rytro, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Podbieg na Makowicę is a 10 km mountain race taking place on October 3, 2026, in Rytro, Małopolska. The course has a challenging profile with uphill sections, making it an excellent challenge for runners who enjoy mountain routes. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running and supports runners in their preparations.
course_highlights: A 10 km mountain route
Challenging uphill sections
Scenic views around Rytro
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to a runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support. The organizer encourages runners to use the TreningBiegacza.pl platform, which offers preparation support and race information management. The event focuses on trail running, and registration details have not yet been provided. The race is an opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful surroundings of Rytro.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
JÁSZFÉNYSZARUI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.6 km, 0.3 km
organizer: Petőfi Sándor Művelődési Ház és Könyvtár Jászfényszaru
description: The 7th Jászfényszaru Running Festival is a recreational running event held at Szentcsalád Square in Jászfényszaru. It offers distances for several age groups, from preschoolers to adults, on paved roads and short dirt sections. The quarter-marathon features chip timing, refreshment points, and medals. All distances are free. The event aims to promote community sport and running, and is held in memory of István Maróti.
course_highlights: A mostly paved route with short dirt sections
Several distances for age groups from preschoolers to adults
Refreshment points and chip timing on the quarter-marathon distance
additional: On-site registration is available on race day from 13:00 and closes 15 minutes before each race starts. Quarter-marathon finishers receive a finisher’s package and a medal. The top three finishers in each age group and gender category receive medals. Bibs must be worn visibly on the front. Each participant may enter only one distance. Medical supervision is provided. The event offers several distances on paved and dirt roads, with online and on-site registration. The organizers provide medical supervision and refreshment points.

name: MAPEI TIHANYI FÉLMARATON (XI.)   .
location: Club Tihany, Tihany, Veszprém County, Hungary
description: The MAPEI Tihany Half Marathon is a traditional running race held for the 11th time in Tihany, offering a range of distances for everyone from beginners to experienced runners. The race stands out for the beautiful panoramas of the Balaton Uplands and its challenging, varied terrain, which takes in some of the peninsula’s most scenic areas. Many runners choose the half marathon as their first, as the course and its spectacular sections make for an unforgettable experience. The event is family-friendly, with a Baby Run for the youngest participants. Runners in every distance receive a finisher’s medal, refreshments and a running T-shirt.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route takes in some of Tihany’s most scenic stretches and varied panoramas, including the shore of Lake Balaton and the northern tip of the peninsula.
The 12 km route is the “Tihany Loop,” offering a challenge with elevation changes and varied terrain.
The 3 km and 5 km routes are easy-to-complete paved courses, ideal for beginners and those returning to running.
additional: All distances include a finisher’s medal and a running T-shirt. The 3K starts at 11:00, and the 5K, 12K and 21K start at 12:00; the 21K has a wave start. The 400-metre Baby Run takes place at the race centre, with refreshments at the finish. Age-group awards are presented, and participants under 18 need a parental consent form. Field sizes are limited to 1,500 participants, except for the Baby Run. The race follows paved roads on the Tihany Peninsula, with varied elevation and panoramic views. Distances: 400 m, 3 km, 5 km, 12 km and 21 km. The race takes place on October 3, 2026, at Club Tihany.

name: MVM Sopron Félmaraton
location: Városi Stadion, Káposztás u. 4., Sopron, Hungary

name: Medzinárodný maratón mieru
description: Medzinárodný maratón mieru v Košiciach je tradičný bežecký sviatok, ktorý sa koná 4. októbra 2026 na Hlavnej ulici. Organizovaný Maratónskym klubom Košice, ponúka maratónsku trať, polmaratón a ďalšie disciplíny, pričom štart a cieľ sú situované v centre mesta. Podujatie je známe svojou dlhou históriou a kvalitnou organizáciou, vrátane Majstrovstiev Slovenska v polmaratóne. Bežci môžu očakávať profesionálnu časomieru a bohatý sprievodný program.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ na Hlavnej ulici medzi DoubleTree by Hilton a obchodným domom Dargov
Majstrovstvá Slovenska v polmaratóne sú súčasťou podujatia
Trať je certifikovaná podľa pravidiel World Athletics a Slovenského atletického zväzu
additional: Štart a cieľ sú na Hlavnej ulici v Košiciach. Organizátor zabezpečuje profesionálnu časomieru. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj Majstrovstvá Slovenska v polmaratóne. K dispozícii sú vekové kategórie a špeciálne kategórie pre štafety a handbike. Registrácia je možná online a platba je možná kartou, Google Pay, Apple Pay a registračným kódom. Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne kategórie vrátane maratónu, polmaratónu, štafety a inline disciplín, s možnosťou online registrácie a zmeny štartu či disciplíny v stanovených termínoch.

name: OLFINCAR HRADECKÝ PŮL/MARATON
location: Malšovický stadion, Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: OLFINCAR Hradec Half Marathon is the largest sporting event in Eastern Bohemia and has been held since 2013. The event offers certified courses for the marathon, half marathon, relay, 10 km race and children’s races. The course is among the fastest in the Czech Republic and is considered one of the most beautiful urban courses. In 2026, the event will also host the Czech Veterans’ Half Marathon Championships and the Czech Championships for Emergency and Security Services in the half marathon. The facilities at the new football arena in the city centre provide runners with comfortable services.
course_highlights: Certified courses with a fast profile
The course is among the fastest in the Czech Republic
Facilities at the new football arena in the centre of Hradec Králové
additional: Start times: 11:15 (marathon), 12:30 (half marathon and 10 km), 12:40 (charity run). Facilities include changing rooms, luggage storage, toilets, catering, parking and clothing sales. The race package includes an original medal, a gift, a race number and an electronic timing chip. Refreshments are provided during the race and at the finish. Photos and a downloadable certificate are available (a photo is not guaranteed for every participant). There is an accompanying programme and prizes for 1st–3rd place in the categories. Races include the half marathon, marathon, 10 km and children’s races, with a limit of 3,500 runners, chip timing and certified courses.

name: Horský běh Alfrédka - Memoriál Miroslava Čermáka
location: Stará Ves u Rýmařova, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Alfrédka Mountain Run – Miroslav Čermák Memorial is a race run mainly on forest roads, covering 13.6 km with 430 m of elevation gain. It is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Endurance Runners and the Czech Cup in Mountain Running. The challenging course winds through the beautiful countryside of the Moravian-Silesian Region, appealing to fans of mountain running and endurance events. The race takes place in Stará Ves near Rýmařov and is suitable for experienced runners looking for an off-road challenge.
course_highlights: 13.6 km course, mainly on forest roads
430 m of elevation gain
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Endurance Runners and the Czech Cup in Mountain Running
additional: The race is part of running series and cups. It takes place on October 4, 2026.

name: Běh okolo Panoramy
description: The Run Around Panorama is a traditional cross-country race on challenging mountain terrain around the Jáchymov football stadium. The race is open to all age groups and is being held for the 33rd year. The event is organised by the Jáchymov Physical Education Union and offers sporting activities in the beautiful setting of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain terrain around the TJ Jáchymov football stadium
Traditional cross-country race with a long history (33rd edition)
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race starts at the TJ Jáchymov football pitch. The event is open to the general public and all age groups. The race takes place on challenging mountain terrain in the Ore Mountains around Jáchymov. It is suitable for all age groups; registration is not explicitly mentioned, and the course runs through the mountain terrain around Jáchymov.

description: The Run through the Orlice Valley is a traditional cross-country race held in Klášterec nad Orlicí. Its courses follow meadows and local roads over hilly terrain. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. Winners can look forward to medals, prizes in kind and cash prizes. The start and finish are at the football pitch by the school, and the main race starts in the morning.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses on meadows and local roads
3 km loop with 60 m of elevation gain
A mix of flat and hilly sections on grass and dirt tracks
additional: On-site registration from 8:30. The main race starts at 11:15. Prizes for winners include diplomas, medals, prizes in kind and cash prizes for the best runners in the 6 km and 9 km races. The 9 km course consists of three 3 km loops, and the 6 km course consists of two loops. The 3 km loop has 60 m of elevation gain. Hilly terrain, trail/cross-country, various course distances, on-site registration, refreshments and a draw of race numbers

name: Slatinský kros
location: Park Terénky, Dědická, Brno-Slatina, Brno, Czech Republic
description: Slatinský kros is a traditional cross-country running race held in Brno-Slatina, now in its 19th year. The race takes place in Terénky Park on Dědická Street and features a grassy course with a rolling profile that challenges runners in pleasant natural surroundings. It is held under the patronage of the Brno-Slatina Municipal District and is suitable for the general public. Participants can look forward to trophies, medals, and valuable prizes.
course_highlights: Grassy course with a rolling profile
Terénky Park in Brno-Slatina
Cross-country running in natural surroundings
additional: Prizes include trophies, medals, and valuable prizes. Online registration will open in summer 2026. The race is held under the patronage of the Brno-Slatina Municipal District. The race offers trophies, medals, and prizes; registration is available online, and the course runs through Terénky Park in Brno-Slatina.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - říjen
description: The Olomouc 2 Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The event focuses on the joy of running and competing primarily against yourself. It takes place in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc by the fountain, except for some races in June and August, which are held by the river. The race is part of a cup competition, where results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.2 km) course, with a 600 m children’s category
Race venue: Smetana Gardens in Olomouc by the fountain
Races by the river on U Dětského domova Street in June and August
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 on race day. The top three places are announced in each category. Results are adjusted using an age coefficient, and points are accumulated as part of the cup competition for the period September 2025 to August 2026. The course follows paved paths in Smetana Gardens; registration is voluntary, and the race takes place on 4 October 2026. A 600 m children’s race is also included.

name: Roštejnské stráně
location: Ranč u Lipek, Telč, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Roštejnské stráně is a traditional cross-country race organized by Orel Telč and part of the Orel Running League. This 14th edition takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ranč u Lipek in Telč and offers various race categories, including family relays and a recreational run for beginners. The race is open to all age groups and emphasizes fair play and sportsmanship. Medals, diplomas, and prizes are prepared for the winners, along with special awards for the youngest and oldest runners.
course_highlights: Start at Ranč u Lipek in Telč
Cross-country race on natural terrain
Part of the Orel Running League
additional: Categories include children’s races, family relays (teams of 3, including one child aged 12 or under), and a recreational run for beginners over 18. Start times are approximate and fall between 12:30 and 13:20; participants are advised to arrive at least half an hour before their start. Each runner participates at their own risk and is responsible for their health. The race is part of the Orel Running League; start times are between 12:30 and 13:20, and the event emphasizes fair play and sportsmanship.

name: Běh kolem Lužnice
location: TJ Lokomotiva stadion, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around the Lužnice is a traditional running race organized by the Atletika Veselí athletics club in Veselí nad Lužnicí. The race offers runners of all ages a unique opportunity to enjoy the beautiful countryside and sporting atmosphere at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium. The club has a long-standing commitment to athletics and running races, with an emphasis on high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and children alike.
course_highlights: The route runs around the Lužnice amid beautiful natural scenery
Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium in Veselí nad Lužnicí
Friendly atmosphere and support from the Atletika Veselí athletics club
additional: Athletics training takes place outdoors at the stadium according to the spring schedule. Parking is available in the TJ Lokomotiva sports complex. The club also offers club caps and headbands for sale. Payments and registration are handled electronically through club membership. The race is open to all age groups, with registration available via the website. The start is at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium, and runners can choose between the 8.09 km and 5.67 km courses.

name: Huť - Bratříkov - Huť
location: Huti, Jablonec nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: Huť-Bratříkov-Huť is a traditional cross-country race held every year on the first Sunday in October in Huť, near Jablonec nad Nisou. The race, which dates back to 1972, features a 10 km main race and shorter distances for various age groups. The course runs through picturesque countryside, with a grass field serving as the start and finish venue. The event is suitable for runners of all ages, from children to adults, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: 10 km main race through picturesque countryside
Traditionally held on the first Sunday in October
Start and finish on the grass field by the fire station in Huť
additional: Entries and race bibs are handled at the start venue. Children’s races register from 08:10 to 09:00; other categories register from 08:10 until 15 minutes before their start. The program begins with a group assembly at 09:10. Categories include preschool children, youth, unregistered men and women, and the 10 km main race. The event takes place on the first Sunday in October on the grass field by the fire station in Huť, with online registration available. The course is highly undulating and follows mainly forest and meadow paths, making it suitable for trail runners.

name: Festiwal Biegowy JuraRun 2026
distance_verbose: 50 mil, 50 mil, Maraton, 23 km, Półmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: The JuraRun Running Festival is a unique sporting event held in the heart of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland, bringing together a passion for running, competition and the satisfaction of pushing your limits. In 2026, as many as 9 different running events are planned, with distances ranging from 5 km to over 100 km, as well as Nordic Walking and a night run. The routes pass through scenic landscapes, limestone rocks, forests and Jurassic hills, offering both technical challenges and beautiful views. The festival is open to runners of all ability levels and features a varied programme of events and attractive race packages.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the forests, limestone rocks and picturesque castles of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
JuraRun ULTRA 100+ is an ultra of over 100 km with minimal asphalt, requiring technical skill and endurance
The JuraRun ULTRA 100+ route includes, among other places, Mount Zborów (467 m above sea level) and the distinctive Rzędkowice Rocks
additional: Starts take place in waves; for example, the JuraRun Night 10+ night run starts at 21:00. The race package includes, among other things, timekeeping, medical support, aid stations, a medal, a post-race meal and the option to purchase personalised technical apparel. Ultra routes have mandatory equipment that is checked before the start. During the festival, there are activities, an expo and talks on running and a healthy lifestyle. 9 sporting events, options to split participation into stages, talks and meetings about running and a healthy lifestyle, online registration

name: Festiwal Biegowy Silesia Marathon 2026
description: Silesia Marathon is the largest running event in Silesia. In 2026, it will take place as a three-day running festival. Participants can choose from a range of distances, including the marathon, half marathon, ultramarathon, and 10 km and 5 km races. The finish line is at the iconic Silesian Stadium, giving the event a distinctive character. It is not only a competition, but also an unforgettable experience and a celebration of the running community.
course_highlights: Finish at the Silesian Stadium in Chorzów
A range of distances: marathon, half marathon, ultramarathon, 10K and 5K
A three-day running festival with many attractions
additional: In 2026, Silesia Marathon will take place as a three-day running festival for the first time, offering more distances and options to choose a race suited to participants’ abilities and goals. Participants receive a race pack, including a free technical T-shirt when they enter the half marathon, marathon or ultramarathon. Registration opens on 15 December 2025. The event includes various race categories, with regulations and courses available on the website. Participants can expect support and attractions throughout the event.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The 25th Maciej Frankiewicz Poznań Marathon is the jubilee 25th edition of the classic 42.195 km distance, taking place on 4 October 2026 in Poznań. For a quarter of a century, the race has brought together thousands of runners and spectators, offering a new, attractive course that starts and finishes at the Poznań International Fair grounds. The organisers provide professional medical support, timekeeping and a comprehensive race pack. It is a special sporting celebration, with enthusiastic support from Poznań’s spectators and a rich tradition.
course_highlights: A new, attractive course starting and finishing at the Poznań International Fair grounds
The classic marathon distance of 42.195 km
A jubilee 25th edition with a rich tradition and enthusiastic support from local spectators
additional: The race pack includes a race number with a chip, safety pins, sponsor materials, professional timekeeping, medical support, and refreshment stations offering isotonic drinks, water, chocolate, fruit and sugar. The organiser provides free overnight accommodation for 600 people in POSiR sports halls on 3–4 October 2026; participants must bring their own mats and sleeping bags. There are numerous car parks near the Poznań International Fair grounds, with different rates. OK Poznań programme participants receive a 25% discount, while people aged 60 and over receive a 50% discount. The official marathon T-shirt can be ordered until 1 September 2026 for PLN 70. Registration is open until 1 October 2026. Discounts are available for seniors and programme participants, along with official merchandise and sportswear. Side events include Poznań Run Expo and the Kids Marathon.

description: Wild Run is a charity race held in Wrocław, with a course through Wrocław Zoo. The event supports the protection of endangered animal species living in Poland, and participants can also run virtually on a route of their choice. The main race consists of two laps of approximately 5 km each. Children’s and youth races are also held. All participants receive commemorative medals, and the top runners receive prizes from sponsors.
course_highlights: The main race is two laps of approximately 5 km each through Wrocław Zoo
Virtual 10 km race on a route of your choice
Children’s (100 m) and youth races (approximately 1 km), with medals and prizes
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 12:00 to 15:30 at the zoo ticket offices. An upgraded pack can be ordered with a T-shirt, towel or race-number belt. Participants in the main race are asked to return their race numbers, which will be reused in future editions. Race packs for the virtual race are shipped according to the date of registration. The event includes a variety of attractions, costume contests, support for animal conservation, and the option to take part in the virtual race. The race is part of initiatives promoting nature conservation and an active lifestyle.

name: XRUN Wielki Finał
location: Domu Zdrojowego CECHINI, Żegiestów-Zdrój, Małopolskie, Poland
description: The XRUN Grand Finale is a mountain trail race taking place on 4 October 2026 in Żegiestów-Zdrój, with its base at the CECHINI Spa House. Participants can choose from four distances: 40 km with 1,800 m of elevation gain, 28 km with 1,300 m of elevation gain, 18 km with 900 m of elevation gain, and shorter distances for children. The routes pass through scenic mountains, featuring technical descents and challenging climbs, making the race appealing to fans of mountain challenges. The event is a great way to round off the running season, combining intensity with the beauty of mountain nature.
course_highlights: 40 km route with 1,800 m of elevation gain; start at 08:00; 8-hour time limit
28 km route with 1,300 m of elevation gain; start at 09:00; 6-hour time limit
18 km route with 900 m of elevation gain; start at 09:30; 4-hour time limit
additional: The race office and the start/finish for all distances are at the CECHINI Spa House. Age categories for children aged 3 to 15, with distances of 150, 300, 500, 800 and 1,000 m. Time limits for the respective distances: 8 hours (40 km), 6 hours (28 km), 4 hours (18 km). The routes pass through Pusta Wielka, Jaworzynka, the PTTK mountain hut above Wierchomla and other mountain trails. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants need written permission from a guardian. The event also includes KIDS family races and is the finale of a series of mountain races in Poland, bringing the season to a close at the highest sporting and community level.

description: The 15th Legnica Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Legnica, attracting runners from various parts of Poland. The half-marathon course runs through the city’s picturesque streets, giving participants the chance to test their endurance and enjoy the sporting atmosphere. The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Legnica, which ensures professional organization and the safety of participants. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the running community together.

A flat course profile conducive to achieving good results
Picturesque urban views and a sporting atmosphere
additional: The race pack includes a race bib, a timing chip and a commemorative medal. Refreshment and medical stations are available along the course. A post-race meal is provided for participants. The participant limit is set, and registration is online. Race registration, date: 2026-10-04, location: Legnica, various distances available, event promoted on Facebook.

description: The Berounka - Tetín running series is a community trail race held on October 5, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Tetín. The route runs over hills and offers stunning views of the Bohemian Karst and the surrounding countryside, including a climb to the viewpoint overlooking Beroun. The race is part of a series of 12 runs that encourage runners of all levels to get active outdoors in a friendly atmosphere, with facilities at local pubs. Refreshments, baggage storage, and prizes for the top finishers in each category are available on site.
course_highlights: The route crosses Damil Hill, with views of Tetín and the Bohemian Karst
The highest point is near the village of Na Koledníku, followed by a mostly downhill route
A picturesque viewpoint overlooking Beroun and the surrounding countryside comes before the final descent to the finish
additional: The route is marked with red-and-white and yellow reflective markings, as well as red arrows on the ground. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. Bringing a headlamp is recommended. The first three finishers in each category receive a certificate and medals. This trail race has a marked route and starts at Hospůdka u Plotice. It features hilly terrain and beautiful views. Registration is via voucher. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site; bringing a headlamp is recommended.

name: Mrdická mašina
location: Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Mrdická Mašina is a fast 2.0 km run across the Mrdice meadows in Heřmanův Městec. The race is part of the Heřmanův Městec Sports League, which includes ten athletics and cycling races around the Mrdice fortress site. The race is open to the general public and offers a fun sporting challenge for all runners. It is organized by Běžecký klub Heřmanův Městec, which promotes running and sports activities in the region.
course_highlights: 2.0 km run across the Mrdice meadows
Part of the Heřmanův Městec Sports League, with 10 races
Around the historic Mrdice fortress site
additional: The race is for all running enthusiasts. Registration is available in the race information, and the course runs across meadows and forest paths around Heřmanův Městec.

name: Javornícka stovka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatok za štart jedného účastníka je 79 EUR.

description: Javornícka stovka je horský ultramaratón a diaľkový pochod, ktorý sa koná v oblasti Javorníkov. Bežci prechádzajú náročným horským terénom s viacerými kontrolnými bodmi a časovými limitmi. Podujatie je určené pre skúsených bežcov, ktorí hľadajú výzvu v krásnej prírode. Štart aj prezentácia prebiehajú v Čadci, cieľ je v Lysej pod Makytou. Organizátori kladú dôraz na bezpečnosť, povinnú výbavu a zdravotnú pomoc počas celej trasy.
course_highlights: Horský terén Javorníkov s viacerými kontrolnými bodmi
Cieľ v Lysej pod Makytou
Dlhý časový limit 27 hodín s viacerými etapovými časovými limitmi
additional: Prezentácia účastníkov prebieha v Dome kultúry v Čadci na Matičnom námestí v piatok večer a v sobotu ráno. Štart je spoločný z Čadce o 07:00. Organizátori zabezpečujú prevoz batožiny a dropbagy pre kontrolný bod K4. Počas podujatia je zabezpečená zdravotná pomoc a bezpečnosť. Ubytovanie je možné v Čadci, v telocvični základnej školy je nočný kľud pre účastníkov. Trať zahŕňa 80% lesných ciest, 5% asfaltu a 15% lúk; povinné vybavenie zahŕňa čelovku, reflexné prvky, hydratáciu a prvú pomoc; registrácia bola uzavretá 26. septembra 2025.

description: GARMIN Beh Súľovskými skalami je tradičný bežecký závod v krásnom prostredí Súľovských skál, ktorý ponúka tri trate rôznej dĺžky a náročnosti. Bežci prechádzajú malebnou prírodou s výhľadmi na skalné útvary a hrebeňové chodníky, pričom súčasťou trate sú aj občerstvovacie stanice. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, ktoré majú samostatné kategórie a štarty. Organizátorom je Slovenský cykloklub CYKLO TOUR Súľov - Hradná, ktorý zabezpečuje kvalitnú prípravu a servis pre účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez malebné Súľovské skaly s výhľadmi na skalné útvary a hrebeňové chodníky
Prevýšenie až 850 metrov na najdlhšej 17 km trati
Tri občerstvovacie stanice na trati a samostatné detské kategórie s vlastnými štartmi
additional: Limit účasti je 1200 bežcov na veľký beh a 350 detí na detský beh. Detský beh je bezplatný. Registrácia je platná až po úhrade štartovného. Možnosť osobnej registrácie a platby v deň pred štartom, ak nie je naplnený limit účasti. Štarty detských kategórií sú medzi štartmi veľkého behu. Trať zahŕňa lesné chodníky a krátke asfaltové úseky; registrácia je možná cez oficiálne stránky; podujatie je známe svojou krásnou prírodou a atmosférou

name: Grand Prix – Cabaj-Čápor
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste, zadarmo pre deti a niektoré kategórie
description: Grand Prix Cabaj-Čápor je tradičný krosový beh v krásnej prírode, ktorý sa koná v obci Cabaj-Čápor so štartom pri Salaši Cabaj. Bežci si môžu vybrať z viacerých tratí vrátane 10 km, 3 km a detských behov na 600 m a 1000 m. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetkých, ktorí chcú zažiť atmosféru športu v prírode, či už pre súťaž alebo pre radosť z pohybu. Registrácia je otvorená a počet účastníkov je limitovaný, preto je vhodné sa prihlásiť včas.
course_highlights: Krosový beh v prírode Cabaj-Čápor
Trate 10 km, 3 km a detské behy 600 m a 1000 m
Štart pri Salaši Cabaj
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov začína od 9:00 hod. Počet účastníkov je limitovaný. Účastníci hlavného a hobby behu získavajú účastnícke ocenenie. Podujatie sa koná 10. októbra 2026, registrácia je dostupná online, a pretek je vhodný pre všetky vekové skupiny a úrovne výkonnosti.

Hlavný beh na 3 km pozostávajúci z 3 kôl po 900 m

Detský beh (500 m) začína o 9:30, hlavný beh (3 km) o 9:45; registrácia na mieste; kategórie pre dospelých, deti a seniorov; podujatie je súčasťou jesenného športového kalendára.

name: Beh Myšľou
location: Archeoskanzene Nižná Myšľa, Nižná Myšľa, Slovakia
description: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou je bežecké podujatie organizované Bežeckým klubom obce Vyšná Myšľa a obcou Vyšná Myšľa. Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku v obci Vyšná Myšľa v okrese Košice okolie. Štart detských kategórií je o 14:00 a dospelých o 16:00. Súťažiť môžu muži a ženy v rôznych vekových kategóriách, vrátane štafety dvojíc na 2 x 3 km. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru bežeckého športu v obci.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku v obci Vyšná Myšľa
Štafeta dvojíc na 2 x 3 km
Viacero vekových kategórií pre mužov a ženy
additional: Štartovné neplatia Muži E, Ženy I, členovia BKO Vyšná Myšľa, občania obce Vyšná Myšľa a deti. Štart detí o 14:00, dospelých o 16:00. Pretek má rôzne dĺžky tratí od 350 m po 8 km, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, a podujatie je vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie.

name: Beh za zdravie – Kuchajda
description: Beh za zdravie - Kuchajda je charitatívne bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa koná 11. októbra 2026 v Bratislave na Kuchajde. Tento beh spája šport s podporou zdravia a komunity, pričom jeho cieľom je pomáhať znevýhodneným osobám a organizáciám prostredníctvom pohybu. Účastníci môžu bežať, pomalým tempom alebo prechádzkou, pričom sa vytvára skvelá atmosféra plná inšpiratívnych príbehov a solidarity. Beh za zdravie je otvorený pre všetky vekové kategórie a kondície, a zároveň podporuje charitatívne projekty s reálnym dopadom.
course_highlights: Bežecké podujatie na Kuchajde v Bratislave
Podpora zdravia a komunity prostredníctvom športu
Príležitosť zúčastniť sa bez ohľadu na vek a kondíciu
additional: Podujatie je charitatívne a podporuje znevýhodnené osoby a organizácie. Zúčastniť sa môžu deti, dospelí aj starší, behom, pomalým tempom alebo prechádzkou. Organizátori ponúkajú možnosť stať sa dobrovoľníkom a prispieť tak k úspechu podujatia. Podujatie sa koná na Kuchajde v Bratislave, podporuje zdravie a sociálne znevýhodnené skupiny, registrácia podrobne nie je špecifikovaná.

name: Beh ulicami Krompách
organizer: Mesto Krompachy, Komisia kultúry a športu pri MsZ v Krompachoch

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 5,- € okrem žiakov, dorastencov a pretekárov nad  60 rokov

description: Beh ulicami Krompách je tradičný bežecký pretek v meste Krompachy, ktorý ponúka kategórie pre deti, dorast, juniorov, mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách. Preteky sa konajú pred budovou mestského úradu a sú organizované Mestom Krompachy a Komisiou kultúry a športu pri MsZ v Krompachoch. Štart je rozdelený na detské kategórie a dorast o 9:30 a dospelých o 11:00. Štartovné je symbolické, 5 € okrem žiakov, dorastencov a pretekárov nad 60 rokov. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje športový život v regióne.
course_highlights: Preteky vedú ulicami mesta Krompachy
Štart a cieľ pred budovou mestského úradu
Kategórie pre všetky vekové skupiny od detí po seniorov
additional: Štart je rozdelený na 9:30 pre detské kategórie a dorast a 11:00 pre dospelých. Kategórie sú detailne rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane viacerých vekových skupín mužov a žien. Organizátorom je Mesto Krompachy a Komisia kultúry a športu pri MsZ v Krompachoch. Podujatie sa koná v októbri, s rôznymi kategóriami a začiatkami od 9:00, registrácia je možná prostredníctvom kontaktu s organizátorom. Trať je pravdepodobne mestská a ulicná.

location: Ružomberok, Ružomberok, Pred Hotelom Áčko ( Hrabovská cesta 34 )

name: Roštejnskou oborou
description: The Run through Roštejn Game Preserve is a friendly race for the general public, held in the scenic forests near Růžená in the Vysočina Region. The course follows forest paths and is suitable for all ages from 4 upwards, with distances ranging from 300 metres to 8,900 metres. The event is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and offers a unique opportunity to run in nature and observe local wildlife. It is organised by TJ Růžená, z.s., and is ideal for families and sports enthusiasts who want to combine sport with nature.
course_highlights: Forest terrain with opportunities to observe local wildlife
Distances from 300 m to 8,900 m, suitable for all age groups
Part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup, ideal for families and sports enthusiasts
additional: The race takes place on 9 October 2026 near Růžená. The main race is 7.3 km long, follows forest paths and is suitable for all age groups from 4 upwards.

name: Pražský Kelt
description: Pražský Kelt is a unique 100 km ultra trail in the heart of Prague, offering runners the chance to discover beautiful natural surroundings and Celtic hillforts, with a total elevation gain of 2,500 metres. The route passes through Prague’s wooded, hilly landscape and includes historic sites such as the Šance, Butovice, Závist and Vyšehrad hillforts, as well as others. It offers beautiful views of the city and surrounding nature. The race starts and finishes at the grounds of Kunratice Elementary School and is for runners who want to experience the atmosphere of an ultramarathon in an unconventional urban setting. The race is limited to 120 participants, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 100 km course with 2,500 m of elevation gain through Prague’s wooded hills
A route linking three Celtic hillforts and historic sites in Prague
Beautiful views of Prague from Vyšehrad, Branické skály and other places
additional: The start and finish are at the grounds of Kunratice Elementary School. The race is limited to 120 participants. Take bus 193 from Kačerov station to Kunratická škola (12 minutes). Parking is available around the school. Mandatory equipment is specified in the race rules (section 3.3). The route for the new edition is emailed to registered participants. Aid stations are provided as part of the race and are highly appreciated by participants. The course is 100 km with 2,500 m of elevation gain; aid stations; the option of a distance race; a diploma and medal; registration until 30.9.2026; capacity of 120 participants.

name: Cena Metuje
location: Nové Město nad Metují, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní klub Nové Město nad Metují z.s.
price_range: 300-500 Kč pro dospělé, zdarma pro členy SK Nové Město nad Metují

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 300,- Kč při přihlášení a zaplacení on-line do středy 8.10. 2025, 23:59 hod.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 350,- Kč při přihlášení on-line do soboty 11.10. do 8:00 hod.

tiers.label: tier_2
